title: 沉管隧道預製與浮運
summary: 本課以整合沉管預製質量、浮力、穩性與海事介面為主線，從預製體積與結構質量與排水體積與浮力平衡建立系統邊界，再把吃水變化與水線面、預製溫度與節段變形連到浮運放行與資料一致性。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on integrate immersed-tube fabrication mass, buoyancy, stability and marine interfaces. It begins with Fabrication volume and structural mass and Displacement and buoyancy balance, links Draft change and waterplane area and Fabrication temperature and segment deformation, and ends with Flotation release and record consistency. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查預製體積與結構質量：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t；再獨立檢查排水體積與浮力平衡：displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3。結構質量由 60000 增為 63000 t，海水密度 1.025 t/m3，平衡排水體積由 58536.6 增為 61463.4 m3；質量增加 5% 不代表穩性也改善 5%。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 將比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Fabrication volume and structural mass: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t. Independently check Displacement and buoyancy balance: displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3. Mass rising from 60000 to 63000 t at seawater density 1.025 t/m3 increases displacement from 58536.6 to 61463.4 m3; five percent more mass does not imply five percent better stability. The two results are not a complete design because buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. Use compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預製體積與結構質量」與「排水體積與浮力平衡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fabrication volume and structural mass" and "Displacement and buoyancy balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預製體積與結構質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fabrication volume and structural mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預製體積與結構質量」如何影響沉管隧道預製與浮運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fabrication volume and structural mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮運計算需要所有混凝土、鋼材、設備和臨時構件的質量，不能只採名義混凝土體積。公噸是質量而非力，受力計算還需重力加速度；材料密度與實際幾何誤差應分開追蹤，才可判斷預測吃水差異來源。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳；若出現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預製體積與結構質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone. Tonnes measure mass rather than force; force calculations also require gravity. Track density and geometry errors separately to diagnose differences between predicted and observed draft. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fabrication volume and structural mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預製體積與結構質量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fabrication volume and structural mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預製體積與結構質量
knowledge.text: 浮運計算需要所有混凝土、鋼材、設備和臨時構件的質量，不能只採名義混凝土體積。公噸是質量而非力，受力計算還需重力加速度；材料密度與實際幾何誤差應分開追蹤，才可判斷預測吃水差異來源。
knowledge.textEn: Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone. Tonnes measure mass rather than force; force calculations also require gravity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預製體積與結構質量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fabrication volume and structural mass" is correct?
options: 管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量
浮運計算需要所有混凝土、鋼材、設備和臨時構件的質量，不能只採名義混凝土體積。
能漂浮就代表管節遇到傾斜一定能自行恢復
optionsEn: Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass
Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone.
A floating element necessarily returns upright after any inclination
quiz.explanation: 浮運計算需要所有混凝土、鋼材、設備和臨時構件的質量，不能只採名義混凝土體積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預製體積與結構質量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fabrication volume and structural mass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預製體積與結構質量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fabrication volume and structural mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預製體積與結構質量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fabrication volume and structural mass", which statement holds?
options: 加水壓載一定只會改善而不會降低穩性
浮體整體浮力平衡就足以證明封艙板安全
原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。
optionsEn: Adding water ballast always improves stability and can never reduce it
Global buoyancy balance is sufficient to prove bulkhead safety
Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預製體積與結構質量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fabrication volume and structural mass: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預製體積與結構質量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fabrication volume and structural mass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預製體積與結構質量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fabrication volume and structural mass"?
options: 把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
平均水流阻力小就能保證所有拖航動態荷載都小
optionsEn: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Low mean current drag guarantees small loads in every towing dynamic event
quiz.explanation: 把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預製體積與結構質量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fabrication volume and structural mass: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預製體積與結構質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fabrication volume and structural mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳；若出現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

steps.title: 排水體積與浮力平衡：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Displacement and buoyancy balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 靜浮時浮力等於總重量，所需排水體積由總質量除水密度得到。海水密度隨鹽度和溫度變化，內部進水還會同時改變質量與自由液面；平衡只說明垂直合力，不保證遇擾動後會回復原姿態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將實測水密度、吃水及質量帳共同檢核浮力平衡；若出現沿用錯誤水密度造成吃水預測偏差，局部淨距不足，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水體積與浮力平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At static flotation buoyancy balances total weight, giving displacement as mass divided by water density. Salinity and temperature change density, while internal flooding changes mass and free surfaces. Vertical balance alone does not establish restoration after a disturbance or a safe marine operation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check measured water density and draft against the mass ledger. If incorrect water density biases draft prediction and leaves insufficient local clearance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Displacement and buoyancy balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「能漂浮就代表管節遇到傾斜一定能自行恢復」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A floating element necessarily returns upright after any inclination" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水體積與浮力平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Unchanged total mass means flotation stability is completely unchanged

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

總重量不變就代表浮體穩性完全不變
沿用錯誤水密度造成吃水預測偏差，局部淨距不足。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Unchanged total mass means flotation stability is completely unchanged
Incorrect water density biases draft prediction and leaves insufficient local clearance.
quiz.explanation: 沿用錯誤水密度造成吃水預測偏差，局部淨距不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Incorrect water density biases draft prediction and leaves insufficient local clearance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「重心與初始橫向穩性」與「自由液面與穩性折減」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability" and "Free surfaces and stability reduction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 重心與初始橫向穩性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重心與初始橫向穩性」如何影響沉管隧道預製與浮運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 初始穩性取決於重心、浮心與水線面幾何，不只是總浮力。小角度穩心高只描述平衡附近斜率，大角度扶正力臂仍需獨立分析；臨時設備放高或壓載分布不當，可能在總重量不變時明顯改變穩性。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對設備與壓載重心，對照專業穩性模型及傾斜證據；若出現質量不變卻提高重心，初始扶正能力下降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重心與初始橫向穩性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Initial stability depends on gravity centre, buoyancy centre and waterplane geometry rather than total buoyancy alone. Small-angle metacentric height describes the local restoring slope; large-angle arms require separate analysis. High equipment or altered ballast can change stability without changing total mass. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check equipment and ballast centres against specialist stability modelling and inclination evidence. If raising the gravity centre reduces initial restoring ability despite unchanged mass, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：GM=KB+BM-KG=3.0 m+8.0 m-9.5 m=1.5 m before free-surface correction。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: GM=KB+BM-KG=3.0 m+8.0 m-9.5 m=1.5 m before free-surface correction.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總重量不變就代表浮體穩性完全不變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unchanged total mass means flotation stability is completely unchanged" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重心與初始橫向穩性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重心與初始橫向穩性
knowledge.titleEn: Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability
knowledge.text: 初始穩性取決於重心、浮心與水線面幾何，不只是總浮力。小角度穩心高只描述平衡附近斜率，大角度扶正力臂仍需獨立分析；臨時設備放高或壓載分布不當，可能在總重量不變時明顯改變穩性。
knowledge.textEn: Initial stability depends on gravity centre, buoyancy centre and waterplane geometry rather than total buoyancy alone. Small-angle metacentric height describes the local restoring slope; large-angle arms require separate analysis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總重量不變就代表浮體穩性完全不變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Unchanged total mass means flotation stability is completely unchanged Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重心與初始橫向穩性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability" is correct?
options: 初始穩性取決於重心、浮心與水線面幾何，不只是總浮力。
總重量不變就代表浮體穩性完全不變
加水壓載一定只會改善而不會降低穩性
optionsEn: Initial stability depends on gravity centre, buoyancy centre and waterplane geometry rather than total buoyancy alone.
Unchanged total mass means flotation stability is completely unchanged
Adding water ballast always improves stability and can never reduce it
quiz.explanation: 初始穩性取決於重心、浮心與水線面幾何，不只是總浮力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial stability depends on gravity centre, buoyancy centre and waterplane geometry rather than total buoyancy alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重心與初始橫向穩性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重心與初始橫向穩性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：GM=KB+BM-KG=3.0 m+8.0 m-9.5 m=1.5 m before free-surface correction。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: GM=KB+BM-KG=3.0 m+8.0 m-9.5 m=1.5 m before free-surface correction. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對設備與壓載重心，對照專業穩性模型及傾斜證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check equipment and ballast centres against specialist stability modelling and inclination evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：GM=KB+BM-KG=3.0 m+8.0 m-9.5 m=1.5 m before free-surface correction。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: GM=KB+BM-KG=3.0 m+8.0 m-9.5 m=1.5 m before free-surface correction. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重心與初始橫向穩性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability", which statement holds?
options: 浮體整體浮力平衡就足以證明封艙板安全
原創教學假設：GM=KB+BM-KG=3.0 m+8.0 m-9.5 m=1.5 m before free-surface correction。
平均水流阻力小就能保證所有拖航動態荷載都小
optionsEn: Global buoyancy balance is sufficient to prove bulkhead safety
Original teaching assumptions: GM=KB+BM-KG=3.0 m+8.0 m-9.5 m=1.5 m before free-surface correction.
Low mean current drag guarantees small loads in every towing dynamic event
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：GM=KB+BM-KG=3.0 m+8.0 m-9.5 m=1.5 m before free-surface correction。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: GM=KB+BM-KG=3.0 m+8.0 m-9.5 m=1.5 m before free-surface correction. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重心與初始橫向穩性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重心與初始橫向穩性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對設備與壓載重心，對照專業穩性模型及傾斜證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「質量不變卻提高重心，初始扶正能力下降」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check equipment and ballast centres against specialist stability modelling and inclination evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Raising the gravity centre reduces initial restoring ability despite unchanged mass. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對設備與壓載重心，對照專業穩性模型及傾斜證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現質量不變卻提高重心，初始扶正能力下降，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check equipment and ballast centres against specialist stability modelling and inclination evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If raising the gravity centre reduces initial restoring ability despite unchanged mass, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：質量不變卻提高重心，初始扶正能力下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Raising the gravity centre reduces initial restoring ability despite unchanged mass. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對設備與壓載重心，對照專業穩性模型及傾斜證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「質量不變卻提高重心，初始扶正能力下降」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check equipment and ballast centres against specialist stability modelling and inclination evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Raising the gravity centre reduces initial restoring ability despite unchanged mass. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對設備與壓載重心，對照專業穩性模型及傾斜證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現質量不變卻提高重心，初始扶正能力下降，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check equipment and ballast centres against specialist stability modelling and inclination evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If raising the gravity centre reduces initial restoring ability despite unchanged mass, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重心與初始橫向穩性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
所有單項曾經合格就代表任何新配置都可放行
核對設備與壓載重心，對照專業穩性模型及傾斜證據。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Previously passing components authorize release of every later configuration
Check equipment and ballast centres against specialist stability modelling and inclination evidence.
quiz.explanation: 核對設備與壓載重心，對照專業穩性模型及傾斜證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check equipment and ballast centres against specialist stability modelling and inclination evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重心與初始橫向穩性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重心與初始橫向穩性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 質量不變卻提高重心，初始扶正能力下降。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對設備與壓載重心，對照專業穩性模型及傾斜證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Raising the gravity centre reduces initial restoring ability despite unchanged mass. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check equipment and ballast centres against specialist stability modelling and inclination evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對設備與壓載重心，對照專業穩性模型及傾斜證據；若出現質量不變卻提高重心，初始扶正能力下降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If raising the gravity centre reduces initial restoring ability despite unchanged mass, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總重量不變就代表浮體穩性完全不變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unchanged total mass means flotation stability is completely unchanged" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 質量不變卻提高重心，初始扶正能力下降。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對設備與壓載重心，對照專業穩性模型及傾斜證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Raising the gravity centre reduces initial restoring ability despite unchanged mass. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check equipment and ballast centres against specialist stability modelling and inclination evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重心與初始橫向穩性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Centre of gravity and initial transverse stability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 質量不變卻提高重心，初始扶正能力下降。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
加水壓載一定只會改善而不會降低穩性
optionsEn: Raising the gravity centre reduces initial restoring ability despite unchanged mass.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Adding water ballast always improves stability and can never reduce it
quiz.explanation: 質量不變卻提高重心，初始扶正能力下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Raising the gravity centre reduces initial restoring ability despite unchanged mass. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 自由液面與穩性折減：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free surfaces and stability reduction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由液面與穩性折減」如何影響沉管隧道預製與浮運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free surfaces and stability reduction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 未滿的壓載艙液體會隨傾斜移動，產生減少扶正能力的自由液面效應。其影響取決於液面面積慣性矩而非僅水量，寬而淺的艙可能比窄艙更敏感；隔艙和液位狀態需要在每個浮運階段明確列示。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按實際艙格液位檢查自由液面及修正後穩性；若出現只計壓載降低重心卻漏算自由液面，穩性被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由液面與穩性折減」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Liquid in partially filled tanks shifts with heel and reduces restoring action through free-surface effects. The effect depends on liquid-surface second moment rather than volume alone; broad shallow tanks can be especially sensitive. Define compartments and fill state at every flotation stage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check free surfaces and corrected stability for the actual compartment levels. If crediting ballast for lowering gravity while omitting free surfaces overstates stability, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free surfaces and stability reduction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：GMcorrection=rhoLiquid*Ifree/mass=1.0 t/m3*6000 m4/60000 t=0.10 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: GMcorrection=rhoLiquid*Ifree/mass=1.0 t/m3*6000 m4/60000 t=0.10 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加水壓載一定只會改善而不會降低穩性」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding water ballast always improves stability and can never reduce it" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由液面與穩性折減」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free surfaces and stability reduction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自由液面與穩性折減
knowledge.text: 未滿的壓載艙液體會隨傾斜移動，產生減少扶正能力的自由液面效應。其影響取決於液面面積慣性矩而非僅水量，寬而淺的艙可能比窄艙更敏感；隔艙和液位狀態需要在每個浮運階段明確列示。
knowledge.textEn: Liquid in partially filled tanks shifts with heel and reduces restoring action through free-surface effects. The effect depends on liquid-surface second moment rather than volume alone; broad shallow tanks can be especially sensitive.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：加水壓載一定只會改善而不會降低穩性 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding water ballast always improves stability and can never reduce it Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自由液面與穩性折減」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Free surfaces and stability reduction" is correct?
options: 加水壓載一定只會改善而不會降低穩性
未滿的壓載艙液體會隨傾斜移動，產生減少扶正能力的自由液面效應。
平均吃水值就能代表管節每一端的最低位置
optionsEn: Adding water ballast always improves stability and can never reduce it
Liquid in partially filled tanks shifts with heel and reduces restoring action through free-surface effects.
Mean draft represents the lowest position at every end of the element
quiz.explanation: 未滿的壓載艙液體會隨傾斜移動，產生減少扶正能力的自由液面效應。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Liquid in partially filled tanks shifts with heel and reduces restoring action through free-surface effects. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自由液面與穩性折減：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Free surfaces and stability reduction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由液面與穩性折減」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free surfaces and stability reduction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：GMcorrection=rhoLiquid*Ifree/mass=1.0 t/m3*6000 m4/60000 t=0.10 m。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: GMcorrection=rhoLiquid*Ifree/mass=1.0 t/m3*6000 m4/60000 t=0.10 m. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按實際艙格液位檢查自由液面及修正後穩性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check free surfaces and corrected stability for the actual compartment levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：GMcorrection=rhoLiquid*Ifree/mass=1.0 t/m3*6000 m4/60000 t=0.10 m。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: GMcorrection=rhoLiquid*Ifree/mass=1.0 t/m3*6000 m4/60000 t=0.10 m. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自由液面與穩性折減」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Free surfaces and stability reduction", which statement holds?

optionsEn: Concrete element dimensions never change after fabrication is complete
Unchanged self-weight means identical bending moments in every construction stage
Original teaching assumptions: GMcorrection=rhoLiquid*Ifree/mass=1.0 t/m3*6000 m4/60000 t=0.10 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：GMcorrection=rhoLiquid*Ifree/mass=1.0 t/m3*6000 m4/60000 t=0.10 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: GMcorrection=rhoLiquid*Ifree/mass=1.0 t/m3*6000 m4/60000 t=0.10 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自由液面與穩性折減：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free surfaces and stability reduction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由液面與穩性折減」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free surfaces and stability reduction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按實際艙格液位檢查自由液面及修正後穩性。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只計壓載降低重心卻漏算自由液面，穩性被高估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check free surfaces and corrected stability for the actual compartment levels. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Crediting ballast for lowering gravity while omitting free surfaces overstates stability. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將按實際艙格液位檢查自由液面及修正後穩性列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只計壓載降低重心卻漏算自由液面，穩性被高估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check free surfaces and corrected stability for the actual compartment levels. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If crediting ballast for lowering gravity while omitting free surfaces overstates stability, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只計壓載降低重心卻漏算自由液面，穩性被高估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Crediting ballast for lowering gravity while omitting free surfaces overstates stability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按實際艙格液位檢查自由液面及修正後穩性。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只計壓載降低重心卻漏算自由液面，穩性被高估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check free surfaces and corrected stability for the actual compartment levels. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Crediting ballast for lowering gravity while omitting free surfaces overstates stability. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將按實際艙格液位檢查自由液面及修正後穩性列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只計壓載降低重心卻漏算自由液面，穩性被高估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check free surfaces and corrected stability for the actual compartment levels. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If crediting ballast for lowering gravity while omitting free surfaces overstates stability, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自由液面與穩性折減」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Free surfaces and stability reduction"?
options: 按實際艙格液位檢查自由液面及修正後穩性。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量
optionsEn: Check free surfaces and corrected stability for the actual compartment levels.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass
quiz.explanation: 按實際艙格液位檢查自由液面及修正後穩性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check free surfaces and corrected stability for the actual compartment levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自由液面與穩性折減：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Free surfaces and stability reduction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由液面與穩性折減」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free surfaces and stability reduction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只計壓載降低重心卻漏算自由液面，穩性被高估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按實際艙格液位檢查自由液面及修正後穩性，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Crediting ballast for lowering gravity while omitting free surfaces overstates stability. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check free surfaces and corrected stability for the actual compartment levels to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察按實際艙格液位檢查自由液面及修正後穩性；若出現只計壓載降低重心卻漏算自由液面，穩性被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If crediting ballast for lowering gravity while omitting free surfaces overstates stability, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加水壓載一定只會改善而不會降低穩性」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding water ballast always improves stability and can never reduce it" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只計壓載降低重心卻漏算自由液面，穩性被高估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按實際艙格液位檢查自由液面及修正後穩性，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Crediting ballast for lowering gravity while omitting free surfaces overstates stability. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check free surfaces and corrected stability for the actual compartment levels to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自由液面與穩性折減」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Free surfaces and stability reduction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只計壓載降低重心卻漏算自由液面，穩性被高估。
平均吃水值就能代表管節每一端的最低位置
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Crediting ballast for lowering gravity while omitting free surfaces overstates stability.
Mean draft represents the lowest position at every end of the element
quiz.explanation: 只計壓載降低重心卻漏算自由液面，穩性被高估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Crediting ballast for lowering gravity while omitting free surfaces overstates stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「吃水變化與水線面」與「臨時封艙與水壓合力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Draft change and waterplane area" and "Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吃水變化與水線面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Draft change and waterplane area: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「吃水變化與水線面」如何影響沉管隧道預製與浮運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Draft change and waterplane area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 小幅增重的吃水變化可用新增質量除水密度和水線面積估算，但水線面隨吃水變化時需重新計算。縱向質量位置還會造成俯仰，不應把平均吃水套到每個角落；測量須同時辨認平均下沉和姿態變化。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較四角吃水、壓載位置及水線面幾何變化；若出現平均吃水合格卻一端俯仰過深，水下淨距被局部吃掉，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吃水變化與水線面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small added mass changes mean draft according to density and waterplane area, provided area remains approximately constant. Longitudinal mass position also changes trim, so average draft cannot represent every corner. Distinguish mean immersion from pitch and roll in the survey. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare corner drafts, ballast position and changes in waterplane geometry. If acceptable mean draft hides excessive trim and local loss of underwater clearance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Draft change and waterplane area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：deltaDraft=deltaMass/(rho*Awaterplane)=500 t/(1.025 t/m3*4000 m2)=0.122 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: deltaDraft=deltaMass/(rho*Awaterplane)=500 t/(1.025 t/m3*4000 m2)=0.122 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均吃水值就能代表管節每一端的最低位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean draft represents the lowest position at every end of the element" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「吃水變化與水線面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Draft change and waterplane area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吃水變化與水線面
knowledge.text: 小幅增重的吃水變化可用新增質量除水密度和水線面積估算，但水線面隨吃水變化時需重新計算。縱向質量位置還會造成俯仰，不應把平均吃水套到每個角落；測量須同時辨認平均下沉和姿態變化。
knowledge.textEn: Small added mass changes mean draft according to density and waterplane area, provided area remains approximately constant. Longitudinal mass position also changes trim, so average draft cannot represent every corner.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均吃水值就能代表管節每一端的最低位置 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean draft represents the lowest position at every end of the element Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吃水變化與水線面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Draft change and waterplane area" is correct?
options: 平均吃水值就能代表管節每一端的最低位置
浮體整體浮力平衡就足以證明封艙板安全
小幅增重的吃水變化可用新增質量除水密度和水線面積估算，但水線面隨吃水變化時需重新計算。
optionsEn: Mean draft represents the lowest position at every end of the element
Global buoyancy balance is sufficient to prove bulkhead safety
Small added mass changes mean draft according to density and waterplane area, provided area remains approximately constant.
quiz.explanation: 小幅增重的吃水變化可用新增質量除水密度和水線面積估算，但水線面隨吃水變化時需重新計算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small added mass changes mean draft according to density and waterplane area, provided area remains approximately constant. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吃水變化與水線面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Draft change and waterplane area: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吃水變化與水線面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Draft change and waterplane area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：deltaDraft=deltaMass/(rho*Awaterplane)=500 t/(1.025 t/m3*4000 m2)=0.122 m。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: deltaDraft=deltaMass/(rho*Awaterplane)=500 t/(1.025 t/m3*4000 m2)=0.122 m. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較四角吃水、壓載位置及水線面幾何變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare corner drafts, ballast position and changes in waterplane geometry.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吃水變化與水線面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 吃水變化與水線面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Draft change and waterplane area: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吃水變化與水線面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Draft change and waterplane area” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較四角吃水、壓載位置及水線面幾何變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「平均吃水合格卻一端俯仰過深，水下淨距被局部吃掉」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare corner drafts, ballast position and changes in waterplane geometry. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Acceptable mean draft hides excessive trim and local loss of underwater clearance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較四角吃水、壓載位置及水線面幾何變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現平均吃水合格卻一端俯仰過深，水下淨距被局部吃掉，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare corner drafts, ballast position and changes in waterplane geometry. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If acceptable mean draft hides excessive trim and local loss of underwater clearance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均吃水合格卻一端俯仰過深，水下淨距被局部吃掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Acceptable mean draft hides excessive trim and local loss of underwater clearance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吃水變化與水線面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Draft change and waterplane area"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
比較四角吃水、壓載位置及水線面幾何變化。
能漂浮就代表管節遇到傾斜一定能自行恢復
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare corner drafts, ballast position and changes in waterplane geometry.
A floating element necessarily returns upright after any inclination
quiz.explanation: 比較四角吃水、壓載位置及水線面幾何變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare corner drafts, ballast position and changes in waterplane geometry. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吃水變化與水線面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Draft change and waterplane area: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吃水變化與水線面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Draft change and waterplane area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均吃水合格卻一端俯仰過深，水下淨距被局部吃掉。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較四角吃水、壓載位置及水線面幾何變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptable mean draft hides excessive trim and local loss of underwater clearance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare corner drafts, ballast position and changes in waterplane geometry to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較四角吃水、壓載位置及水線面幾何變化；若出現平均吃水合格卻一端俯仰過深，水下淨距被局部吃掉，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If acceptable mean draft hides excessive trim and local loss of underwater clearance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均吃水值就能代表管節每一端的最低位置」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean draft represents the lowest position at every end of the element" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均吃水合格卻一端俯仰過深，水下淨距被局部吃掉。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較四角吃水、壓載位置及水線面幾何變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptable mean draft hides excessive trim and local loss of underwater clearance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare corner drafts, ballast position and changes in waterplane geometry to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吃水變化與水線面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Draft change and waterplane area" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
浮體整體浮力平衡就足以證明封艙板安全
平均吃水合格卻一端俯仰過深，水下淨距被局部吃掉。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Global buoyancy balance is sufficient to prove bulkhead safety
Acceptable mean draft hides excessive trim and local loss of underwater clearance.
quiz.explanation: 平均吃水合格卻一端俯仰過深，水下淨距被局部吃掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptable mean draft hides excessive trim and local loss of underwater clearance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 臨時封艙與水壓合力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「臨時封艙與水壓合力」如何影響沉管隧道預製與浮運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 封艙在浮運期間承受內外水位差，合力與壓力沿高度的分布有關，不能只用底部壓力乘整面積。支承、接頭與滲漏會影響局部受力，還須考慮不同艙室狀態；船體浮力平衡不會自動證明封艙強度。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將封艙兩側水位、板面變形及接頭滲漏共同記錄；若出現以平均吃水忽略局部壓差，封艙接頭承受未檢核反力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「臨時封艙與水壓合力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bulkheads resist internal-external head differences with a pressure distribution over depth, not bottom pressure uniformly over the area. Supports, joints and leakage affect local response across compartment states. Global flotation balance does not establish bulkhead strength or connection integrity. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record water levels on both sides, plate deformation and joint leakage together. If mean draft conceals a local head difference and unchecked bulkhead-joint reactions, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：F=0.5*gammaWater*b*h^2=0.5*10.055 kN/m3*8 m*(4 m)^2=643.5 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: F=0.5*gammaWater*b*h^2=0.5*10.055 kN/m3*8 m*(4 m)^2=643.5 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浮體整體浮力平衡就足以證明封艙板安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Global buoyancy balance is sufficient to prove bulkhead safety" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「臨時封艙與水壓合力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: F=0.5*gammaWater*b*h^2=0.5*10.055 kN/m3*8 m*(4 m)^2=643.5 kN. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將封艙兩側水位、板面變形及接頭滲漏共同記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record water levels on both sides, plate deformation and joint leakage together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: F=0.5*gammaWater*b*h^2=0.5*10.055 kN/m3*8 m*(4 m)^2=643.5 kN. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「臨時封艙與水壓合力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant", which statement holds?
options: 管節自重不變就代表各施工階段彎矩相同

管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量
optionsEn: Unchanged self-weight means identical bending moments in every construction stage

Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: F=0.5*gammaWater*b*h^2=0.5*10.055 kN/m3*8 m*(4 m)^2=643.5 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 臨時封艙與水壓合力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「臨時封艙與水壓合力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將封艙兩側水位、板面變形及接頭滲漏共同記錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「以平均吃水忽略局部壓差，封艙接頭承受未檢核反力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record water levels on both sides, plate deformation and joint leakage together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Mean draft conceals a local head difference and unchecked bulkhead-joint reactions. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將封艙兩側水位、板面變形及接頭滲漏共同記錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現以平均吃水忽略局部壓差，封艙接頭承受未檢核反力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Record water levels on both sides, plate deformation and joint leakage together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If mean draft conceals a local head difference and unchecked bulkhead-joint reactions, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以平均吃水忽略局部壓差，封艙接頭承受未檢核反力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mean draft conceals a local head difference and unchecked bulkhead-joint reactions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Record water levels on both sides, plate deformation and joint leakage together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Mean draft conceals a local head difference and unchecked bulkhead-joint reactions. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 要驗證「臨時封艙與水壓合力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
總重量不變就代表浮體穩性完全不變
將封艙兩側水位、板面變形及接頭滲漏共同記錄。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Unchanged total mass means flotation stability is completely unchanged
Record water levels on both sides, plate deformation and joint leakage together.
quiz.explanation: 將封艙兩側水位、板面變形及接頭滲漏共同記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record water levels on both sides, plate deformation and joint leakage together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 臨時封艙與水壓合力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「臨時封艙與水壓合力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以平均吃水忽略局部壓差，封艙接頭承受未檢核反力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將封艙兩側水位、板面變形及接頭滲漏共同記錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mean draft conceals a local head difference and unchecked bulkhead-joint reactions. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record water levels on both sides, plate deformation and joint leakage together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將封艙兩側水位、板面變形及接頭滲漏共同記錄；若出現以平均吃水忽略局部壓差，封艙接頭承受未檢核反力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If mean draft conceals a local head difference and unchecked bulkhead-joint reactions, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「浮體整體浮力平衡就足以證明封艙板安全」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Global buoyancy balance is sufficient to prove bulkhead safety" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以平均吃水忽略局部壓差，封艙接頭承受未檢核反力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將封艙兩側水位、板面變形及接頭滲漏共同記錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Mean draft conceals a local head difference and unchecked bulkhead-joint reactions. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record water levels on both sides, plate deformation and joint leakage together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「臨時封艙與水壓合力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temporary bulkheads and pressure resultant" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 以平均吃水忽略局部壓差，封艙接頭承受未檢核反力。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
混凝土管節製造完成後尺寸就永遠不再改變
optionsEn: Mean draft conceals a local head difference and unchecked bulkhead-joint reactions.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Concrete element dimensions never change after fabrication is complete
quiz.explanation: 以平均吃水忽略局部壓差，封艙接頭承受未檢核反力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean draft conceals a local head difference and unchecked bulkhead-joint reactions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預製溫度與節段變形」與「水流阻力與拖航界面」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fabrication temperature and segment deformation" and "Current drag and tow interface": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預製溫度與節段變形：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fabrication temperature and segment deformation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預製溫度與節段變形」如何影響沉管隧道預製與浮運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fabrication temperature and segment deformation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長大混凝土管節在水化、養護和轉場時經歷溫度變化，支承拘束使自由伸縮轉成應力。短節段的自由變形算例不能直接代表整體接頭力，因為裂縫、徐變與支承摩擦會改變反應；尺寸驗收需註明參考溫度。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照尺寸量測時溫度、支承狀態及裂縫發展；若出現不同溫度量得長度被誤判製造超差，引發錯誤接頭調整，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預製溫度與節段變形」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large concrete elements change temperature during hydration, curing and transfer, turning free movement into stress under restraint. A short-segment free-expansion example does not establish joint force because cracking, creep and support friction modify it. State the reference temperature for dimensional acceptance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare dimensional survey temperature, support state and crack development. If lengths measured at different temperatures appear out of tolerance and prompt the wrong joint adjustment, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fabrication temperature and segment deformation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：freeMovement=alpha*L*dT=1e-5/K*12 m*30 K=0.0036 m=3.6 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: freeMovement=alpha*L*dT=1e-5/K*12 m*30 K=0.0036 m=3.6 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土管節製造完成後尺寸就永遠不再改變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete element dimensions never change after fabrication is complete" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預製溫度與節段變形」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fabrication temperature and segment deformation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 長大混凝土管節在水化、養護和轉場時經歷溫度變化，支承拘束使自由伸縮轉成應力。短節段的自由變形算例不能直接代表整體接頭力，因為裂縫、徐變與支承摩擦會改變反應；尺寸驗收需註明參考溫度。
