knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土管節製造完成後尺寸就永遠不再改變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Concrete element dimensions never change after fabrication is complete Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預製溫度與節段變形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fabrication temperature and segment deformation" is correct?
options: 混凝土管節製造完成後尺寸就永遠不再改變
長大混凝土管節在水化、養護和轉場時經歷溫度變化，支承拘束使自由伸縮轉成應力。

optionsEn: Concrete element dimensions never change after fabrication is complete
Large concrete elements change temperature during hydration, curing and transfer, turning free movement into stress under restraint.

Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照尺寸量測時溫度、支承狀態及裂縫發展。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare dimensional survey temperature, support state and crack development.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 預製溫度與節段變形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fabrication temperature and segment deformation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預製溫度與節段變形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fabrication temperature and segment deformation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照尺寸量測時溫度、支承狀態及裂縫發展。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「不同溫度量得長度被誤判製造超差，引發錯誤接頭調整」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare dimensional survey temperature, support state and crack development. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Lengths measured at different temperatures appear out of tolerance and prompt the wrong joint adjustment. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照尺寸量測時溫度、支承狀態及裂縫發展列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現不同溫度量得長度被誤判製造超差，引發錯誤接頭調整，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare dimensional survey temperature, support state and crack development. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If lengths measured at different temperatures appear out of tolerance and prompt the wrong joint adjustment, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同溫度量得長度被誤判製造超差，引發錯誤接頭調整。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lengths measured at different temperatures appear out of tolerance and prompt the wrong joint adjustment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Compare dimensional survey temperature, support state and crack development. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Lengths measured at different temperatures appear out of tolerance and prompt the wrong joint adjustment. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預製溫度與節段變形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fabrication temperature and segment deformation"?
options: 對照尺寸量測時溫度、支承狀態及裂縫發展。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
加水壓載一定只會改善而不會降低穩性
optionsEn: Compare dimensional survey temperature, support state and crack development.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding water ballast always improves stability and can never reduce it
quiz.explanation: 對照尺寸量測時溫度、支承狀態及裂縫發展。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare dimensional survey temperature, support state and crack development. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預製溫度與節段變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fabrication temperature and segment deformation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預製溫度與節段變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fabrication temperature and segment deformation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同溫度量得長度被誤判製造超差，引發錯誤接頭調整。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照尺寸量測時溫度、支承狀態及裂縫發展，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lengths measured at different temperatures appear out of tolerance and prompt the wrong joint adjustment. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare dimensional survey temperature, support state and crack development to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照尺寸量測時溫度、支承狀態及裂縫發展；若出現不同溫度量得長度被誤判製造超差，引發錯誤接頭調整，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If lengths measured at different temperatures appear out of tolerance and prompt the wrong joint adjustment, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土管節製造完成後尺寸就永遠不再改變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete element dimensions never change after fabrication is complete" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同溫度量得長度被誤判製造超差，引發錯誤接頭調整。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照尺寸量測時溫度、支承狀態及裂縫發展，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Lengths measured at different temperatures appear out of tolerance and prompt the wrong joint adjustment. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare dimensional survey temperature, support state and crack development to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預製溫度與節段變形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fabrication temperature and segment deformation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
不同溫度量得長度被誤判製造超差，引發錯誤接頭調整。
平均水流阻力小就能保證所有拖航動態荷載都小
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Lengths measured at different temperatures appear out of tolerance and prompt the wrong joint adjustment.
Low mean current drag guarantees small loads in every towing dynamic event
quiz.explanation: 不同溫度量得長度被誤判製造超差，引發錯誤接頭調整。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lengths measured at different temperatures appear out of tolerance and prompt the wrong joint adjustment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水流阻力與拖航界面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Current drag and tow interface: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水流阻力與拖航界面」如何影響沉管隧道預製與浮運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Current drag and tow interface” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流體阻力與相對流速平方成正比，流向、投影面積及阻力係數會隨姿態變化。簡式只估準靜態作用，波浪、加速度及拖纜動態另需海事分析；不能把單一阻力數值當成拖具或操作窗口的完整設計。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄；若出現忽略橫流及動態峰值，平均阻力低卻拖纜瞬間超載，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水流阻力與拖航界面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drag varies with relative speed squared and changes with orientation, projected area and coefficient. A simple formula estimates quasi-static action only; waves, acceleration and towline dynamics require marine analysis. One drag figure is not a complete towing-system or weather-window design. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records. If ignored cross-current and dynamic peaks overload a towline despite modest mean drag, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Current drag and tow interface” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1025 kg/m3, Cd=1.0, A=200 m2, v=1.5 m/s; Fd=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=0.5*1025*1.0*200*(1.5)^2=230625 N=230.6 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均水流阻力小就能保證所有拖航動態荷載都小」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low mean current drag guarantees small loads in every towing dynamic event" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水流阻力與拖航界面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Current drag and tow interface”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Drag varies with relative speed squared and changes with orientation, projected area and coefficient. A simple formula estimates quasi-static action only; waves, acceleration and towline dynamics require marine analysis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均水流阻力小就能保證所有拖航動態荷載都小 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low mean current drag guarantees small loads in every towing dynamic event Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水流阻力與拖航界面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Current drag and tow interface" is correct?
options: 平均水流阻力小就能保證所有拖航動態荷載都小
管節自重不變就代表各施工階段彎矩相同

Unchanged self-weight means identical bending moments in every construction stage
Drag varies with relative speed squared and changes with orientation, projected area and coefficient.
quiz.explanation: 流體阻力與相對流速平方成正比，流向、投影面積及阻力係數會隨姿態變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Inputs rho=1025 kg/m3, Cd=1.0, A=200 m2, v=1.5 m/s; Fd=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=0.5*1025*1.0*200*(1.5)^2=230625 N=230.6 kN。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1025 kg/m3, Cd=1.0, A=200 m2, v=1.5 m/s; Fd=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=0.5*1025*1.0*200*(1.5)^2=230625 N=230.6 kN. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水流阻力與拖航界面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Current drag and tow interface", which statement holds?
options: 管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量
總重量不變就代表浮體穩性完全不變
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1025 kg/m3, Cd=1.0, A=200 m2, v=1.5 m/s; Fd=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=0.5*1025*1.0*200*(1.5)^2=230625 N=230.6 kN.
Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass
Unchanged total mass means flotation stability is completely unchanged
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1025 kg/m3, Cd=1.0, A=200 m2, v=1.5 m/s; Fd=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=0.5*1025*1.0*200*(1.5)^2=230625 N=230.6 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水流阻力與拖航界面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Current drag and tow interface: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水流阻力與拖航界面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Current drag and tow interface” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「忽略橫流及動態峰值，平均阻力低卻拖纜瞬間超載」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ignored cross-current and dynamic peaks overload a towline despite modest mean drag. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現忽略橫流及動態峰值，平均阻力低卻拖纜瞬間超載，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignored cross-current and dynamic peaks overload a towline despite modest mean drag, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略橫流及動態峰值，平均阻力低卻拖纜瞬間超載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignored cross-current and dynamic peaks overload a towline despite modest mean drag. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「忽略橫流及動態峰值，平均阻力低卻拖纜瞬間超載」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ignored cross-current and dynamic peaks overload a towline despite modest mean drag. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現忽略橫流及動態峰值，平均阻力低卻拖纜瞬間超載，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignored cross-current and dynamic peaks overload a towline despite modest mean drag, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水流阻力與拖航界面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Current drag and tow interface"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄。
平均吃水值就能代表管節每一端的最低位置
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records.
Mean draft represents the lowest position at every end of the element
quiz.explanation: 比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水流阻力與拖航界面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Current drag and tow interface: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水流阻力與拖航界面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Current drag and tow interface” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略橫流及動態峰值，平均阻力低卻拖纜瞬間超載。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignored cross-current and dynamic peaks overload a towline despite modest mean drag. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄；若出現忽略橫流及動態峰值，平均阻力低卻拖纜瞬間超載，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If ignored cross-current and dynamic peaks overload a towline despite modest mean drag, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均水流阻力小就能保證所有拖航動態荷載都小」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low mean current drag guarantees small loads in every towing dynamic event" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略橫流及動態峰值，平均阻力低卻拖纜瞬間超載。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Ignored cross-current and dynamic peaks overload a towline despite modest mean drag. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水流阻力與拖航界面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Current drag and tow interface" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
管節自重不變就代表各施工階段彎矩相同
忽略橫流及動態峰值，平均阻力低卻拖纜瞬間超載。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Unchanged self-weight means identical bending moments in every construction stage
Ignored cross-current and dynamic peaks overload a towline despite modest mean drag.
quiz.explanation: 忽略橫流及動態峰值，平均阻力低卻拖纜瞬間超載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignored cross-current and dynamic peaks overload a towline despite modest mean drag. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支承轉換與縱向彎曲」與「浮運放行與資料一致性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support transitions and longitudinal bending" and "Flotation release and record consistency": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支承轉換與縱向彎曲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support transitions and longitudinal bending: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支承轉換與縱向彎曲」如何影響沉管隧道預製與浮運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support transitions and longitudinal bending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管節從預製支座到浮力分布，再到沉放和基床接觸，縱向支承條件多次改變。相同自重在不同分布反力下產生不同彎矩，浮體波浪彎曲也不能用陸上簡支模型替代；每一階段需有自己的荷載及接觸假設。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將支座、浮力分布及基床接觸分別連到管節應變資料；若出現借用上一階段支承模型，漏掉轉換時的最大縱向彎矩，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支承轉換與縱向彎曲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Support changes from fabrication bearings to distributed buoyancy and then immersion and bedding contact. Equal weight produces different moments under different reactions, and wave bending is not a land-based simple beam. Each stage needs its own loading and contact assumptions with verified transitions. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Relate bearing, buoyancy and bedding contact states separately to element strains. If reusing a previous support model misses peak longitudinal bending during transfer, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support transitions and longitudinal bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：M=q*L^2/8=100 kN/m*(60 m)^2/8=45000 kNm for an ideal land-based simple span。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: M=q*L^2/8=100 kN/m*(60 m)^2/8=45000 kNm for an ideal land-based simple span.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管節自重不變就代表各施工階段彎矩相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unchanged self-weight means identical bending moments in every construction stage" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支承轉換與縱向彎曲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support transitions and longitudinal bending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支承轉換與縱向彎曲
knowledge.text: 管節從預製支座到浮力分布，再到沉放和基床接觸，縱向支承條件多次改變。相同自重在不同分布反力下產生不同彎矩，浮體波浪彎曲也不能用陸上簡支模型替代；每一階段需有自己的荷載及接觸假設。
knowledge.textEn: Support changes from fabrication bearings to distributed buoyancy and then immersion and bedding contact. Equal weight produces different moments under different reactions, and wave bending is not a land-based simple beam.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管節自重不變就代表各施工階段彎矩相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Unchanged self-weight means identical bending moments in every construction stage Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支承轉換與縱向彎曲」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support transitions and longitudinal bending" is correct?
options: 管節從預製支座到浮力分布，再到沉放和基床接觸，縱向支承條件多次改變。
管節自重不變就代表各施工階段彎矩相同
所有單項曾經合格就代表任何新配置都可放行
optionsEn: Support changes from fabrication bearings to distributed buoyancy and then immersion and bedding contact.
Unchanged self-weight means identical bending moments in every construction stage
Previously passing components authorize release of every later configuration
quiz.explanation: 管節從預製支座到浮力分布，再到沉放和基床接觸，縱向支承條件多次改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Support changes from fabrication bearings to distributed buoyancy and then immersion and bedding contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支承轉換與縱向彎曲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support transitions and longitudinal bending: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支承轉換與縱向彎曲」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support transitions and longitudinal bending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：M=q*L^2/8=100 kN/m*(60 m)^2/8=45000 kNm for an ideal land-based simple span。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: M=q*L^2/8=100 kN/m*(60 m)^2/8=45000 kNm for an ideal land-based simple span. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將支座、浮力分布及基床接觸分別連到管節應變資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Relate bearing, buoyancy and bedding contact states separately to element strains.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：M=q*L^2/8=100 kN/m*(60 m)^2/8=45000 kNm for an ideal land-based simple span。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支承轉換與縱向彎曲」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support transitions and longitudinal bending", which statement holds?

steps.instruction: 將支座、浮力分布及基床接觸分別連到管節應變資料。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「借用上一階段支承模型，漏掉轉換時的最大縱向彎矩」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Relate bearing, buoyancy and bedding contact states separately to element strains. steps.failure: 注意干擾：借用上一階段支承模型，漏掉轉換時的最大縱向彎矩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 支承轉換與縱向彎曲：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支承轉換與縱向彎曲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support transitions and longitudinal bending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 借用上一階段支承模型，漏掉轉換時的最大縱向彎矩。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將支座、浮力分布及基床接觸分別連到管節應變資料，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing a previous support model misses peak longitudinal bending during transfer. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to relate bearing, buoyancy and bedding contact states separately to element strains to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將支座、浮力分布及基床接觸分別連到管節應變資料；若出現借用上一階段支承模型，漏掉轉換時的最大縱向彎矩，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If reusing a previous support model misses peak longitudinal bending during transfer, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管節自重不變就代表各施工階段彎矩相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unchanged self-weight means identical bending moments in every construction stage" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 浮運放行與資料一致性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flotation release and record consistency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「浮運放行與資料一致性」如何影響沉管隧道預製與浮運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flotation release and record consistency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮運判斷需要質量、幾何、水密、穩性及設備狀態的共同版本，單項合格不能互相抵消。晚期設備變更可能改變重心和吃水，若未更新計算就使原結論失效；交接應能追溯每項輸入的日期與實際配置。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對最後配置與質量、穩性、水密及幾何文件版本；若出現設備改裝未納入海事模型，原放行數據已不對應實體，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「浮運放行與資料一致性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Release requires consistent versions of mass, geometry, tightness, stability and equipment status; passing one cannot offset failure of another. Late equipment changes alter gravity and draft and can invalidate earlier conclusions. Trace each input to its date and installed configuration rather than a generic certificate. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit final configuration against mass, stability, tightness and geometry document revisions. If equipment changes omitted from the marine model leave release data inconsistent with the element, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Flotation release and record consistency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：massDiscrepancy=(verified-estimated)/estimated=(60600-60000) t/60000 t=1 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: massDiscrepancy=(verified-estimated)/estimated=(60600-60000) t/60000 t=1 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有單項曾經合格就代表任何新配置都可放行」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Previously passing components authorize release of every later configuration" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「浮運放行與資料一致性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Flotation release and record consistency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 浮運放行與資料一致性
knowledge.text: 浮運判斷需要質量、幾何、水密、穩性及設備狀態的共同版本，單項合格不能互相抵消。晚期設備變更可能改變重心和吃水，若未更新計算就使原結論失效；交接應能追溯每項輸入的日期與實際配置。
knowledge.textEn: Release requires consistent versions of mass, geometry, tightness, stability and equipment status; passing one cannot offset failure of another. Late equipment changes alter gravity and draft and can invalidate earlier conclusions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有單項曾經合格就代表任何新配置都可放行 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Previously passing components authorize release of every later configuration Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：massDiscrepancy=(verified-estimated)/estimated=(60600-60000) t/60000 t=1 percent。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: massDiscrepancy=(verified-estimated)/estimated=(60600-60000) t/60000 t=1 percent. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Equipment changes omitted from the marine model leave release data inconsistent with the element. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If equipment changes omitted from the marine model leave release data inconsistent with the element, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：設備改裝未納入海事模型，原放行數據已不對應實體。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

quiz.question: 要驗證「浮運放行與資料一致性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flotation release and record consistency"?
options: 核對最後配置與質量、穩性、水密及幾何文件版本。

steps.title: 浮運放行與資料一致性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flotation release and record consistency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「浮運放行與資料一致性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Flotation release and record consistency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 設備改裝未納入海事模型，原放行數據已不對應實體。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對最後配置與質量、穩性、水密及幾何文件版本，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equipment changes omitted from the marine model leave release data inconsistent with the element. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit final configuration against mass, stability, tightness and geometry document revisions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對最後配置與質量、穩性、水密及幾何文件版本；若出現設備改裝未納入海事模型，原放行數據已不對應實體，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If equipment changes omitted from the marine model leave release data inconsistent with the element, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有單項曾經合格就代表任何新配置都可放行」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Previously passing components authorize release of every later configuration" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 設備改裝未納入海事模型，原放行數據已不對應實體。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對最後配置與質量、穩性、水密及幾何文件版本，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Equipment changes omitted from the marine model leave release data inconsistent with the element. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit final configuration against mass, stability, tightness and geometry document revisions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「浮運放行與資料一致性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Flotation release and record consistency" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
設備改裝未納入海事模型，原放行數據已不對應實體。
管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Equipment changes omitted from the marine model leave release data inconsistent with the element.
Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass
quiz.explanation: 設備改裝未納入海事模型，原放行數據已不對應實體。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equipment changes omitted from the marine model leave release data inconsistent with the element. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 沉管基床整平
summary: 本課以以海床幾何、接觸壓力與沉陷驗證沉管基床為主線，從溝槽斷面與開挖體積與淨重與基床平均壓力建立系統邊界，再把墊層厚度與材料收支、高點接觸與局部壓力連到基床交接與長期基線。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on verify immersed-tunnel bedding through seabed geometry, contact pressure and settlement. It begins with Trench section and dredging volume and Submerged weight and mean bed pressure, links Bedding thickness and material balance and High-point contact and local pressure, and ends with Bedding handover and long-term baseline. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查溝槽斷面與開挖體積：V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer；再獨立檢查淨重與基床平均壓力：q=netDownwardForce/contactArea=20000 kN/4000 m2=5 kPa。其餘條件不變，壓縮係數由 0.0002 增為 0.0003 /kPa，簡化沉陷由 50 增為 75 mm；相鄰管節差異仍須轉成接頭轉角檢核。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 將核對水位基準、聲速剖面及交叉測線閉合差作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Trench section and dredging volume: V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer. Independently check Submerged weight and mean bed pressure: q=netDownwardForce/contactArea=20000 kN/4000 m2=5 kPa. With other inputs fixed, compressibility rising from 0.0002 to 0.0003 per kPa increases simplified settlement from 50 to 75 mm; differences between elements still require joint-rotation assessment. The two results are not a complete design because measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. Use check water-level datum, sound-speed profiles and cross-line closure residuals as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」與「淨重與基床平均壓力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Trench section and dredging volume" and "Submerged weight and mean bed pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溝槽斷面與開挖體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Trench section and dredging volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Trench section and dredging volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海床溝槽需容納管節、基床及回填保護，疏浚體積還受邊坡和原地形影響。矩形體積只是物料帳基準，超挖與回淤會改變後續接觸；應將設計斷面與不同時間海床測量配準，不能只用船舶出土量驗收幾何。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤；若出現疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The trench accommodates element, bedding and protective fill, with slopes and terrain changing dredged volume. A rectangular estimate is only a material baseline; over-dredging and resedimentation alter contact. Register design and time-stamped seabed surveys rather than accepting geometry from vessel spoil volume alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation. If unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Trench section and dredging volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出土量達到設計值就能保證溝槽形狀正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Design dredged volume guarantees the correct trench shape" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Trench section and dredging volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溝槽斷面與開挖體積
knowledge.text: 海床溝槽需容納管節、基床及回填保護，疏浚體積還受邊坡和原地形影響。矩形體積只是物料帳基準，超挖與回淤會改變後續接觸；應將設計斷面與不同時間海床測量配準，不能只用船舶出土量驗收幾何。
knowledge.textEn: The trench accommodates element, bedding and protective fill, with slopes and terrain changing dredged volume. A rectangular estimate is only a material baseline; over-dredging and resedimentation alter contact.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出土量達到設計值就能保證溝槽形狀正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Design dredged volume guarantees the correct trench shape Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Trench section and dredging volume" is correct?
options: 出土量達到設計值就能保證溝槽形狀正確
海床溝槽需容納管節、基床及回填保護，疏浚體積還受邊坡和原地形影響。
空氣中重量與水下基床接觸荷載永遠相同
optionsEn: Design dredged volume guarantees the correct trench shape
The trench accommodates element, bedding and protective fill, with slopes and terrain changing dredged volume.
Air weight always equals the contact load on submerged bedding
quiz.explanation: 海床溝槽需容納管節、基床及回填保護，疏浚體積還受邊坡和原地形影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The trench accommodates element, bedding and protective fill, with slopes and terrain changing dredged volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溝槽斷面與開挖體積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trench section and dredging volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Trench section and dredging volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: V=width*depth*length=40 m*1 m*200 m=8000 m3 for an assumed rectangular layer. steps.title: 溝槽斷面與開挖體積：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Trench section and dredging volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 溝槽斷面與開挖體積：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Trench section and dredging volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare repeated bathymetry with design base level, slopes and resedimentation to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以多期測深斷面比較設計底標高、邊坡及回淤；若出現疏浚完成後回淤未重測，管節落在軟泥而非設計基床，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If unsurveyed resedimentation leaves the element on soft mud rather than the designed bed, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「出土量達到設計值就能保證溝槽形狀正確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Design dredged volume guarantees the correct trench shape" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 淨重與基床平均壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Submerged weight and mean bed pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淨重與基床平均壓力」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Submerged weight and mean bed pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 基床承受的是管節與回填在水下的有效作用，不能把空氣中自重直接當成同一接觸荷載。浮力、壓載及外部水壓需採一致自由體，若重複扣浮力會低估荷載；平均壓力仍需另查接觸面是否完整。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積；若出現重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淨重與基床平均壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bedding carries submerged actions from the element and fill, not simply air weight. Use one consistent free body for buoyancy, ballast and external pressure; subtracting buoyancy twice understates demand. Mean pressure also requires separate confirmation of the actual contact area. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states. If double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Submerged weight and mean bed pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：q=netDownwardForce/contactArea=20000 kN/4000 m2=5 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: q=netDownwardForce/contactArea=20000 kN/4000 m2=5 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「空氣中重量與水下基床接觸荷載永遠相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Air weight always equals the contact load on submerged bedding" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淨重與基床平均壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Submerged weight and mean bed pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.titleEn: Submerged weight and mean bed pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「淨重與基床平均壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Submerged weight and mean bed pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.text: 將對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

quiz.question: 要驗證「淨重與基床平均壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Submerged weight and mean bed pressure"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積。
管節落位驗收後基床支承就永遠不會改變
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states.
Bedding support never changes after placement acceptance
quiz.explanation: 對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 淨重與基床平均壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Submerged weight and mean bed pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「淨重與基床平均壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Submerged weight and mean bed pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積；若出現重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「空氣中重量與水下基床接觸荷載永遠相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Air weight always equals the contact load on submerged bedding" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「淨重與基床平均壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Submerged weight and mean bed pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮
重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress
Double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement.
quiz.explanation: 重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「深部壓縮與總沉陷」與「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Deep compression and total settlement" and "Differential settlement and joint rotation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Deep compression and total settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「深部壓縮與總沉陷」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deep compression and total settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。簡化一維沉陷模型使用應力增量、壓縮性和層厚，需區分有效應力和總應力；排水時間與應力歷史會改變實際反應。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較；若出現只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「深部壓縮與總沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position. A one-dimensional settlement model uses stress increment, compressibility and thickness, requiring effective rather than indiscriminate total stress. Drainage time and stress history modify actual response. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure. If surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Deep compression and total settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「深部壓縮與總沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Deep compression and total settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷
knowledge.text: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。簡化一維沉陷模型使用應力增量、壓縮性和層厚，需區分有效應力和總應力；排水時間與應力歷史會改變實際反應。
knowledge.textEn: Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position. A one-dimensional settlement model uses stress increment, compressibility and thickness, requiring effective rather than indiscriminate total stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「深部壓縮與總沉陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Deep compression and total settlement" is correct?
options: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。
基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮
總平均沉陷很小就代表接頭不會轉動
optionsEn: Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position.
A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress
Small overall average settlement means joints cannot rotate
quiz.explanation: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deep compression and total settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「深部壓縮與總沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deep compression and total settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「深部壓縮與總沉陷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Deep compression and total settlement", which statement holds?
options: 均勻係數相同就代表兩種基床材料性能完全相同
原創教學假設：s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm。
把所有誤差平方和開根號就能消除共同基準偏差
optionsEn: Equal uniformity coefficients prove identical performance of two bedding materials
Original teaching assumptions: s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm.
Root-sum-square of errors eliminates every shared datum bias
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

quiz.question: 要驗證「深部壓縮與總沉陷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deep compression and total settlement"?

地形圖看起來連續就代表每一點都實際量測過

A continuous-looking terrain map proves every point was directly measured
Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deep compression and total settlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「深部壓縮與總沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deep compression and total settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較；若出現只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「深部壓縮與總沉陷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deep compression and total settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
總平均沉陷很小就代表接頭不會轉動
optionsEn: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Small overall average settlement means joints cannot rotate
quiz.explanation: 只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement and joint rotation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰管節沉陷不同會使接頭旋轉，平均總沉陷小也可能有較大局部角差。單一管節的端點差除長度是弦傾角；本算例額外假定該管節為剛體且相鄰管節保持水平，才可把弦傾角當接頭相對轉角。一般情況須取接頭兩側斜率差，實際還有彎曲及接頭剪力；應沿縱向保留多點量測而不只記兩岸高程。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移；若出現局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different settlement of adjacent elements rotates joints, even when mean settlement is small. Endpoint difference divided by element length is chord inclination. Only the additional assumptions of a rigid element and a horizontal neighboring element make it relative joint rotation here; otherwise compare slopes on both sides. Bending and joint shear also occur. Preserve multiple longitudinal observations rather than relying on the shore-end elevations alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element. If a soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement and joint rotation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：chordInclination=settlementDifference/length=20 mm/200000 mm=0.0001 rad; relativeJointRotation=chordInclination only for this rigid element beside an assumed horizontal neighbor。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: chordInclination=settlementDifference/length=20 mm/200000 mm=0.0001 rad; relativeJointRotation=chordInclination only for this rigid element beside an assumed horizontal neighbor.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總平均沉陷很小就代表接頭不會轉動」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small overall average settlement means joints cannot rotate" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential settlement and joint rotation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角
knowledge.text: 相鄰管節沉陷不同會使接頭旋轉，平均總沉陷小也可能有較大局部角差。單一管節的端點差除長度是弦傾角；本算例額外假定該管節為剛體且相鄰管節保持水平，才可把弦傾角當接頭相對轉角。
knowledge.textEn: Different settlement of adjacent elements rotates joints, even when mean settlement is small. Endpoint difference divided by element length is chord inclination.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總平均沉陷很小就代表接頭不會轉動 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small overall average settlement means joints cannot rotate Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Differential settlement and joint rotation" is correct?

相鄰管節沉陷不同會使接頭旋轉，平均總沉陷小也可能有較大局部角差。

optionsEn: Small overall average settlement means joints cannot rotate
Different settlement of adjacent elements rotates joints, even when mean settlement is small.
Adequate total material guarantees equal bedding thickness everywhere

quiz.explanationEn: Different settlement of adjacent elements rotates joints, even when mean settlement is small. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
