workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查端面姿態與初始接觸：differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm；再獨立檢查主密封壓縮與反力曲線：compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40。角差從 0.0005 增至 0.0008 rad，使 30 m 寬面上的幾何差由 15 增至 24 mm，增加六成；反力不一定同比。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 將同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check End-face attitude and initial contact: differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm. Independently check Primary-seal compression and reaction curves: compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40. Increasing angular mismatch from 0.0005 to 0.0008 rad raises the differential across a 30 m face from 15 to 24 mm, a sixty-percent increase; reaction need not scale proportionally. The two results are not a complete design because joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. Use record compartment pressure, collected flow and external water-level changes together as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「端面姿態與初始接觸」與「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "End-face attitude and initial contact" and "Primary-seal compression and reaction curves": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 端面姿態與初始接觸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: End-face attitude and initial contact: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「端面姿態與初始接觸」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “End-face attitude and initial contact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接頭兩端面並非只需中心對準，偏航、俯仰和翹曲會使密封圈局部先接觸。第一接觸點承受的壓縮可能遠大於平均值，因而幾何差應沿整個周邊呈現；剛體角差模型只識別不均勻性，不能給出橡膠反力分布。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序；若出現中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「端面姿態與初始接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Coincident centers do not ensure matching end faces: yaw, pitch and warping create early local seal contact. The first contact can compress far more than the average, so map mismatch around the perimeter. A rigid-angle model identifies nonuniformity but cannot determine rubber reaction distribution. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact. If acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “End-face attitude and initial contact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「端面姿態與初始接觸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “End-face attitude and initial contact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 端面姿態與初始接觸
knowledge.text: 接頭兩端面並非只需中心對準，偏航、俯仰和翹曲會使密封圈局部先接觸。第一接觸點承受的壓縮可能遠大於平均值，因而幾何差應沿整個周邊呈現；剛體角差模型只識別不均勻性，不能給出橡膠反力分布。
knowledge.textEn: Coincident centers do not ensure matching end faces: yaw, pitch and warping create early local seal contact. The first contact can compress far more than the average, so map mismatch around the perimeter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「端面姿態與初始接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "End-face attitude and initial contact" is correct?
options: 兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸
接頭兩端面並非只需中心對準，偏航、俯仰和翹曲會使密封圈局部先接觸。
橡膠壓縮率相同就代表任何密封斷面的反力相同
optionsEn: Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal
Coincident centers do not ensure matching end faces: yaw, pitch and warping create early local seal contact.
Equal rubber compression ratios imply equal reaction for every seal profile
quiz.explanation: 接頭兩端面並非只需中心對準，偏航、俯仰和翹曲會使密封圈局部先接觸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Coincident centers do not ensure matching end faces: yaw, pitch and warping create early local seal contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 端面姿態與初始接觸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: End-face attitude and initial contact: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「端面姿態與初始接觸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “End-face attitude and initial contact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「端面姿態與初始接觸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "End-face attitude and initial contact", which statement holds?
options: 壓力乘密封跨距即可直接得到所有位置的膜張力
量測接頭中央一個開度就能代表整圈密封變形
原創教學假設：differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm。
optionsEn: Pressure times seal span directly gives membrane tension at every location
One central opening measurement represents deformation around the entire seal
Original teaching assumptions: differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 端面姿態與初始接觸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: End-face attitude and initial contact: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「端面姿態與初始接觸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “End-face attitude and initial contact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「端面姿態與初始接觸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "End-face attitude and initial contact"?
options: 比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷
optionsEn: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free
quiz.explanation: 比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 端面姿態與初始接觸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: End-face attitude and initial contact: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「端面姿態與初始接觸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “End-face attitude and initial contact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序；若出現中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「端面姿態與初始接觸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "End-face attitude and initial contact" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸。
橡膠壓縮率相同就代表任何密封斷面的反力相同
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other.
Equal rubber compression ratios imply equal reaction for every seal profile
quiz.explanation: 中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 主密封壓縮與反力曲線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Primary-seal compression and reaction curves: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Primary-seal compression and reaction curves” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Gina 類主密封利用端面壓縮建立接觸，但空心斷面與材料非線性使反力不會簡單正比壓縮率。製造商試驗曲線應對應實際斷面和溫度，接縫、轉角及長期鬆弛另行評估；幾何壓縮率只能作版本與尺寸核對。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對；若出現借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A Gina-type primary seal develops contact through end compression, but hollow geometry and nonlinear rubber prevent reaction from scaling directly with compression ratio. Match manufacturer tests to the profile and temperature and assess corners, splices and relaxation separately. A geometric ratio checks dimensions and configuration only. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches. If using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Primary-seal compression and reaction curves” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橡膠壓縮率相同就代表任何密封斷面的反力相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal rubber compression ratios imply equal reaction for every seal profile" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Primary-seal compression and reaction curves”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主密封壓縮與反力曲線
knowledge.text: Gina 類主密封利用端面壓縮建立接觸，但空心斷面與材料非線性使反力不會簡單正比壓縮率。製造商試驗曲線應對應實際斷面和溫度，接縫、轉角及長期鬆弛另行評估；幾何壓縮率只能作版本與尺寸核對。
knowledge.textEn: A Gina-type primary seal develops contact through end compression, but hollow geometry and nonlinear rubber prevent reaction from scaling directly with compression ratio. Match manufacturer tests to the profile and temperature and assess corners, splices and relaxation separately.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橡膠壓縮率相同就代表任何密封斷面的反力相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal rubber compression ratios imply equal reaction for every seal profile Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Primary-seal compression and reaction curves" is correct?
options: 橡膠壓縮率相同就代表任何密封斷面的反力相同
外水壓乘全部濕表面就等於接頭軸向合攏力
Gina 類主密封利用端面壓縮建立接觸，但空心斷面與材料非線性使反力不會簡單正比壓縮率。
optionsEn: Equal rubber compression ratios imply equal reaction for every seal profile
External pressure times every wet surface equals the axial joint-closing force
A Gina-type primary seal develops contact through end compression, but hollow geometry and nonlinear rubber prevent reaction from scaling directly with compression ratio.
quiz.explanation: Gina 類主密封利用端面壓縮建立接觸，但空心斷面與材料非線性使反力不會簡單正比壓縮率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A Gina-type primary seal develops contact through end compression, but hollow geometry and nonlinear rubber prevent reaction from scaling directly with compression ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主密封壓縮與反力曲線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Primary-seal compression and reaction curves: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Primary-seal compression and reaction curves” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Primary-seal compression and reaction curves", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40。
長管節的自由熱伸縮必定全部集中在單一接頭
剪力鍵外觀面積全部都會同時均勻承受剪力
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40.
All free thermal expansion of a long element concentrates at one joint
The full visible shear-key area always carries shear uniformly
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主密封壓縮與反力曲線：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Primary-seal compression and reaction curves: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Primary-seal compression and reaction curves” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Primary-seal compression and reaction curves"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對。
壓縮量固定就表示橡膠密封反力永遠不會降低
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches.
Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time
quiz.explanation: 將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主密封壓縮與反力曲線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Primary-seal compression and reaction curves: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Primary-seal compression and reaction curves” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對；若出現借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橡膠壓縮率相同就代表任何密封斷面的反力相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal rubber compression ratios imply equal reaction for every seal profile" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主密封壓縮與反力曲線」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Primary-seal compression and reaction curves" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
外水壓乘全部濕表面就等於接頭軸向合攏力
借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
External pressure times every wet surface equals the axial joint-closing force
Using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity.
quiz.explanation: 借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓差合攏與受力邊界」與「次級密封與膜面荷載」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries" and "Secondary seals and membrane loading": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓差合攏與受力邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓差合攏與受力邊界」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接合階段內外壓差對封閉投影面產生軸向合力，經管節、接頭與支承形成平衡。計算面積應是壓差實際作用的有效面，不能混用水下面積或密封橡膠面積；摩擦、姿態和臨時構造使實際位移不能只由壓力推得。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照壓力分區圖、端面位移與接頭受力路徑；若出現漏列與外水連通的腔室，錯算有效壓差及合攏力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓差合攏與受力邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During joining, pressure difference over a closed projected area produces axial force balanced through the element, joint and supports. Use the actual pressure-boundary area rather than submerged surface or rubber contact area. Friction, attitude and temporary works prevent pressure alone from predicting displacement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare pressure-zone diagrams, end-face displacement and joint load paths. If an omitted chamber connected to external water produces the wrong pressure difference and closure force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：axialResultant=dp*effectiveArea=0.20 MPa*100 m2=20 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: axialResultant=dp*effectiveArea=0.20 MPa*100 m2=20 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外水壓乘全部濕表面就等於接頭軸向合攏力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "External pressure times every wet surface equals the axial joint-closing force" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓差合攏與受力邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓差合攏與受力邊界
knowledge.text: 接合階段內外壓差對封閉投影面產生軸向合力，經管節、接頭與支承形成平衡。計算面積應是壓差實際作用的有效面，不能混用水下面積或密封橡膠面積；摩擦、姿態和臨時構造使實際位移不能只由壓力推得。
knowledge.textEn: During joining, pressure difference over a closed projected area produces axial force balanced through the element, joint and supports. Use the actual pressure-boundary area rather than submerged surface or rubber contact area.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外水壓乘全部濕表面就等於接頭軸向合攏力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: External pressure times every wet surface equals the axial joint-closing force Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓差合攏與受力邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries" is correct?
options: 接合階段內外壓差對封閉投影面產生軸向合力，經管節、接頭與支承形成平衡。
外水壓乘全部濕表面就等於接頭軸向合攏力
壓力乘密封跨距即可直接得到所有位置的膜張力
optionsEn: During joining, pressure difference over a closed projected area produces axial force balanced through the element, joint and supports.
External pressure times every wet surface equals the axial joint-closing force
Pressure times seal span directly gives membrane tension at every location
quiz.explanation: 接合階段內外壓差對封閉投影面產生軸向合力，經管節、接頭與支承形成平衡。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: During joining, pressure difference over a closed projected area produces axial force balanced through the element, joint and supports. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓差合攏與受力邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓差合攏與受力邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：axialResultant=dp*effectiveArea=0.20 MPa*100 m2=20 MN。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: axialResultant=dp*effectiveArea=0.20 MPa*100 m2=20 MN. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照壓力分區圖、端面位移與接頭受力路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pressure-zone diagrams, end-face displacement and joint load paths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：axialResultant=dp*effectiveArea=0.20 MPa*100 m2=20 MN。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: axialResultant=dp*effectiveArea=0.20 MPa*100 m2=20 MN. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓差合攏與受力邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 量測接頭中央一個開度就能代表整圈密封變形
原創教學假設：axialResultant=dp*effectiveArea=0.20 MPa*100 m2=20 MN。
接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷
optionsEn: One central opening measurement represents deformation around the entire seal
Original teaching assumptions: axialResultant=dp*effectiveArea=0.20 MPa*100 m2=20 MN.
Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：axialResultant=dp*effectiveArea=0.20 MPa*100 m2=20 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: axialResultant=dp*effectiveArea=0.20 MPa*100 m2=20 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓差合攏與受力邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓差合攏與受力邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照壓力分區圖、端面位移與接頭受力路徑。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「漏列與外水連通的腔室，錯算有效壓差及合攏力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pressure-zone diagrams, end-face displacement and joint load paths. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An omitted chamber connected to external water produces the wrong pressure difference and closure force. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照壓力分區圖、端面位移與接頭受力路徑列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現漏列與外水連通的腔室，錯算有效壓差及合攏力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare pressure-zone diagrams, end-face displacement and joint load paths. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an omitted chamber connected to external water produces the wrong pressure difference and closure force, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏列與外水連通的腔室，錯算有效壓差及合攏力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An omitted chamber connected to external water produces the wrong pressure difference and closure force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照壓力分區圖、端面位移與接頭受力路徑。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「漏列與外水連通的腔室，錯算有效壓差及合攏力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare pressure-zone diagrams, end-face displacement and joint load paths. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An omitted chamber connected to external water produces the wrong pressure difference and closure force. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照壓力分區圖、端面位移與接頭受力路徑列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現漏列與外水連通的腔室，錯算有效壓差及合攏力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare pressure-zone diagrams, end-face displacement and joint load paths. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an omitted chamber connected to external water produces the wrong pressure difference and closure force, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓差合攏與受力邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要安裝兩道密封就必定得到完全獨立的雙重保障
對照壓力分區圖、端面位移與接頭受力路徑。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Installing two seals always creates completely independent redundant protection
Compare pressure-zone diagrams, end-face displacement and joint load paths.
quiz.explanation: 對照壓力分區圖、端面位移與接頭受力路徑。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pressure-zone diagrams, end-face displacement and joint load paths. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓差合攏與受力邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓差合攏與受力邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏列與外水連通的腔室，錯算有效壓差及合攏力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照壓力分區圖、端面位移與接頭受力路徑，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An omitted chamber connected to external water produces the wrong pressure difference and closure force. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare pressure-zone diagrams, end-face displacement and joint load paths to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照壓力分區圖、端面位移與接頭受力路徑；若出現漏列與外水連通的腔室，錯算有效壓差及合攏力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an omitted chamber connected to external water produces the wrong pressure difference and closure force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外水壓乘全部濕表面就等於接頭軸向合攏力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "External pressure times every wet surface equals the axial joint-closing force" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏列與外水連通的腔室，錯算有效壓差及合攏力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照壓力分區圖、端面位移與接頭受力路徑，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: An omitted chamber connected to external water produces the wrong pressure difference and closure force. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare pressure-zone diagrams, end-face displacement and joint load paths to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓差合攏與受力邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 漏列與外水連通的腔室，錯算有效壓差及合攏力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
壓力乘密封跨距即可直接得到所有位置的膜張力
optionsEn: An omitted chamber connected to external water produces the wrong pressure difference and closure force.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Pressure times seal span directly gives membrane tension at every location
quiz.explanation: 漏列與外水連通的腔室，錯算有效壓差及合攏力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An omitted chamber connected to external water produces the wrong pressure difference and closure force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 次級密封與膜面荷載：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Secondary seals and membrane loading: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「次級密封與膜面荷載」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Secondary seals and membrane loading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Omega 類次級密封容許接頭相對位移，並提供與主密封不同的水密屏障。壓力乘跨距是每單位長度的橫向合力，不是膜張力；張力還取決於鼓出幾何、邊界固定和材料變形，夾具與角部不能從均勻薄膜模型略去。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把次級膜鼓出形狀、夾具位移與壓差試驗結果連結；若出現把橫向合力誤當膜張力，漏估夾持區剝離與角部應變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「次級密封與膜面荷載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An Omega-type secondary seal accommodates relative movement and forms a barrier distinct from the primary seal. Pressure times span gives transverse resultant per unit length, not membrane tension. Tension also depends on bulging geometry, restraints and material deformation; clamps and corners require separate assessment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Relate secondary-membrane bulge, clamp movement and differential-pressure tests. If treating transverse resultant as tension misses clamp peeling and corner strain, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Secondary seals and membrane loading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：transverseResultantPerLength=p*span=0.20 MPa*0.30 m=60 kN/m; this is not membrane tension。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: transverseResultantPerLength=p*span=0.20 MPa*0.30 m=60 kN/m; this is not membrane tension.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓力乘密封跨距即可直接得到所有位置的膜張力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pressure times seal span directly gives membrane tension at every location" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「次級密封與膜面荷載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Secondary seals and membrane loading”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 次級密封與膜面荷載
knowledge.text: Omega 類次級密封容許接頭相對位移，並提供與主密封不同的水密屏障。壓力乘跨距是每單位長度的橫向合力，不是膜張力；張力還取決於鼓出幾何、邊界固定和材料變形，夾具與角部不能從均勻薄膜模型略去。
knowledge.textEn: An Omega-type secondary seal accommodates relative movement and forms a barrier distinct from the primary seal. Pressure times span gives transverse resultant per unit length, not membrane tension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓力乘密封跨距即可直接得到所有位置的膜張力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pressure times seal span directly gives membrane tension at every location Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「次級密封與膜面荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Secondary seals and membrane loading" is correct?
options: 壓力乘密封跨距即可直接得到所有位置的膜張力
Omega 類次級密封容許接頭相對位移，並提供與主密封不同的水密屏障。
長管節的自由熱伸縮必定全部集中在單一接頭
optionsEn: Pressure times seal span directly gives membrane tension at every location
An Omega-type secondary seal accommodates relative movement and forms a barrier distinct from the primary seal.
All free thermal expansion of a long element concentrates at one joint
quiz.explanation: Omega 類次級密封容許接頭相對位移，並提供與主密封不同的水密屏障。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An Omega-type secondary seal accommodates relative movement and forms a barrier distinct from the primary seal. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 次級密封與膜面荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Secondary seals and membrane loading: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「次級密封與膜面荷載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Secondary seals and membrane loading” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：transverseResultantPerLength=p*span=0.20 MPa*0.30 m=60 kN/m; this is not membrane tension。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: transverseResultantPerLength=p*span=0.20 MPa*0.30 m=60 kN/m; this is not membrane tension. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把次級膜鼓出形狀、夾具位移與壓差試驗結果連結。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Relate secondary-membrane bulge, clamp movement and differential-pressure tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：transverseResultantPerLength=p*span=0.20 MPa*0.30 m=60 kN/m; this is not membrane tension。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: transverseResultantPerLength=p*span=0.20 MPa*0.30 m=60 kN/m; this is not membrane tension. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「次級密封與膜面荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Secondary seals and membrane loading", which statement holds?
options: 剪力鍵外觀面積全部都會同時均勻承受剪力
壓縮量固定就表示橡膠密封反力永遠不會降低

Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time
Original teaching assumptions: transverseResultantPerLength=p*span=0.20 MPa*0.30 m=60 kN/m; this is not membrane tension.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：transverseResultantPerLength=p*span=0.20 MPa*0.30 m=60 kN/m; this is not membrane tension。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: transverseResultantPerLength=p*span=0.20 MPa*0.30 m=60 kN/m; this is not membrane tension. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 次級密封與膜面荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Secondary seals and membrane loading: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「次級密封與膜面荷載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Secondary seals and membrane loading” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把次級膜鼓出形狀、夾具位移與壓差試驗結果連結。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把橫向合力誤當膜張力，漏估夾持區剝離與角部應變」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Relate secondary-membrane bulge, clamp movement and differential-pressure tests. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Treating transverse resultant as tension misses clamp peeling and corner strain. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將把次級膜鼓出形狀、夾具位移與壓差試驗結果連結列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把橫向合力誤當膜張力，漏估夾持區剝離與角部應變，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Relate secondary-membrane bulge, clamp movement and differential-pressure tests. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If treating transverse resultant as tension misses clamp peeling and corner strain, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把橫向合力誤當膜張力，漏估夾持區剝離與角部應變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating transverse resultant as tension misses clamp peeling and corner strain. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把次級膜鼓出形狀、夾具位移與壓差試驗結果連結。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把橫向合力誤當膜張力，漏估夾持區剝離與角部應變」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Relate secondary-membrane bulge, clamp movement and differential-pressure tests. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Treating transverse resultant as tension misses clamp peeling and corner strain. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將把次級膜鼓出形狀、夾具位移與壓差試驗結果連結列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把橫向合力誤當膜張力，漏估夾持區剝離與角部應變，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Relate secondary-membrane bulge, clamp movement and differential-pressure tests. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If treating transverse resultant as tension misses clamp peeling and corner strain, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「次級密封與膜面荷載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Secondary seals and membrane loading"?
options: 把次級膜鼓出形狀、夾具位移與壓差試驗結果連結。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸
optionsEn: Relate secondary-membrane bulge, clamp movement and differential-pressure tests.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal
quiz.explanation: 把次級膜鼓出形狀、夾具位移與壓差試驗結果連結。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Relate secondary-membrane bulge, clamp movement and differential-pressure tests. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 次級密封與膜面荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Secondary seals and membrane loading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「次級密封與膜面荷載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Secondary seals and membrane loading” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把橫向合力誤當膜張力，漏估夾持區剝離與角部應變。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把次級膜鼓出形狀、夾具位移與壓差試驗結果連結，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating transverse resultant as tension misses clamp peeling and corner strain. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to relate secondary-membrane bulge, clamp movement and differential-pressure tests to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把次級膜鼓出形狀、夾具位移與壓差試驗結果連結；若出現把橫向合力誤當膜張力，漏估夾持區剝離與角部應變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If treating transverse resultant as tension misses clamp peeling and corner strain, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓力乘密封跨距即可直接得到所有位置的膜張力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pressure times seal span directly gives membrane tension at every location" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把橫向合力誤當膜張力，漏估夾持區剝離與角部應變。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把次級膜鼓出形狀、夾具位移與壓差試驗結果連結，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Treating transverse resultant as tension misses clamp peeling and corner strain. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to relate secondary-membrane bulge, clamp movement and differential-pressure tests to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「次級密封與膜面荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Secondary seals and membrane loading" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把橫向合力誤當膜張力，漏估夾持區剝離與角部應變。
長管節的自由熱伸縮必定全部集中在單一接頭
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating transverse resultant as tension misses clamp peeling and corner strain.
All free thermal expansion of a long element concentrates at one joint
quiz.explanation: 把橫向合力誤當膜張力，漏估夾持區剝離與角部應變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating transverse resultant as tension misses clamp peeling and corner strain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溫度伸縮與軸向位移」與「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal expansion and axial movement" and "Differential settlement and joint rotation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度伸縮與軸向位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal expansion and axial movement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫度伸縮與軸向位移」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal expansion and axial movement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管節溫度改變可能透過接頭釋放位移，也可能因基床摩擦和相鄰約束累積軸力。自由伸縮是假想無拘束上限情境之一，不能同時又假定全拘束應力；維護判讀須對應量測溫度與實際滑移邊界，分開季節變化和永久漂移。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較管節溫度、接頭軸向開度及長期位置趨勢；若出現季節開度被誤判永久沉陷，或永久漂移被季節平均掩蓋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫度伸縮與軸向位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Element temperature changes can release movement at joints or accumulate force through bedding friction and neighboring restraints. Free expansion is a hypothetical unrestrained case and cannot simultaneously imply full-restraint stress. Relate monitoring temperature to slip boundaries to separate seasonal changes from permanent drift. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare element temperature, axial joint opening and long-term position trends. If seasonal opening is mistaken for settlement or averaging conceals permanent drift, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal expansion and axial movement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：freeExpansion=alpha*L*dT=1e-5/K*200 m*15 K=0.030 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: freeExpansion=alpha*L*dT=1e-5/K*200 m*15 K=0.030 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「長管節的自由熱伸縮必定全部集中在單一接頭」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All free thermal expansion of a long element concentrates at one joint" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溫度伸縮與軸向位移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thermal expansion and axial movement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫度伸縮與軸向位移
knowledge.text: 管節溫度改變可能透過接頭釋放位移，也可能因基床摩擦和相鄰約束累積軸力。自由伸縮是假想無拘束上限情境之一，不能同時又假定全拘束應力；維護判讀須對應量測溫度與實際滑移邊界，分開季節變化和永久漂移。
knowledge.textEn: Element temperature changes can release movement at joints or accumulate force through bedding friction and neighboring restraints. Free expansion is a hypothetical unrestrained case and cannot simultaneously imply full-restraint stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：長管節的自由熱伸縮必定全部集中在單一接頭 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All free thermal expansion of a long element concentrates at one joint Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度伸縮與軸向位移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal expansion and axial movement" is correct?
options: 長管節的自由熱伸縮必定全部集中在單一接頭
量測接頭中央一個開度就能代表整圈密封變形
管節溫度改變可能透過接頭釋放位移，也可能因基床摩擦和相鄰約束累積軸力。
optionsEn: All free thermal expansion of a long element concentrates at one joint
One central opening measurement represents deformation around the entire seal
Element temperature changes can release movement at joints or accumulate force through bedding friction and neighboring restraints.
quiz.explanation: 管節溫度改變可能透過接頭釋放位移，也可能因基床摩擦和相鄰約束累積軸力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Element temperature changes can release movement at joints or accumulate force through bedding friction and neighboring restraints. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫度伸縮與軸向位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal expansion and axial movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溫度伸縮與軸向位移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal expansion and axial movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：freeExpansion=alpha*L*dT=1e-5/K*200 m*15 K=0.030 m。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: freeExpansion=alpha*L*dT=1e-5/K*200 m*15 K=0.030 m. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較管節溫度、接頭軸向開度及長期位置趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare element temperature, axial joint opening and long-term position trends.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：freeExpansion=alpha*L*dT=1e-5/K*200 m*15 K=0.030 m。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫度伸縮與軸向位移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 原創教學假設：freeExpansion=alpha*L*dT=1e-5/K*200 m*15 K=0.030 m。
接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷

Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free
