steps.title: 溫度伸縮與軸向位移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal expansion and axial movement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溫度伸縮與軸向位移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal expansion and axial movement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較管節溫度、接頭軸向開度及長期位置趨勢。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「季節開度被誤判永久沉陷，或永久漂移被季節平均掩蓋」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare element temperature, axial joint opening and long-term position trends. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Seasonal opening is mistaken for settlement or averaging conceals permanent drift. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較管節溫度、接頭軸向開度及長期位置趨勢列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現季節開度被誤判永久沉陷，或永久漂移被季節平均掩蓋，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare element temperature, axial joint opening and long-term position trends. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If seasonal opening is mistaken for settlement or averaging conceals permanent drift, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：季節開度被誤判永久沉陷，或永久漂移被季節平均掩蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Seasonal opening is mistaken for settlement or averaging conceals permanent drift. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較管節溫度、接頭軸向開度及長期位置趨勢。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「季節開度被誤判永久沉陷，或永久漂移被季節平均掩蓋」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare element temperature, axial joint opening and long-term position trends. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Seasonal opening is mistaken for settlement or averaging conceals permanent drift. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較管節溫度、接頭軸向開度及長期位置趨勢列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現季節開度被誤判永久沉陷，或永久漂移被季節平均掩蓋，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare element temperature, axial joint opening and long-term position trends. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If seasonal opening is mistaken for settlement or averaging conceals permanent drift, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫度伸縮與軸向位移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal expansion and axial movement"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
比較管節溫度、接頭軸向開度及長期位置趨勢。
橡膠壓縮率相同就代表任何密封斷面的反力相同
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare element temperature, axial joint opening and long-term position trends.
Equal rubber compression ratios imply equal reaction for every seal profile
quiz.explanation: 比較管節溫度、接頭軸向開度及長期位置趨勢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare element temperature, axial joint opening and long-term position trends. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫度伸縮與軸向位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal expansion and axial movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「溫度伸縮與軸向位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal expansion and axial movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 季節開度被誤判永久沉陷，或永久漂移被季節平均掩蓋。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較管節溫度、接頭軸向開度及長期位置趨勢，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Seasonal opening is mistaken for settlement or averaging conceals permanent drift. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare element temperature, axial joint opening and long-term position trends to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較管節溫度、接頭軸向開度及長期位置趨勢；若出現季節開度被誤判永久沉陷，或永久漂移被季節平均掩蓋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If seasonal opening is mistaken for settlement or averaging conceals permanent drift, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「長管節的自由熱伸縮必定全部集中在單一接頭」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All free thermal expansion of a long element concentrates at one joint" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 季節開度被誤判永久沉陷，或永久漂移被季節平均掩蓋。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較管節溫度、接頭軸向開度及長期位置趨勢，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Seasonal opening is mistaken for settlement or averaging conceals permanent drift. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare element temperature, axial joint opening and long-term position trends to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度伸縮與軸向位移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal expansion and axial movement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
量測接頭中央一個開度就能代表整圈密封變形
季節開度被誤判永久沉陷，或永久漂移被季節平均掩蓋。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
One central opening measurement represents deformation around the entire seal
Seasonal opening is mistaken for settlement or averaging conceals permanent drift.
quiz.explanation: 季節開度被誤判永久沉陷，或永久漂移被季節平均掩蓋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Seasonal opening is mistaken for settlement or averaging conceals permanent drift. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement and joint rotation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰基床沉陷差使接頭發生轉角和剪位移，密封上緣與下緣的開度因而不同。本算例假定一管節為剛體且相鄰管節維持水平，因此單段弦傾角等於接頭相對轉角；若兩側都轉動，應改用兩側斜率差。管節本身彎曲及接頭剪力鍵約束也會重新分配變形；必須同時觀察接頭和管節的長基線高程。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較長基線沉陷、接頭四角開度與剪位移；若出現單點開度正常卻四角變化不一致，漏掉轉角造成的局部卸壓，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Differential bedding settlement rotates and shears a joint, producing different openings at its top and bottom. This example assumes one rigid element beside a horizontal neighbor, so its chord inclination equals relative joint rotation. If both sides rotate, use their slope difference instead. Element bending and shear-key restraints also redistribute movement. Monitor both the joint and long-baseline element elevations to distinguish these contributions. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare long-baseline settlement, four-corner opening and joint shear movement. If one normal opening measurement conceals corner differences and rotation-induced local unloading, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement and joint rotation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：relativeJointRotation=0.020 m/200 m=0.00010 rad only for a rigid element beside a horizontal neighbor; openingDifference=relativeJointRotation*10 m=0.001 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: relativeJointRotation=0.020 m/200 m=0.00010 rad only for a rigid element beside a horizontal neighbor; openingDifference=relativeJointRotation*10 m=0.001 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量測接頭中央一個開度就能代表整圈密封變形」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One central opening measurement represents deformation around the entire seal" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential settlement and joint rotation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 相鄰基床沉陷差使接頭發生轉角和剪位移，密封上緣與下緣的開度因而不同。本算例假定一管節為剛體且相鄰管節維持水平，因此單段弦傾角等於接頭相對轉角；若兩側都轉動，應改用兩側斜率差。

The full visible shear-key area always carries shear uniformly
quiz.explanation: 相鄰基床沉陷差使接頭發生轉角和剪位移，密封上緣與下緣的開度因而不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Differential bedding settlement rotates and shears a joint, producing different openings at its top and bottom. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential settlement and joint rotation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：relativeJointRotation=0.020 m/200 m=0.00010 rad only for a rigid element beside a horizontal neighbor; openingDifference=relativeJointRotation*10 m=0.001 m。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: relativeJointRotation=0.020 m/200 m=0.00010 rad only for a rigid element beside a horizontal neighbor; openingDifference=relativeJointRotation*10 m=0.001 m. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較長基線沉陷、接頭四角開度與剪位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare long-baseline settlement, four-corner opening and joint shear movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：relativeJointRotation=0.020 m/200 m=0.00010 rad only for a rigid element beside a horizontal neighbor; openingDifference=relativeJointRotation*10 m=0.001 m。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: relativeJointRotation=0.020 m/200 m=0.00010 rad only for a rigid element beside a horizontal neighbor; openingDifference=relativeJointRotation*10 m=0.001 m. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Differential settlement and joint rotation", which statement holds?
options: 壓縮量固定就表示橡膠密封反力永遠不會降低

Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: relativeJointRotation=0.020 m/200 m=0.00010 rad only for a rigid element beside a horizontal neighbor; openingDifference=relativeJointRotation*10 m=0.001 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement and joint rotation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較長基線沉陷、接頭四角開度與剪位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「單點開度正常卻四角變化不一致，漏掉轉角造成的局部卸壓」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare long-baseline settlement, four-corner opening and joint shear movement. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: One normal opening measurement conceals corner differences and rotation-induced local unloading. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較長基線沉陷、接頭四角開度與剪位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現單點開度正常卻四角變化不一致，漏掉轉角造成的局部卸壓，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare long-baseline settlement, four-corner opening and joint shear movement. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If one normal opening measurement conceals corner differences and rotation-induced local unloading, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單點開度正常卻四角變化不一致，漏掉轉角造成的局部卸壓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One normal opening measurement conceals corner differences and rotation-induced local unloading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較長基線沉陷、接頭四角開度與剪位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「單點開度正常卻四角變化不一致，漏掉轉角造成的局部卸壓」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare long-baseline settlement, four-corner opening and joint shear movement. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: One normal opening measurement conceals corner differences and rotation-induced local unloading. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較長基線沉陷、接頭四角開度與剪位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現單點開度正常卻四角變化不一致，漏掉轉角造成的局部卸壓，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare long-baseline settlement, four-corner opening and joint shear movement. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If one normal opening measurement conceals corner differences and rotation-induced local unloading, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential settlement and joint rotation"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
外水壓乘全部濕表面就等於接頭軸向合攏力

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
External pressure times every wet surface equals the axial joint-closing force
Compare long-baseline settlement, four-corner opening and joint shear movement.
quiz.explanation: 比較長基線沉陷、接頭四角開度與剪位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare long-baseline settlement, four-corner opening and joint shear movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement and joint rotation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單點開度正常卻四角變化不一致，漏掉轉角造成的局部卸壓。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較長基線沉陷、接頭四角開度與剪位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One normal opening measurement conceals corner differences and rotation-induced local unloading. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare long-baseline settlement, four-corner opening and joint shear movement to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較長基線沉陷、接頭四角開度與剪位移；若出現單點開度正常卻四角變化不一致，漏掉轉角造成的局部卸壓，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If one normal opening measurement conceals corner differences and rotation-induced local unloading, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量測接頭中央一個開度就能代表整圈密封變形」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One central opening measurement represents deformation around the entire seal" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單點開度正常卻四角變化不一致，漏掉轉角造成的局部卸壓。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較長基線沉陷、接頭四角開度與剪位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: One normal opening measurement conceals corner differences and rotation-induced local unloading. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare long-baseline settlement, four-corner opening and joint shear movement to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Differential settlement and joint rotation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 單點開度正常卻四角變化不一致，漏掉轉角造成的局部卸壓。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
剪力鍵外觀面積全部都會同時均勻承受剪力
optionsEn: One normal opening measurement conceals corner differences and rotation-induced local unloading.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The full visible shear-key area always carries shear uniformly

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」與「分區滲漏與來源辨識」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact" and "Compartment leakage and source diagnosis": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 剪力鍵限制管節相對橫移並將剪力傳給混凝土，接觸位置取決於間隙、裝配與差異沉陷。平均承壓只適用已知有效面積，邊緣接觸會伴隨劈裂和局部彎曲；不能把整塊外觀面積直接當作同時承壓面。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫；若出現鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shear keys restrain relative transverse movement and transmit shear into concrete, with contact governed by gaps, assembly and settlement. Average bearing requires a known effective area; edge contact introduces splitting and local bending. The whole visible face is not automatically active bearing area. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks. If corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：meanBearing=shear/effectiveArea=1000 kN/0.50 m2=2000 kPa=2 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: meanBearing=shear/effectiveArea=1000 kN/0.50 m2=2000 kPa=2 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力鍵外觀面積全部都會同時均勻承受剪力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The full visible shear-key area always carries shear uniformly" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心
knowledge.text: 剪力鍵限制管節相對橫移並將剪力傳給混凝土，接觸位置取決於間隙、裝配與差異沉陷。平均承壓只適用已知有效面積，邊緣接觸會伴隨劈裂和局部彎曲；不能把整塊外觀面積直接當作同時承壓面。
knowledge.textEn: Shear keys restrain relative transverse movement and transmit shear into concrete, with contact governed by gaps, assembly and settlement. Average bearing requires a known effective area; edge contact introduces splitting and local bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力鍵外觀面積全部都會同時均勻承受剪力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The full visible shear-key area always carries shear uniformly Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 剪力鍵外觀面積全部都會同時均勻承受剪力
剪力鍵限制管節相對橫移並將剪力傳給混凝土，接觸位置取決於間隙、裝配與差異沉陷。
接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷
optionsEn: The full visible shear-key area always carries shear uniformly
Shear keys restrain relative transverse movement and transmit shear into concrete, with contact governed by gaps, assembly and settlement.
Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free

quiz.explanationEn: Shear keys restrain relative transverse movement and transmit shear into concrete, with contact governed by gaps, assembly and settlement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：meanBearing=shear/effectiveArea=1000 kN/0.50 m2=2000 kPa=2 MPa。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: meanBearing=shear/effectiveArea=1000 kN/0.50 m2=2000 kPa=2 MPa. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

optionsEn: Check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Pressure times seal span directly gives membrane tension at every location
quiz.explanation: 核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫；若出現鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力鍵外觀面積全部都會同時均勻承受剪力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The full visible shear-key area always carries shear uniformly" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低。
接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low.
Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free
quiz.explanation: 鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分區滲漏與來源辨識：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 接頭集水量可能來自主密封、次級密封、螺栓穿孔或周邊施工縫，不是單憑出水位置就能定位缺口。比較分區壓力與時間響應可縮小來源，總流量還受外水位影響；低流量不能證明兩重屏障均保持完整。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化；若出現匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分區滲漏與來源辨識」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Collected joint water can originate at primary seals, secondary seals, penetrations or adjacent construction joints. Outlet location alone does not locate the breach. Compartment pressure and time response narrow the source, while external water level affects total flow; low flow does not demonstrate two intact barriers. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record compartment pressure, collected flow and external water-level changes together. If combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compartment leakage and source diagnosis” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：collectedFlow=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: collectedFlow=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分區滲漏與來源辨識」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Compartment leakage and source diagnosis”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Collected joint water can originate at primary seals, secondary seals, penetrations or adjacent construction joints. Outlet location alone does not locate the breach.

quiz.question: 關於「分區滲漏與來源辨識」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free
Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：collectedFlow=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: collectedFlow=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分區滲漏與來源辨識」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸

Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal
External pressure times every wet surface equals the axial joint-closing force
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：collectedFlow=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: collectedFlow=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分區滲漏與來源辨識：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compartment leakage and source diagnosis: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分區滲漏與來源辨識」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compartment leakage and source diagnosis” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record compartment pressure, collected flow and external water-level changes together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Record compartment pressure, collected flow and external water-level changes together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分區滲漏與來源辨識」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Record compartment pressure, collected flow and external water-level changes together.
All free thermal expansion of a long element concentrates at one joint
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record compartment pressure, collected flow and external water-level changes together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分區滲漏與來源辨識：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compartment leakage and source diagnosis: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分區滲漏與來源辨識」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compartment leakage and source diagnosis” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record compartment pressure, collected flow and external water-level changes together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化；若出現匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record compartment pressure, collected flow and external water-level changes together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分區滲漏與來源辨識」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compartment leakage and source diagnosis" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
壓縮量固定就表示橡膠密封反力永遠不會降低
匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time
Combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow.
quiz.explanation: 匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「應力鬆弛與長期密封」與「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stress relaxation and long-term sealing" and "Barrier independence and handover records": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 應力鬆弛與長期密封：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stress relaxation and long-term sealing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「應力鬆弛與長期密封」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stress relaxation and long-term sealing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 橡膠在近固定壓縮下仍會應力鬆弛，溫度、老化和化學環境共同改變長期接觸反力。短期保持率只是特定試驗條件的比較，不是現場壽命或剩餘承壓能力；長期評估需保持幾何變形與材料劣化資料之間的對應。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移；若出現將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「應力鬆弛與長期密封」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rubber relaxes under nearly fixed compression, with temperature, aging and chemistry altering long-term contact force. Short-term retention compares specified test conditions, not field lifetime or remaining pressure capacity. Long-term assessment must link material degradation evidence with actual geometric deformation histories. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare sustained-compression tests at equal temperature with joint movement histories. If equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stress relaxation and long-term sealing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：forceRetention=180 kN/240 kN=0.75=75 percent at equal imposed compression。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: forceRetention=180 kN/240 kN=0.75=75 percent at equal imposed compression.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓縮量固定就表示橡膠密封反力永遠不會降低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「應力鬆弛與長期密封」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stress relaxation and long-term sealing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Rubber relaxes under nearly fixed compression, with temperature, aging and chemistry altering long-term contact force. Short-term retention compares specified test conditions, not field lifetime or remaining pressure capacity.

knowledge.text: 誤解：壓縮量固定就表示橡膠密封反力永遠不會降低 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「應力鬆弛與長期密封」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：forceRetention=180 kN/240 kN=0.75=75 percent at equal imposed compression。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instruction: 比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓縮量固定就表示橡膠密封反力永遠不會降低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objective: 說明「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Barrier independence and handover records” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主次密封若共用同一失效夾持件或受同一大位移破壞，就不構成完全獨立的備援。交接需對應各屏障試驗、幾何、材料和可檢查部位，完整率僅顯示證據缺口；缺失一項關鍵試驗不能由更多非關鍵紀錄補足。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單；若出現雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Primary and secondary seals are not fully independent if they share a failed restraint or suffer the same excessive movement. Record completeness reveals evidence gaps; many minor records cannot compensate for a missing critical barrier test. If a shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Barrier independence and handover records” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Barrier independence and handover records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Barrier independence and handover records"?
options: 逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The full visible shear-key area always carries shear uniformly
quiz.explanation: 逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 屏障獨立性與交接檔案：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Barrier independence and handover records: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Barrier independence and handover records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單；若出現雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要安裝兩道密封就必定得到完全獨立的雙重保障」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing two seals always creates completely independent redundant protection" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Barrier independence and handover records" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援。
兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy.
Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal
quiz.explanation: 雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 箱涵頂進施工
summary: 本課以箱涵頂進的力鏈、地層損失與營運界面為主線，從箱涵自重與滑移界面與油壓推力與後座反力建立系統邊界，再把刃口接觸與局部承壓、姿態修正與曲線相容連到封鎖窗口與恢復證據。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on box-jacking load paths, ground loss and operating interfaces. It begins with Box weight and sliding interfaces and Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force, links Cutting-edge contact and local bearing and Attitude correction and path compatibility, and ends with Possession windows and restoration evidence. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查箱涵自重與滑移界面：Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN；再獨立檢查油壓推力與後座反力：idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN。假設摩擦係數從 0.15 增至 0.25，自重 5760 kN 對應的底面摩擦由 864 增至 1440 kN；未含側摩阻及切口阻力。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 將將原位換算出土量、周邊間隙及地表沉陷按里程對齊作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Box weight and sliding interfaces: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN. Independently check Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force: idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN. Increasing assumed friction from 0.15 to 0.25 raises base friction for 5760 kN weight from 864 to 1440 kN, excluding side friction and cutting resistance. The two results are not a complete design because rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. Use align in-situ-equivalent spoil, peripheral gaps and surface settlement by chainage as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「箱涵自重與滑移界面」與「油壓推力與後座反力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Box weight and sliding interfaces" and "Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Box weight and sliding interfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「箱涵自重與滑移界面」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Box weight and sliding interfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 箱涵混凝土截面由外框扣除內孔得到，但附屬設備、臨時構件與積水仍需另計。自重決定底面接觸的部分法向力，浮力和地層反力則會改變分布；把外包體積全部視為實心會高估重量並扭曲推力預估。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區；若出現錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「箱涵自重與滑移界面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Subtract the internal void from the outer rectangle to obtain concrete area, while accounting separately for equipment, temporary works and water. Weight contributes to base normal force, modified by buoyancy and soil reactions. Treating the bounding volume as solid overstates mass and distorts thrust estimates. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. If treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Box weight and sliding interfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「箱涵自重與滑移界面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Box weight and sliding interfaces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面
knowledge.text: 箱涵混凝土截面由外框扣除內孔得到，但附屬設備、臨時構件與積水仍需另計。自重決定底面接觸的部分法向力，浮力和地層反力則會改變分布；把外包體積全部視為實心會高估重量並扭曲推力預估。
knowledge.textEn: Subtract the internal void from the outer rectangle to obtain concrete area, while accounting separately for equipment, temporary works and water. Weight contributes to base normal force, modified by buoyancy and soil reactions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「箱涵自重與滑移界面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Box weight and sliding interfaces" is correct?
options: 箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積
箱涵混凝土截面由外框扣除內孔得到，但附屬設備、臨時構件與積水仍需另計。
千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力
optionsEn: Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume
Subtract the internal void from the outer rectangle to obtain concrete area, while accounting separately for equipment, temporary works and water.
Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain
quiz.explanation: 箱涵混凝土截面由外框扣除內孔得到，但附屬設備、臨時構件與積水仍需另計。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Subtract the internal void from the outer rectangle to obtain concrete area, while accounting separately for equipment, temporary works and water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Box weight and sliding interfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「箱涵自重與滑移界面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Box weight and sliding interfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. steps.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Box weight and sliding interfaces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「箱涵自重與滑移界面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Box weight and sliding interfaces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 要驗證「箱涵自重與滑移界面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An overbreak percentage directly equals the maximum surface-settlement percentage
quiz.explanation: 逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Box weight and sliding interfaces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「箱涵自重與滑移界面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Box weight and sliding interfaces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區；若出現錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「箱涵自重與滑移界面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Box weight and sliding interfaces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差。
千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically.
Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain
quiz.explanation: 錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 油壓推力與後座反力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「油壓推力與後座反力」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 千斤頂壓力透過有效活塞面積變成力，後座牆和地層必須提供相反反力。油封摩擦、回油壓及不同缸位使表壓總和不是精確合力；推力能力與後座可承力是不同限制，不能因油壓未滿就判斷可繼續增加負載。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫；若出現後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「油壓推力與後座反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jack pressure produces force over effective piston area, requiring equal reaction from the thrust wall and ground. Seal friction, return pressure and cylinder states affect the result. Hydraulic capability and reaction-wall capacity are separate constraints; unused pressure capacity does not establish permission to increase load. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks. If reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「油壓推力與後座反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 油壓推力與後座反力
knowledge.text: 千斤頂壓力透過有效活塞面積變成力，後座牆和地層必須提供相反反力。油封摩擦、回油壓及不同缸位使表壓總和不是精確合力；推力能力與後座可承力是不同限制，不能因油壓未滿就判斷可繼續增加負載。
knowledge.textEn: Jack pressure produces force over effective piston area, requiring equal reaction from the thrust wall and ground. Seal friction, return pressure and cylinder states affect the result.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「油壓推力與後座反力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force" is correct?
options: 千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力
量到一次低摩擦係數就可套用所有後續頂進階段
千斤頂壓力透過有效活塞面積變成力，後座牆和地層必須提供相反反力。
optionsEn: Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain
One low measured friction coefficient applies to every later jacking stage
Jack pressure produces force over effective piston area, requiring equal reaction from the thrust wall and ground.
quiz.explanation: 千斤頂壓力透過有效活塞面積變成力，後座牆和地層必須提供相反反力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
