knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「油壓推力與後座反力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN。
刃口總面積夠大就不會產生任何局部壓碎
前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN.
A sufficiently large total edge area prevents every local crushing mechanism
A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 油壓推力與後座反力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「油壓推力與後座反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「油壓推力與後座反力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫。
平均沉陷足夠小就代表所有鐵路幾何必定合格
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks.
Sufficiently small average settlement guarantees all railway geometry is acceptable
quiz.explanation: 比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 油壓推力與後座反力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「油壓推力與後座反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫；若出現後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「油壓推力與後座反力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
量到一次低摩擦係數就可套用所有後續頂進階段
後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
One low measured friction coefficient applies to every later jacking stage
Reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance.
quiz.explanation: 後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」與「頂板框架與施工支承」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Base friction and lubrication variability" and "Roof-frame action and construction support": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 底面摩擦與潤滑變異：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base friction and lubrication variability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Base friction and lubrication variability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 滑移界面摩阻隨有效法向力、材料接觸與潤滑狀態改變，啟動阻力可能高於穩定滑移。庫倫模型只表示一個假設狀態，不能把同一係數套到乾濕區、停機時間及側面土壓；推力歷程需按工況分段解讀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較啟動與穩態推力、停機時長及潤滑覆蓋證據；若出現局部失潤滑造成推力尖峰，被誤判成全面硬地層，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sliding friction depends on effective normal force, contact materials and lubrication, with breakaway potentially above steady motion. A Coulomb model describes an assumed state, not one coefficient valid across dry zones, waiting periods and side earth pressure. Interpret thrust histories by operating condition. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare breakaway and steady thrust, stoppage duration and lubrication coverage evidence. If local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Base friction and lubrication variability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：baseFriction=mu*W=0.15*5760 kN=864 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: baseFriction=mu*W=0.15*5760 kN=864 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量到一次低摩擦係數就可套用所有後續頂進階段」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One low measured friction coefficient applies to every later jacking stage" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Base friction and lubrication variability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 底面摩擦與潤滑變異
knowledge.text: 滑移界面摩阻隨有效法向力、材料接觸與潤滑狀態改變，啟動阻力可能高於穩定滑移。庫倫模型只表示一個假設狀態，不能把同一係數套到乾濕區、停機時間及側面土壓；推力歷程需按工況分段解讀。
knowledge.textEn: Sliding friction depends on effective normal force, contact materials and lubrication, with breakaway potentially above steady motion. A Coulomb model describes an assumed state, not one coefficient valid across dry zones, waiting periods and side earth pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量到一次低摩擦係數就可套用所有後續頂進階段 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One low measured friction coefficient applies to every later jacking stage Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base friction and lubrication variability" is correct?
options: 滑移界面摩阻隨有效法向力、材料接觸與潤滑狀態改變，啟動阻力可能高於穩定滑移。
量到一次低摩擦係數就可套用所有後續頂進階段
頂板當作簡支梁計算就涵蓋所有框架受力
optionsEn: Sliding friction depends on effective normal force, contact materials and lubrication, with breakaway potentially above steady motion.
One low measured friction coefficient applies to every later jacking stage
A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action
quiz.explanation: 滑移界面摩阻隨有效法向力、材料接觸與潤滑狀態改變，啟動阻力可能高於穩定滑移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sliding friction depends on effective normal force, contact materials and lubrication, with breakaway potentially above steady motion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 底面摩擦與潤滑變異：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base friction and lubrication variability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Base friction and lubrication variability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：baseFriction=mu*W=0.15*5760 kN=864 kN。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: baseFriction=mu*W=0.15*5760 kN=864 kN. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較啟動與穩態推力、停機時長及潤滑覆蓋證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare breakaway and steady thrust, stoppage duration and lubrication coverage evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：baseFriction=mu*W=0.15*5760 kN=864 kN。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: baseFriction=mu*W=0.15*5760 kN=864 kN. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Base friction and lubrication variability", which statement holds?
options: 只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配
原創教學假設：baseFriction=mu*W=0.15*5760 kN=864 kN。
超挖百分比可以直接當作地表最大沉陷百分比
optionsEn: If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter
Original teaching assumptions: baseFriction=mu*W=0.15*5760 kN=864 kN.

quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：baseFriction=mu*W=0.15*5760 kN=864 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: baseFriction=mu*W=0.15*5760 kN=864 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 底面摩擦與潤滑變異：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base friction and lubrication variability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Base friction and lubrication variability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較啟動與穩態推力、停機時長及潤滑覆蓋證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部失潤滑造成推力尖峰，被誤判成全面硬地層」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare breakaway and steady thrust, stoppage duration and lubrication coverage evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較啟動與穩態推力、停機時長及潤滑覆蓋證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部失潤滑造成推力尖峰，被誤判成全面硬地層，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare breakaway and steady thrust, stoppage duration and lubrication coverage evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部失潤滑造成推力尖峰，被誤判成全面硬地層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較啟動與穩態推力、停機時長及潤滑覆蓋證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部失潤滑造成推力尖峰，被誤判成全面硬地層，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

quiz.question: 要驗證「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Base friction and lubrication variability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
窗口還有剩餘時間就代表工程品質已經獲得保證
比較啟動與穩態推力、停機時長及潤滑覆蓋證據。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Remaining possession time proves construction quality has already been assured
Compare breakaway and steady thrust, stoppage duration and lubrication coverage evidence.
quiz.explanation: 比較啟動與穩態推力、停機時長及潤滑覆蓋證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare breakaway and steady thrust, stoppage duration and lubrication coverage evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 底面摩擦與潤滑變異：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base friction and lubrication variability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Base friction and lubrication variability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部失潤滑造成推力尖峰，被誤判成全面硬地層。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較啟動與穩態推力、停機時長及潤滑覆蓋證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare breakaway and steady thrust, stoppage duration and lubrication coverage evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較啟動與穩態推力、停機時長及潤滑覆蓋證據；若出現局部失潤滑造成推力尖峰，被誤判成全面硬地層，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量到一次低摩擦係數就可套用所有後續頂進階段」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One low measured friction coefficient applies to every later jacking stage" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部失潤滑造成推力尖峰，被誤判成全面硬地層。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較啟動與穩態推力、停機時長及潤滑覆蓋證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare breakaway and steady thrust, stoppage duration and lubrication coverage evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base friction and lubrication variability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 局部失潤滑造成推力尖峰，被誤判成全面硬地層。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
頂板當作簡支梁計算就涵蓋所有框架受力
optionsEn: Local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action
quiz.explanation: 局部失潤滑造成推力尖峰，被誤判成全面硬地層。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 頂板框架與施工支承：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Roof-frame action and construction support: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頂板框架與施工支承」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roof-frame action and construction support” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 箱涵頂板和側牆形成框架，角部轉動限制使彎矩不同於獨立簡支梁。條帶模型可用來核對量級，但頂進時前緣懸伸、地面交通與覆土拱效應又改變支承；應逐階段標出荷載路徑和拉力側。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將框架邊界、頂板應變及前緣懸伸狀態共同比對；若出現把固定角部當鉸接，遺漏角隅負彎矩與裂縫需求，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂板框架與施工支承」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The roof and walls form a frame, with corner restraint changing moments from those of an isolated simple beam. A strip check estimates scale only; front overhang, surface traffic and soil arching alter support during jacking. Identify load paths and tension faces separately for each stage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare frame restraints, roof strains and leading-edge overhang state. If treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Roof-frame action and construction support” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：idealStripMoment=q*L^2/8=50 kN/m*(7 m)^2/8=306.25 kNm for a 1 m strip。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: idealStripMoment=q*L^2/8=50 kN/m*(7 m)^2/8=306.25 kNm for a 1 m strip.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頂板當作簡支梁計算就涵蓋所有框架受力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頂板框架與施工支承」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Roof-frame action and construction support”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頂板框架與施工支承
knowledge.text: 箱涵頂板和側牆形成框架，角部轉動限制使彎矩不同於獨立簡支梁。條帶模型可用來核對量級，但頂進時前緣懸伸、地面交通與覆土拱效應又改變支承；應逐階段標出荷載路徑和拉力側。
knowledge.textEn: The roof and walls form a frame, with corner restraint changing moments from those of an isolated simple beam. A strip check estimates scale only; front overhang, surface traffic and soil arching alter support during jacking.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頂板當作簡支梁計算就涵蓋所有框架受力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頂板框架與施工支承」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Roof-frame action and construction support" is correct?
options: 頂板當作簡支梁計算就涵蓋所有框架受力
箱涵頂板和側牆形成框架，角部轉動限制使彎矩不同於獨立簡支梁。
刃口總面積夠大就不會產生任何局部壓碎
optionsEn: A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action
The roof and walls form a frame, with corner restraint changing moments from those of an isolated simple beam.
A sufficiently large total edge area prevents every local crushing mechanism
quiz.explanation: 箱涵頂板和側牆形成框架，角部轉動限制使彎矩不同於獨立簡支梁。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The roof and walls form a frame, with corner restraint changing moments from those of an isolated simple beam. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頂板框架與施工支承：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Roof-frame action and construction support: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂板框架與施工支承」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Roof-frame action and construction support” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：idealStripMoment=q*L^2/8=50 kN/m*(7 m)^2/8=306.25 kNm for a 1 m strip。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: idealStripMoment=q*L^2/8=50 kN/m*(7 m)^2/8=306.25 kNm for a 1 m strip. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將框架邊界、頂板應變及前緣懸伸狀態共同比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare frame restraints, roof strains and leading-edge overhang state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：idealStripMoment=q*L^2/8=50 kN/m*(7 m)^2/8=306.25 kNm for a 1 m strip。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: idealStripMoment=q*L^2/8=50 kN/m*(7 m)^2/8=306.25 kNm for a 1 m strip. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「頂板框架與施工支承」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Roof-frame action and construction support", which statement holds?
options: 前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確

Sufficiently small average settlement guarantees all railway geometry is acceptable

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Roof-frame action and construction support"?

steps.title: 頂板框架與施工支承：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Roof-frame action and construction support: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂板框架與施工支承」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roof-frame action and construction support” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把固定角部當鉸接，遺漏角隅負彎矩與裂縫需求。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將框架邊界、頂板應變及前緣懸伸狀態共同比對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare frame restraints, roof strains and leading-edge overhang state to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將框架邊界、頂板應變及前緣懸伸狀態共同比對；若出現把固定角部當鉸接，遺漏角隅負彎矩與裂縫需求，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂板當作簡支梁計算就涵蓋所有框架受力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare frame restraints, roof strains and leading-edge overhang state to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頂板框架與施工支承」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Roof-frame action and construction support" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把固定角部當鉸接，遺漏角隅負彎矩與裂縫需求。
刃口總面積夠大就不會產生任何局部壓碎
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand.
A sufficiently large total edge area prevents every local crushing mechanism
quiz.explanation: 把固定角部當鉸接，遺漏角隅負彎矩與裂縫需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「刃口接觸與局部承壓」與「推力偏心與箱身應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cutting-edge contact and local bearing" and "Eccentric thrust and box stress": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 刃口接觸與局部承壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cutting-edge contact and local bearing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「刃口接觸與局部承壓」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cutting-edge contact and local bearing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 刃口將前緣阻力傳入箱涵，局部硬塊和偏斜會縮小實際接觸面。平均壓力不能代表刃角峰值，背後混凝土還需承受剪力與劈裂；不均勻切削也可能改變行進方向，應把局部受力和姿態聯合判讀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較刃口磨耗、分區推力與前端姿態變化；若出現一側硬塊集中受力使刃口局部損傷並帶偏箱涵，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「刃口接觸與局部承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The cutting edge transfers face resistance into the box, while hard inclusions and skew reduce active contact area. Mean pressure misses corner peaks and the backing concrete must resist shear and splitting. Uneven cutting can also steer the box, linking local load evidence with attitude monitoring. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare edge wear, zonal thrust and leading-end attitude changes. If a hard inclusion concentrates force on one side, damaging the edge and steering the box, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cutting-edge contact and local bearing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「刃口總面積夠大就不會產生任何局部壓碎」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large total edge area prevents every local crushing mechanism" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「刃口接觸與局部承壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cutting-edge contact and local bearing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 刃口接觸與局部承壓
knowledge.text: 刃口將前緣阻力傳入箱涵，局部硬塊和偏斜會縮小實際接觸面。平均壓力不能代表刃角峰值，背後混凝土還需承受剪力與劈裂；不均勻切削也可能改變行進方向，應把局部受力和姿態聯合判讀。
knowledge.textEn: The cutting edge transfers face resistance into the box, while hard inclusions and skew reduce active contact area. Mean pressure misses corner peaks and the backing concrete must resist shear and splitting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：刃口總面積夠大就不會產生任何局部壓碎 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently large total edge area prevents every local crushing mechanism Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「刃口接觸與局部承壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cutting-edge contact and local bearing" is correct?
options: 刃口總面積夠大就不會產生任何局部壓碎
只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配
刃口將前緣阻力傳入箱涵，局部硬塊和偏斜會縮小實際接觸面。
optionsEn: A sufficiently large total edge area prevents every local crushing mechanism
If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter
The cutting edge transfers face resistance into the box, while hard inclusions and skew reduce active contact area.
quiz.explanation: 刃口將前緣阻力傳入箱涵，局部硬塊和偏斜會縮小實際接觸面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The cutting edge transfers face resistance into the box, while hard inclusions and skew reduce active contact area. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「刃口接觸與局部承壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cutting-edge contact and local bearing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較刃口磨耗、分區推力與前端姿態變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare edge wear, zonal thrust and leading-end attitude changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「刃口接觸與局部承壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cutting-edge contact and local bearing", which statement holds?

超挖百分比可以直接當作地表最大沉陷百分比
窗口還有剩餘時間就代表工程品質已經獲得保證

An overbreak percentage directly equals the maximum surface-settlement percentage

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 推力偏心與箱身應力：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「推力偏心與箱身應力」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentric thrust and box stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 推力中心偏離承壓截面中心會同時引入軸壓與彎曲，局部頂塊接觸也不必均勻。線彈性疊加只適用未開裂及已知截面幾何，不能替代箱涵角部和開孔分析；多缸推力應與實際力臂一起核對。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變；若出現總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「推力偏心與箱身應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thrust eccentricity combines compression and bending, and thrust-block contact need not be uniform. Linear superposition requires an uncracked section with known properties and cannot replace corner or opening analysis. Reconcile individual jack forces with their actual lever arms rather than summing magnitudes alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains. If normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric thrust and box stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：M=3000 kN*0.05 m=150 kNm; sigmaMax=N/A+M/Z=3000/1+150/0.2=3750 kPa (A=1 m2,Z=0.2 m3)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: M=3000 kN*0.05 m=150 kNm; sigmaMax=N/A+M/Z=3000/1+150/0.2=3750 kPa (A=1 m2,Z=0.2 m3).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「推力偏心與箱身應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「推力偏心與箱身應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Eccentric thrust and box stress"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
量到一次低摩擦係數就可套用所有後續頂進階段
核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
One low measured friction coefficient applies to every later jacking stage
Check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains.
quiz.explanation: 核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 推力偏心與箱身應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Eccentric thrust and box stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「推力偏心與箱身應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Eccentric thrust and box stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變；若出現總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「推力偏心與箱身應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Eccentric thrust and box stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確
optionsEn: Normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct
quiz.explanation: 總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「姿態修正與曲線相容」與「超挖體積與地層損失」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Attitude correction and path compatibility" and "Overbreak volume and ground loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 姿態修正與曲線相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Attitude correction and path compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「姿態修正與曲線相容」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Attitude correction and path compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 箱涵姿態由前後位置共同決定，短距偏移不等於沿全長均勻轉角。剛體小角度可識別量級，實際修正受地層、導板與框架變形限制；突然集中修正可能增加側壓和摩阻，不能把幾何誤差直接轉為操作命令。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以共同基準比較前後測點與導板接觸痕跡；若出現單點修正造成尾部擠壓，前端改善但全體摩阻上升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「姿態修正與曲線相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Front and rear positions jointly determine box attitude, and a local offset is not uniform rotation along the whole length. Small-angle geometry estimates scale, while soil, guides and frame deformation constrain correction. Concentrated correction can increase lateral pressure and friction, so geometric error is not an operating command. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare front and rear survey points and guide-contact marks in a common datum. If single-point correction pinches the rear, improving the front while raising overall friction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Attitude correction and path compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「姿態修正與曲線相容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Attitude correction and path compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 姿態修正與曲線相容
knowledge.text: 箱涵姿態由前後位置共同決定，短距偏移不等於沿全長均勻轉角。剛體小角度可識別量級，實際修正受地層、導板與框架變形限制；突然集中修正可能增加側壓和摩阻，不能把幾何誤差直接轉為操作命令。
knowledge.textEn: Front and rear positions jointly determine box attitude, and a local offset is not uniform rotation along the whole length. Small-angle geometry estimates scale, while soil, guides and frame deformation constrain correction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「姿態修正與曲線相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Attitude correction and path compatibility" is correct?
options: 前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確
箱涵姿態由前後位置共同決定，短距偏移不等於沿全長均勻轉角。
超挖百分比可以直接當作地表最大沉陷百分比
optionsEn: A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct
Front and rear positions jointly determine box attitude, and a local offset is not uniform rotation along the whole length.
An overbreak percentage directly equals the maximum surface-settlement percentage
quiz.explanation: 箱涵姿態由前後位置共同決定，短距偏移不等於沿全長均勻轉角。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Front and rear positions jointly determine box attitude, and a local offset is not uniform rotation along the whole length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 姿態修正與曲線相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Attitude correction and path compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「姿態修正與曲線相容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Attitude correction and path compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以共同基準比較前後測點與導板接觸痕跡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare front and rear survey points and guide-contact marks in a common datum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「姿態修正與曲線相容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 姿態修正與曲線相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Attitude correction and path compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「姿態修正與曲線相容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Attitude correction and path compatibility” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以共同基準比較前後測點與導板接觸痕跡。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「單點修正造成尾部擠壓，前端改善但全體摩阻上升」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare front and rear survey points and guide-contact marks in a common datum. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare front and rear survey points and guide-contact marks in a common datum. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If single-point correction pinches the rear, improving the front while raising overall friction, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單點修正造成尾部擠壓，前端改善但全體摩阻上升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Single-point correction pinches the rear, improving the front while raising overall friction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以共同基準比較前後測點與導板接觸痕跡。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「單點修正造成尾部擠壓，前端改善但全體摩阻上升」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

steps.title: 姿態修正與曲線相容：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「姿態修正與曲線相容」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Attitude correction and path compatibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單點修正造成尾部擠壓，前端改善但全體摩阻上升。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以共同基準比較前後測點與導板接觸痕跡，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Single-point correction pinches the rear, improving the front while raising overall friction. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare front and rear survey points and guide-contact marks in a common datum to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以共同基準比較前後測點與導板接觸痕跡；若出現單點修正造成尾部擠壓，前端改善但全體摩阻上升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If single-point correction pinches the rear, improving the front while raising overall friction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 超挖體積與地層損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Overbreak volume and ground loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「超挖體積與地層損失」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Overbreak volume and ground loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 箱體周邊超挖、面前流失與潤滑空隙閉合都可能造成地表位移，土量平衡須區分原位和鬆方體積。簡化損失比例不能直接給出某建物沉陷，因為傳播受埋深及地層影響；應連結出土、間隙與地面監測。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將原位換算出土量、周邊間隙及地表沉陷按里程對齊；若出現鬆方出土量未換算就與原位相比，掩蓋實際地層流失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「超挖體積與地層損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Overbreak, face loss and closure of lubricated gaps can all move the ground; volume balance must distinguish in-situ and loose spoil. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Align in-situ-equivalent spoil, peripheral gaps and surface settlement by chainage. If comparing loose spoil directly with in-situ volume conceals real ground loss, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Overbreak volume and ground loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：excavatedPrism=40 m2*20 m=800 m3; assumedLoss=0.005*800 m3=4 m3。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An overbreak percentage directly equals the maximum surface-settlement percentage" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 超挖體積與地層損失：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：excavatedPrism=40 m2*20 m=800 m3; assumedLoss=0.005*800 m3=4 m3。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: excavatedPrism=40 m2*20 m=800 m3; assumedLoss=0.005*800 m3=4 m3. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將原位換算出土量、周邊間隙及地表沉陷按里程對齊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align in-situ-equivalent spoil, peripheral gaps and surface settlement by chainage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將原位換算出土量、周邊間隙及地表沉陷按里程對齊；若出現鬆方出土量未換算就與原位相比，掩蓋實際地層流失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If comparing loose spoil directly with in-situ volume conceals real ground loss, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超挖百分比可以直接當作地表最大沉陷百分比」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An overbreak percentage directly equals the maximum surface-settlement percentage" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鬆方出土量未換算就與原位相比，掩蓋實際地層流失。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將原位換算出土量、周邊間隙及地表沉陷按里程對齊，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing loose spoil directly with in-situ volume conceals real ground loss. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to align in-situ-equivalent spoil, peripheral gaps and surface settlement by chainage to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超挖體積與地層損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Overbreak volume and ground loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均沉陷足夠小就代表所有鐵路幾何必定合格
鬆方出土量未換算就與原位相比，掩蓋實際地層流失。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Sufficiently small average settlement guarantees all railway geometry is acceptable
Comparing loose spoil directly with in-situ volume conceals real ground loss.
quiz.explanation: 鬆方出土量未換算就與原位相比，掩蓋實際地層流失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing loose spoil directly with in-situ volume conceals real ground loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」與「封鎖窗口與恢復證據」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rail interface and differential settlement" and "Possession windows and restoration evidence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鐵路介面與差異沉陷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rail interface and differential settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rail interface and differential settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨越營運線時，軌道幾何關心相鄰點的差異及變化速度，而非只有平均沉陷。兩點沉陷差除距離僅為平均沉陷坡度，仍含整體剛體傾斜；不能直接當作已扣除傾斜的角變形或規範軌道扭曲，也不能取代道床支承和營運標準；監測需分開頂進、回填與恢復交通後的再壓密。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢；若出現平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Operating rail interfaces depend on differential movement and rate, not mean settlement alone. Settlement difference over distance is a mean settlement slope that still includes rigid-body tilt. It is not automatically tilt-corrected angular distortion or code-defined track twist and does not replace ballast-support or operating criteria. Distinguish jacking, backfill and post-reopening densification when interpreting monitoring histories. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends. If small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rail interface and differential settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均沉陷足夠小就代表所有鐵路幾何必定合格」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sufficiently small average settlement guarantees all railway geometry is acceptable" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rail interface and differential settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鐵路介面與差異沉陷
knowledge.text: 跨越營運線時，軌道幾何關心相鄰點的差異及變化速度，而非只有平均沉陷。兩點沉陷差除距離僅為平均沉陷坡度，仍含整體剛體傾斜；不能直接當作已扣除傾斜的角變形或規範軌道扭曲，也不能取代道床支承和營運標準；監測需分開頂進、回填與恢復交通後的再壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Operating rail interfaces depend on differential movement and rate, not mean settlement alone. Settlement difference over distance is a mean settlement slope that still includes rigid-body tilt.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均沉陷足夠小就代表所有鐵路幾何必定合格 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sufficiently small average settlement guarantees all railway geometry is acceptable Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rail interface and differential settlement" is correct?

平均沉陷足夠小就代表所有鐵路幾何必定合格
窗口還有剩餘時間就代表工程品質已經獲得保證
optionsEn: Operating rail interfaces depend on differential movement and rate, not mean settlement alone.
Sufficiently small average settlement guarantees all railway geometry is acceptable
Remaining possession time proves construction quality has already been assured
quiz.explanation: 跨越營運線時，軌道幾何關心相鄰點的差異及變化速度，而非只有平均沉陷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Operating rail interfaces depend on differential movement and rate, not mean settlement alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鐵路介面與差異沉陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rail interface and differential settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rail interface and differential settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rail interface and differential settlement", which statement holds?
options: 千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力
原創教學假設：meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist。
頂板當作簡支梁計算就涵蓋所有框架受力

A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鐵路介面與差異沉陷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rail interface and differential settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rail interface and differential settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

title: 微型隧道機頂管
summary: 本課以微型隧道的面壓、泥水輸送與管節受力為主線，從面壓合力與地下水邊界與泥漿濃度與固體平衡建立系統邊界，再把接頭傳力與墊材接觸、泥水管路損失與流變連到成品管線水密與紀錄。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on microtunnel face pressure, slurry transport and pipe loading. It begins with Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary and Slurry concentration and solids balance, links Joint load transfer and packer contact and Slurry-line loss and rheology, and ends with Finished-pipeline tightness and records. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
