workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查面壓合力與地下水邊界：uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN；再獨立檢查泥漿濃度與固體平衡：Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s。假定推力 1200 kN 不變，有效接觸面從 0.30 減到 0.15 m2 時，平均接頭承壓由 4 增至 8 MPa；局部峰值可能更高。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 將用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary: uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN. Independently check Slurry concentration and solids balance: Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s. At an assumed 1200 kN thrust, reducing effective contact from 0.30 to 0.15 m2 doubles mean joint bearing from 4 to 8 MPa; local peaks may be higher. The two results are not a complete design because slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. Use test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「面壓合力與地下水邊界」與「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary" and "Slurry concentration and solids balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 面壓合力與地下水邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「面壓合力與地下水邊界」如何影響微型隧道機頂管的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Microtunneling pipe jacking”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泥水面壓需與土骨架及孔隙水的穩定條件共同評估，壓力乘圓面積只是作用合力。高程差使掌子面上下水壓不同，局部滲透又影響有效應力；不能將這個合力當成面前土體所需支護的完整判準。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應；若出現使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「面壓合力與地下水邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Slurry face pressure must be assessed with soil-skeleton and pore-water stability; pressure times circular area is only a resultant. Elevation creates vertical pressure variation and seepage changes effective stress. This resultant alone does not establish the support needed for the ground ahead of the machine. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile. If comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泥水壓力乘面積就是完整的掌子面穩定驗算」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Slurry pressure times area constitutes a complete face-stability verification" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「面壓合力與地下水邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：泥水壓力乘面積就是完整的掌子面穩定驗算 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Slurry pressure times area constitutes a complete face-stability verification Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 面壓合力與地下水邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「面壓合力與地下水邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 面壓合力與地下水邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「面壓合力與地下水邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「面壓合力與地下水邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應；若出現使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泥水壓力乘面積就是完整的掌子面穩定驗算」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Slurry pressure times area constitutes a complete face-stability verification" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 泥漿濃度與固體平衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Slurry concentration and solids balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」如何影響微型隧道機頂管的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slurry concentration and solids balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Microtunneling pipe jacking”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 回流密度同時受輸入載液、挖出固體及混入水影響，需用兩相質量體積平衡估固體濃度。輸入載液若已有固體就不能把全部回流固體當新增出土；沉積與密度計偏差也會使瞬時資料不能閉合長時段土量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量；若出現循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Return density depends on carrier fluid, excavated solids and incoming water, requiring two-phase balance. Solids already present in the feed cannot be counted as newly excavated ground. Deposition and density-meter bias further prevent instantaneous readings from closing a long-period excavation balance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. If recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Slurry concentration and solids balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「回流所有固體都一定是這一時段新挖出的土」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every solid in the return flow was newly excavated during that interval" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Slurry concentration and solids balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 泥漿濃度與固體平衡
knowledge.text: 回流密度同時受輸入載液、挖出固體及混入水影響，需用兩相質量體積平衡估固體濃度。輸入載液若已有固體就不能把全部回流固體當新增出土；沉積與密度計偏差也會使瞬時資料不能閉合長時段土量。
knowledge.textEn: Return density depends on carrier fluid, excavated solids and incoming water, requiring two-phase balance. Solids already present in the feed cannot be counted as newly excavated ground.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：回流所有固體都一定是這一時段新挖出的土 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every solid in the return flow was newly excavated during that interval Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Every solid in the return flow was newly excavated during that interval
Finished pipe internal diameter directly gives the cutter excavation volume
Return density depends on carrier fluid, excavated solids and incoming water, requiring two-phase balance.
quiz.explanation: 回流密度同時受輸入載液、挖出固體及混入水影響，需用兩相質量體積平衡估固體濃度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Return density depends on carrier fluid, excavated solids and incoming water, requiring two-phase balance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 泥漿濃度與固體平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Slurry concentration and solids balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slurry concentration and solids balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 泥漿濃度與固體平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Slurry concentration and solids balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slurry concentration and solids balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 泥漿濃度與固體平衡：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slurry concentration and solids balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量；若出現循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「回流所有固體都一定是這一時段新挖出的土」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every solid in the return flow was newly excavated during that interval" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開挖體積與進尺一致性」與「管壁摩阻與長度累積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Excavated volume and advance consistency" and "Pipe skin friction and length accumulation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開挖體積與進尺一致性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Excavated volume and advance consistency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開挖體積與進尺一致性」如何影響微型隧道機頂管的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Excavated volume and advance consistency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Microtunneling pipe jacking”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理論切削體積由切削外徑及實際進尺決定，並非成品管內徑。超挖與面前土體流入會使移除量增加，而含水、膨鬆及分離滯留使地面量測不直接等於原位量；應保留體積換算及輸送延遲。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將刀盤外徑、進尺時戳與延遲修正出土量比對；若出現忽略回流延遲把前段出土誤配後段進尺，掩蓋局部流失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開挖體積與進尺一致性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Theoretical cut volume uses cutter diameter and actual advance rather than finished internal diameter. Overcut and face inflow increase removal, while moisture, bulking and separator retention alter surface measurements. Preserve conversion assumptions and transport delay when reconciling excavated volume with progress. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare cutter diameter and advance timestamps with delay-corrected spoil volume. If ignoring return delay assigns earlier spoil to later advance and hides local loss, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Excavated volume and advance consistency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：theoreticalVolume=pi*(1.5 m)^2/4*0.50 m=0.8836 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: theoreticalVolume=pi*(1.5 m)^2/4*0.50 m=0.8836 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「成品管內徑可以直接用來計算刀盤開挖體積」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Finished pipe internal diameter directly gives the cutter excavation volume" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「開挖體積與進尺一致性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Excavated volume and advance consistency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開挖體積與進尺一致性
knowledge.text: 理論切削體積由切削外徑及實際進尺決定，並非成品管內徑。超挖與面前土體流入會使移除量增加，而含水、膨鬆及分離滯留使地面量測不直接等於原位量；應保留體積換算及輸送延遲。
knowledge.textEn: Theoretical cut volume uses cutter diameter and actual advance rather than finished internal diameter. Overcut and face inflow increase removal, while moisture, bulking and separator retention alter surface measurements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：成品管內徑可以直接用來計算刀盤開挖體積 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Finished pipe internal diameter directly gives the cutter excavation volume Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開挖體積與進尺一致性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Excavated volume and advance consistency" is correct?
options: 理論切削體積由切削外徑及實際進尺決定，並非成品管內徑。
成品管內徑可以直接用來計算刀盤開挖體積
把總推力除以全管外表面就得到真實均勻摩阻
optionsEn: Theoretical cut volume uses cutter diameter and actual advance rather than finished internal diameter.
Finished pipe internal diameter directly gives the cutter excavation volume
Dividing total thrust by pipe surface yields the true uniform skin friction
quiz.explanation: 理論切削體積由切削外徑及實際進尺決定，並非成品管內徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Theoretical cut volume uses cutter diameter and actual advance rather than finished internal diameter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開挖體積與進尺一致性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Excavated volume and advance consistency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開挖體積與進尺一致性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Excavated volume and advance consistency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：theoreticalVolume=pi*(1.5 m)^2/4*0.50 m=0.8836 m3。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: theoreticalVolume=pi*(1.5 m)^2/4*0.50 m=0.8836 m3. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將刀盤外徑、進尺時戳與延遲修正出土量比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare cutter diameter and advance timestamps with delay-corrected spoil volume.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：theoreticalVolume=pi*(1.5 m)^2/4*0.50 m=0.8836 m3。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: theoreticalVolume=pi*(1.5 m)^2/4*0.50 m=0.8836 m3. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「開挖體積與進尺一致性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Excavated volume and advance consistency", which statement holds?
options: 雷射讀值穩定就能證明整條管線高程沒有偏差
原創教學假設：theoreticalVolume=pi*(1.5 m)^2/4*0.50 m=0.8836 m3。
單一最大沉陷讀值足以唯一決定完整沉陷槽形
optionsEn: Stable laser readings prove the entire pipeline elevation has no bias
Original teaching assumptions: theoreticalVolume=pi*(1.5 m)^2/4*0.50 m=0.8836 m3.
One maximum-settlement reading uniquely determines the complete trough shape

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: theoreticalVolume=pi*(1.5 m)^2/4*0.50 m=0.8836 m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 開挖體積與進尺一致性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Excavated volume and advance consistency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開挖體積與進尺一致性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Excavated volume and advance consistency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將刀盤外徑、進尺時戳與延遲修正出土量比對。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「忽略回流延遲把前段出土誤配後段進尺，掩蓋局部流失」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare cutter diameter and advance timestamps with delay-corrected spoil volume. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ignoring return delay assigns earlier spoil to later advance and hides local loss. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將刀盤外徑、進尺時戳與延遲修正出土量比對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現忽略回流延遲把前段出土誤配後段進尺，掩蓋局部流失，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare cutter diameter and advance timestamps with delay-corrected spoil volume. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignoring return delay assigns earlier spoil to later advance and hides local loss, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略回流延遲把前段出土誤配後段進尺，掩蓋局部流失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring return delay assigns earlier spoil to later advance and hides local loss. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將刀盤外徑、進尺時戳與延遲修正出土量比對。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「忽略回流延遲把前段出土誤配後段進尺，掩蓋局部流失」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare cutter diameter and advance timestamps with delay-corrected spoil volume. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ignoring return delay assigns earlier spoil to later advance and hides local loss. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將刀盤外徑、進尺時戳與延遲修正出土量比對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現忽略回流延遲把前段出土誤配後段進尺，掩蓋局部流失，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare cutter diameter and advance timestamps with delay-corrected spoil volume. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignoring return delay assigns earlier spoil to later advance and hides local loss, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

knowledge.text: 摩阻集中在局部失潤滑段，均勻模型低估該處管節負荷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照各段推力增量、潤滑紀錄與停機時間，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Friction concentrates in a poorly lubricated section and a uniform model understates local pipe loading. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare thrust increments by segment with lubrication records and stoppage duration to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Friction concentrates in a poorly lubricated section and a uniform model understates local pipe loading.
Thrust below the pipe rating eliminates the need to inspect joint contact

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接頭傳力與墊材接觸」與「雷射坡度與基準傳遞」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint load transfer and packer contact" and "Laser grade and datum transfer": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接頭傳力與墊材接觸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint load transfer and packer contact: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接頭傳力與墊材接觸」如何影響微型隧道機頂管的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint load transfer and packer contact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Microtunneling pipe jacking”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 頂管接頭透過端面與墊材傳遞壓力，曲線、偏轉和端面不平會縮小有效接觸面。墊材壓縮改變接觸分布而非只平均分力；平均承壓偏低仍可能發生邊緣剝落，需與接頭角差及材料壓縮特性一起檢查。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較接頭角差、墊材壓痕及管端裂縫位置；若出現接頭一側失去接觸使另一側壓碎，總推力仍低於名義額定，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭傳力與墊材接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pipe joints transmit thrust through end faces and packers, while curvature, deflection and unevenness reduce effective contact. Packer compression redistributes contact rather than merely averaging force. Low mean stress can coexist with edge spalling, requiring checks against joint angle and packer compression characteristics. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare joint angularity, packer impressions and pipe-end crack locations. If loss of contact on one side crushes the opposite edge despite thrust below the nominal rating, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint load transfer and packer contact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：jointBearing=1200 kN/0.30 m2=4000 kPa=4 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: jointBearing=1200 kN/0.30 m2=4000 kPa=4 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總推力低於管節額定值就不需檢查接頭接觸」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thrust below the pipe rating eliminates the need to inspect joint contact" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接頭傳力與墊材接觸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint load transfer and packer contact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接頭傳力與墊材接觸
knowledge.titleEn: Joint load transfer and packer contact

knowledge.textEn: Pipe joints transmit thrust through end faces and packers, while curvature, deflection and unevenness reduce effective contact. Packer compression redistributes contact rather than merely averaging force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總推力低於管節額定值就不需檢查接頭接觸 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

Stable laser readings prove the entire pipeline elevation has no bias

steps.title: 接頭傳力與墊材接觸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint load transfer and packer contact: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接頭傳力與墊材接觸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint load transfer and packer contact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：jointBearing=1200 kN/0.30 m2=4000 kPa=4 MPa。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: jointBearing=1200 kN/0.30 m2=4000 kPa=4 MPa. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較接頭角差、墊材壓痕及管端裂縫位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare joint angularity, packer impressions and pipe-end crack locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：jointBearing=1200 kN/0.30 m2=4000 kPa=4 MPa。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 接頭傳力與墊材接觸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint load transfer and packer contact: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接頭傳力與墊材接觸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint load transfer and packer contact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較接頭角差、墊材壓痕及管端裂縫位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接頭一側失去接觸使另一側壓碎，總推力仍低於名義額定」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare joint angularity, packer impressions and pipe-end crack locations. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Loss of contact on one side crushes the opposite edge despite thrust below the nominal rating. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較接頭角差、墊材壓痕及管端裂縫位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接頭一側失去接觸使另一側壓碎，總推力仍低於名義額定，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare joint angularity, packer impressions and pipe-end crack locations. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If loss of contact on one side crushes the opposite edge despite thrust below the nominal rating, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭一側失去接觸使另一側壓碎，總推力仍低於名義額定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loss of contact on one side crushes the opposite edge despite thrust below the nominal rating. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較接頭角差、墊材壓痕及管端裂縫位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接頭一側失去接觸使另一側壓碎，總推力仍低於名義額定」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare joint angularity, packer impressions and pipe-end crack locations. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Loss of contact on one side crushes the opposite edge despite thrust below the nominal rating. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Stable laser readings prove the entire pipeline elevation has no bias
Loss of contact on one side crushes the opposite edge despite thrust below the nominal rating.

steps.title: 雷射坡度與基準傳遞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Laser grade and datum transfer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雷射坡度與基準傳遞」如何影響微型隧道機頂管的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Laser grade and datum transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Microtunneling pipe jacking”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力管線的坡度依賴長距高程一致性，雷射線、機頭姿態及管列中心線是不同量。折射、支架位移和發射點重設會造成共同偏差，不能靠同一儀器重複讀值排除；接收井閉合與獨立水準可提供外部檢核。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程；若出現發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雷射坡度與基準傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gravity pipelines depend on consistent elevation over distance; laser line, machine attitude and pipe centerline differ. Refraction, mount movement and transmitter resets introduce shared bias that repeated readings cannot remove. Receiving-shaft closure and independent leveling provide external checks on the transferred datum. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check laser reference, independent leveling and measured pipe-invert elevation. If transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Laser grade and datum transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：gradeDrop=slope*length=0.003*100 m=0.30 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: gradeDrop=slope*length=0.003*100 m=0.30 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雷射讀值穩定就能證明整條管線高程沒有偏差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stable laser readings prove the entire pipeline elevation has no bias" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雷射坡度與基準傳遞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Laser grade and datum transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雷射坡度與基準傳遞
knowledge.text: 重力管線的坡度依賴長距高程一致性，雷射線、機頭姿態及管列中心線是不同量。折射、支架位移和發射點重設會造成共同偏差，不能靠同一儀器重複讀值排除；接收井閉合與獨立水準可提供外部檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Gravity pipelines depend on consistent elevation over distance; laser line, machine attitude and pipe centerline differ. Refraction, mount movement and transmitter resets introduce shared bias that repeated readings cannot remove.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雷射讀值穩定就能證明整條管線高程沒有偏差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stable laser readings prove the entire pipeline elevation has no bias Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雷射坡度與基準傳遞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Laser grade and datum transfer" is correct?
options: 重力管線的坡度依賴長距高程一致性，雷射線、機頭姿態及管列中心線是不同量。
雷射讀值穩定就能證明整條管線高程沒有偏差
泵出口壓力一定等於掌子面泥水艙壓力
optionsEn: Gravity pipelines depend on consistent elevation over distance; laser line, machine attitude and pipe centerline differ.
Stable laser readings prove the entire pipeline elevation has no bias
Pump discharge pressure always equals slurry pressure at the excavation face
quiz.explanation: 重力管線的坡度依賴長距高程一致性，雷射線、機頭姿態及管列中心線是不同量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Gravity pipelines depend on consistent elevation over distance; laser line, machine attitude and pipe centerline differ. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雷射坡度與基準傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Laser grade and datum transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雷射坡度與基準傳遞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Laser grade and datum transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：gradeDrop=slope*length=0.003*100 m=0.30 m。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: gradeDrop=slope*length=0.003*100 m=0.30 m. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check laser reference, independent leveling and measured pipe-invert elevation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：gradeDrop=slope*length=0.003*100 m=0.30 m。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: gradeDrop=slope*length=0.003*100 m=0.30 m. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雷射坡度與基準傳遞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Laser grade and datum transfer", which statement holds?
options: 機頭到達接收井就代表地下水風險自動消失
原創教學假設：gradeDrop=slope*length=0.003*100 m=0.30 m。
泥水壓力乘面積就是完整的掌子面穩定驗算
optionsEn: Groundwater risk automatically disappears once the machine reaches the receiving shaft
Original teaching assumptions: gradeDrop=slope*length=0.003*100 m=0.30 m.
Slurry pressure times area constitutes a complete face-stability verification
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：gradeDrop=slope*length=0.003*100 m=0.30 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: gradeDrop=slope*length=0.003*100 m=0.30 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雷射坡度與基準傳遞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Laser grade and datum transfer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雷射坡度與基準傳遞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Laser grade and datum transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check laser reference, independent leveling and measured pipe-invert elevation. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check laser reference, independent leveling and measured pipe-invert elevation. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check laser reference, independent leveling and measured pipe-invert elevation. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check laser reference, independent leveling and measured pipe-invert elevation. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雷射坡度與基準傳遞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Laser grade and datum transfer"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
成品管內徑可以直接用來計算刀盤開挖體積
核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Finished pipe internal diameter directly gives the cutter excavation volume
Check laser reference, independent leveling and measured pipe-invert elevation.
quiz.explanation: 核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check laser reference, independent leveling and measured pipe-invert elevation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雷射坡度與基準傳遞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Laser grade and datum transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雷射坡度與基準傳遞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Laser grade and datum transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check laser reference, independent leveling and measured pipe-invert elevation to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程；若出現發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雷射讀值穩定就能證明整條管線高程沒有偏差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stable laser readings prove the entire pipeline elevation has no bias" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check laser reference, independent leveling and measured pipe-invert elevation to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雷射坡度與基準傳遞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Laser grade and datum transfer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
泵出口壓力一定等於掌子面泥水艙壓力
optionsEn: Transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Pump discharge pressure always equals slurry pressure at the excavation face
quiz.explanation: 發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「泥水管路損失與流變」與「地表槽形與體積推估」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Slurry-line loss and rheology" and "Surface troughs and volume estimates": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 泥水管路損失與流變：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slurry-line loss and rheology” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Microtunneling pipe jacking”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 輸送管的壓損受流速、管徑、彎頭及泥漿流變影響，清水形式的摩擦係數不能任意套用高濃度漿體。等效牛頓流體算例只是量級比較，沉積還會改變有效管徑；泵端壓力不能代表機頭艙壓。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較管路分段壓差、流量與泥漿流變及沉積檢查；若出現把泵壓上升當成面壓增加，漏掉管內堵塞與輸送衰退，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泥水管路損失與流變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

knowledge.title: 泥水管路損失與流變

steps.title: 泥水管路損失與流變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Slurry-line loss and rheology: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泥水管路損失與流變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slurry-line loss and rheology” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：dp=f*(L/D)*rho*v^2/2=0.03*(200 m/0.15 m)*1200 kg/m3*(2 m/s)^2/2=96000 Pa。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: dp=f*(L/D)*rho*v^2/2=0.03*(200 m/0.15 m)*1200 kg/m3*(2 m/s)^2/2=96000 Pa. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較管路分段壓差、流量與泥漿流變及沉積檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare sectional pressure loss, flow and slurry rheology with deposition checks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 泥水管路損失與流變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Slurry-line loss and rheology: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泥水管路損失與流變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slurry-line loss and rheology” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較管路分段壓差、流量與泥漿流變及沉積檢查。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把泵壓上升當成面壓增加，漏掉管內堵塞與輸送衰退」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare sectional pressure loss, flow and slurry rheology with deposition checks. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Treating rising pump pressure as rising face pressure misses blockage and reduced transport. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較管路分段壓差、流量與泥漿流變及沉積檢查列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把泵壓上升當成面壓增加，漏掉管內堵塞與輸送衰退，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare sectional pressure loss, flow and slurry rheology with deposition checks. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If treating rising pump pressure as rising face pressure misses blockage and reduced transport, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把泵壓上升當成面壓增加，漏掉管內堵塞與輸送衰退。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating rising pump pressure as rising face pressure misses blockage and reduced transport. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較管路分段壓差、流量與泥漿流變及沉積檢查。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把泵壓上升當成面壓增加，漏掉管內堵塞與輸送衰退」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare sectional pressure loss, flow and slurry rheology with deposition checks. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Treating rising pump pressure as rising face pressure misses blockage and reduced transport. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較管路分段壓差、流量與泥漿流變及沉積檢查列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把泵壓上升當成面壓增加，漏掉管內堵塞與輸送衰退，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare sectional pressure loss, flow and slurry rheology with deposition checks. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If treating rising pump pressure as rising face pressure misses blockage and reduced transport, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「泥水管路損失與流變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Compare sectional pressure loss, flow and slurry rheology with deposition checks.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare sectional pressure loss, flow and slurry rheology with deposition checks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 泥水管路損失與流變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slurry-line loss and rheology: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泥水管路損失與流變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slurry-line loss and rheology” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把泵壓上升當成面壓增加，漏掉管內堵塞與輸送衰退。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較管路分段壓差、流量與泥漿流變及沉積檢查，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating rising pump pressure as rising face pressure misses blockage and reduced transport. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare sectional pressure loss, flow and slurry rheology with deposition checks to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較管路分段壓差、流量與泥漿流變及沉積檢查；若出現把泵壓上升當成面壓增加，漏掉管內堵塞與輸送衰退，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If treating rising pump pressure as rising face pressure misses blockage and reduced transport, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵出口壓力一定等於掌子面泥水艙壓力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pump discharge pressure always equals slurry pressure at the excavation face" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把泵壓上升當成面壓增加，漏掉管內堵塞與輸送衰退。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較管路分段壓差、流量與泥漿流變及沉積檢查，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare sectional pressure loss, flow and slurry rheology with deposition checks to discriminate the cause. knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「泥水管路損失與流變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Slurry-line loss and rheology" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.title: 地表槽形與體積推估：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Surface troughs and volume estimates: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地表槽形與體積推估」如何影響微型隧道機頂管的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Surface troughs and volume estimates” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Microtunneling pipe jacking”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 橫向沉陷槽積分可估每延米地表體積損失，但槽寬、最大沉陷與基準誤差需共同擬合。高斯形只是特定土層情境的近似，建物、地下水和多管線互動可破壞對稱；地表損失也不必等於當時出土超量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形；若出現只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地表槽形與體積推估」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Integrating a transverse settlement trough estimates surface volume loss per unit length, requiring joint assessment of width, peak and datum error. A Gaussian is an approximation for particular ground conditions; buildings, groundwater and adjacent drives can break symmetry. Surface loss need not equal contemporaneous excess spoil. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks. If measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Surface troughs and volume estimates” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 地表槽形與體積推估
knowledge.text: 橫向沉陷槽積分可估每延米地表體積損失，但槽寬、最大沉陷與基準誤差需共同擬合。高斯形只是特定土層情境的近似，建物、地下水和多管線互動可破壞對稱；地表損失也不必等於當時出土超量。
knowledge.textEn: Integrating a transverse settlement trough estimates surface volume loss per unit length, requiring joint assessment of width, peak and datum error. A Gaussian is an approximation for particular ground conditions; buildings, groundwater and adjacent drives can break symmetry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單一最大沉陷讀值足以唯一決定完整沉陷槽形 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One maximum-settlement reading uniquely determines the complete trough shape Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地表槽形與體積推估」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Surface troughs and volume estimates" is correct?
options: 單一最大沉陷讀值足以唯一決定完整沉陷槽形
機頭到達接收井就代表地下水風險自動消失
橫向沉陷槽積分可估每延米地表體積損失，但槽寬、最大沉陷與基準誤差需共同擬合。
optionsEn: One maximum-settlement reading uniquely determines the complete trough shape
Groundwater risk automatically disappears once the machine reaches the receiving shaft
Integrating a transverse settlement trough estimates surface volume loss per unit length, requiring joint assessment of width, peak and datum error.
quiz.explanation: 橫向沉陷槽積分可估每延米地表體積損失，但槽寬、最大沉陷與基準誤差需共同擬合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrating a transverse settlement trough estimates surface volume loss per unit length, requiring joint assessment of width, peak and datum error. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地表槽形與體積推估：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Surface troughs and volume estimates: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地表槽形與體積推估」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Surface troughs and volume estimates” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Vs=sqrt(2*pi)*i*Smax=2.5066*4 m*0.003 m=0.0301 m2。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Vs=sqrt(2*pi)*i*Smax=2.5066*4 m*0.003 m=0.0301 m2. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Vs=sqrt(2*pi)*i*Smax=2.5066*4 m*0.003 m=0.0301 m2。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地表槽形與體積推估」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Surface troughs and volume estimates", which statement holds?
