quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Vs=sqrt(2*pi)*i*Smax=2.5066*4 m*0.003 m=0.0301 m2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地表槽形與體積推估：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surface troughs and volume estimates: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地表槽形與體積推估」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Surface troughs and volume estimates” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地表槽形與體積推估」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surface troughs and volume estimates"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形。
總推力低於管節額定值就不需檢查接頭接觸
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks.
Thrust below the pipe rating eliminates the need to inspect joint contact
quiz.explanation: 用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地表槽形與體積推估：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surface troughs and volume estimates: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地表槽形與體積推估」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Surface troughs and volume estimates” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形；若出現只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單一最大沉陷讀值足以唯一決定完整沉陷槽形」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One maximum-settlement reading uniquely determines the complete trough shape" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地表槽形與體積推估」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surface troughs and volume estimates" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
機頭到達接收井就代表地下水風險自動消失
只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Groundwater risk automatically disappears once the machine reaches the receiving shaft
Measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss.
quiz.explanation: 只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接收井水壓與破口界面」與「成品管線水密與紀錄」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Receiving-shaft pressure and opening interfaces" and "Finished-pipeline tightness and records": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接收井水壓與破口界面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Receiving-shaft pressure and opening interfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接收井水壓與破口界面」如何影響微型隧道機頂管的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Receiving-shaft pressure and opening interfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Microtunneling pipe jacking”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機頭到達接收井時，土體及井壁的水密邊界會改變，開口的水壓合力需用對應水頭計算。井內外水位、封口和地層滲透共同決定流動風險；靜水力算例不能代替經核定的接收與隔離設計。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將接收開口高程、內外水位及封口試驗資料對齊；若出現接收前水位升高未更新壓差，原有封口假設失效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接收井水壓與破口界面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Arrival changes groundwater boundaries at the shaft wall and ground interface; calculate opening force using the relevant head. Internal and external levels, seals and permeability jointly determine inflow risk. A hydrostatic force example does not replace an approved reception and isolation design. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Align receiving-opening elevation, internal and external levels and seal-test evidence. If a pre-arrival water-level rise invalidates the pressure difference assumed for the seal, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Receiving-shaft pressure and opening interfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：waterForce=rho*g*h*A=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*12 m*1.5 m2=176580 N=176.6 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: waterForce=rho*g*h*A=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*12 m*1.5 m2=176580 N=176.6 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「機頭到達接收井就代表地下水風險自動消失」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Groundwater risk automatically disappears once the machine reaches the receiving shaft" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 接收井水壓與破口界面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Receiving-shaft pressure and opening interfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接收井水壓與破口界面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Receiving-shaft pressure and opening interfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：waterForce=rho*g*h*A=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*12 m*1.5 m2=176580 N=176.6 kN。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: waterForce=rho*g*h*A=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*12 m*1.5 m2=176580 N=176.6 kN. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將接收開口高程、內外水位及封口試驗資料對齊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align receiving-opening elevation, internal and external levels and seal-test evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 接收井水壓與破口界面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Receiving-shaft pressure and opening interfaces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接收井水壓與破口界面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Receiving-shaft pressure and opening interfaces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將接收開口高程、內外水位及封口試驗資料對齊。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接收前水位升高未更新壓差，原有封口假設失效」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align receiving-opening elevation, internal and external levels and seal-test evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A pre-arrival water-level rise invalidates the pressure difference assumed for the seal. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將接收開口高程、內外水位及封口試驗資料對齊列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接收前水位升高未更新壓差，原有封口假設失效，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Align receiving-opening elevation, internal and external levels and seal-test evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a pre-arrival water-level rise invalidates the pressure difference assumed for the seal, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接收前水位升高未更新壓差，原有封口假設失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A pre-arrival water-level rise invalidates the pressure difference assumed for the seal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 接收井水壓與破口界面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Receiving-shaft pressure and opening interfaces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接收井水壓與破口界面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Receiving-shaft pressure and opening interfaces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接收前水位升高未更新壓差，原有封口假設失效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將接收開口高程、內外水位及封口試驗資料對齊，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A pre-arrival water-level rise invalidates the pressure difference assumed for the seal. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to align receiving-opening elevation, internal and external levels and seal-test evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將接收開口高程、內外水位及封口試驗資料對齊；若出現接收前水位升高未更新壓差，原有封口假設失效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a pre-arrival water-level rise invalidates the pressure difference assumed for the seal, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「機頭到達接收井就代表地下水風險自動消失」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Groundwater risk automatically disappears once the machine reaches the receiving shaft" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 接收前水位升高未更新壓差，原有封口假設失效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將接收開口高程、內外水位及封口試驗資料對齊，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

steps.title: 成品管線水密與紀錄：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Finished-pipeline tightness and records: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「成品管線水密與紀錄」如何影響微型隧道機頂管的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Finished-pipeline tightness and records” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Microtunneling pipe jacking”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完成頂進後的接頭水密與施工時抗推力是兩種性能，局部擦傷或墊圈位移可能未在推力曲線顯現。流量試驗需聲明測段、水頭及穩定時間，並區分管體、接頭和端部封堵；全線平均值不能掩蓋關鍵局部漏點。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對試驗水頭、測段界線與逐接頭影像紀錄；若出現端部試驗封堵漏水被誤判管線失效，或局部漏點被全線平均隱藏，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「成品管線水密與紀錄」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Post-jacking joint tightness differs from thrust resistance, and damaged or displaced seals may leave no clear thrust signature. Flow tests need defined section, head and stabilization time and must distinguish pipes, joints and end closures. An overall average cannot conceal critical localized leakage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check test head, section boundaries and images indexed to individual joints. If a leaking test closure is mistaken for pipe failure or overall averaging hides a local leak, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Finished-pipeline tightness and records” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：measuredLeakage=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min at a specified hypothetical test head。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: measuredLeakage=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min at a specified hypothetical test head.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頂進推力曲線平順就代表完工管線必定完全水密」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A smooth jacking-thrust history guarantees a fully watertight finished pipeline" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「成品管線水密與紀錄」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Finished-pipeline tightness and records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 成品管線水密與紀錄
knowledge.text: 完成頂進後的接頭水密與施工時抗推力是兩種性能，局部擦傷或墊圈位移可能未在推力曲線顯現。流量試驗需聲明測段、水頭及穩定時間，並區分管體、接頭和端部封堵；全線平均值不能掩蓋關鍵局部漏點。
knowledge.textEn: Post-jacking joint tightness differs from thrust resistance, and damaged or displaced seals may leave no clear thrust signature. Flow tests need defined section, head and stabilization time and must distinguish pipes, joints and end closures.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頂進推力曲線平順就代表完工管線必定完全水密 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A smooth jacking-thrust history guarantees a fully watertight finished pipeline Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「成品管線水密與紀錄」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Finished-pipeline tightness and records" is correct?
options: 頂進推力曲線平順就代表完工管線必定完全水密
完成頂進後的接頭水密與施工時抗推力是兩種性能，局部擦傷或墊圈位移可能未在推力曲線顯現。
泥水壓力乘面積就是完整的掌子面穩定驗算
optionsEn: A smooth jacking-thrust history guarantees a fully watertight finished pipeline
Post-jacking joint tightness differs from thrust resistance, and damaged or displaced seals may leave no clear thrust signature.
Slurry pressure times area constitutes a complete face-stability verification
quiz.explanation: 完成頂進後的接頭水密與施工時抗推力是兩種性能，局部擦傷或墊圈位移可能未在推力曲線顯現。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Post-jacking joint tightness differs from thrust resistance, and damaged or displaced seals may leave no clear thrust signature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 成品管線水密與紀錄：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Finished-pipeline tightness and records: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「成品管線水密與紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Finished-pipeline tightness and records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：measuredLeakage=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min at a specified hypothetical test head。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: measuredLeakage=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min at a specified hypothetical test head. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對試驗水頭、測段界線與逐接頭影像紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check test head, section boundaries and images indexed to individual joints.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 成品管線水密與紀錄：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Finished-pipeline tightness and records: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「成品管線水密與紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Finished-pipeline tightness and records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對試驗水頭、測段界線與逐接頭影像紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「端部試驗封堵漏水被誤判管線失效，或局部漏點被全線平均隱藏」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check test head, section boundaries and images indexed to individual joints. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A leaking test closure is mistaken for pipe failure or overall averaging hides a local leak. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對試驗水頭、測段界線與逐接頭影像紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現端部試驗封堵漏水被誤判管線失效，或局部漏點被全線平均隱藏，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check test head, section boundaries and images indexed to individual joints. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a leaking test closure is mistaken for pipe failure or overall averaging hides a local leak, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：端部試驗封堵漏水被誤判管線失效，或局部漏點被全線平均隱藏。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A leaking test closure is mistaken for pipe failure or overall averaging hides a local leak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 核對試驗水頭、測段界線與逐接頭影像紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「端部試驗封堵漏水被誤判管線失效，或局部漏點被全線平均隱藏」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check test head, section boundaries and images indexed to individual joints. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A leaking test closure is mistaken for pipe failure or overall averaging hides a local leak. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對試驗水頭、測段界線與逐接頭影像紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現端部試驗封堵漏水被誤判管線失效，或局部漏點被全線平均隱藏，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

quiz.question: 要驗證「成品管線水密與紀錄」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Finished-pipeline tightness and records"?
options: 核對試驗水頭、測段界線與逐接頭影像紀錄。

steps.title: 成品管線水密與紀錄：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Finished-pipeline tightness and records: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「成品管線水密與紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Finished-pipeline tightness and records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 端部試驗封堵漏水被誤判管線失效，或局部漏點被全線平均隱藏。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對試驗水頭、測段界線與逐接頭影像紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A leaking test closure is mistaken for pipe failure or overall averaging hides a local leak. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check test head, section boundaries and images indexed to individual joints to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對試驗水頭、測段界線與逐接頭影像紀錄；若出現端部試驗封堵漏水被誤判管線失效，或局部漏點被全線平均隱藏，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a leaking test closure is mistaken for pipe failure or overall averaging hides a local leak, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂進推力曲線平順就代表完工管線必定完全水密」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A smooth jacking-thrust history guarantees a fully watertight finished pipeline" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「成品管線水密與紀錄」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

title: 頂管中繼推進站
summary: 本課以頂管中繼站的分段受力、行程相容與局部接觸為主線，從分段推力與反力連續與多缸合力與偏心檢核建立系統邊界，再把管列彈性壓縮與位移差、曲線管列與徑向作用連到站體閉合與通水淨空。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on intermediate-jacking segment forces, stroke compatibility and local contact. It begins with Segment thrust and reaction continuity and Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity, links Pipeline elastic compression and displacement differences and Curved pipe strings and radial action, and ends with Station closure and hydraulic clearance. Intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查分段推力與反力連續：frontDemand=120 m*8 kN/m+400 kN=1360 kN; rearFriction=180 m*8 kN/m=1440 kN；再獨立檢查多缸合力與偏心檢核：idealResultant=8*20 MPa*0.010 m2=1.60 MN; sevenCylinders=1.40 MN。若同壓八缸其中一缸無有效輸出，理想合力由 1.6 降至 1.4 MN，還會改變合力位置；不能只按八分之七評估安全。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 將比較套筒間隙、全行程密封檢查與滲水時序作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Segment thrust and reaction continuity: frontDemand=120 m*8 kN/m+400 kN=1360 kN; rearFriction=180 m*8 kN/m=1440 kN. Independently check Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity: idealResultant=8*20 MPa*0.010 m2=1.60 MN; sevenCylinders=1.40 MN. Losing one effective cylinder from eight equal-pressure cylinders reduces ideal resultant from 1.6 to 1.4 MN and shifts its location; a seven-eighths capacity ratio alone cannot establish safety. The two results are not a complete design because intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. Use compare sleeve clearance, full-travel seal inspections and leakage timing as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分段推力與反力連續」與「多缸合力與偏心檢核」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Segment thrust and reaction continuity" and "Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分段推力與反力連續：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Segment thrust and reaction continuity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分段推力與反力連續」如何影響頂管中繼推進站的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Segment thrust and reaction continuity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Intermediate jacking stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中繼站將前後管列分開推進，使單段所需軸力小於整列一次推動的總需求，但每個階段仍需連續反力路徑。前段包含機頭阻力，後段則有自身摩阻；兩者不能直接當成同時疊加在每個接頭的荷載。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄；若出現反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分段推力與反力連續」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Intermediate stations advance leading and trailing pipe sections separately, reducing the force associated with moving the whole string at once. Every stage still needs a continuous reaction path. The leading section includes head resistance while the rear has its own friction; these are not simultaneous loads at every joint. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records. If an incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Segment thrust and reaction continuity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 關於「分段推力與反力連續」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Segment thrust and reaction continuity" is correct?
options: 中繼站能推進前段而完全不需要後方提供反力
中繼站將前後管列分開推進，使單段所需軸力小於整列一次推動的總需求，但每個階段仍需連續反力路徑。
共用同一油壓就保證所有千斤頂有效推力相同
optionsEn: An intermediate station advances front pipes without any reaction from behind
Intermediate stations advance leading and trailing pipe sections separately, reducing the force associated with moving the whole string at once.
A shared hydraulic pressure guarantees equal effective thrust from all cylinders
quiz.explanation: 中繼站將前後管列分開推進，使單段所需軸力小於整列一次推動的總需求，但每個階段仍需連續反力路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Intermediate stations advance leading and trailing pipe sections separately, reducing the force associated with moving the whole string at once. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分段推力與反力連續：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Segment thrust and reaction continuity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分段推力與反力連續」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Segment thrust and reaction continuity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：frontDemand=120 m*8 kN/m+400 kN=1360 kN; rearFriction=180 m*8 kN/m=1440 kN。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: frontDemand=120 m*8 kN/m+400 kN=1360 kN; rearFriction=180 m*8 kN/m=1440 kN. Intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：frontDemand=120 m*8 kN/m+400 kN=1360 kN; rearFriction=180 m*8 kN/m=1440 kN。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

推力環存在就能保證所有管端壓力完全均勻

steps.title: 分段推力與反力連續：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Segment thrust and reaction continuity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分段推力與反力連續」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Segment thrust and reaction continuity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分段推力與反力連續」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Segment thrust and reaction continuity"?
options: 按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄。

optionsEn: Map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
No leakage at rest proves the station remains watertight throughout movement
quiz.explanation: 按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分段推力與反力連續：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Segment thrust and reaction continuity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分段推力與反力連續」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Segment thrust and reaction continuity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄；若出現反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「中繼站能推進前段而完全不需要後方提供反力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An intermediate station advances front pipes without any reaction from behind" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按行程階段畫出前後管列與後座反力，對照荷重紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: An incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to map front and rear pipes and thrust-wall reactions by stroke stage against load records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分段推力與反力連續」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Segment thrust and reaction continuity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺。
共用同一油壓就保證所有千斤頂有效推力相同
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress.
A shared hydraulic pressure guarantees equal effective thrust from all cylinders
quiz.explanation: 反力路徑未閉合使後段滑退，前段位移被錯當有效進尺。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An incomplete reaction path lets rear pipes retreat and apparent front displacement is mistaken for useful progress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 多缸合力與偏心檢核：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「多缸合力與偏心檢核」如何影響頂管中繼推進站的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Intermediate jacking stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中繼站沿環布置多個缸，合力大小與作用位置都取決於各缸實際輸出。共同油壓不保證相同有效力，摩擦、行程止點及失效缸會改變分配；應以各缸位置與荷重重建軸力及力矩。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對各缸有效面積、行程及環向荷重分布；若出現一缸卡滯使合力偏心，即使總壓力正常仍壓傷管端，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多缸合力與偏心檢核」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 多缸合力與偏心檢核：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多缸合力與偏心檢核」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：idealResultant=8*20 MPa*0.010 m2=1.60 MN; sevenCylinders=1.40 MN。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: idealResultant=8*20 MPa*0.010 m2=1.60 MN; sevenCylinders=1.40 MN. Intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對各缸有效面積、行程及環向荷重分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare effective cylinder area, stroke and circumferential load distribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：idealResultant=8*20 MPa*0.010 m2=1.60 MN; sevenCylinders=1.40 MN。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 多缸合力與偏心檢核：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「多缸合力與偏心檢核」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對各缸有效面積、行程及環向荷重分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「一缸卡滯使合力偏心，即使總壓力正常仍壓傷管端」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare effective cylinder area, stroke and circumferential load distribution. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A seized cylinder shifts the resultant and damages the pipe end despite normal total pressure. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比對各缸有效面積、行程及環向荷重分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現一缸卡滯使合力偏心，即使總壓力正常仍壓傷管端，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare effective cylinder area, stroke and circumferential load distribution. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a seized cylinder shifts the resultant and damages the pipe end despite normal total pressure, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一缸卡滯使合力偏心，即使總壓力正常仍壓傷管端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A seized cylinder shifts the resultant and damages the pipe end despite normal total pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對各缸有效面積、行程及環向荷重分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「一缸卡滯使合力偏心，即使總壓力正常仍壓傷管端」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare effective cylinder area, stroke and circumferential load distribution. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A seized cylinder shifts the resultant and damages the pipe end despite normal total pressure. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比對各缸有效面積、行程及環向荷重分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現一缸卡滯使合力偏心，即使總壓力正常仍壓傷管端，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare effective cylinder area, stroke and circumferential load distribution. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a seized cylinder shifts the resultant and damages the pipe end despite normal total pressure, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多缸合力與偏心檢核」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity"?

optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare effective cylinder area, stroke and circumferential load distribution.
A reduced load-displacement slope uniquely proves the concrete pipe has fractured

quiz.explanationEn: Compare effective cylinder area, stroke and circumferential load distribution. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 多缸合力與偏心檢核：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多缸合力與偏心檢核」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Multi-cylinder resultant and eccentricity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一缸卡滯使合力偏心，即使總壓力正常仍壓傷管端。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比對各缸有效面積、行程及環向荷重分布，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A seized cylinder shifts the resultant and damages the pipe end despite normal total pressure. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare effective cylinder area, stroke and circumferential load distribution to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比對各缸有效面積、行程及環向荷重分布；若出現一缸卡滯使合力偏心，即使總壓力正常仍壓傷管端，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a seized cylinder shifts the resultant and damages the pipe end despite normal total pressure, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「共用同一油壓就保證所有千斤頂有效推力相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A shared hydraulic pressure guarantees equal effective thrust from all cylinders" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一缸卡滯使合力偏心，即使總壓力正常仍壓傷管端。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比對各缸有效面積、行程及環向荷重分布，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A seized cylinder shifts the resultant and damages the pipe end despite normal total pressure. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare effective cylinder area, stroke and circumferential load distribution to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多缸合力與偏心檢核」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

一缸卡滯使合力偏心，即使總壓力正常仍壓傷管端。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.

A seized cylinder shifts the resultant and damages the pipe end despite normal total pressure.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停機黏著與再啟動荷載」與「行程餘量與幾何相容」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stoppage adhesion and restart loading" and "Stroke reserve and geometric compatibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停機黏著與再啟動荷載：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stoppage adhesion and restart loading: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停機黏著與再啟動荷載」如何影響頂管中繼推進站的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stoppage adhesion and restart loading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Intermediate jacking stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停機後潤滑狀態、土體固結和接觸黏著可能改變，使再啟動需求大於移動時摩阻。假想倍率只比較敏感度，不可當作通用再啟動係數；中繼站位置及管節接觸需要對應停機歷程檢查。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較不同停機時長後的推力峰值與持續滑移荷重；若出現把移動摩阻當啟動需求，停機後接頭瞬間局部超載，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停機黏著與再啟動荷載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stoppages change lubrication, consolidation and contact adhesion, potentially increasing breakaway demand above moving resistance. An assumed multiplier illustrates sensitivity rather than a universal restart factor. Evaluate station location and joint contact against the actual stoppage history and observed force response. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare peak restart and sustained sliding loads after different stoppage durations. If using moving friction as restart demand permits localized joint overload after a stoppage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stoppage adhesion and restart loading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 比較不同停機時長後的推力峰值與持續滑移荷重。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把移動摩阻當啟動需求，停機後接頭瞬間局部超載」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 中繼站伸縮需與管列彈性縮短、間隙閉合及後段跟進相容，行程餘量不能只由名義缸長判斷。位移可能分配到多個接頭，量測基準若混用管內外位置會產生假餘量；極限位置也不是一般作業目標。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對缸伸長、接頭開度與管列前後獨立位移；若出現忽略管列縮短使計算餘量為正，但實際缸已到行程邊界，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「行程餘量與幾何相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Station travel must accommodate pipe compression, gap closure and trailing advance; nominal cylinder length alone does not establish reserve. If ignoring pipe compression predicts positive reserve while a cylinder reaches its travel boundary, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. quiz.question: 關於「行程餘量與幾何相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stroke reserve and geometric compatibility" is correct?
options: 名義油缸行程減去機頭進尺就等於真實可用餘量
中繼站伸縮需與管列彈性縮短、間隙閉合及後段跟進相容，行程餘量不能只由名義缸長判斷。
中繼站油缸每伸長一毫米就代表機頭前進一毫米
optionsEn: Nominal cylinder travel minus machine advance equals the true remaining stroke
Station travel must accommodate pipe compression, gap closure and trailing advance; nominal cylinder length alone does not establish reserve.
Every millimeter of station-cylinder extension means one millimeter of machine advance
quiz.explanation: 中繼站伸縮需與管列彈性縮短、間隙閉合及後段跟進相容，行程餘量不能只由名義缸長判斷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Station travel must accommodate pipe compression, gap closure and trailing advance; nominal cylinder length alone does not establish reserve. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 行程餘量與幾何相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stroke reserve and geometric compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「行程餘量與幾何相容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stroke reserve and geometric compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：remainingStroke=0.52 m-(0.40 m+0.10 m)=0.02 m。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: remainingStroke=0.52 m-(0.40 m+0.10 m)=0.02 m. Intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對缸伸長、接頭開度與管列前後獨立位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check cylinder extension, joint opening and independent front and rear pipeline movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「行程餘量與幾何相容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: remainingStroke=0.52 m-(0.40 m+0.10 m)=0.02 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 行程餘量與幾何相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stroke reserve and geometric compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「行程餘量與幾何相容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stroke reserve and geometric compatibility” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對缸伸長、接頭開度與管列前後獨立位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「忽略管列縮短使計算餘量為正，但實際缸已到行程邊界」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check cylinder extension, joint opening and independent front and rear pipeline movement. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ignoring pipe compression predicts positive reserve while a cylinder reaches its travel boundary. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對缸伸長、接頭開度與管列前後獨立位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現忽略管列縮短使計算餘量為正，但實際缸已到行程邊界，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check cylinder extension, joint opening and independent front and rear pipeline movement. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignoring pipe compression predicts positive reserve while a cylinder reaches its travel boundary, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略管列縮短使計算餘量為正，但實際缸已到行程邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring pipe compression predicts positive reserve while a cylinder reaches its travel boundary. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 核對缸伸長、接頭開度與管列前後獨立位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「忽略管列縮短使計算餘量為正，但實際缸已到行程邊界」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ignoring pipe compression predicts positive reserve while a cylinder reaches its travel boundary. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

If ignoring pipe compression predicts positive reserve while a cylinder reaches its travel boundary, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「行程餘量與幾何相容」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stroke reserve and geometric compatibility"?
options: 核對缸伸長、接頭開度與管列前後獨立位移。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
中繼站能推進前段而完全不需要後方提供反力
optionsEn: Check cylinder extension, joint opening and independent front and rear pipeline movement.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
An intermediate station advances front pipes without any reaction from behind
quiz.explanation: 核對缸伸長、接頭開度與管列前後獨立位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check cylinder extension, joint opening and independent front and rear pipeline movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 行程餘量與幾何相容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stroke reserve and geometric compatibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「行程餘量與幾何相容」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stroke reserve and geometric compatibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略管列縮短使計算餘量為正，但實際缸已到行程邊界。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對缸伸長、接頭開度與管列前後獨立位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring pipe compression predicts positive reserve while a cylinder reaches its travel boundary. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check cylinder extension, joint opening and independent front and rear pipeline movement to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對缸伸長、接頭開度與管列前後獨立位移；若出現忽略管列縮短使計算餘量為正，但實際缸已到行程邊界，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If ignoring pipe compression predicts positive reserve while a cylinder reaches its travel boundary, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「名義油缸行程減去機頭進尺就等於真實可用餘量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Nominal cylinder travel minus machine advance equals the true remaining stroke" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略管列縮短使計算餘量為正，但實際缸已到行程邊界。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對缸伸長、接頭開度與管列前後獨立位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check cylinder extension, joint opening and independent front and rear pipeline movement to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「行程餘量與幾何相容」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stroke reserve and geometric compatibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

忽略管列縮短使計算餘量為正，但實際缸已到行程邊界。

Every millimeter of station-cylinder extension means one millimeter of machine advance

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「管列彈性壓縮與位移差」與「推力環局部承壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pipeline elastic compression and displacement differences" and "Thrust-ring local bearing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 管列彈性壓縮與位移差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pipeline elastic compression and displacement differences: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「管列彈性壓縮與位移差」如何影響頂管中繼推進站的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pipeline elastic compression and displacement differences” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Intermediate jacking stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受壓管列會彈性縮短，站體行程不完全等於機頭進尺。均勻軸力模型可分離鋼或混凝土材料變形，但接頭墊材與地層滑移會增加非線性位移；卸載回彈和永久進尺必須分開記錄。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較載入卸載行程、管列應變與機頭絕對位置；若出現彈性回彈被計成反向滑移，導致錯誤判讀地層摩阻，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「管列彈性壓縮與位移差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A compressed pipeline shortens elastically, so station travel is not entirely machine progress. A uniform-force model isolates material strain, but packers and soil slip add nonlinear movement. Separate unloading rebound from permanent advance to avoid interpreting stored deformation as productive excavation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare loading and unloading travel, pipe strain and absolute machine position. If elastic rebound is counted as reverse slip and misinterpreted as soil friction behavior, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pipeline elastic compression and displacement differences” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：elasticShortening=N*L/(E*A)=2e6 N*100 m/(30e9 Pa*0.40 m2)=0.0167 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: elasticShortening=N*L/(E*A)=2e6 N*100 m/(30e9 Pa*0.40 m2)=0.0167 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「中繼站油缸每伸長一毫米就代表機頭前進一毫米」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every millimeter of station-cylinder extension means one millimeter of machine advance" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「管列彈性壓縮與位移差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pipeline elastic compression and displacement differences”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 管列彈性壓縮與位移差：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管列彈性壓縮與位移差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pipeline elastic compression and displacement differences” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較載入卸載行程、管列應變與機頭絕對位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「彈性回彈被計成反向滑移，導致錯誤判讀地層摩阻」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare loading and unloading travel, pipe strain and absolute machine position. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Elastic rebound is counted as reverse slip and misinterpreted as soil friction behavior. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較載入卸載行程、管列應變與機頭絕對位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現彈性回彈被計成反向滑移，導致錯誤判讀地層摩阻，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare loading and unloading travel, pipe strain and absolute machine position. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If elastic rebound is counted as reverse slip and misinterpreted as soil friction behavior, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：彈性回彈被計成反向滑移，導致錯誤判讀地層摩阻。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 管列彈性壓縮與位移差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pipeline elastic compression and displacement differences: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「管列彈性壓縮與位移差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pipeline elastic compression and displacement differences” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 彈性回彈被計成反向滑移，導致錯誤判讀地層摩阻。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較載入卸載行程、管列應變與機頭絕對位置，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Elastic rebound is counted as reverse slip and misinterpreted as soil friction behavior. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare loading and unloading travel, pipe strain and absolute machine position to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較載入卸載行程、管列應變與機頭絕對位置；若出現彈性回彈被計成反向滑移，導致錯誤判讀地層摩阻，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If elastic rebound is counted as reverse slip and misinterpreted as soil friction behavior, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「中繼站油缸每伸長一毫米就代表機頭前進一毫米」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every millimeter of station-cylinder extension means one millimeter of machine advance" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 彈性回彈被計成反向滑移，導致錯誤判讀地層摩阻。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較載入卸載行程、管列應變與機頭絕對位置，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

steps.title: 推力環局部承壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thrust-ring local bearing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「推力環局部承壓」如何影響頂管中繼推進站的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
