steps.instruction: 推力環將離散缸力散布到管端，環的彎曲剛度和接觸平整度決定分配範圍。單缸力除有效接觸面可檢查局部量級，不能以全環面積沖淡峰值；接觸邊緣與管端劈裂仍需結構分析。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照推力環平整度、接觸壓痕及管端環向裂縫；若出現環變形使單缸力集中到窄邊，平均全環壓力仍顯示很低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「推力環局部承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A thrust ring distributes discrete cylinder forces into pipe ends, with bending stiffness and flatness controlling the spread. Dividing one cylinder force by its effective footprint checks local scale. Averaging over the entire ring conceals peaks; edge contact and pipe-end splitting need structural assessment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare ring flatness, contact impressions and circumferential pipe-end cracks. If ring distortion focuses one cylinder onto a narrow edge while full-ring mean pressure remains low, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thrust-ring local bearing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：localBearing=200 kN/0.025 m2=8000 kPa=8 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: localBearing=200 kN/0.025 m2=8000 kPa=8 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「推力環存在就能保證所有管端壓力完全均勻」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The presence of a thrust ring guarantees perfectly uniform pipe-end pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「推力環局部承壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thrust-ring local bearing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 推力環局部承壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thrust-ring local bearing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「推力環局部承壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 對照推力環平整度、接觸壓痕及管端環向裂縫。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「環變形使單缸力集中到窄邊，平均全環壓力仍顯示很低」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare ring flatness, contact impressions and circumferential pipe-end cracks. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ring distortion focuses one cylinder onto a narrow edge while full-ring mean pressure remains low. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ring distortion focuses one cylinder onto a narrow edge while full-ring mean pressure remains low, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：環變形使單缸力集中到窄邊，平均全環壓力仍顯示很低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ring distortion focuses one cylinder onto a narrow edge while full-ring mean pressure remains low. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 推力環局部承壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thrust-ring local bearing: failure diagnosis

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thrust-ring local bearing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 環變形使單缸力集中到窄邊，平均全環壓力仍顯示很低。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照推力環平整度、接觸壓痕及管端環向裂縫，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ring distortion focuses one cylinder onto a narrow edge while full-ring mean pressure remains low. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare ring flatness, contact impressions and circumferential pipe-end cracks to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照推力環平整度、接觸壓痕及管端環向裂縫；若出現環變形使單缸力集中到窄邊，平均全環壓力仍顯示很低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If ring distortion focuses one cylinder onto a narrow edge while full-ring mean pressure remains low, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「推力環存在就能保證所有管端壓力完全均勻」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The presence of a thrust ring guarantees perfectly uniform pipe-end pressure" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「推力環局部承壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「曲線管列與徑向作用」與「伸縮套筒與水密邊界」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Curved pipe strings and radial action" and "Telescopic sleeves and watertight boundaries": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 曲線管列與徑向作用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Curved pipe strings and radial action: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲線管列與徑向作用」如何影響頂管中繼推進站的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curved pipe strings and radial action” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Intermediate jacking stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在曲線中相鄰軸力方向不同，合成後產生徑向作用並增加導向和地層接觸需求。對稱小角模型只給某節點的向量合力，不能替代整條曲線摩阻；角度應用一致單位並對應實際接頭轉角。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較曲線接頭角度、側向接觸與導向偏差；若出現軸力方向改變被忽略，使側壁接觸壓力與摩阻被低估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲線管列與徑向作用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Adjacent axial forces change direction along a curve, producing radial action and additional guidance or ground contact demand. A symmetric angle model gives the vector resultant at one node, not the entire curved-drive friction. Use consistent angular units tied to actual joint rotation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare curved-joint angles, lateral contact and guidance deviation. If ignoring changing force direction understates lateral contact pressure and friction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Curved pipe strings and radial action” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：radialResultant=2*N*sin(theta/2)=2*1000 kN*sin(2 degrees/2)=34.90 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: radialResultant=2*N*sin(theta/2)=2*1000 kN*sin(2 degrees/2)=34.90 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「曲線內只要軸向推力相同就不會增加任何側向作用」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal axial thrust in a curve produces no additional lateral action" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲線管列與徑向作用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Curved pipe strings and radial action”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Telescopic sleeves and watertight boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Intermediate jacking stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中繼站伸縮套筒需在相對移動中保持水密，密封方向和有效壓力面積取決於構造。水壓合力只是作用之一，偏心、砂粒與刮傷可能先破壞密封；靜態水密合格不能代表全行程循環後仍無損傷。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較套筒間隙、全行程密封檢查與滲水時序；若出現砂粒刮傷在伸縮後形成漏水通道，靜止試驗未曾顯現，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「伸縮套筒與水密邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Telescopic sleeves maintain tightness during relative motion, with seal orientation and effective pressure area defined by detail. steps.instruction: 比較套筒間隙、全行程密封檢查與滲水時序。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「砂粒刮傷在伸縮後形成漏水通道，靜止試驗未曾顯現」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare sleeve clearance, full-travel seal inspections and leakage timing. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 伸縮套筒與水密邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Telescopic sleeves and watertight boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「伸縮套筒與水密邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Telescopic sleeves and watertight boundaries” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 砂粒刮傷在伸縮後形成漏水通道，靜止試驗未曾顯現。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較套筒間隙、全行程密封檢查與滲水時序，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Grit scoring opens a leakage path after movement that was absent during a stationary test. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare sleeve clearance, full-travel seal inspections and leakage timing to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較套筒間隙、全行程密封檢查與滲水時序；若出現砂粒刮傷在伸縮後形成漏水通道，靜止試驗未曾顯現，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If grit scoring opens a leakage path after movement that was absent during a stationary test, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「中繼站靜止不漏水就證明伸縮過程一定完全水密」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No leakage at rest proves the station remains watertight throughout movement" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「剛度變化與異常辨識」與「站體閉合與通水淨空」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stiffness changes and anomaly diagnosis" and "Station closure and hydraulic clearance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 剛度變化與異常辨識：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stiffness changes and anomaly diagnosis: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剛度變化與異常辨識」如何影響頂管中繼推進站的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stiffness changes and anomaly diagnosis” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Intermediate jacking stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 荷重位移斜率可描述特定區段的表觀剛度，卻混合缸、環、墊材、管列與土體的反應。斜率突變可能是接觸閉合、滑移或儀器基準變動，不能只憑曲線判定一個零件損壞；需與分部位移聯合解讀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將總行程分解為缸、接頭及管列位移並比較斜率；若出現測點基座鬆動造成假剛度下降，被誤判管節破壞，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剛度變化與異常辨識」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A load-displacement slope describes apparent stiffness over an interval but combines cylinders, rings, packers, pipes and soil. A change may reflect contact closure, slip or datum movement rather than a single damaged component. Interpret it with component displacement measurements to identify the responsible mechanism. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Separate overall travel into cylinder, joint and pipe movements and compare slopes. If a loose sensor base creates apparent stiffness loss mistaken for pipe failure, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stiffness changes and anomaly diagnosis” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：secantStiffness=(1200 kN-1000 kN)/(4 mm-2 mm)=100 kN/mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: secantStiffness=(1200 kN-1000 kN)/(4 mm-2 mm)=100 kN/mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「荷重位移斜率下降就唯一證明混凝土管節已破裂」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A reduced load-displacement slope uniquely proves the concrete pipe has fractured" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剛度變化與異常辨識」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stiffness changes and anomaly diagnosis”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剛度變化與異常辨識
knowledge.text: 荷重位移斜率可描述特定區段的表觀剛度，卻混合缸、環、墊材、管列與土體的反應。斜率突變可能是接觸閉合、滑移或儀器基準變動，不能只憑曲線判定一個零件損壞；需與分部位移聯合解讀。
knowledge.textEn: A load-displacement slope describes apparent stiffness over an interval but combines cylinders, rings, packers, pipes and soil. A change may reflect contact closure, slip or datum movement rather than a single damaged component.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：荷重位移斜率下降就唯一證明混凝土管節已破裂 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A reduced load-displacement slope uniquely proves the concrete pipe has fractured Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剛度變化與異常辨識」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stiffness changes and anomaly diagnosis" is correct?
options: 荷重位移斜率可描述特定區段的表觀剛度，卻混合缸、環、墊材、管列與土體的反應。
荷重位移斜率下降就唯一證明混凝土管節已破裂
頂進任務完成就代表中繼站永久通水功能必定合格
optionsEn: A load-displacement slope describes apparent stiffness over an interval but combines cylinders, rings, packers, pipes and soil.
A reduced load-displacement slope uniquely proves the concrete pipe has fractured
Completion of jacking guarantees the permanent hydraulic function of every station
quiz.explanation: 荷重位移斜率可描述特定區段的表觀剛度，卻混合缸、環、墊材、管列與土體的反應。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A load-displacement slope describes apparent stiffness over an interval but combines cylinders, rings, packers, pipes and soil. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剛度變化與異常辨識：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stiffness changes and anomaly diagnosis: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剛度變化與異常辨識」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stiffness changes and anomaly diagnosis” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：secantStiffness=(1200 kN-1000 kN)/(4 mm-2 mm)=100 kN/mm。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: secantStiffness=(1200 kN-1000 kN)/(4 mm-2 mm)=100 kN/mm. Intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將總行程分解為缸、接頭及管列位移並比較斜率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Separate overall travel into cylinder, joint and pipe movements and compare slopes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：secantStiffness=(1200 kN-1000 kN)/(4 mm-2 mm)=100 kN/mm。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instruction: 施工完成後中繼站狀態必須符合永久管線要求，局部凸起、未閉合間隙與拆件遺留會影響水力和維護通道。圓截面面積比只能估幾何縮減，流量還取決於坡度、粗糙與局部損失；影像應與最後配置核對。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對最終閉合尺寸、內視影像與拆件交接清單；若出現臨時構件殘留形成局部阻塞，施工推進完成卻不符永久功能，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「站體閉合與通水淨空」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After construction the station must meet permanent-pipeline requirements; protrusions, unclosed gaps and leftover fittings affect flow and maintenance access. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Station closure and hydraulic clearance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.text: 核對最終閉合尺寸、內視影像與拆件交接清單。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「臨時構件殘留形成局部阻塞，施工推進完成卻不符永久功能」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile final closure dimensions, internal images and removed-equipment records. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Remaining temporary fittings restrict flow despite completed construction advance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對最終閉合尺寸、內視影像與拆件交接清單列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現臨時構件殘留形成局部阻塞，施工推進完成卻不符永久功能，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Reconcile final closure dimensions, internal images and removed-equipment records. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If remaining temporary fittings restrict flow despite completed construction advance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「站體閉合與通水淨空」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Station closure and hydraulic clearance"?

不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Reconcile final closure dimensions, internal images and removed-equipment records.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Equal axial thrust in a curve produces no additional lateral action
quiz.explanation: 核對最終閉合尺寸、內視影像與拆件交接清單。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile final closure dimensions, internal images and removed-equipment records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 站體閉合與通水淨空：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Station closure and hydraulic clearance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「站體閉合與通水淨空」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Station closure and hydraulic clearance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 臨時構件殘留形成局部阻塞，施工推進完成卻不符永久功能。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對最終閉合尺寸、內視影像與拆件交接清單，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Remaining temporary fittings restrict flow despite completed construction advance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile final closure dimensions, internal images and removed-equipment records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對最終閉合尺寸、內視影像與拆件交接清單；若出現臨時構件殘留形成局部阻塞，施工推進完成卻不符永久功能，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If remaining temporary fittings restrict flow despite completed construction advance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂進任務完成就代表中繼站永久通水功能必定合格」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Completion of jacking guarantees the permanent hydraulic function of every station" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 臨時構件殘留形成局部阻塞，施工推進完成卻不符永久功能。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對最終閉合尺寸、內視影像與拆件交接清單，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Remaining temporary fittings restrict flow despite completed construction advance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile final closure dimensions, internal images and removed-equipment records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「站體閉合與通水淨空」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Station closure and hydraulic clearance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
臨時構件殘留形成局部阻塞，施工推進完成卻不符永久功能。
中繼站能推進前段而完全不需要後方提供反力
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Remaining temporary fittings restrict flow despite completed construction advance.
An intermediate station advances front pipes without any reaction from behind
quiz.explanation: 臨時構件殘留形成局部阻塞，施工推進完成卻不符永久功能。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Remaining temporary fittings restrict flow despite completed construction advance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 水平定向鑽掘導向
summary: 本課以定向鑽掘的姿態積分、誤差來源與障礙淨距為主線，從鑽桿長度與垂向投影與方位誤差與橫向漂移建立系統邊界，再把磁場干擾與方位可信度、設施淨距與不確定度連到竣工閉合與全線可信度。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on directional-drilling attitude integration, error sources and obstacle clearance. It begins with Rod length and vertical projection and Heading error and lateral drift, links Magnetic interference and heading confidence and Utility clearance and uncertainty, and ends with As-built closure and route confidence. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查鑽桿長度與垂向投影：verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m；再獨立檢查方位誤差與橫向漂移：lateralOffset=100 m*tan(0.1 degrees)=0.1745 m。方向誤差由 0.1 增至 0.2 度，在 100 m 直段上橫向差約由 0.175 增至 0.349 m；系統誤差不能靠增加相同來源讀值消除。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 將對照進返流量、環空壓力及地表異常位置作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Rod length and vertical projection: verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m. Independently check Heading error and lateral drift: lateralOffset=100 m*tan(0.1 degrees)=0.1745 m. Increasing heading error from 0.1 to 0.2 degree raises lateral offset over a 100 m straight segment from about 0.175 to 0.349 m; repeating the same biased source does not remove systematic error. The two results are not a complete design because guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. Use compare feed and return flow, annular pressure and locations of surface anomalies as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鑽桿長度與垂向投影」與「方位誤差與橫向漂移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rod length and vertical projection" and "Heading error and lateral drift": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鑽桿長度與垂向投影：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rod length and vertical projection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鑽桿長度與垂向投影」如何影響水平定向鑽掘導向的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rod length and vertical projection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Horizontal directional drilling guidance”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鑽進長度沿實際路徑量取，垂向變化由傾角投影決定而非直接等於桿長。分段積分需保留角度正負與參考方向，彎曲段還需考慮角度在桿內的變化；一個末端傾角不能代表整段平均姿態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對桿長紀錄、傾角符號與獨立高程閉合；若出現把向下傾角符號反用，路徑深度隨進尺愈算愈錯，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鑽桿長度與垂向投影」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drilled length follows the actual path, while vertical change comes from inclination projection rather than rod length itself. Segment integration requires signed angles and reference direction, with curvature changing attitude within a rod. One endpoint inclination cannot automatically represent the segment-average attitude. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check rod-length records, inclination signs and independent elevation closure. If reversing the sign of downward inclination progressively corrupts calculated depth, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rod length and vertical projection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鑽桿末端傾角一定等於整根鑽桿的平均傾角」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The rod-end inclination always equals the mean inclination of the whole rod" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鑽桿長度與垂向投影」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rod length and vertical projection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鑽桿長度與垂向投影
knowledge.text: 鑽進長度沿實際路徑量取，垂向變化由傾角投影決定而非直接等於桿長。分段積分需保留角度正負與參考方向，彎曲段還需考慮角度在桿內的變化；一個末端傾角不能代表整段平均姿態。
knowledge.textEn: Drilled length follows the actual path, while vertical change comes from inclination projection rather than rod length itself. Segment integration requires signed angles and reference direction, with curvature changing attitude within a rod.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鑽桿末端傾角一定等於整根鑽桿的平均傾角 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The rod-end inclination always equals the mean inclination of the whole rod Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鑽桿長度與垂向投影」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rod length and vertical projection" is correct?
options: 鑽桿末端傾角一定等於整根鑽桿的平均傾角
鑽進長度沿實際路徑量取，垂向變化由傾角投影決定而非直接等於桿長。
同一導向儀讀很多次就能消除所有系統性方位偏差
optionsEn: The rod-end inclination always equals the mean inclination of the whole rod
Drilled length follows the actual path, while vertical change comes from inclination projection rather than rod length itself.
Many readings from one guidance instrument eliminate every systematic heading bias
quiz.explanation: 鑽進長度沿實際路徑量取，垂向變化由傾角投影決定而非直接等於桿長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drilled length follows the actual path, while vertical change comes from inclination projection rather than rod length itself. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鑽桿長度與垂向投影：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rod length and vertical projection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鑽桿長度與垂向投影」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rod length and vertical projection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對桿長紀錄、傾角符號與獨立高程閉合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check rod-length records, inclination signs and independent elevation closure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鑽桿長度與垂向投影」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rod length and vertical projection", which statement holds?
options: 工具面偏轉角度永遠等於成孔路徑的實際轉向角
陀螺不受磁場影響就代表永遠不會產生方位誤差

A gyro immune to magnetic interference never develops heading error

quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鑽桿長度與垂向投影：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rod length and vertical projection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鑽桿長度與垂向投影」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rod length and vertical projection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對桿長紀錄、傾角符號與獨立高程閉合。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把向下傾角符號反用，路徑深度隨進尺愈算愈錯」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check rod-length records, inclination signs and independent elevation closure. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Reversing the sign of downward inclination progressively corrupts calculated depth. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對桿長紀錄、傾角符號與獨立高程閉合列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把向下傾角符號反用，路徑深度隨進尺愈算愈錯，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If reversing the sign of downward inclination progressively corrupts calculated depth, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把向下傾角符號反用，路徑深度隨進尺愈算愈錯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 鑽桿長度與垂向投影：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rod length and vertical projection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鑽桿長度與垂向投影」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rod length and vertical projection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把向下傾角符號反用，路徑深度隨進尺愈算愈錯。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對桿長紀錄、傾角符號與獨立高程閉合，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reversing the sign of downward inclination progressively corrupts calculated depth. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check rod-length records, inclination signs and independent elevation closure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對桿長紀錄、傾角符號與獨立高程閉合；若出現把向下傾角符號反用，路徑深度隨進尺愈算愈錯，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If reversing the sign of downward inclination progressively corrupts calculated depth, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鑽桿末端傾角一定等於整根鑽桿的平均傾角」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The rod-end inclination always equals the mean inclination of the whole rod" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 方位誤差與橫向漂移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Heading error and lateral drift: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方位誤差與橫向漂移」如何影響水平定向鑽掘導向的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Heading error and lateral drift” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Horizontal directional drilling guidance”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 微小方位偏差沿距離累積成顯著橫向漂移，固定偏差與隨機噪聲的統計行為不同。直線投影可估單一偏差的量級，真正路線需要逐段姿態積分；不能把多次讀值平均當成對磁北或控制網的獨立校核。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較重複方位讀值與獨立測量控制的方向差；若出現固定方位偏差被當隨機誤差平均，長距離後仍偏離走廊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方位誤差與橫向漂移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small heading bias accumulates into substantial lateral drift, unlike zero-mean random noise. Straight projection estimates one fixed-bias effect, while real routes require segmentwise attitude integration. Averaging repeated readings does not independently verify the magnetic reference or survey control network. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare repeated headings with independently surveyed control directions. If a fixed heading bias is treated as random noise and the long route still leaves its corridor, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Heading error and lateral drift” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：lateralOffset=100 m*tan(0.1 degrees)=0.1745 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: lateralOffset=100 m*tan(0.1 degrees)=0.1745 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一導向儀讀很多次就能消除所有系統性方位偏差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many readings from one guidance instrument eliminate every systematic heading bias" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方位誤差與橫向漂移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Heading error and lateral drift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 方位誤差與橫向漂移
knowledge.text: 微小方位偏差沿距離累積成顯著橫向漂移，固定偏差與隨機噪聲的統計行為不同。直線投影可估單一偏差的量級，真正路線需要逐段姿態積分；不能把多次讀值平均當成對磁北或控制網的獨立校核。
knowledge.textEn: Small heading bias accumulates into substantial lateral drift, unlike zero-mean random noise. Straight projection estimates one fixed-bias effect, while real routes require segmentwise attitude integration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一導向儀讀很多次就能消除所有系統性方位偏差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Many readings from one guidance instrument eliminate every systematic heading bias Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「方位誤差與橫向漂移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Heading error and lateral drift" is correct?
options: 同一導向儀讀很多次就能消除所有系統性方位偏差
用弧長除角度時不需要區分度數與弧度
微小方位偏差沿距離累積成顯著橫向漂移，固定偏差與隨機噪聲的統計行為不同。
optionsEn: Many readings from one guidance instrument eliminate every systematic heading bias
Dividing arc length by angle never requires distinguishing degrees from radians
Small heading bias accumulates into substantial lateral drift, unlike zero-mean random noise.
quiz.explanation: 微小方位偏差沿距離累積成顯著橫向漂移，固定偏差與隨機噪聲的統計行為不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small heading bias accumulates into substantial lateral drift, unlike zero-mean random noise. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Heading error and lateral drift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：lateralOffset=100 m*tan(0.1 degrees)=0.1745 m。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: lateralOffset=100 m*tan(0.1 degrees)=0.1745 m. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較重複方位讀值與獨立測量控制的方向差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare repeated headings with independently surveyed control directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「方位誤差與橫向漂移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 方位誤差與橫向漂移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Heading error and lateral drift: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方位誤差與橫向漂移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 固定方位偏差被當隨機誤差平均，長距離後仍偏離走廊。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較重複方位讀值與獨立測量控制的方向差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A fixed heading bias is treated as random noise and the long route still leaves its corridor. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一導向儀讀很多次就能消除所有系統性方位偏差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 曲率半徑與角度單位：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Curvature radius and angular units: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲率半徑與角度單位」如何影響水平定向鑽掘導向的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curvature radius and angular units” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Horizontal directional drilling guidance”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰姿態角差與弧長決定局部曲率，但角度需轉成弧度才可直接使用半徑關係。鑽具和成品管各有不同彎曲限制，短距姿態噪聲會製造假小半徑；路徑平滑不能刪除真實局部折角的證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對相鄰姿態、測距及獨立管材彎曲要求；若出現把度數直接當弧度使半徑低估數十倍，導致錯誤判讀，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲率半徑與角度單位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Local curvature relates arc length to attitude change, with radians required in the radius relation. Drill string and product pipe have different bending constraints, and short-baseline attitude noise can create falsely tight curvature. Smoothing the path must not erase evidence of a real localized dogleg. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare adjacent attitudes and distances with separately established pipe-bending requirements. If using degrees directly as radians understates radius by a large factor and distorts interpretation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Curvature radius and angular units” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: radius=arcLength/dTheta=3 m/(0.5*pi/180 rad)=343.8 m.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲率半徑與角度單位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Curvature radius and angular units”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Local curvature relates arc length to attitude change, with radians required in the radius relation. Drill string and product pipe have different bending constraints, and short-baseline attitude noise can create falsely tight curvature.

steps.title: 工具面與地層轉向反應：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Toolface and ground steering response” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Horizontal directional drilling guidance”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 工具面方向設定與實際軌跡轉向之間受地層、鑽頭和桿件彈性影響，並非固定一比一。觀察到的轉向增益僅適用該段與該工況，交替地層可能改變幅度和延遲；應先識別回應再談模型是否可信。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照工具面紀錄、實測姿態變化與地層轉換里程；若出現沿用前一土層增益造成過度修正，曲率在界面集中，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「工具面與地層轉向反應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Toolface orientation does not translate one-to-one into route turning because ground, bit and rod elasticity intervene. Observed steering gain belongs to the specific segment and state; changing layers alter magnitude and delay. Identify the response before treating a steering model as transferable. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare toolface records and measured attitude changes against geological transitions. If reusing the previous layer gain overcorrects the route and concentrates curvature at the interface, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Toolface and ground steering response” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 工具面與地層轉向反應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Toolface and ground steering response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「工具面與地層轉向反應」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Toolface and ground steering response” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一土層增益造成過度修正，曲率在界面集中。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照工具面紀錄、實測姿態變化與地層轉換里程，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing the previous layer gain overcorrects the route and concentrates curvature at the interface. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare toolface records and measured attitude changes against geological transitions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照工具面紀錄、實測姿態變化與地層轉換里程；若出現沿用前一土層增益造成過度修正，曲率在界面集中，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If reusing the previous layer gain overcorrects the route and concentrates curvature at the interface, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「工具面偏轉角度永遠等於成孔路徑的實際轉向角」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Toolface deflection always equals the actual turning angle of the bore" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沿用前一土層增益造成過度修正，曲率在界面集中。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照工具面紀錄、實測姿態變化與地層轉換里程，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing the previous layer gain overcorrects the route and concentrates curvature at the interface. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare toolface records and measured attitude changes against geological transitions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「工具面與地層轉向反應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Toolface and ground steering response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
沿用前一土層增益造成過度修正，曲率在界面集中。
總磁場強度正常就能保證磁導向的方位完全準確
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Reusing the previous layer gain overcorrects the route and concentrates curvature at the interface.
Normal total magnetic intensity guarantees completely accurate magnetic heading
quiz.explanation: 沿用前一土層增益造成過度修正，曲率在界面集中。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing the previous layer gain overcorrects the route and concentrates curvature at the interface. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「磁場干擾與方位可信度」與「陀螺漂移與時間校核」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Magnetic interference and heading confidence" and "Gyro drift and time checks": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 磁場干擾與方位可信度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Magnetic interference and heading confidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「磁場干擾與方位可信度」如何影響水平定向鑽掘導向的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Magnetic interference and heading confidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Horizontal directional drilling guidance”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 磁導向依賴地磁向量，埋設鋼材、電流及鄰近設施會改變局部場。簡單橫向擾動模型可顯示方位敏感度，但傾角補償與三維磁異常需另評估；總磁場強度接近正常也不能保證方向不偏。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較三軸磁場、設備位置與非磁性導向或測量證據；若出現局部鋼材扭轉磁場方向，總場近正常卻方位已偏移，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「磁場干擾與方位可信度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Magnetic guidance depends on the field vector, disturbed by buried steel, electrical currents and nearby structures. A simple transverse perturbation illustrates heading sensitivity, while tilt compensation and three-dimensional anomalies require separate assessment. A near-normal field magnitude does not prove an unbiased field direction. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare three-axis magnetic fields and equipment positions with nonmagnetic guidance or survey evidence. If local steel rotates the field while near-normal magnitude conceals heading bias, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Magnetic interference and heading confidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：headingBias=atan(Btransverse/Breference)=atan(0.5 uT/20 uT)=1.432 degrees。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: headingBias=atan(Btransverse/Breference)=atan(0.5 uT/20 uT)=1.432 degrees.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總磁場強度正常就能保證磁導向的方位完全準確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal total magnetic intensity guarantees completely accurate magnetic heading" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「磁場干擾與方位可信度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Magnetic interference and heading confidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 磁場干擾與方位可信度
knowledge.text: 磁導向依賴地磁向量，埋設鋼材、電流及鄰近設施會改變局部場。簡單橫向擾動模型可顯示方位敏感度，但傾角補償與三維磁異常需另評估；總磁場強度接近正常也不能保證方向不偏。
knowledge.textEn: Magnetic guidance depends on the field vector, disturbed by buried steel, electrical currents and nearby structures. A simple transverse perturbation illustrates heading sensitivity, while tilt compensation and three-dimensional anomalies require separate assessment.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總磁場強度正常就能保證磁導向的方位完全準確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal total magnetic intensity guarantees completely accurate magnetic heading Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「磁場干擾與方位可信度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Magnetic interference and heading confidence" is correct?
options: 總磁場強度正常就能保證磁導向的方位完全準確
陀螺不受磁場影響就代表永遠不會產生方位誤差
磁導向依賴地磁向量，埋設鋼材、電流及鄰近設施會改變局部場。
optionsEn: Normal total magnetic intensity guarantees completely accurate magnetic heading
A gyro immune to magnetic interference never develops heading error
Magnetic guidance depends on the field vector, disturbed by buried steel, electrical currents and nearby structures.
quiz.explanation: 磁導向依賴地磁向量，埋設鋼材、電流及鄰近設施會改變局部場。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Magnetic guidance depends on the field vector, disturbed by buried steel, electrical currents and nearby structures. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 磁場干擾與方位可信度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Magnetic interference and heading confidence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「磁場干擾與方位可信度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Magnetic interference and heading confidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：headingBias=atan(Btransverse/Breference)=atan(0.5 uT/20 uT)=1.432 degrees。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: headingBias=atan(Btransverse/Breference)=atan(0.5 uT/20 uT)=1.432 degrees. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較三軸磁場、設備位置與非磁性導向或測量證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare three-axis magnetic fields and equipment positions with nonmagnetic guidance or survey evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：headingBias=atan(Btransverse/Breference)=atan(0.5 uT/20 uT)=1.432 degrees。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: headingBias=atan(Btransverse/Breference)=atan(0.5 uT/20 uT)=1.432 degrees. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「磁場干擾與方位可信度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Magnetic interference and heading confidence", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：headingBias=atan(Btransverse/Breference)=atan(0.5 uT/20 uT)=1.432 degrees。
平均環空流速正常就能排除所有冒漿風險
終點閉合誤差小就能證明中途所有位置都正確
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: headingBias=atan(Btransverse/Breference)=atan(0.5 uT/20 uT)=1.432 degrees.
Normal mean annular velocity rules out every inadvertent-return risk
Small endpoint closure error proves every intermediate position is correct
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：headingBias=atan(Btransverse/Breference)=atan(0.5 uT/20 uT)=1.432 degrees。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: headingBias=atan(Btransverse/Breference)=atan(0.5 uT/20 uT)=1.432 degrees. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 磁場干擾與方位可信度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Magnetic interference and heading confidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「磁場干擾與方位可信度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Magnetic interference and heading confidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較三軸磁場、設備位置與非磁性導向或測量證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部鋼材扭轉磁場方向，總場近正常卻方位已偏移」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare three-axis magnetic fields and equipment positions with nonmagnetic guidance or survey evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Local steel rotates the field while near-normal magnitude conceals heading bias. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較三軸磁場、設備位置與非磁性導向或測量證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部鋼材扭轉磁場方向，總場近正常卻方位已偏移，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare three-axis magnetic fields and equipment positions with nonmagnetic guidance or survey evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If local steel rotates the field while near-normal magnitude conceals heading bias, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部鋼材扭轉磁場方向，總場近正常卻方位已偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local steel rotates the field while near-normal magnitude conceals heading bias. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較三軸磁場、設備位置與非磁性導向或測量證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部鋼材扭轉磁場方向，總場近正常卻方位已偏移」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare three-axis magnetic fields and equipment positions with nonmagnetic guidance or survey evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Local steel rotates the field while near-normal magnitude conceals heading bias. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較三軸磁場、設備位置與非磁性導向或測量證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部鋼材扭轉磁場方向，總場近正常卻方位已偏移，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare three-axis magnetic fields and equipment positions with nonmagnetic guidance or survey evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If local steel rotates the field while near-normal magnitude conceals heading bias, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「磁場干擾與方位可信度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Magnetic interference and heading confidence"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
比較三軸磁場、設備位置與非磁性導向或測量證據。

Many readings from one guidance instrument eliminate every systematic heading bias

quiz.explanationEn: Compare three-axis magnetic fields and equipment positions with nonmagnetic guidance or survey evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重啟後沿用舊零偏，磁場雖無影響仍產生路線漂移。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照陀螺溫度、時間戳與獨立方位閉合差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing an old bias after restart creates route drift despite freedom from magnetic interference. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare gyro temperature and timestamps with independent heading-closure error to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「陀螺漂移與時間校核」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gyro drift and time checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 重啟後沿用舊零偏，磁場雖無影響仍產生路線漂移。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
圖上的中心距大於零就代表鑽孔與設施一定不接觸
optionsEn: Reusing an old bias after restart creates route drift despite freedom from magnetic interference.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Positive centerline separation on a map guarantees bore and utility do not touch
quiz.explanation: 重啟後沿用舊零偏，磁場雖無影響仍產生路線漂移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing an old bias after restart creates route drift despite freedom from magnetic interference. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設施淨距與不確定度」與「環空輸送與孔內壓力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Utility clearance and uncertainty" and "Annular transport and bore pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設施淨距與不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Utility clearance and uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「設施淨距與不確定度」如何影響水平定向鑽掘導向的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Utility clearance and uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Horizontal directional drilling guidance”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下設施的中心線位置、外徑和調查精度都影響真正淨距，圖上中心距不是可用安全間隔。不確定度扣減需明示保守或統計規則，還要扣除兩者尺寸；未知設施不能因地圖空白就視為不存在。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐一核對設施實測位置、外徑及定位不確定度；若出現只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「設施淨距與不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: True utility clearance depends on centerline location, outside dimensions and survey uncertainty; map center distance is not available separation. State conservative or statistical uncertainty rules and subtract both object dimensions. A blank map does not establish that unknown services are absent from the route. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check surveyed utility position, outside diameter and positioning uncertainty individually. If comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Utility clearance and uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：centerDistance=sqrt((0.30 m)^2+(0.40 m)^2)=0.50 m; afterConservativeUncertainty=0.50-0.10-0.15=0.25 m before subtracting radii。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: centerDistance=sqrt((0.30 m)^2+(0.40 m)^2)=0.50 m; afterConservativeUncertainty=0.50-0.10-0.15=0.25 m before subtracting radii.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「圖上的中心距大於零就代表鑽孔與設施一定不接觸」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Positive centerline separation on a map guarantees bore and utility do not touch" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「設施淨距與不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Utility clearance and uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設施淨距與不確定度
knowledge.text: 地下設施的中心線位置、外徑和調查精度都影響真正淨距，圖上中心距不是可用安全間隔。不確定度扣減需明示保守或統計規則，還要扣除兩者尺寸；未知設施不能因地圖空白就視為不存在。
knowledge.textEn: True utility clearance depends on centerline location, outside dimensions and survey uncertainty; map center distance is not available separation. State conservative or statistical uncertainty rules and subtract both object dimensions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：圖上的中心距大於零就代表鑽孔與設施一定不接觸 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Positive centerline separation on a map guarantees bore and utility do not touch Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設施淨距與不確定度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Utility clearance and uncertainty" is correct?
options: 圖上的中心距大於零就代表鑽孔與設施一定不接觸
地下設施的中心線位置、外徑和調查精度都影響真正淨距，圖上中心距不是可用安全間隔。

optionsEn: Positive centerline separation on a map guarantees bore and utility do not touch
True utility clearance depends on centerline location, outside dimensions and survey uncertainty; map center distance is not available separation.
Normal mean annular velocity rules out every inadvertent-return risk
quiz.explanation: 地下設施的中心線位置、外徑和調查精度都影響真正淨距，圖上中心距不是可用安全間隔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: True utility clearance depends on centerline location, outside dimensions and survey uncertainty; map center distance is not available separation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設施淨距與不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Utility clearance and uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設施淨距與不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Utility clearance and uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：centerDistance=sqrt((0.30 m)^2+(0.40 m)^2)=0.50 m; afterConservativeUncertainty=0.50-0.10-0.15=0.25 m before subtracting radii。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: centerDistance=sqrt((0.30 m)^2+(0.40 m)^2)=0.50 m; afterConservativeUncertainty=0.50-0.10-0.15=0.25 m before subtracting radii. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐一核對設施實測位置、外徑及定位不確定度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check surveyed utility position, outside diameter and positioning uncertainty individually.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：centerDistance=sqrt((0.30 m)^2+(0.40 m)^2)=0.50 m; afterConservativeUncertainty=0.50-0.10-0.15=0.25 m before subtracting radii。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: centerDistance=sqrt((0.30 m)^2+(0.40 m)^2)=0.50 m; afterConservativeUncertainty=0.50-0.10-0.15=0.25 m before subtracting radii. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設施淨距與不確定度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Utility clearance and uncertainty", which statement holds?
options: 終點閉合誤差小就能證明中途所有位置都正確

Many readings from one guidance instrument eliminate every systematic heading bias

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: centerDistance=sqrt((0.30 m)^2+(0.40 m)^2)=0.50 m; afterConservativeUncertainty=0.50-0.10-0.15=0.25 m before subtracting radii. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 設施淨距與不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Utility clearance and uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「設施淨距與不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Utility clearance and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐一核對設施實測位置、外徑及定位不確定度。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check surveyed utility position, outside diameter and positioning uncertainty individually. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐一核對設施實測位置、外徑及定位不確定度列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check surveyed utility position, outside diameter and positioning uncertainty individually. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐一核對設施實測位置、外徑及定位不確定度。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check surveyed utility position, outside diameter and positioning uncertainty individually. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐一核對設施實測位置、外徑及定位不確定度列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
