Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設施淨距與不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 設施淨距與不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Utility clearance and uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「設施淨距與不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Utility clearance and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐一核對設施實測位置、外徑及定位不確定度，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「設施淨距與不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Utility clearance and uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入。
平均環空流速正常就能排除所有冒漿風險
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect.
Normal mean annular velocity rules out every inadvertent-return risk
quiz.explanation: 只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環空輸送與孔內壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Annular transport and bore pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環空輸送與孔內壓力」如何影響水平定向鑽掘導向的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Annular transport and bore pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Horizontal directional drilling guidance”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 環空流速由流量和淨流通面積決定，偏心、岩屑床與非牛頓流變會改變局部速度及壓損。平均流速不能單獨證明孔壁穩定或不會冒漿；導向紀錄需與返流及壓力資料共同解釋地層反應。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照進返流量、環空壓力及地表異常位置；若出現岩屑床縮小流路推高局部壓力，但平均環空面積仍被當固定，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環空輸送與孔內壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Annular velocity follows flow and available area, while eccentricity, cuttings beds and non-Newtonian rheology change local speed and loss. Mean velocity alone proves neither wall stability nor freedom from inadvertent returns. Interpret guidance with return-flow and pressure evidence to understand ground response. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare feed and return flow, annular pressure and locations of surface anomalies. If a cuttings bed restricts flow and raises local pressure while nominal annular area is treated as unchanged, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Annular transport and bore pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：annulusArea=pi*((0.60 m)^2-(0.40 m)^2)/4=0.1571 m2; meanVelocity=0.020 m3/s/0.1571 m2=0.1273 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: annulusArea=pi*((0.60 m)^2-(0.40 m)^2)/4=0.1571 m2; meanVelocity=0.020 m3/s/0.1571 m2=0.1273 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均環空流速正常就能排除所有冒漿風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal mean annular velocity rules out every inadvertent-return risk" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環空輸送與孔內壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Annular transport and bore pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環空輸送與孔內壓力
knowledge.text: 環空流速由流量和淨流通面積決定，偏心、岩屑床與非牛頓流變會改變局部速度及壓損。平均流速不能單獨證明孔壁穩定或不會冒漿；導向紀錄需與返流及壓力資料共同解釋地層反應。
knowledge.textEn: Annular velocity follows flow and available area, while eccentricity, cuttings beds and non-Newtonian rheology change local speed and loss. Mean velocity alone proves neither wall stability nor freedom from inadvertent returns.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均環空流速正常就能排除所有冒漿風險 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal mean annular velocity rules out every inadvertent-return risk Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環空輸送與孔內壓力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Annular transport and bore pressure" is correct?
options: 平均環空流速正常就能排除所有冒漿風險
所有管材都能用同一彈性模量估算回拖應變
環空流速由流量和淨流通面積決定，偏心、岩屑床與非牛頓流變會改變局部速度及壓損。
optionsEn: Normal mean annular velocity rules out every inadvertent-return risk
Every pipe material uses the same elastic modulus for pullback strain
Annular velocity follows flow and available area, while eccentricity, cuttings beds and non-Newtonian rheology change local speed and loss.
quiz.explanation: 環空流速由流量和淨流通面積決定，偏心、岩屑床與非牛頓流變會改變局部速度及壓損。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Annular velocity follows flow and available area, while eccentricity, cuttings beds and non-Newtonian rheology change local speed and loss. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環空輸送與孔內壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Annular transport and bore pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環空輸送與孔內壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Annular transport and bore pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：annulusArea=pi*((0.60 m)^2-(0.40 m)^2)/4=0.1571 m2; meanVelocity=0.020 m3/s/0.1571 m2=0.1273 m/s。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: annulusArea=pi*((0.60 m)^2-(0.40 m)^2)/4=0.1571 m2; meanVelocity=0.020 m3/s/0.1571 m2=0.1273 m/s. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照進返流量、環空壓力及地表異常位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare feed and return flow, annular pressure and locations of surface anomalies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 環空輸送與孔內壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Annular transport and bore pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環空輸送與孔內壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Annular transport and bore pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照進返流量、環空壓力及地表異常位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「岩屑床縮小流路推高局部壓力，但平均環空面積仍被當固定」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare feed and return flow, annular pressure and locations of surface anomalies. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A cuttings bed restricts flow and raises local pressure while nominal annular area is treated as unchanged. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照進返流量、環空壓力及地表異常位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現岩屑床縮小流路推高局部壓力，但平均環空面積仍被當固定，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare feed and return flow, annular pressure and locations of surface anomalies. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a cuttings bed restricts flow and raises local pressure while nominal annular area is treated as unchanged, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：岩屑床縮小流路推高局部壓力，但平均環空面積仍被當固定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A cuttings bed restricts flow and raises local pressure while nominal annular area is treated as unchanged. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照進返流量、環空壓力及地表異常位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「岩屑床縮小流路推高局部壓力，但平均環空面積仍被當固定」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare feed and return flow, annular pressure and locations of surface anomalies. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A cuttings bed restricts flow and raises local pressure while nominal annular area is treated as unchanged. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照進返流量、環空壓力及地表異常位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現岩屑床縮小流路推高局部壓力，但平均環空面積仍被當固定，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare feed and return flow, annular pressure and locations of surface anomalies. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a cuttings bed restricts flow and raises local pressure while nominal annular area is treated as unchanged, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環空輸送與孔內壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Annular transport and bore pressure"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare feed and return flow, annular pressure and locations of surface anomalies.
Normal total magnetic intensity guarantees completely accurate magnetic heading

steps.title: 環空輸送與孔內壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Annular transport and bore pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環空輸送與孔內壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Annular transport and bore pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 岩屑床縮小流路推高局部壓力，但平均環空面積仍被當固定。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照進返流量、環空壓力及地表異常位置，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照進返流量、環空壓力及地表異常位置；若出現岩屑床縮小流路推高局部壓力，但平均環空面積仍被當固定，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a cuttings bed restricts flow and raises local pressure while nominal annular area is treated as unchanged, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均環空流速正常就能排除所有冒漿風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal mean annular velocity rules out every inadvertent-return risk" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「回拖彎曲與軸向應變」與「竣工閉合與全線可信度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pullback bending and axial strain" and "As-built closure and route confidence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 回拖彎曲與軸向應變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pullback bending and axial strain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「回拖彎曲與軸向應變」如何影響水平定向鑽掘導向的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pullback bending and axial strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Horizontal directional drilling guidance”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 成品管沿孔道曲率彎曲，回拖張力再疊加軸向應變，最外纖維可能成為控制位置。小應變線彈性相加需使用一致材料模量，熱塑管的時間與溫度行為不能直接套鋼材；實際孔徑和摩擦仍影響回拖荷載。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能；若出現鋼管模量被錯用於塑膠管，嚴重低估實際軸向變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回拖彎曲與軸向應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The product pipe bends along bore curvature while pullback tension adds axial strain, potentially governing the outer fiber. Small-strain elastic addition requires consistent modulus; thermoplastic time and temperature behavior cannot be replaced by steel assumptions. Actual bore geometry and friction also affect pullback loading. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties. If applying steel modulus to plastic pipe substantially understates actual axial deformation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pullback bending and axial strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：elasticSteelExample: bendingStrain=D/(2*R)=0.40 m/(2*200 m)=0.001; axialStrain=20 MPa/200000 MPa=0.0001; sum=0.0011。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: elasticSteelExample: bendingStrain=D/(2*R)=0.40 m/(2*200 m)=0.001; axialStrain=20 MPa/200000 MPa=0.0001; sum=0.0011.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有管材都能用同一彈性模量估算回拖應變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every pipe material uses the same elastic modulus for pullback strain" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「回拖彎曲與軸向應變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pullback bending and axial strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 回拖彎曲與軸向應變
knowledge.text: 成品管沿孔道曲率彎曲，回拖張力再疊加軸向應變，最外纖維可能成為控制位置。小應變線彈性相加需使用一致材料模量，熱塑管的時間與溫度行為不能直接套鋼材；實際孔徑和摩擦仍影響回拖荷載。
knowledge.textEn: The product pipe bends along bore curvature while pullback tension adds axial strain, potentially governing the outer fiber. Small-strain elastic addition requires consistent modulus; thermoplastic time and temperature behavior cannot be replaced by steel assumptions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有管材都能用同一彈性模量估算回拖應變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every pipe material uses the same elastic modulus for pullback strain Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「回拖彎曲與軸向應變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pullback bending and axial strain" is correct?
options: 成品管沿孔道曲率彎曲，回拖張力再疊加軸向應變，最外纖維可能成為控制位置。
所有管材都能用同一彈性模量估算回拖應變
終點閉合誤差小就能證明中途所有位置都正確
optionsEn: The product pipe bends along bore curvature while pullback tension adds axial strain, potentially governing the outer fiber.
Every pipe material uses the same elastic modulus for pullback strain
Small endpoint closure error proves every intermediate position is correct
quiz.explanation: 成品管沿孔道曲率彎曲，回拖張力再疊加軸向應變，最外纖維可能成為控制位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The product pipe bends along bore curvature while pullback tension adds axial strain, potentially governing the outer fiber. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 回拖彎曲與軸向應變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pullback bending and axial strain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「回拖彎曲與軸向應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pullback bending and axial strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：elasticSteelExample: bendingStrain=D/(2*R)=0.40 m/(2*200 m)=0.001; axialStrain=20 MPa/200000 MPa=0.0001; sum=0.0011。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: elasticSteelExample: bendingStrain=D/(2*R)=0.40 m/(2*200 m)=0.001; axialStrain=20 MPa/200000 MPa=0.0001; sum=0.0011. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：elasticSteelExample: bendingStrain=D/(2*R)=0.40 m/(2*200 m)=0.001; axialStrain=20 MPa/200000 MPa=0.0001; sum=0.0011。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: elasticSteelExample: bendingStrain=D/(2*R)=0.40 m/(2*200 m)=0.001; axialStrain=20 MPa/200000 MPa=0.0001; sum=0.0011. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「回拖彎曲與軸向應變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pullback bending and axial strain", which statement holds?
options: 同一導向儀讀很多次就能消除所有系統性方位偏差
原創教學假設：elasticSteelExample: bendingStrain=D/(2*R)=0.40 m/(2*200 m)=0.001; axialStrain=20 MPa/200000 MPa=0.0001; sum=0.0011。
工具面偏轉角度永遠等於成孔路徑的實際轉向角
optionsEn: Many readings from one guidance instrument eliminate every systematic heading bias
Original teaching assumptions: elasticSteelExample: bendingStrain=D/(2*R)=0.40 m/(2*200 m)=0.001; axialStrain=20 MPa/200000 MPa=0.0001; sum=0.0011.
Toolface deflection always equals the actual turning angle of the bore
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：elasticSteelExample: bendingStrain=D/(2*R)=0.40 m/(2*200 m)=0.001; axialStrain=20 MPa/200000 MPa=0.0001; sum=0.0011。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: elasticSteelExample: bendingStrain=D/(2*R)=0.40 m/(2*200 m)=0.001; axialStrain=20 MPa/200000 MPa=0.0001; sum=0.0011. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 回拖彎曲與軸向應變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pullback bending and axial strain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「回拖彎曲與軸向應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pullback bending and axial strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「鋼管模量被錯用於塑膠管，嚴重低估實際軸向變形」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Applying steel modulus to plastic pipe substantially understates actual axial deformation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現鋼管模量被錯用於塑膠管，嚴重低估實際軸向變形，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If applying steel modulus to plastic pipe substantially understates actual axial deformation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鋼管模量被錯用於塑膠管，嚴重低估實際軸向變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying steel modulus to plastic pipe substantially understates actual axial deformation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「鋼管模量被錯用於塑膠管，嚴重低估實際軸向變形」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Applying steel modulus to plastic pipe substantially understates actual axial deformation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現鋼管模量被錯用於塑膠管，嚴重低估實際軸向變形，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If applying steel modulus to plastic pipe substantially understates actual axial deformation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「回拖彎曲與軸向應變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pullback bending and axial strain"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
陀螺不受磁場影響就代表永遠不會產生方位誤差
比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A gyro immune to magnetic interference never develops heading error
Compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties.
quiz.explanation: 比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 回拖彎曲與軸向應變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pullback bending and axial strain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「回拖彎曲與軸向應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pullback bending and axial strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋼管模量被錯用於塑膠管，嚴重低估實際軸向變形。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying steel modulus to plastic pipe substantially understates actual axial deformation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能；若出現鋼管模量被錯用於塑膠管，嚴重低估實際軸向變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If applying steel modulus to plastic pipe substantially understates actual axial deformation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有管材都能用同一彈性模量估算回拖應變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every pipe material uses the same elastic modulus for pullback strain" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鋼管模量被錯用於塑膠管，嚴重低估實際軸向變形。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「回拖彎曲與軸向應變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pullback bending and axial strain" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.title: 竣工閉合與全線可信度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: As-built closure and route confidence: mechanism and system paths

steps.title: 竣工閉合與全線可信度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: As-built closure and route confidence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「竣工閉合與全線可信度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “As-built closure and route confidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：endpointResidual=sqrt((0.05 m)^2+(0.03 m)^2+(0.04 m)^2)=0.0707 m。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: endpointResidual=sqrt((0.05 m)^2+(0.03 m)^2+(0.04 m)^2)=0.0707 m. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把終點閉合與中途獨立控制點及逐桿資料比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare endpoint closure with intermediate independent control points and rod-by-rod data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 竣工閉合與全線可信度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: As-built closure and route confidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「竣工閉合與全線可信度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “As-built closure and route confidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把終點閉合與中途獨立控制點及逐桿資料比對。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「中途左右偏差相互抵消，終點漂亮卻曾侵入設施走廊」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare endpoint closure with intermediate independent control points and rod-by-rod data. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Opposing intermediate errors cancel at the endpoint despite entering a utility corridor along the route. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將把終點閉合與中途獨立控制點及逐桿資料比對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現中途左右偏差相互抵消，終點漂亮卻曾侵入設施走廊，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare endpoint closure with intermediate independent control points and rod-by-rod data. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If opposing intermediate errors cancel at the endpoint despite entering a utility corridor along the route, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：中途左右偏差相互抵消，終點漂亮卻曾侵入設施走廊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Opposing intermediate errors cancel at the endpoint despite entering a utility corridor along the route. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Opposing intermediate errors cancel at the endpoint despite entering a utility corridor along the route. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

steps.title: 竣工閉合與全線可信度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: As-built closure and route confidence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「竣工閉合與全線可信度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “As-built closure and route confidence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 中途左右偏差相互抵消，終點漂亮卻曾侵入設施走廊。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把終點閉合與中途獨立控制點及逐桿資料比對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Opposing intermediate errors cancel at the endpoint despite entering a utility corridor along the route. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare endpoint closure with intermediate independent control points and rod-by-rod data to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把終點閉合與中途獨立控制點及逐桿資料比對；若出現中途左右偏差相互抵消，終點漂亮卻曾侵入設施走廊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If opposing intermediate errors cancel at the endpoint despite entering a utility corridor along the route, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「終點閉合誤差小就能證明中途所有位置都正確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small endpoint closure error proves every intermediate position is correct" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 中途左右偏差相互抵消，終點漂亮卻曾侵入設施走廊。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把終點閉合與中途獨立控制點及逐桿資料比對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「竣工閉合與全線可信度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

中途左右偏差相互抵消，終點漂亮卻曾侵入設施走廊。
鑽桿末端傾角一定等於整根鑽桿的平均傾角

Opposing intermediate errors cancel at the endpoint despite entering a utility corridor along the route.

quiz.explanationEn: Opposing intermediate errors cancel at the endpoint despite entering a utility corridor along the route. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 豎井沉井施工
summary: 本課以沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮為主線，從下沉驅動與力系平衡與側摩阻與埋深累積建立系統邊界，再把井底滲流與有效應力、位移速率與突沉辨識連到永久抗浮與階段交接。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift. It begins with Sinking drive and force equilibrium and Skin resistance and embedded depth, links Base seepage and effective stress and Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection, and ends with Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查下沉驅動與力系平衡：netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN；再獨立檢查側摩阻與埋深累積：skinResistance=tau*pi*D*depth=15 kPa*pi*10 m*20 m=9425 kN。假設側摩阻由 3500 降至 2500 kN，其餘力不變，淨向下力由 500 增至 1500 kN；三倍差值不能推成三倍下沉速度。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 將對照封底厚度、齡期、井壁接觸及分階段水頭作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Sinking drive and force equilibrium: netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN. Independently check Skin resistance and embedded depth: skinResistance=tau*pi*D*depth=15 kPa*pi*10 m*20 m=9425 kN. If assumed skin resistance falls from 3500 to 2500 kN with other forces unchanged, net downward force rises from 500 to 1500 kN; tripling imbalance does not imply triple sinking speed. The two results are not a complete design because driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. Use compare plug thickness, age, wall contact and stage-specific head as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「下沉驅動與力系平衡」與「側摩阻與埋深累積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sinking drive and force equilibrium" and "Skin resistance and embedded depth": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 下沉驅動與力系平衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sinking drive and force equilibrium: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「下沉驅動與力系平衡」如何影響豎井沉井施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sinking drive and force equilibrium” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sinking-caisson shaft construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉井自重與附加荷載提供下沉作用，浮力、側摩阻與刃腳反力則抵抗移動。各項會隨水位、接觸和土體擾動改變，靜態差值只表示假想瞬間的不平衡；突然卸阻時需要考慮動態和可控性，不能由力差直接決定施工動作。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據；若出現側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「下沉驅動與力系平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Caisson weight and surcharge drive sinking against buoyancy, skin friction and cutting-edge resistance. Water levels, contact and disturbed soil change these terms. A static difference describes a hypothetical instant, while sudden resistance loss involves dynamics and controllability; imbalance alone cannot prescribe field action. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time. If sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sinking drive and force equilibrium” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「下沉淨力為正就能唯一決定沉井的下沉速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Positive downward imbalance uniquely determines the caisson sinking velocity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「下沉驅動與力系平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sinking drive and force equilibrium”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 下沉驅動與力系平衡
knowledge.text: 沉井自重與附加荷載提供下沉作用，浮力、側摩阻與刃腳反力則抵抗移動。各項會隨水位、接觸和土體擾動改變，靜態差值只表示假想瞬間的不平衡；突然卸阻時需要考慮動態和可控性，不能由力差直接決定施工動作。
knowledge.textEn: Caisson weight and surcharge drive sinking against buoyancy, skin friction and cutting-edge resistance. Water levels, contact and disturbed soil change these terms.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：下沉淨力為正就能唯一決定沉井的下沉速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Positive downward imbalance uniquely determines the caisson sinking velocity Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「下沉驅動與力系平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sinking drive and force equilibrium" is correct?
options: 下沉淨力為正就能唯一決定沉井的下沉速度
沉井自重與附加荷載提供下沉作用，浮力、側摩阻與刃腳反力則抵抗移動。
沉井每增加一米深度都一定增加相同大小的摩阻
optionsEn: Positive downward imbalance uniquely determines the caisson sinking velocity
Caisson weight and surcharge drive sinking against buoyancy, skin friction and cutting-edge resistance.
Every added meter of sinking always adds the same skin resistance
quiz.explanation: 沉井自重與附加荷載提供下沉作用，浮力、側摩阻與刃腳反力則抵抗移動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Caisson weight and surcharge drive sinking against buoyancy, skin friction and cutting-edge resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 下沉驅動與力系平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sinking drive and force equilibrium: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「下沉驅動與力系平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sinking drive and force equilibrium” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「下沉驅動與力系平衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sinking drive and force equilibrium", which statement holds?
options: 量一側井口高程就能完整決定整座沉井傾斜
沉井沒有移動就證明周圍地層與建築都不會沉陷
原創教學假設：netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN。
optionsEn: One rim elevation fully determines the tilt of the whole caisson
An unmoving caisson proves surrounding ground and buildings cannot settle
Original teaching assumptions: netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 下沉驅動與力系平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sinking drive and force equilibrium: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「下沉驅動與力系平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sinking drive and force equilibrium” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「下沉驅動與力系平衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sinking drive and force equilibrium"?
options: 按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
封底混凝土已硬化就代表任何排水水頭都能承受
optionsEn: Compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Hardened base concrete can sustain any dewatering head without further verification
quiz.explanation: 按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 下沉驅動與力系平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sinking drive and force equilibrium: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「下沉驅動與力系平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sinking drive and force equilibrium” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據；若出現側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「下沉淨力為正就能唯一決定沉井的下沉速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Positive downward imbalance uniquely determines the caisson sinking velocity" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time to discriminate the cause. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Skin resistance and embedded depth” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sinking-caisson shaft construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井壁與地層摩阻沿周邊和深度分布，不同土層、潤滑和接觸間隙使剪應力非均勻。平均值模型可顯示埋深敏感度，但上下段可能在不同時刻動員；停沉後黏著恢復也會改變再次移動所需力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將土層分段、井壁接觸與停沉前後荷重位移對照；若出現以淺層平均摩阻推估全深，漏掉高黏著層造成懸掛，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側摩阻與埋深累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
