quiz.explanationEn: Extrapolating shallow mean friction misses a high-adhesion layer that hangs up the caisson. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「刃腳環帶與局部支承」與「井體傾斜與共同基準」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cutting-edge annulus and local support" and "Caisson tilt and shared survey datum": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 刃腳環帶與局部支承：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cutting-edge annulus and local support: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「刃腳環帶與局部支承」如何影響豎井沉井施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cutting-edge annulus and local support” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sinking-caisson shaft construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 刃腳將井體荷載傳到下方土體，理想環帶面積不等於實際均勻接觸。地層軟硬差、刃角幾何和局部掏空會使壓力集中，還可能引起井壁彎曲；平均承壓只用於檢查量級，不能定義局部挖土範圍。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變；若出現局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「刃腳環帶與局部支承」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The cutting edge transfers load into underlying soil, but its geometric annulus is not necessarily uniformly engaged. Contrasting strata, edge geometry and local voids concentrate pressure and can bend the wall. Mean bearing checks scale only and cannot define a field excavation pattern. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain. If a local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cutting-edge annulus and local support” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：annulusArea=pi*((10 m)^2-(9 m)^2)/4=14.92 m2; meanBearing=6000 kN/14.92 m2=402.1 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: annulusArea=pi*((10 m)^2-(9 m)^2)/4=14.92 m2; meanBearing=6000 kN/14.92 m2=402.1 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「刃腳平均承壓均勻就代表每個位置實際接觸均勻」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uniform assumed mean bearing proves uniform actual contact at every cutting-edge point" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「刃腳環帶與局部支承」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cutting-edge annulus and local support”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 刃腳環帶與局部支承
knowledge.text: 刃腳將井體荷載傳到下方土體，理想環帶面積不等於實際均勻接觸。地層軟硬差、刃角幾何和局部掏空會使壓力集中，還可能引起井壁彎曲；平均承壓只用於檢查量級，不能定義局部挖土範圍。
knowledge.textEn: The cutting edge transfers load into underlying soil, but its geometric annulus is not necessarily uniformly engaged. Contrasting strata, edge geometry and local voids concentrate pressure and can bend the wall.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：刃腳平均承壓均勻就代表每個位置實際接觸均勻 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uniform assumed mean bearing proves uniform actual contact at every cutting-edge point Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「刃腳環帶與局部支承」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cutting-edge annulus and local support" is correct?
options: 刃腳將井體荷載傳到下方土體，理想環帶面積不等於實際均勻接觸。
刃腳平均承壓均勻就代表每個位置實際接觸均勻
量一側井口高程就能完整決定整座沉井傾斜
optionsEn: The cutting edge transfers load into underlying soil, but its geometric annulus is not necessarily uniformly engaged.
Uniform assumed mean bearing proves uniform actual contact at every cutting-edge point
One rim elevation fully determines the tilt of the whole caisson
quiz.explanation: 刃腳將井體荷載傳到下方土體，理想環帶面積不等於實際均勻接觸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The cutting edge transfers load into underlying soil, but its geometric annulus is not necessarily uniformly engaged. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 刃腳環帶與局部支承：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cutting-edge annulus and local support: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「刃腳環帶與局部支承」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cutting-edge annulus and local support” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：annulusArea=pi*((10 m)^2-(9 m)^2)/4=14.92 m2; meanBearing=6000 kN/14.92 m2=402.1 kPa。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: annulusArea=pi*((10 m)^2-(9 m)^2)/4=14.92 m2; meanBearing=6000 kN/14.92 m2=402.1 kPa. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：annulusArea=pi*((10 m)^2-(9 m)^2)/4=14.92 m2; meanBearing=6000 kN/14.92 m2=402.1 kPa。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: annulusArea=pi*((10 m)^2-(9 m)^2)/4=14.92 m2; meanBearing=6000 kN/14.92 m2=402.1 kPa. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「刃腳環帶與局部支承」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cutting-edge annulus and local support", which statement holds?
options: 沉井沒有移動就證明周圍地層與建築都不會沉陷
原創教學假設：annulusArea=pi*((10 m)^2-(9 m)^2)/4=14.92 m2; meanBearing=6000 kN/14.92 m2=402.1 kPa。
封底混凝土已硬化就代表任何排水水頭都能承受
optionsEn: An unmoving caisson proves surrounding ground and buildings cannot settle
Original teaching assumptions: annulusArea=pi*((10 m)^2-(9 m)^2)/4=14.92 m2; meanBearing=6000 kN/14.92 m2=402.1 kPa.
Hardened base concrete can sustain any dewatering head without further verification
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：annulusArea=pi*((10 m)^2-(9 m)^2)/4=14.92 m2; meanBearing=6000 kN/14.92 m2=402.1 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: annulusArea=pi*((10 m)^2-(9 m)^2)/4=14.92 m2; meanBearing=6000 kN/14.92 m2=402.1 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 刃腳環帶與局部支承：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cutting-edge annulus and local support: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「刃腳環帶與局部支承」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cutting-edge annulus and local support” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「刃腳環帶與局部支承」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cutting-edge annulus and local support"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
施工時重量浮力比大於一就代表永久抗浮必定合格
比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A construction-stage weight ratio above one guarantees permanent uplift compliance
Compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain.
quiz.explanation: 比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 刃腳環帶與局部支承：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cutting-edge annulus and local support: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「刃腳環帶與局部支承」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cutting-edge annulus and local support” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變；若出現局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「刃腳平均承壓均勻就代表每個位置實際接觸均勻」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uniform assumed mean bearing proves uniform actual contact at every cutting-edge point" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「刃腳環帶與局部支承」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cutting-edge annulus and local support" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
量一側井口高程就能完整決定整座沉井傾斜
optionsEn: A local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
One rim elevation fully determines the tilt of the whole caisson
quiz.explanation: 局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 井體傾斜與共同基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Caisson tilt and shared survey datum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「井體傾斜與共同基準」如何影響豎井沉井施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Caisson tilt and shared survey datum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sinking-caisson shaft construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井體傾斜由對向高差與水平基線定義，單一側點下沉不能區分整體沉降與轉動。環向多點可檢查是否近似剛體，井壁彎曲或測點鬆動會破壞此假設；量測系統須與影響區外穩定基準連結。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對；若出現共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「井體傾斜與共同基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tilt follows differential elevation over a horizontal baseline, while one sinking point cannot separate translation from rotation. Circumferential points test the rigid-body assumption, which wall bending or loose targets can invalidate. Tie measurements to stable reference points outside the influence zone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure. If settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Caisson tilt and shared survey datum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：tilt=oppositeLevelDifference/diameter=0.020 m/10 m=0.002 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: tilt=oppositeLevelDifference/diameter=0.020 m/10 m=0.002 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量一側井口高程就能完整決定整座沉井傾斜」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One rim elevation fully determines the tilt of the whole caisson" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「井體傾斜與共同基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Caisson tilt and shared survey datum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 井體傾斜與共同基準
knowledge.titleEn: Caisson tilt and shared survey datum
knowledge.text: 井體傾斜由對向高差與水平基線定義，單一側點下沉不能區分整體沉降與轉動。環向多點可檢查是否近似剛體，井壁彎曲或測點鬆動會破壞此假設；量測系統須與影響區外穩定基準連結。
knowledge.textEn: Tilt follows differential elevation over a horizontal baseline, while one sinking point cannot separate translation from rotation. Circumferential points test the rigid-body assumption, which wall bending or loose targets can invalidate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量一側井口高程就能完整決定整座沉井傾斜 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One rim elevation fully determines the tilt of the whole caisson Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「井體傾斜與共同基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Caisson tilt and shared survey datum" is correct?
options: 量一側井口高程就能完整決定整座沉井傾斜
井體傾斜由對向高差與水平基線定義，單一側點下沉不能區分整體沉降與轉動。
任何土層都能用同一砂土臨界梯度判定井底穩定
optionsEn: One rim elevation fully determines the tilt of the whole caisson
Tilt follows differential elevation over a horizontal baseline, while one sinking point cannot separate translation from rotation.
One granular critical gradient determines base stability in every soil type
quiz.explanation: 井體傾斜由對向高差與水平基線定義，單一側點下沉不能區分整體沉降與轉動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tilt follows differential elevation over a horizontal baseline, while one sinking point cannot separate translation from rotation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 井體傾斜與共同基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Caisson tilt and shared survey datum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「井體傾斜與共同基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Caisson tilt and shared survey datum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：tilt=oppositeLevelDifference/diameter=0.020 m/10 m=0.002 rad。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: tilt=oppositeLevelDifference/diameter=0.020 m/10 m=0.002 rad. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：tilt=oppositeLevelDifference/diameter=0.020 m/10 m=0.002 rad。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: tilt=oppositeLevelDifference/diameter=0.020 m/10 m=0.002 rad. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「井體傾斜與共同基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Caisson tilt and shared survey datum", which statement holds?
options: 半小時平均速度低就能排除期間任何突沉事件
止水帶外觀完整就一定能承受所有接縫剪位移
原創教學假設：tilt=oppositeLevelDifference/diameter=0.020 m/10 m=0.002 rad。
optionsEn: A low half-hour average speed rules out every rapid-sinking event within it
An intact-looking waterstop withstands every possible joint shear movement
Original teaching assumptions: tilt=oppositeLevelDifference/diameter=0.020 m/10 m=0.002 rad.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：tilt=oppositeLevelDifference/diameter=0.020 m/10 m=0.002 rad。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: tilt=oppositeLevelDifference/diameter=0.020 m/10 m=0.002 rad. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 井體傾斜與共同基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Caisson tilt and shared survey datum: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「井體傾斜與共同基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Caisson tilt and shared survey datum” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「井體傾斜與共同基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Caisson tilt and shared survey datum"?
options: 以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
下沉淨力為正就能唯一決定沉井的下沉速度
optionsEn: Compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Positive downward imbalance uniquely determines the caisson sinking velocity
quiz.explanation: 以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 井體傾斜與共同基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Caisson tilt and shared survey datum: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「井體傾斜與共同基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Caisson tilt and shared survey datum” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對；若出現共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量一側井口高程就能完整決定整座沉井傾斜」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One rim elevation fully determines the tilt of the whole caisson" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「井體傾斜與共同基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Caisson tilt and shared survey datum" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤。
任何土層都能用同一砂土臨界梯度判定井底穩定
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation.
One granular critical gradient determines base stability in every soil type
quiz.explanation: 共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「井底滲流與有效應力」與「降水固結與鄰近沉陷」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Base seepage and effective stress" and "Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 井底滲流與有效應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base seepage and effective stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「井底滲流與有效應力」如何影響豎井沉井施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Base seepage and effective stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sinking-caisson shaft construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井內外水頭差沿井底滲流路徑產生梯度，向上滲流降低土體有效應力。平均路徑模型不能代表刃腳附近局部峰值，黏土不排水隆起也不是砂土臨界梯度問題；先辨識土類、方向和破壞機制再比較數值。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化；若出現向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「井底滲流與有效應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Head difference drives base seepage, and upward flow reduces effective stress. An average path misses local gradients near the cutting edge; undrained clay heave is distinct from granular critical-gradient behavior. Identify soil type, flow direction and mechanism before interpreting numerical comparisons. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage. If upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Base seepage and effective stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：upwardGradient=8 m/5 m=1.60; idealGranularCritical=(Gs-1)/(1+e)=(2.65-1)/(1+0.65)=1.00。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: upwardGradient=8 m/5 m=1.60; idealGranularCritical=(Gs-1)/(1+e)=(2.65-1)/(1+0.65)=1.00.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何土層都能用同一砂土臨界梯度判定井底穩定」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One granular critical gradient determines base stability in every soil type" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「井底滲流與有效應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Base seepage and effective stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 井底滲流與有效應力

quiz.question: 關於「井底滲流與有效應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base seepage and effective stress" is correct?
options: 任何土層都能用同一砂土臨界梯度判定井底穩定
沉井沒有移動就證明周圍地層與建築都不會沉陷
井內外水頭差沿井底滲流路徑產生梯度，向上滲流降低土體有效應力。
optionsEn: One granular critical gradient determines base stability in every soil type
An unmoving caisson proves surrounding ground and buildings cannot settle
Head difference drives base seepage, and upward flow reduces effective stress.
quiz.explanation: 井內外水頭差沿井底滲流路徑產生梯度，向上滲流降低土體有效應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Head difference drives base seepage, and upward flow reduces effective stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 井底滲流與有效應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base seepage and effective stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「井底滲流與有效應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Base seepage and effective stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：upwardGradient=8 m/5 m=1.60; idealGranularCritical=(Gs-1)/(1+e)=(2.65-1)/(1+0.65)=1.00。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: upwardGradient=8 m/5 m=1.60; idealGranularCritical=(Gs-1)/(1+e)=(2.65-1)/(1+0.65)=1.00. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：upwardGradient=8 m/5 m=1.60; idealGranularCritical=(Gs-1)/(1+e)=(2.65-1)/(1+0.65)=1.00。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: upwardGradient=8 m/5 m=1.60; idealGranularCritical=(Gs-1)/(1+e)=(2.65-1)/(1+0.65)=1.00. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「井底滲流與有效應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Base seepage and effective stress", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：upwardGradient=8 m/5 m=1.60; idealGranularCritical=(Gs-1)/(1+e)=(2.65-1)/(1+0.65)=1.00。
封底混凝土已硬化就代表任何排水水頭都能承受

Hardened base concrete can sustain any dewatering head without further verification
A construction-stage weight ratio above one guarantees permanent uplift compliance

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: upwardGradient=8 m/5 m=1.60; idealGranularCritical=(Gs-1)/(1+e)=(2.65-1)/(1+0.65)=1.00. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 井底滲流與有效應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base seepage and effective stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「井底滲流與有效應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Base seepage and effective stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「井底滲流與有效應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Base seepage and effective stress"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化。
沉井每增加一米深度都一定增加相同大小的摩阻
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage.
Every added meter of sinking always adds the same skin resistance
quiz.explanation: 對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 井底滲流與有效應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base seepage and effective stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「井底滲流與有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Base seepage and effective stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化；若出現向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何土層都能用同一砂土臨界梯度判定井底穩定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One granular critical gradient determines base stability in every soil type" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「井底滲流與有效應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base seepage and effective stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
沉井沒有移動就證明周圍地層與建築都不會沉陷
向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
An unmoving caisson proves surrounding ground and buildings cannot settle
Upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil.
quiz.explanation: 向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 降水固結與鄰近沉陷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「降水固結與鄰近沉陷」如何影響豎井沉井施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sinking-caisson shaft construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井周降水降低孔壓並提高有效應力，可能使可壓縮層固結而影響鄰近設施。線性壓縮模型只適合指定應力範圍和一維假設，實際沉陷還取決於分層、時間與降水範圍；井體本身位移不能代替周邊監測。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將周邊水位、分層壓縮及建物沉陷按時間對齊；若出現只監測井體穩定而忽略遠處降水沉陷，鄰房持續變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「降水固結與鄰近沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dewatering reduces pore pressure and increases effective stress, potentially consolidating compressible layers beneath neighboring assets. A linear model assumes a specified stress interval and one-dimensional response. Layering, time and drawdown extent control real settlement; caisson movement cannot substitute for surrounding monitoring. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Align surrounding water levels, layer compression and building settlement in time. If monitoring only caisson stability misses remote drawdown settlement and ongoing building deformation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：settlement=mv*dSigma*H=0.0001 m2/kN*100 kPa*10 m=0.10 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: settlement=mv*dSigma*H=0.0001 m2/kN*100 kPa*10 m=0.10 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沉井沒有移動就證明周圍地層與建築都不會沉陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An unmoving caisson proves surrounding ground and buildings cannot settle" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「降水固結與鄰近沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 降水固結與鄰近沉陷
knowledge.text: 井周降水降低孔壓並提高有效應力，可能使可壓縮層固結而影響鄰近設施。線性壓縮模型只適合指定應力範圍和一維假設，實際沉陷還取決於分層、時間與降水範圍；井體本身位移不能代替周邊監測。
knowledge.textEn: Dewatering reduces pore pressure and increases effective stress, potentially consolidating compressible layers beneath neighboring assets. A linear model assumes a specified stress interval and one-dimensional response.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：沉井沒有移動就證明周圍地層與建築都不會沉陷 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An unmoving caisson proves surrounding ground and buildings cannot settle Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「降水固結與鄰近沉陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement" is correct?
options: 井周降水降低孔壓並提高有效應力，可能使可壓縮層固結而影響鄰近設施。
沉井沒有移動就證明周圍地層與建築都不會沉陷
半小時平均速度低就能排除期間任何突沉事件
optionsEn: Dewatering reduces pore pressure and increases effective stress, potentially consolidating compressible layers beneath neighboring assets.
An unmoving caisson proves surrounding ground and buildings cannot settle
A low half-hour average speed rules out every rapid-sinking event within it
quiz.explanation: 井周降水降低孔壓並提高有效應力，可能使可壓縮層固結而影響鄰近設施。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dewatering reduces pore pressure and increases effective stress, potentially consolidating compressible layers beneath neighboring assets. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 降水固結與鄰近沉陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「降水固結與鄰近沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：settlement=mv*dSigma*H=0.0001 m2/kN*100 kPa*10 m=0.10 m。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: settlement=mv*dSigma*H=0.0001 m2/kN*100 kPa*10 m=0.10 m. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將周邊水位、分層壓縮及建物沉陷按時間對齊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align surrounding water levels, layer compression and building settlement in time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：settlement=mv*dSigma*H=0.0001 m2/kN*100 kPa*10 m=0.10 m。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: settlement=mv*dSigma*H=0.0001 m2/kN*100 kPa*10 m=0.10 m. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「降水固結與鄰近沉陷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement", which statement holds?
options: 止水帶外觀完整就一定能承受所有接縫剪位移
原創教學假設：settlement=mv*dSigma*H=0.0001 m2/kN*100 kPa*10 m=0.10 m。
下沉淨力為正就能唯一決定沉井的下沉速度
optionsEn: An intact-looking waterstop withstands every possible joint shear movement
Original teaching assumptions: settlement=mv*dSigma*H=0.0001 m2/kN*100 kPa*10 m=0.10 m.
Positive downward imbalance uniquely determines the caisson sinking velocity
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：settlement=mv*dSigma*H=0.0001 m2/kN*100 kPa*10 m=0.10 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: settlement=mv*dSigma*H=0.0001 m2/kN*100 kPa*10 m=0.10 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 降水固結與鄰近沉陷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「降水固結與鄰近沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將周邊水位、分層壓縮及建物沉陷按時間對齊。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只監測井體穩定而忽略遠處降水沉陷，鄰房持續變形」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align surrounding water levels, layer compression and building settlement in time. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Monitoring only caisson stability misses remote drawdown settlement and ongoing building deformation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將周邊水位、分層壓縮及建物沉陷按時間對齊列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只監測井體穩定而忽略遠處降水沉陷，鄰房持續變形，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Align surrounding water levels, layer compression and building settlement in time. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If monitoring only caisson stability misses remote drawdown settlement and ongoing building deformation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只監測井體穩定而忽略遠處降水沉陷，鄰房持續變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Monitoring only caisson stability misses remote drawdown settlement and ongoing building deformation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將周邊水位、分層壓縮及建物沉陷按時間對齊。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只監測井體穩定而忽略遠處降水沉陷，鄰房持續變形」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Align surrounding water levels, layer compression and building settlement in time. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Monitoring only caisson stability misses remote drawdown settlement and ongoing building deformation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將周邊水位、分層壓縮及建物沉陷按時間對齊列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只監測井體穩定而忽略遠處降水沉陷，鄰房持續變形，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Align surrounding water levels, layer compression and building settlement in time. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If monitoring only caisson stability misses remote drawdown settlement and ongoing building deformation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「降水固結與鄰近沉陷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
刃腳平均承壓均勻就代表每個位置實際接觸均勻
將周邊水位、分層壓縮及建物沉陷按時間對齊。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Uniform assumed mean bearing proves uniform actual contact at every cutting-edge point
Align surrounding water levels, layer compression and building settlement in time.
quiz.explanation: 將周邊水位、分層壓縮及建物沉陷按時間對齊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align surrounding water levels, layer compression and building settlement in time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 降水固結與鄰近沉陷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「降水固結與鄰近沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只監測井體穩定而忽略遠處降水沉陷，鄰房持續變形。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將周邊水位、分層壓縮及建物沉陷按時間對齊，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Monitoring only caisson stability misses remote drawdown settlement and ongoing building deformation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to align surrounding water levels, layer compression and building settlement in time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將周邊水位、分層壓縮及建物沉陷按時間對齊；若出現只監測井體穩定而忽略遠處降水沉陷，鄰房持續變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If monitoring only caisson stability misses remote drawdown settlement and ongoing building deformation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沉井沒有移動就證明周圍地層與建築都不會沉陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An unmoving caisson proves surrounding ground and buildings cannot settle" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只監測井體穩定而忽略遠處降水沉陷，鄰房持續變形。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將周邊水位、分層壓縮及建物沉陷按時間對齊，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring only caisson stability misses remote drawdown settlement and ongoing building deformation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to align surrounding water levels, layer compression and building settlement in time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「降水固結與鄰近沉陷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只監測井體穩定而忽略遠處降水沉陷，鄰房持續變形。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
半小時平均速度低就能排除期間任何突沉事件
optionsEn: Monitoring only caisson stability misses remote drawdown settlement and ongoing building deformation.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A low half-hour average speed rules out every rapid-sinking event within it
quiz.explanation: 只監測井體穩定而忽略遠處降水沉陷，鄰房持續變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Monitoring only caisson stability misses remote drawdown settlement and ongoing building deformation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「位移速率與突沉辨識」與「封底自重與水壓作用」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection" and "Base-plug weight and water-pressure action": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 位移速率與突沉辨識：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「位移速率與突沉辨識」如何影響豎井沉井施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sinking-caisson shaft construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉井移動速率需依時間解析度判讀，長時段平均會掩蓋短暫突沉。速率跳變可能來自土阻崩落，也可能是感測器或時鐘異常；應使用同步獨立資料確認，而不是由累積進尺推定整段平順。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較高頻位移、時鐘同步與獨立井口測量；若出現一分鐘突沉被半小時平均稀釋，報表看似平順，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「位移速率與突沉辨識」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 位移速率與突沉辨識：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「位移速率與突沉辨識」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：meanRate=0.12 m/0.50 h=0.24 m/h; shortEvent=0.10 m/(1/60 h)=6.0 m/h。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: meanRate=0.12 m/0.50 h=0.24 m/h; shortEvent=0.10 m/(1/60 h)=6.0 m/h. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較高頻位移、時鐘同步與獨立井口測量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare high-frequency movement, clock synchronization and independent rim surveys.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 位移速率與突沉辨識：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「位移速率與突沉辨識」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較高頻位移、時鐘同步與獨立井口測量。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「一分鐘突沉被半小時平均稀釋，報表看似平順」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare high-frequency movement, clock synchronization and independent rim surveys. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A one-minute sinking event is diluted by a half-hour average and appears smooth in reports. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較高頻位移、時鐘同步與獨立井口測量列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現一分鐘突沉被半小時平均稀釋，報表看似平順，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare high-frequency movement, clock synchronization and independent rim surveys. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a one-minute sinking event is diluted by a half-hour average and appears smooth in reports, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一分鐘突沉被半小時平均稀釋，報表看似平順。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A one-minute sinking event is diluted by a half-hour average and appears smooth in reports. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較高頻位移、時鐘同步與獨立井口測量。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「一分鐘突沉被半小時平均稀釋，報表看似平順」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare high-frequency movement, clock synchronization and independent rim surveys. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A one-minute sinking event is diluted by a half-hour average and appears smooth in reports. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較高頻位移、時鐘同步與獨立井口測量列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現一分鐘突沉被半小時平均稀釋，報表看似平順，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a one-minute sinking event is diluted by a half-hour average and appears smooth in reports, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「位移速率與突沉辨識」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

One rim elevation fully determines the tilt of the whole caisson

steps.title: 位移速率與突沉辨識：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「位移速率與突沉辨識」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一分鐘突沉被半小時平均稀釋，報表看似平順。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較高頻位移、時鐘同步與獨立井口測量，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A one-minute sinking event is diluted by a half-hour average and appears smooth in reports. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare high-frequency movement, clock synchronization and independent rim surveys to discriminate the cause. steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較高頻位移、時鐘同步與獨立井口測量；若出現一分鐘突沉被半小時平均稀釋，報表看似平順，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a one-minute sinking event is diluted by a half-hour average and appears smooth in reports, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「半小時平均速度低就能排除期間任何突沉事件」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low half-hour average speed rules out every rapid-sinking event within it" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一分鐘突沉被半小時平均稀釋，報表看似平順。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較高頻位移、時鐘同步與獨立井口測量，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

steps.title: 封底自重與水壓作用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base-plug weight and water-pressure action: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「封底自重與水壓作用」如何影響豎井沉井施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Base-plug weight and water-pressure action” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sinking-caisson shaft construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 封底承受向上水壓並把作用傳到井壁或其他核定抗浮系統，自重通常只是抵抗項之一。水下施工階段與排水後壓差不同，不能只確認混凝土厚度就判斷可轉換狀態；黏結、剪力傳遞與齡期強度另需驗證。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照封底厚度、齡期、井壁接觸及分階段水頭；若出現封底自重不足卻漏計或未證實壁面傳力，水壓使封底抬升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「封底自重與水壓作用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The base plug transfers uplift to the walls or another approved resisting system, with self-weight only one resistance component. Differential pressure changes between underwater and dewatered stages. Thickness alone cannot justify a stage change; bond, shear transfer and age-dependent strength need separate evidence. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare plug thickness, age, wall contact and stage-specific head. knowledge.title: 封底自重與水壓作用
knowledge.text: 封底承受向上水壓並把作用傳到井壁或其他核定抗浮系統，自重通常只是抵抗項之一。水下施工階段與排水後壓差不同，不能只確認混凝土厚度就判斷可轉換狀態；黏結、剪力傳遞與齡期強度另需驗證。
knowledge.textEn: The base plug transfers uplift to the walls or another approved resisting system, with self-weight only one resistance component. Differential pressure changes between underwater and dewatered stages.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：封底混凝土已硬化就代表任何排水水頭都能承受 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hardened base concrete can sustain any dewatering head without further verification Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「封底自重與水壓作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Hardened base concrete can sustain any dewatering head without further verification
An intact-looking waterstop withstands every possible joint shear movement
The base plug transfers uplift to the walls or another approved resisting system, with self-weight only one resistance component.
quiz.explanation: 封底承受向上水壓並把作用傳到井壁或其他核定抗浮系統，自重通常只是抵抗項之一。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The base plug transfers uplift to the walls or another approved resisting system, with self-weight only one resistance component. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 封底自重與水壓作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base-plug weight and water-pressure action: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「封底自重與水壓作用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Base-plug weight and water-pressure action” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：A=pi*(10 m)^2/4=78.54 m2; plugWeight=24 kN/m3*2 m*A=3770 kN; uplift=9.81 kN/m3*10 m*A=7705 kN。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: A=pi*(10 m)^2/4=78.54 m2; plugWeight=24 kN/m3*2 m*A=3770 kN; uplift=9.81 kN/m3*10 m*A=7705 kN. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照封底厚度、齡期、井壁接觸及分階段水頭。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare plug thickness, age, wall contact and stage-specific head.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 封底自重與水壓作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base-plug weight and water-pressure action: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「封底自重與水壓作用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Base-plug weight and water-pressure action” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照封底厚度、齡期、井壁接觸及分階段水頭。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「封底自重不足卻漏計或未證實壁面傳力，水壓使封底抬升」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare plug thickness, age, wall contact and stage-specific head. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Insufficient plug weight combined with unverified wall transfer permits uplift displacement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照封底厚度、齡期、井壁接觸及分階段水頭列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現封底自重不足卻漏計或未證實壁面傳力，水壓使封底抬升，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare plug thickness, age, wall contact and stage-specific head. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If insufficient plug weight combined with unverified wall transfer permits uplift displacement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：封底自重不足卻漏計或未證實壁面傳力，水壓使封底抬升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient plug weight combined with unverified wall transfer permits uplift displacement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Insufficient plug weight combined with unverified wall transfer permits uplift displacement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照封底厚度、齡期、井壁接觸及分階段水頭列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現封底自重不足卻漏計或未證實壁面傳力，水壓使封底抬升，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare plug thickness, age, wall contact and stage-specific head.
One granular critical gradient determines base stability in every soil type
