steps.title: 封底自重與水壓作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base-plug weight and water-pressure action: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「封底自重與水壓作用」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Base-plug weight and water-pressure action” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 封底自重不足卻漏計或未證實壁面傳力，水壓使封底抬升。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照封底厚度、齡期、井壁接觸及分階段水頭，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient plug weight combined with unverified wall transfer permits uplift displacement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare plug thickness, age, wall contact and stage-specific head to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照封底厚度、齡期、井壁接觸及分階段水頭；若出現封底自重不足卻漏計或未證實壁面傳力，水壓使封底抬升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If insufficient plug weight combined with unverified wall transfer permits uplift displacement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「封底混凝土已硬化就代表任何排水水頭都能承受」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hardened base concrete can sustain any dewatering head without further verification" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 封底自重不足卻漏計或未證實壁面傳力，水壓使封底抬升。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照封底厚度、齡期、井壁接觸及分階段水頭，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare plug thickness, age, wall contact and stage-specific head to discriminate the cause. knowledge.title: 根因確認

quiz.question: 在「封底自重與水壓作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base-plug weight and water-pressure action" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

止水帶外觀完整就一定能承受所有接縫剪位移
封底自重不足卻漏計或未證實壁面傳力，水壓使封底抬升。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
An intact-looking waterstop withstands every possible joint shear movement
Insufficient plug weight combined with unverified wall transfer permits uplift displacement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接縫水密與相對位移」與「永久抗浮與階段交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint tightness and relative movement" and "Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接縫水密與相對位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint tightness and relative movement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接縫水密與相對位移」如何影響豎井沉井施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint tightness and relative movement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sinking-caisson shaft construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井壁節段與封底交界可能在下沉、固結和溫度變化時產生相對位移，止水材料需要對應開度與剪切。幾何應變只是形變指標，不能代替產品的循環、黏結或老化試驗；漏點位置還可能是水沿界面遷移後的出口。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較接縫開度、剪位移及滲水位置的時間關係；若出現只檢查張開而漏掉剪切損傷，止水帶外觀完整仍滲漏，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接縫水密與相對位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wall segments and base interfaces move during sinking, consolidation and temperature changes, requiring seals suited to opening and shear. Geometric strain is a deformation indicator, not a substitute for cyclic, bond or aging tests. A visible leak may be an outlet after migration along an interface. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare the timing of joint opening, shear movement and leakage locations. If checking only opening misses shear damage and leakage despite an intact-looking waterstop, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint tightness and relative movement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 接縫水密與相對位移
knowledge.text: 井壁節段與封底交界可能在下沉、固結和溫度變化時產生相對位移，止水材料需要對應開度與剪切。幾何應變只是形變指標，不能代替產品的循環、黏結或老化試驗；漏點位置還可能是水沿界面遷移後的出口。
knowledge.textEn: Wall segments and base interfaces move during sinking, consolidation and temperature changes, requiring seals suited to opening and shear. Geometric strain is a deformation indicator, not a substitute for cyclic, bond or aging tests.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：止水帶外觀完整就一定能承受所有接縫剪位移 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An intact-looking waterstop withstands every possible joint shear movement Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接縫水密與相對位移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint tightness and relative movement" is correct?
options: 井壁節段與封底交界可能在下沉、固結和溫度變化時產生相對位移，止水材料需要對應開度與剪切。
止水帶外觀完整就一定能承受所有接縫剪位移
施工時重量浮力比大於一就代表永久抗浮必定合格
optionsEn: Wall segments and base interfaces move during sinking, consolidation and temperature changes, requiring seals suited to opening and shear.
An intact-looking waterstop withstands every possible joint shear movement
A construction-stage weight ratio above one guarantees permanent uplift compliance
quiz.explanation: 井壁節段與封底交界可能在下沉、固結和溫度變化時產生相對位移，止水材料需要對應開度與剪切。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wall segments and base interfaces move during sinking, consolidation and temperature changes, requiring seals suited to opening and shear. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接縫水密與相對位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint tightness and relative movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接縫水密與相對位移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint tightness and relative movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：nominalSealStrain=jointOpening/sealGauge=2 mm/20 mm=0.10=10 percent。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: nominalSealStrain=jointOpening/sealGauge=2 mm/20 mm=0.10=10 percent. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較接縫開度、剪位移及滲水位置的時間關係。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the timing of joint opening, shear movement and leakage locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 接縫水密與相對位移：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接縫水密與相對位移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint tightness and relative movement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較接縫開度、剪位移及滲水位置的時間關係。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只檢查張開而漏掉剪切損傷，止水帶外觀完整仍滲漏」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the timing of joint opening, shear movement and leakage locations. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Checking only opening misses shear damage and leakage despite an intact-looking waterstop. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較接縫開度、剪位移及滲水位置的時間關係列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只檢查張開而漏掉剪切損傷，止水帶外觀完整仍滲漏，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare the timing of joint opening, shear movement and leakage locations. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If checking only opening misses shear damage and leakage despite an intact-looking waterstop, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只檢查張開而漏掉剪切損傷，止水帶外觀完整仍滲漏。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only opening misses shear damage and leakage despite an intact-looking waterstop. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較接縫開度、剪位移及滲水位置的時間關係。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只檢查張開而漏掉剪切損傷，止水帶外觀完整仍滲漏」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare the timing of joint opening, shear movement and leakage locations. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Checking only opening misses shear damage and leakage despite an intact-looking waterstop. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.text: 將比較接縫開度、剪位移及滲水位置的時間關係列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只檢查張開而漏掉剪切損傷，止水帶外觀完整仍滲漏，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

An unmoving caisson proves surrounding ground and buildings cannot settle
Compare the timing of joint opening, shear movement and leakage locations.

steps.title: 接縫水密與相對位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint tightness and relative movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接縫水密與相對位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint tightness and relative movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只檢查張開而漏掉剪切損傷，止水帶外觀完整仍滲漏。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較接縫開度、剪位移及滲水位置的時間關係，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only opening misses shear damage and leakage despite an intact-looking waterstop. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare the timing of joint opening, shear movement and leakage locations to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較接縫開度、剪位移及滲水位置的時間關係；若出現只檢查張開而漏掉剪切損傷，止水帶外觀完整仍滲漏，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If checking only opening misses shear damage and leakage despite an intact-looking waterstop, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「止水帶外觀完整就一定能承受所有接縫剪位移」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An intact-looking waterstop withstands every possible joint shear movement" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只檢查張開而漏掉剪切損傷，止水帶外觀完整仍滲漏。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較接縫開度、剪位移及滲水位置的時間關係，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接縫水密與相對位移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 永久抗浮與階段交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「永久抗浮與階段交接」如何影響豎井沉井施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sinking-caisson shaft construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉井作為永久豎井後，抗浮依賴最終重量、結構連接及設計水位，施工臨時壓重不能自動列為永久抵抗。重量與浮力比只是未分項平衡，規範組合、耐久和連接強度另行要求；交接需明確哪些抵抗已實際形成。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本；若出現移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「永久抗浮與階段交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: As a permanent shaft, uplift resistance depends on final weight, structural connections and design water level. Temporary ballast is not automatically permanent resistance. A raw weight-to-buoyancy ratio omits code combinations, durability and connection checks; handover must identify which resisting mechanisms are actually established. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item. If removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：buoyancy=9.81 kN/m3*1000 m3=9810 kN; rawWeightRatio=12000 kN/9810 kN=1.223。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: buoyancy=9.81 kN/m3*1000 m3=9810 kN; rawWeightRatio=12000 kN/9810 kN=1.223.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工時重量浮力比大於一就代表永久抗浮必定合格」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A construction-stage weight ratio above one guarantees permanent uplift compliance" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「永久抗浮與階段交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 永久抗浮與階段交接
knowledge.titleEn: Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover
knowledge.text: 沉井作為永久豎井後，抗浮依賴最終重量、結構連接及設計水位，施工臨時壓重不能自動列為永久抵抗。重量與浮力比只是未分項平衡，規範組合、耐久和連接強度另行要求；交接需明確哪些抵抗已實際形成。
knowledge.textEn: As a permanent shaft, uplift resistance depends on final weight, structural connections and design water level. Temporary ballast is not automatically permanent resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工時重量浮力比大於一就代表永久抗浮必定合格 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A construction-stage weight ratio above one guarantees permanent uplift compliance Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「永久抗浮與階段交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover" is correct?
options: 施工時重量浮力比大於一就代表永久抗浮必定合格
沉井作為永久豎井後，抗浮依賴最終重量、結構連接及設計水位，施工臨時壓重不能自動列為永久抵抗。
下沉淨力為正就能唯一決定沉井的下沉速度
optionsEn: A construction-stage weight ratio above one guarantees permanent uplift compliance
As a permanent shaft, uplift resistance depends on final weight, structural connections and design water level.
Positive downward imbalance uniquely determines the caisson sinking velocity
quiz.explanation: 沉井作為永久豎井後，抗浮依賴最終重量、結構連接及設計水位，施工臨時壓重不能自動列為永久抵抗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: As a permanent shaft, uplift resistance depends on final weight, structural connections and design water level. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 永久抗浮與階段交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「永久抗浮與階段交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：buoyancy=9.81 kN/m3*1000 m3=9810 kN; rawWeightRatio=12000 kN/9810 kN=1.223。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: buoyancy=9.81 kN/m3*1000 m3=9810 kN; rawWeightRatio=12000 kN/9810 kN=1.223. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：buoyancy=9.81 kN/m3*1000 m3=9810 kN; rawWeightRatio=12000 kN/9810 kN=1.223。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: buoyancy=9.81 kN/m3*1000 m3=9810 kN; rawWeightRatio=12000 kN/9810 kN=1.223. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「永久抗浮與階段交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover", which statement holds?
options: 刃腳平均承壓均勻就代表每個位置實際接觸均勻
任何土層都能用同一砂土臨界梯度判定井底穩定
原創教學假設：buoyancy=9.81 kN/m3*1000 m3=9810 kN; rawWeightRatio=12000 kN/9810 kN=1.223。
optionsEn: Uniform assumed mean bearing proves uniform actual contact at every cutting-edge point
One granular critical gradient determines base stability in every soil type
Original teaching assumptions: buoyancy=9.81 kN/m3*1000 m3=9810 kN; rawWeightRatio=12000 kN/9810 kN=1.223.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：buoyancy=9.81 kN/m3*1000 m3=9810 kN; rawWeightRatio=12000 kN/9810 kN=1.223。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: buoyancy=9.81 kN/m3*1000 m3=9810 kN; rawWeightRatio=12000 kN/9810 kN=1.223. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 永久抗浮與階段交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「永久抗浮與階段交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「永久抗浮與階段交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover"?
options: 逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
半小時平均速度低就能排除期間任何突沉事件
optionsEn: Verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A low half-hour average speed rules out every rapid-sinking event within it
quiz.explanation: 逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 永久抗浮與階段交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「永久抗浮與階段交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本；若出現移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工時重量浮力比大於一就代表永久抗浮必定合格」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A construction-stage weight ratio above one guarantees permanent uplift compliance" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「永久抗浮與階段交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足。
下沉淨力為正就能唯一決定沉井的下沉速度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance.
Positive downward imbalance uniquely determines the caisson sinking velocity
quiz.explanation: 移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 深豎井襯砌施工
summary: 深豎井襯砌同時受到地層卸載、地下水、施工分段與長期材料變形影響。本課從有效應力及環向受壓開始，逐步區分厚壁分析、垂直承載、止水細部及背填空隙造成的彎曲，最後建立水位回復與裂縫變化的交接證據。
summaryEn: Deep-shaft linings respond to ground unloading, groundwater, construction lifts and long-term material deformation. The course separates effective stress and ring compression from thick-wall analysis, vertical load transfer, waterstop behaviour and bending over backfill voids, then builds evidence for groundwater recovery and crack monitoring.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：同一方向總應力假設為900 kPa，孔隙水壓為300 kPa，骨架有效應力為σ′=900−300=600 kPa。若只把孔壓提高10%至330 kPa，而總應力保持不變，σ′變為570 kPa，降低30 kPa亦即5%。這個比較只適用於相同位置、方向及總應力邊界；它不表示襯砌所受外水壓減少，相反水壓需求可能增加。工程師應分別把骨架強度與襯砌水壓作用帶回各自模型，並用分層水壓資料確認假設。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume total stress of 900 kPa and pore pressure of 300 kPa in the same direction, giving skeleton effective stress σ′=900−300=600 kPa. Increase only pore pressure by 10% to 330 kPa while holding total stress fixed: σ′ becomes 570 kPa, a reduction of 30 kPa or 5%. This comparison requires the same location, direction and total-stress boundary. It does not reduce external water pressure on the lining; hydraulic demand may instead rise. Check skeleton strength and lining pressure in their respective models and verify the assumptions using aquifer-specific piezometer data.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「有效應力的機理與驗證」與「環向壓力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective stress mechanism and verification" and "Hoop compression mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 有效應力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective stress mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效應力」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開挖降低井壁側向拘束，土骨架與孔隙水卻不是同一條荷載路徑。有效應力決定摩擦強度及變形，水壓另對不透水襯砌施力；因此從總應力扣去孔壓後，不能在襯砌設計中再把水力作用刪除。施工抽水與長期回復需分成不同階段，並核對應力方向及量測深度是否一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation removes lateral confinement, but the soil skeleton and pore water follow different load paths. Effective stress controls frictional strength and deformation while water pressure also acts on an impermeable lining. Subtracting pore pressure from total stress therefore does not eliminate hydraulic loading on the lining. Temporary drawdown and long-term recovery require separate stages, with consistent stress directions and measurement depths. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：同一方向總應力 σ=900 kPa、孔壓 u=300 kPa，σ′=σ−u=600 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=900 kPa and pore pressure u=300 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=600 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效應力的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 開挖降低井壁側向拘束，土骨架與孔隙水卻不是同一條荷載路徑。有效應力決定摩擦強度及變形，水壓另對不透水襯砌施力；因此從總應力扣去孔壓後，不能在襯砌設計中再把水力作用刪除。
knowledge.textEn: Excavation removes lateral confinement, but the soil skeleton and pore water follow different load paths. Effective stress controls frictional strength and deformation while water pressure also acts on an impermeable lining.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有效應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective stress mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。
開挖降低井壁側向拘束，土骨架與孔隙水卻不是同一條荷載路徑。
平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。
optionsEn: A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored.
Excavation removes lateral confinement, but the soil skeleton and pore water follow different load paths.
A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking.
quiz.explanation: 開挖降低井壁側向拘束，土骨架與孔隙水卻不是同一條荷載路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Excavation removes lateral confinement, but the soil skeleton and pore water follow different load paths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效應力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective stress mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：同一方向總應力 σ=900 kPa、孔壓 u=300 kPa，σ′=σ−u=600 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=900 kPa and pore pressure u=300 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=600 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將分層水壓計與地質剖面對齊，先查高程基準及濾管所在含水層，再比較停抽前後孔壓。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align multilevel piezometers with the geological section, checking elevation datum and screened aquifer before comparing pressures before and after pumping stops.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：同一方向總應力 σ=900 kPa、孔壓 u=300 kPa，σ′=σ−u=600 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=900 kPa and pore pressure u=300 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=600 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效應力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective stress mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 最終襯砌足夠強就代表每個施工階段也足夠強。
降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。
原創教學假設：同一方向總應力 σ=900 kPa、孔壓 u=300 kPa，σ′=σ−u=600 kPa。
optionsEn: Adequate completed-lining strength guarantees adequate strength at every construction stage.
Reducing peak concrete temperature alone eliminates all early restraint cracking.
Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=900 kPa and pore pressure u=300 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=600 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：同一方向總應力 σ=900 kPa、孔壓 u=300 kPa，σ′=σ−u=600 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=900 kPa and pore pressure u=300 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=600 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 有效應力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective stress mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將分層水壓計與地質剖面對齊，先查高程基準及濾管所在含水層，再比較停抽前後孔壓。以地層參數及施工階段推估骨架應力，分別保留總應力與有效應力欄，避免同名數值混用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align multilevel piezometers with the geological section, checking elevation datum and screened aquifer before comparing pressures before and after pumping stops. Infer skeleton stress using ground parameters and construction stage, retaining separate total and effective stress columns to prevent substitution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計圖應同時列出施工低水位、設計高水位與排水失效情境；襯砌封閉前，由地工與結構設計者共同確認各階段採用的水壓邊界。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Show construction drawdown, design high water and drainage failure on the design basis; before lining closure, the geotechnical and structural designers must jointly confirm hydraulic boundaries for each stage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把有效應力當成襯砌全部外壓，停抽後可能出現未預期裂縫及滲水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating effective stress as the entire lining pressure can produce unexpected cracking and leakage after pumping stops. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將分層水壓計與地質剖面對齊，先查高程基準及濾管所在含水層，再比較停抽前後孔壓。以地層參數及施工階段推估骨架應力，分別保留總應力與有效應力欄，避免同名數值混用。
knowledge.textEn: Align multilevel piezometers with the geological section, checking elevation datum and screened aquifer before comparing pressures before and after pumping stops. Infer skeleton stress using ground parameters and construction stage, retaining separate total and effective stress columns to prevent substitution.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計圖應同時列出施工低水位、設計高水位與排水失效情境；襯砌封閉前，由地工與結構設計者共同確認各階段採用的水壓邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Show construction drawdown, design high water and drainage failure on the design basis; before lining closure, the geotechnical and structural designers must jointly confirm hydraulic boundaries for each stage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「有效應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective stress mechanism and verification"?
options: 將分層水壓計與地質剖面對齊，先查高程基準及濾管所在含水層，再比較停抽前後孔壓。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
保護層只影響耐久性，不會影響截面內力與裂縫。
optionsEn: Align multilevel piezometers with the geological section, checking elevation datum and screened aquifer before comparing pressures before and after pumping stops.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Concrete cover affects durability but never section forces or cracking.
quiz.explanation: 將分層水壓計與地質剖面對齊，先查高程基準及濾管所在含水層，再比較停抽前後孔壓。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align multilevel piezometers with the geological section, checking elevation datum and screened aquifer before comparing pressures before and after pumping stops. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 有效應力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective stress mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把有效應力當成襯砌全部外壓，停抽後可能出現未預期裂縫及滲水。水位回升而井內仍乾燥時，壓差會增大，排水暢通的施工觀察不足以證明永久水密安全。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating effective stress as the entire lining pressure can produce unexpected cracking and leakage after pumping stops. Rising external water levels increase differential pressure around a dry shaft; successful construction drainage does not establish permanent watertightness. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工抽水與長期回復需分成不同階段，並核對應力方向及量測深度是否一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Temporary drawdown and long-term recovery require separate stages, with consistent stress directions and measurement depths.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把有效應力當成襯砌全部外壓，停抽後可能出現未預期裂縫及滲水。水位回升而井內仍乾燥時，壓差會增大，排水暢通的施工觀察不足以證明永久水密安全。
knowledge.textEn: Treating effective stress as the entire lining pressure can produce unexpected cracking and leakage after pumping stops. Rising external water levels increase differential pressure around a dry shaft; successful construction drainage does not establish permanent watertightness.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「有效應力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective stress mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把有效應力當成襯砌全部外壓，停抽後可能出現未預期裂縫及滲水。
平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating effective stress as the entire lining pressure can produce unexpected cracking and leakage after pumping stops.
A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking.
quiz.explanation: 若把有效應力當成襯砌全部外壓，停抽後可能出現未預期裂縫及滲水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating effective stress as the entire lining pressure can produce unexpected cracking and leakage after pumping stops. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環向壓力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hoop compression mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環向壓力」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圓形襯砌可把近似均勻徑向外壓轉成環向壓力，這是圓井結構效率的來源。薄環模型假設厚度相對半徑小、斷面圓整且受壓連續；局部井口、設備孔洞或不均勻岩壓會破壞此假設。環向壓力只能描述平均膜力，不能替代偏心、裂縫、接縫轉動與局部彎矩的檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環向壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A circular lining converts approximately uniform radial pressure into hoop compression, explaining the efficiency of a round shaft. The thin-ring model assumes a relatively small thickness, a circular section and continuous compression. Openings, penetrations and nonuniform rock loading violate these assumptions. Hoop force describes average membrane action, but it cannot replace checks of eccentricity, cracking, joint rotation or local bending where the load path is interrupted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：外壓 p=0.4 MPa、半徑 R=4 m、厚度 t=0.5 m，N=pR=1.6 MN/m，平均 σ=N/t=3.2 MPa；本厚徑比須再以厚壁或數值模型檢查。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With p=0.4 MPa, R=4 m and t=0.5 m, N=pR=1.6 MN/m and mean σ=N/t=3.2 MPa; this thickness ratio also requires a thick-wall or numerical check.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環向壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向壓力的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 圓形襯砌可把近似均勻徑向外壓轉成環向壓力，這是圓井結構效率的來源。薄環模型假設厚度相對半徑小、斷面圓整且受壓連續；局部井口、設備孔洞或不均勻岩壓會破壞此假設。
knowledge.textEn: A circular lining converts approximately uniform radial pressure into hoop compression, explaining the efficiency of a round shaft. The thin-ring model assumes a relatively small thickness, a circular section and continuous compression.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向壓力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hoop compression mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。
厚壁圓筒內外表面的環向應力必定相同。
圓形襯砌可把近似均勻徑向外壓轉成環向壓力，這是圓井結構效率的來源。
optionsEn: A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking.
Hoop stress must be identical at both surfaces of a thick cylinder.
A circular lining converts approximately uniform radial pressure into hoop compression, explaining the efficiency of a round shaft.
quiz.explanation: 圓形襯砌可把近似均勻徑向外壓轉成環向壓力，這是圓井結構效率的來源。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A circular lining converts approximately uniform radial pressure into hoop compression, explaining the efficiency of a round shaft. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向壓力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hoop compression mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環向壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：外壓 p=0.4 MPa、半徑 R=4 m、厚度 t=0.5 m，N=pR=1.6 MN/m，平均 σ=N/t=3.2 MPa；本厚徑比須再以厚壁或數值模型檢查。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: With p=0.4 MPa, R=4 m and t=0.5 m, N=pR=1.6 MN/m and mean σ=N/t=3.2 MPa; this thickness ratio also requires a thick-wall or numerical check. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用全站儀或掃描取得井徑與橢圓度，將實測斷面放回環分析；對孔洞兩側及地層轉換處配置成對應變計，比較內外表面的差值，判別平均壓力以外的彎曲是否正在增加。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey diameter and ovality and insert the measured section into ring analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：外壓 p=0.4 MPa、半徑 R=4 m、厚度 t=0.5 m，N=pR=1.6 MN/m，平均 σ=N/t=3.2 MPa；本厚徑比須再以厚壁或數值模型檢查。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: With p=0.4 MPa, R=4 m and t=0.5 m, N=pR=1.6 MN/m and mean σ=N/t=3.2 MPa; this thickness ratio also requires a thick-wall or numerical check. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環向壓力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hoop compression mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：外壓 p=0.4 MPa、半徑 R=4 m、厚度 t=0.5 m，N=pR=1.6 MN/m，平均 σ=N/t=3.2 MPa。
止水材料耐水壓合格就表示整條施工縫一定水密。
灌入的漿量越多就代表襯砌外側接觸越完整。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: With p=0.4 MPa, R=4 m and t=0.5 m, N=pR=1.6 MN/m and mean σ=N/t=3.2 MPa.
A waterstop material pressure rating guarantees a watertight constructed joint.
More injected grout necessarily means more complete lining contact.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：外壓 p=0.4 MPa、半徑 R=4 m、厚度 t=0.5 m，N=pR=1.6 MN/m，平均 σ=N/t=3.2 MPa；本厚徑比須再以厚壁或數值模型檢查。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: With p=0.4 MPa, R=4 m and t=0.5 m, N=pR=1.6 MN/m and mean σ=N/t=3.2 MPa; this thickness ratio also requires a thick-wall or numerical check. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環向壓力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hoop compression mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環向壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hoop compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用全站儀或掃描取得井徑與橢圓度，將實測斷面放回環分析；對孔洞兩側及地層轉換處配置成對應變計，比較內外表面的差值，判別平均壓力以外的彎曲是否正在增加。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey diameter and ovality and insert the measured section into ring analysis. Use paired strain gauges across openings and geological transitions; differences between inner and outer surface readings distinguish increasing local bending from average membrane compression. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將圓整度偏差、洞口加勁與背填驗收列為同一設計檢查；任何設備開孔變更，須經結構設計者確認環向力如何繞過開口後才施工。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Review ovality tolerances, opening reinforcement and backfill acceptance together; any revised service penetration requires the structural designer to confirm how hoop force bypasses the opening before construction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：偏心外壓或背填不實使圓環局部受彎，平均壓應力低仍可能在內緣形成拉裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Eccentric pressure or incomplete backfill bends the ring locally, allowing inner-face tension even at low mean compressive stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用全站儀或掃描取得井徑與橢圓度，將實測斷面放回環分析；對孔洞兩側及地層轉換處配置成對應變計，比較內外表面的差值，判別平均壓力以外的彎曲是否正在增加。
knowledge.textEn: Survey diameter and ovality and insert the measured section into ring analysis. Use paired strain gauges across openings and geological transitions; differences between inner and outer surface readings distinguish increasing local bending from average membrane compression.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將圓整度偏差、洞口加勁與背填驗收列為同一設計檢查；任何設備開孔變更，須經結構設計者確認環向力如何繞過開口後才施工。
knowledge.textEn: Review ovality tolerances, opening reinforcement and backfill acceptance together; any revised service penetration requires the structural designer to confirm how hoop force bypasses the opening before construction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環向壓力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hoop compression mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用全站儀或掃描取得井徑與橢圓度，將實測斷面放回環分析；對孔洞兩側及地層轉換處配置成對應變計，比較內外表面的差值，判別平均壓力以外的彎曲是否正在增加。
有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Survey diameter and ovality and insert the measured section into ring analysis.
Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released.
quiz.explanation: 用全站儀或掃描取得井徑與橢圓度，將實測斷面放回環分析；對孔洞兩側及地層轉換處配置成對應變計，比較內外表面的差值，判別平均壓力以外的彎曲是否正在增加。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey diameter and ovality and insert the measured section into ring analysis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環向壓力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hoop compression mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環向壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 偏心外壓或背填不實使圓環局部受彎，平均壓應力低仍可能在內緣形成拉裂。裂縫集中於開口角隅時，應追查力流中斷，不能只靠提高混凝土抗壓強度處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Eccentric pressure or incomplete backfill bends the ring locally, allowing inner-face tension even at low mean compressive stress. Cracks concentrated at opening corners indicate interrupted load paths that stronger concrete alone will not resolve. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：環向壓力只能描述平均膜力，不能替代偏心、裂縫、接縫轉動與局部彎矩的檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hoop force describes average membrane action, but it cannot replace checks of eccentricity, cracking, joint rotation or local bending where the load path is interrupted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 偏心外壓或背填不實使圓環局部受彎，平均壓應力低仍可能在內緣形成拉裂。裂縫集中於開口角隅時，應追查力流中斷，不能只靠提高混凝土抗壓強度處理。
knowledge.textEn: Eccentric pressure or incomplete backfill bends the ring locally, allowing inner-face tension even at low mean compressive stress. Cracks concentrated at opening corners indicate interrupted load paths that stronger concrete alone will not resolve.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環向壓力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hoop compression mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
厚壁圓筒內外表面的環向應力必定相同。
偏心外壓或背填不實使圓環局部受彎，平均壓應力低仍可能在內緣形成拉裂。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Hoop stress must be identical at both surfaces of a thick cylinder.
Eccentric pressure or incomplete backfill bends the ring locally, allowing inner-face tension even at low mean compressive stress.
quiz.explanation: 偏心外壓或背填不實使圓環局部受彎，平均壓應力低仍可能在內緣形成拉裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Eccentric pressure or incomplete backfill bends the ring locally, allowing inner-face tension even at low mean compressive stress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「厚壁內緣的機理與驗證」與「分段自重的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thick-wall inner face mechanism and verification" and "Lift self-weight mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 厚壁內緣的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thick-wall inner face mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「厚壁內緣」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thick-wall inner face” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 襯砌較厚時，環向應力沿半徑並不均勻；以整個厚度平均值評估內緣會漏掉應力集中。拉梅解把內外表面的徑向壓力邊界同時納入，適用於均質彈性圓筒的軸對稱狀態。分塊接縫、開裂及非均勻地層作用會改變剛度與接觸，須另用含接縫的模型判讀，不能把解析解當成完整承載能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「厚壁內緣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a thick lining, hoop stress varies across the radius, so an average stress can miss the inner-face concentration. The Lamé solution enforces radial-pressure boundaries at both surfaces and applies to a homogeneous elastic cylinder under axisymmetric loading. Segment joints, cracking and uneven ground alter stiffness and contact. They require separate joint-sensitive analysis; the elastic solution estimates a stress distribution rather than a complete structural resistance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thick-wall inner face” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：內半徑 a=4 m、外半徑 b=5 m、均勻外壓 p=0.4 MPa且內壓為零，σθ(a)=−2pb²/(b²−a²)=−2.22 MPa，負號代表受壓。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For a=4 m, b=5 m, external p=0.4 MPa and zero internal pressure, σθ(a)=−2pb²/(b²−a²)=−2.22 MPa, with compression negative.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「厚壁圓筒內外表面的環向應力必定相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hoop stress must be identical at both surfaces of a thick cylinder." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「厚壁內緣」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thick-wall inner face”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 厚壁內緣的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Thick-wall inner face mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 襯砌較厚時，環向應力沿半徑並不均勻；以整個厚度平均值評估內緣會漏掉應力集中。拉梅解把內外表面的徑向壓力邊界同時納入，適用於均質彈性圓筒的軸對稱狀態。
knowledge.textEn: In a thick lining, hoop stress varies across the radius, so an average stress can miss the inner-face concentration. The Lamé solution enforces radial-pressure boundaries at both surfaces and applies to a homogeneous elastic cylinder under axisymmetric loading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：厚壁圓筒內外表面的環向應力必定相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hoop stress must be identical at both surfaces of a thick cylinder. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「厚壁內緣的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thick-wall inner face mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 襯砌較厚時，環向應力沿半徑並不均勻；以整個厚度平均值評估內緣會漏掉應力集中。
厚壁圓筒內外表面的環向應力必定相同。
最終襯砌足夠強就代表每個施工階段也足夠強。
optionsEn: In a thick lining, hoop stress varies across the radius, so an average stress can miss the inner-face concentration.
Hoop stress must be identical at both surfaces of a thick cylinder.
Adequate completed-lining strength guarantees adequate strength at every construction stage.
quiz.explanation: 襯砌較厚時，環向應力沿半徑並不均勻；以整個厚度平均值評估內緣會漏掉應力集中。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a thick lining, hoop stress varies across the radius, so an average stress can miss the inner-face concentration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「厚壁內緣」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：內半徑 a=4 m、外半徑 b=5 m、均勻外壓 p=0.4 MPa且內壓為零，σθ(a)=−2pb²/(b²−a²)=−2.22 MPa，負號代表受壓。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For a=4 m, b=5 m, external p=0.4 MPa and zero internal pressure, σθ(a)=−2pb²/(b²−a²)=−2.22 MPa, with compression negative. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate the analytical solution from measured radii and boundary pressures, then check mesh convergence in an axisymmetric model and model openings separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 厚壁內緣的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thick-wall inner face mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「厚壁內緣」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thick-wall inner face” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先以內外半徑及壓力邊界重算解析解，再用軸對稱模型查網格收斂；對開口附近另建局部模型。把不同位置的應變量測換成同一溫度基準，核對徑向分布是否符合完整接觸假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate the analytical solution from measured radii and boundary pressures, then check mesh convergence in an axisymmetric model and model openings separately. Temperature-correct strain readings at different radii and compare their distribution with the assumed continuous contact. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：計算書應標出壓力正負號、內外半徑及接觸範圍；以解析解校驗數值模型後，才由結構設計者核准加入孔洞和接縫的工程模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label pressure signs, radii and contact extent in the calculation; use the analytical solution to verify the numerical model before the structural designer approves the engineering model with openings and joints.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將外徑誤當半徑或忽略內壓，會使厚壁應力分布與實際邊界不符。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using diameter as radius or omitting internal pressure corrupts the boundary solution. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Temperature-correct strain readings at different radii and compare their distribution with the assumed continuous contact.

quiz.question: 要驗證「厚壁內緣的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thick-wall inner face mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。
先以內外半徑及壓力邊界重算解析解，再用軸對稱模型查網格收斂；對開口附近另建局部模型。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A crack below one fixed width never needs further investigation.
Recalculate the analytical solution from measured radii and boundary pressures, then check mesh convergence in an axisymmetric model and model openings separately.
quiz.explanation: 先以內外半徑及壓力邊界重算解析解，再用軸對稱模型查網格收斂；對開口附近另建局部模型。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 厚壁內緣的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thick-wall inner face mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「厚壁內緣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thick-wall inner face” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將外徑誤當半徑或忽略內壓，會使厚壁應力分布與實際邊界不符。若接縫張開仍沿用連續圓筒解，局部壓碎及滲水可能被平滑的平均結果掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using diameter as radius or omitting internal pressure corrupts the boundary solution. Continuing to assume a continuous cylinder after joints open can conceal local crushing and leakage behind a smooth average stress distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分塊接縫、開裂及非均勻地層作用會改變剛度與接觸，須另用含接縫的模型判讀，不能把解析解當成完整承載能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: They require separate joint-sensitive analysis; the elastic solution estimates a stress distribution rather than a complete structural resistance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「厚壁圓筒內外表面的環向應力必定相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hoop stress must be identical at both surfaces of a thick cylinder." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將外徑誤當半徑或忽略內壓，會使厚壁應力分布與實際邊界不符。若接縫張開仍沿用連續圓筒解，局部壓碎及滲水可能被平滑的平均結果掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Using diameter as radius or omitting internal pressure corrupts the boundary solution. Continuing to assume a continuous cylinder after joints open can conceal local crushing and leakage behind a smooth average stress distribution.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「厚壁內緣的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thick-wall inner face mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 將外徑誤當半徑或忽略內壓，會使厚壁應力分布與實際邊界不符。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
最終襯砌足夠強就代表每個施工階段也足夠強。
optionsEn: Using diameter as radius or omitting internal pressure corrupts the boundary solution.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Adequate completed-lining strength guarantees adequate strength at every construction stage.
quiz.explanation: 將外徑誤當半徑或忽略內壓，會使厚壁應力分布與實際邊界不符。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using diameter as radius or omitting internal pressure corrupts the boundary solution. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分段自重的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lift self-weight mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分段自重」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift self-weight” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每一段新澆襯砌的自重先經施工接縫、支承環或臨時支承傳遞，不能假設未達強度的下段立刻承擔全部重量。粗糙接面可提供摩擦與剪力傳遞，但其能力與法向壓力、鋼筋連續性及施工品質有關。井壁與岩面若存在滑移或脫空，自重分配也會改變，施工階段的支承路徑因此必須單獨畫出。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分段自重」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each new lining lift transfers its weight through construction joints, support rings or temporary supports; the immature lift below cannot automatically carry the full weight. Roughened interfaces transmit friction and shear according to normal pressure, reinforcement continuity and workmanship. Slip or separation against the rock changes the weight distribution. A separate construction-stage load-path diagram is therefore needed instead of assuming that the completed shaft's support system already exists. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lift self-weight” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：混凝土單位重 γ=24 kN/m³、內外半徑4與4.5 m、段高 h=3 m，自重 W=γπ(4.5²−4²)h=961 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For γ=24 kN/m³, radii 4 and 4.5 m and lift height h=3 m, W=γπ(4.5²−4²)h=961 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最終襯砌足夠強就代表每個施工階段也足夠強。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate completed-lining strength guarantees adequate strength at every construction stage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分段自重」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lift self-weight”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Each new lining lift transfers its weight through construction joints, support rings or temporary supports; the immature lift below cannot automatically carry the full weight. Roughened interfaces transmit friction and shear according to normal pressure, reinforcement continuity and workmanship.

knowledge.text: 誤解：最終襯砌足夠強就代表每個施工階段也足夠強。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate completed-lining strength guarantees adequate strength at every construction stage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分段自重的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 最終襯砌足夠強就代表每個施工階段也足夠強。
每一段新澆襯砌的自重先經施工接縫、支承環或臨時支承傳遞，不能假設未達強度的下段立刻承擔全部重量。
止水材料耐水壓合格就表示整條施工縫一定水密。

quiz.explanation: 每一段新澆襯砌的自重先經施工接縫、支承環或臨時支承傳遞，不能假設未達強度的下段立刻承擔全部重量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
