steps.title: 分段自重的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lift self-weight mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分段自重」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lift self-weight” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以澆置體積、實際段高與材料密度核對自重，檢查支承環標高及接縫面。拆除臨時支承前，將同養護試體強度與支承反力量測對照施工分析，確認下一段的荷載已有可靠傳遞路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check weight from placed volume, actual lift height and material density, and inspect support-ring elevations and joint surfaces. Before temporary support removal, compare companion-cured strength and measured reactions with stage analysis to confirm a reliable path for the next lift. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每一施工段交接須保存材料齡期、接面處理與支承移除紀錄；臨時工程設計者應簽認拆撐停留點，避免下一段施工自動成為放行依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record material age, interface preparation and support-removal evidence for each lift; the temporary-works designer must release the removal hold point rather than allowing the next construction activity to imply approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：新澆段提前加載可能使施工縫滑移或局部壓碎，留下環狀裂縫與不均勻沉降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Premature loading of a new lift can cause joint slip or local crushing, leaving circumferential cracking and differential settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以澆置體積、實際段高與材料密度核對自重，檢查支承環標高及接縫面。拆除臨時支承前，將同養護試體強度與支承反力量測對照施工分析，確認下一段的荷載已有可靠傳遞路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Check weight from placed volume, actual lift height and material density, and inspect support-ring elevations and joint surfaces. Before temporary support removal, compare companion-cured strength and measured reactions with stage analysis to confirm a reliable path for the next lift.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每一施工段交接須保存材料齡期、接面處理與支承移除紀錄；臨時工程設計者應簽認拆撐停留點，避免下一段施工自動成為放行依據。
knowledge.textEn: Record material age, interface preparation and support-removal evidence for each lift; the temporary-works designer must release the removal hold point rather than allowing the next construction activity to imply approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分段自重的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lift self-weight mechanism and verification"?
options: 以澆置體積、實際段高與材料密度核對自重，檢查支承環標高及接縫面。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。
optionsEn: Check weight from placed volume, actual lift height and material density, and inspect support-ring elevations and joint surfaces.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 以澆置體積、實際段高與材料密度核對自重，檢查支承環標高及接縫面。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check weight from placed volume, actual lift height and material density, and inspect support-ring elevations and joint surfaces. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分段自重的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lift self-weight mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分段自重」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lift self-weight” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 新澆段提前加載可能使施工縫滑移或局部壓碎，留下環狀裂縫與不均勻沉降。這種損傷未必由最終使用荷載控制，完工後補算整體強度無法消除早期裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Premature loading of a new lift can cause joint slip or local crushing, leaving circumferential cracking and differential settlement. The governing event may be an early construction stage; a satisfactory final-state strength calculation does not remove that damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：井壁與岩面若存在滑移或脫空，自重分配也會改變，施工階段的支承路徑因此必須單獨畫出。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A separate construction-stage load-path diagram is therefore needed instead of assuming that the completed shaft's support system already exists.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最終襯砌足夠強就代表每個施工階段也足夠強。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate completed-lining strength guarantees adequate strength at every construction stage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 新澆段提前加載可能使施工縫滑移或局部壓碎，留下環狀裂縫與不均勻沉降。這種損傷未必由最終使用荷載控制，完工後補算整體強度無法消除早期裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Premature loading of a new lift can cause joint slip or local crushing, leaving circumferential cracking and differential settlement. The governing event may be an early construction stage; a satisfactory final-state strength calculation does not remove that damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分段自重的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lift self-weight mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
新澆段提前加載可能使施工縫滑移或局部壓碎，留下環狀裂縫與不均勻沉降。
止水材料耐水壓合格就表示整條施工縫一定水密。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Premature loading of a new lift can cause joint slip or local crushing, leaving circumferential cracking and differential settlement.
A waterstop material pressure rating guarantees a watertight constructed joint.
quiz.explanation: 新澆段提前加載可能使施工縫滑移或局部壓碎，留下環狀裂縫與不均勻沉降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Premature loading of a new lift can cause joint slip or local crushing, leaving circumferential cracking and differential settlement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工縫止水的機理與驗證」與「早齡期溫差的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Construction-joint waterstop mechanism and verification" and "Early-age temperature change mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工縫止水的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction-joint waterstop mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工縫止水」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction-joint waterstop” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 止水帶的作用是延長或封閉接縫滲流路徑，效果同時取決於埋設位置、連續接合及兩側混凝土密實度。外部水頭提高時，微小缺口也可能成為集中滲漏路徑。接縫張開、錯位與材料老化會影響止水能力，故不能把混凝土本體抗滲結果直接當作施工縫性能，必須把位移與水壓共同納入試驗邊界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工縫止水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A waterstop lengthens or closes the seepage path through a joint, but performance depends on embedment, continuity and concrete consolidation on both sides. A small defect can concentrate leakage as external head rises. Joint opening, offset and ageing also affect sealing. Concrete permeability alone therefore does not establish joint performance; displacement and water pressure must be imposed together when defining a representative qualification test. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Construction-joint waterstop” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密設計教學水頭 h=60 m、水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For teaching head h=60 m, water density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s², p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「止水材料耐水壓合格就表示整條施工縫一定水密。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A waterstop material pressure rating guarantees a watertight constructed joint." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工縫止水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Construction-joint waterstop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工縫止水的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 止水帶的作用是延長或封閉接縫滲流路徑，效果同時取決於埋設位置、連續接合及兩側混凝土密實度。外部水頭提高時，微小缺口也可能成為集中滲漏路徑。
knowledge.textEn: A waterstop lengthens or closes the seepage path through a joint, but performance depends on embedment, continuity and concrete consolidation on both sides. A small defect can concentrate leakage as external head rises.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：止水材料耐水壓合格就表示整條施工縫一定水密。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A waterstop material pressure rating guarantees a watertight constructed joint. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工縫止水的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction-joint waterstop mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 止水材料耐水壓合格就表示整條施工縫一定水密。
降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。
止水帶的作用是延長或封閉接縫滲流路徑，效果同時取決於埋設位置、連續接合及兩側混凝土密實度。
optionsEn: A waterstop material pressure rating guarantees a watertight constructed joint.
Reducing peak concrete temperature alone eliminates all early restraint cracking.
A waterstop lengthens or closes the seepage path through a joint, but performance depends on embedment, continuity and concrete consolidation on both sides.
quiz.explanation: 止水帶的作用是延長或封閉接縫滲流路徑，效果同時取決於埋設位置、連續接合及兩側混凝土密實度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A waterstop lengthens or closes the seepage path through a joint, but performance depends on embedment, continuity and concrete consolidation on both sides. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工縫止水的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction-joint waterstop mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工縫止水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Construction-joint waterstop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密設計教學水頭 h=60 m、水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For teaching head h=60 m, water density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s², p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查止水帶接頭連續性、固定位置與澆置後的蜂窩區；以代表性接縫試體在指定開口與錯位下施加水壓。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect splice continuity, restraint position and honeycombing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密設計教學水頭 h=60 m、水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For teaching head h=60 m, water density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s², p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工縫止水的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Construction-joint waterstop mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：水密設計教學水頭 h=60 m、水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa。
保護層只影響耐久性，不會影響截面內力與裂縫。
裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For teaching head h=60 m, water density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s², p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa.
Concrete cover affects durability but never section forces or cracking.
A crack below one fixed width never needs further investigation.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密設計教學水頭 h=60 m、水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For teaching head h=60 m, water density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s², p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工縫止水的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction-joint waterstop mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工縫止水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Construction-joint waterstop” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查止水帶接頭連續性、固定位置與澆置後的蜂窩區；以代表性接縫試體在指定開口與錯位下施加水壓。比較滲漏量與專案訂定標準，並記錄升降壓循環後是否留下永久變形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect splice continuity, restraint position and honeycombing. Test a representative joint under specified opening and offset while applying water pressure; compare leakage with project criteria and record permanent deformation after pressure cycles rather than testing an undeformed strip alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將接頭照片、材料批號與接縫位移需求綁定同一位置編碼；封模前由監造確認止水連續性，缺陷處理須經設計者核准而非只增塗表面材料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Link splice photographs, material batch and required joint movement to one location code; inspection must confirm continuity before form closure, and the designer must approve defect repair rather than relying on added surface coating.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：止水帶扭轉、斷接或周邊蜂窩會形成繞流，常見症狀是施工縫局部出水而本體仍乾。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Twisting, discontinuous splices or surrounding honeycombing create bypass paths, often producing localized joint leakage while the concrete remains dry. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查止水帶接頭連續性、固定位置與澆置後的蜂窩區；以代表性接縫試體在指定開口與錯位下施加水壓。比較滲漏量與專案訂定標準，並記錄升降壓循環後是否留下永久變形。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect splice continuity, restraint position and honeycombing. Test a representative joint under specified opening and offset while applying water pressure; compare leakage with project criteria and record permanent deformation after pressure cycles rather than testing an undeformed strip alone.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將接頭照片、材料批號與接縫位移需求綁定同一位置編碼；封模前由監造確認止水連續性，缺陷處理須經設計者核准而非只增塗表面材料。
knowledge.textEn: Link splice photographs, material batch and required joint movement to one location code; inspection must confirm continuity before form closure, and the designer must approve defect repair rather than relying on added surface coating.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工縫止水的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Construction-joint waterstop mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
檢查止水帶接頭連續性、固定位置與澆置後的蜂窩區；以代表性接縫試體在指定開口與錯位下施加水壓。
平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Inspect splice continuity, restraint position and honeycombing.
A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking.
quiz.explanation: 檢查止水帶接頭連續性、固定位置與澆置後的蜂窩區；以代表性接縫試體在指定開口與錯位下施加水壓。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect splice continuity, restraint position and honeycombing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工縫止水的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction-joint waterstop mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工縫止水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction-joint waterstop” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 止水帶扭轉、斷接或周邊蜂窩會形成繞流，常見症狀是施工縫局部出水而本體仍乾。只在內表面封堵可能使水改走另一弱面，並掩蓋持續外水壓。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Twisting, discontinuous splices or surrounding honeycombing create bypass paths, often producing localized joint leakage while the concrete remains dry. Surface sealing alone may divert flow to another weak interface and conceal sustained external water pressure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接縫張開、錯位與材料老化會影響止水能力，故不能把混凝土本體抗滲結果直接當作施工縫性能，必須把位移與水壓共同納入試驗邊界。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Concrete permeability alone therefore does not establish joint performance; displacement and water pressure must be imposed together when defining a representative qualification test.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「止水材料耐水壓合格就表示整條施工縫一定水密。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A waterstop material pressure rating guarantees a watertight constructed joint." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 止水帶扭轉、斷接或周邊蜂窩會形成繞流，常見症狀是施工縫局部出水而本體仍乾。只在內表面封堵可能使水改走另一弱面，並掩蓋持續外水壓。
knowledge.textEn: Twisting, discontinuous splices or surrounding honeycombing create bypass paths, often producing localized joint leakage while the concrete remains dry. Surface sealing alone may divert flow to another weak interface and conceal sustained external water pressure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工縫止水的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Construction-joint waterstop mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。
止水帶扭轉、斷接或周邊蜂窩會形成繞流，常見症狀是施工縫局部出水而本體仍乾。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Reducing peak concrete temperature alone eliminates all early restraint cracking.
Twisting, discontinuous splices or surrounding honeycombing create bypass paths, often producing localized joint leakage while the concrete remains dry.
quiz.explanation: 止水帶扭轉、斷接或周邊蜂窩會形成繞流，常見症狀是施工縫局部出水而本體仍乾。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Twisting, discontinuous splices or surrounding honeycombing create bypass paths, often producing localized joint leakage while the concrete remains dry. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 早齡期溫差的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Early-age temperature change mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「早齡期溫差」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Early-age temperature change” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水化熱提高厚襯砌核心溫度，後續降溫卻受到先澆段及岩面的拘束，於是自由收縮轉變為拉應力。材料在早齡期的彈性模數、抗拉強度與潛變都隨時間改變，完全拘束的彈性式僅提供上限量級。把溫差與齡期分開看會漏掉最弱時刻，因此須同時記錄溫度歷程、養護條件及接縫拘束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「早齡期溫差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydration heats the lining core, but subsequent cooling is restrained by earlier lifts and the rock, converting free contraction into tension. Elastic modulus, tensile strength and creep all change at early age, so a fully restrained elastic expression is only a bounding scale. Temperature difference cannot be assessed independently of material age: the weakest stage requires simultaneous temperature histories, curing conditions and realistic joint restraint rather than a final concrete strength alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Early-age temperature change” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設完全拘束、E=20 GPa、α=1×10⁻⁵/K、降溫ΔT=15 K，σ=EαΔT=3 MPa；未含潛變鬆弛。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Assuming full restraint, E=20 GPa, α=1×10⁻⁵/K and cooling ΔT=15 K, σ=EαΔT=3 MPa; creep relaxation is excluded.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing peak concrete temperature alone eliminates all early restraint cracking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「早齡期溫差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Early-age temperature change”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 水化熱提高厚襯砌核心溫度，後續降溫卻受到先澆段及岩面的拘束，於是自由收縮轉變為拉應力。材料在早齡期的彈性模數、抗拉強度與潛變都隨時間改變，完全拘束的彈性式僅提供上限量級。
knowledge.textEn: Hydration heats the lining core, but subsequent cooling is restrained by earlier lifts and the rock, converting free contraction into tension. Elastic modulus, tensile strength and creep all change at early age, so a fully restrained elastic expression is only a bounding scale.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reducing peak concrete temperature alone eliminates all early restraint cracking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「早齡期溫差的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Early-age temperature change mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 水化熱提高厚襯砌核心溫度，後續降溫卻受到先澆段及岩面的拘束，於是自由收縮轉變為拉應力。
降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。
灌入的漿量越多就代表襯砌外側接觸越完整。
optionsEn: Hydration heats the lining core, but subsequent cooling is restrained by earlier lifts and the rock, converting free contraction into tension.
Reducing peak concrete temperature alone eliminates all early restraint cracking.
More injected grout necessarily means more complete lining contact.
quiz.explanation: 水化熱提高厚襯砌核心溫度，後續降溫卻受到先澆段及岩面的拘束，於是自由收縮轉變為拉應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydration heats the lining core, but subsequent cooling is restrained by earlier lifts and the rock, converting free contraction into tension. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 早齡期溫差的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Early-age temperature change mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「早齡期溫差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Early-age temperature change” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設完全拘束、E=20 GPa、α=1×10⁻⁵/K、降溫ΔT=15 K，σ=EαΔT=3 MPa；未含潛變鬆弛。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Assuming full restraint, E=20 GPa, α=1×10⁻⁵/K and cooling ΔT=15 K, σ=EαΔT=3 MPa; creep relaxation is excluded. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在核心、內表面及先澆接面布置溫度計，同步紀錄澆置與拆模時間；將最高溫及冷卻速率輸入齡期分析，並以材料試驗校正早期強度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Instrument the core, inner surface and previous-lift interface and synchronize placement and form-removal times.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設完全拘束、E=20 GPa、α=1×10⁻⁵/K、降溫ΔT=15 K，σ=EαΔT=3 MPa；未含潛變鬆弛。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Assuming full restraint, E=20 GPa, α=1×10⁻⁵/K and cooling ΔT=15 K, σ=EαΔT=3 MPa; creep relaxation is excluded. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「早齡期溫差的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Early-age temperature change mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。
原創教學假設：假設完全拘束、E=20 GPa、α=1×10⁻⁵/K、降溫ΔT=15 K，σ=EαΔT=3 MPa；未含潛變鬆弛。
抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。
optionsEn: Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released.
Original teaching assumptions: Assuming full restraint, E=20 GPa, α=1×10⁻⁵/K and cooling ΔT=15 K, σ=EαΔT=3 MPa; creep relaxation is excluded.
A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設完全拘束、E=20 GPa、α=1×10⁻⁵/K、降溫ΔT=15 K，σ=EαΔT=3 MPa；未含潛變鬆弛。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Assuming full restraint, E=20 GPa, α=1×10⁻⁵/K and cooling ΔT=15 K, σ=EαΔT=3 MPa; creep relaxation is excluded. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 早齡期溫差的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Early-age temperature change mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「早齡期溫差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Early-age temperature change” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在核心、內表面及先澆接面布置溫度計，同步紀錄澆置與拆模時間；將最高溫及冷卻速率輸入齡期分析，並以材料試驗校正早期強度。裂縫巡查應比對溫降時刻，不只看最後寬度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Instrument the core, inner surface and previous-lift interface and synchronize placement and form-removal times. Use peak temperature and cooling rate in age-dependent analysis, calibrating early strength with tests; relate crack inspections to cooling events rather than final width alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：溫控計畫應列出材料齡期、拘束假設及觀測位置；拆模與養護調整由材料及結構負責人共同核定，不能用單支表面溫度計取代核心紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The thermal-control plan must include material age, restraint assumptions and observation positions; materials and structural leads jointly authorize form-removal and curing changes, and one surface thermometer cannot replace core records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過快表面降溫或強拘束會產生貫穿裂縫，之後外水壓沿裂縫作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rapid surface cooling or strong restraint can cause through-cracks that later admit pressurized water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「早齡期溫差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Early-age temperature change” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過快表面降溫或強拘束會產生貫穿裂縫，之後外水壓沿裂縫作用。若只把裂縫當成一般乾縮，忽略水化熱時程，後續各施工段可能重複出現相同損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid surface cooling or strong restraint can cause through-cracks that later admit pressurized water. Misclassifying these as ordinary drying shrinkage and ignoring the hydration history can reproduce the same damage in subsequent lining lifts. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把溫差與齡期分開看會漏掉最弱時刻，因此須同時記錄溫度歷程、養護條件及接縫拘束。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Temperature difference cannot be assessed independently of material age: the weakest stage requires simultaneous temperature histories, curing conditions and realistic joint restraint rather than a final concrete strength alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing peak concrete temperature alone eliminates all early restraint cracking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 過快表面降溫或強拘束會產生貫穿裂縫，之後外水壓沿裂縫作用。若只把裂縫當成一般乾縮，忽略水化熱時程，後續各施工段可能重複出現相同損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Rapid surface cooling or strong restraint can cause through-cracks that later admit pressurized water. Misclassifying these as ordinary drying shrinkage and ignoring the hydration history can reproduce the same damage in subsequent lining lifts.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「早齡期溫差的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Early-age temperature change mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 過快表面降溫或強拘束會產生貫穿裂縫，之後外水壓沿裂縫作用。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
灌入的漿量越多就代表襯砌外側接觸越完整。
optionsEn: Rapid surface cooling or strong restraint can cause through-cracks that later admit pressurized water.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
More injected grout necessarily means more complete lining contact.
quiz.explanation: 過快表面降溫或強拘束會產生貫穿裂縫，之後外水壓沿裂縫作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rapid surface cooling or strong restraint can cause through-cracks that later admit pressurized water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「背填空隙的機理與驗證」與「鋼筋保護層的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Backfill void mechanism and verification" and "Reinforcement cover mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 背填空隙的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Backfill void mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「背填空隙」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backfill void” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 襯砌外側背填的功能是建立地層與圓環之間的接觸，空隙會讓原本分散的徑向作用集中到空隙兩端。局部襯砌此時近似跨越缺口的板帶，彎曲需求隨未支承長度平方增長。簡支梁只是診斷用量級，真實曲率、軸向壓力與兩側彈性支承會改變結果，灌漿壓力本身也可能額外推動襯砌。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「背填空隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill establishes contact between the ground and lining; a void concentrates formerly distributed radial loading near its edges. The local lining behaves partly like a strip spanning a gap, with bending increasing approximately with the square of unsupported length. A simply supported beam is a diagnostic scale only: curvature, hoop compression and elastic end restraint change the response, while backfill pressure can itself impose additional lining movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backfill void” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單位寬板帶均布載重 w=40 kN/m、假設簡支缺口 L=2 m，M=wL²/8=20 kN·m/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For a unit-width strip with w=40 kN/m and a hypothetical simply supported gap L=2 m, M=wL²/8=20 kN·m per metre of lining width.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「灌入的漿量越多就代表襯砌外側接觸越完整。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More injected grout necessarily means more complete lining contact." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「背填空隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Backfill void”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 背填空隙的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 襯砌外側背填的功能是建立地層與圓環之間的接觸，空隙會讓原本分散的徑向作用集中到空隙兩端。局部襯砌此時近似跨越缺口的板帶，彎曲需求隨未支承長度平方增長。
knowledge.textEn: Backfill establishes contact between the ground and lining; a void concentrates formerly distributed radial loading near its edges. The local lining behaves partly like a strip spanning a gap, with bending increasing approximately with the square of unsupported length.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：灌入的漿量越多就代表襯砌外側接觸越完整。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More injected grout necessarily means more complete lining contact. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「背填空隙的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Backfill void mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 灌入的漿量越多就代表襯砌外側接觸越完整。
襯砌外側背填的功能是建立地層與圓環之間的接觸，空隙會讓原本分散的徑向作用集中到空隙兩端。
保護層只影響耐久性，不會影響截面內力與裂縫。
optionsEn: More injected grout necessarily means more complete lining contact.
Backfill establishes contact between the ground and lining; a void concentrates formerly distributed radial loading near its edges.
Concrete cover affects durability but never section forces or cracking.
quiz.explanation: 襯砌外側背填的功能是建立地層與圓環之間的接觸，空隙會讓原本分散的徑向作用集中到空隙兩端。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Backfill establishes contact between the ground and lining; a void concentrates formerly distributed radial loading near its edges. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 背填空隙的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Backfill void mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背填空隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backfill void” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單位寬板帶均布載重 w=40 kN/m、假設簡支缺口 L=2 m，M=wL²/8=20 kN·m/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For a unit-width strip with w=40 kN/m and a hypothetical simply supported gap L=2 m, M=wL²/8=20 kN·m per metre of lining width. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以背填量平衡、聲學檢測及必要的驗證孔交叉定位空隙，避免僅用灌漿耗量推定填滿。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Locate voids using backfill-volume balance, acoustic methods and justified verification holes rather than grout consumption alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單位寬板帶均布載重 w=40 kN/m、假設簡支缺口 L=2 m，M=wL²/8=20 kN·m/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For a unit-width strip with w=40 kN/m and a hypothetical simply supported gap L=2 m, M=wL²/8=20 kN·m per metre of lining width. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「背填空隙的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Backfill void mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。
平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。
原創教學假設：單位寬板帶均布載重 w=40 kN/m、假設簡支缺口 L=2 m，M=wL²/8=20 kN·m/m。
optionsEn: A crack below one fixed width never needs further investigation.
A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking.
Original teaching assumptions: For a unit-width strip with w=40 kN/m and a hypothetical simply supported gap L=2 m, M=wL²/8=20 kN·m per metre of lining width.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：單位寬板帶均布載重 w=40 kN/m、假設簡支缺口 L=2 m，M=wL²/8=20 kN·m/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For a unit-width strip with w=40 kN/m and a hypothetical simply supported gap L=2 m, M=wL²/8=20 kN·m per metre of lining width. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 背填空隙的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Backfill void mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「背填空隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backfill void” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以背填量平衡、聲學檢測及必要的驗證孔交叉定位空隙，避免僅用灌漿耗量推定填滿。將疑似空隙長度與裂縫位置疊圖，再比較補填前後的應變及接觸狀況，確認力流已恢復。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Locate voids using backfill-volume balance, acoustic methods and justified verification holes rather than grout consumption alone. Overlay suspected void length and cracking, then compare strain and contact evidence before and after remedial filling to verify restoration of the load path. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：背填驗收應以可證明的接觸範圍及結構反應為主；異常耗漿或襯砌位移須觸發停留點，由地工與襯砌設計者共同審查補填方案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Base backfill acceptance on demonstrable contact extent and structural response; abnormal grout consumption or lining movement triggers a hold point for joint review by the geotechnical and lining designers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：空隙兩端可能先出現彎曲裂縫，過高補漿壓力又可能把裂縫撐大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Bending cracks can develop at void edges, while excessive remedial grouting pressure may widen them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以背填量平衡、聲學檢測及必要的驗證孔交叉定位空隙，避免僅用灌漿耗量推定填滿。將疑似空隙長度與裂縫位置疊圖，再比較補填前後的應變及接觸狀況，確認力流已恢復。

Overlay suspected void length and cracking, then compare strain and contact evidence before and after remedial filling to verify restoration of the load path.

knowledge.text: 背填驗收應以可證明的接觸範圍及結構反應為主；異常耗漿或襯砌位移須觸發停留點，由地工與襯砌設計者共同審查補填方案。
knowledge.textEn: Base backfill acceptance on demonstrable contact extent and structural response; abnormal grout consumption or lining movement triggers a hold point for joint review by the geotechnical and lining designers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「背填空隙的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Backfill void mechanism and verification"?
options: 以背填量平衡、聲學檢測及必要的驗證孔交叉定位空隙，避免僅用灌漿耗量推定填滿。

quiz.explanationEn: Locate voids using backfill-volume balance, acoustic methods and justified verification holes rather than grout consumption alone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

quiz.question: 在「背填空隙的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Backfill void mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
空隙兩端可能先出現彎曲裂縫，過高補漿壓力又可能把裂縫撐大。
保護層只影響耐久性，不會影響截面內力與裂縫。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Bending cracks can develop at void edges, while excessive remedial grouting pressure may widen them.
Concrete cover affects durability but never section forces or cracking.
quiz.explanation: 空隙兩端可能先出現彎曲裂縫，過高補漿壓力又可能把裂縫撐大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Bending cracks can develop at void edges, while excessive remedial grouting pressure may widen them. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼筋保護層的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reinforcement cover mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼筋保護層」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reinforcement cover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保護層隔開鋼筋與水分及侵蝕介質，也決定鋼筋到受壓邊緣的有效深度。增加保護層可能改善耐久性，卻會縮短內力力臂，改變裂縫分布及彎曲容量。曲面襯砌中，鋼筋籠偏心及局部墊塊位移常使設計厚度無法直接代表有效深度，必須對照實測鋼筋位置與真正受拉側。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼筋保護層」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cover separates reinforcement from water and aggressive agents while also determining the effective depth measured from the compression face. More cover can improve durability but reduce the internal lever arm and alter crack distribution and bending resistance. In a curved lining, cage eccentricity and displaced spacers mean nominal thickness does not establish effective depth. Measurements must identify actual bar position and the tension face for the relevant bending direction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reinforcement cover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：襯砌厚 h=500 mm、受拉側保護層 c=60 mm、主筋直徑φ=20 mm，d=h−c−φ/2=430 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For lining thickness h=500 mm, tension-face cover c=60 mm and bar diameter φ=20 mm, d=h−c−φ/2=430 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「保護層只影響耐久性，不會影響截面內力與裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete cover affects durability but never section forces or cracking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼筋保護層」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reinforcement cover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼筋保護層的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 保護層隔開鋼筋與水分及侵蝕介質，也決定鋼筋到受壓邊緣的有效深度。增加保護層可能改善耐久性，卻會縮短內力力臂，改變裂縫分布及彎曲容量。
knowledge.textEn: Cover separates reinforcement from water and aggressive agents while also determining the effective depth measured from the compression face. More cover can improve durability but reduce the internal lever arm and alter crack distribution and bending resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：保護層只影響耐久性，不會影響截面內力與裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Concrete cover affects durability but never section forces or cracking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼筋保護層的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reinforcement cover mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 保護層只影響耐久性，不會影響截面內力與裂縫。
有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。
保護層隔開鋼筋與水分及侵蝕介質，也決定鋼筋到受壓邊緣的有效深度。
optionsEn: Concrete cover affects durability but never section forces or cracking.
Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released.
Cover separates reinforcement from water and aggressive agents while also determining the effective depth measured from the compression face.
quiz.explanation: 保護層隔開鋼筋與水分及侵蝕介質，也決定鋼筋到受壓邊緣的有效深度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cover separates reinforcement from water and aggressive agents while also determining the effective depth measured from the compression face. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼筋保護層的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reinforcement cover mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼筋保護層」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reinforcement cover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：襯砌厚 h=500 mm、受拉側保護層 c=60 mm、主筋直徑φ=20 mm，d=h−c−φ/2=430 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For lining thickness h=500 mm, tension-face cover c=60 mm and bar diameter φ=20 mm, d=h−c−φ/2=430 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：澆置前量測籠位與墊塊，澆置後用校正的保護層探測器抽查，必要時採局部驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey cages and spacers before placement, then sample with a calibrated cover meter and justified local verification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：襯砌厚 h=500 mm、受拉側保護層 c=60 mm、主筋直徑φ=20 mm，d=h−c−φ/2=430 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For lining thickness h=500 mm, tension-face cover c=60 mm and bar diameter φ=20 mm, d=h−c−φ/2=430 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼筋保護層的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reinforcement cover mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：襯砌厚 h=500 mm、受拉側保護層 c=60 mm、主筋直徑φ=20 mm，d=h−c−φ/2=430 mm。
抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。
厚壁圓筒內外表面的環向應力必定相同。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For lining thickness h=500 mm, tension-face cover c=60 mm and bar diameter φ=20 mm, d=h−c−φ/2=430 mm.
A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored.
Hoop stress must be identical at both surfaces of a thick cylinder.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：襯砌厚 h=500 mm、受拉側保護層 c=60 mm、主筋直徑φ=20 mm，d=h−c−φ/2=430 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For lining thickness h=500 mm, tension-face cover c=60 mm and bar diameter φ=20 mm, d=h−c−φ/2=430 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼筋保護層的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reinforcement cover mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼筋保護層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reinforcement cover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 澆置前量測籠位與墊塊，澆置後用校正的保護層探測器抽查，必要時採局部驗證。將實測偏差輸入截面分析，分別核對耐久下限及有效深度，不能只以平均保護層符合判定全段合格。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey cages and spacers before placement, then sample with a calibrated cover meter and justified local verification. Insert measured deviations into section analysis, separately checking minimum durability cover and effective depth; an acceptable average does not establish compliance everywhere. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將保護層偏差與鋼筋位置保留在竣工斷面，而非只保存合格章；超差區由結構設計者評估受力和耐久兩項需求後核定處理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain cover deviations and bar locations in as-built sections rather than only a compliance stamp; the structural designer evaluates both resistance and durability before deciding how to treat out-of-tolerance zones.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：保護層過薄可能加速腐蝕，過厚又可能降低力臂並形成較寬表面裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Thin cover can accelerate corrosion, while excessive cover reduces lever arm and may widen surface cracks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 澆置前量測籠位與墊塊，澆置後用校正的保護層探測器抽查，必要時採局部驗證。將實測偏差輸入截面分析，分別核對耐久下限及有效深度，不能只以平均保護層符合判定全段合格。
knowledge.textEn: Survey cages and spacers before placement, then sample with a calibrated cover meter and justified local verification. Insert measured deviations into section analysis, separately checking minimum durability cover and effective depth; an acceptable average does not establish compliance everywhere.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將保護層偏差與鋼筋位置保留在竣工斷面，而非只保存合格章；超差區由結構設計者評估受力和耐久兩項需求後核定處理。
knowledge.textEn: Retain cover deviations and bar locations in as-built sections rather than only a compliance stamp; the structural designer evaluates both resistance and durability before deciding how to treat out-of-tolerance zones.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼筋保護層的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reinforcement cover mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
澆置前量測籠位與墊塊，澆置後用校正的保護層探測器抽查，必要時採局部驗證。
止水材料耐水壓合格就表示整條施工縫一定水密。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Survey cages and spacers before placement, then sample with a calibrated cover meter and justified local verification.
A waterstop material pressure rating guarantees a watertight constructed joint.
quiz.explanation: 澆置前量測籠位與墊塊，澆置後用校正的保護層探測器抽查，必要時採局部驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey cages and spacers before placement, then sample with a calibrated cover meter and justified local verification. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼筋保護層的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reinforcement cover mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼筋保護層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reinforcement cover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 保護層過薄可能加速腐蝕，過厚又可能降低力臂並形成較寬表面裂縫。若探測器未校正而漏掉籠位偏移，竣工模型會高估局部抗彎能力與使用壽命。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Thin cover can accelerate corrosion, while excessive cover reduces lever arm and may widen surface cracks. An uncalibrated survey that misses cage displacement can overstate local flexural resistance and durability in the as-built model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：曲面襯砌中，鋼筋籠偏心及局部墊塊位移常使設計厚度無法直接代表有效深度，必須對照實測鋼筋位置與真正受拉側。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Measurements must identify actual bar position and the tension face for the relevant bending direction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「保護層只影響耐久性，不會影響截面內力與裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete cover affects durability but never section forces or cracking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 保護層過薄可能加速腐蝕，過厚又可能降低力臂並形成較寬表面裂縫。若探測器未校正而漏掉籠位偏移，竣工模型會高估局部抗彎能力與使用壽命。
knowledge.textEn: Thin cover can accelerate corrosion, while excessive cover reduces lever arm and may widen surface cracks. An uncalibrated survey that misses cage displacement can overstate local flexural resistance and durability in the as-built model.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼筋保護層的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reinforcement cover mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。
保護層過薄可能加速腐蝕，過厚又可能降低力臂並形成較寬表面裂縫。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released.
Thin cover can accelerate corrosion, while excessive cover reduces lever arm and may widen surface cracks.
quiz.explanation: 保護層過薄可能加速腐蝕，過厚又可能降低力臂並形成較寬表面裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Thin cover can accelerate corrosion, while excessive cover reduces lever arm and may widen surface cracks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水頭回復的機理與驗證」與「裂縫成長率的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification" and "Crack growth rate mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水頭回復的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水頭回復」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Groundwater recovery” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停抽後含水層的水頭逐步回復，襯砌的永久荷載可能高於施工期間，且不同含水層的回復速率未必相同。若永久設計依賴排水，堵塞、停電及管路隔離就屬重要的失效情境。監測必須區分外部水頭與井內水位，因為作用於襯砌的是兩側壓差，單看抽水機是否運轉無法證明壓差受到控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水頭回復」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After pumping stops, aquifer heads recover and permanent lining loads may exceed construction loads; separate aquifers need not recover at the same rate. If the permanent design relies on drainage, blockage, power loss and pipe isolation become relevant failure scenarios. Monitoring must distinguish external head from the internal shaft water level because differential pressure loads the lining. Pump-running status alone does not establish control of that pressure difference. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Groundwater recovery” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：外部水頭增加 Δh=20 m、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²且內水位不變，Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For external recovery Δh=20 m, ρ=1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and unchanged internal level, Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水頭回復」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Groundwater recovery”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水頭回復的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 停抽後含水層的水頭逐步回復，襯砌的永久荷載可能高於施工期間，且不同含水層的回復速率未必相同。若永久設計依賴排水，堵塞、停電及管路隔離就屬重要的失效情境。
knowledge.textEn: After pumping stops, aquifer heads recover and permanent lining loads may exceed construction loads; separate aquifers need not recover at the same rate. If the permanent design relies on drainage, blockage, power loss and pipe isolation become relevant failure scenarios.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水頭回復的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。
裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。
optionsEn: After pumping stops, aquifer heads recover and permanent lining loads may exceed construction loads; separate aquifers need not recover at the same rate.
Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released.
A crack below one fixed width never needs further investigation.
quiz.explanation: 停抽後含水層的水頭逐步回復，襯砌的永久荷載可能高於施工期間，且不同含水層的回復速率未必相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 水頭回復的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭回復」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Groundwater recovery” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：外部水頭增加 Δh=20 m、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²且內水位不變，Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For external recovery Δh=20 m, ρ=1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and unchanged internal level, Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每個水壓計記錄所在含水層與設計水頭，建立停抽後趨勢圖；同步比較排水量、裂縫與滲漏位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Assign each piezometer to an aquifer and design head, then trend pressures after pumping stops.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

最終襯砌足夠強就代表每個施工階段也足夠強。

steps.title: 水頭回復的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭回復」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Groundwater recovery” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對每個水壓計記錄所在含水層與設計水頭，建立停抽後趨勢圖；同步比較排水量、裂縫與滲漏位置。只有壓差與結構反應均落在核定範圍，才可確認交接階段的水力邊界成立。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Assign each piezometer to an aquifer and design head, then trend pressures after pumping stops. Compare drainage flow, crack readings and leak locations concurrently; the handover hydraulic boundary is demonstrated only when pressure differences and structural response satisfy approved criteria. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護圖應標明每段排水的集水範圍、可隔離閥及替代排水路徑；停抽或封閉排水前，由設計者及營運單位共同核准水頭回復監測計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Maintenance drawings must identify each drainage catchment, isolation valve and alternative route; the designer and operator jointly approve a groundwater-recovery monitoring plan before pumping or drainage is discontinued.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水管沉積或閥門誤關可能使外壓快速上升，而泵房狀態仍顯示正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sediment or an incorrectly closed valve can raise external pressure while the pump-room display appears normal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭回復的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification"?

降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.

steps.title: 水頭回復的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭回復」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Groundwater recovery” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水管沉積或閥門誤關可能使外壓快速上升，而泵房狀態仍顯示正常。先出現接縫滲漏不表示壓力已安全釋放，局部堵塞與壓力分區可能仍持續增加構件需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sediment or an incorrectly closed valve can raise external pressure while the pump-room display appears normal. Initial joint leakage does not prove safe pressure relief; local blockage and compartmentalized water can continue increasing lining demand. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測必須區分外部水頭與井內水位，因為作用於襯砌的是兩側壓差，單看抽水機是否運轉無法證明壓差受到控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pump-running status alone does not establish control of that pressure difference.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.objective: 說明「裂縫成長率」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crack growth rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裂縫寬度是某一時刻的狀態，成長率與其對溫度及水頭的反應才有助區分持續變形和可逆開合。相同裂縫在不同季節量測可能有不同寬度，測點位置改變也會造成假趨勢。維護判讀需把裂縫位置、方向、滲水與材料劣化放在同一時間軸，避免把平穩表象誤認為已停止發展。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂縫成長率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crack width describes one state, while growth rate and response to temperature and water head help distinguish progressive deformation from reversible opening. Maintenance interpretation therefore needs a common time axis for crack position, direction, leakage and material deterioration. An apparently stable isolated reading does not establish that the underlying movement has stopped. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crack growth rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：固定測點裂縫由 w₀=0.20 mm增至w₁=0.30 mm，間隔Δt=2 year，平均成長率(w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: At a fixed point, width changes from w₀=0.20 mm to w₁=0.30 mm over Δt=2 year, giving mean growth (w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A crack below one fixed width never needs further investigation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂縫成長率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
