steps.observation: 如何核對：用固定基座裂縫計與可重複照片定位，紀錄每次讀值的溫度、水頭及儀器解析度；比較同條件下的永久增量與短期循環。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use fixed-base crack gauges and repeatable photographs, recording temperature, head and instrument resolution with every reading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：固定測點裂縫由 w₀=0.20 mm增至w₁=0.30 mm，間隔Δt=2 year，平均成長率(w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: At a fixed point, width changes from w₀=0.20 mm to w₁=0.30 mm over Δt=2 year, giving mean growth (w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「裂縫成長率的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Crack growth rate mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 厚壁圓筒內外表面的環向應力必定相同。
止水材料耐水壓合格就表示整條施工縫一定水密。
原創教學假設：固定測點裂縫由 w₀=0.20 mm增至w₁=0.30 mm，間隔Δt=2 year，平均成長率(w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year。
optionsEn: Hoop stress must be identical at both surfaces of a thick cylinder.
A waterstop material pressure rating guarantees a watertight constructed joint.
Original teaching assumptions: At a fixed point, width changes from w₀=0.20 mm to w₁=0.30 mm over Δt=2 year, giving mean growth (w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：固定測點裂縫由 w₀=0.20 mm增至w₁=0.30 mm，間隔Δt=2 year，平均成長率(w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: At a fixed point, width changes from w₀=0.20 mm to w₁=0.30 mm over Δt=2 year, giving mean growth (w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 裂縫成長率的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crack growth rate mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂縫成長率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crack growth rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用固定基座裂縫計與可重複照片定位，紀錄每次讀值的溫度、水頭及儀器解析度；比較同條件下的永久增量與短期循環。當變化接近解析度時先報不確定度，避免把量測雜訊當成劣化趨勢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use fixed-base crack gauges and repeatable photographs, recording temperature, head and instrument resolution with every reading. Separate permanent increments at comparable conditions from short cycles; report uncertainty when changes approach resolution rather than treating noise as deterioration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接資料應含初始裂縫圖、環境基準與事件後檢查責任；異常成長或滲流改變由管理單位召集原設計專業判讀，不能只以年度平均率決定放行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover must include initial crack maps, environmental baselines and responsibility for post-event inspections; abnormal growth or changed seepage requires engineering interpretation, and annual mean growth alone must not determine release.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：缺少固定基準或忽略溫度會造成錯誤警報，也可能把緩慢劣化抵銷成無變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unstable reference points or uncorrected temperature can create false alarms or hide slow deterioration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用固定基座裂縫計與可重複照片定位，紀錄每次讀值的溫度、水頭及儀器解析度；比較同條件下的永久增量與短期循環。當變化接近解析度時先報不確定度，避免把量測雜訊當成劣化趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Use fixed-base crack gauges and repeatable photographs, recording temperature, head and instrument resolution with every reading. Separate permanent increments at comparable conditions from short cycles; report uncertainty when changes approach resolution rather than treating noise as deterioration.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接資料應含初始裂縫圖、環境基準與事件後檢查責任；異常成長或滲流改變由管理單位召集原設計專業判讀，不能只以年度平均率決定放行。
knowledge.textEn: Handover must include initial crack maps, environmental baselines and responsibility for post-event inspections; abnormal growth or changed seepage requires engineering interpretation, and annual mean growth alone must not determine release.

quiz.question: 要驗證「裂縫成長率的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Crack growth rate mechanism and verification"?
options: 用固定基座裂縫計與可重複照片定位，紀錄每次讀值的溫度、水頭及儀器解析度；比較同條件下的永久增量與短期循環。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
灌入的漿量越多就代表襯砌外側接觸越完整。
optionsEn: Use fixed-base crack gauges and repeatable photographs, recording temperature, head and instrument resolution with every reading.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
More injected grout necessarily means more complete lining contact.
quiz.explanation: 用固定基座裂縫計與可重複照片定位，紀錄每次讀值的溫度、水頭及儀器解析度；比較同條件下的永久增量與短期循環。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use fixed-base crack gauges and repeatable photographs, recording temperature, head and instrument resolution with every reading. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 裂縫成長率的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crack growth rate mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂縫成長率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crack growth rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 缺少固定基準或忽略溫度會造成錯誤警報，也可能把緩慢劣化抵銷成無變化。若裂縫伴隨混濁滲水或新剝落，應追查接觸、滲流與腐蝕，而非僅重貼量測標記。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unstable reference points or uncorrected temperature can create false alarms or hide slow deterioration. Cracking accompanied by turbid leakage or fresh spalling requires investigation of contact, seepage and corrosion rather than merely replacing measurement marks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：維護判讀需把裂縫位置、方向、滲水與材料劣化放在同一時間軸，避免把平穩表象誤認為已停止發展。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An apparently stable isolated reading does not establish that the underlying movement has stopped.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A crack below one fixed width never needs further investigation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 缺少固定基準或忽略溫度會造成錯誤警報，也可能把緩慢劣化抵銷成無變化。若裂縫伴隨混濁滲水或新剝落，應追查接觸、滲流與腐蝕，而非僅重貼量測標記。
knowledge.textEn: Unstable reference points or uncorrected temperature can create false alarms or hide slow deterioration. Cracking accompanied by turbid leakage or fresh spalling requires investigation of contact, seepage and corrosion rather than merely replacing measurement marks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「裂縫成長率的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Crack growth rate mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
缺少固定基準或忽略溫度會造成錯誤警報，也可能把緩慢劣化抵銷成無變化。
抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unstable reference points or uncorrected temperature can create false alarms or hide slow deterioration.
A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 缺少固定基準或忽略溫度會造成錯誤警報，也可能把緩慢劣化抵銷成無變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unstable reference points or uncorrected temperature can create false alarms or hide slow deterioration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 大直徑鑽掘豎井
summary: 大直徑豎井的進度由完整作業循環決定，不能只看切削機額定功率。本課把幾何開挖量、切削能、提升循環、工作盤反力與通風排水聯成系統，利用量測分辨設備瓶頸與地層限制，並以故障停機及永久襯砌介面建立可追溯的施工交接。
summaryEn: Large-shaft progress depends on the complete operating cycle rather than rated cutting power. The course links excavation volume, cutting energy, hoisting cycles, working-platform reactions, ventilation and drainage, uses measurements to separate equipment bottlenecks from ground constraints, and develops traceable handover through downtime and permanent-lining interfaces.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：圓井直徑D=10 m，每次進尺h=1 m，原位體積為V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³。若直徑增加10%至11 m而進尺相同，V=π×11²×1/4=95.03 m³，增加21%。提升量若以鬆方記錄，必須先以實測鬆方係數換算，才可與此原位量比較。這項幾何敏感度不表示切削時間必然增加21%，因為岩性、刀具、出碴及支護還可能改變循環。施工團隊應把新增體積放入整個循環分析，而非只擴大切削功率。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: for a circular shaft with D=10 m and advance h=1 m, in-situ volume is V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³. Increasing diameter by 10% to 11 m at the same advance gives V=π×11²×1/4=95.03 m³, an increase of 21%. Hoisted loose volume must first be converted using a measured bulking factor before comparison. This geometric sensitivity does not imply exactly 21% more cutting time because geology, tools, muck handling and support also shape the cycle. The construction team should insert the extra volume into the complete cycle model instead of simply increasing the installed cutting power alone.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開挖斷面的機理與驗證」與「切削比能的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Excavation section mechanism and verification" and "Cutting specific energy mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開挖斷面的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Excavation section mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開挖斷面」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Excavation section” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大直徑井每增加少量直徑，單位深度的開挖體積便按平方增加；出碴、襯砌與設備空間也隨之改變。名目井徑不是實際開挖輪廓，超挖及地層掉塊必須另外計量，才可建立可靠的物料平衡與施工循環。幾何計算不預測切削難度，也不能把破碎岩塊的鬆方直接當作地層流失；比較產量前須先統一體積基準與計量位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開挖斷面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Even a small diameter increase raises excavation volume per unit depth quadratically, affecting muck handling, lining and equipment space. Nominal shaft diameter is not the excavated profile; overbreak and falling blocks must be measured separately to establish a credible material balance and cycle. Geometry does not predict cuttability, and loose broken rock is not automatically ground loss; normalize the volume basis and measurement location before comparing production. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Excavation section” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：直徑D=10 m、進尺h=1 m，原位體積V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For diameter D=10 m and advance h=1 m, in-situ volume V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「井徑增加百分之十，開挖體積也只增加百分之十。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten-percent diameter increase produces only ten-percent more excavation volume." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「開挖斷面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Excavation section”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開挖斷面的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 大直徑井每增加少量直徑，單位深度的開挖體積便按平方增加；出碴、襯砌與設備空間也隨之改變。名目井徑不是實際開挖輪廓，超挖及地層掉塊必須另外計量，才可建立可靠的物料平衡與施工循環。
knowledge.textEn: Even a small diameter increase raises excavation volume per unit depth quadratically, affecting muck handling, lining and equipment space. Nominal shaft diameter is not the excavated profile; overbreak and falling blocks must be measured separately to establish a credible material balance and cycle.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：井徑增加百分之十，開挖體積也只增加百分之十。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ten-percent diameter increase produces only ten-percent more excavation volume. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開挖斷面的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Excavation section mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 井徑增加百分之十，開挖體積也只增加百分之十。
大直徑井每增加少量直徑，單位深度的開挖體積便按平方增加；出碴、襯砌與設備空間也隨之改變。
切削機額定功率越大就一定有同比例的進尺。
optionsEn: A ten-percent diameter increase produces only ten-percent more excavation volume.
Even a small diameter increase raises excavation volume per unit depth quadratically, affecting muck handling, lining and equipment space.
Higher rated cutting power always gives proportionally higher advance.
quiz.explanation: 大直徑井每增加少量直徑，單位深度的開挖體積便按平方增加；出碴、襯砌與設備空間也隨之改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Even a small diameter increase raises excavation volume per unit depth quadratically, affecting muck handling, lining and equipment space. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開挖斷面的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Excavation section mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開挖斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Excavation section” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.

steps.title: 開挖斷面的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Excavation section” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 掃描各段斷面並核對標高，將原位體積與提升容器計量分列，使用實測鬆方係數比較。物料表須保留井深、掃描輪廓及體積定義，超挖量應交地工設計者判讀後調整支護。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan each lift and check elevations; distinguish in-situ volume from hoisted loose volume and compare them using a measured bulking factor. Retain depth, scanned profile and volume definitions in material records; the geotechnical designer reviews overbreak before support is revised. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain depth, scanned profile and volume definitions in material records; the geotechnical designer reviews overbreak before support is revised. Geometry does not predict cuttability, and loose broken rock is not automatically ground loss; normalize the volume basis and measurement location before comparing production.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把鬆方當原位方會誤判出碴效率，亦可能掩蓋局部超挖與井壁鬆動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing loose and in-situ volume distorts mucking efficiency and can conceal overbreak or shaft-wall loosening. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「開挖斷面的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.instruction: 切削比能把破岩所需能量與開挖體積連結，可用來比較同一設備在不同岩層中的反應。刀具磨耗、岩石強度、節理和切入深度都會改變比能；額定電功率另含傳動損失，不能全部當成有效破岩功率。比能是狀態指標而非可通用的材料常數，必須注明量測位於馬達端或刀盤端，並保留效率與空轉扣除的方法。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「切削比能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Specific cutting energy links rock-breaking energy to excavated volume and helps compare one machine across strata. Specific energy is a condition indicator rather than a universal material constant; identify whether measurement is at motor or cutter and document efficiency and idle-power corrections. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cutting specific energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For useful specific energy e=20 MJ/m³ and in-situ cutting rate Q=0.02 m³/s, P=eQ=0.4 MW=400 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「切削機額定功率越大就一定有同比例的進尺。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher rated cutting power always gives proportionally higher advance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「切削比能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher rated cutting power always gives proportionally higher advance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「切削比能的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Hoisting speed and bucket capacity alone determine actual daily production.

導向儀顯示垂直就不需要獨立測量複核。

A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks.
Adequate measured duct flow guarantees air quality at every work location.

steps.title: 切削比能的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cutting specific energy mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「切削比能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cutting specific energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄功率、扭矩、切入量與原位方量，剔除空轉時段後比較不同地層的比能。機械與地質紀錄應用同一時間戳；功率偏離基準時先查刀具及地層，再由設備負責人核定調整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize power, torque, penetration and in-situ volume, excluding idle periods before comparing specific energy between strata. Use one clock for mechanical and geological logs; investigate tools and ground before the equipment lead approves changes following power deviations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：機械與地質紀錄應用同一時間戳；功率偏離基準時先查刀具及地層，再由設備負責人核定調整。比能是狀態指標而非可通用的材料常數，必須注明量測位於馬達端或刀盤端，並保留效率與空轉扣除的方法。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use one clock for mechanical and geological logs; investigate tools and ground before the equipment lead approves changes following power deviations. Specific energy is a condition indicator rather than a universal material constant; identify whether measurement is at motor or cutter and document efficiency and idle-power corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：刀具磨鈍仍追求固定進尺會使熱與扭矩升高，造成異常磨損或頻繁跳機。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Maintaining fixed advance with blunt tools increases heat and torque, producing abnormal wear or frequent trips. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cutting specific energy mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步記錄功率、扭矩、切入量與原位方量，剔除空轉時段後比較不同地層的比能。

steps.title: 切削比能的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cutting specific energy mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「切削比能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cutting specific energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刀具磨鈍仍追求固定進尺會使熱與扭矩升高，造成異常磨損或頻繁跳機。比能是狀態指標而非可通用的材料常數，必須注明量測位於馬達端或刀盤端，並保留效率與空轉扣除的方法。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Maintaining fixed advance with blunt tools increases heat and torque, producing abnormal wear or frequent trips. Specific energy is a condition indicator rather than a universal material constant; identify whether measurement is at motor or cutter and document efficiency and idle-power corrections. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比能是狀態指標而非可通用的材料常數，必須注明量測位於馬達端或刀盤端，並保留效率與空轉扣除的方法。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Specific energy is a condition indicator rather than a universal material constant; identify whether measurement is at motor or cutter and document efficiency and idle-power corrections.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「切削機額定功率越大就一定有同比例的進尺。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher rated cutting power always gives proportionally higher advance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 刀具磨鈍仍追求固定進尺會使熱與扭矩升高，造成異常磨損或頻繁跳機。比能是狀態指標而非可通用的材料常數，必須注明量測位於馬達端或刀盤端，並保留效率與空轉扣除的方法。
knowledge.textEn: Maintaining fixed advance with blunt tools increases heat and torque, producing abnormal wear or frequent trips. Specific energy is a condition indicator rather than a universal material constant; identify whether measurement is at motor or cutter and document efficiency and idle-power corrections.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「切削比能的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cutting specific energy mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
提升速度與容器容量足以單獨決定實際日產量。
刀具磨鈍仍追求固定進尺會使熱與扭矩升高，造成異常磨損或頻繁跳機。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Hoisting speed and bucket capacity alone determine actual daily production.
Maintaining fixed advance with blunt tools increases heat and torque, producing abnormal wear or frequent trips.
quiz.explanation: 刀具磨鈍仍追求固定進尺會使熱與扭矩升高，造成異常磨損或頻繁跳機。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Maintaining fixed advance with blunt tools increases heat and torque, producing abnormal wear or frequent trips. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「提升循環的機理與驗證」與「工作盤支承的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hoisting cycle mechanism and verification" and "Working-platform supports mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 提升循環的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hoisting cycle mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「提升循環」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hoisting cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井底破岩後仍須把碴土送至地面，提升能力常隨井深增加而下降。完整循環包含裝載、加速、運送、卸載與回程，容器額定容量若未滿載或受限於重量便不能直接當有效體積。設備之間的等候時間也會消耗可用產能。此處是鬆方提升量，與切削原位量比較時要換算；雙容器或交錯作業會改變循環邏輯，不能直接相加額定值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「提升循環」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Broken rock must still reach the surface, and hoisting capacity often falls as shaft depth increases. The full cycle includes loading, acceleration, travel, unloading and return. Rated bucket volume is not useful volume when fill is incomplete or weight governs, while waiting between subsystems consumes available capacity. This is loose-volume hoisting capacity and requires conversion before comparison with in-situ cutting; twin-bucket or overlapping operations change cycle logic, so ratings cannot simply be added. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hoisting cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設每循環有效鬆方Vb=8 m³、完整循環t=240 s，Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With useful loose volume Vb=8 m³ and full cycle t=240 s, hoisting rate Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提升速度與容器容量足以單獨決定實際日產量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hoisting speed and bucket capacity alone determine actual daily production." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「提升循環」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hoisting cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 提升循環的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 井底破岩後仍須把碴土送至地面，提升能力常隨井深增加而下降。完整循環包含裝載、加速、運送、卸載與回程，容器額定容量若未滿載或受限於重量便不能直接當有效體積。
knowledge.textEn: Broken rock must still reach the surface, and hoisting capacity often falls as shaft depth increases. The full cycle includes loading, acceleration, travel, unloading and return.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：提升速度與容器容量足以單獨決定實際日產量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hoisting speed and bucket capacity alone determine actual daily production. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「提升循環的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hoisting cycle mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 井底破岩後仍須把碴土送至地面，提升能力常隨井深增加而下降。
提升速度與容器容量足以單獨決定實際日產量。
四個支點在所有工況下必定各承受四分之一重量。
optionsEn: Broken rock must still reach the surface, and hoisting capacity often falls as shaft depth increases.
Hoisting speed and bucket capacity alone determine actual daily production.
Four supports necessarily carry one quarter of the load in every condition.
quiz.explanation: 井底破岩後仍須把碴土送至地面，提升能力常隨井深增加而下降。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Broken rock must still reach the surface, and hoisting capacity often falls as shaft depth increases. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 提升循環的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hoisting cycle mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「提升循環」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hoisting cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設每循環有效鬆方Vb=8 m³、完整循環t=240 s，Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: With useful loose volume Vb=8 m³ and full cycle t=240 s, hoisting rate Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用事件紀錄拆解各循環時間，抽核容器重量與密度；將平均及長尾等候時間分別呈現。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Break cycles into event times and sample bucket mass and density; report average times and long waiting tails separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設每循環有效鬆方Vb=8 m³、完整循環t=240 s，Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: With useful loose volume Vb=8 m³ and full cycle t=240 s, hoisting rate Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「提升循環的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hoisting cycle mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 只要最終支護足夠厚，施工中裸露長度就不重要。
原創教學假設：假設每循環有效鬆方Vb=8 m³、完整循環t=240 s，Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h。
排水泵額定流量大於平均湧水量就沒有停機風險。
optionsEn: Adequate final support thickness makes temporary exposed length unimportant.
Original teaching assumptions: With useful loose volume Vb=8 m³ and full cycle t=240 s, hoisting rate Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h.
Pump nameplate capacity above average inflow eliminates outage risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設每循環有效鬆方Vb=8 m³、完整循環t=240 s，Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: With useful loose volume Vb=8 m³ and full cycle t=240 s, hoisting rate Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 提升循環的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hoisting cycle mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「提升循環」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hoisting cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用事件紀錄拆解各循環時間，抽核容器重量與密度；將平均及長尾等候時間分別呈現。施工排程應列有效容器量及完整循環分布；碴量接近工作空間上限時，由施工負責人啟動排程停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Break cycles into event times and sample bucket mass and density; report average times and long waiting tails separately. Schedule with useful bucket volume and full-cycle distributions; the construction lead activates a hold point when muck approaches the working-space limit. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Working-platform supports” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 工作盤承載人員、機具及材料，反力經支承裝置傳入井壁或懸吊系統。理想對稱分配僅能作初步估算，設備偏心、支點高差與局部剛度不同會使個別支點受力超過平均值；臨時構件的負載也隨施工階段改變。平均反力不是支點設計上限；實際檢核還須含偏心、動態作用與支承局部承壓，並確認井壁有足夠的傳力範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「工作盤支承」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The working platform carries personnel, machinery and materials, transferring reactions into the shaft wall or suspension system. Equal sharing is only an initial estimate: equipment eccentricity, support-level errors and stiffness differences can overload one support above the average, and temporary-member loads change with construction stage. The mean reaction is not a design maximum; actual checks include eccentricity, dynamics and local bearing, with adequate shaft-wall area to transfer the force. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Working-platform supports” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「四個支點在所有工況下必定各承受四分之一重量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

A ten-percent diameter increase produces only ten-percent more excavation volume.
quiz.explanation: 核對設備重心、支點標高與反力計，將實測反力總和及力矩與荷重清單比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check equipment centres of gravity, support elevations and load cells; compare the measured reaction sum and moment with the load inventory. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 工作盤支承的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Working-platform supports mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「工作盤支承」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Working-platform supports” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一個支點失去接觸會使荷重轉移，造成局部壓碎或盤面傾斜，而總重量並未改變。平均反力不是支點設計上限；實際檢核還須含偏心、動態作用與支承局部承壓，並確認井壁有足夠的傳力範圍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loss of contact at one support redistributes load, causing local crushing or platform tilt even though total weight is unchanged. The mean reaction is not a design maximum; actual checks include eccentricity, dynamics and local bearing, with adequate shaft-wall area to transfer the force. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均反力不是支點設計上限；實際檢核還須含偏心、動態作用與支承局部承壓，並確認井壁有足夠的傳力範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The mean reaction is not a design maximum; actual checks include eccentricity, dynamics and local bearing, with adequate shaft-wall area to transfer the force.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「四個支點在所有工況下必定各承受四分之一重量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Four supports necessarily carry one quarter of the load in every condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一個支點失去接觸會使荷重轉移，造成局部壓碎或盤面傾斜，而總重量並未改變。平均反力不是支點設計上限；實際檢核還須含偏心、動態作用與支承局部承壓，並確認井壁有足夠的傳力範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Loss of contact at one support redistributes load, causing local crushing or platform tilt even though total weight is unchanged. The mean reaction is not a design maximum; actual checks include eccentricity, dynamics and local bearing, with adequate shaft-wall area to transfer the force.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「工作盤支承的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Working-platform supports mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
一個支點失去接觸會使荷重轉移，造成局部壓碎或盤面傾斜，而總重量並未改變。
導向儀顯示垂直就不需要獨立測量複核。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Loss of contact at one support redistributes load, causing local crushing or platform tilt even though total weight is unchanged.
A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks.
quiz.explanation: 一個支點失去接觸會使荷重轉移，造成局部壓碎或盤面傾斜，而總重量並未改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Loss of contact at one support redistributes load, causing local crushing or platform tilt even though total weight is unchanged. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「垂直導向的機理與驗證」與「支護落後距的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Vertical alignment mechanism and verification" and "Support lag mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 垂直導向的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Vertical alignment mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「垂直導向」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vertical alignment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深井的微小方向誤差會隨深度累積為顯著偏移，影響設備間隙、襯砌厚度與後續永久設施。井口控制點若移動，單一雷射可能顯示穩定卻整體偏離，因此導向需要獨立測量網與分段閉合檢核，而非只觀察機械姿態。小角線性式只描述固定角誤差；真實曲線偏移應沿深度積分，且不同方向的誤差可能抵銷或疊加，不能只看最後井底點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「垂直導向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small directional error accumulates into substantial offset with depth, affecting equipment clearance, lining thickness and permanent installations. If a collar control point moves, one laser may appear stable while the entire alignment drifts. Guidance therefore needs an independent survey network and staged closure checks, not machinery attitude alone. The linear approximation describes constant angular error only; real curved deviation requires integration with depth, and directional errors can cancel or accumulate, so the final bottom point is insufficient. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vertical alignment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：深度L=300 m、假設恆定小角誤差θ=0.001 rad，偏移δ≈Lθ=0.30 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For depth L=300 m and constant small angular error θ=0.001 rad, offset δ≈Lθ=0.30 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「導向儀顯示垂直就不需要獨立測量複核。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「垂直導向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Vertical alignment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Small directional error accumulates into substantial offset with depth, affecting equipment clearance, lining thickness and permanent installations. If a collar control point moves, one laser may appear stable while the entire alignment drifts.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：導向儀顯示垂直就不需要獨立測量複核。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「垂直導向的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vertical alignment mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 導向儀顯示垂直就不需要獨立測量複核。
只要最終支護足夠厚，施工中裸露長度就不重要。
深井的微小方向誤差會隨深度累積為顯著偏移，影響設備間隙、襯砌厚度與後續永久設施。
optionsEn: A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks.
Adequate final support thickness makes temporary exposed length unimportant.
Small directional error accumulates into substantial offset with depth, affecting equipment clearance, lining thickness and permanent installations.
quiz.explanation: 深井的微小方向誤差會隨深度累積為顯著偏移，影響設備間隙、襯砌厚度與後續永久設施。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small directional error accumulates into substantial offset with depth, affecting equipment clearance, lining thickness and permanent installations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 垂直導向的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vertical alignment mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂直導向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vertical alignment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：深度L=300 m、假設恆定小角誤差θ=0.001 rad，偏移δ≈Lθ=0.30 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For depth L=300 m and constant small angular error θ=0.001 rad, offset δ≈Lθ=0.30 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立基準複測井口控制點，分深度比對雷射、垂線與斷面掃描，辨別基準漂移及真實偏斜。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Resurvey collar control independently and compare laser, plumb and scanned profiles by depth to distinguish datum movement from real inclination.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：深度L=300 m、假設恆定小角誤差θ=0.001 rad，偏移δ≈Lθ=0.30 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For depth L=300 m and constant small angular error θ=0.001 rad, offset δ≈Lθ=0.30 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「垂直導向的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 原創教學假設：深度L=300 m、假設恆定小角誤差θ=0.001 rad，偏移δ≈Lθ=0.30 m。
排水泵額定流量大於平均湧水量就沒有停機風險。
每個工序的額定產量相加就是整體施工產量。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For depth L=300 m and constant small angular error θ=0.001 rad, offset δ≈Lθ=0.30 m.
Pump nameplate capacity above average inflow eliminates outage risk.
Adding the rated capacities of all activities gives system throughput.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For depth L=300 m and constant small angular error θ=0.001 rad, offset δ≈Lθ=0.30 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 垂直導向的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vertical alignment mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「垂直導向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 以獨立基準複測井口控制點，分深度比對雷射、垂線與斷面掃描，辨別基準漂移及真實偏斜。每次控制點改設均保留前後轉換及閉合誤差；測量負責人確認後，才更新施工設備的導向座標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Resurvey collar control independently and compare laser, plumb and scanned profiles by depth to distinguish datum movement from real inclination. Retain transformations and closure errors whenever control is changed; the survey lead confirms them before machine guidance coordinates are updated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每次控制點改設均保留前後轉換及閉合誤差；測量負責人確認後，才更新施工設備的導向座標。小角線性式只描述固定角誤差；真實曲線偏移應沿深度積分，且不同方向的誤差可能抵銷或疊加，不能只看最後井底點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain transformations and closure errors whenever control is changed; the survey lead confirms them before machine guidance coordinates are updated. The linear approximation describes constant angular error only; real curved deviation requires integration with depth, and directional errors can cancel or accumulate, so the final bottom point is insufficient.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基準點漂移或儀器偏心會使井道逐步偏離，直到設備與襯砌間隙不足才顯現問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Control movement or instrument eccentricity can progressively misalign the shaft until equipment-to-lining clearance becomes insufficient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基準點漂移或儀器偏心會使井道逐步偏離，直到設備與襯砌間隙不足才顯現問題。小角線性式只描述固定角誤差；真實曲線偏移應沿深度積分，且不同方向的誤差可能抵銷或疊加，不能只看最後井底點。
knowledge.textEn: Control movement or instrument eccentricity can progressively misalign the shaft until equipment-to-lining clearance becomes insufficient. The linear approximation describes constant angular error only; real curved deviation requires integration with depth, and directional errors can cancel or accumulate, so the final bottom point is insufficient.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.instruction: 切削面與已完成支護之間的距離代表裸露井壁的空間與時間，不能只用每日進尺判斷穩定。節理、地下水與風化控制自立時間，支護施工慢於破岩時，落後距會逐步增加，令原先合理的工序變成新的不利暴露條件。此算例不是允許的裸露長度，亦未包含開挖擾動；穩定評估需結合節理幾何與觀測趨勢，不可用產能公式替代岩體分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護落後距」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The distance between excavation and completed support represents both exposed-wall length and exposure time; daily advance alone cannot establish stability. Joints, groundwater and weathering govern stand-up behaviour. When support progresses slower than cutting, lag grows and a previously acceptable sequence develops a new adverse exposure condition. This is not an allowable exposure length and excludes excavation disturbance; stability requires joint geometry and observed trends, not a production equation substituted for rock-mass analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support lag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: At constant advance v=0.4 m/h and support delay t=5 h, exposed length L=vt=2 m.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate final support thickness makes temporary exposed length unimportant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: At constant advance v=0.4 m/h and support delay t=5 h, exposed length L=vt=2 m. stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風流量的機理與驗證」與「湧水緩衝的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation flow mechanism and verification" and "Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風流量的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation flow mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通風流量」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 豎井通風須把新鮮空氣送到實際作業位置，再形成可辨識的回流路徑。管內平均速度與截面積決定風量，但漏風、短路循環和局部死角會使作業區的有效換氣低於管路量測，深度增加也會增加沿程壓損。體積流量不等於污染物控制標準；還須依污染源、設備排放與當地規範核定需求，本課數值不是作業許可。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shaft ventilation must deliver fresh air to the actual work location and establish a recognizable return path. Mean duct velocity and area determine flow, but leakage, recirculation short circuits and stagnant pockets can reduce effective workplace exchange below the duct measurement, while greater depth increases friction losses. Volumetric flow is not a contaminant-control criterion; demand also depends on sources, equipment emissions and local requirements, and this example does not authorize operations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設平均管速v=10 m/s、有效截面A=0.8 m²，Q=vA=8 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With mean duct velocity v=10 m/s and effective area A=0.8 m², Q=vA=8 m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風管測得足夠流量就能保證每個作業點的空氣品質。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate measured duct flow guarantees air quality at every work location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通風流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ventilation flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風流量的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 豎井通風須把新鮮空氣送到實際作業位置，再形成可辨識的回流路徑。管內平均速度與截面積決定風量，但漏風、短路循環和局部死角會使作業區的有效換氣低於管路量測，深度增加也會增加沿程壓損。
knowledge.textEn: Shaft ventilation must deliver fresh air to the actual work location and establish a recognizable return path. Mean duct velocity and area determine flow, but leakage, recirculation short circuits and stagnant pockets can reduce effective workplace exchange below the duct measurement, while greater depth increases friction losses.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風管測得足夠流量就能保證每個作業點的空氣品質。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate measured duct flow guarantees air quality at every work location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風流量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation flow mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 風管測得足夠流量就能保證每個作業點的空氣品質。
豎井通風須把新鮮空氣送到實際作業位置，再形成可辨識的回流路徑。
排水泵額定流量大於平均湧水量就沒有停機風險。
optionsEn: Adequate measured duct flow guarantees air quality at every work location.
Shaft ventilation must deliver fresh air to the actual work location and establish a recognizable return path.
Pump nameplate capacity above average inflow eliminates outage risk.
quiz.explanation: 豎井通風須把新鮮空氣送到實際作業位置，再形成可辨識的回流路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shaft ventilation must deliver fresh air to the actual work location and establish a recognizable return path. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風流量的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation flow mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通風流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設平均管速v=10 m/s、有效截面A=0.8 m²，Q=vA=8 m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: With mean duct velocity v=10 m/s and effective area A=0.8 m², Q=vA=8 m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以風速剖面量測取得平均值，並在進風、工作區與回風測氣體及粉塵，辨別循環短路。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure a velocity traverse for the mean and sample gases and dust at intake, workplace and return to identify recirculation short circuits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設平均管速v=10 m/s、有效截面A=0.8 m²，Q=vA=8 m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: With mean duct velocity v=10 m/s and effective area A=0.8 m², Q=vA=8 m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風流量的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation flow mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 每個工序的額定產量相加就是整體施工產量。
切削機額定功率越大就一定有同比例的進尺。
原創教學假設：假設平均管速v=10 m/s、有效截面A=0.8 m²，Q=vA=8 m³/s。
optionsEn: Adding the rated capacities of all activities gives system throughput.
Higher rated cutting power always gives proportionally higher advance.
Original teaching assumptions: With mean duct velocity v=10 m/s and effective area A=0.8 m², Q=vA=8 m³/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設平均管速v=10 m/s、有效截面A=0.8 m²，Q=vA=8 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: With mean duct velocity v=10 m/s and effective area A=0.8 m², Q=vA=8 m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通風流量的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation flow mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通風流量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ventilation flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以風速剖面量測取得平均值，並在進風、工作區與回風測氣體及粉塵，辨別循環短路。通風設計者需核准作業區量測位置及改管後驗證；任何風管延伸或工作盤配置變更都應重查有效換氣。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure a velocity traverse for the mean and sample gases and dust at intake, workplace and return to identify recirculation short circuits. The ventilation designer approves workplace sampling and post-modification verification; extending ducts or changing platform layout requires reassessment of effective air exchange. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：通風設計者需核准作業區量測位置及改管後驗證；任何風管延伸或工作盤配置變更都應重查有效換氣。體積流量不等於污染物控制標準；還須依污染源、設備排放與當地規範核定需求，本課數值不是作業許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The ventilation designer approves workplace sampling and post-modification verification; extending ducts or changing platform layout requires reassessment of effective air exchange. Volumetric flow is not a contaminant-control criterion; demand also depends on sources, equipment emissions and local requirements, and this example does not authorize operations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：風管流量合格仍可能因漏風或回流造成局部污染物累積，單點風速讀值會掩蓋死角。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An acceptable duct flow can coexist with local contaminant buildup from leakage or recirculation; one velocity reading may conceal stagnant zones. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以風速剖面量測取得平均值，並在進風、工作區與回風測氣體及粉塵，辨別循環短路。通風設計者需核准作業區量測位置及改管後驗證；任何風管延伸或工作盤配置變更都應重查有效換氣。
knowledge.textEn: Measure a velocity traverse for the mean and sample gases and dust at intake, workplace and return to identify recirculation short circuits. The ventilation designer approves workplace sampling and post-modification verification; extending ducts or changing platform layout requires reassessment of effective air exchange.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 通風設計者需核准作業區量測位置及改管後驗證；任何風管延伸或工作盤配置變更都應重查有效換氣。體積流量不等於污染物控制標準；還須依污染源、設備排放與當地規範核定需求，本課數值不是作業許可。
knowledge.textEn: The ventilation designer approves workplace sampling and post-modification verification; extending ducts or changing platform layout requires reassessment of effective air exchange. Volumetric flow is not a contaminant-control criterion; demand also depends on sources, equipment emissions and local requirements, and this example does not authorize operations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風流量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation flow mechanism and verification"?
options: 以風速剖面量測取得平均值，並在進風、工作區與回風測氣體及粉塵，辨別循環短路。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
四個支點在所有工況下必定各承受四分之一重量。
optionsEn: Measure a velocity traverse for the mean and sample gases and dust at intake, workplace and return to identify recirculation short circuits.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Four supports necessarily carry one quarter of the load in every condition.
quiz.explanation: 以風速剖面量測取得平均值，並在進風、工作區與回風測氣體及粉塵，辨別循環短路。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure a velocity traverse for the mean and sample gases and dust at intake, workplace and return to identify recirculation short circuits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通風流量的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation flow mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通風流量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ventilation flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 風管流量合格仍可能因漏風或回流造成局部污染物累積，單點風速讀值會掩蓋死角。體積流量不等於污染物控制標準；還須依污染源、設備排放與當地規範核定需求，本課數值不是作業許可。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An acceptable duct flow can coexist with local contaminant buildup from leakage or recirculation; one velocity reading may conceal stagnant zones. Volumetric flow is not a contaminant-control criterion; demand also depends on sources, equipment emissions and local requirements, and this example does not authorize operations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：體積流量不等於污染物控制標準；還須依污染源、設備排放與當地規範核定需求，本課數值不是作業許可。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Volumetric flow is not a contaminant-control criterion; demand also depends on sources, equipment emissions and local requirements, and this example does not authorize operations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風管測得足夠流量就能保證每個作業點的空氣品質。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate measured duct flow guarantees air quality at every work location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 風管流量合格仍可能因漏風或回流造成局部污染物累積，單點風速讀值會掩蓋死角。體積流量不等於污染物控制標準；還須依污染源、設備排放與當地規範核定需求，本課數值不是作業許可。
knowledge.textEn: An acceptable duct flow can coexist with local contaminant buildup from leakage or recirculation; one velocity reading may conceal stagnant zones. Volumetric flow is not a contaminant-control criterion; demand also depends on sources, equipment emissions and local requirements, and this example does not authorize operations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風流量的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation flow mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
風管流量合格仍可能因漏風或回流造成局部污染物累積，單點風速讀值會掩蓋死角。
排水泵額定流量大於平均湧水量就沒有停機風險。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An acceptable duct flow can coexist with local contaminant buildup from leakage or recirculation; one velocity reading may conceal stagnant zones.
Pump nameplate capacity above average inflow eliminates outage risk.
quiz.explanation: 風管流量合格仍可能因漏風或回流造成局部污染物累積，單點風速讀值會掩蓋死角。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An acceptable duct flow can coexist with local contaminant buildup from leakage or recirculation; one velocity reading may conceal stagnant zones. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 湧水緩衝的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「湧水緩衝」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water inflow buffer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井底集水與排水系統必須在湧水變動及設備停機期間保持可用空間。平均湧水量只能估算短時累積，裂隙連通或承壓層突破會使流量突然改變；泵浦曲線、排放背壓與備援供電共同決定可排出的實際水量。這是固定流量的儲水量估算，不包含突湧峰值或自由空間損失；容量分析必須扣除沉積物、泵浦與不可用高度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「湧水緩衝」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sump and pumping systems must preserve working space during changing inflow and equipment outages. Mean inflow estimates short-term accumulation only; connected fractures or penetration of a pressurized aquifer can change flow abruptly. Pump curves, discharge backpressure and backup power jointly determine actual removal rather than nameplate capacity alone. This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water inflow buffer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設停泵期間恆定流入Q=0.06 m³/s、停機t=600 s，新增水量V=Qt=36 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For constant inflow Q=0.06 m³/s during an outage t=600 s, accumulated volume V=Qt=36 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水泵額定流量大於平均湧水量就沒有停機風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pump nameplate capacity above average inflow eliminates outage risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「湧水緩衝」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water inflow buffer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 湧水緩衝的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 井底集水與排水系統必須在湧水變動及設備停機期間保持可用空間。平均湧水量只能估算短時累積，裂隙連通或承壓層突破會使流量突然改變；泵浦曲線、排放背壓與備援供電共同決定可排出的實際水量。
knowledge.textEn: Sump and pumping systems must preserve working space during changing inflow and equipment outages. Mean inflow estimates short-term accumulation only; connected fractures or penetration of a pressurized aquifer can change flow abruptly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水泵額定流量大於平均湧水量就沒有停機風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pump nameplate capacity above average inflow eliminates outage risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「湧水緩衝的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 排水泵額定流量大於平均湧水量就沒有停機風險。
設備可用率百分之九十就代表日進尺達理論值九成。
井底集水與排水系統必須在湧水變動及設備停機期間保持可用空間。
optionsEn: Pump nameplate capacity above average inflow eliminates outage risk.
Ninety-percent availability means daily advance reaches ninety percent of its theoretical value.
Sump and pumping systems must preserve working space during changing inflow and equipment outages.
quiz.explanation: 井底集水與排水系統必須在湧水變動及設備停機期間保持可用空間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sump and pumping systems must preserve working space during changing inflow and equipment outages. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 湧水緩衝的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「湧水緩衝」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water inflow buffer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設停泵期間恆定流入Q=0.06 m³/s、停機t=600 s，新增水量V=Qt=36 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For constant inflow Q=0.06 m³/s during an outage t=600 s, accumulated volume V=Qt=36 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以流量計、水位計及泵浦運轉紀錄建立入出水平衡，測試訊號失效與備援切換的可辨識性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use flow, level and pump logs for a water balance, checking whether signal failure and backup transfer remain detectable.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設停泵期間恆定流入Q=0.06 m³/s、停機t=600 s，新增水量V=Qt=36 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For constant inflow Q=0.06 m³/s during an outage t=600 s, accumulated volume V=Qt=36 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「湧水緩衝的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設停泵期間恆定流入Q=0.06 m³/s、停機t=600 s，新增水量V=Qt=36 m³。
井徑增加百分之十，開挖體積也只增加百分之十。
提升速度與容器容量足以單獨決定實際日產量。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For constant inflow Q=0.06 m³/s during an outage t=600 s, accumulated volume V=Qt=36 m³.
A ten-percent diameter increase produces only ten-percent more excavation volume.
Hoisting speed and bucket capacity alone determine actual daily production.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設停泵期間恆定流入Q=0.06 m³/s、停機t=600 s，新增水量V=Qt=36 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For constant inflow Q=0.06 m³/s during an outage t=600 s, accumulated volume V=Qt=36 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 湧水緩衝的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「湧水緩衝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water inflow buffer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以流量計、水位計及泵浦運轉紀錄建立入出水平衡，測試訊號失效與備援切換的可辨識性。湧水增加與液位上升應有獨立警報；備援能力及停留點由排水、地工與施工負責人共同核定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use flow, level and pump logs for a water balance, checking whether signal failure and backup transfer remain detectable. Provide independent inflow and level alarms; drainage, geotechnical and construction leads jointly approve backup capability and operational hold points. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：湧水增加與液位上升應有獨立警報；備援能力及停留點由排水、地工與施工負責人共同核定。這是固定流量的儲水量估算，不包含突湧峰值或自由空間損失；容量分析必須扣除沉積物、泵浦與不可用高度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Provide independent inflow and level alarms; drainage, geotechnical and construction leads jointly approve backup capability and operational hold points. This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：集水容積不足或備援不能啟動會使水位淹及設備，並改變井底穩定與撤離條件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient sump storage or failed backup raises water over equipment and changes bottom stability and evacuation conditions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Use flow, level and pump logs for a water balance, checking whether signal failure and backup transfer remain detectable. Provide independent inflow and level alarms; drainage, geotechnical and construction leads jointly approve backup capability and operational hold points.
