This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth.

quiz.question: 要驗證「湧水緩衝的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以流量計、水位計及泵浦運轉紀錄建立入出水平衡，測試訊號失效與備援切換的可辨識性。
導向儀顯示垂直就不需要獨立測量複核。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Use flow, level and pump logs for a water balance, checking whether signal failure and backup transfer remain detectable.
A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks.
quiz.explanation: 以流量計、水位計及泵浦運轉紀錄建立入出水平衡，測試訊號失效與備援切換的可辨識性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use flow, level and pump logs for a water balance, checking whether signal failure and backup transfer remain detectable. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 湧水緩衝的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「湧水緩衝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water inflow buffer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 集水容積不足或備援不能啟動會使水位淹及設備，並改變井底穩定與撤離條件。這是固定流量的儲水量估算，不包含突湧峰值或自由空間損失；容量分析必須扣除沉積物、泵浦與不可用高度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient sump storage or failed backup raises water over equipment and changes bottom stability and evacuation conditions. This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是固定流量的儲水量估算，不包含突湧峰值或自由空間損失；容量分析必須扣除沉積物、泵浦與不可用高度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水泵額定流量大於平均湧水量就沒有停機風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pump nameplate capacity above average inflow eliminates outage risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 集水容積不足或備援不能啟動會使水位淹及設備，並改變井底穩定與撤離條件。這是固定流量的儲水量估算，不包含突湧峰值或自由空間損失；容量分析必須扣除沉積物、泵浦與不可用高度。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient sump storage or failed backup raises water over equipment and changes bottom stability and evacuation conditions. This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「湧水緩衝的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
設備可用率百分之九十就代表日進尺達理論值九成。
集水容積不足或備援不能啟動會使水位淹及設備，並改變井底穩定與撤離條件。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Ninety-percent availability means daily advance reaches ninety percent of its theoretical value.
Insufficient sump storage or failed backup raises water over equipment and changes bottom stability and evacuation conditions.
quiz.explanation: 集水容積不足或備援不能啟動會使水位淹及設備，並改變井底穩定與撤離條件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient sump storage or failed backup raises water over equipment and changes bottom stability and evacuation conditions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設備可用率的機理與驗證」與「系統瓶頸的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equipment availability mechanism and verification" and "System bottleneck mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設備可用率的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equipment availability mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「設備可用率」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equipment availability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機械可用率描述設備具備運轉能力的時間比例，不能與實際利用率或工地進尺混為一談。預防維護可能短時降低排程可用時間，卻減少重大故障；等待支護、通風或材料則屬系統協調問題，應與設備自身故障分開編碼。此可用率式假設長期穩態且故障修復定義一致；它不包含計畫休班、施工等待或地層限制，不能直接作為工程進度保證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「設備可用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mechanical availability describes the fraction of time equipment is capable of operating, not utilization or achieved advance. Preventive maintenance can reduce scheduled available time temporarily while avoiding major failures. Waiting for support, ventilation or supplies belongs to system coordination and should be coded separately from intrinsic machinery failure. The expression assumes a long-run steady state and consistent failure-repair definitions; it excludes planned shifts, construction waiting and ground limits and therefore cannot guarantee project progress. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equipment availability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設平均運轉至故障MTBF=80 h、平均修復MTTR=8 h，A=MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR)=0.909。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With mean time between failures MTBF=80 h and mean repair time MTTR=8 h, A=MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR)=0.909.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備可用率百分之九十就代表日進尺達理論值九成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ninety-percent availability means daily advance reaches ninety percent of its theoretical value." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「設備可用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equipment availability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設備可用率的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 機械可用率描述設備具備運轉能力的時間比例，不能與實際利用率或工地進尺混為一談。預防維護可能短時降低排程可用時間，卻減少重大故障；等待支護、通風或材料則屬系統協調問題，應與設備自身故障分開編碼。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical availability describes the fraction of time equipment is capable of operating, not utilization or achieved advance. Preventive maintenance can reduce scheduled available time temporarily while avoiding major failures.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備可用率百分之九十就代表日進尺達理論值九成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Ninety-percent availability means daily advance reaches ninety percent of its theoretical value. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設備可用率的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equipment availability mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 機械可用率描述設備具備運轉能力的時間比例，不能與實際利用率或工地進尺混為一談。
設備可用率百分之九十就代表日進尺達理論值九成。
每個工序的額定產量相加就是整體施工產量。
optionsEn: Mechanical availability describes the fraction of time equipment is capable of operating, not utilization or achieved advance.
Ninety-percent availability means daily advance reaches ninety percent of its theoretical value.
Adding the rated capacities of all activities gives system throughput.
quiz.explanation: 機械可用率描述設備具備運轉能力的時間比例，不能與實際利用率或工地進尺混為一談。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「系統瓶頸的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

導向儀顯示垂直就不需要獨立測量複核。
原創教學假設：全部換成原位等值後，切削90、提升120、支護70 m³/h，理想穩態Q=min(90,120,70)=70 m³/h。
optionsEn: Hoisting speed and bucket capacity alone determine actual daily production.
A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks.
Original teaching assumptions: On one in-situ-equivalent basis, cutting, hoisting and support capacities are 90, 120 and 70 m³/h.

steps.title: 系統瓶頸的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: System bottleneck mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「系統瓶頸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “System bottleneck” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊工序時間戳與體積基準，追蹤排隊長度、暫存量及支護完成深度，確認最慢環節是否持續存在。日報應把各工序等值產量與等待原因並列；任何增產方案由施工及臨時工程設計者共同審查支護與緩衝容量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align activity clocks and volume bases, then track queues, buffer volumes and completed-support depth to determine whether the apparent bottleneck persists. Daily reports show equivalent activity outputs beside waiting causes; construction and temporary-works leads jointly review support and buffer capacity for any production increase. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：日報應把各工序等值產量與等待原因並列；任何增產方案由施工及臨時工程設計者共同審查支護與緩衝容量。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Daily reports show equivalent activity outputs beside waiting causes; construction and temporary-works leads jointly review support and buffer capacity for any production increase. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A larger cutter alone may increase cost without improving throughput while overloading the planned support and drainage coordination. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Daily reports show equivalent activity outputs beside waiting causes; construction and temporary-works leads jointly review support and buffer capacity for any production increase.

quiz.question: 要驗證「系統瓶頸的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System bottleneck mechanism and verification"?
options: 對齊工序時間戳與體積基準，追蹤排隊長度、暫存量及支護完成深度，確認最慢環節是否持續存在。

quiz.explanationEn: Align activity clocks and volume bases, then track queues, buffer volumes and completed-support depth to determine whether the apparent bottleneck persists. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 系統瓶頸的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System bottleneck mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「系統瓶頸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “System bottleneck” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A larger cutter alone may increase cost without improving throughput while overloading the planned support and drainage coordination. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個工序的額定產量相加就是整體施工產量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding the rated capacities of all activities gives system throughput." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。
knowledge.textEn: A larger cutter alone may increase cost without improving throughput while overloading the planned support and drainage coordination. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「系統瓶頸的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System bottleneck mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。
井徑增加百分之十，開挖體積也只增加百分之十。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A larger cutter alone may increase cost without improving throughput while overloading the planned support and drainage coordination.
A ten-percent diameter increase produces only ten-percent more excavation volume.
quiz.explanation: 只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A larger cutter alone may increase cost without improving throughput while overloading the planned support and drainage coordination. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 地下岩洞穹頂支護
summary: 大跨度岩洞的穩定同時受到節理幾何、開挖卸載、支護剛度及三維交叉口影響。本課分開討論可脫落楔塊與整體岩體拱效應，讓學徒用力學模型、應變監測及反算辨別真正的荷載路徑，再檢查地震與排水退化如何改變既有支護的需求。
summaryEn: Large-span cavern stability depends on joints, excavation unloading, support stiffness and three-dimensional intersections. This course distinguishes detachable wedges from rock-mass arching, uses force models, strain monitoring and back-analysis to identify load paths, and evaluates how seismic action and drainage deterioration change support demand.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設穹頂可動楔塊體積V=12 m³，岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=312 kN。若地質測繪使估計體積增加10%至13.2 m³，重量增為343.2 kN，增加31.2 kN。這個結果只修改重力項，不表示所需錨力也一定按相同比例增加，因為楔塊形狀改變可能同時影響節理接觸面、出露方向與錨索穿越位置。必須重新建立三維自由體圖，檢查水壓、摩擦及錨固，再用獨立地質觀測確認模型。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume a potentially movable crown wedge of V=12 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Its weight is W=γV=312 kN. If mapping increases the estimated volume by 10% to 13.2 m³, weight becomes 343.2 kN, an increase of 31.2 kN. This changes gravity only; required cable force need not increase by the same percentage because revised geometry may also change joint contact area, daylighting direction and cable intersections. Rebuild the three-dimensional free body, check water pressure, friction and anchorage, and corroborate the geometry with independent geological observations.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「節理楔塊的機理與驗證」與「岩拱應力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint wedge mechanism and verification" and "Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint wedge mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「節理楔塊」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint wedge” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。楔塊是否形成取決於節理傾向、傾角及延續性，不能只從單一剖面推斷；重量則是滑移或掉落分析的基本荷載。重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「節理楔塊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong. Formation depends on joint dip, direction and persistence and cannot be inferred from one section alone. Block weight is the basic load for a sliding or falling mechanism. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint wedge” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³、假設楔塊體積V=12 m³，W=γV=312 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³ and assumed wedge volume V=12 m³, W=γV=312 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「節理楔塊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint wedge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。楔塊是否形成取決於節理傾向、傾角及延續性，不能只從單一剖面推斷；重量則是滑移或掉落分析的基本荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong. Formation depends on joint dip, direction and persistence and cannot be inferred from one section alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節理楔塊的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint wedge mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。
岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。
上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。
optionsEn: High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls.
Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong.
All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell.
quiz.explanation: 岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint wedge mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節理楔塊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint wedge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³、假設楔塊體積V=12 m³，W=γV=312 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: With rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³ and assumed wedge volume V=12 m³, W=γV=312 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用掌子面與穹頂測繪建立三維節理面，對可能出露的塊體核對延續性與體積，不把所有交線當真實裂面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build three-dimensional joint planes from face and crown mapping, verifying persistence and volume of potentially daylighting blocks rather than treating every intersection as a real release surface.

steps.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Build three-dimensional joint planes from face and crown mapping, verifying persistence and volume of potentially daylighting blocks rather than treating every intersection as a real release surface. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain joint-confidence levels and unexposed areas in the geological model; the geotechnical designer reassesses wedge support when new joints are exposed. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：節理延續性低估會漏掉大楔塊，局部落石常是幾何失穩的先兆，不能以平均岩體評分忽略。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 節理延續性低估會漏掉大楔塊，局部落石常是幾何失穩的先兆，不能以平均岩體評分忽略。重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 岩拱應力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩拱應力」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rock-arch stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下開挖把原先穿越洞室的應力重新分配到穹頂與側牆，岩體可形成拱狀傳力，但拱腳必須有足夠拘束。上覆地層重量提供初始應力量級，實際水平應力及構造作用則可能主導局部壓碎、剝落或高側牆變形。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩拱應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation redirects stresses that previously crossed the cavern into the crown and sidewalls, allowing arch-like transfer only if the abutments retain confinement. Overburden weight gives an initial stress scale, while horizontal and tectonic stresses may govern local crushing, spalling or tall-wall deformation. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rock-arch stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設均質覆岩γ=26 kN/m³、深度H=100 m，垂直應力σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For homogeneous overburden γ=26 kN/m³ and depth H=100 m, vertical stress σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩拱應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rock-arch stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

噴凝土表面看起來連續就具有均勻厚度與韌性。
開口率相同的兩個交叉口一定具有相同穩定性。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For homogeneous overburden γ=26 kN/m³ and depth H=100 m, vertical stress σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa.
A continuous-looking shotcrete surface has uniform thickness and toughness.
Two intersections with the same opening ratio have the same stability.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設均質覆岩γ=26 kN/m³、深度H=100 m，垂直應力σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For homogeneous overburden γ=26 kN/m³ and depth H=100 m, vertical stress σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 岩拱應力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩拱應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rock-arch stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照覆岩地形與原位應力量測，追蹤穹頂及側牆收斂方向，檢查數值模型的拱腳反力位置。分層開挖方案須同時檢查穹頂及拱腳，不可只更新拱頂斷面；側牆開挖停留點由岩洞設計者確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare overburden topography and in-situ stress measurements, track crown and sidewall convergence directions, and inspect arch-abutment reactions in the numerical model. Stage analysis must update both crown and abutments, not only the roof section; the cavern designer confirms hold points for sidewall excavation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分層開挖方案須同時檢查穹頂及拱腳，不可只更新拱頂斷面；側牆開挖停留點由岩洞設計者確認。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Stage analysis must update both crown and abutments, not only the roof section; the cavern designer confirms hold points for sidewall excavation. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：側牆卸載破壞拱腳拘束時，穹頂支護需求會增加；單看拱頂位移小可能漏掉側向失穩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sidewall unloading can weaken arch confinement and increase crown-support demand; small crown movement alone may conceal a developing lateral instability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照覆岩地形與原位應力量測，追蹤穹頂及側牆收斂方向，檢查數值模型的拱腳反力位置。分層開挖方案須同時檢查穹頂及拱腳，不可只更新拱頂斷面；側牆開挖停留點由岩洞設計者確認。
knowledge.textEn: Compare overburden topography and in-situ stress measurements, track crown and sidewall convergence directions, and inspect arch-abutment reactions in the numerical model. Stage analysis must update both crown and abutments, not only the roof section; the cavern designer confirms hold points for sidewall excavation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 分層開挖方案須同時檢查穹頂及拱腳，不可只更新拱頂斷面；側牆開挖停留點由岩洞設計者確認。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。
knowledge.textEn: Stage analysis must update both crown and abutments, not only the roof section; the cavern designer confirms hold points for sidewall excavation. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩拱應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對照覆岩地形與原位應力量測，追蹤穹頂及側牆收斂方向，檢查數值模型的拱腳反力位置。
地下岩洞不受地表搖動，所以支護不用耐震檢查。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare overburden topography and in-situ stress measurements, track crown and sidewall convergence directions, and inspect arch-abutment reactions in the numerical model.
Underground caverns do not experience surface shaking, so support needs no seismic checks.
quiz.explanation: 對照覆岩地形與原位應力量測，追蹤穹頂及側牆收斂方向，檢查數值模型的拱腳反力位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare overburden topography and in-situ stress measurements, track crown and sidewall convergence directions, and inspect arch-abutment reactions in the numerical model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岩拱應力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩拱應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rock-arch stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 側牆卸載破壞拱腳拘束時，穹頂支護需求會增加；單看拱頂位移小可能漏掉側向失穩。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sidewall unloading can weaken arch confinement and increase crown-support demand; small crown movement alone may conceal a developing lateral instability. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 側牆卸載破壞拱腳拘束時，穹頂支護需求會增加；單看拱頂位移小可能漏掉側向失穩。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。
knowledge.textEn: Sidewall unloading can weaken arch confinement and increase crown-support demand; small crown movement alone may conceal a developing lateral instability. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩拱應力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
洞室跨度變大時，只按跨度比例增加支護即可。
側牆卸載破壞拱腳拘束時，穹頂支護需求會增加；單看拱頂位移小可能漏掉側向失穩。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Support only needs to increase linearly with cavern span.
Sidewall unloading can weaken arch confinement and increase crown-support demand; small crown movement alone may conceal a developing lateral instability.
quiz.explanation: 側牆卸載破壞拱腳拘束時，穹頂支護需求會增加；單看拱頂位移小可能漏掉側向失穩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sidewall unloading can weaken arch confinement and increase crown-support demand; small crown movement alone may conceal a developing lateral instability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「跨度效應的機理與驗證」與「錨索分力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Span effect mechanism and verification" and "Cable support component mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 跨度效應的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Span effect mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「跨度效應」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Span effect” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 增加岩洞跨度會增加支護跨越弱區的需求，也改變節理楔塊可形成的尺寸。均布荷載簡支梁的平方尺度可提醒跨度敏感度，但岩洞不是自由梁，實際承載由岩體、噴凝土及錨索共同提供，不能把梁式直接當岩洞設計公式。這個比值只對假設的梁系統成立，並非任何實際岩洞的承載力比例；尺寸放大還可能改變節理機制與施工方法。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「跨度效應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Greater cavern span increases the distance support must bridge across weak ground and changes possible wedge dimensions. The squared-span scaling of a uniformly loaded simple beam illustrates sensitivity, but a cavern is not a free beam: rock, shotcrete and anchors share resistance, so the beam relation is not a cavern design equation. The ratio applies only to the assumed beam system, not the resistance of an actual cavern; scaling geometry can also change joint mechanisms and construction methods. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Span effect” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：僅作等載重簡支梁比較，L₁=18 m、L₂=24 m，M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Only for equal-load simple-beam comparison, L₁=18 m and L₂=24 m give M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「洞室跨度變大時，只按跨度比例增加支護即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Support only needs to increase linearly with cavern span." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「跨度效應」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Span effect”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 跨度效應的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 增加岩洞跨度會增加支護跨越弱區的需求，也改變節理楔塊可形成的尺寸。均布荷載簡支梁的平方尺度可提醒跨度敏感度，但岩洞不是自由梁，實際承載由岩體、噴凝土及錨索共同提供，不能把梁式直接當岩洞設計公式。
knowledge.textEn: Greater cavern span increases the distance support must bridge across weak ground and changes possible wedge dimensions. The squared-span scaling of a uniformly loaded simple beam illustrates sensitivity, but a cavern is not a free beam: rock, shotcrete and anchors share resistance, so the beam relation is not a cavern design equation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：洞室跨度變大時，只按跨度比例增加支護即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Support only needs to increase linearly with cavern span. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「跨度效應的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Span effect mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 增加岩洞跨度會增加支護跨越弱區的需求，也改變節理楔塊可形成的尺寸。
洞室跨度變大時，只按跨度比例增加支護即可。
錨索總張力直接相加就是任意方向的支護力。
optionsEn: Greater cavern span increases the distance support must bridge across weak ground and changes possible wedge dimensions.
Support only needs to increase linearly with cavern span.
Adding cable tensions directly gives support resistance in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 增加岩洞跨度會增加支護跨越弱區的需求，也改變節理楔塊可形成的尺寸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Greater cavern span increases the distance support must bridge across weak ground and changes possible wedge dimensions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 跨度效應的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Span effect mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨度效應」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Span effect” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：僅作等載重簡支梁比較，L₁=18 m、L₂=24 m，M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Only for equal-load simple-beam comparison, L₁=18 m and L₂=24 m give M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較各跨度方案的地質暴露、楔塊幾何與支護位移，使用同一材料及邊界條件檢查敏感度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare geological exposure, wedge geometry and support displacement across span alternatives, keeping material and boundary assumptions consistent in the sensitivity study.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：僅作等載重簡支梁比較，L₁=18 m、L₂=24 m，M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Only for equal-load simple-beam comparison, L₁=18 m and L₂=24 m give M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「跨度效應的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Span effect mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 量到應變後乘上固定模數即可得到精確永久應力。
原創教學假設：僅作等載重簡支梁比較，L₁=18 m、L₂=24 m，M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78。
模型配合一個監測點就證明所有地層參數正確。
optionsEn: Measured strain times one constant modulus gives exact permanent stress.
Original teaching assumptions: Only for equal-load simple-beam comparison, L₁=18 m and L₂=24 m give M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78.
Matching one monitoring point proves every ground parameter is correct.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：僅作等載重簡支梁比較，L₁=18 m、L₂=24 m，M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Only for equal-load simple-beam comparison, L₁=18 m and L₂=24 m give M₂/M₁=(L₂/L₁)²=(24/18)²=1.78. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 跨度效應的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Span effect mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨度效應」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Span effect” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較各跨度方案的地質暴露、楔塊幾何與支護位移，使用同一材料及邊界條件檢查敏感度。方案比較應把模型形式與不變參數列清楚；結構及地工設計者共同確認何時必須改採三維岩體分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 錨索分力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cable support component mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「錨索分力」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cable support component” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穹頂錨索須跨越可能移動的岩塊並錨入穩定岩體，才能提供有效拘束。錨力沿索軸傳遞，只有對抗位移方向的分量直接抗衡掉落；錨索角度也可能增加節理法向力而改變摩擦，但需要在自由體圖中明確計入。分力總和未檢查群體作用、鋼材容量或長期損失，也不代表每支錨索均勻受力；應另核對變形相容與試驗證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錨索分力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crown cables must cross the moving block and bond into stable rock to provide restraint. Force acts along the cable, and only its component opposing motion directly resists falling. Cable inclination may also increase joint normal force and friction, but that contribution must be represented explicitly in the free-body model. The component sum omits group effects, steel resistance and long-term losses and does not prove equal cable loading; check deformation compatibility and test evidence separately. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cable support component” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：4支錨索各T=150 kN、與抗落方向夾角θ=30°，有效分力R=4Tcosθ=520 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For four cables each carrying T=150 kN at θ=30° to the resisting direction, R=4Tcosθ=520 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錨索總張力直接相加就是任意方向的支護力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding cable tensions directly gives support resistance in every direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「錨索分力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cable support component”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Crown cables must cross the moving block and bond into stable rock to provide restraint. Force acts along the cable, and only its component opposing motion directly resists falling.

knowledge.text: 誤解：錨索總張力直接相加就是任意方向的支護力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding cable tensions directly gives support resistance in every direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 錨索分力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cable support component mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨索分力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cable support component” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：4支錨索各T=150 kN、與抗落方向夾角θ=30°，有效分力R=4Tcosθ=520 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For four cables each carrying T=150 kN at θ=30° to the resisting direction, R=4Tcosθ=520 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對鑽孔方向、錨碇段位置及張力紀錄，以載重試驗檢查錨固行為，再把實際角度帶入力平衡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify bore direction, bond-zone position and force records, use load tests to assess anchorage, and insert actual angles into equilibrium.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For four cables each carrying T=150 kN at θ=30° to the resisting direction, R=4Tcosθ=520 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

The component sum omits group effects, steel resistance and long-term losses and does not prove equal cable loading; check deformation compatibility and test evidence separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錨碇段仍位於可動楔塊內時，張拉成功不代表已把力傳入穩定岩體，可能整組一同移動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A bond zone inside the moving wedge may tension successfully without transferring force into stable ground, allowing the whole assembly to move together. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 核對鑽孔方向、錨碇段位置及張力紀錄，以載重試驗檢查錨固行為，再把實際角度帶入力平衡。竣工圖要標出自由段、錨碇段與節理面的相對位置；地工設計者確認錨定區穩定後才放行支護驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Verify bore direction, bond-zone position and force records, use load tests to assess anchorage, and insert actual angles into equilibrium. As-built drawings show free and bond lengths relative to joints; the geotechnical designer confirms stable anchorage before support acceptance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 竣工圖要標出自由段、錨碇段與節理面的相對位置；地工設計者確認錨定區穩定後才放行支護驗收。分力總和未檢查群體作用、鋼材容量或長期損失，也不代表每支錨索均勻受力；應另核對變形相容與試驗證據。
knowledge.textEn: As-built drawings show free and bond lengths relative to joints; the geotechnical designer confirms stable anchorage before support acceptance. The component sum omits group effects, steel resistance and long-term losses and does not prove equal cable loading; check deformation compatibility and test evidence separately.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨索分力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cable support component mechanism and verification"?
options: 核對鑽孔方向、錨碇段位置及張力紀錄，以載重試驗檢查錨固行為，再把實際角度帶入力平衡。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。
optionsEn: Verify bore direction, bond-zone position and force records, use load tests to assess anchorage, and insert actual angles into equilibrium.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls.
quiz.explanation: 核對鑽孔方向、錨碇段位置及張力紀錄，以載重試驗檢查錨固行為，再把實際角度帶入力平衡。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify bore direction, bond-zone position and force records, use load tests to assess anchorage, and insert actual angles into equilibrium. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 錨索分力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cable support component mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨索分力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cable support component” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錨碇段仍位於可動楔塊內時，張拉成功不代表已把力傳入穩定岩體，可能整組一同移動。分力總和未檢查群體作用、鋼材容量或長期損失，也不代表每支錨索均勻受力；應另核對變形相容與試驗證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A bond zone inside the moving wedge may tension successfully without transferring force into stable ground, allowing the whole assembly to move together. The component sum omits group effects, steel resistance and long-term losses and does not prove equal cable loading; check deformation compatibility and test evidence separately. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分力總和未檢查群體作用、鋼材容量或長期損失，也不代表每支錨索均勻受力；應另核對變形相容與試驗證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The component sum omits group effects, steel resistance and long-term losses and does not prove equal cable loading; check deformation compatibility and test evidence separately.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錨索總張力直接相加就是任意方向的支護力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding cable tensions directly gives support resistance in every direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錨碇段仍位於可動楔塊內時，張拉成功不代表已把力傳入穩定岩體，可能整組一同移動。分力總和未檢查群體作用、鋼材容量或長期損失，也不代表每支錨索均勻受力；應另核對變形相容與試驗證據。
knowledge.textEn: A bond zone inside the moving wedge may tension successfully without transferring force into stable ground, allowing the whole assembly to move together. The component sum omits group effects, steel resistance and long-term losses and does not prove equal cable loading; check deformation compatibility and test evidence separately.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錨索分力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cable support component mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
錨碇段仍位於可動楔塊內時，張拉成功不代表已把力傳入穩定岩體，可能整組一同移動。
噴凝土表面看起來連續就具有均勻厚度與韌性。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A bond zone inside the moving wedge may tension successfully without transferring force into stable ground, allowing the whole assembly to move together.
A continuous-looking shotcrete surface has uniform thickness and toughness.
quiz.explanation: 錨碇段仍位於可動楔塊內時，張拉成功不代表已把力傳入穩定岩體，可能整組一同移動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A bond zone inside the moving wedge may tension successfully without transferring force into stable ground, allowing the whole assembly to move together. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「噴凝土面板的機理與驗證」與「應變換算的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shotcrete panel mechanism and verification" and "Strain conversion mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 噴凝土面板的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shotcrete panel mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「噴凝土面板」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shotcrete panel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 噴凝土可束制小塊岩石並與錨桿形成局部面板系統，厚度、纖維殘餘強度及與岩面黏結共同影響其性能。面板平均壓力只能描述總荷載除以面積，不能說明孔邊沖切、薄弱處彎曲或早齡期承載是否足夠。均布壓力並不代表真正局部荷載形狀，面板需依支點與岩塊接觸重新分析；本式不能取代噴凝土構件驗算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「噴凝土面板」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shotcrete restrains small blocks and forms local panels with rock bolts; thickness, fibre residual strength and rock adhesion jointly govern performance. Average panel pressure is only total load divided by area and does not establish resistance to punching near bolts, bending at thin spots or loading at early age. Uniform pressure does not establish the actual contact pattern; panels require analysis with their supports and block contacts, and this expression cannot replace member checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shotcrete panel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設局部岩塊荷重W=20 kN、分配面板面積A=4 m²，平均q=W/A=5 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For local block load W=20 kN distributed over panel area A=4 m², mean q=W/A=5 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「噴凝土表面看起來連續就具有均勻厚度與韌性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A continuous-looking shotcrete surface has uniform thickness and toughness." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「噴凝土面板」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Shotcrete panel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 噴凝土面板的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 噴凝土可束制小塊岩石並與錨桿形成局部面板系統，厚度、纖維殘餘強度及與岩面黏結共同影響其性能。面板平均壓力只能描述總荷載除以面積，不能說明孔邊沖切、薄弱處彎曲或早齡期承載是否足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Shotcrete restrains small blocks and forms local panels with rock bolts; thickness, fibre residual strength and rock adhesion jointly govern performance. Average panel pressure is only total load divided by area and does not establish resistance to punching near bolts, bending at thin spots or loading at early age.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：噴凝土表面看起來連續就具有均勻厚度與韌性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A continuous-looking shotcrete surface has uniform thickness and toughness. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「噴凝土面板的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shotcrete panel mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 噴凝土表面看起來連續就具有均勻厚度與韌性。
量到應變後乘上固定模數即可得到精確永久應力。
噴凝土可束制小塊岩石並與錨桿形成局部面板系統，厚度、纖維殘餘強度及與岩面黏結共同影響其性能。
optionsEn: A continuous-looking shotcrete surface has uniform thickness and toughness.
Measured strain times one constant modulus gives exact permanent stress.
Shotcrete restrains small blocks and forms local panels with rock bolts; thickness, fibre residual strength and rock adhesion jointly govern performance.
quiz.explanation: 噴凝土可束制小塊岩石並與錨桿形成局部面板系統，厚度、纖維殘餘強度及與岩面黏結共同影響其性能。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shotcrete restrains small blocks and forms local panels with rock bolts; thickness, fibre residual strength and rock adhesion jointly govern performance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 噴凝土面板的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shotcrete panel mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「噴凝土面板」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shotcrete panel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設局部岩塊荷重W=20 kN、分配面板面積A=4 m²，平均q=W/A=5 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For local block load W=20 kN distributed over panel area A=4 m², mean q=W/A=5 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用厚度針、取芯及面板試驗核對厚度與韌性，檢查錨頭附近薄弱區；將材料齡期與實際加載時間配對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check thickness and toughness using depth pins, cores and panel tests, inspect thin zones near bolt heads, and match material age to actual loading time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設局部岩塊荷重W=20 kN、分配面板面積A=4 m²，平均q=W/A=5 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For local block load W=20 kN distributed over panel area A=4 m², mean q=W/A=5 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「噴凝土面板的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shotcrete panel mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設局部岩塊荷重W=20 kN、分配面板面積A=4 m²，平均q=W/A=5 kPa。
模型配合一個監測點就證明所有地層參數正確。
排水量減少一定表示岩洞變得更乾燥且更穩定。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For local block load W=20 kN distributed over panel area A=4 m², mean q=W/A=5 kPa.
Matching one monitoring point proves every ground parameter is correct.
Lower drain flow always means a drier and more stable cavern.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設局部岩塊荷重W=20 kN、分配面板面積A=4 m²，平均q=W/A=5 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For local block load W=20 kN distributed over panel area A=4 m², mean q=W/A=5 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 噴凝土面板的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shotcrete panel mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「噴凝土面板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shotcrete panel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用厚度針、取芯及面板試驗核對厚度與韌性，檢查錨頭附近薄弱區；將材料齡期與實際加載時間配對。檢驗計畫應把厚度、黏結及殘餘強度分列；未達指定齡期與試驗要求前，由支護設計者確認後續開挖限制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check thickness and toughness using depth pins, cores and panel tests, inspect thin zones near bolt heads, and match material age to actual loading time. The inspection plan separates thickness, bond and residual-strength evidence; the support designer confirms excavation restrictions until specified age and test requirements are satisfied. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢驗計畫應把厚度、黏結及殘餘強度分列；未達指定齡期與試驗要求前，由支護設計者確認後續開挖限制。均布壓力並不代表真正局部荷載形狀，面板需依支點與岩塊接觸重新分析；本式不能取代噴凝土構件驗算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The inspection plan separates thickness, bond and residual-strength evidence; the support designer confirms excavation restrictions until specified age and test requirements are satisfied. Uniform pressure does not establish the actual contact pattern; panels require analysis with their supports and block contacts, and this expression cannot replace member checks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：表面平整但局部過薄或背後脫黏，會使面板突然剝落；只驗抗壓強度可能漏掉韌性不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A smooth surface can conceal thin spots or debonding that cause panel detachment; compressive strength alone may miss inadequate toughness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用厚度針、取芯及面板試驗核對厚度與韌性，檢查錨頭附近薄弱區；將材料齡期與實際加載時間配對。檢驗計畫應把厚度、黏結及殘餘強度分列；未達指定齡期與試驗要求前，由支護設計者確認後續開挖限制。
knowledge.textEn: Check thickness and toughness using depth pins, cores and panel tests, inspect thin zones near bolt heads, and match material age to actual loading time. The inspection plan separates thickness, bond and residual-strength evidence; the support designer confirms excavation restrictions until specified age and test requirements are satisfied.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 檢驗計畫應把厚度、黏結及殘餘強度分列；未達指定齡期與試驗要求前，由支護設計者確認後續開挖限制。均布壓力並不代表真正局部荷載形狀，面板需依支點與岩塊接觸重新分析；本式不能取代噴凝土構件驗算。

Uniform pressure does not establish the actual contact pattern; panels require analysis with their supports and block contacts, and this expression cannot replace member checks.

quiz.question: 要驗證「噴凝土面板的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shotcrete panel mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用厚度針、取芯及面板試驗核對厚度與韌性，檢查錨頭附近薄弱區；將材料齡期與實際加載時間配對。

quiz.explanation: 用厚度針、取芯及面板試驗核對厚度與韌性，檢查錨頭附近薄弱區；將材料齡期與實際加載時間配對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check thickness and toughness using depth pins, cores and panel tests, inspect thin zones near bolt heads, and match material age to actual loading time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 噴凝土面板的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shotcrete panel mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「噴凝土面板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shotcrete panel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 表面平整但局部過薄或背後脫黏，會使面板突然剝落；只驗抗壓強度可能漏掉韌性不足。均布壓力並不代表真正局部荷載形狀，面板需依支點與岩塊接觸重新分析；本式不能取代噴凝土構件驗算。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A smooth surface can conceal thin spots or debonding that cause panel detachment; compressive strength alone may miss inadequate toughness. Uniform pressure does not establish the actual contact pattern; panels require analysis with their supports and block contacts, and this expression cannot replace member checks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：均布壓力並不代表真正局部荷載形狀，面板需依支點與岩塊接觸重新分析；本式不能取代噴凝土構件驗算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Uniform pressure does not establish the actual contact pattern; panels require analysis with their supports and block contacts, and this expression cannot replace member checks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「噴凝土表面看起來連續就具有均勻厚度與韌性。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A continuous-looking shotcrete surface has uniform thickness and toughness." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 表面平整但局部過薄或背後脫黏，會使面板突然剝落；只驗抗壓強度可能漏掉韌性不足。均布壓力並不代表真正局部荷載形狀，面板需依支點與岩塊接觸重新分析；本式不能取代噴凝土構件驗算。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「噴凝土面板的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shotcrete panel mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
量到應變後乘上固定模數即可得到精確永久應力。
表面平整但局部過薄或背後脫黏，會使面板突然剝落；只驗抗壓強度可能漏掉韌性不足。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Measured strain times one constant modulus gives exact permanent stress.
A smooth surface can conceal thin spots or debonding that cause panel detachment; compressive strength alone may miss inadequate toughness.
quiz.explanation: 表面平整但局部過薄或背後脫黏，會使面板突然剝落；只驗抗壓強度可能漏掉韌性不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A smooth surface can conceal thin spots or debonding that cause panel detachment; compressive strength alone may miss inadequate toughness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 應變換算的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Strain conversion mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「應變換算」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strain conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 噴凝土或鋼構件的應變可反映支護開始參與承載的時間，但量測值包含溫度、收縮與儀器零點變化。用彈性模數換算應力前須先分離機械應變；早齡期模數及潛變不確定時，單一讀值無法唯一推回實際作用力。線彈性式只適用於所取機械增量與相應模數，不能跨越開裂或大幅潛變狀態；零讀值也不代表構件沒有歷史荷載。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「應變換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Support strain can indicate when shotcrete or steel begins carrying load, but readings include temperature, shrinkage and zero drift. Separate mechanical strain before multiplying by modulus; uncertain early-age stiffness and creep mean one reading cannot uniquely recover the actual force carried by the support. The elastic expression applies to the selected mechanical increment and corresponding modulus, not across cracking or major creep; a zero reading does not imply absence of historical load. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Strain conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設已扣除溫度與收縮、E=20 GPa、機械應變ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶，Δσ=Eε=1 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: After temperature and shrinkage correction, assume E=20 GPa and mechanical ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶; Δσ=Eε=1 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量到應變後乘上固定模數即可得到精確永久應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Measured strain times one constant modulus gives exact permanent stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「應變換算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Strain conversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Separate mechanical strain before multiplying by modulus; uncertain early-age stiffness and creep mean one reading cannot uniquely recover the actual force carried by the support.

knowledge.text: 誤解：量到應變後乘上固定模數即可得到精確永久應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「應變換算的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strain conversion mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 噴凝土或鋼構件的應變可反映支護開始參與承載的時間，但量測值包含溫度、收縮與儀器零點變化。
量到應變後乘上固定模數即可得到精確永久應力。
開口率相同的兩個交叉口一定具有相同穩定性。
optionsEn: Support strain can indicate when shotcrete or steel begins carrying load, but readings include temperature, shrinkage and zero drift.
Measured strain times one constant modulus gives exact permanent stress.
Two intersections with the same opening ratio have the same stability.
quiz.explanation: 噴凝土或鋼構件的應變可反映支護開始參與承載的時間，但量測值包含溫度、收縮與儀器零點變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 應變換算的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strain conversion mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「應變換算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strain conversion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設已扣除溫度與收縮、E=20 GPa、機械應變ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶，Δσ=Eε=1 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: After temperature and shrinkage correction, assume E=20 GPa and mechanical ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶; Δσ=Eε=1 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：成對配置應變與溫度感測器，保存安裝、歸零及開挖時間；用材料試驗模數檢查換算範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair strain and temperature sensors, retain installation, zeroing and excavation times, and use tested moduli to bound stress conversion.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設已扣除溫度與收縮、E=20 GPa、機械應變ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶，Δσ=Eε=1 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: After temperature and shrinkage correction, assume E=20 GPa and mechanical ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶; Δσ=Eε=1 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「應變換算的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strain conversion mechanism and verification", which statement holds?

原創教學假設：假設已扣除溫度與收縮、E=20 GPa、機械應變ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶，Δσ=Eε=1 MPa。
完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。
optionsEn: Underground caverns do not experience surface shaking, so support needs no seismic checks.
Original teaching assumptions: After temperature and shrinkage correction, assume E=20 GPa and mechanical ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶; Δσ=Eε=1 MPa.
High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: After temperature and shrinkage correction, assume E=20 GPa and mechanical ε=50 με=50×10⁻⁶; Δσ=Eε=1 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 應變換算的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strain conversion mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「應變換算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strain conversion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 成對配置應變與溫度感測器，保存安裝、歸零及開挖時間；用材料試驗模數檢查換算範圍。原始讀值與修正值須分開保存；感測器更換或歸零由監測負責人記錄，設計者審核其對基準連續性的影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair strain and temperature sensors, retain installation, zeroing and excavation times, and use tested moduli to bound stress conversion. Preserve raw and corrected readings separately; the monitoring lead records sensor replacement or rezeroing, and the designer reviews its effect on baseline continuity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Preserve raw and corrected readings separately; the monitoring lead records sensor replacement or rezeroing, and the designer reviews its effect on baseline continuity. The elastic expression applies to the selected mechanical increment and corresponding modulus, not across cracking or major creep; a zero reading does not imply absence of historical load.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把冷卻收縮全部當成荷載應變，會誤判支護超載；錯誤歸零也可能抹掉施工前已存在的應變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating cooling contraction entirely as load strain can falsely indicate overload, while incorrect zeroing can erase strain that existed before later excavation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把冷卻收縮全部當成荷載應變，會誤判支護超載；錯誤歸零也可能抹掉施工前已存在的應變。線彈性式只適用於所取機械增量與相應模數，不能跨越開裂或大幅潛變狀態；零讀值也不代表構件沒有歷史荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Treating cooling contraction entirely as load strain can falsely indicate overload, while incorrect zeroing can erase strain that existed before later excavation. The elastic expression applies to the selected mechanical increment and corresponding modulus, not across cracking or major creep; a zero reading does not imply absence of historical load.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Treating cooling contraction entirely as load strain can falsely indicate overload, while incorrect zeroing can erase strain that existed before later excavation.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Two intersections with the same opening ratio have the same stability.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「交叉口開口率的機理與驗證」與「反算剛度的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
