steps.title: 交叉口開口率的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Intersection opening ratio mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「交叉口開口率」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Intersection opening ratio” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支洞穿入大岩洞會切斷局部岩拱及支護連續性，使受力呈三維繞流。開口面積比例可用於列出幾何擾動程度，但開口位置比單一比例更重要；靠近拱腳或大型節理交會處的小開口，也可能導致顯著的應力轉移。開口率是無因次幾何指標，沒有直接的強度允收值；必須另查形狀、距離、支護連續性及交會角度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「交叉口開口率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A branch cavern interrupts local rock arching and support continuity, forcing three-dimensional load redistribution. Opening-area ratio is useful for describing geometric disturbance, but location can matter more than the ratio: a small opening near an abutment or major joint intersection may cause substantial stress transfer. Opening ratio is a dimensionless geometry descriptor without a direct strength acceptance limit; shape, spacing, support continuity and intersection angle require independent checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Intersection opening ratio” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設交叉開口Aopen=12 m²、參考牆面Aref=60 m²，幾何開口率r=Aopen/Aref=0.20。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For opening area Aopen=12 m² and reference wall area Aref=60 m², geometric opening ratio r=Aopen/Aref=0.20.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「開口率相同的兩個交叉口一定具有相同穩定性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two intersections with the same opening ratio have the same stability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「交叉口開口率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Opening-area ratio is useful for describing geometric disturbance, but location can matter more than the ratio: a small opening near an abutment or major joint intersection may cause substantial stress transfer.

knowledge.text: 誤解：開口率相同的兩個交叉口一定具有相同穩定性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 交叉口開口率的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「交叉口開口率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設交叉開口Aopen=12 m²、參考牆面Aref=60 m²，幾何開口率r=Aopen/Aref=0.20。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For opening area Aopen=12 m² and reference wall area Aref=60 m², geometric opening ratio r=Aopen/Aref=0.20. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立三維開口及節理模型，量測角隅收斂與支護應變；將分部開挖順序與反應峰值對時比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Model openings and joints in three dimensions, measure corner convergence and support strain, and align response peaks with staged excavation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: Model openings and joints in three dimensions, measure corner convergence and support strain, and align response peaks with staged excavation. Provide dedicated geological and support sections at intersections; the designer verifies three-dimensional transfer and excavation hold points before standard tunnel details are adopted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交叉口應有獨立地質與支護剖面；設計者確認三維荷載轉移及分部開挖停留點後，才可套用洞身標準細部。開口率是無因次幾何指標，沒有直接的強度允收值；必須另查形狀、距離、支護連續性及交會角度。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.explanationEn: Treating an intersection as a two-dimensional uniform tunnel misses corner stresses and weakened abutments, allowing damage to concentrate at the branch junction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 反算剛度的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Back-calculated stiffness mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反算剛度」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Back-calculated stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 已知荷載與位移可反算等效剛度，用於檢查分析模型是否過軟或過硬，但不同的岩體參數、接縫滑移與支護剛度可能產生相似位移。只配合一個量測點會造成參數不可識別，必須用多位置與多階段反應限制合理解的範圍。此剛度屬特定階段與荷載路徑的等效值，不是岩石材料模數；若量測含剛體移動，須先移除其影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反算剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Known force and displacement can provide an equivalent stiffness for checking whether an analysis is too soft or stiff. Different rock parameters, joint slip and support stiffness can produce similar displacement, however. Fitting one point creates an identifiability problem; several locations and construction stages are needed to constrain plausible solutions. This is an equivalent stiffness for one stage and load path, not a rock material modulus; rigid-body movement must be separated before interpreting the measurement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Back-calculated stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設對應荷載增量ΔF=500 kN、位移增量Δu=5 mm，等效k=ΔF/Δu=100 kN/mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For corresponding increments ΔF=500 kN and Δu=5 mm, equivalent stiffness k=ΔF/Δu=100 kN/mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模型配合一個監測點就證明所有地層參數正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Matching one monitoring point proves every ground parameter is correct." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反算剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Back-calculated stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反算剛度的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 已知荷載與位移可反算等效剛度，用於檢查分析模型是否過軟或過硬，但不同的岩體參數、接縫滑移與支護剛度可能產生相似位移。只配合一個量測點會造成參數不可識別，必須用多位置與多階段反應限制合理解的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Known force and displacement can provide an equivalent stiffness for checking whether an analysis is too soft or stiff. Different rock parameters, joint slip and support stiffness can produce similar displacement, however.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模型配合一個監測點就證明所有地層參數正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Matching one monitoring point proves every ground parameter is correct. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反算剛度的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Back-calculated stiffness mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 模型配合一個監測點就證明所有地層參數正確。
地下岩洞不受地表搖動，所以支護不用耐震檢查。
已知荷載與位移可反算等效剛度，用於檢查分析模型是否過軟或過硬，但不同的岩體參數、接縫滑移與支護剛度可能產生相似位移。
optionsEn: Matching one monitoring point proves every ground parameter is correct.
Underground caverns do not experience surface shaking, so support needs no seismic checks.
Known force and displacement can provide an equivalent stiffness for checking whether an analysis is too soft or stiff.
quiz.explanation: 已知荷載與位移可反算等效剛度，用於檢查分析模型是否過軟或過硬，但不同的岩體參數、接縫滑移與支護剛度可能產生相似位移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Known force and displacement can provide an equivalent stiffness for checking whether an analysis is too soft or stiff. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反算剛度的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Back-calculated stiffness mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反算剛度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Back-calculated stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設對應荷載增量ΔF=500 kN、位移增量Δu=5 mm，等效k=ΔF/Δu=100 kN/mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For corresponding increments ΔF=500 kN and Δu=5 mm, equivalent stiffness k=ΔF/Δu=100 kN/mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多支伸長計、收斂點及支護力共同反算，保留未用於配適的資料作驗證，檢查參數是否仍具物理意義。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Back-analyse extensometers, convergence and support forces together, retaining unused observations for validation and checking that fitted parameters remain physically meaningful.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設對應荷載增量ΔF=500 kN、位移增量Δu=5 mm，等效k=ΔF/Δu=100 kN/mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For corresponding increments ΔF=500 kN and Δu=5 mm, equivalent stiffness k=ΔF/Δu=100 kN/mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反算剛度的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Back-calculated stiffness mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設對應荷載增量ΔF=500 kN、位移增量Δu=5 mm，等效k=ΔF/Δu=100 kN/mm。
完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。
洞室跨度變大時，只按跨度比例增加支護即可。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For corresponding increments ΔF=500 kN and Δu=5 mm, equivalent stiffness k=ΔF/Δu=100 kN/mm.
High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls.
Support only needs to increase linearly with cavern span.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設對應荷載增量ΔF=500 kN、位移增量Δu=5 mm，等效k=ΔF/Δu=100 kN/mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For corresponding increments ΔF=500 kN and Δu=5 mm, equivalent stiffness k=ΔF/Δu=100 kN/mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反算剛度的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Back-calculated stiffness mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反算剛度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Back-calculated stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多支伸長計、收斂點及支護力共同反算，保留未用於配適的資料作驗證，檢查參數是否仍具物理意義。反算報告應列參數相關性、測值誤差及獨立驗證結果；變更支護前，由設計者審核而非以自動最佳配適放行。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Back-analyse extensometers, convergence and support forces together, retaining unused observations for validation and checking that fitted parameters remain physically meaningful. Report parameter correlations, measurement error and independent validation; the designer reviews them before support changes rather than accepting an automatic best fit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：反算報告應列參數相關性、測值誤差及獨立驗證結果；變更支護前，由設計者審核而非以自動最佳配適放行。此剛度屬特定階段與荷載路徑的等效值，不是岩石材料模數；若量測含剛體移動，須先移除其影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Report parameter correlations, measurement error and independent validation; the designer reviews them before support changes rather than accepting an automatic best fit. This is an equivalent stiffness for one stage and load path, not a rock material modulus; rigid-body movement must be separated before interpreting the measurement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：任意調整岩體模數直到位移吻合，可能掩蓋錯誤支承邊界，導致下一開挖階段預測失準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adjusting rock modulus until displacement matches can conceal incorrect support boundaries and produce poor predictions for the next excavation stage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以多支伸長計、收斂點及支護力共同反算，保留未用於配適的資料作驗證，檢查參數是否仍具物理意義。反算報告應列參數相關性、測值誤差及獨立驗證結果；變更支護前，由設計者審核而非以自動最佳配適放行。
knowledge.textEn: Back-analyse extensometers, convergence and support forces together, retaining unused observations for validation and checking that fitted parameters remain physically meaningful. Report parameter correlations, measurement error and independent validation; the designer reviews them before support changes rather than accepting an automatic best fit.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 反算報告應列參數相關性、測值誤差及獨立驗證結果；變更支護前，由設計者審核而非以自動最佳配適放行。此剛度屬特定階段與荷載路徑的等效值，不是岩石材料模數；若量測含剛體移動，須先移除其影響。
knowledge.textEn: Report parameter correlations, measurement error and independent validation; the designer reviews them before support changes rather than accepting an automatic best fit. This is an equivalent stiffness for one stage and load path, not a rock material modulus; rigid-body movement must be separated before interpreting the measurement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反算剛度的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Back-calculated stiffness mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以多支伸長計、收斂點及支護力共同反算，保留未用於配適的資料作驗證，檢查參數是否仍具物理意義。
噴凝土表面看起來連續就具有均勻厚度與韌性。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Back-analyse extensometers, convergence and support forces together, retaining unused observations for validation and checking that fitted parameters remain physically meaningful.
A continuous-looking shotcrete surface has uniform thickness and toughness.
quiz.explanation: 以多支伸長計、收斂點及支護力共同反算，保留未用於配適的資料作驗證，檢查參數是否仍具物理意義。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Back-analyse extensometers, convergence and support forces together, retaining unused observations for validation and checking that fitted parameters remain physically meaningful. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反算剛度的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Back-calculated stiffness mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反算剛度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Back-calculated stiffness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 任意調整岩體模數直到位移吻合，可能掩蓋錯誤支承邊界，導致下一開挖階段預測失準。此剛度屬特定階段與荷載路徑的等效值，不是岩石材料模數；若量測含剛體移動，須先移除其影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adjusting rock modulus until displacement matches can conceal incorrect support boundaries and produce poor predictions for the next excavation stage. This is an equivalent stiffness for one stage and load path, not a rock material modulus; rigid-body movement must be separated before interpreting the measurement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此剛度屬特定階段與荷載路徑的等效值，不是岩石材料模數；若量測含剛體移動，須先移除其影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is an equivalent stiffness for one stage and load path, not a rock material modulus; rigid-body movement must be separated before interpreting the measurement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模型配合一個監測點就證明所有地層參數正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Matching one monitoring point proves every ground parameter is correct." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 任意調整岩體模數直到位移吻合，可能掩蓋錯誤支承邊界，導致下一開挖階段預測失準。此剛度屬特定階段與荷載路徑的等效值，不是岩石材料模數；若量測含剛體移動，須先移除其影響。
knowledge.textEn: Adjusting rock modulus until displacement matches can conceal incorrect support boundaries and produce poor predictions for the next excavation stage. This is an equivalent stiffness for one stage and load path, not a rock material modulus; rigid-body movement must be separated before interpreting the measurement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「反算剛度的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Back-calculated stiffness mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
地下岩洞不受地表搖動，所以支護不用耐震檢查。
任意調整岩體模數直到位移吻合，可能掩蓋錯誤支承邊界，導致下一開挖階段預測失準。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Underground caverns do not experience surface shaking, so support needs no seismic checks.
Adjusting rock modulus until displacement matches can conceal incorrect support boundaries and produce poor predictions for the next excavation stage.
quiz.explanation: 任意調整岩體模數直到位移吻合，可能掩蓋錯誤支承邊界，導致下一開挖階段預測失準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adjusting rock modulus until displacement matches can conceal incorrect support boundaries and produce poor predictions for the next excavation stage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地震慣性的機理與驗證」與「排水與接觸力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seismic inertia mechanism and verification" and "Drainage and contact force mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地震慣性的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seismic inertia mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地震慣性」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seismic inertia” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地震可對穹頂楔塊施加附加慣性力，也會改變節理接觸與支護受力方向。擬靜力係數提供簡化水平力，但忽略波傳、相位及結構變形差異；地下工程不能只因埋置而假設沒有地震需求，尤其需要查節理與錨固區的相對變位。擬靜力係數不是任意選用的通用常數，且此單一水平力不包含垂直作用或波傳應變；應按專案地震分析基準選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地震慣性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Earthquakes add inertia to crown wedges and alter joint contact and support-force direction. A pseudo-static coefficient supplies a simplified horizontal force but omits wave propagation, phase and differential deformation. Burial alone does not eliminate seismic demand, particularly where joints and anchorage zones undergo relative movement. The pseudo-static coefficient is not a universal arbitrary constant, and this horizontal force excludes vertical action and wave strain; select it under the project's seismic-analysis basis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seismic inertia” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 地震慣性的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 地震可對穹頂楔塊施加附加慣性力，也會改變節理接觸與支護受力方向。擬靜力係數提供簡化水平力，但忽略波傳、相位及結構變形差異；地下工程不能只因埋置而假設沒有地震需求，尤其需要查節理與錨固區的相對變位。
knowledge.textEn: Earthquakes add inertia to crown wedges and alter joint contact and support-force direction. A pseudo-static coefficient supplies a simplified horizontal force but omits wave propagation, phase and differential deformation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地下岩洞不受地表搖動，所以支護不用耐震檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Underground caverns do not experience surface shaking, so support needs no seismic checks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drainage and contact force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩洞節理中的水壓會減少有效法向接觸，降低摩擦可動員程度；排水系統因此是支護性能的一部分。時間久後的沉積或結垢可使局部水壓恢復，外觀乾燥並不能證明深部節理無壓，維護應把水頭變化與支護反應一起追蹤。本式假設均勻水壓與有效接觸面積，部分張開節理需重新界定面積；若計算負值，不能把摩擦抗力當成負值繼續套用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水與接觸力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water pressure in joints reduces effective normal contact and available friction, making drainage part of support performance. Sediment or mineral buildup can restore local water pressure with time. A dry visible surface does not establish unpressurized deeper joints, so maintenance must track hydraulic head together with support response. The expression assumes uniform pressure and a defined contact area; partly open joints require revised area, and a negative result cannot be carried forward as negative friction resistance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drainage and contact force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With total normal force N=500 kN, uniform joint pressure u=100 kPa and area A=2 m², N′=N−uA=300 kN.

岩洞節理中的水壓會減少有效法向接觸，降低摩擦可動員程度；排水系統因此是支護性能的一部分。
完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。
optionsEn: Lower drain flow always means a drier and more stable cavern.
Water pressure in joints reduces effective normal contact and available friction, making drainage part of support performance.
High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls.
quiz.explanation: 岩洞節理中的水壓會減少有效法向接觸，降低摩擦可動員程度；排水系統因此是支護性能的一部分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water pressure in joints reduces effective normal contact and available friction, making drainage part of support performance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水與接觸力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drainage and contact force mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水與接觸力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drainage and contact force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：法向總力N=500 kN、均勻節理水壓u=100 kPa、面積A=2 m²，N′=N−uA=300 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: With total normal force N=500 kN, uniform joint pressure u=100 kPa and area A=2 m², N′=N−uA=300 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將排水流量、水壓計與節理開合量對時比對，檢查低流量是否代表缺水或堵塞，保留清理前後資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare drain flow, piezometers and joint opening on one clock, distinguishing low inflow from blockage and retaining evidence before and after cleaning.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：法向總力N=500 kN、均勻節理水壓u=100 kPa、面積A=2 m²，N′=N−uA=300 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: With total normal force N=500 kN, uniform joint pressure u=100 kPa and area A=2 m², N′=N−uA=300 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「排水與接觸力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drainage and contact force mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 洞室跨度變大時，只按跨度比例增加支護即可。
噴凝土表面看起來連續就具有均勻厚度與韌性。
原創教學假設：法向總力N=500 kN、均勻節理水壓u=100 kPa、面積A=2 m²，N′=N−uA=300 kN。
optionsEn: Support only needs to increase linearly with cavern span.
A continuous-looking shotcrete surface has uniform thickness and toughness.
Original teaching assumptions: With total normal force N=500 kN, uniform joint pressure u=100 kPa and area A=2 m², N′=N−uA=300 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：法向總力N=500 kN、均勻節理水壓u=100 kPa、面積A=2 m²，N′=N−uA=300 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: With total normal force N=500 kN, uniform joint pressure u=100 kPa and area A=2 m², N′=N−uA=300 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 排水與接觸力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drainage and contact force mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水與接觸力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drainage and contact force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將排水流量、水壓計與節理開合量對時比對，檢查低流量是否代表缺水或堵塞，保留清理前後資料。維護資料須記各排水孔的集水區與通達性；清理或封孔前，由地工及營運負責人核定對接觸力的影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare drain flow, piezometers and joint opening on one clock, distinguishing low inflow from blockage and retaining evidence before and after cleaning. Maintenance records identify each drain's catchment and access; geotechnical and operations leads approve the effect on contact force before cleaning or sealing drains. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護資料須記各排水孔的集水區與通達性；清理或封孔前，由地工及營運負責人核定對接觸力的影響。本式假設均勻水壓與有效接觸面積，部分張開節理需重新界定面積；若計算負值，不能把摩擦抗力當成負值繼續套用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Maintenance records identify each drain's catchment and access; geotechnical and operations leads approve the effect on contact force before cleaning or sealing drains. The expression assumes uniform pressure and a defined contact area; partly open joints require revised area, and a negative result cannot be carried forward as negative friction resistance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水堵塞可能使摩擦力下降而表面流量變小；若誤以為滲水改善，會錯過接觸力衰減的訊號。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Blocked drainage may reduce friction while visible flow decreases; interpreting reduced seepage as improvement can miss the loss of effective contact force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將排水流量、水壓計與節理開合量對時比對，檢查低流量是否代表缺水或堵塞，保留清理前後資料。維護資料須記各排水孔的集水區與通達性；清理或封孔前，由地工及營運負責人核定對接觸力的影響。
knowledge.textEn: Compare drain flow, piezometers and joint opening on one clock, distinguishing low inflow from blockage and retaining evidence before and after cleaning. Maintenance records identify each drain's catchment and access; geotechnical and operations leads approve the effect on contact force before cleaning or sealing drains.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護資料須記各排水孔的集水區與通達性；清理或封孔前，由地工及營運負責人核定對接觸力的影響。本式假設均勻水壓與有效接觸面積，部分張開節理需重新界定面積；若計算負值，不能把摩擦抗力當成負值繼續套用。
knowledge.textEn: Maintenance records identify each drain's catchment and access; geotechnical and operations leads approve the effect on contact force before cleaning or sealing drains. The expression assumes uniform pressure and a defined contact area; partly open joints require revised area, and a negative result cannot be carried forward as negative friction resistance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排水與接觸力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drainage and contact force mechanism and verification"?
options: 將排水流量、水壓計與節理開合量對時比對，檢查低流量是否代表缺水或堵塞，保留清理前後資料。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
開口率相同的兩個交叉口一定具有相同穩定性。
optionsEn: Compare drain flow, piezometers and joint opening on one clock, distinguishing low inflow from blockage and retaining evidence before and after cleaning.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Two intersections with the same opening ratio have the same stability.
quiz.explanation: 將排水流量、水壓計與節理開合量對時比對，檢查低流量是否代表缺水或堵塞，保留清理前後資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare drain flow, piezometers and joint opening on one clock, distinguishing low inflow from blockage and retaining evidence before and after cleaning. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 排水與接觸力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drainage and contact force mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排水與接觸力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drainage and contact force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水堵塞可能使摩擦力下降而表面流量變小；若誤以為滲水改善，會錯過接觸力衰減的訊號。本式假設均勻水壓與有效接觸面積，部分張開節理需重新界定面積；若計算負值，不能把摩擦抗力當成負值繼續套用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked drainage may reduce friction while visible flow decreases; interpreting reduced seepage as improvement can miss the loss of effective contact force. The expression assumes uniform pressure and a defined contact area; partly open joints require revised area, and a negative result cannot be carried forward as negative friction resistance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本式假設均勻水壓與有效接觸面積，部分張開節理需重新界定面積；若計算負值，不能把摩擦抗力當成負值繼續套用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The expression assumes uniform pressure and a defined contact area; partly open joints require revised area, and a negative result cannot be carried forward as negative friction resistance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水量減少一定表示岩洞變得更乾燥且更穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lower drain flow always means a drier and more stable cavern." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 排水堵塞可能使摩擦力下降而表面流量變小；若誤以為滲水改善，會錯過接觸力衰減的訊號。本式假設均勻水壓與有效接觸面積，部分張開節理需重新界定面積；若計算負值，不能把摩擦抗力當成負值繼續套用。
knowledge.textEn: Blocked drainage may reduce friction while visible flow decreases; interpreting reduced seepage as improvement can miss the loss of effective contact force. The expression assumes uniform pressure and a defined contact area; partly open joints require revised area, and a negative result cannot be carried forward as negative friction resistance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「排水與接觸力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drainage and contact force mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
排水堵塞可能使摩擦力下降而表面流量變小；若誤以為滲水改善，會錯過接觸力衰減的訊號。
完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Blocked drainage may reduce friction while visible flow decreases; interpreting reduced seepage as improvement can miss the loss of effective contact force.
High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls.
quiz.explanation: 排水堵塞可能使摩擦力下降而表面流量變小；若誤以為滲水改善，會錯過接觸力衰減的訊號。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Blocked drainage may reduce friction while visible flow decreases; interpreting reduced seepage as improvement can miss the loss of effective contact force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 交叉隧道人工地盤凍結
summary: 人工地盤凍結透過冷卻與相變暫時增加地層強度並減少滲流，卻同時引入熱量、凍脹及解凍變形問題。本課將凍結管幾何、對流熱輸送、長期潛變與備援冷量分開檢查，再建立從臨時凍土支護轉交永久襯砌的證據與停留點。
summaryEn: Artificial ground freezing temporarily strengthens ground and restricts seepage through cooling and phase change, while introducing thermal, heave and thaw-deformation concerns. The course separately examines pipe geometry, advective heat, creep and cooling reserves, then builds evidence and hold points for transferring support from frozen soil to the permanent lining.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設需相變的孔隙水質量m=1000 kg，潛熱Lf=334 kJ/kg，移除潛熱Q=mLf=334000 kJ。若取樣顯示需相變水量增加10%至1100 kg，Q變為367400 kJ，同樣增加10%。這個比較保持潛熱與相變比例固定，只計冰水轉換，不含土粒顯熱、未凍水、鹽分、管路損失或地下水對流。真正冷凍工期需以焓與流動熱輸送模型配合測溫判定，不能把這個能量除以機組額定功率後直接放行開挖。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume m=1000 kg of pore water undergoes phase change with latent heat Lf=334 kJ/kg. The latent energy is Q=mLf=334000 kJ. Increasing the water mass by 10% to 1100 kg raises Q to 367400 kJ, also by 10%. This comparison holds latent heat and frozen fraction fixed and covers only ice-water conversion. It excludes soil sensible heat, unfrozen water, salinity, pipe losses and groundwater advection. Actual freezing duration requires an enthalpy and advective-heat model supported by temperatures; dividing this energy by rated plant power does not authorize excavation.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「相變熱量的機理與驗證」與「凍結管交疊的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Latent heat mechanism and verification" and "Freeze-pipe overlap mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 相變熱量的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Latent heat mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「相變熱量」如何影響交叉隧道人工地盤凍結的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Latent heat” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground freezing for tunnel cross-passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 凍結不只是把溫度降到零度以下，孔隙水由液態轉成冰還需移除潛熱。含水量、鹽分及未凍水比例決定熱量與強度的關係；測得局部低溫不代表整個目標體積已形成連續、足夠厚且可承載的凍土體。此式只計相變潛熱，未含土粒顯熱、管路損失及流動地下水帶入熱量，因此不能直接用來決定實際凍結工期或設備容量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「相變熱量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Freezing requires more than lowering temperature below zero: converting pore water to ice also removes latent heat. Water content, salinity and unfrozen water govern the relation between heat and strength. A cold local reading does not establish a continuous frozen body with adequate thickness and resistance throughout the target volume. This expression includes latent heat only, excluding soil sensible heat, pipe losses and heat carried by flowing groundwater; it cannot directly determine field freezing duration or plant capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Latent heat” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設需要相變的水質量m=1000 kg、潛熱Lf=334 kJ/kg，Q=mLf=334000 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass m=1000 kg undergoing phase change and latent heat Lf=334 kJ/kg, Q=mLf=334000 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「溫度低於零度就表示所有孔隙水已全部結冰。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A temperature below zero means all pore water is frozen." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「相變熱量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Latent heat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 相變熱量的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 凍結不只是把溫度降到零度以下，孔隙水由液態轉成冰還需移除潛熱。含水量、鹽分及未凍水比例決定熱量與強度的關係；測得局部低溫不代表整個目標體積已形成連續、足夠厚且可承載的凍土體。
knowledge.textEn: Freezing requires more than lowering temperature below zero: converting pore water to ice also removes latent heat. Water content, salinity and unfrozen water govern the relation between heat and strength.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：溫度低於零度就表示所有孔隙水已全部結冰。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A temperature below zero means all pore water is frozen. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「相變熱量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Latent heat mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 溫度低於零度就表示所有孔隙水已全部結冰。
凍結不只是把溫度降到零度以下，孔隙水由液態轉成冰還需移除潛熱。
所有凍結管出水都很冷就代表凍土壁已閉合。
optionsEn: A temperature below zero means all pore water is frozen.
Freezing requires more than lowering temperature below zero: converting pore water to ice also removes latent heat.
Cold return fluid from every pipe proves closure of the frozen wall.
quiz.explanation: 凍結不只是把溫度降到零度以下，孔隙水由液態轉成冰還需移除潛熱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Freezing requires more than lowering temperature below zero: converting pore water to ice also removes latent heat. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 相鄰凍結管周圍的低溫區需連成完整屏障，管距及鑽孔偏斜決定最薄弱的中間位置。均勻圓形凍結半徑只是簡化，地下水流會使凍土範圍不對稱；井內靠近管壁的低溫因此不能替代管間最暖點的閉合證據。幾何交疊只是理想等半徑判斷，沒有證明溫度、強度或水密；鹽分和地下水對流可能使實際閉合時間大幅不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「凍結管交疊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 凍結管交疊的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Freeze-pipe overlap mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「凍結管交疊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Freeze-pipe overlap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測鑽孔軌跡並在預測最暖區配置測溫孔，對照三維等溫面與實際管位。管位偏差圖與測溫孔應共同驗收；開挖放行由設計者依最不利連續路徑判定，不以平均低溫取代。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure bore trajectories and locate temperature holes in predicted warm zones, comparing three-dimensional isotherms with actual pipe positions. Accept pipe deviations and temperature-hole positions together; the designer releases excavation from the most adverse continuous path, not from average cold readings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：管位偏差圖與測溫孔應共同驗收；開挖放行由設計者依最不利連續路徑判定，不以平均低溫取代。幾何交疊只是理想等半徑判斷，沒有證明溫度、強度或水密；鹽分和地下水對流可能使實際閉合時間大幅不同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Accept pipe deviations and temperature-hole positions together; the designer releases excavation from the most adverse continuous path, not from average cold readings. Geometric overlap assumes equal ideal radii and proves neither temperature, strength nor sealing; salinity and groundwater advection can substantially alter actual closure time.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：管位偏差可能留下狹窄未凍通道，平均溫度合格仍會在開口時產生集中湧水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Pipe deviation can leave a narrow unfrozen channel that admits concentrated inflow despite an acceptable mean temperature. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「凍結管交疊的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Continuous refrigeration can automatically overcome any groundwater flow rate.
Pipe deviation can leave a narrow unfrozen channel that admits concentrated inflow despite an acceptable mean temperature.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「對流熱輸送的機理與驗證」與「熱擴散尺度的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Advective heat mechanism and verification" and "Thermal diffusion scale mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 對流熱輸送的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Advective heat mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「對流熱輸送」如何影響交叉隧道人工地盤凍結的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Advective heat” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground freezing for tunnel cross-passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流動地下水會持續把熱量帶進凍結區，可能使凍結壁迎水側與背水側形成不同厚度。熱輸送取決於水量與溫差，不只取決於土壤導熱係數；若地下水通道集中在薄砂層，整體平均滲透係數可能低估局部熱障礙。算例為水流顯熱負荷，未含相變與導熱；流量本身會隨凍結堵塞而變化，不能假設整個過程維持固定熱輸入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「對流熱輸送」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flowing groundwater continuously brings heat into the freezing zone and can produce different upstream and downstream thicknesses. Heat transport depends on discharge and temperature difference as well as conductivity. Concentrated flow in a thin sand layer may create a local thermal obstacle that an average ground permeability fails to represent. This is an advective sensible-heat load, excluding phase change and conduction; discharge itself changes as freezing restricts flow, so heat input need not remain constant throughout. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Advective heat” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、比熱c=4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、流量q=0.001 m³/s、降溫ΔT=10 K，P=ρcqΔT=41.8 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For ρ=1000 kg/m³, c=4.18 kJ/(kg·K), q=0.001 m³/s and ΔT=10 K, P=ρcqΔT=41.8 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要冷凍機持續運轉，任何地下水流量都能自然克服。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Continuous refrigeration can automatically overcome any groundwater flow rate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「對流熱輸送」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Advective heat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 對流熱輸送的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 流動地下水會持續把熱量帶進凍結區，可能使凍結壁迎水側與背水側形成不同厚度。熱輸送取決於水量與溫差，不只取決於土壤導熱係數；若地下水通道集中在薄砂層，整體平均滲透係數可能低估局部熱障礙。
knowledge.textEn: Flowing groundwater continuously brings heat into the freezing zone and can produce different upstream and downstream thicknesses. Heat transport depends on discharge and temperature difference as well as conductivity.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要冷凍機持續運轉，任何地下水流量都能自然克服。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Continuous refrigeration can automatically overcome any groundwater flow rate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「對流熱輸送的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 對流熱輸送的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Advective heat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用分層水壓與抽水試驗推估流向，對照測溫面是否沿含水層偏移，核對熱平衡殘差。熱水力模型應分列集中流路與平均流場；異常暖區需由冷凍及水文設計者共同解釋，才可改變開挖時程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Infer flow direction from multilevel pressures and hydraulic tests, compare thermal-front displacement along aquifers, and examine heat-balance residuals. Separate concentrated flow paths from the average field in the thermal-hydraulic model; refrigeration and hydrogeological designers explain warm anomalies before excavation timing changes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate concentrated flow paths from the average field in the thermal-hydraulic model; refrigeration and hydrogeological designers explain warm anomalies before excavation timing changes. This is an advective sensible-heat load, excluding phase change and conduction; discharge itself changes as freezing restricts flow, so heat input need not remain constant throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部高速水流可能維持未凍通道，若只增加冷卻時間而不查熱源，閉合可能始終無法完成。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A local high-flow path may remain unfrozen; simply extending cooling without identifying the heat source may never achieve closure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 熱擴散尺度的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal diffusion scale mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「熱擴散尺度」如何影響交叉隧道人工地盤凍結的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal diffusion scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground freezing for tunnel cross-passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 溫度擾動向土體內傳遞需要時間，傳遞距離加倍時，純擴散的代表時間約增為四倍。這個尺度幫助辨識管距敏感度，卻沒有包含冰水相變與地下水對流；不能把擴散時間直接當成凍結壁已滿足開挖條件的時刻。這是量綱一致的擴散估算，不是史蒂芬相變問題的完整解；材料溫度依存性與鹽水凍結區間仍須另外處理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「熱擴散尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temperature changes take time to propagate through soil, and doubling distance approximately quadruples a pure-diffusion time scale. This helps identify spacing sensitivity but excludes phase change and groundwater advection. The diffusion time cannot therefore be treated as the instant when a frozen wall satisfies excavation requirements. This is a dimensionally consistent diffusion estimate, not a full Stefan phase-change solution; temperature-dependent properties and a saline freezing interval require separate treatment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal diffusion scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：傳熱距離L=0.5 m、熱擴散率α=1×10⁻⁶ m²/s，t*=L²/α=250000 s=2.89 day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For thermal length L=0.5 m and diffusivity α=1×10⁻⁶ m²/s, t*=L²/α=250000 s=2.89 day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「公式算出三天就保證三天後所有凍土都能承載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A three-day diffusion calculation guarantees load-bearing frozen soil after three days." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「熱擴散尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thermal diffusion scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 以不同距離測溫孔比較反應延遲，檢查純導熱模型是否系統性低估最暖點的降溫時間。計畫中分開標示熱尺度、預測閉合時間與驗收停留點；開挖決策須由設計者依實測連續溫度場核准。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare thermal response delays at different distances and check whether conduction-only analysis systematically underestimates cooling time at the warmest point. Distinguish thermal scale, predicted closure and acceptance hold point in the plan; the designer approves excavation from the measured continuous temperature field. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：計畫中分開標示熱尺度、預測閉合時間與驗收停留點；開挖決策須由設計者依實測連續溫度場核准。這是量綱一致的擴散估算，不是史蒂芬相變問題的完整解；材料溫度依存性與鹽水凍結區間仍須另外處理。

This is a dimensionally consistent diffusion estimate, not a full Stefan phase-change solution; temperature-dependent properties and a saline freezing interval require separate treatment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把擴散尺度當成完工工期會提前開挖，凍結壁可能仍有薄弱區或未達所需低溫強度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 熱擴散尺度的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal diffusion scale mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱擴散尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 把擴散尺度當成完工工期會提前開挖，凍結壁可能仍有薄弱區或未達所需低溫強度。這是量綱一致的擴散估算，不是史蒂芬相變問題的完整解；材料溫度依存性與鹽水凍結區間仍須另外處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

This is a dimensionally consistent diffusion estimate, not a full Stefan phase-change solution; temperature-dependent properties and a saline freezing interval require separate treatment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是量綱一致的擴散估算，不是史蒂芬相變問題的完整解；材料溫度依存性與鹽水凍結區間仍須另外處理。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「公式算出三天就保證三天後所有凍土都能承載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A three-day diffusion calculation guarantees load-bearing frozen soil after three days." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「熱擴散尺度的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal diffusion scale mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把擴散尺度當成完工工期會提前開挖，凍結壁可能仍有薄弱區或未達所需低溫強度。
凍土短期抗壓試驗合格就不需要考慮施工等待時間。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating a diffusion scale as completion time can release excavation while the wall remains locally thin or lacks the required low-temperature strength.
Passing a short-term frozen-soil compression test makes waiting time irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 把擴散尺度當成完工工期會提前開挖，凍結壁可能仍有薄弱區或未達所需低溫強度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating a diffusion scale as completion time can release excavation while the wall remains locally thin or lacks the required low-temperature strength. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「凍土潛變的機理與驗證」與「凍結壁滲流的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Frozen-soil creep mechanism and verification" and "Frozen-wall seepage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 凍土潛變的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Frozen-soil creep mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「凍土潛變」如何影響交叉隧道人工地盤凍結的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frozen-soil creep” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground freezing for tunnel cross-passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 凍土的承載不只由瞬間抗壓強度決定，溫度接近融點或長時間受力時會發生潛變。交叉通道開挖改變凍結壁的形狀及受力路徑，永久襯砌未閉合前的暴露時間因此直接影響變形需求，必須用相應溫度與持續時間評估。平均應力不代表凍土容許應力，局部拉應力與剪應力也可能控制；設計材料參數必須對應實際溫度範圍與時間尺度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「凍土潛變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Frozen-soil resistance depends on more than instantaneous compressive strength because creep develops under sustained load, especially near thawing. Cross-passage excavation changes frozen-wall geometry and load paths. Exposure before permanent lining closure therefore directly affects deformation demand and must be evaluated at the relevant temperature and loading duration. Mean stress is not an allowable frozen-soil stress, and local tension or shear may govern; design properties must correspond to the actual temperature range and time scale. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Frozen-soil creep” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設凍土受壓力N=1200 kN、有效面積A=4 m²，平均σ=N/A=300 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For frozen-ground compression N=1200 kN over effective area A=4 m², mean σ=N/A=300 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「凍土短期抗壓試驗合格就不需要考慮施工等待時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing a short-term frozen-soil compression test makes waiting time irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「凍土潛變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Frozen-soil creep”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 凍土潛變的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 凍土的承載不只由瞬間抗壓強度決定，溫度接近融點或長時間受力時會發生潛變。交叉通道開挖改變凍結壁的形狀及受力路徑，永久襯砌未閉合前的暴露時間因此直接影響變形需求，必須用相應溫度與持續時間評估。
knowledge.textEn: Frozen-soil resistance depends on more than instantaneous compressive strength because creep develops under sustained load, especially near thawing. Cross-passage excavation changes frozen-wall geometry and load paths.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：凍土短期抗壓試驗合格就不需要考慮施工等待時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing a short-term frozen-soil compression test makes waiting time irrelevant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「凍土潛變的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Frozen-soil creep mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 凍土短期抗壓試驗合格就不需要考慮施工等待時間。
凍結後的土體可以永遠視為絕對不透水。
凍土的承載不只由瞬間抗壓強度決定，溫度接近融點或長時間受力時會發生潛變。
optionsEn: Passing a short-term frozen-soil compression test makes waiting time irrelevant.
Frozen ground can always be treated as completely impermeable.
Frozen-soil resistance depends on more than instantaneous compressive strength because creep develops under sustained load, especially near thawing.
quiz.explanation: 凍土的承載不只由瞬間抗壓強度決定，溫度接近融點或長時間受力時會發生潛變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Frozen-soil resistance depends on more than instantaneous compressive strength because creep develops under sustained load, especially near thawing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 凍土潛變的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Frozen-soil creep mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「凍土潛變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Frozen-soil creep” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設凍土受壓力N=1200 kN、有效面積A=4 m²，平均σ=N/A=300 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For frozen-ground compression N=1200 kN over effective area A=4 m², mean σ=N/A=300 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表溫度下做持續載重材料試驗，配合洞內收斂與溫度資料，檢查變形速率是否加速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run sustained-load material tests at representative temperatures and compare convergence and temperature records for accelerating deformation rates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設凍土受壓力N=1200 kN、有效面積A=4 m²，平均σ=N/A=300 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For frozen-ground compression N=1200 kN over effective area A=4 m², mean σ=N/A=300 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「凍土潛變的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Frozen-soil creep mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設凍土受壓力N=1200 kN、有效面積A=4 m²，平均σ=N/A=300 kPa。
凍土沒有完全融化前，其支護能力都不會改變。
永久混凝土強度達標就能立即解除所有冷凍支護。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For frozen-ground compression N=1200 kN over effective area A=4 m², mean σ=N/A=300 kPa.
Frozen-ground support capacity remains unchanged until complete thawing.
Meeting permanent concrete strength allows immediate removal of all freezing support.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設凍土受壓力N=1200 kN、有效面積A=4 m²，平均σ=N/A=300 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For frozen-ground compression N=1200 kN over effective area A=4 m², mean σ=N/A=300 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 凍土潛變的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Frozen-soil creep mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「凍土潛變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Frozen-soil creep” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表溫度下做持續載重材料試驗，配合洞內收斂與溫度資料，檢查變形速率是否加速。排程應把凍結支護使用時間與襯砌閉合時間連結；延誤時由地工設計者重新評估潛變與維持冷量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run sustained-load material tests at representative temperatures and compare convergence and temperature records for accelerating deformation rates. Link frozen-support duration to lining closure in the programme; delays require the geotechnical designer to reassess creep and sustained cooling demand. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：排程應把凍結支護使用時間與襯砌閉合時間連結；延誤時由地工設計者重新評估潛變與維持冷量。平均應力不代表凍土容許應力，局部拉應力與剪應力也可能控制；設計材料參數必須對應實際溫度範圍與時間尺度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Link frozen-support duration to lining closure in the programme; delays require the geotechnical designer to reassess creep and sustained cooling demand. Mean stress is not an allowable frozen-soil stress, and local tension or shear may govern; design properties must correspond to the actual temperature range and time scale.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低溫試體的短期強度若誤用於較暖且長期受壓區，可能出現逐步收斂及支護超載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Run sustained-load material tests at representative temperatures and compare convergence and temperature records for accelerating deformation rates. Link frozen-support duration to lining closure in the programme; delays require the geotechnical designer to reassess creep and sustained cooling demand.

knowledge.text: 排程應把凍結支護使用時間與襯砌閉合時間連結；延誤時由地工設計者重新評估潛變與維持冷量。平均應力不代表凍土容許應力，局部拉應力與剪應力也可能控制；設計材料參數必須對應實際溫度範圍與時間尺度。

Mean stress is not an allowable frozen-soil stress, and local tension or shear may govern; design properties must correspond to the actual temperature range and time scale.

quiz.question: 要驗證「凍土潛變的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Frozen-soil creep mechanism and verification"?

所有凍結管出水都很冷就代表凍土壁已閉合。

quiz.explanationEn: Run sustained-load material tests at representative temperatures and compare convergence and temperature records for accelerating deformation rates. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 凍土潛變的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Frozen-soil creep mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「凍土潛變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Frozen-soil creep” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低溫試體的短期強度若誤用於較暖且長期受壓區，可能出現逐步收斂及支護超載。平均應力不代表凍土容許應力，局部拉應力與剪應力也可能控制；設計材料參數必須對應實際溫度範圍與時間尺度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying cold-specimen short-term strength to warmer, sustained-loading zones may lead to progressive convergence and overloaded support. Mean stress is not an allowable frozen-soil stress, and local tension or shear may govern; design properties must correspond to the actual temperature range and time scale. knowledge.text: 低溫試體的短期強度若誤用於較暖且長期受壓區，可能出現逐步收斂及支護超載。平均應力不代表凍土容許應力，局部拉應力與剪應力也可能控制；設計材料參數必須對應實際溫度範圍與時間尺度。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「凍土潛變的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Frozen-soil creep mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

凍結後的土體可以永遠視為絕對不透水。
低溫試體的短期強度若誤用於較暖且長期受壓區，可能出現逐步收斂及支護超載。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Frozen ground can always be treated as completely impermeable.
Applying cold-specimen short-term strength to warmer, sustained-loading zones may lead to progressive convergence and overloaded support.

steps.title: 凍結壁滲流的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Frozen-wall seepage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「凍結壁滲流」如何影響交叉隧道人工地盤凍結的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frozen-wall seepage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground freezing for tunnel cross-passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 冰填充孔隙後滲透性會下降，但未凍水、砂層與管間缺口仍可能形成連通通道。達西流量可描述理想均質屏障的量級，實際水密控制往往由最薄弱路徑主導；觀察少量出水也應檢查它是否攜砂及是否隨時間增大。達西模型假設層流與代表性滲透係數，無法描述開裂集中流；本式的低流量不能取代整體凍結壁連續性證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「凍結壁滲流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ice reduces pore connectivity, but unfrozen water, sand seams and pipe gaps can preserve connected pathways. Darcy flow gives the scale for an ideal homogeneous barrier, whereas actual sealing is often controlled by the weakest path. Even small inflow requires checks for transported sediment and increasing discharge with time. Darcy modelling assumes laminar flow and representative permeability and does not describe concentrated fracture flow; this small calculated discharge cannot replace evidence of barrier continuity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Frozen-wall seepage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、滲流面積A=20 m²、水力坡降i=5，Q=kAi=1×10⁻⁶ m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, seepage area A=20 m² and gradient i=5, Q=kAi=1×10⁻⁶ m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「凍結後的土體可以永遠視為絕對不透水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Frozen ground can always be treated as completely impermeable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「凍結壁滲流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Frozen-wall seepage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 凍結壁滲流的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 冰填充孔隙後滲透性會下降，但未凍水、砂層與管間缺口仍可能形成連通通道。達西流量可描述理想均質屏障的量級，實際水密控制往往由最薄弱路徑主導；觀察少量出水也應檢查它是否攜砂及是否隨時間增大。
knowledge.textEn: Ice reduces pore connectivity, but unfrozen water, sand seams and pipe gaps can preserve connected pathways. Darcy flow gives the scale for an ideal homogeneous barrier, whereas actual sealing is often controlled by the weakest path.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：凍結後的土體可以永遠視為絕對不透水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Frozen ground can always be treated as completely impermeable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「凍結壁滲流的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Frozen-wall seepage mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 冰填充孔隙後滲透性會下降，但未凍水、砂層與管間缺口仍可能形成連通通道。
凍結後的土體可以永遠視為絕對不透水。

optionsEn: Ice reduces pore connectivity, but unfrozen water, sand seams and pipe gaps can preserve connected pathways.
Frozen ground can always be treated as completely impermeable.
Small total frost heave cannot damage neighbouring structures.

steps.title: 凍結壁滲流的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Frozen-wall seepage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「凍結壁滲流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Frozen-wall seepage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、滲流面積A=20 m²、水力坡降i=5，Q=kAi=1×10⁻⁶ m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, seepage area A=20 m² and gradient i=5, Q=kAi=1×10⁻⁶ m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pressure difference and zoned collection flows, check temperature anomalies and turbidity, and overlay seepage locations on actual pipe trajectories.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

quiz.question: 依「凍結壁滲流的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 凍結壁滲流的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Frozen-wall seepage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「凍結壁滲流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Frozen-wall seepage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對水壓差與分區集水量，檢查溫度異常及混濁度，將滲流位置與實際凍結管軌跡疊圖。開挖前的水密驗證須使用核定方法且控制擾動；地工與水文負責人共同確認異常出水的停止條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An unfrozen path can enlarge after excavation pressure release; sediment-carrying inflow may erode the frozen wall and change its support geometry. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

Use an approved, disturbance-controlled sealing verification before excavation; geotechnical and hydrogeological leads jointly define stop conditions for anomalous inflow.

knowledge.textEn: Use an approved, disturbance-controlled sealing verification before excavation; geotechnical and hydrogeological leads jointly define stop conditions for anomalous inflow. Darcy modelling assumes laminar flow and representative permeability and does not describe concentrated fracture flow; this small calculated discharge cannot replace evidence of barrier continuity.

quiz.question: 要驗證「凍結壁滲流的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
