options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要冷凍機持續運轉，任何地下水流量都能自然克服。
比對水壓差與分區集水量，檢查溫度異常及混濁度，將滲流位置與實際凍結管軌跡疊圖。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Continuous refrigeration can automatically overcome any groundwater flow rate.
Compare pressure difference and zoned collection flows, check temperature anomalies and turbidity, and overlay seepage locations on actual pipe trajectories.
quiz.explanation: 比對水壓差與分區集水量，檢查溫度異常及混濁度，將滲流位置與實際凍結管軌跡疊圖。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pressure difference and zoned collection flows, check temperature anomalies and turbidity, and overlay seepage locations on actual pipe trajectories. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 凍結壁滲流的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Frozen-wall seepage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「凍結壁滲流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Frozen-wall seepage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未凍通道可能在開挖卸壓後擴大，湧水攜砂會使凍結壁局部侵蝕並改變支護形狀。達西模型假設層流與代表性滲透係數，無法描述開裂集中流；本式的低流量不能取代整體凍結壁連續性證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An unfrozen path can enlarge after excavation pressure release; sediment-carrying inflow may erode the frozen wall and change its support geometry. Darcy modelling assumes laminar flow and representative permeability and does not describe concentrated fracture flow; this small calculated discharge cannot replace evidence of barrier continuity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：達西模型假設層流與代表性滲透係數，無法描述開裂集中流；本式的低流量不能取代整體凍結壁連續性證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Darcy modelling assumes laminar flow and representative permeability and does not describe concentrated fracture flow; this small calculated discharge cannot replace evidence of barrier continuity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「凍結後的土體可以永遠視為絕對不透水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Frozen ground can always be treated as completely impermeable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未凍通道可能在開挖卸壓後擴大，湧水攜砂會使凍結壁局部侵蝕並改變支護形狀。達西模型假設層流與代表性滲透係數，無法描述開裂集中流；本式的低流量不能取代整體凍結壁連續性證據。
knowledge.textEn: An unfrozen path can enlarge after excavation pressure release; sediment-carrying inflow may erode the frozen wall and change its support geometry. Darcy modelling assumes laminar flow and representative permeability and does not describe concentrated fracture flow; this small calculated discharge cannot replace evidence of barrier continuity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「凍結壁滲流的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Frozen-wall seepage mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 未凍通道可能在開挖卸壓後擴大，湧水攜砂會使凍結壁局部侵蝕並改變支護形狀。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
凍脹只要總抬升不大就不會損傷周邊結構。
optionsEn: An unfrozen path can enlarge after excavation pressure release; sediment-carrying inflow may erode the frozen wall and change its support geometry.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Small total frost heave cannot damage neighbouring structures.
quiz.explanation: 未凍通道可能在開挖卸壓後擴大，湧水攜砂會使凍結壁局部侵蝕並改變支護形狀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An unfrozen path can enlarge after excavation pressure release; sediment-carrying inflow may erode the frozen wall and change its support geometry. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「凍脹差異的機理與驗證」與「冷量備援的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Differential frost heave mechanism and verification" and "Cooling reserve mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 凍脹差異的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential frost heave mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「凍脹差異」如何影響交叉隧道人工地盤凍結的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential frost heave” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground freezing for tunnel cross-passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 凍脹與水分遷移及冰透鏡生長有關，不只是原有孔隙水的體積膨脹。地層約束及補水路徑使地表或既有隧道產生不均勻隆起；結構常由差異變位而非平均抬升量控制，監測因此須跨越凍結區邊界。角變形是兩點平均坡度，不等於構件曲率或接縫開口；若剛體轉動佔主要部分，應與真正畸變分開判讀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「凍脹差異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Frost heave involves water migration and ice-lens growth, not merely expansion of existing pore water. Ground restraint and water supply cause uneven uplift of the surface or existing tunnels. Structures are often governed by differential movement rather than mean heave, so monitoring must span the boundary of the freezing zone. Angular distortion here is a two-point mean slope, not member curvature or joint opening; separate rigid-body rotation where it dominates from actual structural distortion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential frost heave” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：兩點差異抬升Δs=6 mm、間距L=12 m=12000 mm，角變形β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For differential heave Δs=6 mm over L=12 m=12000 mm, angular distortion β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「凍脹只要總抬升不大就不會損傷周邊結構。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small total frost heave cannot damage neighbouring structures." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「凍脹差異」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential frost heave”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 凍脹差異的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Differential frost heave mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 凍脹與水分遷移及冰透鏡生長有關，不只是原有孔隙水的體積膨脹。地層約束及補水路徑使地表或既有隧道產生不均勻隆起；結構常由差異變位而非平均抬升量控制，監測因此須跨越凍結區邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Frost heave involves water migration and ice-lens growth, not merely expansion of existing pore water. Ground restraint and water supply cause uneven uplift of the surface or existing tunnels.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：凍脹只要總抬升不大就不會損傷周邊結構。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small total frost heave cannot damage neighbouring structures. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「凍脹差異的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Differential frost heave mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 凍脹只要總抬升不大就不會損傷周邊結構。
凍脹與水分遷移及冰透鏡生長有關，不只是原有孔隙水的體積膨脹。
凍土沒有完全融化前，其支護能力都不會改變。
optionsEn: Small total frost heave cannot damage neighbouring structures.
Frost heave involves water migration and ice-lens growth, not merely expansion of existing pore water.
Frozen-ground support capacity remains unchanged until complete thawing.
quiz.explanation: 凍脹與水分遷移及冰透鏡生長有關，不只是原有孔隙水的體積膨脹。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Frost heave involves water migration and ice-lens growth, not merely expansion of existing pore water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 凍脹差異的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Differential frost heave mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「凍脹差異」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential frost heave” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：兩點差異抬升Δs=6 mm、間距L=12 m=12000 mm，角變形β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For differential heave Δs=6 mm over L=12 m=12000 mm, angular distortion β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用精密水準及隧道收斂測點追蹤凍結區內外差異，將位移方向與水位、溫度歷程比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track differential movement inside and outside the freezing zone with precise levelling and tunnel convergence, comparing directions with water levels and temperature history.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：兩點差異抬升Δs=6 mm、間距L=12 m=12000 mm，角變形β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For differential heave Δs=6 mm over L=12 m=12000 mm, angular distortion β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「凍脹差異的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Differential frost heave mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 永久混凝土強度達標就能立即解除所有冷凍支護。
所有凍結管出水都很冷就代表凍土壁已閉合。
原創教學假設：兩點差異抬升Δs=6 mm、間距L=12 m=12000 mm，角變形β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。
optionsEn: Meeting permanent concrete strength allows immediate removal of all freezing support.
Cold return fluid from every pipe proves closure of the frozen wall.
Original teaching assumptions: For differential heave Δs=6 mm over L=12 m=12000 mm, angular distortion β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：兩點差異抬升Δs=6 mm、間距L=12 m=12000 mm，角變形β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For differential heave Δs=6 mm over L=12 m=12000 mm, angular distortion β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 凍脹差異的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential frost heave mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「凍脹差異」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential frost heave” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用精密水準及隧道收斂測點追蹤凍結區內外差異，將位移方向與水位、溫度歷程比對。變形允收需依資產接縫與管線能力制定；凍結區變更前，由資產管理者和設計者確認監測涵蓋範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track differential movement inside and outside the freezing zone with precise levelling and tunnel convergence, comparing directions with water levels and temperature history. Set movement criteria from asset-joint and utility capacity; the asset owner and designer confirm monitoring coverage before the freezing zone is changed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：變形允收需依資產接縫與管線能力制定；凍結區變更前，由資產管理者和設計者確認監測涵蓋範圍。角變形是兩點平均坡度，不等於構件曲率或接縫開口；若剛體轉動佔主要部分，應與真正畸變分開判讀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set movement criteria from asset-joint and utility capacity; the asset owner and designer confirm monitoring coverage before the freezing zone is changed. Angular distortion here is a two-point mean slope, not member curvature or joint opening; separate rigid-body rotation where it dominates from actual structural distortion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：地表抬升看似均勻時，接縫附近仍可能集中轉角；既有管線的脆性接頭可能先開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Apparently uniform surface heave can still concentrate rotation near joints, allowing brittle connections in existing utilities to crack first. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用精密水準及隧道收斂測點追蹤凍結區內外差異，將位移方向與水位、溫度歷程比對。變形允收需依資產接縫與管線能力制定；凍結區變更前，由資產管理者和設計者確認監測涵蓋範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Track differential movement inside and outside the freezing zone with precise levelling and tunnel convergence, comparing directions with water levels and temperature history. Set movement criteria from asset-joint and utility capacity; the asset owner and designer confirm monitoring coverage before the freezing zone is changed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 變形允收需依資產接縫與管線能力制定；凍結區變更前，由資產管理者和設計者確認監測涵蓋範圍。角變形是兩點平均坡度，不等於構件曲率或接縫開口；若剛體轉動佔主要部分，應與真正畸變分開判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Set movement criteria from asset-joint and utility capacity; the asset owner and designer confirm monitoring coverage before the freezing zone is changed. Angular distortion here is a two-point mean slope, not member curvature or joint opening; separate rigid-body rotation where it dominates from actual structural distortion.

quiz.question: 要驗證「凍脹差異的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential frost heave mechanism and verification"?
options: 用精密水準及隧道收斂測點追蹤凍結區內外差異，將位移方向與水位、溫度歷程比對。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
公式算出三天就保證三天後所有凍土都能承載。
optionsEn: Track differential movement inside and outside the freezing zone with precise levelling and tunnel convergence, comparing directions with water levels and temperature history.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A three-day diffusion calculation guarantees load-bearing frozen soil after three days.
quiz.explanation: 用精密水準及隧道收斂測點追蹤凍結區內外差異，將位移方向與水位、溫度歷程比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track differential movement inside and outside the freezing zone with precise levelling and tunnel convergence, comparing directions with water levels and temperature history. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 凍脹差異的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential frost heave mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「凍脹差異」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential frost heave” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 地表抬升看似均勻時，接縫附近仍可能集中轉角；既有管線的脆性接頭可能先開裂。角變形是兩點平均坡度，不等於構件曲率或接縫開口；若剛體轉動佔主要部分，應與真正畸變分開判讀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Apparently uniform surface heave can still concentrate rotation near joints, allowing brittle connections in existing utilities to crack first. Angular distortion here is a two-point mean slope, not member curvature or joint opening; separate rigid-body rotation where it dominates from actual structural distortion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 冷量備援的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「冷量備援」如何影響交叉隧道人工地盤凍結的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cooling reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground freezing for tunnel cross-passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 冷凍設備停機後，凍土吸收外部熱量並逐步升溫，尚未完全融化前其強度也可能下降。可用熱緩衝取決於最低允許溫度及凍土體積，不能把全部冰融化熱都當可用餘裕；備援還要考慮電力、循環泵及管路共同失效。定熱流估算只提供簡化時間尺度，實際熱流會隨溫差與流場改變；十小時不是可繼續作業的保證或撤離時限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「冷量備援」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After refrigeration stops, frozen ground absorbs heat and warms, potentially losing strength before complete thawing. Useful thermal reserve depends on the allowable temperature and frozen volume; total ice-melting energy is not all usable margin. Backup assessment must also consider common failures of power, circulation pumps and pipework rather than the refrigeration unit alone. The constant-heat estimate gives a simplified time scale; heat flow changes with temperature difference and groundwater, so ten hours is neither an operating guarantee nor an evacuation deadline. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cooling reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設到指定警戒溫度的可用熱緩衝E=3600 MJ、持續熱流P=0.1 MW=0.1 MJ/s，t=E/P=36000 s=10 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With usable reserve E=3600 MJ to a specified warning temperature and heat inflow P=0.1 MW=0.1 MJ/s, t=E/P=36000 s=10 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「凍土沒有完全融化前，其支護能力都不會改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Frozen-ground support capacity remains unchanged until complete thawing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「冷量備援」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 誤解：凍土沒有完全融化前，其支護能力都不會改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Frozen-ground support capacity remains unchanged until complete thawing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「冷量備援的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Frozen-ground support capacity remains unchanged until complete thawing.
Thawing always reverses frost heave exactly to the original position.
After refrigeration stops, frozen ground absorbs heat and warms, potentially losing strength before complete thawing.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: With usable reserve E=3600 MJ to a specified warning temperature and heat inflow P=0.1 MW=0.1 MJ/s, t=E/P=36000 s=10 h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Thawing always reverses frost heave exactly to the original position.
A spare refrigeration unit sharing power or circulation pumps can still lose all cooling from one failure, allowing thin local zones to soften first.
quiz.explanation: 冷凍機有備機但共用供電或循環泵時，單一故障仍可能切斷全部冷量，使局部薄壁先軟化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A spare refrigeration unit sharing power or circulation pumps can still lose all cooling from one failure, allowing thin local zones to soften first. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「融沉預估的機理與驗證」與「永久襯砌接管的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thaw settlement mechanism and verification" and "Permanent-lining takeover mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 融沉預估的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thaw settlement mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「融沉預估」如何影響交叉隧道人工地盤凍結的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thaw settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground freezing for tunnel cross-passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 解凍後冰透鏡消失，土骨架可能在外荷載下重新壓密，造成與凍脹不對稱的殘餘沉陷。永久襯砌、管線與周邊地基對此變形的剛度不同，荷載會重新分配；凍結期間表現良好並不代表解凍階段已完成驗證。一維應變積分不包含三維拘束與結構互制，融沉應變必須由代表性試驗界定，不能把其他工程的沉陷率直接移用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「融沉預估」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thawing removes ice lenses and allows the skeleton to reconsolidate under load, leaving settlement that need not reverse prior heave symmetrically. Permanent lining, utilities and neighbouring foundations have different stiffnesses, causing load redistribution. Good behaviour during freezing therefore does not establish satisfactory performance through the thaw stage. One-dimensional strain integration excludes three-dimensional restraint and structural interaction; representative tests must establish thaw strain rather than transferring another project's settlement ratio. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thaw settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設受影響層厚H=3 m、平均融沉應變εv=0.02，s=εvH=0.06 m=60 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For affected thickness H=3 m and mean thaw-settlement strain εv=0.02, s=εvH=0.06 m=60 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「凍脹多少，解凍後就必定等量回到原位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thawing always reverses frost heave exactly to the original position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「融沉預估」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thaw settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 融沉預估的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 解凍後冰透鏡消失，土骨架可能在外荷載下重新壓密，造成與凍脹不對稱的殘餘沉陷。永久襯砌、管線與周邊地基對此變形的剛度不同，荷載會重新分配；凍結期間表現良好並不代表解凍階段已完成驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Thawing removes ice lenses and allows the skeleton to reconsolidate under load, leaving settlement that need not reverse prior heave symmetrically. Permanent lining, utilities and neighbouring foundations have different stiffnesses, causing load redistribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：凍脹多少，解凍後就必定等量回到原位。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thawing always reverses frost heave exactly to the original position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「融沉預估的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thaw settlement mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 解凍後冰透鏡消失，土骨架可能在外荷載下重新壓密，造成與凍脹不對稱的殘餘沉陷。
凍脹多少，解凍後就必定等量回到原位。
永久混凝土強度達標就能立即解除所有冷凍支護。
optionsEn: Thawing removes ice lenses and allows the skeleton to reconsolidate under load, leaving settlement that need not reverse prior heave symmetrically.
Thawing always reverses frost heave exactly to the original position.
Meeting permanent concrete strength allows immediate removal of all freezing support.
quiz.explanation: 解凍後冰透鏡消失，土骨架可能在外荷載下重新壓密，造成與凍脹不對稱的殘餘沉陷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Thawing removes ice lenses and allows the skeleton to reconsolidate under load, leaving settlement that need not reverse prior heave symmetrically. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 融沉預估的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thaw settlement mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「融沉預估」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thaw settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設受影響層厚H=3 m、平均融沉應變εv=0.02，s=εvH=0.06 m=60 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For affected thickness H=3 m and mean thaw-settlement strain εv=0.02, s=εvH=0.06 m=60 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用凍融試驗與分層沉陷計檢查殘餘變形，配合孔壓消散曲線，將地表總沉陷分解到受影響土層。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use freeze-thaw tests and layered settlement instruments to assess residual deformation, combining pore-pressure dissipation with decomposition of surface settlement by affected layer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設受影響層厚H=3 m、平均融沉應變εv=0.02，s=εvH=0.06 m=60 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For affected thickness H=3 m and mean thaw-settlement strain εv=0.02, s=εvH=0.06 m=60 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「融沉預估的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thaw settlement mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 所有凍結管出水都很冷就代表凍土壁已閉合。
原創教學假設：假設受影響層厚H=3 m、平均融沉應變εv=0.02，s=εvH=0.06 m=60 mm。
公式算出三天就保證三天後所有凍土都能承載。
optionsEn: Cold return fluid from every pipe proves closure of the frozen wall.
Original teaching assumptions: For affected thickness H=3 m and mean thaw-settlement strain εv=0.02, s=εvH=0.06 m=60 mm.
A three-day diffusion calculation guarantees load-bearing frozen soil after three days.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設受影響層厚H=3 m、平均融沉應變εv=0.02，s=εvH=0.06 m=60 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For affected thickness H=3 m and mean thaw-settlement strain εv=0.02, s=εvH=0.06 m=60 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 融沉預估的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thaw settlement mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「融沉預估」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thaw settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用凍融試驗與分層沉陷計檢查殘餘變形，配合孔壓消散曲線，將地表總沉陷分解到受影響土層。交接需指定解凍後監測終止條件及資產檢查責任；地工設計者確認孔壓與沉陷趨勢穩定後才核准結案。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use freeze-thaw tests and layered settlement instruments to assess residual deformation, combining pore-pressure dissipation with decomposition of surface settlement by affected layer. Handover specifies post-thaw monitoring closure criteria and asset-inspection responsibility; the geotechnical designer confirms stable pore-pressure and settlement trends before closeout. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接需指定解凍後監測終止條件及資產檢查責任；地工設計者確認孔壓與沉陷趨勢穩定後才核准結案。一維應變積分不包含三維拘束與結構互制，融沉應變必須由代表性試驗界定，不能把其他工程的沉陷率直接移用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover specifies post-thaw monitoring closure criteria and asset-inspection responsibility; the geotechnical designer confirms stable pore-pressure and settlement trends before closeout. One-dimensional strain integration excludes three-dimensional restraint and structural interaction; representative tests must establish thaw strain rather than transferring another project's settlement ratio.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：解凍後差異沉陷可能使接縫張開，若監測在冷凍停止時即結束，就會漏掉最重要的永久變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Differential thaw settlement may open joints; ending monitoring when refrigeration stops misses the most significant permanent deformation stage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用凍融試驗與分層沉陷計檢查殘餘變形，配合孔壓消散曲線，將地表總沉陷分解到受影響土層。交接需指定解凍後監測終止條件及資產檢查責任；地工設計者確認孔壓與沉陷趨勢穩定後才核准結案。
knowledge.textEn: Use freeze-thaw tests and layered settlement instruments to assess residual deformation, combining pore-pressure dissipation with decomposition of surface settlement by affected layer. Handover specifies post-thaw monitoring closure criteria and asset-inspection responsibility; the geotechnical designer confirms stable pore-pressure and settlement trends before closeout.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接需指定解凍後監測終止條件及資產檢查責任；地工設計者確認孔壓與沉陷趨勢穩定後才核准結案。一維應變積分不包含三維拘束與結構互制，融沉應變必須由代表性試驗界定，不能把其他工程的沉陷率直接移用。
knowledge.textEn: Handover specifies post-thaw monitoring closure criteria and asset-inspection responsibility; the geotechnical designer confirms stable pore-pressure and settlement trends before closeout. One-dimensional strain integration excludes three-dimensional restraint and structural interaction; representative tests must establish thaw strain rather than transferring another project's settlement ratio.

quiz.question: 要驗證「融沉預估的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thaw settlement mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
凍結後的土體可以永遠視為絕對不透水。
用凍融試驗與分層沉陷計檢查殘餘變形，配合孔壓消散曲線，將地表總沉陷分解到受影響土層。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Frozen ground can always be treated as completely impermeable.
Use freeze-thaw tests and layered settlement instruments to assess residual deformation, combining pore-pressure dissipation with decomposition of surface settlement by affected layer.
quiz.explanation: 用凍融試驗與分層沉陷計檢查殘餘變形，配合孔壓消散曲線，將地表總沉陷分解到受影響土層。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use freeze-thaw tests and layered settlement instruments to assess residual deformation, combining pore-pressure dissipation with decomposition of surface settlement by affected layer. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 融沉預估的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thaw settlement mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「融沉預估」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thaw settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 解凍後差異沉陷可能使接縫張開，若監測在冷凍停止時即結束，就會漏掉最重要的永久變形。一維應變積分不包含三維拘束與結構互制，融沉應變必須由代表性試驗界定，不能把其他工程的沉陷率直接移用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Differential thaw settlement may open joints; ending monitoring when refrigeration stops misses the most significant permanent deformation stage. One-dimensional strain integration excludes three-dimensional restraint and structural interaction; representative tests must establish thaw strain rather than transferring another project's settlement ratio. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：一維應變積分不包含三維拘束與結構互制，融沉應變必須由代表性試驗界定，不能把其他工程的沉陷率直接移用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One-dimensional strain integration excludes three-dimensional restraint and structural interaction; representative tests must establish thaw strain rather than transferring another project's settlement ratio.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「凍脹多少，解凍後就必定等量回到原位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thawing always reverses frost heave exactly to the original position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 解凍後差異沉陷可能使接縫張開，若監測在冷凍停止時即結束，就會漏掉最重要的永久變形。一維應變積分不包含三維拘束與結構互制，融沉應變必須由代表性試驗界定，不能把其他工程的沉陷率直接移用。
knowledge.textEn: Differential thaw settlement may open joints; ending monitoring when refrigeration stops misses the most significant permanent deformation stage. One-dimensional strain integration excludes three-dimensional restraint and structural interaction; representative tests must establish thaw strain rather than transferring another project's settlement ratio.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「融沉預估的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thaw settlement mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 解凍後差異沉陷可能使接縫張開，若監測在冷凍停止時即結束，就會漏掉最重要的永久變形。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
永久混凝土強度達標就能立即解除所有冷凍支護。
optionsEn: Differential thaw settlement may open joints; ending monitoring when refrigeration stops misses the most significant permanent deformation stage.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Meeting permanent concrete strength allows immediate removal of all freezing support.
quiz.explanation: 解凍後差異沉陷可能使接縫張開，若監測在冷凍停止時即結束，就會漏掉最重要的永久變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Differential thaw settlement may open joints; ending monitoring when refrigeration stops misses the most significant permanent deformation stage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 永久襯砌接管的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Permanent-lining takeover mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「永久襯砌接管」如何影響交叉隧道人工地盤凍結的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Permanent-lining takeover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground freezing for tunnel cross-passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設外部水頭h=15 m、受浮投影面積A=8 m²、γw=9.81 kN/m³，U=γwhA=1177 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 永久襯砌接管的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「永久襯砌接管」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 核對永久襯砌閉合與止水試驗，將設計水位、抗浮構件及解凍位移聯合審查，不只驗材料強度。冷凍解除必須設正式停留點，地工、襯砌及營運負責人共同簽認荷載接管與後續監測責任。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify permanent closure and joint tests, reviewing design water level, uplift-resisting members and thaw movement together rather than material strength alone. title: 連續壁槽溝穩定
summary: 連續壁成槽時，穩定液必須與地下水、土層滲透性及地面載重共同維持槽壁穩定。本課從壓差與濾餅機理出發，連結槽段幾何、垂直度、沉渣與鋼筋籠浮力，再用混凝土量平衡與接頭水力坡降建立施工品質及鄰房變形的驗證鏈。
summaryEn: During diaphragm-wall excavation, support fluid interacts with groundwater, permeability and surface loading to maintain trench stability. The course connects pressure balance and filter cake to panel geometry, verticality, sediment and cage buoyancy, then uses concrete-volume balance and joint hydraulic gradients to verify construction quality and adjacent-asset movement.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設穩定液與地下水液面相同，單位重分別為11與9.81 kN/m³，在深度20 m的靜水壓差為Δp=(11−9.81)×20=23.8 kPa。保持液位與密度條件不變，若檢查深度增加10%至22 m，壓差增為26.18 kPa。這只增加液壓差，不代表整體槽壁安全也增加10%，因為土壓、地層變化及槽段幾何同步影響穩定。應把液位實測、濾餅形成及槽邊載重納入完整分析，再由成槽設計者確認可接受的施工條件。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume equal slurry and groundwater levels with unit weights of 11 and 9.81 kN/m³. At 20 m depth the static pressure margin is Δp=(11−9.81)×20=23.8 kPa. Holding levels and densities fixed while increasing depth by 10% to 22 m gives 26.18 kPa. This increases hydraulic margin only, not overall trench stability by 10%, because earth pressures, changing strata and panel geometry also influence the mechanism. Include observed fluid levels, filter-cake formation and edge surcharge in the complete analysis before the excavation designer confirms acceptable site-specific construction conditions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「穩定液壓差的機理與驗證」與「濾餅滲流的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Slurry pressure margin mechanism and verification" and "Filter-cake seepage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 穩定液壓差的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Slurry pressure margin mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「穩定液壓差」如何影響連續壁槽溝穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slurry pressure margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穩定液的靜水壓對槽壁施加支承，地下水則從外側抵銷部分壓力，兩者須以同一高程及液面比較。液位突然下降可能使支承消失，密度增加雖可提高壓力，卻也影響沉渣、流動及混凝土置換，不能單獨追求較大數值。壓差不是完整槽壁安全係數，還須檢查土楔、地面載重及三維拱效應；高滲透地層可能無法形成有效壓力邊界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「穩定液壓差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Support-fluid pressure acts on trench walls while external groundwater offsets part of it, requiring comparison at a common elevation and fluid level. A sudden level drop can remove support. Higher density increases pressure but also affects sedimentation, flow and concrete displacement, so maximizing density alone is not a rational criterion. Pressure margin is not a complete trench-stability factor; soil wedges, surcharge and three-dimensional arching also matter, and permeable strata may not sustain the intended pressure boundary. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Slurry pressure margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設液面相同、穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、水γw=9.81 kN/m³、深度z=20 m，Δp=(γs−γw)z=23.8 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With equal fluid levels, γs=11 kN/m³, γw=9.81 kN/m³ and z=20 m, Δp=(γs−γw)z=23.8 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「穩定液密度合格就不需要再監測液面高度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Acceptable slurry density eliminates the need to monitor fluid level." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「穩定液壓差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Slurry pressure margin”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 穩定液壓差的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Slurry pressure margin mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 穩定液的靜水壓對槽壁施加支承，地下水則從外側抵銷部分壓力，兩者須以同一高程及液面比較。液位突然下降可能使支承消失，密度增加雖可提高壓力，卻也影響沉渣、流動及混凝土置換，不能單獨追求較大數值。
knowledge.textEn: Support-fluid pressure acts on trench walls while external groundwater offsets part of it, requiring comparison at a common elevation and fluid level. A sudden level drop can remove support.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：穩定液密度合格就不需要再監測液面高度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Acceptable slurry density eliminates the need to monitor fluid level. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「穩定液壓差的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Slurry pressure margin mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 穩定液密度合格就不需要再監測液面高度。
穩定液的靜水壓對槽壁施加支承，地下水則從外側抵銷部分壓力，兩者須以同一高程及液面比較。
穩定液黏度足夠就一定能在任何地層形成濾餅。
optionsEn: Acceptable slurry density eliminates the need to monitor fluid level.
Support-fluid pressure acts on trench walls while external groundwater offsets part of it, requiring comparison at a common elevation and fluid level.
Adequate slurry viscosity guarantees a filter cake in every soil.
quiz.explanation: 穩定液的靜水壓對槽壁施加支承，地下水則從外側抵銷部分壓力，兩者須以同一高程及液面比較。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Support-fluid pressure acts on trench walls while external groundwater offsets part of it, requiring comparison at a common elevation and fluid level. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 穩定液壓差的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Slurry pressure margin mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「穩定液壓差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slurry pressure margin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設液面相同、穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、水γw=9.81 kN/m³、深度z=20 m，Δp=(γs−γw)z=23.8 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: With equal fluid levels, γs=11 kN/m³, γw=9.81 kN/m³ and z=20 m, Δp=(γs−γw)z=23.8 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分深度測密度並連續追蹤液位，對照外側水壓計；將液位差與密度差分開帶入壓力圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure density by depth and continuously track fluid level against external piezometers, separating level and density differences in pressure diagrams.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設液面相同、穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、水γw=9.81 kN/m³、深度z=20 m，Δp=(γs−γw)z=23.8 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: With equal fluid levels, γs=11 kN/m³, γw=9.81 kN/m³ and z=20 m, Δp=(γs−γw)z=23.8 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「穩定液壓差的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Slurry pressure margin mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 地面不沉陷就表示機具載重沒有影響槽壁穩定。
清底完成一次後，多久再澆置都不會重新沉積。
原創教學假設：假設液面相同、穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、水γw=9.81 kN/m³、深度z=20 m，Δp=(γs−γw)z=23.8 kPa。
optionsEn: No visible surface settlement means machinery loading does not affect trench stability.
Once the base is cleaned, no sediment can redeposit before concrete placement.
Original teaching assumptions: With equal fluid levels, γs=11 kN/m³, γw=9.81 kN/m³ and z=20 m, Δp=(γs−γw)z=23.8 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設液面相同、穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、水γw=9.81 kN/m³、深度z=20 m，Δp=(γs−γw)z=23.8 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: With equal fluid levels, γs=11 kN/m³, γw=9.81 kN/m³ and z=20 m, Δp=(γs−γw)z=23.8 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 穩定液壓差的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Slurry pressure margin mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「穩定液壓差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slurry pressure margin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分深度測密度並連續追蹤液位，對照外側水壓計；將液位差與密度差分開帶入壓力圖。每個槽段應保留液位與密度時間線；異常漏失的停留點由成槽及地工負責人共同確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure density by depth and continuously track fluid level against external piezometers, separating level and density differences in pressure diagrams. Retain fluid-level and density time histories for every panel; excavation and geotechnical leads jointly confirm hold points for abnormal fluid loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每個槽段應保留液位與密度時間線；異常漏失的停留點由成槽及地工負責人共同確認。壓差不是完整槽壁安全係數，還須檢查土楔、地面載重及三維拱效應；高滲透地層可能無法形成有效壓力邊界。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain fluid-level and density time histories for every panel; excavation and geotechnical leads jointly confirm hold points for abnormal fluid loss. Pressure margin is not a complete trench-stability factor; soil wedges, surcharge and three-dimensional arching also matter, and permeable strata may not sustain the intended pressure boundary.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：穩定液漏失會降低支承壓力，槽口沉陷或局部坍塌可能在平均密度仍合格時發生。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fluid loss reduces support pressure; collar settlement or local collapse can occur even while average slurry density remains acceptable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Pressure margin is not a complete trench-stability factor; soil wedges, surcharge and three-dimensional arching also matter, and permeable strata may not sustain the intended pressure boundary.

quiz.question: 要驗證「穩定液壓差的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Slurry pressure margin mechanism and verification"?

steps.title: 穩定液壓差的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slurry pressure margin mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「穩定液壓差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slurry pressure margin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 穩定液漏失會降低支承壓力，槽口沉陷或局部坍塌可能在平均密度仍合格時發生。壓差不是完整槽壁安全係數，還須檢查土楔、地面載重及三維拱效應；高滲透地層可能無法形成有效壓力邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fluid loss reduces support pressure; collar settlement or local collapse can occur even while average slurry density remains acceptable. Pressure margin is not a complete trench-stability factor; soil wedges, surcharge and three-dimensional arching also matter, and permeable strata may not sustain the intended pressure boundary. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：壓差不是完整槽壁安全係數，還須檢查土楔、地面載重及三維拱效應；高滲透地層可能無法形成有效壓力邊界。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「穩定液壓差的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 濾餅滲流的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter-cake seepage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「濾餅滲流」如何影響連續壁槽溝穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filter-cake seepage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穩定液在可滲透槽壁形成低滲透濾餅，才可把液壓有效傳給土骨架；若濾餅太薄、破損或無法形成，液體可能深入地層而失去支承效果。濾餅厚度也影響後續混凝土與土體接觸，成槽穩定與接面品質不能分開看。式中流速是達西通量而非孔隙內真實流速，假設均勻完整濾餅；開裂及粗孔隙穿透不能靠此一維模型表達。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濾餅滲流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A low-permeability filter cake allows slurry pressure to act effectively on the soil skeleton. Thin, damaged or absent cake permits fluid penetration and loss of support efficiency. Cake thickness also affects later concrete-ground contact, linking excavation stability with interface quality rather than treating them as unrelated controls. The velocity is Darcy flux rather than pore-water velocity and assumes intact uniform cake; cracking and penetration into coarse voids fall outside this one-dimensional model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter-cake seepage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設濾餅k=1×10⁻⁹ m/s、水頭差Δh=10 m、厚度t=0.005 m，達西流速v=kΔh/t=2×10⁻⁶ m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For cake permeability k=1×10⁻⁹ m/s, head difference Δh=10 m and thickness t=0.005 m, Darcy flux v=kΔh/t=2×10⁻⁶ m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「穩定液黏度足夠就一定能在任何地層形成濾餅。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate slurry viscosity guarantees a filter cake in every soil." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「濾餅滲流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Filter-cake seepage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「濾餅滲流的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

槽段越長、接頭越少，就必定具有更好的整體安全性。
穩定液在可滲透槽壁形成低滲透濾餅，才可把液壓有效傳給土骨架；若濾餅太薄、破損或無法形成，液體可能深入地層而失去支承效果。
optionsEn: Adequate slurry viscosity guarantees a filter cake in every soil.
Longer panels with fewer joints necessarily improve overall safety.
A low-permeability filter cake allows slurry pressure to act effectively on the soil skeleton.
quiz.explanation: 穩定液在可滲透槽壁形成低滲透濾餅，才可把液壓有效傳給土骨架；若濾餅太薄、破損或無法形成，液體可能深入地層而失去支承效果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A low-permeability filter cake allows slurry pressure to act effectively on the soil skeleton. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 濾餅滲流的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Filter-cake seepage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濾餅滲流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter-cake seepage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設濾餅k=1×10⁻⁹ m/s、水頭差Δh=10 m、厚度t=0.005 m，達西流速v=kΔh/t=2×10⁻⁶ m/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For cake permeability k=1×10⁻⁹ m/s, head difference Δh=10 m and thickness t=0.005 m, Darcy flux v=kΔh/t=2×10⁻⁶ m/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以濾失與泥皮試驗配合地層粒徑判斷濾餅形成，核對現場液位補充量及漏失位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use fluid-loss and cake tests with soil grading to assess cake formation, checking field replenishment volumes and fluid-loss locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設濾餅k=1×10⁻⁹ m/s、水頭差Δh=10 m、厚度t=0.005 m，達西流速v=kΔh/t=2×10⁻⁶ m/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「濾餅滲流的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Filter-cake seepage mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設濾餅k=1×10⁻⁹ m/s、水頭差Δh=10 m、厚度t=0.005 m，達西流速v=kΔh/t=2×10⁻⁶ m/s。
槽口位置正確就代表整個深槽都在設計位置。
鋼筋比穩定液重，所以施工中完全不可能上浮。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For cake permeability k=1×10⁻⁹ m/s, head difference Δh=10 m and thickness t=0.005 m, Darcy flux v=kΔh/t=2×10⁻⁶ m/s.
A correctly located trench collar guarantees the full-depth panel position.
Steel is denser than slurry, so the cage cannot rise during construction.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For cake permeability k=1×10⁻⁹ m/s, head difference Δh=10 m and thickness t=0.005 m, Darcy flux v=kΔh/t=2×10⁻⁶ m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 濾餅滲流的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter-cake seepage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濾餅滲流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter-cake seepage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以濾失與泥皮試驗配合地層粒徑判斷濾餅形成，核對現場液位補充量及漏失位置。穩定液配方試驗需對應代表性地層；漏失機理未辨明前，地工設計者應審查替代支承或預處理方案。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use fluid-loss and cake tests with soil grading to assess cake formation, checking field replenishment volumes and fluid-loss locations. Fluid qualification must represent the ground; before proceeding with unexplained losses, the geotechnical designer reviews alternative support or pretreatment options. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：穩定液配方試驗需對應代表性地層；漏失機理未辨明前，地工設計者應審查替代支承或預處理方案。式中流速是達西通量而非孔隙內真實流速，假設均勻完整濾餅；開裂及粗孔隙穿透不能靠此一維模型表達。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Fluid qualification must represent the ground; before proceeding with unexplained losses, the geotechnical designer reviews alternative support or pretreatment options. The velocity is Darcy flux rather than pore-water velocity and assumes intact uniform cake; cracking and penetration into coarse voids fall outside this one-dimensional model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把試驗杯內泥皮表現直接套用於礫石層，可能漏掉大孔隙流失與槽壁局部失穩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Transferring laboratory filter-cake behaviour directly to gravel may miss large-pore fluid loss and local wall instability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Filter-cake seepage mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以濾失與泥皮試驗配合地層粒徑判斷濾餅形成，核對現場液位補充量及漏失位置。

Impermeable wall concrete guarantees every panel joint is watertight.
quiz.explanation: 以濾失與泥皮試驗配合地層粒徑判斷濾餅形成，核對現場液位補充量及漏失位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 濾餅滲流的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Filter-cake seepage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濾餅滲流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Filter-cake seepage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把試驗杯內泥皮表現直接套用於礫石層，可能漏掉大孔隙流失與槽壁局部失穩。式中流速是達西通量而非孔隙內真實流速，假設均勻完整濾餅；開裂及粗孔隙穿透不能靠此一維模型表達。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Transferring laboratory filter-cake behaviour directly to gravel may miss large-pore fluid loss and local wall instability. The velocity is Darcy flux rather than pore-water velocity and assumes intact uniform cake; cracking and penetration into coarse voids fall outside this one-dimensional model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「濾餅滲流的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「槽段三維效應的機理與驗證」與「槽邊載重的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Panel three-dimensional effect mechanism and verification" and "Trench-edge surcharge mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 槽段三維效應的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Panel three-dimensional effect mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「槽段三維效應」如何影響連續壁槽溝穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Panel three-dimensional effect” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 有限槽段的兩端土體可提供三維拱效應，因而槽長與深度會影響穩定，不能把無限長剖面的結果無條件套用。延長槽段可減少接頭數，卻增加開放面與施工時間，也可能穿越更多地層變異，方案取捨需要同時考量。長深比僅為幾何描述，並無通用允收界限；完整分析仍需土體強度、液壓、地面載重與槽端條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「槽段三維效應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Soil at the ends of a finite panel provides three-dimensional arching, making stability sensitive to panel length and depth. An infinite-section result cannot be transferred unconditionally. Longer panels reduce joint count but enlarge exposure, prolong excavation and cross more ground variability, so these effects must be considered together. The length-depth ratio describes geometry and has no universal acceptance threshold; full analysis still needs soil strength, fluid pressure, surcharge and end conditions. steps.instruction: 成槽後的懸浮粒子會沉降在槽底，形成低強度、易壓縮的接面，也可能在混凝土置換時夾入壁體。沉渣厚度不是單靠穩定液密度可知，停置時間、粒徑及清底效果均有影響；壁樁承載與止水連續性需分別檢查。體積式只估算平均沉渣量，局部厚層可能更不利；沉渣允收需依端承、壁體品質及專案規範分別訂定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「槽底沉渣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instructionEn: Measure sediment at multiple base positions and verify the cleaning-to-placement interval; use sampling and concrete-displacement records to investigate entrapped slurry. Record measurement positions and time at base acceptance; delays beyond approved conditions require reinspection rather than reliance on the earlier acceptance record. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：清底驗收需記錄量測位置與時間；延誤超過核定條件時由監造要求複查，不能只沿用先前合格紀錄。體積式只估算平均沉渣量，局部厚層可能更不利；沉渣允收需依端承、壁體品質及專案規範分別訂定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record measurement positions and time at base acceptance; delays beyond approved conditions require reinspection rather than reliance on the earlier acceptance record. The volume expression estimates mean sediment only; local thick pockets can be more adverse, and acceptance depends on bearing, wall quality and project specifications.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：厚沉渣會造成端部壓縮或局部夾泥，表面混凝土強度合格仍可能留下深部滲漏路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Thick sediment can cause base compression or slurry inclusions; satisfactory surface concrete strength does not exclude a deep leakage path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Bottom sediment mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「槽底沉渣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bottom sediment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 厚沉渣會造成端部壓縮或局部夾泥，表面混凝土強度合格仍可能留下深部滲漏路徑。體積式只估算平均沉渣量，局部厚層可能更不利；沉渣允收需依端承、壁體品質及專案規範分別訂定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Thick sediment can cause base compression or slurry inclusions; satisfactory surface concrete strength does not exclude a deep leakage path. The volume expression estimates mean sediment only; local thick pockets can be more adverse, and acceptance depends on bearing, wall quality and project specifications. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「槽底沉渣的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 厚沉渣會造成端部壓縮或局部夾泥，表面混凝土強度合格仍可能留下深部滲漏路徑。

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

quiz.explanationEn: Thick sediment can cause base compression or slurry inclusions; satisfactory surface concrete strength does not exclude a deep leakage path. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼筋籠浮力的機理與驗證」與「混凝土量平衡的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cage buoyancy mechanism and verification" and "Concrete volume balance mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼筋籠浮力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cage buoyancy mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼筋籠浮力」如何影響連續壁槽溝穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cage buoyancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼筋籠浸入穩定液後，其有效吊重因排開液體而下降，但在混凝土置換時還可能受到黏滯拖曳與上舉作用。空心附件若封閉會增加排水體積，實際浮力不一定只等於鋼筋實體體積；定位系統須辨別重量、浮力與施工擾動。阿基米德式只給靜浮力，不包括混凝土流動拖曳與卡阻；排液體積需按實際封閉附件及開口狀態計算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼筋籠浮力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A cage immersed in slurry has reduced effective suspended weight, but concrete displacement can also create drag and upward force. Closed hollow attachments increase displaced volume, so buoyancy is not necessarily based on steel volume alone. Restraint design must distinguish weight, buoyancy and construction disturbances rather than treating every upward movement as one cause. Archimedes' expression gives static buoyancy only, excluding concrete-flow drag and snagging; displaced volume must reflect actual closed attachments and opening conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cage buoyancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、假設總排液體積V=3 m³，浮力B=γsV=33 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With support-fluid unit weight γs=11 kN/m³ and total displaced volume V=3 m³, buoyancy B=γsV=33 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼筋比穩定液重，所以施工中完全不可能上浮。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel is denser than slurry, so the cage cannot rise during construction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼筋籠浮力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cage buoyancy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼筋籠浮力的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 鋼筋籠浸入穩定液後，其有效吊重因排開液體而下降，但在混凝土置換時還可能受到黏滯拖曳與上舉作用。空心附件若封閉會增加排水體積，實際浮力不一定只等於鋼筋實體體積；定位系統須辨別重量、浮力與施工擾動。
knowledge.textEn: A cage immersed in slurry has reduced effective suspended weight, but concrete displacement can also create drag and upward force. Closed hollow attachments increase displaced volume, so buoyancy is not necessarily based on steel volume alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼筋比穩定液重，所以施工中完全不可能上浮。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steel is denser than slurry, so the cage cannot rise during construction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼筋籠浮力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cage buoyancy mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 鋼筋比穩定液重，所以施工中完全不可能上浮。
鋼筋籠浸入穩定液後，其有效吊重因排開液體而下降，但在混凝土置換時還可能受到黏滯拖曳與上舉作用。
混凝土用量超過理論值就代表連續壁一定更強。
optionsEn: Steel is denser than slurry, so the cage cannot rise during construction.
A cage immersed in slurry has reduced effective suspended weight, but concrete displacement can also create drag and upward force.
Concrete volume above theory necessarily produces a stronger diaphragm wall.
quiz.explanation: 鋼筋籠浸入穩定液後，其有效吊重因排開液體而下降，但在混凝土置換時還可能受到黏滯拖曳與上舉作用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A cage immersed in slurry has reduced effective suspended weight, but concrete displacement can also create drag and upward force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼筋籠浮力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cage buoyancy mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼筋籠浮力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cage buoyancy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、假設總排液體積V=3 m³，浮力B=γsV=33 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: With support-fluid unit weight γs=11 kN/m³ and total displaced volume V=3 m³, buoyancy B=γsV=33 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對籠體與附件體積，記錄吊重及籠頂高程，對照澆置速度與液面變化，分辨靜浮力和拖曳。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check cage and attachment volumes and log suspended load and cage-top elevation against placement rate and fluid levels to distinguish static buoyancy from drag.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、假設總排液體積V=3 m³，浮力B=γsV=33 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: With support-fluid unit weight γs=11 kN/m³ and total displaced volume V=3 m³, buoyancy B=γsV=33 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼筋籠浮力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cage buoyancy mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 建物總沉陷很小就能保證任何接縫與構件都不受損。
穩定液黏度足夠就一定能在任何地層形成濾餅。
原創教學假設：穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、假設總排液體積V=3 m³，浮力B=γsV=33 kN。
optionsEn: Small total building settlement guarantees no damage to joints or members.
Adequate slurry viscosity guarantees a filter cake in every soil.
Original teaching assumptions: With support-fluid unit weight γs=11 kN/m³ and total displaced volume V=3 m³, buoyancy B=γsV=33 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、假設總排液體積V=3 m³，浮力B=γsV=33 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: With support-fluid unit weight γs=11 kN/m³ and total displaced volume V=3 m³, buoyancy B=γsV=33 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼筋籠浮力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cage buoyancy mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼筋籠浮力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cage buoyancy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對籠體與附件體積，記錄吊重及籠頂高程，對照澆置速度與液面變化，分辨靜浮力和拖曳。澆置前由臨時工程負責人核定籠體定位與監測，任何上浮趨勢須依核定停留點處理並保存高程紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check cage and attachment volumes and log suspended load and cage-top elevation against placement rate and fluid levels to distinguish static buoyancy from drag. The temporary-works lead approves cage restraint and monitoring before placement; any rising trend is managed under an approved hold point with retained elevation records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：澆置前由臨時工程負責人核定籠體定位與監測，任何上浮趨勢須依核定停留點處理並保存高程紀錄。阿基米德式只給靜浮力，不包括混凝土流動拖曳與卡阻；排液體積需按實際封閉附件及開口狀態計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The temporary-works lead approves cage restraint and monitoring before placement; any rising trend is managed under an approved hold point with retained elevation records. Archimedes' expression gives static buoyancy only, excluding concrete-flow drag and snagging; displaced volume must reflect actual closed attachments and opening conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鋼筋籠上浮會改變保護層及接頭鋼筋位置，固定不足可能在混凝土開始凝結後才被發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cage uplift changes cover and connection-bar positions, and inadequate restraint may only become apparent after concrete starts setting. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
