steps.title: 混凝土量平衡的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Concrete volume balance mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土量平衡」如何影響連續壁槽溝穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete volume balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 混凝土澆置量與理論槽體積的差異，可用於追蹤超挖、漏失或輪廓量測誤差，但過量不是品質良好的證明。澆置上升曲線若局部異常，可能反映槽壁坍落、夾泥或混凝土流入空隙，須與槽形及回收穩定液量共同判讀。此比值不區分超挖、損失及量測誤差，也沒有通用合格範圍；驗收還需材料、幾何與完整性等獨立證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「混凝土量平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Differences between placed concrete and theoretical trench volume help track overbreak, loss and profiling error, but excess volume does not prove quality. An anomalous rise curve can indicate wall collapse, slurry entrapment or concrete entering voids and must be interpreted with trench shape and recovered-fluid volume. The ratio does not distinguish overbreak, loss and measurement error and has no universal pass range; acceptance also requires independent material, geometry and integrity evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Concrete volume balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：理論體積Vt=180 m³、實際投入Va=210 m³，超量率(Va−Vt)/Vt=16.7%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For theoretical volume Vt=180 m³ and placed volume Va=210 m³, excess ratio (Va−Vt)/Vt=16.7%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土用量超過理論值就代表連續壁一定更強。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete volume above theory necessarily produces a stronger diaphragm wall." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「混凝土量平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Concrete volume balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Differences between placed concrete and theoretical trench volume help track overbreak, loss and profiling error, but excess volume does not prove quality. An anomalous rise curve can indicate wall collapse, slurry entrapment or concrete entering voids and must be interpreted with trench shape and recovered-fluid volume.

quiz.question: 關於「混凝土量平衡的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Impermeable wall concrete guarantees every panel joint is watertight.

steps.title: 混凝土量平衡的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混凝土量平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete volume balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：理論體積Vt=180 m³、實際投入Va=210 m³，超量率(Va−Vt)/Vt=16.7%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For theoretical volume Vt=180 m³ and placed volume Va=210 m³, excess ratio (Va−Vt)/Vt=16.7%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每車方量、澆置時間與混凝土面標高形成曲線，對照超音波槽形及液體回收量，標出突變深度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 將每車方量、澆置時間與混凝土面標高形成曲線，對照超音波槽形及液體回收量，標出突變深度。量平衡異常須與地質及澆置事件一起審查；壁體設計者決定補充檢測範圍，不以單一超量率放行。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

quiz.explanation: 將每車方量、澆置時間與混凝土面標高形成曲線，對照超音波槽形及液體回收量，標出突變深度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot batch volume, placement time and concrete elevation, compare with ultrasonic trench profile and recovered-fluid volume, and identify depths where the trend changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 混凝土量平衡的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Concrete volume balance mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混凝土量平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete volume balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看總方量足夠可能掩蓋局部夾泥，過量混凝土也可能代表槽壁坍塌而非有效增加壁厚。此比值不區分超挖、損失及量測誤差，也沒有通用合格範圍；驗收還需材料、幾何與完整性等獨立證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adequate total volume can conceal local slurry inclusions; excess concrete may indicate wall collapse rather than useful additional wall thickness. The ratio does not distinguish overbreak, loss and measurement error and has no universal pass range; acceptance also requires independent material, geometry and integrity evidence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此比值不區分超挖、損失及量測誤差，也沒有通用合格範圍；驗收還需材料、幾何與完整性等獨立證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The ratio does not distinguish overbreak, loss and measurement error and has no universal pass range; acceptance also requires independent material, geometry and integrity evidence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土用量超過理論值就代表連續壁一定更強。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete volume above theory necessarily produces a stronger diaphragm wall." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看總方量足夠可能掩蓋局部夾泥，過量混凝土也可能代表槽壁坍塌而非有效增加壁厚。此比值不區分超挖、損失及量測誤差，也沒有通用合格範圍；驗收還需材料、幾何與完整性等獨立證據。
knowledge.textEn: Adequate total volume can conceal local slurry inclusions; excess concrete may indicate wall collapse rather than useful additional wall thickness. The ratio does not distinguish overbreak, loss and measurement error and has no universal pass range; acceptance also requires independent material, geometry and integrity evidence.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混凝土量平衡的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Concrete volume balance mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
連續壁混凝土本體抗滲合格，就代表每個接頭水密。
只看總方量足夠可能掩蓋局部夾泥，過量混凝土也可能代表槽壁坍塌而非有效增加壁厚。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Impermeable wall concrete guarantees every panel joint is watertight.
Adequate total volume can conceal local slurry inclusions; excess concrete may indicate wall collapse rather than useful additional wall thickness.
quiz.explanation: 只看總方量足夠可能掩蓋局部夾泥，過量混凝土也可能代表槽壁坍塌而非有效增加壁厚。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adequate total volume can conceal local slurry inclusions; excess concrete may indicate wall collapse rather than useful additional wall thickness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證」與「鄰房角變形的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint hydraulic gradient mechanism and verification" and "Adjacent-building distortion mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint hydraulic gradient mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接頭水力坡降」如何影響連續壁槽溝穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint hydraulic gradient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰連續壁槽段的接頭是幾何、混凝土品質及止水構件共同形成的薄弱界面。外內水頭差沿很短的缺口集中時，局部坡降會很高，可能引發滲流帶砂；因此完工水密不是只靠壁體本身的滲透係數來判斷。坡降不是流量，仍需滲透性及路徑面積才能估算出水；局部集中流與侵蝕可能使達西均質模型失效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭水力坡降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Panel joints are interfaces governed jointly by geometry, concrete quality and sealing components. A head difference concentrated across a short defect creates a high local gradient and may transport soil. Completed-wall sealing therefore cannot be established solely from the permeability of the concrete away from its joints. Gradient is not flow rate; permeability and path area are still required, and concentrated flow or erosion may invalidate a homogeneous Darcy model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint hydraulic gradient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設水頭差Δh=10 m、有效滲流路長L=0.5 m，水力坡降i=Δh/L=20，無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For head difference Δh=10 m and effective seepage length L=0.5 m, hydraulic gradient i=Δh/L=20, dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「連續壁混凝土本體抗滲合格，就代表每個接頭水密。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Impermeable wall concrete guarantees every panel joint is watertight." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接頭水力坡降」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint hydraulic gradient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Joint hydraulic gradient mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 相鄰連續壁槽段的接頭是幾何、混凝土品質及止水構件共同形成的薄弱界面。外內水頭差沿很短的缺口集中時，局部坡降會很高，可能引發滲流帶砂；因此完工水密不是只靠壁體本身的滲透係數來判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Panel joints are interfaces governed jointly by geometry, concrete quality and sealing components. A head difference concentrated across a short defect creates a high local gradient and may transport soil.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：連續壁混凝土本體抗滲合格，就代表每個接頭水密。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Impermeable wall concrete guarantees every panel joint is watertight. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint hydraulic gradient mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 相鄰連續壁槽段的接頭是幾何、混凝土品質及止水構件共同形成的薄弱界面。
連續壁混凝土本體抗滲合格，就代表每個接頭水密。
建物總沉陷很小就能保證任何接縫與構件都不受損。
optionsEn: Panel joints are interfaces governed jointly by geometry, concrete quality and sealing components.
Impermeable wall concrete guarantees every panel joint is watertight.
Small total building settlement guarantees no damage to joints or members.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰連續壁槽段的接頭是幾何、混凝土品質及止水構件共同形成的薄弱界面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Panel joints are interfaces governed jointly by geometry, concrete quality and sealing components. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint hydraulic gradient mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接頭水力坡降」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint hydraulic gradient” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設水頭差Δh=10 m、有效滲流路長L=0.5 m，水力坡降i=Δh/L=20，無因次。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For head difference Δh=10 m and effective seepage length L=0.5 m, hydraulic gradient i=Δh/L=20, dimensionless. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分槽段記錄水壓與出水混濁度，將接頭位置、實際偏斜及止水構件紀錄疊合，追查短路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record pressure and turbidity by panel, overlay joint positions, actual deviation and waterstop records, and investigate short seepage paths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設水頭差Δh=10 m、有效滲流路長L=0.5 m，水力坡降i=Δh/L=20，無因次。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For head difference Δh=10 m and effective seepage length L=0.5 m, hydraulic gradient i=Δh/L=20, dimensionless. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint hydraulic gradient mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 穩定液黏度足夠就一定能在任何地層形成濾餅。
原創教學假設：假設水頭差Δh=10 m、有效滲流路長L=0.5 m，水力坡降i=Δh/L=20，無因次。
地面不沉陷就表示機具載重沒有影響槽壁穩定。
optionsEn: Adequate slurry viscosity guarantees a filter cake in every soil.
Original teaching assumptions: For head difference Δh=10 m and effective seepage length L=0.5 m, hydraulic gradient i=Δh/L=20, dimensionless.
No visible surface settlement means machinery loading does not affect trench stability.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設水頭差Δh=10 m、有效滲流路長L=0.5 m，水力坡降i=Δh/L=20，無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For head difference Δh=10 m and effective seepage length L=0.5 m, hydraulic gradient i=Δh/L=20, dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint hydraulic gradient mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接頭水力坡降」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint hydraulic gradient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分槽段記錄水壓與出水混濁度，將接頭位置、實際偏斜及止水構件紀錄疊合，追查短路徑。接頭缺陷處理需由地工及結構設計者共同核准，監測應持續涵蓋外水頭與周邊沉陷，不能只記室內漏水量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record pressure and turbidity by panel, overlay joint positions, actual deviation and waterstop records, and investigate short seepage paths. Geotechnical and structural designers jointly approve joint repair; monitoring must retain external heads and adjacent settlement rather than indoor leakage alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接頭缺陷處理需由地工及結構設計者共同核准，監測應持續涵蓋外水頭與周邊沉陷，不能只記室內漏水量。坡降不是流量，仍需滲透性及路徑面積才能估算出水；局部集中流與侵蝕可能使達西均質模型失效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Geotechnical and structural designers jointly approve joint repair; monitoring must retain external heads and adjacent settlement rather than indoor leakage alone. Gradient is not flow rate; permeability and path area are still required, and concentrated flow or erosion may invalidate a homogeneous Darcy model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭缺口可導致帶砂滲流與周邊沉陷；內表面止漏若未查明水路，可能只把流量轉移到鄰近界面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A joint defect can cause sediment-carrying leakage and adjacent settlement; surface sealing without tracing the water path may merely divert flow to a neighbouring interface. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint hydraulic gradient mechanism and verification"?

title: 咬合樁止水壁施工
summary: 咬合樁牆以相鄰樁體互相切入形成連續擋土與止水系統，其性能受樁位、垂直度、切削時齡及結構樁剛度共同控制。本課將幾何咬合與材料強度分開驗證，再檢查冠梁傳力、嵌入深度、缺口滲流與長期裂縫，建立全深度的竣工證據。
summaryEn: Secant walls use overlapping piles to form a retaining and cutoff system governed by position, verticality, cutting age and structural-pile stiffness. The course verifies geometric overlap separately from material strength, then examines capping-beam transfer, embedment, defect seepage and long-term cracking through full-depth as-built evidence.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：相同圓樁直徑D=1.0 m，中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。若只把中心距增加10%至0.88 m，樁徑不變，咬合減為0.12 m，降低40%。這顯示接近幾何閉合條件時，小幅位置變更可消耗很大的餘量。實際還須扣除孔斜、樁徑變異及測量誤差，並用全深相鄰樁位置重建止水路徑；正的名目咬合不是接面水密或結構抗剪已獲證明。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: equal circular piles have D=1.0 m and centre spacing s=0.8 m, giving nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m. Increase spacing alone by 10% to 0.88 m while holding diameter fixed: overlap becomes 0.12 m, a 40% reduction. This shows how a small positional change can consume substantial reserve near a geometric closure condition. Actual evaluation must also account for inclination, diameter variation and survey uncertainty and reconstruct the full-depth cutoff using adjacent-pile positions. Positive nominal overlap does not demonstrate either watertight contact or structural shear transfer. Verify the geometric prediction against independent survey and observed hydraulic behaviour.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設計咬合量的機理與驗證」與「先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Nominal overlap mechanism and verification" and "Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設計咬合量的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Nominal overlap mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「設計咬合量」如何影響咬合樁止水壁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nominal overlap” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰圓樁相交形成牆體連續性，中心距與直徑共同決定名目咬合量。樁位偏差及鑽孔彎曲會沿深度改變實際交疊，槽口看起來連續不代表深部也完整；止水與結構連續性須分別考慮主次樁材料及鋼筋配置。此式只給兩個等直徑平行圓柱的線性咬合尺寸，未證明接觸品質或抗剪連續性；不等徑與偏斜需按三維幾何處理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「設計咬合量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Intersecting circular piles create wall continuity, with centre spacing and diameter defining nominal overlap. Position errors and curved bores change overlap with depth, so a continuous collar does not prove deep continuity. Hydraulic and structural performance must separately account for primary-secondary materials and reinforcement arrangements. This expression gives a linear overlap for equal parallel cylinders only and proves neither contact quality nor shear continuity; unequal diameters and deviations require three-dimensional geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Nominal overlap” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設相同樁徑D=1.0 m、中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For equal pile diameter D=1.0 m and spacing s=0.8 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樁頂有咬合就能保證所有深度的止水連續性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Overlap at the pile heads guarantees cutoff continuity at every depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「設計咬合量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Nominal overlap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設計咬合量的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 相鄰圓樁相交形成牆體連續性，中心距與直徑共同決定名目咬合量。樁位偏差及鑽孔彎曲會沿深度改變實際交疊，槽口看起來連續不代表深部也完整；止水與結構連續性須分別考慮主次樁材料及鋼筋配置。
knowledge.textEn: Intersecting circular piles create wall continuity, with centre spacing and diameter defining nominal overlap. Position errors and curved bores change overlap with depth, so a continuous collar does not prove deep continuity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樁頂有咬合就能保證所有深度的止水連續性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Overlap at the pile heads guarantees cutoff continuity at every depth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設計咬合量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Nominal overlap mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 樁頂有咬合就能保證所有深度的止水連續性。
相鄰圓樁相交形成牆體連續性，中心距與直徑共同決定名目咬合量。
固定等三天就能適用所有氣溫與先行樁配比。
optionsEn: Overlap at the pile heads guarantees cutoff continuity at every depth.
Intersecting circular piles create wall continuity, with centre spacing and diameter defining nominal overlap.
Waiting a fixed three days works for every temperature and primary-pile mix.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰圓樁相交形成牆體連續性，中心距與直徑共同決定名目咬合量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Intersecting circular piles create wall continuity, with centre spacing and diameter defining nominal overlap. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設計咬合量的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Nominal overlap mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設計咬合量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nominal overlap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設相同樁徑D=1.0 m、中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For equal pile diameter D=1.0 m and spacing s=0.8 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測導牆樁位與全深孔斜，重建相鄰圓柱交集，將最小咬合位置與含水層對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey guide-wall positions and full-depth inclinations, reconstruct adjacent cylinder intersections, and compare minimum overlap locations with aquifers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設相同樁徑D=1.0 m、中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For equal pile diameter D=1.0 m and spacing s=0.8 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設計咬合量的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Nominal overlap mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 冠梁只是把樁頭連起來，不需要分析彎矩與剪力。
只要樁長達到圖面數字，樁趾就一定是完全固定。
原創教學假設：假設相同樁徑D=1.0 m、中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。
optionsEn: A cap merely connects pile heads and needs no bending or shear analysis.
Reaching the drawing's pile length guarantees a fully fixed toe.
Original teaching assumptions: For equal pile diameter D=1.0 m and spacing s=0.8 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設相同樁徑D=1.0 m、中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For equal pile diameter D=1.0 m and spacing s=0.8 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 設計咬合量的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Nominal overlap mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「設計咬合量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Nominal overlap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測導牆樁位與全深孔斜，重建相鄰圓柱交集，將最小咬合位置與含水層對照。咬合驗收須採全深相對幾何，不只查單樁容許誤差；異常段由地工設計者核定補充驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey guide-wall positions and full-depth inclinations, reconstruct adjacent cylinder intersections, and compare minimum overlap locations with aquifers. Accept overlap from full-depth relative geometry rather than single-pile tolerances alone; the geotechnical designer approves supplementary investigation of anomalies. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：咬合驗收須採全深相對幾何，不只查單樁容許誤差；異常段由地工設計者核定補充驗證。此式只給兩個等直徑平行圓柱的線性咬合尺寸，未證明接觸品質或抗剪連續性；不等徑與偏斜需按三維幾何處理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Accept overlap from full-depth relative geometry rather than single-pile tolerances alone; the geotechnical designer approves supplementary investigation of anomalies. This expression gives a linear overlap for equal parallel cylinders only and proves neither contact quality nor shear continuity; unequal diameters and deviations require three-dimensional geometry.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：深部樁體分離會形成滲流缺口，土砂流失可能先於可見牆面裂縫出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Deep separation creates seepage gaps, and soil loss may precede visible wall cracking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

This expression gives a linear overlap for equal parallel cylinders only and proves neither contact quality nor shear continuity; unequal diameters and deviations require three-dimensional geometry.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設計咬合量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Nominal overlap mechanism and verification"?
options: 量測導牆樁位與全深孔斜，重建相鄰圓柱交集，將最小咬合位置與含水層對照。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
任何一個應變計都可直接量出整根樁的彎矩。
optionsEn: Survey guide-wall positions and full-depth inclinations, reconstruct adjacent cylinder intersections, and compare minimum overlap locations with aquifers.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any single strain gauge directly measures the entire pile's bending moment.
quiz.explanation: 量測導牆樁位與全深孔斜，重建相鄰圓柱交集，將最小咬合位置與含水層對照。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey guide-wall positions and full-depth inclinations, reconstruct adjacent cylinder intersections, and compare minimum overlap locations with aquifers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 設計咬合量的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Nominal overlap mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「設計咬合量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nominal overlap” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 深部樁體分離會形成滲流缺口，土砂流失可能先於可見牆面裂縫出現。此式只給兩個等直徑平行圓柱的線性咬合尺寸，未證明接觸品質或抗剪連續性；不等徑與偏斜需按三維幾何處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Deep separation creates seepage gaps, and soil loss may precede visible wall cracking. This expression gives a linear overlap for equal parallel cylinders only and proves neither contact quality nor shear continuity; unequal diameters and deviations require three-dimensional geometry. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此式只給兩個等直徑平行圓柱的線性咬合尺寸，未證明接觸品質或抗剪連續性；不等徑與偏斜需按三維幾何處理。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樁頂有咬合就能保證所有深度的止水連續性。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Overlap at the pile heads guarantees cutoff continuity at every depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 深部樁體分離會形成滲流缺口，土砂流失可能先於可見牆面裂縫出現。此式只給兩個等直徑平行圓柱的線性咬合尺寸，未證明接觸品質或抗剪連續性；不等徑與偏斜需按三維幾何處理。
knowledge.textEn: Deep separation creates seepage gaps, and soil loss may precede visible wall cracking. This expression gives a linear overlap for equal parallel cylinders only and proves neither contact quality nor shear continuity; unequal diameters and deviations require three-dimensional geometry.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「設計咬合量的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Nominal overlap mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
深部樁體分離會形成滲流缺口，土砂流失可能先於可見牆面裂縫出現。
固定等三天就能適用所有氣溫與先行樁配比。

Deep separation creates seepage gaps, and soil loss may precede visible wall cracking.
Waiting a fixed three days works for every temperature and primary-pile mix.
quiz.explanation: 深部樁體分離會形成滲流缺口，土砂流失可能先於可見牆面裂縫出現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Deep separation creates seepage gaps, and soil loss may precede visible wall cracking. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「先行樁切削齡期」如何影響咬合樁止水壁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Primary-pile cutting age” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 次樁鑽掘必須切入先行樁，先行材料太軟可能被擠移，太硬則會使刀具偏轉或難以切削。可切削窗口受配比、溫度與養護影響，不能只用日曆天數管理；施工排程需與材料強度發展及實際切入紀錄連結。時間差不是材料強度，亦沒有通用合格齡期；應以代表性試驗建立強度與可切削性的場址關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「先行樁切削齡期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Secondary drilling must cut into primary piles. Material that is too soft may displace, while excessive hardness can deflect tools or impede cutting. The workable window depends on mix, temperature and curing, so calendar age alone is inadequate; sequencing must be linked to strength development and actual cutting behaviour. Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Primary-pile cutting age” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設先行樁澆置完成t₁=24 h、次樁切入t₂=96 h，相對齡期Δt=t₂−t₁=72 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For primary completion t₁=24 h and secondary cutting t₂=96 h on one clock, elapsed age Δt=72 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「固定等三天就能適用所有氣溫與先行樁配比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Waiting a fixed three days works for every temperature and primary-pile mix." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「先行樁切削齡期」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Primary-pile cutting age”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 次樁鑽掘必須切入先行樁，先行材料太軟可能被擠移，太硬則會使刀具偏轉或難以切削。可切削窗口受配比、溫度與養護影響，不能只用日曆天數管理；施工排程需與材料強度發展及實際切入紀錄連結。
knowledge.textEn: Secondary drilling must cut into primary piles. Material that is too soft may displace, while excessive hardness can deflect tools or impede cutting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：固定等三天就能適用所有氣溫與先行樁配比。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Waiting a fixed three days works for every temperature and primary-pile mix. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 固定等三天就能適用所有氣溫與先行樁配比。
所有咬合樁都可以用相同的毛截面剛度相加。
次樁鑽掘必須切入先行樁，先行材料太軟可能被擠移，太硬則會使刀具偏轉或難以切削。
optionsEn: Waiting a fixed three days works for every temperature and primary-pile mix.
All secant piles can be added using identical gross-section stiffness.
Secondary drilling must cut into primary piles.
quiz.explanation: 次樁鑽掘必須切入先行樁，先行材料太軟可能被擠移，太硬則會使刀具偏轉或難以切削。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Secondary drilling must cut into primary piles. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「先行樁切削齡期」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Primary-pile cutting age” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設先行樁澆置完成t₁=24 h、次樁切入t₂=96 h，相對齡期Δt=t₂−t₁=72 h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For primary completion t₁=24 h and secondary cutting t₂=96 h on one clock, elapsed age Δt=72 h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同養護試體與溫度紀錄核對切削時強度，再比較鑽進扭矩、偏斜與回收材料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use companion-cured samples and temperature records to estimate cutting-age strength, then compare drilling torque, deviation and recovered material.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設先行樁澆置完成t₁=24 h、次樁切入t₂=96 h，相對齡期Δt=t₂−t₁=72 h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For primary completion t₁=24 h and secondary cutting t₂=96 h on one clock, elapsed age Δt=72 h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

四項定位誤差一律都可以用平方和開根號合成。
小流量清水滲漏永遠不會演變成帶砂地層流失。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For primary completion t₁=24 h and secondary cutting t₂=96 h on one clock, elapsed age Δt=72 h.
Four positioning errors can always be combined by root-sum-square.
A small clear-water leak can never develop into sediment-carrying ground loss.

steps.title: 先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「先行樁切削齡期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Primary-pile cutting age” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同養護試體與溫度紀錄核對切削時強度，再比較鑽進扭矩、偏斜與回收材料。排程需保留澆置、切入及材料強度證據；延誤時由材料及成樁負責人重新核定切削窗口。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use companion-cured samples and temperature records to estimate cutting-age strength, then compare drilling torque, deviation and recovered material. Retain placement, cutting and strength evidence in the schedule; materials and piling leads reassess the cutting window after delays. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：排程需保留澆置、切入及材料強度證據；延誤時由材料及成樁負責人重新核定切削窗口。時間差不是材料強度，亦沒有通用合格齡期；應以代表性試驗建立強度與可切削性的場址關係。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain placement, cutting and strength evidence in the schedule; materials and piling leads reassess the cutting window after delays. Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：齡期超窗可能使次樁偏離先行樁，留下深部未咬合帶，即使鑽達設計深度仍無法止水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cutting outside the workable window can deflect the secondary pile and leave a deep unconnected strip despite reaching design depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain placement, cutting and strength evidence in the schedule; materials and piling leads reassess the cutting window after delays.

knowledge.textEn: Retain placement, cutting and strength evidence in the schedule; materials and piling leads reassess the cutting window after delays. Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification"?

以同養護試體與溫度紀錄核對切削時強度，再比較鑽進扭矩、偏斜與回收材料。

steps.title: 先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「先行樁切削齡期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Primary-pile cutting age” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 齡期超窗可能使次樁偏離先行樁，留下深部未咬合帶，即使鑽達設計深度仍無法止水。時間差不是材料強度，亦沒有通用合格齡期；應以代表性試驗建立強度與可切削性的場址關係。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting outside the workable window can deflect the secondary pile and leave a deep unconnected strip despite reaching design depth. Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 齡期超窗可能使次樁偏離先行樁，留下深部未咬合帶，即使鑽達設計深度仍無法止水。時間差不是材料強度，亦沒有通用合格齡期；應以代表性試驗建立強度與可切削性的場址關係。
knowledge.textEn: Cutting outside the workable window can deflect the secondary pile and leave a deep unconnected strip despite reaching design depth. quiz.question: 在「先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

所有咬合樁都可以用相同的毛截面剛度相加。
齡期超窗可能使次樁偏離先行樁，留下深部未咬合帶，即使鑽達設計深度仍無法止水。

All secant piles can be added using identical gross-section stiffness.
Cutting outside the workable window can deflect the secondary pile and leave a deep unconnected strip despite reaching design depth.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「結構樁剛度的機理與驗證」與「冠梁荷載轉移的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification" and "Capping-beam transfer mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 結構樁剛度的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「結構樁剛度」如何影響咬合樁止水壁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Structural-pile stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 擋土牆的彎曲剛度取決於真正承擔結構作用的樁列，不能把所有軟質先行樁都當成同樣剛度的鋼筋混凝土。圓截面慣性矩隨直徑四次方增加，但開裂、咬合切削與配筋會改變有效剛度，並影響各樁分擔的土壓。毛截面慣性矩是幾何量而非整體牆剛度，還須乘相應模數並考慮每米樁數；裂縫及接觸滑移可能主導變形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「結構樁剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wall bending stiffness depends on the piles actually assigned structural action; soft primary piles cannot automatically be treated as equally stiff reinforced concrete. Circular-section inertia increases with diameter to the fourth power, but cracking, secant cuts and reinforcement change effective stiffness and the pressure shared by individual piles. Gross inertia is geometric rather than system stiffness; the corresponding modulus and piles per metre are also needed, while cracking and interface slip may govern deformation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Structural-pile stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設完整實心圓截面D=1 m，毛截面I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For a complete solid circular section D=1 m, gross second moment I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有咬合樁都可以用相同的毛截面剛度相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 結構樁剛度的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 擋土牆的彎曲剛度取決於真正承擔結構作用的樁列，不能把所有軟質先行樁都當成同樣剛度的鋼筋混凝土。圓截面慣性矩隨直徑四次方增加，但開裂、咬合切削與配筋會改變有效剛度，並影響各樁分擔的土壓。
knowledge.textEn: Wall bending stiffness depends on the piles actually assigned structural action; soft primary piles cannot automatically be treated as equally stiff reinforced concrete. Circular-section inertia increases with diameter to the fourth power, but cracking, secant cuts and reinforcement change effective stiffness and the pressure shared by individual piles.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有咬合樁都可以用相同的毛截面剛度相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All secant piles can be added using identical gross-section stiffness. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 結構樁剛度的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「結構樁剛度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Structural-pile stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設完整實心圓截面D=1 m，毛截面I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For a complete solid circular section D=1 m, gross second moment I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將實際樁徑、切削輪廓及鋼筋位置輸入截面分析，以測得牆位移比較開裂與未開裂剛度範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Insert actual diameter, cut profile and reinforcement into section analysis, comparing measured wall movement with cracked and uncracked stiffness bounds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 結構樁剛度的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「結構樁剛度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Structural-pile stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將實際樁徑、切削輪廓及鋼筋位置輸入截面分析，以測得牆位移比較開裂與未開裂剛度範圍。計算書應標明主次樁各自材料與開裂假設；結構設計者核准等值牆剛度後才用於整體開挖模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Insert actual diameter, cut profile and reinforcement into section analysis, comparing measured wall movement with cracked and uncracked stiffness bounds. Identify primary-secondary materials and cracking assumptions; the structural designer approves equivalent wall stiffness before it is used in excavation analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：計算書應標明主次樁各自材料與開裂假設；結構設計者核准等值牆剛度後才用於整體開挖模型。毛截面慣性矩是幾何量而非整體牆剛度，還須乘相應模數並考慮每米樁數；裂縫及接觸滑移可能主導變形。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Identify primary-secondary materials and cracking assumptions; the structural designer approves equivalent wall stiffness before it is used in excavation analysis. Gross inertia is geometric rather than system stiffness; the corresponding modulus and piles per metre are also needed, while cracking and interface slip may govern deformation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高估先行樁剛度會低估牆位移，並錯估冠梁與支撐反力，造成鄰近資產變形超出預期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overstating primary-pile stiffness underestimates wall movement and misallocates cap and strut forces, increasing unexpected adjacent-asset deformation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「結構樁剛度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 冠梁荷載轉移的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Capping-beam transfer mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「冠梁荷載轉移」如何影響咬合樁止水壁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Capping-beam transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 冠梁把不均勻樁頭反力重新分配到鄰近樁體，並為上部支撐提供連續的傳力界面。它的作用取決於樁頭嵌入、鋼筋錨定與接縫，不能只把冠梁視為整平構件；局部空樁或樁頭缺陷會增加其跨越需求。簡支點載模型只示範局部彎矩，真實冠梁常為連續梁且受扭；樁頭剛度及支撐偏心須另行納入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「冠梁荷載轉移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A capping beam redistributes unequal pile-head reactions and provides a continuous interface for upper support. Its function depends on pile embedment, reinforcement anchorage and joints, not merely surface levelling. A missing or defective pile head increases the distance over which the beam must bridge and transfer load. The simple point-load model illustrates local bending only; actual caps are often continuous and torsion-sensitive, requiring pile-head stiffness and support eccentricity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Capping-beam transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設簡支冠梁跨L=3 m、跨中集中力P=400 kN，Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For a simply supported cap span L=3 m and central force P=400 kN, Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「冠梁只是把樁頭連起來，不需要分析彎矩與剪力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cap merely connects pile heads and needs no bending or shear analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 冠梁荷載轉移的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Capping-beam transfer mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「冠梁荷載轉移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Capping-beam transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設簡支冠梁跨L=3 m、跨中集中力P=400 kN，Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For a simply supported cap span L=3 m and central force P=400 kN, Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對樁頭標高、混凝土品質與主筋錨定長度，將支撐反力位置和樁中心放在同一配筋圖。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 冠梁荷載轉移的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「冠梁荷載轉移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 核對樁頭標高、混凝土品質與主筋錨定長度，將支撐反力位置和樁中心放在同一配筋圖。澆置前確認樁頭與冠梁傳力細部；支撐位置變更須由冠梁設計者重新核對，而非現場直接移座。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify pile-head level, concrete quality and bar anchorage, placing support reactions and pile centres on one reinforcement drawing. Confirm pile-head transfer details before casting; the cap designer reviews support relocation instead of allowing seats to be moved directly on site. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Confirm pile-head transfer details before casting; the cap designer reviews support relocation instead of allowing seats to be moved directly on site. steps.failure: 注意干擾：樁頭處理不足使冠梁局部失去支承，裂縫可能集中在支撐座下方並造成反力轉移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor pile-head preparation can remove local cap support, concentrating cracks below strut seats and redistributing reactions. steps.instruction: 封閉圍護牆的最後接合位置累積了前面樁位誤差，不能假設每根樁單獨合格就能自然閉合。誤差可能有共同方向的系統偏差，也可能是獨立隨機偏差；兩者需要不同組合方法，並應及早用獨立測量發現。平方和開根號只適用於指定的獨立隨機假設，最不利容差疊加須另算；標準差也不是最大可能誤差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閉合定位誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The final connection in a closed wall inherits earlier positioning errors; individually acceptable piles do not guarantee closure. Errors may share a systematic direction or be independent random deviations, requiring different combination rules. Independent survey should identify the distinction before the final opening becomes too constrained to correct. Root-sum-square applies only under the stated independence assumptions; worst-case tolerance accumulation requires separate analysis, and a standard deviation is not a maximum error. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Closure positioning error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設4項獨立零均值誤差各標準差σ=15 mm，合成σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「四項定位誤差一律都可以用平方和開根號合成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Four positioning errors can always be combined by root-sum-square." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「閉合定位誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 閉合定位誤差的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closure positioning error mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「閉合定位誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closure positioning error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立控制網重測起終點，將誤差方向分解，檢查共同偏移後再作統計合成。設置中途閉合檢核與備用修正區，測量負責人應在樁序逼近最後接頭前提交偏差分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Resurvey start and closure points from independent control, resolving error directions and checking common bias before statistical combination. Provide interim closure checks and a correction allowance; the survey lead reports deviations before the pile sequence approaches the final connection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Root-sum-square applies only under the stated independence assumptions; worst-case tolerance accumulation requires separate analysis, and a standard deviation is not a maximum error.

steps.title: 樁趾嵌入的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Toe embedment mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「樁趾嵌入」如何影響咬合樁止水壁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Toe embedment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開挖面以下的樁段藉由土體反力提供轉動拘束與側向平衡，嵌入深度同時影響止水路徑。土體被動反力需要位移才能動員，不能只用幾何深度宣稱固定端；深部軟弱層或滲流可能削弱原本假設的支承。反力乘力臂是力矩平衡，不證明土體能動員該反力；承載、變形、基底隆起及滲流穩定均須獨立檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樁趾嵌入」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The embedded pile below excavation provides rotational restraint and lateral equilibrium through soil reaction while also lengthening seepage paths. Passive resistance needs movement to mobilize, so embedment depth alone does not establish a fixed end. Deep weak layers or seepage can reduce the assumed support and alter wall deformation. Reaction times lever arm is equilibrium, not proof that soil can mobilize the reaction; resistance, deformation, base heave and seepage stability require independent checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Toe embedment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設每米牆長的反力R=500 kN/m、對開挖底的力臂z=2 m，抗力矩M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For reaction R=500 kN per metre of wall and lever arm z=2 m about excavation level, resisting moment M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要樁長達到圖面數字，樁趾就一定是完全固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reaching the drawing's pile length guarantees a fully fixed toe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「樁趾嵌入」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 未到達設計嵌入層會使牆趾旋轉，表面支撐力可能上升並伴隨開挖底隆起。反力乘力臂是力矩平衡，不證明土體能動員該反力；承載、變形、基底隆起及滲流穩定均須獨立檢查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Failure to reach the intended bearing stratum allows toe rotation, potentially increasing strut force and causing base movement. Reaction times lever arm is equilibrium, not proof that soil can mobilize the reaction; resistance, deformation, base heave and seepage stability require independent checks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reaching the drawing's pile length guarantees a fully fixed toe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 未到達設計嵌入層會使牆趾旋轉，表面支撐力可能上升並伴隨開挖底隆起。反力乘力臂是力矩平衡，不證明土體能動員該反力；承載、變形、基底隆起及滲流穩定均須獨立檢查。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「缺口漏水的機理與驗證」與「彎曲應力增量的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Defect leakage mechanism and verification" and "Bending-stress increment mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 缺口漏水的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Defect leakage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「缺口漏水」如何影響咬合樁止水壁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Defect leakage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 咬合牆的水密性常由局部缺口或施工接面控制，而不是整個混凝土樁的平均滲透性。流量與缺口面積及水力坡降相關，隨開挖降水增加的壓差會放大弱路徑；帶砂出水則表示地層本身可能正在流失。等效達西模型只供量級比較，開放裂縫可能屬非達西流；沒有水頭資料就不能從一次流量倒推出可靠滲透係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「缺口漏水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Secant-wall sealing is often controlled by local gaps or construction interfaces rather than average concrete permeability. Flow depends on defect area and hydraulic gradient, and drawdown increases the driving pressure along weak paths. Sediment-carrying inflow indicates that the ground itself may be escaping, not merely water leaking through a stable interface. The equivalent Darcy model provides scale only; open fractures may be non-Darcy, and one discharge measurement without head data cannot establish reliable permeability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Defect leakage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設缺口等效k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s、A=0.5 m²、i=10，Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For equivalent defect permeability k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, area A=0.5 m² and gradient i=10, Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「小流量清水滲漏永遠不會演變成帶砂地層流失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small clear-water leak can never develop into sediment-carrying ground loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「缺口漏水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Defect leakage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 缺口漏水的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 咬合牆的水密性常由局部缺口或施工接面控制，而不是整個混凝土樁的平均滲透性。流量與缺口面積及水力坡降相關，隨開挖降水增加的壓差會放大弱路徑；帶砂出水則表示地層本身可能正在流失。
knowledge.textEn: Secant-wall sealing is often controlled by local gaps or construction interfaces rather than average concrete permeability. Flow depends on defect area and hydraulic gradient, and drawdown increases the driving pressure along weak paths.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：小流量清水滲漏永遠不會演變成帶砂地層流失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small clear-water leak can never develop into sediment-carrying ground loss. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「缺口漏水的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Defect leakage mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 小流量清水滲漏永遠不會演變成帶砂地層流失。
咬合牆的水密性常由局部缺口或施工接面控制，而不是整個混凝土樁的平均滲透性。
任何一個應變計都可直接量出整根樁的彎矩。
optionsEn: A small clear-water leak can never develop into sediment-carrying ground loss.
Secant-wall sealing is often controlled by local gaps or construction interfaces rather than average concrete permeability.
Any single strain gauge directly measures the entire pile's bending moment.
quiz.explanation: 咬合牆的水密性常由局部缺口或施工接面控制，而不是整個混凝土樁的平均滲透性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Secant-wall sealing is often controlled by local gaps or construction interfaces rather than average concrete permeability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 缺口漏水的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Defect leakage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「缺口漏水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Defect leakage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設缺口等效k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s、A=0.5 m²、i=10，Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For equivalent defect permeability k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, area A=0.5 m² and gradient i=10, Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分區量測出水量與混濁度，對照內外水頭及孔斜模型，辨認缺口而非直接推定整牆材料不良。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure zoned flow and turbidity against internal-external heads and bore-deviation models to identify gaps rather than assuming uniformly poor wall material.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設缺口等效k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s、A=0.5 m²、i=10，Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For equivalent defect permeability k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, area A=0.5 m² and gradient i=10, Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「缺口漏水的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Defect leakage mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 漏水量逐年下降就一定表示牆體性能逐年改善。
固定等三天就能適用所有氣溫與先行樁配比。
原創教學假設：假設缺口等效k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s、A=0.5 m²、i=10，Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s。
optionsEn: Declining annual leakage necessarily indicates improving wall performance.
Waiting a fixed three days works for every temperature and primary-pile mix.
Original teaching assumptions: For equivalent defect permeability k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, area A=0.5 m² and gradient i=10, Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設缺口等效k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s、A=0.5 m²、i=10，Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For equivalent defect permeability k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, area A=0.5 m² and gradient i=10, Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 缺口漏水的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Defect leakage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「缺口漏水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Defect leakage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分區量測出水量與混濁度，對照內外水頭及孔斜模型，辨認缺口而非直接推定整牆材料不良。異常出水需建立位置、水頭與顆粒紀錄；修補由地工及壁體設計者共同核定並觀察周邊沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure zoned flow and turbidity against internal-external heads and bore-deviation models to identify gaps rather than assuming uniformly poor wall material. Record leak location, head and particles; geotechnical and wall designers jointly approve repair and require observation of adjacent settlement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：異常出水需建立位置、水頭與顆粒紀錄；修補由地工及壁體設計者共同核定並觀察周邊沉陷。等效達西模型只供量級比較，開放裂縫可能屬非達西流；沒有水頭資料就不能從一次流量倒推出可靠滲透係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record leak location, head and particles; geotechnical and wall designers jointly approve repair and require observation of adjacent settlement. The equivalent Darcy model provides scale only; open fractures may be non-Darcy, and one discharge measurement without head data cannot establish reliable permeability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：集中漏水可帶走細砂，形成外側空洞與沉陷；只封內側漏點可能使壓力轉移到另一缺口。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Concentrated leakage can remove fines and form external voids and settlement; sealing one internal leak may transfer pressure to another gap. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分區量測出水量與混濁度，對照內外水頭及孔斜模型，辨認缺口而非直接推定整牆材料不良。異常出水需建立位置、水頭與顆粒紀錄；修補由地工及壁體設計者共同核定並觀察周邊沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Measure zoned flow and turbidity against internal-external heads and bore-deviation models to identify gaps rather than assuming uniformly poor wall material. Record leak location, head and particles; geotechnical and wall designers jointly approve repair and require observation of adjacent settlement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 異常出水需建立位置、水頭與顆粒紀錄；修補由地工及壁體設計者共同核定並觀察周邊沉陷。等效達西模型只供量級比較，開放裂縫可能屬非達西流；沒有水頭資料就不能從一次流量倒推出可靠滲透係數。
knowledge.textEn: Record leak location, head and particles; geotechnical and wall designers jointly approve repair and require observation of adjacent settlement. The equivalent Darcy model provides scale only; open fractures may be non-Darcy, and one discharge measurement without head data cannot establish reliable permeability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「缺口漏水的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Defect leakage mechanism and verification"?
options: 分區量測出水量與混濁度，對照內外水頭及孔斜模型，辨認缺口而非直接推定整牆材料不良。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
冠梁只是把樁頭連起來，不需要分析彎矩與剪力。
optionsEn: Measure zoned flow and turbidity against internal-external heads and bore-deviation models to identify gaps rather than assuming uniformly poor wall material.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A cap merely connects pile heads and needs no bending or shear analysis.
quiz.explanation: 分區量測出水量與混濁度，對照內外水頭及孔斜模型，辨認缺口而非直接推定整牆材料不良。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure zoned flow and turbidity against internal-external heads and bore-deviation models to identify gaps rather than assuming uniformly poor wall material. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 缺口漏水的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Defect leakage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「缺口漏水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Defect leakage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 集中漏水可帶走細砂，形成外側空洞與沉陷；只封內側漏點可能使壓力轉移到另一缺口。等效達西模型只供量級比較，開放裂縫可能屬非達西流；沒有水頭資料就不能從一次流量倒推出可靠滲透係數。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrated leakage can remove fines and form external voids and settlement; sealing one internal leak may transfer pressure to another gap. The equivalent Darcy model provides scale only; open fractures may be non-Darcy, and one discharge measurement without head data cannot establish reliable permeability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：等效達西模型只供量級比較，開放裂縫可能屬非達西流；沒有水頭資料就不能從一次流量倒推出可靠滲透係數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The equivalent Darcy model provides scale only; open fractures may be non-Darcy, and one discharge measurement without head data cannot establish reliable permeability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「小流量清水滲漏永遠不會演變成帶砂地層流失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small clear-water leak can never develop into sediment-carrying ground loss." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
