quiz.explanationEn: Overexcavation or scour ahead of the toe shortens effective embedment, allowing rotation and transferring extra demand to upper braces. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證」與「角隅偏心的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification" and "Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「抽水荷載增量」如何影響鋼板樁圍堰支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dewatering load increment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 內部水位下降時，原先平衡外水壓的一部分內壓被移除，支撐需求因而增加。分析必須以固定板樁高程比較前後兩張壓力圖，不能只看水深數字；若抽水與開挖同時進行，土壓重分配也需另列。此差值僅比較指定兩個三角形合力，作用點也會改變；若分析兩側水位差，需保留共同底高與完整壓力分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「抽水荷載增量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lowering internal water removes part of the pressure that previously balanced the external side, increasing brace demand. Compare complete pressure diagrams at fixed sheet elevations rather than depth numbers alone. When pumping and excavation occur together, earth-pressure redistribution must be accounted for separately from the hydraulic change. The difference compares the specified triangular resultants only, whose application points also change; two-sided water-level analysis needs a common base and complete pressure distributions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dewatering load increment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：僅比較同底部的三角形水壓合力，水深H₁=6 m與H₂=4 m，ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Comparing triangular pressure resultants with one common base at depths H₁=6 m and H₂=4 m, ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽水與拆撐可以分別驗算後任意同時進行。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Separately checked dewatering and brace removal can be performed together arbitrarily." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「抽水荷載增量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dewatering load increment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 內部水位下降時，原先平衡外水壓的一部分內壓被移除，支撐需求因而增加。分析必須以固定板樁高程比較前後兩張壓力圖，不能只看水深數字；若抽水與開挖同時進行，土壓重分配也需另列。
knowledge.textEn: Lowering internal water removes part of the pressure that previously balanced the external side, increasing brace demand. Compare complete pressure diagrams at fixed sheet elevations rather than depth numbers alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抽水與拆撐可以分別驗算後任意同時進行。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Separately checked dewatering and brace removal can be performed together arbitrarily. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 抽水與拆撐可以分別驗算後任意同時進行。
內部水位下降時，原先平衡外水壓的一部分內壓被移除，支撐需求因而增加。
支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。
optionsEn: Separately checked dewatering and brace removal can be performed together arbitrarily.
Lowering internal water removes part of the pressure that previously balanced the external side, increasing brace demand.
An axially loaded strut cannot introduce torsion into a corner connection.
quiz.explanation: 內部水位下降時，原先平衡外水壓的一部分內壓被移除，支撐需求因而增加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lowering internal water removes part of the pressure that previously balanced the external side, increasing brace demand. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「抽水荷載增量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dewatering load increment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：僅比較同底部的三角形水壓合力，水深H₁=6 m與H₂=4 m，ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Comparing triangular pressure resultants with one common base at depths H₁=6 m and H₂=4 m, ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄內外水位與支撐軸力，按固定高程積分壓力增量，檢查反力變化是否符合階段分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize water levels and strut loads, integrate pressure increments over fixed elevations, and check reactions against stage analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：僅比較同底部的三角形水壓合力，水深H₁=6 m與H₂=4 m，ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Comparing triangular pressure resultants with one common base at depths H₁=6 m and H₂=4 m, ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 最終永久結構足夠強，所以拆撐順序不影響安全。
圍檁截面夠大就不必檢查支撐座與板樁接觸。
原創教學假設：僅比較同底部的三角形水壓合力，水深H₁=6 m與H₂=4 m，ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m。
optionsEn: A strong final permanent structure makes brace-removal sequence irrelevant.
A large waler section removes the need to inspect seats and sheet contact.
Original teaching assumptions: Comparing triangular pressure resultants with one common base at depths H₁=6 m and H₂=4 m, ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：僅比較同底部的三角形水壓合力，水深H₁=6 m與H₂=4 m，ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Comparing triangular pressure resultants with one common base at depths H₁=6 m and H₂=4 m, ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「抽水荷載增量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dewatering load increment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄內外水位與支撐軸力，按固定高程積分壓力增量，檢查反力變化是否符合階段分析。每個水位與拆撐組合須有核定階段編號；臨時工程設計者確認實際順序後才放行。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Assign an approved stage identifier to each water-level and brace-removal combination; the temporary-works designer releases the actual sequence. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每個水位與拆撐組合須有核定階段編號；臨時工程設計者確認實際順序後才放行。此差值僅比較指定兩個三角形合力，作用點也會改變；若分析兩側水位差，需保留共同底高與完整壓力分布。

steps.title: 角隅偏心的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corner eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圍堰角隅把兩個方向的圍檁反力轉接到支撐，幾何偏心容易產生額外扭矩。直線段的平面梁分析不能自動涵蓋角接件、焊接與腹板局部承壓，若支撐軸線未交會，荷載路徑需要明確的三維構件傳遞。力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「角隅偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cofferdam corners transfer waler reactions from two directions into bracing, with geometric eccentricity producing extra torsion. A straight-wall planar beam analysis does not automatically cover corner fittings, welds or local web bearing. Nonintersecting strut axes require an explicit three-dimensional structural path for the forces. Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corner eccentricity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設支撐力P=500 kN、偏心距e=0.15 m，附加扭矩T=Pe=75 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For brace force P=500 kN and eccentricity e=0.15 m, additional torque T=Pe=75 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An axially loaded strut cannot introduce torsion into a corner connection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「角隅偏心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Cofferdam corners transfer waler reactions from two directions into bracing, with geometric eccentricity producing extra torsion. A straight-wall planar beam analysis does not automatically cover corner fittings, welds or local web bearing.

knowledge.text: 誤解：支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 角隅偏心的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「角隅偏心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Corner eccentricity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 偏心未納入會使角接板翹曲或焊縫受額外作用，局部失效可中斷兩側圍檁的傳力。力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted eccentricity can distort corner plates or overload welds, interrupting load transfer from both adjoining walers. Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An axially loaded strut cannot introduce torsion into a corner connection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 偏心未納入會使角接板翹曲或焊縫受額外作用，局部失效可中斷兩側圍檁的傳力。力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted eccentricity can distort corner plates or overload welds, interrupting load transfer from both adjoining walers. Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「角隅偏心的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
水流荷載與流速成正比，所以流速加倍只增一倍力。
偏心未納入會使角接板翹曲或焊縫受額外作用，局部失效可中斷兩側圍檁的傳力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Current force is linear in velocity, so doubling velocity only doubles force.
Omitted eccentricity can distort corner plates or overload welds, interrupting load transfer from both adjoining walers.
quiz.explanation: 偏心未納入會使角接板翹曲或焊縫受額外作用，局部失效可中斷兩側圍檁的傳力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted eccentricity can distort corner plates or overload welds, interrupting load transfer from both adjoining walers. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水流拖曳的機理與驗證」與「拆撐跨距變化的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Current drag mechanism and verification" and "Span change after removal mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水流拖曳的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Current drag mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水流拖曳」如何影響鋼板樁圍堰支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Current drag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圍堰暴露於水流時，流速、投影面積與形狀決定拖曳作用，與靜水壓屬不同荷載來源。漂流物或局部流束會改變有效面積及阻力，洪水期間的水位與流速也可能同時增加，不能只沿用施工初期的靜水情境。阻力係數依形狀及流況而變，此式不含波浪、撞擊或渦激效應；不能把假設係數直接當通用設計值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水流拖曳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Current drag is distinct from hydrostatic pressure and depends on velocity, projected area and shape. Debris and local jets can change effective area and resistance, while flood levels and velocities may rise together. The initial construction hydrostatic case therefore does not necessarily represent later environmental demand. The drag coefficient depends on shape and flow regime; this expression excludes waves, impact and vortex effects, and the assumed coefficient is not universal. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Current drag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Cd=1.2、投影面積A=10 m²、流速v=2 m/s，F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For ρ=1000 kg/m³, Cd=1.2, projected area A=10 m² and v=2 m/s, F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水流荷載與流速成正比，所以流速加倍只增一倍力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Current force is linear in velocity, so doubling velocity only doubles force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水流拖曳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Current drag”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水流拖曳的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 圍堰暴露於水流時，流速、投影面積與形狀決定拖曳作用，與靜水壓屬不同荷載來源。漂流物或局部流束會改變有效面積及阻力，洪水期間的水位與流速也可能同時增加，不能只沿用施工初期的靜水情境。
knowledge.textEn: Current drag is distinct from hydrostatic pressure and depends on velocity, projected area and shape. Debris and local jets can change effective area and resistance, while flood levels and velocities may rise together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水流荷載與流速成正比，所以流速加倍只增一倍力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Current force is linear in velocity, so doubling velocity only doubles force. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水流拖曳的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Current drag mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 圍堰暴露於水流時，流速、投影面積與形狀決定拖曳作用，與靜水壓屬不同荷載來源。
水流荷載與流速成正比，所以流速加倍只增一倍力。
最終永久結構足夠強，所以拆撐順序不影響安全。
optionsEn: Current drag is distinct from hydrostatic pressure and depends on velocity, projected area and shape.
Current force is linear in velocity, so doubling velocity only doubles force.
A strong final permanent structure makes brace-removal sequence irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 圍堰暴露於水流時，流速、投影面積與形狀決定拖曳作用，與靜水壓屬不同荷載來源。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Current drag is distinct from hydrostatic pressure and depends on velocity, projected area and shape. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水流拖曳的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Current drag mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水流拖曳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Current drag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Cd=1.2、投影面積A=10 m²、流速v=2 m/s，F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For ρ=1000 kg/m³, Cd=1.2, projected area A=10 m² and v=2 m/s, F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對現場流速剖面與水位資料，檢查漂流物附著及局部沖刷，核對投影面積是否因設備改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare velocity profiles and water levels, inspect debris accumulation and local scour, and check whether equipment changes alter projected area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Cd=1.2、投影面積A=10 m²、流速v=2 m/s，F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For ρ=1000 kg/m³, Cd=1.2, projected area A=10 m² and v=2 m/s, F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水流拖曳的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Current drag mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 圍檁截面夠大就不必檢查支撐座與板樁接觸。
原創教學假設：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Cd=1.2、投影面積A=10 m²、流速v=2 m/s，F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN。
鋼板樁已互鎖就表示圍堰完全不會漏水。
optionsEn: A large waler section removes the need to inspect seats and sheet contact.
Original teaching assumptions: For ρ=1000 kg/m³, Cd=1.2, projected area A=10 m² and v=2 m/s, F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN.
Interlocked sheet piles make the cofferdam completely watertight.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Cd=1.2、投影面積A=10 m²、流速v=2 m/s，F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For ρ=1000 kg/m³, Cd=1.2, projected area A=10 m² and v=2 m/s, F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水流拖曳的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Current drag mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水流拖曳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Current drag” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對現場流速剖面與水位資料，檢查漂流物附著及局部沖刷，核對投影面積是否因設備改變。汛期檢查需包含水流、漂流物及沖刷高程；水工與臨時工程設計者共同核准荷載更新與停工條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare velocity profiles and water levels, inspect debris accumulation and local scour, and check whether equipment changes alter projected area. Flood-season inspections include current, debris and scour elevation; hydraulic and temporary-works designers jointly approve load updates and stop conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：汛期檢查需包含水流、漂流物及沖刷高程；水工與臨時工程設計者共同核准荷載更新與停工條件。阻力係數依形狀及流況而變，此式不含波浪、撞擊或渦激效應；不能把假設係數直接當通用設計值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Flood-season inspections include current, debris and scour elevation; hydraulic and temporary-works designers jointly approve load updates and stop conditions. The drag coefficient depends on shape and flow regime; this expression excludes waves, impact and vortex effects, and the assumed coefficient is not universal.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漂流物增加迎水面積可提高拖曳並導致沖刷，趾部抗力下降又使圍堰側移增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Debris increases exposed area and can intensify drag and scour, while reduced toe resistance further increases cofferdam movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水流拖曳的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Current drag mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

steps.instruction: 拆除一層支撐會改變板樁及圍檁的有效跨距，原有內力隨新的邊界重新分配。永久結構必須先形成可證明的替代支承，材料強度達標並不保證連接已完成；拆撐順序常比最終狀態更容易產生不利彎曲與位移。平方比只適用於假設的簡支均布系統，實際連續壁及土彈簧會改變分配；應依真實拆撐階段重新分析，而非套用倍率設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拆撐跨距變化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For equal uniform load on simple beams, changing span from L₁=3 m to L₂=5 m gives M₂/M₁=(5/3)²=2.78. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.explanationEn: Removing braces before permanent slabs engage the wall creates a temporary long span, causing excessive sheet bending or irreversible ground movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 深開挖內支撐預壓
summary: 深開挖內支撐預壓用來消除間隙並限制壁體位移，卻也會引入額外構件力與地層反力。本課將預壓目標、軸向剛度、溫度作用、座板接觸及鎖定損失分開討論，再用多支撐互制、第二階效應與卸載變位建立設計及現場量測的共同基準。
summaryEn: Preloading excavation struts closes gaps and limits wall movement while introducing additional member forces and ground reactions. The course separates preload targets, axial stiffness, temperature, seating and lock-off loss, then links strut interaction, second-order effects and unloading movement to common design and measurement baselines.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設支撐接觸後的等效剛度k=200 kN/mm，施加力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。保持剛度不變，力增量提高10%至660 kN，縮短為3.3 mm。實際千斤頂行程還包含座板間隙、圍檁、壁體及設備變形，因此不能用這個三毫米推定全部接觸已閉合。驗證應將力與兩端位移同步記錄，先辨識接觸前後剛度變化，再檢查保留預壓、溫度軸力和鄰支撐互制。這些值是原創假設，不是現場施壓指令。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume post-contact support stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, giving elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. With stiffness fixed, a 10% increase to 660 kN gives 3.3 mm. Actual jack stroke also includes seating gaps, waler deformation, wall movement and equipment compliance, so this shortening cannot establish complete contact. Verification records force and both end movements simultaneously, identifies the stiffness change at seating, then checks retained preload, thermal force and interaction with neighbouring struts. These are original assumptions rather than instructions for applying force on site.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」與「支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Contact gap mechanism and verification" and "Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Contact gap mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接觸間隙」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contact gap” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支撐初次受力時，部分位移先消耗在座板、接頭及墊塊的接觸間隙，並非全都壓縮鋼構件。預壓可提早建立傳力路徑，但過高預壓會推動壁體或增加圍檁負擔；目標應由整體開挖變形與構件能力共同決定。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接觸間隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone. Preload can establish the load path early, but excessive preload pushes the wall or overloads walers. The target must therefore follow overall excavation deformation and member resistance rather than a desire to maximize initial force. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Contact gap” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接觸間隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Contact gap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 支撐初次受力時，部分位移先消耗在座板、接頭及墊塊的接觸間隙，並非全都壓縮鋼構件。預壓可提早建立傳力路徑，但過高預壓會推動壁體或增加圍檁負擔；目標應由整體開挖變形與構件能力共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone. Preload can establish the load path early, but excessive preload pushes the wall or overloads walers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Contact gap mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。
支撐初次受力時，部分位移先消耗在座板、接頭及墊塊的接觸間隙，並非全都壓縮鋼構件。
截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。
optionsEn: The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed.
Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone.
A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer.
quiz.explanation: 支撐初次受力時，部分位移先消耗在座板、接頭及墊塊的接觸間隙，並非全都壓縮鋼構件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Contact gap mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接觸間隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Contact gap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄軸力及兩端相對位移，辨別接觸前的非線性段，再以接觸後斜率比較設計剛度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record force and relative end movement together, identify the nonlinear seating phase, and compare the post-contact slope with design stiffness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Contact gap mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 支撐桿件強度足夠，就不用檢查座板下的承壓。
每支支撐都曾達標，就表示整層目前一定同時達標。
原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。
optionsEn: Adequate strut strength eliminates the need to check bearing beneath its seat.
If every strut once met its target, the entire level meets all targets simultaneously.
Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Contact gap mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接觸間隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Contact gap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄軸力及兩端相對位移，辨別接觸前的非線性段，再以接觸後斜率比較設計剛度。預壓驗收應同時保留力與位移曲線；接觸異常由臨時工程設計者核定修正，不以反覆加壓取代診斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record force and relative end movement together, identify the nonlinear seating phase, and compare the post-contact slope with design stiffness. Preload acceptance retains force and displacement curves; the temporary-works designer approves seating corrections rather than replacing diagnosis with repeated pressurization. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預壓驗收應同時保留力與位移曲線；接觸異常由臨時工程設計者核定修正，不以反覆加壓取代診斷。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Preload acceptance retains force and displacement curves; the temporary-works designer approves seating corrections rather than replacing diagnosis with repeated pressurization. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接觸未建立就讀取千斤頂壓力，可能誤判預壓已傳入支撐，卸壓後壁體仍有自由移動空間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reading jack pressure before contact is established can falsely indicate transferred preload while the wall retains free movement after unloading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步記錄軸力及兩端相對位移，辨別接觸前的非線性段，再以接觸後斜率比較設計剛度。預壓驗收應同時保留力與位移曲線；接觸異常由臨時工程設計者核定修正，不以反覆加壓取代診斷。
knowledge.textEn: Record force and relative end movement together, identify the nonlinear seating phase, and compare the post-contact slope with design stiffness. Preload acceptance retains force and displacement curves; the temporary-works designer approves seating corrections rather than replacing diagnosis with repeated pressurization.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 預壓驗收應同時保留力與位移曲線；接觸異常由臨時工程設計者核定修正，不以反覆加壓取代診斷。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。
knowledge.textEn: Preload acceptance retains force and displacement curves; the temporary-works designer approves seating corrections rather than replacing diagnosis with repeated pressurization. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Contact gap mechanism and verification"?
options: 同步記錄軸力及兩端相對位移，辨別接觸前的非線性段，再以接觸後斜率比較設計剛度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
壓力表讀值乘任何外徑面積都能得到精確支撐力。
optionsEn: Record force and relative end movement together, identify the nonlinear seating phase, and compare the post-contact slope with design stiffness.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Gauge pressure times any external cylinder area gives exact strut force.
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄軸力及兩端相對位移，辨別接觸前的非線性段，再以接觸後斜率比較設計剛度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record force and relative end movement together, identify the nonlinear seating phase, and compare the post-contact slope with design stiffness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Contact gap mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接觸間隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Contact gap” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接觸未建立就讀取千斤頂壓力，可能誤判預壓已傳入支撐，卸壓後壁體仍有自由移動空間。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reading jack pressure before contact is established can falsely indicate transferred preload while the wall retains free movement after unloading. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接觸未建立就讀取千斤頂壓力，可能誤判預壓已傳入支撐，卸壓後壁體仍有自由移動空間。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。
knowledge.textEn: Reading jack pressure before contact is established can falsely indicate transferred preload while the wall retains free movement after unloading. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Contact gap mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
接觸未建立就讀取千斤頂壓力，可能誤判預壓已傳入支撐，卸壓後壁體仍有自由移動空間。
截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Reading jack pressure before contact is established can falsely indicate transferred preload while the wall retains free movement after unloading.
A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer.
quiz.explanation: 接觸未建立就讀取千斤頂壓力，可能誤判預壓已傳入支撐，卸壓後壁體仍有自由移動空間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reading jack pressure before contact is established can falsely indicate transferred preload while the wall retains free movement after unloading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支撐軸向剛度」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strut axial stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼支撐的軸向剛度由材料模數、截面積及有效長度決定，長支撐即使強度足夠也可能有較大縮短。真實系統還包括接頭及壁體柔度，串聯柔度會降低整體剛度；用單根鋼管剛度代表完整支撐線可能低估開挖位移。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支撐軸向剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Axial stiffness depends on modulus, area and length, so a long strut can shorten substantially despite adequate strength. The system also includes splice and wall flexibility; serial compliances reduce overall stiffness. Using the steel member alone to represent the entire support line can therefore underestimate excavation movement and misrepresent load sharing. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Strut axial stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m² and L=20 m, k=EA/L=200 MN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支撐軸向剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Strut axial stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 鋼支撐的軸向剛度由材料模數、截面積及有效長度決定，長支撐即使強度足夠也可能有較大縮短。真實系統還包括接頭及壁體柔度，串聯柔度會降低整體剛度；用單根鋼管剛度代表完整支撐線可能低估開挖位移。
knowledge.textEn: Axial stiffness depends on modulus, area and length, so a long strut can shorten substantially despite adequate strength. The system also includes splice and wall flexibility; serial compliances reduce overall stiffness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。
支撐力隨白天上升就一定表示外側土壓增加。
鋼支撐的軸向剛度由材料模數、截面積及有效長度決定，長支撐即使強度足夠也可能有較大縮短。
optionsEn: A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer.
A daytime rise in strut force necessarily indicates increasing earth pressure.
Axial stiffness depends on modulus, area and length, so a long strut can shorten substantially despite adequate strength.
quiz.explanation: 鋼支撐的軸向剛度由材料模數、截面積及有效長度決定，長支撐即使強度足夠也可能有較大縮短。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Axial stiffness depends on modulus, area and length, so a long strut can shorten substantially despite adequate strength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支撐軸向剛度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strut axial stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m² and L=20 m, k=EA/L=200 MN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對截面及長度，以接頭兩側位移和構件應變分離鋼材縮短與接合滑移，再比較等效剛度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify section and length, separating steel shortening from splice slip using displacement on both sides of joints and member strain before comparing effective stiffness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m² and L=20 m, k=EA/L=200 MN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。
鎖定前達到目標力就等於之後一直維持相同預壓。
壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m² and L=20 m, k=EA/L=200 MN/m.
Reaching the target before lock-off means the same preload remains indefinitely.
Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m² and L=20 m, k=EA/L=200 MN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支撐軸向剛度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strut axial stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對截面及長度，以接頭兩側位移和構件應變分離鋼材縮短與接合滑移，再比較等效剛度。分析模型應明列鋼材、接頭、圍檁與壁體柔度；變更接頭型式前由結構設計者重新核對整體剛度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify section and length, separating steel shortening from splice slip using displacement on both sides of joints and member strain before comparing effective stiffness. Identify steel, splice, waler and wall compliance in analysis; the structural designer reassesses system stiffness before a connection type changes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分析模型應明列鋼材、接頭、圍檁與壁體柔度；變更接頭型式前由結構設計者重新核對整體剛度。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Identify steel, splice, waler and wall compliance in analysis; the structural designer reassesses system stiffness before a connection type changes. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未計接頭滑移會使預測支撐過硬，導致施工壁移超出模型，且力分配偏向其他較硬支撐。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted splice slip makes predicted restraint too stiff, producing larger wall movement and transferring force toward other stiffer supports. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對截面及長度，以接頭兩側位移和構件應變分離鋼材縮短與接合滑移，再比較等效剛度。分析模型應明列鋼材、接頭、圍檁與壁體柔度；變更接頭型式前由結構設計者重新核對整體剛度。
knowledge.textEn: Verify section and length, separating steel shortening from splice slip using displacement on both sides of joints and member strain before comparing effective stiffness. Identify steel, splice, waler and wall compliance in analysis; the structural designer reassesses system stiffness before a connection type changes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 分析模型應明列鋼材、接頭、圍檁與壁體柔度；變更接頭型式前由結構設計者重新核對整體剛度。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。
knowledge.textEn: Identify steel, splice, waler and wall compliance in analysis; the structural designer reassesses system stiffness before a connection type changes. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對截面及長度，以接頭兩側位移和構件應變分離鋼材縮短與接合滑移，再比較等效剛度。
累積位移仍低於警戒值，就不必注意位移速率。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Verify section and length, separating steel shortening from splice slip using displacement on both sides of joints and member strain before comparing effective stiffness.
Movement rate is irrelevant while cumulative displacement remains below its trigger.
quiz.explanation: 核對截面及長度，以接頭兩側位移和構件應變分離鋼材縮短與接合滑移，再比較等效剛度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify section and length, separating steel shortening from splice slip using displacement on both sides of joints and member strain before comparing effective stiffness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支撐軸向剛度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strut axial stiffness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未計接頭滑移會使預測支撐過硬，導致施工壁移超出模型，且力分配偏向其他較硬支撐。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted splice slip makes predicted restraint too stiff, producing larger wall movement and transferring force toward other stiffer supports. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未計接頭滑移會使預測支撐過硬，導致施工壁移超出模型，且力分配偏向其他較硬支撐。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted splice slip makes predicted restraint too stiff, producing larger wall movement and transferring force toward other stiffer supports. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
支撐力隨白天上升就一定表示外側土壓增加。
未計接頭滑移會使預測支撐過硬，導致施工壁移超出模型，且力分配偏向其他較硬支撐。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A daytime rise in strut force necessarily indicates increasing earth pressure.
Omitted splice slip makes predicted restraint too stiff, producing larger wall movement and transferring force toward other stiffer supports.
quiz.explanation: 未計接頭滑移會使預測支撐過硬，導致施工壁移超出模型，且力分配偏向其他較硬支撐。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted splice slip makes predicted restraint too stiff, producing larger wall movement and transferring force toward other stiffer supports. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溫度附加軸力的機理與驗證」與「座板局部承壓的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal axial force mechanism and verification" and "Seat bearing mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度附加軸力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal axial force mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫度附加軸力」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal axial force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼支撐受日照或施工環境變化而伸縮，若兩端受到限制，熱變形會轉成附加軸力。完全拘束給出上限尺度，但壁體與接頭柔度會釋放部分熱應變；監測若未扣除溫度，可能把可逆熱力誤判為土壓需求突然增加。完全拘束式不能直接當場址預測，應用串聯剛度估計釋放程度；日照梯度也會引起彎曲，並非只有均勻軸力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫度附加軸力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Struts expand and contract with sunlight and construction conditions, generating axial force when restrained. Full restraint gives a bounding scale, while wall and connection flexibility release part of the thermal strain. Without temperature correction, monitoring may misinterpret reversible thermal force as a sudden increase in earth-pressure demand. The fully restrained expression is not a direct site prediction; serial stiffness determines release, and solar gradients can induce bending as well as uniform axial force. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal axial force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：完全拘束下E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、α=12×10⁻⁶/K、ΔT=10 K，ΔP=EAαΔT=480 kN。

knowledge.title: 溫度附加軸力的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Thermal axial force mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 鋼支撐受日照或施工環境變化而伸縮，若兩端受到限制，熱變形會轉成附加軸力。完全拘束給出上限尺度，但壁體與接頭柔度會釋放部分熱應變；監測若未扣除溫度，可能把可逆熱力誤判為土壓需求突然增加。
knowledge.textEn: Struts expand and contract with sunlight and construction conditions, generating axial force when restrained. Full restraint gives a bounding scale, while wall and connection flexibility release part of the thermal strain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支撐力隨白天上升就一定表示外側土壓增加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A daytime rise in strut force necessarily indicates increasing earth pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度附加軸力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

支撐力隨白天上升就一定表示外側土壓增加。
支撐桿件強度足夠，就不用檢查座板下的承壓。
optionsEn: Struts expand and contract with sunlight and construction conditions, generating axial force when restrained.
A daytime rise in strut force necessarily indicates increasing earth pressure.
Adequate strut strength eliminates the need to check bearing beneath its seat.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：完全拘束下E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、α=12×10⁻⁶/K、ΔT=10 K，ΔP=EAαΔT=480 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Under full restraint, E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m², α=12×10⁻⁶/K and ΔT=10 K give ΔP=EAαΔT=480 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在受光及背光位置量測鋼溫，對時比對軸力與壁移，分辨日循環和持續增長的土壓作用。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 溫度附加軸力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal axial force mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溫度附加軸力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal axial force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在受光及背光位置量測鋼溫，對時比對軸力與壁移，分辨日循環和持續增長的土壓作用。軸力警戒應注明溫度基準與修正方式；設計者審核總力及去溫度趨勢，兩者都不可省略。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure steel temperature in exposed and shaded locations, aligning force and wall movement to distinguish daily cycles from sustained earth-pressure growth. Force triggers state temperature reference and correction method; the designer reviews both total force and temperature-corrected trend, retaining neither as a substitute for the other. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：軸力警戒應注明溫度基準與修正方式；設計者審核總力及去溫度趨勢，兩者都不可省略。完全拘束式不能直接當場址預測，應用串聯剛度估計釋放程度；日照梯度也會引起彎曲，並非只有均勻軸力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Force triggers state temperature reference and correction method; the designer reviews both total force and temperature-corrected trend, retaining neither as a substitute for the other. The fully restrained expression is not a direct site prediction; serial stiffness determines release, and solar gradients can induce bending as well as uniform axial force.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略熱力可能誤觸發警報，也可能在最高溫時低估支撐總軸力與挫屈需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring thermal force can cause false alarms or underestimate total axial and buckling demand at the highest temperature. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 忽略熱力可能誤觸發警報，也可能在最高溫時低估支撐總軸力與挫屈需求。完全拘束式不能直接當場址預測，應用串聯剛度估計釋放程度；日照梯度也會引起彎曲，並非只有均勻軸力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seat bearing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支撐軸力須經座板、加勁肋及圍檁傳到擋土壁，局部接觸面常比構件截面更容易控制。座板翹曲或墊塊不平會縮小有效面積並增加偏心；平均承壓只有在接觸分布合理時才能用來描述局部需求。平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「座板局部承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

quiz.explanationEn: Strut force passes through seats, stiffeners and walers into the wall, and local contact may govern before the member section. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 座板局部承壓的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seat bearing mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「座板局部承壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seat bearing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設力P=800 kN、有效接觸A=0.04 m²，平均p=P/A=20000 kPa=20 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For force P=800 kN over effective contact A=0.04 m², mean p=P/A=20000 kPa=20 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查接觸面平整及加勁位置，量測座板轉角，對照反力是否通過設計傳力中心。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect contact flatness and stiffener location, measure seat rotation, and check whether the reaction passes through the intended transfer centre.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 座板局部承壓的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seat bearing mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「座板局部承壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seat bearing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查接觸面平整及加勁位置，量測座板轉角，對照反力是否通過設計傳力中心。預壓前必須驗收接觸及加勁細部；座板變形異常由連接設計者評估，不能只換更大的千斤頂。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect contact flatness and stiffener location, measure seat rotation, and check whether the reaction passes through the intended transfer centre. Accept contact and stiffening before preload; the connection designer investigates seat deformation rather than responding with a larger jack. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Accept contact and stiffening before preload; the connection designer investigates seat deformation rather than responding with a larger jack. Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：小面積接觸可能導致混凝土局部壓碎或腹板屈曲，支撐本身尚有容量也無法維持整體傳力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Small contact areas can crush concrete or buckle a web, interrupting the system load path despite remaining strut capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 座板局部承壓的機理與驗證：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「座板局部承壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 小面積接觸可能導致混凝土局部壓碎或腹板屈曲，支撐本身尚有容量也無法維持整體傳力。平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Small contact areas can crush concrete or buckle a web, interrupting the system load path despite remaining strut capacity. Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支撐桿件強度足夠，就不用檢查座板下的承壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate strut strength eliminates the need to check bearing beneath its seat." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 小面積接觸可能導致混凝土局部壓碎或腹板屈曲，支撐本身尚有容量也無法維持整體傳力。平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「座板局部承壓的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seat bearing mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

小面積接觸可能導致混凝土局部壓碎或腹板屈曲，支撐本身尚有容量也無法維持整體傳力。

optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Small contact areas can crush concrete or buckle a web, interrupting the system load path despite remaining strut capacity.
Reaching the target before lock-off means the same preload remains indefinitely.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鎖定損失的機理與驗證」與「多支撐互制的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lock-off loss mechanism and verification" and "Interaction between struts mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鎖定損失的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lock-off loss mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鎖定損失」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lock-off loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預壓由液壓設備轉移至機械鎖定後，楔塊坐入、墊片壓縮及接頭滑移會造成軸力損失。鎖定前讀值不是長期保留力，且溫度變化也會干擾比較；設計上需區分施加力、移交力與後續開挖引起的力增量。比例只描述這次力轉移，不是通用允許損失；應排除溫度及儀器漂移，並確認比較期間沒有其他支撐同步受力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鎖定損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Transferring preload from hydraulics to mechanical locking can lose force through wedge seating, packing compression and splice slip. The pre-lock reading is not retained force, and temperature changes complicate comparison. Design must distinguish applied force, transferred force and increments caused by subsequent excavation. The ratio describes this transfer only, not an allowable loss; exclude temperature and sensor drift and confirm no other supports changed load during the comparison. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lock-off loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設施加P₀=800 kN、同溫鎖定後P₁=680 kN，損失比(P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For applied P₀=800 kN and same-temperature retained P₁=680 kN, loss ratio (P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鎖定前達到目標力就等於之後一直維持相同預壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reaching the target before lock-off means the same preload remains indefinitely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鎖定損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lock-off loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鎖定損失的機理與驗證

quiz.question: 關於「鎖定損失的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

每支支撐都曾達標，就表示整層目前一定同時達標。

steps.title: 鎖定損失的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lock-off loss mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鎖定損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lock-off loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較鎖定前後同一量測系統的軸力與位移，記錄溫度及座板狀態，確認損失是否持續發展。驗收文件需列施加、鎖定及穩定後力值；超出核定損失範圍時由設計者查明原因後決定是否調整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare force and displacement before and after lock-off using the same system, recording temperature and seating condition to see whether losses continue. Acceptance records include applied, locked and stabilized forces; losses outside approved bounds require designer diagnosis before adjustment is decided. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

The ratio describes this transfer only, not an allowable loss; exclude temperature and sensor drift and confirm no other supports changed load during the comparison.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instructionEn: Recording only the applied peak overstates retained preload, allowing the wall to move before restraint fully re-engages during excavation. The ratio describes this transfer only, not an allowable loss; exclude temperature and sensor drift and confirm no other supports changed load during the comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 只記施加峰值會高估保留預壓，後續開挖時壁體可能先移動才重新接觸支撐。比例只描述這次力轉移，不是通用允許損失；應排除溫度及儀器漂移，並確認比較期間沒有其他支撐同步受力。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鎖定損失的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lock-off loss mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
每支支撐都曾達標，就表示整層目前一定同時達標。
只記施加峰值會高估保留預壓，後續開挖時壁體可能先移動才重新接觸支撐。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If every strut once met its target, the entire level meets all targets simultaneously.
Recording only the applied peak overstates retained preload, allowing the wall to move before restraint fully re-engages during excavation.
quiz.explanation: 只記施加峰值會高估保留預壓，後續開挖時壁體可能先移動才重新接觸支撐。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Recording only the applied peak overstates retained preload, allowing the wall to move before restraint fully re-engages during excavation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 多支撐互制的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Interaction between struts mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「多支撐互制」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interaction between struts” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預壓一支支撐會推動圍檁與壁體，改變鄰近支撐的長度及軸力，因此各支撐並非互相獨立。施加順序及剛度差異決定反力分配，局部達到目標力可能同時使另一支卸載；整體平衡要以同一時間的力值判定。兩支力增量相加不代表整體水平平衡，還有其他支撐、土反力及力臂；需納入完整同時自由體圖。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多支撐互制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Preloading one strut moves the waler and wall, changing neighbouring lengths and forces. Supports are therefore coupled through stiffness and sequence. Achieving a local target may unload another strut, so overall equilibrium must use simultaneous readings rather than peaks recorded at different times. Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Interaction between struts” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設本支撐增加ΔP₁=100 kN、鄰支撐減少60 kN，兩支合計增量ΔΣP=100−60=40 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: If one strut gains ΔP₁=100 kN and its neighbour loses 60 kN, their combined increment is ΔΣP=100−60=40 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每支支撐都曾達標，就表示整層目前一定同時達標。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every strut once met its target, the entire level meets all targets simultaneously." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「多支撐互制」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Interaction between struts”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「多支撐互制的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
