steps.titleEn: Interaction between struts mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「多支撐互制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Interaction between struts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步讀取整個支撐層的力與圍檁位移，逐段比較力增量矩陣，核對反力總和及作用位置。預壓及複測順序應由臨時工程設計者指定，驗收採同時力場；不得以逐支歷史最大值取代。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Read the complete support level simultaneously with waler movement, compare incremental interaction patterns, and check reaction sums and positions. The temporary-works designer specifies preload and recheck sequence, and acceptance uses a simultaneous force field rather than individual historical maxima. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預壓及複測順序應由臨時工程設計者指定，驗收採同時力場；不得以逐支歷史最大值取代。兩支力增量相加不代表整體水平平衡，還有其他支撐、土反力及力臂；需納入完整同時自由體圖。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The temporary-works designer specifies preload and recheck sequence, and acceptance uses a simultaneous force field rather than individual historical maxima. Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把不同時間的峰值相加會虛構不存在的總支撐力，也可能漏掉某支已卸載而失去接觸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding peaks from different times invents a total force that never existed and can conceal a strut that has unloaded and lost contact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多支撐互制的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Interaction between struts mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
支撐力隨白天上升就一定表示外側土壓增加。
同步讀取整個支撐層的力與圍檁位移，逐段比較力增量矩陣，核對反力總和及作用位置。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A daytime rise in strut force necessarily indicates increasing earth pressure.
Read the complete support level simultaneously with waler movement, compare incremental interaction patterns, and check reaction sums and positions.
quiz.explanation: 同步讀取整個支撐層的力與圍檁位移，逐段比較力增量矩陣，核對反力總和及作用位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Read the complete support level simultaneously with waler movement, compare incremental interaction patterns, and check reaction sums and positions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 多支撐互制的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interaction between struts mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多支撐互制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Interaction between struts” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把不同時間的峰值相加會虛構不存在的總支撐力，也可能漏掉某支已卸載而失去接觸。兩支力增量相加不代表整體水平平衡，還有其他支撐、土反力及力臂；需納入完整同時自由體圖。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding peaks from different times invents a total force that never existed and can conceal a strut that has unloaded and lost contact. Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩支力增量相加不代表整體水平平衡，還有其他支撐、土反力及力臂；需納入完整同時自由體圖。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每支支撐都曾達標，就表示整層目前一定同時達標。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every strut once met its target, the entire level meets all targets simultaneously." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把不同時間的峰值相加會虛構不存在的總支撐力，也可能漏掉某支已卸載而失去接觸。兩支力增量相加不代表整體水平平衡，還有其他支撐、土反力及力臂；需納入完整同時自由體圖。
knowledge.textEn: Adding peaks from different times invents a total force that never existed and can conceal a strut that has unloaded and lost contact. Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多支撐互制的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interaction between struts mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把不同時間的峰值相加會虛構不存在的總支撐力，也可能漏掉某支已卸載而失去接觸。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。
optionsEn: Adding peaks from different times invents a total force that never existed and can conceal a strut that has unloaded and lost contact.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 把不同時間的峰值相加會虛構不存在的總支撐力，也可能漏掉某支已卸載而失去接觸。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding peaks from different times invents a total force that never existed and can conceal a strut that has unloaded and lost contact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」與「液壓力校正的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification" and "Hydraulic-force calibration mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「第二階偏心」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Second-order eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。支撐的穩定檢查因此不能只看平均軸應力，還要核對接頭對心、側向約束與實際彎曲方向；局部改動可使整個支撐線更敏感。此式是已知變形下的附加彎矩，沒有自行求出失穩點；實際分析還需剛度、端部條件及材料非線性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「第二階偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it. Stability checks therefore require alignment, lateral restraint and actual bending direction as well as average axial stress. Local modifications can increase sensitivity of the entire support line. This expression gives added moment for a known deflection and does not solve instability; actual analysis also needs stiffness, end conditions and material nonlinearity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Second-order eccentricity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「第二階偏心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Second-order eccentricity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。支撐的穩定檢查因此不能只看平均軸應力，還要核對接頭對心、側向約束與實際彎曲方向；局部改動可使整個支撐線更敏感。
knowledge.textEn: Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it. Stability checks therefore require alignment, lateral restraint and actual bending direction as well as average axial stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。
受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。
壓力表讀值乘任何外徑面積都能得到精確支撐力。
optionsEn: Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored.
Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it.
Gauge pressure times any external cylinder area gives exact strut force.
quiz.explanation: 受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「第二階偏心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Second-order eccentricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：測量支撐直線度與接頭錯位，將側移和軸力同時輸入第二階分析，檢查側向繫材有效性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure strut straightness and splice offset, input lateral displacement and force together into second-order analysis, and verify effective lateral ties.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 卸載是把力減少，所以不需要像加載一樣分析。
截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。
原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。
optionsEn: Unloading reduces force, so it needs no analysis comparable to loading.
A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer.
Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「第二階偏心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Second-order eccentricity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 測量支撐直線度與接頭錯位，將側移和軸力同時輸入第二階分析，檢查側向繫材有效性。不直度及接頭偏心應納入安裝驗收；超差處由構件設計者確認修正，不能依外觀判斷仍可使用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure strut straightness and splice offset, input lateral displacement and force together into second-order analysis, and verify effective lateral ties. Include straightness and splice eccentricity in installation acceptance; the member designer approves correction of deviations rather than judging usability by appearance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：不直度及接頭偏心應納入安裝驗收；超差處由構件設計者確認修正，不能依外觀判斷仍可使用。此式是已知變形下的附加彎矩，沒有自行求出失穩點；實際分析還需剛度、端部條件及材料非線性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Include straightness and splice eccentricity in installation acceptance; the member designer approves correction of deviations rather than judging usability by appearance. This expression gives added moment for a known deflection and does not solve instability; actual analysis also needs stiffness, end conditions and material nonlinearity.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：小偏心在高軸力下可形成顯著彎矩，局部側向支承失效會進一步放大變形並降低穩定餘裕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Small eccentricity under high compression produces significant bending; lost lateral support further magnifies deformation and reduces stability margin. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「第二階偏心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 小偏心在高軸力下可形成顯著彎矩，局部側向支承失效會進一步放大變形並降低穩定餘裕。此式是已知變形下的附加彎矩，沒有自行求出失穩點；實際分析還需剛度、端部條件及材料非線性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Small eccentricity under high compression produces significant bending; lost lateral support further magnifies deformation and reduces stability margin. This expression gives added moment for a known deflection and does not solve instability; actual analysis also needs stiffness, end conditions and material nonlinearity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 液壓力校正的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic-force calibration mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「液壓力校正」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic-force calibration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 千斤頂壓力乘有效活塞面積可估施力，但回油側壓力、摩擦及校正誤差會使真實力偏離理想值。壓力表量到的是液壓系統狀態，不能獨立證明支撐已受力；應與載重計或構件應變以及位移同步比對。理想公式假設差壓已扣除回壓且忽略摩擦，不是張拉操作程序；現場施力與停留點必須依核定設備和臨時工程方案。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「液壓力校正」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure times effective piston area estimates jack force, but return pressure, friction and calibration error alter actual output. A pressure gauge measures the hydraulic system rather than independently proving force in the strut. Compare it with a load cell or member strain and with displacement on a synchronized time base. The ideal equation assumes backpressure is already removed and neglects friction; it is not an operating procedure, and force application follows approved equipment and temporary-works plans. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic-force calibration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設有效差壓p=20 MPa、有效活塞面積A=0.04 m²，F=pA=0.8 MN=800 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For effective differential pressure p=20 MPa and piston area A=0.04 m², F=pA=0.8 MN=800 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓力表讀值乘任何外徑面積都能得到精確支撐力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gauge pressure times any external cylinder area gives exact strut force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「液壓力校正」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic-force calibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 液壓力校正的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 千斤頂壓力乘有效活塞面積可估施力，但回油側壓力、摩擦及校正誤差會使真實力偏離理想值。壓力表量到的是液壓系統狀態，不能獨立證明支撐已受力；應與載重計或構件應變以及位移同步比對。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure times effective piston area estimates jack force, but return pressure, friction and calibration error alter actual output. A pressure gauge measures the hydraulic system rather than independently proving force in the strut.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓力表讀值乘任何外徑面積都能得到精確支撐力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gauge pressure times any external cylinder area gives exact strut force. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「液壓力校正的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic-force calibration mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 壓力表讀值乘任何外徑面積都能得到精確支撐力。
累積位移仍低於警戒值，就不必注意位移速率。

optionsEn: Gauge pressure times any external cylinder area gives exact strut force.
Movement rate is irrelevant while cumulative displacement remains below its trigger.
Pressure times effective piston area estimates jack force, but return pressure, friction and calibration error alter actual output.
quiz.explanation: 千斤頂壓力乘有效活塞面積可估施力，但回油側壓力、摩擦及校正誤差會使真實力偏離理想值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 液壓力校正的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic-force calibration mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「液壓力校正」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic-force calibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設有效差壓p=20 MPa、有效活塞面積A=0.04 m²，F=pA=0.8 MN=800 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For effective differential pressure p=20 MPa and piston area A=0.04 m², F=pA=0.8 MN=800 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對活塞有效面積與校正證書，在核定範圍比對獨立載重計，檢查升降載遲滯及讀值零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify effective piston area and calibration certificates, compare with an independent load cell within the approved range, and check loading-unloading hysteresis and zero offsets.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For effective differential pressure p=20 MPa and piston area A=0.04 m², F=pA=0.8 MN=800 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

steps.title: 液壓力校正的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「液壓力校正」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic-force calibration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對活塞有效面積與校正證書，在核定範圍比對獨立載重計，檢查升降載遲滯及讀值零點。每組千斤頂、壓力表及載重計應有配對編碼；設備更換後由試驗負責人重核轉換關係再使用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify effective piston area and calibration certificates, compare with an independent load cell within the approved range, and check loading-unloading hysteresis and zero offsets. Pair-code each jack, gauge and load cell; the testing lead rechecks the conversion after equipment changes before further use. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每組千斤頂、壓力表及載重計應有配對編碼；設備更換後由試驗負責人重核轉換關係再使用。理想公式假設差壓已扣除回壓且忽略摩擦，不是張拉操作程序；現場施力與停留點必須依核定設備和臨時工程方案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Pair-code each jack, gauge and load cell; the testing lead rechecks the conversion after equipment changes before further use. The ideal equation assumes backpressure is already removed and neglects friction; it is not an operating procedure, and force application follows approved equipment and temporary-works plans.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用錯活塞面積或忽略回壓會錯估預壓，摩擦遲滯又可能使升載與降載呈不同力值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wrong piston area or ignored backpressure misstates preload, while friction hysteresis gives different forces during loading and unloading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Hydraulic-force calibration mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「液壓力校正」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic-force calibration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用錯活塞面積或忽略回壓會錯估預壓，摩擦遲滯又可能使升載與降載呈不同力值。理想公式假設差壓已扣除回壓且忽略摩擦，不是張拉操作程序；現場施力與停留點必須依核定設備和臨時工程方案。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wrong piston area or ignored backpressure misstates preload, while friction hysteresis gives different forces during loading and unloading. The ideal equation assumes backpressure is already removed and neglects friction; it is not an operating procedure, and force application follows approved equipment and temporary-works plans. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：理想公式假設差壓已扣除回壓且忽略摩擦，不是張拉操作程序；現場施力與停留點必須依核定設備和臨時工程方案。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The ideal equation assumes backpressure is already removed and neglects friction; it is not an operating procedure, and force application follows approved equipment and temporary-works plans.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓力表讀值乘任何外徑面積都能得到精確支撐力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gauge pressure times any external cylinder area gives exact strut force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用錯活塞面積或忽略回壓會錯估預壓，摩擦遲滯又可能使升載與降載呈不同力值。理想公式假設差壓已扣除回壓且忽略摩擦，不是張拉操作程序；現場施力與停留點必須依核定設備和臨時工程方案。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong piston area or ignored backpressure misstates preload, while friction hysteresis gives different forces during loading and unloading. The ideal equation assumes backpressure is already removed and neglects friction; it is not an operating procedure, and force application follows approved equipment and temporary-works plans.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「液壓力校正的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic-force calibration mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
累積位移仍低於警戒值，就不必注意位移速率。
用錯活塞面積或忽略回壓會錯估預壓，摩擦遲滯又可能使升載與降載呈不同力值。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Movement rate is irrelevant while cumulative displacement remains below its trigger.
Wrong piston area or ignored backpressure misstates preload, while friction hysteresis gives different forces during loading and unloading.
quiz.explanation: 用錯活塞面積或忽略回壓會錯估預壓，摩擦遲滯又可能使升載與降載呈不同力值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Wrong piston area or ignored backpressure misstates preload, while friction hysteresis gives different forces during loading and unloading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壁移速率的機理與驗證」與「卸載回彈的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wall movement rate mechanism and verification" and "Unloading rebound mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壁移速率的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wall movement rate mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壁移速率」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wall movement rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開挖壁移除了累積量，變化速率及與支撐受力的相位也能協助診斷。位移持續加速可能代表支承尚未形成、土體潛變或地下水變化；短時間跳點則需先排除測量基準或儀器問題，不能把所有異常都歸因於地層失穩。兩點平均速率不能顯示期間加速或峰值，也不是通用停工值；需依資產敏感度與施工反應時間訂定判據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壁移速率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cumulative wall movement, rate and timing relative to strut force all aid diagnosis. Sustained acceleration may indicate incomplete restraint, soil creep or groundwater changes, whereas a sudden isolated jump first requires checks of datum and instrument integrity. Not every anomalous reading establishes ground instability, but trends must not be dismissed without evidence. A two-point mean rate hides intermediate acceleration and peaks and is not a universal stop value; criteria depend on asset sensitivity and response time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wall movement rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設位移由5 mm增至8 mm，間隔Δt=6 h，平均速率v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For displacement increasing from 5 mm to 8 mm over Δt=6 h, mean rate v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「累積位移仍低於警戒值，就不必注意位移速率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Movement rate is irrelevant while cumulative displacement remains below its trigger." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壁移速率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wall movement rate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壁移速率的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Wall movement rate mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 開挖壁移除了累積量，變化速率及與支撐受力的相位也能協助診斷。位移持續加速可能代表支承尚未形成、土體潛變或地下水變化；短時間跳點則需先排除測量基準或儀器問題，不能把所有異常都歸因於地層失穩。
knowledge.textEn: Cumulative wall movement, rate and timing relative to strut force all aid diagnosis. Sustained acceleration may indicate incomplete restraint, soil creep or groundwater changes, whereas a sudden isolated jump first requires checks of datum and instrument integrity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：累積位移仍低於警戒值，就不必注意位移速率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Movement rate is irrelevant while cumulative displacement remains below its trigger. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壁移速率的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wall movement rate mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 開挖壁移除了累積量，變化速率及與支撐受力的相位也能協助診斷。
累積位移仍低於警戒值，就不必注意位移速率。
卸載是把力減少，所以不需要像加載一樣分析。
optionsEn: Cumulative wall movement, rate and timing relative to strut force all aid diagnosis.
Movement rate is irrelevant while cumulative displacement remains below its trigger.
Unloading reduces force, so it needs no analysis comparable to loading.
quiz.explanation: 開挖壁移除了累積量，變化速率及與支撐受力的相位也能協助診斷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cumulative wall movement, rate and timing relative to strut force all aid diagnosis. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壁移速率的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wall movement rate mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壁移速率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wall movement rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設位移由5 mm增至8 mm，間隔Δt=6 h，平均速率v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For displacement increasing from 5 mm to 8 mm over Δt=6 h, mean rate v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對傾度計、獨立測量及開挖日誌，檢查讀值是否同向持續，並同步查看支撐力與外水頭。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare inclinometers, independent survey and excavation logs for persistent directional movement while checking strut force and external head simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設位移由5 mm增至8 mm，間隔Δt=6 h，平均速率v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For displacement increasing from 5 mm to 8 mm over Δt=6 h, mean rate v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壁移速率的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wall movement rate mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。
原創教學假設：假設位移由5 mm增至8 mm，間隔Δt=6 h，平均速率v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h。
支撐桿件強度足夠，就不用檢查座板下的承壓。
optionsEn: A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer.
Original teaching assumptions: For displacement increasing from 5 mm to 8 mm over Δt=6 h, mean rate v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h.
Adequate strut strength eliminates the need to check bearing beneath its seat.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設位移由5 mm增至8 mm，間隔Δt=6 h，平均速率v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For displacement increasing from 5 mm to 8 mm over Δt=6 h, mean rate v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壁移速率的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wall movement rate mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壁移速率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wall movement rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對傾度計、獨立測量及開挖日誌，檢查讀值是否同向持續，並同步查看支撐力與外水頭。監測計畫應並列累積量、速率及資料品質檢查；異常由地工與臨時工程負責人共同判讀後決定下一階段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare inclinometers, independent survey and excavation logs for persistent directional movement while checking strut force and external head simultaneously. Monitoring plans include cumulative movement, rate and data-quality checks; geotechnical and temporary-works leads jointly interpret anomalies before deciding the next stage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測計畫應並列累積量、速率及資料品質檢查；異常由地工與臨時工程負責人共同判讀後決定下一階段。兩點平均速率不能顯示期間加速或峰值，也不是通用停工值；需依資產敏感度與施工反應時間訂定判據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Monitoring plans include cumulative movement, rate and data-quality checks; geotechnical and temporary-works leads jointly interpret anomalies before deciding the next stage. A two-point mean rate hides intermediate acceleration and peaks and is not a universal stop value; criteria depend on asset sensitivity and response time.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只設總位移警報可能錯過快速惡化，過度平滑資料又會掩蓋施工事件造成的短時加速。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A cumulative-only trigger can miss rapid deterioration, while excessive smoothing conceals short-term acceleration associated with construction events. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壁移速率的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wall movement rate mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
每支支撐都曾達標，就表示整層目前一定同時達標。

If every strut once met its target, the entire level meets all targets simultaneously.

quiz.explanation: 比對傾度計、獨立測量及開挖日誌，檢查讀值是否同向持續，並同步查看支撐力與外水頭。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare inclinometers, independent survey and excavation logs for persistent directional movement while checking strut force and external head simultaneously. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只設總位移警報可能錯過快速惡化，過度平滑資料又會掩蓋施工事件造成的短時加速。兩點平均速率不能顯示期間加速或峰值，也不是通用停工值；需依資產敏感度與施工反應時間訂定判據。
knowledge.textEn: A cumulative-only trigger can miss rapid deterioration, while excessive smoothing conceals short-term acceleration associated with construction events. A two-point mean rate hides intermediate acceleration and peaks and is not a universal stop value; criteria depend on asset sensitivity and response time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壁移速率的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wall movement rate mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只設總位移警報可能錯過快速惡化，過度平滑資料又會掩蓋施工事件造成的短時加速。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
卸載是把力減少，所以不需要像加載一樣分析。
optionsEn: A cumulative-only trigger can miss rapid deterioration, while excessive smoothing conceals short-term acceleration associated with construction events.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Unloading reduces force, so it needs no analysis comparable to loading.
quiz.explanation: 只設總位移警報可能錯過快速惡化，過度平滑資料又會掩蓋施工事件造成的短時加速。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A cumulative-only trigger can miss rapid deterioration, while excessive smoothing conceals short-term acceleration associated with construction events. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 卸載回彈的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unloading rebound mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「卸載回彈」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unloading rebound” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 永久樓板或其他支承接管荷載後，內支撐卸載會釋放儲存彈性能，使壁體及連接產生回彈。回彈方向與既有塑性變形不一定相同，不能假設解除預壓就回到施工前的位置；卸載分析需包含替代支承剛度與接觸狀態。回彈估算假設線性卸載且接觸不變，未含塑性、摩擦與土體時效；不能把四毫米直接當許可的卸載變位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「卸載回彈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When permanent slabs or other restraints take over, strut unloading releases stored elastic energy and causes wall and connection rebound. The rebound need not reverse accumulated plastic deformation or restore the original position. Analysis must include replacement-support stiffness and contact state rather than treating preload removal as a simple return to zero. The rebound estimate assumes linear unloading and unchanged contact, excluding plasticity, friction and time effects; four millimetres is not an authorized unloading movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unloading rebound” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設釋放力ΔP=600 kN、等效卸載剛度k=150 MN/m，回彈δ=ΔP/k=0.004 m=4 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For released force ΔP=600 kN and unloading stiffness k=150 MN/m, rebound δ=ΔP/k=0.004 m=4 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「卸載是把力減少，所以不需要像加載一樣分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unloading reduces force, so it needs no analysis comparable to loading." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「卸載回彈」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unloading rebound”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 卸載回彈的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 永久樓板或其他支承接管荷載後，內支撐卸載會釋放儲存彈性能，使壁體及連接產生回彈。回彈方向與既有塑性變形不一定相同，不能假設解除預壓就回到施工前的位置；卸載分析需包含替代支承剛度與接觸狀態。
knowledge.textEn: When permanent slabs or other restraints take over, strut unloading releases stored elastic energy and causes wall and connection rebound. The rebound need not reverse accumulated plastic deformation or restore the original position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：卸載是把力減少，所以不需要像加載一樣分析。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Unloading reduces force, so it needs no analysis comparable to loading. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「卸載回彈的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Unloading rebound mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 卸載是把力減少，所以不需要像加載一樣分析。
永久樓板或其他支承接管荷載後，內支撐卸載會釋放儲存彈性能，使壁體及連接產生回彈。
千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。
optionsEn: Unloading reduces force, so it needs no analysis comparable to loading.
When permanent slabs or other restraints take over, strut unloading releases stored elastic energy and causes wall and connection rebound.
The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed.
quiz.explanation: 永久樓板或其他支承接管荷載後，內支撐卸載會釋放儲存彈性能，使壁體及連接產生回彈。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When permanent slabs or other restraints take over, strut unloading releases stored elastic energy and causes wall and connection rebound. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 卸載回彈的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unloading rebound mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「卸載回彈」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unloading rebound” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設釋放力ΔP=600 kN、等效卸載剛度k=150 MN/m，回彈δ=ΔP/k=0.004 m=4 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For released force ΔP=600 kN and unloading stiffness k=150 MN/m, rebound δ=ΔP/k=0.004 m=4 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測卸載期間的支撐力、壁移及永久樓板應變，確認荷載確實移交到核定構件而非失去支承。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure strut force, wall movement and permanent-slab strain during unloading to verify actual transfer to approved members rather than loss of restraint.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設釋放力ΔP=600 kN、等效卸載剛度k=150 MN/m，回彈δ=ΔP/k=0.004 m=4 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For released force ΔP=600 kN and unloading stiffness k=150 MN/m, rebound δ=ΔP/k=0.004 m=4 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「卸載回彈的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

鎖定前達到目標力就等於之後一直維持相同預壓。

optionsEn: A daytime rise in strut force necessarily indicates increasing earth pressure.
Reaching the target before lock-off means the same preload remains indefinitely.
Original teaching assumptions: For released force ΔP=600 kN and unloading stiffness k=150 MN/m, rebound δ=ΔP/k=0.004 m=4 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設釋放力ΔP=600 kN、等效卸載剛度k=150 MN/m，回彈δ=ΔP/k=0.004 m=4 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For released force ΔP=600 kN and unloading stiffness k=150 MN/m, rebound δ=ΔP/k=0.004 m=4 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 卸載回彈的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unloading rebound mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「卸載回彈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unloading rebound” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測卸載期間的支撐力、壁移及永久樓板應變，確認荷載確實移交到核定構件而非失去支承。拆撐前由臨時及永久結構設計者共同簽認接管條件；保留卸載曲線及殘餘位移作為營運基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure strut force, wall movement and permanent-slab strain during unloading to verify actual transfer to approved members rather than loss of restraint. Temporary and permanent designers jointly sign off takeover conditions before removal; retain unloading curves and residual movement as the operational baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：拆撐前由臨時及永久結構設計者共同簽認接管條件；保留卸載曲線及殘餘位移作為營運基準。回彈估算假設線性卸載且接觸不變，未含塑性、摩擦與土體時效；不能把四毫米直接當許可的卸載變位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Temporary and permanent designers jointly sign off takeover conditions before removal; retain unloading curves and residual movement as the operational baseline. The rebound estimate assumes linear unloading and unchanged contact, excluding plasticity, friction and time effects; four millimetres is not an authorized unloading movement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未形成替代力流就卸載，可能使壁體向開挖內變形並損傷接縫，無法用重新加壓完全消除。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unloading before a replacement path exists can move the wall inward and damage joints, with effects that reloading may not fully reverse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Temporary and permanent designers jointly sign off takeover conditions before removal; retain unloading curves and residual movement as the operational baseline. The rebound estimate assumes linear unloading and unchanged contact, excluding plasticity, friction and time effects; four millimetres is not an authorized unloading movement.

steps.titleEn: Unloading rebound mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis

title: 地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證
titleEn: Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths
summary: 地錨試驗的位移同時包含自由段伸長、錨碇段變形與座頭滑移，不能由單一荷重或總位移推定錨固品質。本課把穩定錨碇區、拉力分量、潛變、腐蝕與群體作用逐一拆開，最後以座入損失及完整試驗證據確認地錨的長期功能。
summaryEn: Anchor-test movement combines free-length extension, bond-zone deformation and head slip, so one load or displacement does not establish anchorage quality. The course separates stable anchorage, force components, creep, corrosion and group action, then uses seating losses and complete test evidence to assess long-term anchor function.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設地錨自由長Lf=12 m、鋼面積A=0.001 m²、彈性模數E=195 GPa，在P=600 kN時，理論自由伸長δ=PLf/(EA)=36.92 mm。若張力提高10%至660 kN而其他量固定，δ=40.62 mm，也提高10%。這只對自由段線彈性伸長成立，試驗總位移還含座頭坐入、反力架及錨碇變形。應以獨立基準和卸載回復分離各成分，不能把總位移直接倒算為唯一自由長度，更不能用此算例作現場試驗荷載指令。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: take free length Lf=12 m, steel area A=0.001 m² and modulus E=195 GPa. At P=600 kN, theoretical free extension is δ=PLf/(EA)=36.92 mm. Increasing force by 10% to 660 kN with other inputs fixed gives 40.62 mm, also a 10% increase. This applies only to elastic free-segment extension. Total test movement also includes head seating, reaction-frame motion and bond-zone deformation. Separate these using independent references and unloading recovery; total movement cannot uniquely identify free length, and these assumed numbers do not prescribe a field test load.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自由段伸長的機理與驗證」與「錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Free-length extension mechanism and verification" and "Mean bond shear mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自由段伸長的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由段伸長」如何影響地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free-length extension” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由段讓鋼腱在不與周圍漿體黏結的區間彈性伸長，張力才能有效傳到遠端錨碇區。試驗伸長比預期小，可能代表自由段黏住或有效長度不足；比預期大則可能包含座頭滑移、鋼材模數差異或錨碇段移動。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由段伸長」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The free length allows elastic tendon extension without bond to surrounding grout, transferring tension to the distant anchorage zone. Less extension than expected may indicate unintended bond or inadequate effective length; excessive movement may include head slip, modulus differences or movement within the bond zone. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free-length extension” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、自由長Lf=12 m、E=195 GPa、鋼面積A=0.001 m²，δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, free length Lf=12 m, E=195 GPa and steel area A=0.001 m², δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由段伸長」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free-length extension”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自由段伸長的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 自由段讓鋼腱在不與周圍漿體黏結的區間彈性伸長，張力才能有效傳到遠端錨碇區。試驗伸長比預期小，可能代表自由段黏住或有效長度不足；比預期大則可能包含座頭滑移、鋼材模數差異或錨碇段移動。
knowledge.textEn: The free length allows elastic tendon extension without bond to surrounding grout, transferring tension to the distant anchorage zone. Less extension than expected may indicate unintended bond or inadequate effective length; excessive movement may include head slip, modulus differences or movement within the bond zone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自由段伸長的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Free-length extension mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。
自由段讓鋼腱在不與周圍漿體黏結的區間彈性伸長，張力才能有效傳到遠端錨碇區。
平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。
optionsEn: Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct.
The free length allows elastic tendon extension without bond to surrounding grout, transferring tension to the distant anchorage zone.
Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position.
quiz.explanation: 自由段讓鋼腱在不與周圍漿體黏結的區間彈性伸長，張力才能有效傳到遠端錨碇區。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The free length allows elastic tendon extension without bond to surrounding grout, transferring tension to the distant anchorage zone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自由段伸長的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由段伸長」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free-length extension” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、自由長Lf=12 m、E=195 GPa、鋼面積A=0.001 m²，δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, free length Lf=12 m, E=195 GPa and steel area A=0.001 m², δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立基準量測腱端位移，扣除座頭變形後比較彈性卸載回復量與理論自由伸長。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure tendon-end movement from an independent reference, subtract head deformation and compare elastic unloading recovery with theoretical free extension.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、自由長Lf=12 m、E=195 GPa、鋼面積A=0.001 m²，δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, free length Lf=12 m, E=195 GPa and steel area A=0.001 m², δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自由段伸長的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Free-length extension mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 錨碇段越長就一定能補償它位於滑動土體內的問題。
固定荷重時出現的位移全部都是鋼腱彈性伸長。
原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、自由長Lf=12 m、E=195 GPa、鋼面積A=0.001 m²，δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm。
optionsEn: A longer bond zone always compensates for being located within moving ground.
All movement under constant load is elastic tendon extension.
Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, free length Lf=12 m, E=195 GPa and steel area A=0.001 m², δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、自由長Lf=12 m、E=195 GPa、鋼面積A=0.001 m²，δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, free length Lf=12 m, E=195 GPa and steel area A=0.001 m², δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自由段伸長的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由段伸長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free-length extension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立基準量測腱端位移，扣除座頭變形後比較彈性卸載回復量與理論自由伸長。試驗報告需保留升降載曲線與基準穩定證據；地工設計者確認自由伸長範圍後才接受地錨。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure tendon-end movement from an independent reference, subtract head deformation and compare elastic unloading recovery with theoretical free extension. Retain loading-unloading curves and reference-stability evidence; the geotechnical designer confirms the free-extension range before accepting the anchor. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗報告需保留升降載曲線與基準穩定證據；地工設計者確認自由伸長範圍後才接受地錨。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain loading-unloading curves and reference-stability evidence; the geotechnical designer confirms the free-extension range before accepting the anchor. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：自由段局部黏結可能讓錨力過早傳入滑動土體，拉力讀值合格仍不能提供設計的整體穩定作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unintended free-length bond may transfer force prematurely into moving ground; an acceptable tension reading then fails to provide the intended overall stabilization. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以獨立基準量測腱端位移，扣除座頭變形後比較彈性卸載回復量與理論自由伸長。試驗報告需保留升降載曲線與基準穩定證據；地工設計者確認自由伸長範圍後才接受地錨。
knowledge.textEn: Measure tendon-end movement from an independent reference, subtract head deformation and compare elastic unloading recovery with theoretical free extension. Retain loading-unloading curves and reference-stability evidence; the geotechnical designer confirms the free-extension range before accepting the anchor.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試驗報告需保留升降載曲線與基準穩定證據；地工設計者確認自由伸長範圍後才接受地錨。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。
knowledge.textEn: Retain loading-unloading curves and reference-stability evidence; the geotechnical designer confirms the free-extension range before accepting the anchor. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自由段伸長的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Free-length extension mechanism and verification"?
options: 以獨立基準量測腱端位移，扣除座頭變形後比較彈性卸載回復量與理論自由伸長。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
多支地錨總容量永遠等於每支容量直接相加。
optionsEn: Measure tendon-end movement from an independent reference, subtract head deformation and compare elastic unloading recovery with theoretical free extension.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Total capacity of several anchors always equals the direct sum of individual capacities.
quiz.explanation: 以獨立基準量測腱端位移，扣除座頭變形後比較彈性卸載回復量與理論自由伸長。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure tendon-end movement from an independent reference, subtract head deformation and compare elastic unloading recovery with theoretical free extension. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自由段伸長的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由段伸長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free-length extension” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 自由段局部黏結可能讓錨力過早傳入滑動土體，拉力讀值合格仍不能提供設計的整體穩定作用。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unintended free-length bond may transfer force prematurely into moving ground; an acceptable tension reading then fails to provide the intended overall stabilization. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 自由段局部黏結可能讓錨力過早傳入滑動土體，拉力讀值合格仍不能提供設計的整體穩定作用。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。
knowledge.textEn: Unintended free-length bond may transfer force prematurely into moving ground; an acceptable tension reading then fails to provide the intended overall stabilization. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自由段伸長的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Free-length extension mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
自由段局部黏結可能讓錨力過早傳入滑動土體，拉力讀值合格仍不能提供設計的整體穩定作用。
平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Unintended free-length bond may transfer force prematurely into moving ground.
Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position.
quiz.explanation: 自由段局部黏結可能讓錨力過早傳入滑動土體，拉力讀值合格仍不能提供設計的整體穩定作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unintended free-length bond may transfer force prematurely into moving ground; an acceptable tension reading then fails to provide the intended overall stabilization. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mean bond shear mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「錨碇平均剪應力」如何影響地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean bond shear” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 錨碇段透過鋼腱與漿體、漿體與地層兩個界面把張力傳入穩定土岩。平均剪應力可作尺度檢查，實際沿長度的分布並不均勻，近端先動員後可能逐步滑移；增加錨碇長度也不保證容量一直線性增加。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錨碇平均剪應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bond zone transfers tendon force through tendon-grout and grout-ground interfaces into stable soil or rock. Mean bond shear checks scale, but distribution along the length is nonuniform and may progressively slip after mobilizing near the loaded end. Increasing bond length therefore does not guarantee indefinitely linear capacity growth. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean bond shear” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、漿體直徑D=0.15 m、錨碇長Lb=8 m，平均τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, grout diameter D=0.15 m and bond length Lb=8 m, mean τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「錨碇平均剪應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mean bond shear”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Mean bond shear mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 錨碇段透過鋼腱與漿體、漿體與地層兩個界面把張力傳入穩定土岩。平均剪應力可作尺度檢查，實際沿長度的分布並不均勻，近端先動員後可能逐步滑移；增加錨碇長度也不保證容量一直線性增加。
knowledge.textEn: The bond zone transfers tendon force through tendon-grout and grout-ground interfaces into stable soil or rock. Mean bond shear checks scale, but distribution along the length is nonuniform and may progressively slip after mobilizing near the loaded end.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mean bond shear mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。
試驗位移計只會讀到鋼腱本身的彈性伸長。
錨碇段透過鋼腱與漿體、漿體與地層兩個界面把張力傳入穩定土岩。
optionsEn: Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position.
The test displacement gauge reads only elastic tendon extension.
The bond zone transfers tendon force through tendon-grout and grout-ground interfaces into stable soil or rock.
quiz.explanation: 錨碇段透過鋼腱與漿體、漿體與地層兩個界面把張力傳入穩定土岩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The bond zone transfers tendon force through tendon-grout and grout-ground interfaces into stable soil or rock. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mean bond shear mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨碇平均剪應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mean bond shear” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、漿體直徑D=0.15 m、錨碇長Lb=8 m，平均τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, grout diameter D=0.15 m and bond length Lb=8 m, mean τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：結合鑽孔地層、注漿紀錄及載重試驗，檢查錨碇區是否均在設計地層，觀察持載位移是否穩定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Combine bore geology, grouting records and load tests to confirm the bond zone lies in the intended stratum and assess sustained-load movement stability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、漿體直徑D=0.15 m、錨碇長Lb=8 m，平均τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, grout diameter D=0.15 m and bond length Lb=8 m, mean τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mean bond shear mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、漿體直徑D=0.15 m、錨碇長Lb=8 m，平均τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa。
所有地錨張力都可以直接當成水平擋土支撐力。
鋼腱直徑減少百分之十，面積也只減少百分之十。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, grout diameter D=0.15 m and bond length Lb=8 m, mean τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa.
All anchor tension can be counted directly as horizontal retaining resistance.
Ten-percent tendon diameter loss produces only ten-percent area loss.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、漿體直徑D=0.15 m、錨碇長Lb=8 m，平均τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, grout diameter D=0.15 m and bond length Lb=8 m, mean τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mean bond shear mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨碇平均剪應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mean bond shear” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 結合鑽孔地層、注漿紀錄及載重試驗，檢查錨碇區是否均在設計地層，觀察持載位移是否穩定。設計黏結參數須由代表性試驗支持；地層異常與注漿量偏差應交地工設計者核定錨碇長度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Combine bore geology, grouting records and load tests to confirm the bond zone lies in the intended stratum and assess sustained-load movement stability. Support design bond parameters with representative tests; the geotechnical designer reviews anomalous strata and grout volumes before confirming bond length. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計黏結參數須由代表性試驗支持；地層異常與注漿量偏差應交地工設計者核定錨碇長度。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Support design bond parameters with representative tests; the geotechnical designer reviews anomalous strata and grout volumes before confirming bond length. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：假設直徑大於實際或錨碇區跨入弱層，會高估有效接觸面積，造成漿土界面逐步滑移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overstated diameter or a bond zone crossing weak soil exaggerates effective area and may allow progressive grout-ground slip. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Combine bore geology, grouting records and load tests to confirm the bond zone lies in the intended stratum and assess sustained-load movement stability. Support design bond parameters with representative tests; the geotechnical designer reviews anomalous strata and grout volumes before confirming bond length.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計黏結參數須由代表性試驗支持；地層異常與注漿量偏差應交地工設計者核定錨碇長度。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。
knowledge.textEn: Support design bond parameters with representative tests; the geotechnical designer reviews anomalous strata and grout volumes before confirming bond length. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mean bond shear mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
結合鑽孔地層、注漿紀錄及載重試驗，檢查錨碇區是否均在設計地層，觀察持載位移是否穩定。
