Combine bore geology, grouting records and load tests to confirm the bond zone lies in the intended stratum and assess sustained-load movement stability.
Small seating movement cannot significantly affect a short-free-length anchor.
quiz.explanation: 結合鑽孔地層、注漿紀錄及載重試驗，檢查錨碇區是否均在設計地層，觀察持載位移是否穩定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Combine bore geology, grouting records and load tests to confirm the bond zone lies in the intended stratum and assess sustained-load movement stability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mean bond shear mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨碇平均剪應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mean bond shear” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 假設直徑大於實際或錨碇區跨入弱層，會高估有效接觸面積，造成漿土界面逐步滑移。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overstated diameter or a bond zone crossing weak soil exaggerates effective area and may allow progressive grout-ground slip. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 假設直徑大於實際或錨碇區跨入弱層，會高估有效接觸面積，造成漿土界面逐步滑移。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。
knowledge.textEn: Overstated diameter or a bond zone crossing weak soil exaggerates effective area and may allow progressive grout-ground slip. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mean bond shear mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
試驗位移計只會讀到鋼腱本身的彈性伸長。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The test displacement gauge reads only elastic tendon extension.
Overstated diameter or a bond zone crossing weak soil exaggerates effective area and may allow progressive grout-ground slip.
quiz.explanation: 假設直徑大於實際或錨碇區跨入弱層，會高估有效接觸面積，造成漿土界面逐步滑移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Overstated diameter or a bond zone crossing weak soil exaggerates effective area and may allow progressive grout-ground slip. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「試驗位移組成的機理與驗證」與「穩定區錨碇的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Test-movement components mechanism and verification" and "Anchorage in stable ground mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 試驗位移組成的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Test-movement components mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「試驗位移組成」如何影響地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Test-movement components” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 試驗儀器讀到的是整套載重鏈的變形，包括鋼腱伸長、座頭壓縮、楔片滑移及錨碇區移動。不同成分可能有可逆及不可逆部分，必須透過獨立測點與卸載回復辨別；把總位移全歸給自由段會掩蓋錨固異常。相加模型依賴各位移的方向與共同基準，未量測的錨碇滑移不能預設為零；算例僅示範如何分解量測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「試驗位移組成」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The instrument measures deformation of the full loading chain: tendon extension, head compression, wedge slip and bond-zone movement. These components include reversible and irreversible parts, requiring independent points and unloading recovery for separation. Assigning total movement to the free length alone can conceal anchorage defects. The sum requires consistent directions and datum; unmeasured bond slip cannot be assumed zero, and the exercise only illustrates decomposition of observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Test-movement components” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設自由段伸長δf=36.9 mm、座頭變形δh=3.0 mm且無其他變形，δtotal=δf+δh=39.9 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With free extension δf=36.9 mm, head deformation δh=3.0 mm and no other movement, δtotal=δf+δh=39.9 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「試驗位移計只會讀到鋼腱本身的彈性伸長。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The test displacement gauge reads only elastic tendon extension." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「試驗位移組成」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Test-movement components”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「試驗位移組成的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 試驗位移組成的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Test-movement components mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試驗位移組成」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Test-movement components” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設自由段伸長δf=36.9 mm、座頭變形δh=3.0 mm且無其他變形，δtotal=δf+δh=39.9 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: With free extension δf=36.9 mm, head deformation δh=3.0 mm and no other movement, δtotal=δf+δh=39.9 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別量測腱端、承壓板及獨立基準位移，將可逆回復與殘餘位移分列，確認反力架本身穩定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure tendon end, bearing plate and independent reference separately, separating elastic recovery and residual movement and verifying reaction-frame stability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設自由段伸長δf=36.9 mm、座頭變形δh=3.0 mm且無其他變形，δtotal=δf+δh=39.9 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試驗位移組成的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

多支地錨總容量永遠等於每支容量直接相加。
optionsEn: All movement under constant load is elastic tendon extension.
Original teaching assumptions: With free extension δf=36.9 mm, head deformation δh=3.0 mm and no other movement, δtotal=δf+δh=39.9 mm.
Total capacity of several anchors always equals the direct sum of individual capacities.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: With free extension δf=36.9 mm, head deformation δh=3.0 mm and no other movement, δtotal=δf+δh=39.9 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試驗位移組成的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Test-movement components mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試驗位移組成」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Test-movement components” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別量測腱端、承壓板及獨立基準位移，將可逆回復與殘餘位移分列，確認反力架本身穩定。測點配置圖應與儀器校正一併核准；試驗負責人確認基準未受反力影響後，再把資料交設計者判讀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure tendon end, bearing plate and independent reference separately, separating elastic recovery and residual movement and verifying reaction-frame stability. Approve the measurement layout with calibration; the testing lead confirms that reaction loads do not affect the datum before submitting results for design interpretation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：測點配置圖應與儀器校正一併核准；試驗負責人確認基準未受反力影響後，再把資料交設計者判讀。相加模型依賴各位移的方向與共同基準，未量測的錨碇滑移不能預設為零；算例僅示範如何分解量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Approve the measurement layout with calibration; the testing lead confirms that reaction loads do not affect the datum before submitting results for design interpretation. The sum requires consistent directions and datum; unmeasured bond slip cannot be assumed zero, and the exercise only illustrates decomposition of observations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反力架或量測基準移動會造成假伸長，可能誤判自由段合格或把不穩定錨固當作材料彈性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reaction-frame or datum movement creates false extension and can misclassify unstable anchorage as acceptable free-length or material elasticity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Approve the measurement layout with calibration; the testing lead confirms that reaction loads do not affect the datum before submitting results for design interpretation.

The sum requires consistent directions and datum; unmeasured bond slip cannot be assumed zero, and the exercise only illustrates decomposition of observations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試驗位移組成的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Test-movement components mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
文件完整率達到百分之九十六就等於全部地錨合格。
分別量測腱端、承壓板及獨立基準位移，將可逆回復與殘餘位移分列，確認反力架本身穩定。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Ninety-six-percent documentation coverage means every anchor is acceptable.
Measure tendon end, bearing plate and independent reference separately, separating elastic recovery and residual movement and verifying reaction-frame stability.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure tendon end, bearing plate and independent reference separately, separating elastic recovery and residual movement and verifying reaction-frame stability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 試驗位移組成的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Test-movement components mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試驗位移組成」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Test-movement components” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反力架或量測基準移動會造成假伸長，可能誤判自由段合格或把不穩定錨固當作材料彈性。相加模型依賴各位移的方向與共同基準，未量測的錨碇滑移不能預設為零；算例僅示範如何分解量測。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reaction-frame or datum movement creates false extension and can misclassify unstable anchorage as acceptable free-length or material elasticity. The sum requires consistent directions and datum; unmeasured bond slip cannot be assumed zero, and the exercise only illustrates decomposition of observations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相加模型依賴各位移的方向與共同基準，未量測的錨碇滑移不能預設為零；算例僅示範如何分解量測。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The sum requires consistent directions and datum; unmeasured bond slip cannot be assumed zero, and the exercise only illustrates decomposition of observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「試驗位移計只會讀到鋼腱本身的彈性伸長。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The test displacement gauge reads only elastic tendon extension." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反力架或量測基準移動會造成假伸長，可能誤判自由段合格或把不穩定錨固當作材料彈性。相加模型依賴各位移的方向與共同基準，未量測的錨碇滑移不能預設為零；算例僅示範如何分解量測。

The sum requires consistent directions and datum; unmeasured bond slip cannot be assumed zero, and the exercise only illustrates decomposition of observations.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試驗位移組成的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Test-movement components mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 反力架或量測基準移動會造成假伸長，可能誤判自由段合格或把不穩定錨固當作材料彈性。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A longer bond zone always compensates for being located within moving ground.

quiz.explanationEn: Reaction-frame or datum movement creates false extension and can misclassify unstable anchorage as acceptable free-length or material elasticity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 穩定區錨碇的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Anchorage in stable ground mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「穩定區錨碇」如何影響地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anchorage in stable ground” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地錨必須把力傳過潛在滑動面，錨碇區若仍在可移動土體內，只會拉緊同一塊不穩定土。穩定區位置依地下水、開挖及地震情境而變，單一最短距離並不足夠；應在三維剖面上核對自由段與錨碇段相對各失穩面的位置。六米只是幾何位於滑面後的長度，不是已證明的有效黏結長；需確認該段材料、注漿完整性及群體穩定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「穩定區錨碇」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Anchors must transfer force beyond potential slip surfaces. A bond zone inside moving ground merely tightens the same unstable mass. Stable-zone location changes with groundwater, excavation and seismic cases, so one minimum distance is insufficient; check free and bond lengths against relevant three-dimensional failure surfaces. Six metres is geometric length beyond the surface, not demonstrated effective bond length; material, grout continuity and group stability still require confirmation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Anchorage in stable ground” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設沿錨軸滑面交點距頭部16 m、錨碇末端22 m，滑面後長度L=22−16=6 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: If a slip surface intersects the anchor axis 16 m from the head and the bond end is at 22 m, length beyond the surface is 6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錨碇段越長就一定能補償它位於滑動土體內的問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A longer bond zone always compensates for being located within moving ground." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「穩定區錨碇」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Anchorage in stable ground”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 穩定區錨碇的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Anchorage in stable ground mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 地錨必須把力傳過潛在滑動面，錨碇區若仍在可移動土體內，只會拉緊同一塊不穩定土。穩定區位置依地下水、開挖及地震情境而變，單一最短距離並不足夠；應在三維剖面上核對自由段與錨碇段相對各失穩面的位置。
knowledge.textEn: Anchors must transfer force beyond potential slip surfaces. A bond zone inside moving ground merely tightens the same unstable mass.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：錨碇段越長就一定能補償它位於滑動土體內的問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A longer bond zone always compensates for being located within moving ground. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「穩定區錨碇的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Anchorage in stable ground mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 錨碇段越長就一定能補償它位於滑動土體內的問題。
地錨必須把力傳過潛在滑動面，錨碇區若仍在可移動土體內，只會拉緊同一塊不穩定土。
所有地錨張力都可以直接當成水平擋土支撐力。
optionsEn: A longer bond zone always compensates for being located within moving ground.
Anchors must transfer force beyond potential slip surfaces.
All anchor tension can be counted directly as horizontal retaining resistance.
quiz.explanation: 地錨必須把力傳過潛在滑動面，錨碇區若仍在可移動土體內，只會拉緊同一塊不穩定土。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Anchors must transfer force beyond potential slip surfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 穩定區錨碇的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Anchorage in stable ground mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「穩定區錨碇」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anchorage in stable ground” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設沿錨軸滑面交點距頭部16 m、錨碇末端22 m，滑面後長度L=22−16=6 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: If a slip surface intersects the anchor axis 16 m from the head and the bond end is at 22 m, length beyond the surface is 6 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以鑽孔及地層模型確認滑面位置，檢查不利水位與施工階段下的變化，將錨碇段逐支投影。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm failure-surface position using borings and the ground model, assess adverse water levels and construction stages, and project each bond zone individually.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設沿錨軸滑面交點距頭部16 m、錨碇末端22 m，滑面後長度L=22−16=6 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: If a slip surface intersects the anchor axis 16 m from the head and the bond end is at 22 m, length beyond the surface is 6 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「穩定區錨碇的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

座入量很小，所以不可能顯著影響短自由段地錨。

optionsEn: Ten-percent tendon diameter loss produces only ten-percent area loss.
Small seating movement cannot significantly affect a short-free-length anchor.
Original teaching assumptions: If a slip surface intersects the anchor axis 16 m from the head and the bond end is at 22 m, length beyond the surface is 6 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設沿錨軸滑面交點距頭部16 m、錨碇末端22 m，滑面後長度L=22−16=6 m。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 穩定區錨碇的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Anchorage in stable ground mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「穩定區錨碇」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anchorage in stable ground” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以鑽孔及地層模型確認滑面位置，檢查不利水位與施工階段下的變化，將錨碇段逐支投影。地錨圖應標出主要及敏感度滑面；地下水或開挖深度變更時，由地工設計者重新核對穩定區。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm failure-surface position using borings and the ground model, assess adverse water levels and construction stages, and project each bond zone individually. Anchor drawings show principal and sensitivity slip surfaces; groundwater or excavation-depth changes require geotechnical review of stable anchorage zones. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：地錨圖應標出主要及敏感度滑面；地下水或開挖深度變更時，由地工設計者重新核對穩定區。六米只是幾何位於滑面後的長度，不是已證明的有效黏結長；需確認該段材料、注漿完整性及群體穩定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Anchor drawings show principal and sensitivity slip surfaces; groundwater or excavation-depth changes require geotechnical review of stable anchorage zones. Six metres is geometric length beyond the surface, not demonstrated effective bond length; material, grout continuity and group stability still require confirmation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：採用錯誤滑面位置會把有效錨長算得過長，整體滑動時地錨可能與擋土體一起位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incorrect slip surface overstates effective anchorage length, allowing anchors and the retained mass to move together during global instability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

steps.title: 穩定區錨碇的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Anchorage in stable ground mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「穩定區錨碇」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Anchorage in stable ground” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 採用錯誤滑面位置會把有效錨長算得過長，整體滑動時地錨可能與擋土體一起位移。六米只是幾何位於滑面後的長度，不是已證明的有效黏結長；需確認該段材料、注漿完整性及群體穩定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect slip surface overstates effective anchorage length, allowing anchors and the retained mass to move together during global instability. Six metres is geometric length beyond the surface, not demonstrated effective bond length; material, grout continuity and group stability still require confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：六米只是幾何位於滑面後的長度，不是已證明的有效黏結長；需確認該段材料、注漿完整性及群體穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Six metres is geometric length beyond the surface, not demonstrated effective bond length; material, grout continuity and group stability still require confirmation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錨碇段越長就一定能補償它位於滑動土體內的問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A longer bond zone always compensates for being located within moving ground." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 採用錯誤滑面位置會把有效錨長算得過長，整體滑動時地錨可能與擋土體一起位移。六米只是幾何位於滑面後的長度，不是已證明的有效黏結長；需確認該段材料、注漿完整性及群體穩定。

Six metres is geometric length beyond the surface, not demonstrated effective bond length; material, grout continuity and group stability still require confirmation.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「穩定區錨碇的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Anchorage in stable ground mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
採用錯誤滑面位置會把有效錨長算得過長，整體滑動時地錨可能與擋土體一起位移。
所有地錨張力都可以直接當成水平擋土支撐力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An incorrect slip surface overstates effective anchorage length, allowing anchors and the retained mass to move together during global instability.
All anchor tension can be counted directly as horizontal retaining resistance.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「傾角分力的機理與驗證」與「持載潛變的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Inclination components mechanism and verification" and "Sustained-load creep mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 傾角分力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Inclination components mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「傾角分力」如何影響地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inclination components” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 斜地錨同時提供水平及垂直分力，水平分力抵抗擋土需求，垂直分力則進入牆體與基礎。角度增加可能增加向下荷載而減少水平效率，錨頭局部承壓及牆趾承載因此需要一起評估，不能只看鋼腱拉力大小。分力分解只處理力方向，未評估錨頭偏心或牆體變形相容；兩個分量必須放入同一結構自由體圖。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「傾角分力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An inclined anchor supplies horizontal and vertical components. The horizontal component resists retaining demand, while the vertical component enters the wall and foundation. Steeper inclination can increase downward loading while reducing horizontal efficiency, requiring combined assessment of head bearing and toe capacity rather than tendon force alone. Component resolution addresses direction only, not head eccentricity or wall compatibility; both components must enter the same structural free body. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inclination components” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：張力T=600 kN、對水平夾角θ=25°，H=Tcosθ=544 kN，V=Tsinθ=254 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For tension T=600 kN at θ=25° below horizontal, H=Tcosθ=544 kN and V=Tsinθ=254 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有地錨張力都可以直接當成水平擋土支撐力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All anchor tension can be counted directly as horizontal retaining resistance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「傾角分力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Inclination components”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 傾角分力的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 斜地錨同時提供水平及垂直分力，水平分力抵抗擋土需求，垂直分力則進入牆體與基礎。角度增加可能增加向下荷載而減少水平效率，錨頭局部承壓及牆趾承載因此需要一起評估，不能只看鋼腱拉力大小。
knowledge.textEn: An inclined anchor supplies horizontal and vertical components. The horizontal component resists retaining demand, while the vertical component enters the wall and foundation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有地錨張力都可以直接當成水平擋土支撐力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All anchor tension can be counted directly as horizontal retaining resistance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「傾角分力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inclination components mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 所有地錨張力都可以直接當成水平擋土支撐力。
固定荷重時出現的位移全部都是鋼腱彈性伸長。
斜地錨同時提供水平及垂直分力，水平分力抵抗擋土需求，垂直分力則進入牆體與基礎。
optionsEn: All anchor tension can be counted directly as horizontal retaining resistance.
All movement under constant load is elastic tendon extension.
An inclined anchor supplies horizontal and vertical components.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「傾角分力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：張力T=600 kN、對水平夾角θ=25°，H=Tcosθ=544 kN，V=Tsinθ=254 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For tension T=600 kN at θ=25° below horizontal, H=Tcosθ=544 kN and V=Tsinθ=254 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測實際錨頭方向與鑽孔傾角，核對牆體承壓細部及基礎垂直反力，檢查是否與模型一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure actual head direction and bore inclination, checking wall-bearing details and foundation vertical reactions against the model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For tension T=600 kN at θ=25° below horizontal, H=Tcosθ=544 kN and V=Tsinθ=254 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「傾角分力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Inclination components mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：張力T=600 kN、對水平夾角θ=25°，H=Tcosθ=544 kN，V=Tsinθ=254 kN。
多支地錨總容量永遠等於每支容量直接相加。
文件完整率達到百分之九十六就等於全部地錨合格。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For tension T=600 kN at θ=25° below horizontal, H=Tcosθ=544 kN and V=Tsinθ=254 kN.
Total capacity of several anchors always equals the direct sum of individual capacities.
Ninety-six-percent documentation coverage means every anchor is acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：張力T=600 kN、對水平夾角θ=25°，H=Tcosθ=544 kN，V=Tsinθ=254 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For tension T=600 kN at θ=25° below horizontal, H=Tcosθ=544 kN and V=Tsinθ=254 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 傾角分力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inclination components mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「傾角分力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inclination components” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測實際錨頭方向與鑽孔傾角，核對牆體承壓細部及基礎垂直反力，檢查是否與模型一致。任何錨角變更都須同步更新水平效率與垂直荷載；牆體及地工設計者共同確認後才核准。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure actual head direction and bore inclination, checking wall-bearing details and foundation vertical reactions against the model. Every angle change updates horizontal efficiency and vertical loading; wall and geotechnical designers jointly confirm the revised arrangement before approval. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：任何錨角變更都須同步更新水平效率與垂直荷載；牆體及地工設計者共同確認後才核准。分力分解只處理力方向，未評估錨頭偏心或牆體變形相容；兩個分量必須放入同一結構自由體圖。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Every angle change updates horizontal efficiency and vertical loading; wall and geotechnical designers jointly confirm the revised arrangement before approval. Component resolution addresses direction only, not head eccentricity or wall compatibility; both components must enter the same structural free body.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略垂直分力會低估牆體軸力或基礎需求，角度誤差也可能讓錨頭承壓產生偏心。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting the vertical component understates wall axial or foundation demand, and angular error can introduce eccentric head bearing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「傾角分力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inclination components mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
量測實際錨頭方向與鑽孔傾角，核對牆體承壓細部及基礎垂直反力，檢查是否與模型一致。
平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。

Measure actual head direction and bore inclination, checking wall-bearing details and foundation vertical reactions against the model.

steps.title: 傾角分力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inclination components mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「傾角分力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inclination components” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略垂直分力會低估牆體軸力或基礎需求，角度誤差也可能讓錨頭承壓產生偏心。分力分解只處理力方向，未評估錨頭偏心或牆體變形相容；兩個分量必須放入同一結構自由體圖。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting the vertical component understates wall axial or foundation demand, and angular error can introduce eccentric head bearing. Component resolution addresses direction only, not head eccentricity or wall compatibility; both components must enter the same structural free body. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分力分解只處理力方向，未評估錨頭偏心或牆體變形相容；兩個分量必須放入同一結構自由體圖。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Component resolution addresses direction only, not head eccentricity or wall compatibility; both components must enter the same structural free body.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有地錨張力都可以直接當成水平擋土支撐力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All anchor tension can be counted directly as horizontal retaining resistance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略垂直分力會低估牆體軸力或基礎需求，角度誤差也可能讓錨頭承壓產生偏心。分力分解只處理力方向，未評估錨頭偏心或牆體變形相容；兩個分量必須放入同一結構自由體圖。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting the vertical component understates wall axial or foundation demand, and angular error can introduce eccentric head bearing. Component resolution addresses direction only, not head eccentricity or wall compatibility; both components must enter the same structural free body.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「傾角分力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inclination components mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
固定荷重時出現的位移全部都是鋼腱彈性伸長。
忽略垂直分力會低估牆體軸力或基礎需求，角度誤差也可能讓錨頭承壓產生偏心。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
All movement under constant load is elastic tendon extension.
Omitting the vertical component understates wall axial or foundation demand, and angular error can introduce eccentric head bearing.
quiz.explanation: 忽略垂直分力會低估牆體軸力或基礎需求，角度誤差也可能讓錨頭承壓產生偏心。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting the vertical component understates wall axial or foundation demand, and angular error can introduce eccentric head bearing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 持載潛變的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sustained-load creep mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「持載潛變」如何影響地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sustained-load creep” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地錨在固定荷載下仍可能因土體潛變、漿土界面滑移或鋼腱鬆弛而產生位移。位移對時間對數的斜率可用於比較持載階段，但不同荷載與時間區間不能混用；量測須排除溫度及反力架變形的影響。對數斜率只適用於指定持載區間，不能直接外推多年壽命；此數值不是任何規範的通用合格上限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「持載潛變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Anchors can move under constant load through soil creep, interface slip and tendon relaxation. Displacement versus logarithmic time helps compare hold stages, but different load levels and time intervals are not interchangeable. Temperature effects and reaction-frame movement must be separated before interpreting the trend as anchorage creep. The logarithmic slope applies to the specified hold interval and cannot directly predict years of life; this number is not a universal code acceptance limit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sustained-load creep” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設t₁=1 min時δ₁=1.2 mm、t₂=10 min時δ₂=2.1 mm，斜率α=(δ₂−δ₁)/log₁₀(t₂/t₁)=0.9 mm/對數週期。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For δ₁=1.2 mm at t₁=1 min and δ₂=2.1 mm at t₂=10 min, α=(δ₂−δ₁)/log₁₀(t₂/t₁)=0.9 mm per logarithmic cycle.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「固定荷重時出現的位移全部都是鋼腱彈性伸長。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All movement under constant load is elastic tendon extension." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「持載潛變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sustained-load creep”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 持載潛變的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 地錨在固定荷載下仍可能因土體潛變、漿土界面滑移或鋼腱鬆弛而產生位移。位移對時間對數的斜率可用於比較持載階段，但不同荷載與時間區間不能混用；量測須排除溫度及反力架變形的影響。
knowledge.textEn: Anchors can move under constant load through soil creep, interface slip and tendon relaxation. Displacement versus logarithmic time helps compare hold stages, but different load levels and time intervals are not interchangeable.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：固定荷重時出現的位移全部都是鋼腱彈性伸長。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All movement under constant load is elastic tendon extension. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「持載潛變的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sustained-load creep mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 地錨在固定荷載下仍可能因土體潛變、漿土界面滑移或鋼腱鬆弛而產生位移。
固定荷重時出現的位移全部都是鋼腱彈性伸長。
鋼腱直徑減少百分之十，面積也只減少百分之十。
optionsEn: Anchors can move under constant load through soil creep, interface slip and tendon relaxation.
All movement under constant load is elastic tendon extension.
Ten-percent tendon diameter loss produces only ten-percent area loss.

quiz.question: 依「持載潛變的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sustained-load creep mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 座入量很小，所以不可能顯著影響短自由段地錨。
原創教學假設：假設t₁=1 min時δ₁=1.2 mm、t₂=10 min時δ₂=2.1 mm，斜率α=(δ₂−δ₁)/log₁₀(t₂/t₁)=0.9 mm/對數週期。
地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。
optionsEn: Small seating movement cannot significantly affect a short-free-length anchor.
Original teaching assumptions: For δ₁=1.2 mm at t₁=1 min and δ₂=2.1 mm at t₂=10 min, α=(δ₂−δ₁)/log₁₀(t₂/t₁)=0.9 mm per logarithmic cycle.
Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設t₁=1 min時δ₁=1.2 mm、t₂=10 min時δ₂=2.1 mm，斜率α=(δ₂−δ₁)/log₁₀(t₂/t₁)=0.9 mm/對數週期。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For δ₁=1.2 mm at t₁=1 min and δ₂=2.1 mm at t₂=10 min, α=(δ₂−δ₁)/log₁₀(t₂/t₁)=0.9 mm per logarithmic cycle. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 持載潛變的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sustained-load creep mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「持載潛變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sustained-load creep” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保持核定試驗荷載並精確記時，用獨立位移基準及溫度資料檢查持載趨勢，避免中途重設零點。潛變判據應引用核定試驗程序的荷載與時距；試驗負責人將完整時間序列交地工設計者判定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Maintain the approved test load and precise timing, using an independent movement reference and temperature records to assess hold trends without rezeroing mid-stage. Creep criteria reference the approved test load and timing; the testing lead supplies the full time series for geotechnical interpretation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：潛變判據應引用核定試驗程序的荷載與時距；試驗負責人將完整時間序列交地工設計者判定。對數斜率只適用於指定持載區間，不能直接外推多年壽命；此數值不是任何規範的通用合格上限。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Creep criteria reference the approved test load and timing; the testing lead supplies the full time series for geotechnical interpretation. The logarithmic slope applies to the specified hold interval and cannot directly predict years of life; this number is not a universal code acceptance limit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：位移持續加速可能表示黏結區逐步破壞；若只讀起終點而漏掉中間資料，會錯過不穩定變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accelerating movement may indicate progressive bond failure; reading only endpoints misses unstable behaviour within the hold period. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 持載潛變的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sustained-load creep mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「持載潛變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sustained-load creep” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 位移持續加速可能表示黏結區逐步破壞；若只讀起終點而漏掉中間資料，會錯過不穩定變化。對數斜率只適用於指定持載區間，不能直接外推多年壽命；此數值不是任何規範的通用合格上限。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accelerating movement may indicate progressive bond failure; reading only endpoints misses unstable behaviour within the hold period. The logarithmic slope applies to the specified hold interval and cannot directly predict years of life; this number is not a universal code acceptance limit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對數斜率只適用於指定持載區間，不能直接外推多年壽命；此數值不是任何規範的通用合格上限。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The logarithmic slope applies to the specified hold interval and cannot directly predict years of life; this number is not a universal code acceptance limit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「固定荷重時出現的位移全部都是鋼腱彈性伸長。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All movement under constant load is elastic tendon extension." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

The logarithmic slope applies to the specified hold interval and cannot directly predict years of life; this number is not a universal code acceptance limit.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「持載潛變的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sustained-load creep mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Ten-percent tendon diameter loss produces only ten-percent area loss.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「腐蝕截面損失的機理與驗證」與「地錨群體作用的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrosion area loss mechanism and verification" and "Anchor-group interaction mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 腐蝕截面損失的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrosion area loss mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「腐蝕截面損失」如何影響地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corrosion area loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地錨鋼腱承受長期拉力，腐蝕不只減少截面，也可能因點蝕形成應力集中。圓鋼直徑均勻減少的平方關係可說明面積敏感度，真實多股鋼絞線卻常呈不均勻損傷，防蝕套管、錨頭密封與排水因此需要連續管理。面積比不是殘餘拉力能力保證，點蝕、應力腐蝕與鋼絞線斷絲可能更不利；不可僅按平均直徑折減。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「腐蝕截面損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tendons carry sustained tension, and corrosion both reduces area and introduces pitting stress concentrations. The squared relation for uniform circular diameter loss illustrates area sensitivity, but multistrand tendons often deteriorate nonuniformly. Sheathing, head sealing and drainage therefore require continuity of protection and long-term management. Area ratio does not guarantee residual tensile resistance; pitting, stress corrosion and broken wires may be more adverse than a mean-diameter reduction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corrosion area loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設圓鋼直徑剩原值90%，面積比A₂/A₁=(0.90)²=0.81，均勻面積損失19%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: If a circular bar retains 90% of original diameter, A₂/A₁=(0.90)²=0.81, representing 19% uniform area loss.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼腱直徑減少百分之十，面積也只減少百分之十。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ten-percent tendon diameter loss produces only ten-percent area loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「腐蝕截面損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Corrosion area loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 腐蝕截面損失的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Corrosion area loss mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 地錨鋼腱承受長期拉力，腐蝕不只減少截面，也可能因點蝕形成應力集中。圓鋼直徑均勻減少的平方關係可說明面積敏感度，真實多股鋼絞線卻常呈不均勻損傷，防蝕套管、錨頭密封與排水因此需要連續管理。
knowledge.textEn: Tendons carry sustained tension, and corrosion both reduces area and introduces pitting stress concentrations. The squared relation for uniform circular diameter loss illustrates area sensitivity, but multistrand tendons often deteriorate nonuniformly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼腱直徑減少百分之十，面積也只減少百分之十。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Ten-percent tendon diameter loss produces only ten-percent area loss. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「腐蝕截面損失的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corrosion area loss mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 鋼腱直徑減少百分之十，面積也只減少百分之十。
地錨鋼腱承受長期拉力，腐蝕不只減少截面，也可能因點蝕形成應力集中。
多支地錨總容量永遠等於每支容量直接相加。
optionsEn: Ten-percent tendon diameter loss produces only ten-percent area loss.
Tendons carry sustained tension, and corrosion both reduces area and introduces pitting stress concentrations.
Total capacity of several anchors always equals the direct sum of individual capacities.
quiz.explanation: 地錨鋼腱承受長期拉力，腐蝕不只減少截面，也可能因點蝕形成應力集中。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tendons carry sustained tension, and corrosion both reduces area and introduces pitting stress concentrations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 腐蝕截面損失的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corrosion area loss mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「腐蝕截面損失」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Corrosion area loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設圓鋼直徑剩原值90%，面積比A₂/A₁=(0.90)²=0.81，均勻面積損失19%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: If a circular bar retains 90% of original diameter, A₂/A₁=(0.90)²=0.81, representing 19% uniform area loss. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查可接近錨頭的密封與積水，依核定方法評估鋼材狀態，將局部點蝕與均勻損失分開紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect accessible head seals and standing water, assess steel condition using approved methods, and record localized pitting separately from uniform loss.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: If a circular bar retains 90% of original diameter, A₂/A₁=(0.90)²=0.81, representing 19% uniform area loss. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Corrosion area loss mechanism and verification", which statement holds?

steps.title: 腐蝕截面損失的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Corrosion area loss mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「腐蝕截面損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Corrosion area loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查可接近錨頭的密封與積水，依核定方法評估鋼材狀態，將局部點蝕與均勻損失分開紀錄。交接應列防蝕系統、可檢查部位與異常處置責任；發現密封失效時由地錨設計者核定檢測及修復範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect accessible head seals and standing water, assess steel condition using approved methods, and record localized pitting separately from uniform loss. Handover identifies protection systems, inspectable areas and response responsibility; the anchor designer determines testing and repair when sealing fails. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接應列防蝕系統、可檢查部位與異常處置責任；發現密封失效時由地錨設計者核定檢測及修復範圍。面積比不是殘餘拉力能力保證，點蝕、應力腐蝕與鋼絞線斷絲可能更不利；不可僅按平均直徑折減。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover identifies protection systems, inspectable areas and response responsibility; the anchor designer determines testing and repair when sealing fails. Area ratio does not guarantee residual tensile resistance; pitting, stress corrosion and broken wires may be more adverse than a mean-diameter reduction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：密封破損可讓水沿套管進入，外部錨頭外觀良好仍可能有隱藏腐蝕與拉力能力下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A broken seal can admit water along the sheath; a sound-looking external head may coexist with concealed corrosion and reduced tension capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查可接近錨頭的密封與積水，依核定方法評估鋼材狀態，將局部點蝕與均勻損失分開紀錄。交接應列防蝕系統、可檢查部位與異常處置責任；發現密封失效時由地錨設計者核定檢測及修復範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect accessible head seals and standing water, assess steel condition using approved methods, and record localized pitting separately from uniform loss. Handover identifies protection systems, inspectable areas and response responsibility; the anchor designer determines testing and repair when sealing fails.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接應列防蝕系統、可檢查部位與異常處置責任；發現密封失效時由地錨設計者核定檢測及修復範圍。面積比不是殘餘拉力能力保證，點蝕、應力腐蝕與鋼絞線斷絲可能更不利；不可僅按平均直徑折減。
knowledge.textEn: Handover identifies protection systems, inspectable areas and response responsibility; the anchor designer determines testing and repair when sealing fails. Area ratio does not guarantee residual tensile resistance; pitting, stress corrosion and broken wires may be more adverse than a mean-diameter reduction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「腐蝕截面損失的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Corrosion area loss mechanism and verification"?
options: 檢查可接近錨頭的密封與積水，依核定方法評估鋼材狀態，將局部點蝕與均勻損失分開紀錄。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
錨碇段越長就一定能補償它位於滑動土體內的問題。
optionsEn: Inspect accessible head seals and standing water, assess steel condition using approved methods, and record localized pitting separately from uniform loss.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A longer bond zone always compensates for being located within moving ground.
quiz.explanation: 檢查可接近錨頭的密封與積水，依核定方法評估鋼材狀態，將局部點蝕與均勻損失分開紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect accessible head seals and standing water, assess steel condition using approved methods, and record localized pitting separately from uniform loss. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 腐蝕截面損失的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Corrosion area loss mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「腐蝕截面損失」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Corrosion area loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 密封破損可讓水沿套管進入，外部錨頭外觀良好仍可能有隱藏腐蝕與拉力能力下降。面積比不是殘餘拉力能力保證，點蝕、應力腐蝕與鋼絞線斷絲可能更不利；不可僅按平均直徑折減。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A broken seal can admit water along the sheath; a sound-looking external head may coexist with concealed corrosion and reduced tension capacity. Area ratio does not guarantee residual tensile resistance; pitting, stress corrosion and broken wires may be more adverse than a mean-diameter reduction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：面積比不是殘餘拉力能力保證，點蝕、應力腐蝕與鋼絞線斷絲可能更不利；不可僅按平均直徑折減。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Area ratio does not guarantee residual tensile resistance; pitting, stress corrosion and broken wires may be more adverse than a mean-diameter reduction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼腱直徑減少百分之十，面積也只減少百分之十。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ten-percent tendon diameter loss produces only ten-percent area loss." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 密封破損可讓水沿套管進入，外部錨頭外觀良好仍可能有隱藏腐蝕與拉力能力下降。面積比不是殘餘拉力能力保證，點蝕、應力腐蝕與鋼絞線斷絲可能更不利；不可僅按平均直徑折減。
knowledge.textEn: A broken seal can admit water along the sheath; a sound-looking external head may coexist with concealed corrosion and reduced tension capacity. Area ratio does not guarantee residual tensile resistance; pitting, stress corrosion and broken wires may be more adverse than a mean-diameter reduction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「腐蝕截面損失的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Corrosion area loss mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
密封破損可讓水沿套管進入，外部錨頭外觀良好仍可能有隱藏腐蝕與拉力能力下降。
多支地錨總容量永遠等於每支容量直接相加。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A broken seal can admit water along the sheath; a sound-looking external head may coexist with concealed corrosion and reduced tension capacity.
Total capacity of several anchors always equals the direct sum of individual capacities.
quiz.explanation: 密封破損可讓水沿套管進入，外部錨頭外觀良好仍可能有隱藏腐蝕與拉力能力下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A broken seal can admit water along the sheath; a sound-looking external head may coexist with concealed corrosion and reduced tension capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 地錨群體作用的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Anchor-group interaction mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地錨群體作用」如何影響地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anchor-group interaction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多支地錨的錨碇區若互相重疊，地層應力與潛在破壞面會互相影響，單支試驗容量不能直接乘支數。群體效率可作簡化比較，但實際效果取決於間距、方向、層位與載入順序，必須與整體滑動及土體變形共同檢查。效率係數是本例假設，不是固定材料性質；群體穩定不能只靠一個折減值取代失穩面與變形分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地錨群體作用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Overlapping anchorage zones interact through ground stress and potential failure surfaces, so single-anchor test capacity cannot automatically be multiplied by anchor count. Group efficiency gives a simplified comparison, but spacing, orientation, strata and loading sequence govern the actual effect, requiring checks of overall movement and ground deformation. The efficiency is assumed for this exercise rather than a fixed material property; one reduction factor cannot replace group failure-surface and deformation analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Anchor-group interaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設4支各R=600 kN、合成群體效率η=0.8，Rgroup=η×4R=1920 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For four anchors each with R=600 kN and assumed group efficiency η=0.8, Rgroup=η×4R=1920 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多支地錨總容量永遠等於每支容量直接相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total capacity of several anchors always equals the direct sum of individual capacities." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地錨群體作用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Anchor-group interaction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地錨群體作用的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 多支地錨的錨碇區若互相重疊，地層應力與潛在破壞面會互相影響，單支試驗容量不能直接乘支數。群體效率可作簡化比較，但實際效果取決於間距、方向、層位與載入順序，必須與整體滑動及土體變形共同檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Overlapping anchorage zones interact through ground stress and potential failure surfaces, so single-anchor test capacity cannot automatically be multiplied by anchor count. Group efficiency gives a simplified comparison, but spacing, orientation, strata and loading sequence govern the actual effect, requiring checks of overall movement and ground deformation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：多支地錨總容量永遠等於每支容量直接相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total capacity of several anchors always equals the direct sum of individual capacities. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地錨群體作用的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Anchor-group interaction mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 多支地錨總容量永遠等於每支容量直接相加。
座入量很小，所以不可能顯著影響短自由段地錨。
多支地錨的錨碇區若互相重疊，地層應力與潛在破壞面會互相影響，單支試驗容量不能直接乘支數。
optionsEn: Total capacity of several anchors always equals the direct sum of individual capacities.
Small seating movement cannot significantly affect a short-free-length anchor.
Overlapping anchorage zones interact through ground stress and potential failure surfaces, so single-anchor test capacity cannot automatically be multiplied by anchor count.
quiz.explanation: 多支地錨的錨碇區若互相重疊，地層應力與潛在破壞面會互相影響，單支試驗容量不能直接乘支數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Overlapping anchorage zones interact through ground stress and potential failure surfaces, so single-anchor test capacity cannot automatically be multiplied by anchor count. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地錨群體作用的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Anchor-group interaction mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地錨群體作用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anchor-group interaction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設4支各R=600 kN、合成群體效率η=0.8，Rgroup=η×4R=1920 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For four anchors each with R=600 kN and assumed group efficiency η=0.8, Rgroup=η×4R=1920 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維圖上檢查錨碇區間距，對比不同錨的試驗與監測反應，核對共同滑面及鄰地權界線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check bond-zone spacing in three dimensions, compare test and monitoring responses between anchors, and assess common slip surfaces and property boundaries.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設4支各R=600 kN、合成群體效率η=0.8，Rgroup=η×4R=1920 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For four anchors each with R=600 kN and assumed group efficiency η=0.8, Rgroup=η×4R=1920 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地錨群體作用的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Anchor-group interaction mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設4支各R=600 kN、合成群體效率η=0.8，Rgroup=η×4R=1920 kN。
地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。
試驗位移計只會讀到鋼腱本身的彈性伸長。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For four anchors each with R=600 kN and assumed group efficiency η=0.8, Rgroup=η×4R=1920 kN.
Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct.
The test displacement gauge reads only elastic tendon extension.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設4支各R=600 kN、合成群體效率η=0.8，Rgroup=η×4R=1920 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For four anchors each with R=600 kN and assumed group efficiency η=0.8, Rgroup=η×4R=1920 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地錨群體作用的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Anchor-group interaction mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地錨群體作用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anchor-group interaction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在三維圖上檢查錨碇區間距，對比不同錨的試驗與監測反應，核對共同滑面及鄰地權界線。群體效率與錨距應有分析或試驗依據；新增地錨前由地工設計者重審共同破壞機制及地下界面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check bond-zone spacing in three dimensions, compare test and monitoring responses between anchors, and assess common slip surfaces and property boundaries. Support group efficiency and spacing with analysis or tests; the geotechnical designer reviews common failure mechanisms and underground interfaces before anchors are added. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：群體效率與錨距應有分析或試驗依據；新增地錨前由地工設計者重審共同破壞機制及地下界面。效率係數是本例假設，不是固定材料性質；群體穩定不能只靠一個折減值取代失穩面與變形分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Support group efficiency and spacing with analysis or tests; the geotechnical designer reviews common failure mechanisms and underground interfaces before anchors are added. The efficiency is assumed for this exercise rather than a fixed material property; one reduction factor cannot replace group failure-surface and deformation analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：群體錨碇區形成共同破壞體時，單支都曾試驗合格仍可能整體滑動，力分配也會變得不均。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A common failure mass can move despite individual test passes, and interaction can produce unequal force distribution among anchors. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

Support group efficiency and spacing with analysis or tests; the geotechnical designer reviews common failure mechanisms and underground interfaces before anchors are added.

steps.title: 地錨群體作用的機理與驗證：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地錨群體作用」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Anchor-group interaction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 群體錨碇區形成共同破壞體時，單支都曾試驗合格仍可能整體滑動，力分配也會變得不均。效率係數是本例假設，不是固定材料性質；群體穩定不能只靠一個折減值取代失穩面與變形分析。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

The efficiency is assumed for this exercise rather than a fixed material property; one reduction factor cannot replace group failure-surface and deformation analysis. quiz.question: 在「地錨群體作用的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Small seating movement cannot significantly affect a short-free-length anchor.
A common failure mass can move despite individual test passes, and interaction can produce unequal force distribution among anchors.
