quiz.explanationEn: A common failure mass can move despite individual test passes, and interaction can produce unequal force distribution among anchors. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「錨頭座入損失的機理與驗證」與「試驗文件覆蓋的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Head-seating loss mechanism and verification" and "Test-evidence coverage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 錨頭座入損失的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Head-seating loss mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「錨頭座入損失」如何影響地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head-seating loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 錨頭楔片座入或承壓構件壓縮會縮短鋼腱有效伸長，造成鎖定力下降。自由段越短，同樣座入量引起的力損失越大，因為軸向剛度較高；施加峰值因此需要與鎖定後實際保留力分開記錄。線彈性式未含摩擦與錨碇段變形，並假設座入全轉成自由段回縮；實測保留力仍是必要的獨立證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錨頭座入損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wedge seating or bearing-component compression reduces tendon extension and retained force. For the same seating movement, a shorter free length loses more force because axial stiffness is higher. The applied peak must therefore be recorded separately from the force actually retained after lock-off and verified against the intended load-transfer state. The elastic expression excludes friction and bond deformation and assumes all seating shortens the free segment; measured retained force remains necessary independent evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Head-seating loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：E=195 GPa、A=0.001 m²、自由長Lf=12 m、座入s=0.002 m，ΔP=EAs/Lf=32.5 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For E=195 GPa, A=0.001 m², Lf=12 m and seating s=0.002 m, ΔP=EAs/Lf=32.5 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「座入量很小，所以不可能顯著影響短自由段地錨。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small seating movement cannot significantly affect a short-free-length anchor." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「錨頭座入損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Head-seating loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錨頭座入損失的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 錨頭楔片座入或承壓構件壓縮會縮短鋼腱有效伸長，造成鎖定力下降。自由段越短，同樣座入量引起的力損失越大，因為軸向剛度較高；施加峰值因此需要與鎖定後實際保留力分開記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Wedge seating or bearing-component compression reduces tendon extension and retained force. For the same seating movement, a shorter free length loses more force because axial stiffness is higher.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：座入量很小，所以不可能顯著影響短自由段地錨。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small seating movement cannot significantly affect a short-free-length anchor. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錨頭座入損失的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head-seating loss mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 錨頭楔片座入或承壓構件壓縮會縮短鋼腱有效伸長，造成鎖定力下降。
座入量很小，所以不可能顯著影響短自由段地錨。
文件完整率達到百分之九十六就等於全部地錨合格。
optionsEn: Wedge seating or bearing-component compression reduces tendon extension and retained force.
Small seating movement cannot significantly affect a short-free-length anchor.
Ninety-six-percent documentation coverage means every anchor is acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 錨頭楔片座入或承壓構件壓縮會縮短鋼腱有效伸長，造成鎖定力下降。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wedge seating or bearing-component compression reduces tendon extension and retained force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錨頭座入損失的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head-seating loss mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨頭座入損失」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Head-seating loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：E=195 GPa、A=0.001 m²、自由長Lf=12 m、座入s=0.002 m，ΔP=EAs/Lf=32.5 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For E=195 GPa, A=0.001 m², Lf=12 m and seating s=0.002 m, ΔP=EAs/Lf=32.5 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測鎖定前後腱端與承壓板的相對位移，對照載重計或核定提離試驗，排除溫度變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure relative tendon-end and bearing-plate movement across lock-off, compare with load cells or approved lift-off testing, and separate temperature changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：E=195 GPa、A=0.001 m²、自由長Lf=12 m、座入s=0.002 m，ΔP=EAs/Lf=32.5 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For E=195 GPa, A=0.001 m², Lf=12 m and seating s=0.002 m, ΔP=EAs/Lf=32.5 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錨頭座入損失的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Head-seating loss mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。
原創教學假設：E=195 GPa、A=0.001 m²、自由長Lf=12 m、座入s=0.002 m，ΔP=EAs/Lf=32.5 kN。
錨碇段越長就一定能補償它位於滑動土體內的問題。
optionsEn: Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position.
Original teaching assumptions: For E=195 GPa, A=0.001 m², Lf=12 m and seating s=0.002 m, ΔP=EAs/Lf=32.5 kN.
A longer bond zone always compensates for being located within moving ground.

steps.title: 錨頭座入損失的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head-seating loss mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨頭座入損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head-seating loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測鎖定前後腱端與承壓板的相對位移，對照載重計或核定提離試驗，排除溫度變化。驗收需保留座入與保留力紀錄；地錨設計者核定補償及再驗證條件，現場不得只追求較高峰值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure relative tendon-end and bearing-plate movement across lock-off, compare with load cells or approved lift-off testing, and separate temperature changes. Acceptance retains seating and retained-force records; the anchor designer approves compensation and reverification rather than pursuing a higher peak alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：驗收需保留座入與保留力紀錄；地錨設計者核定補償及再驗證條件，現場不得只追求較高峰值。線彈性式未含摩擦與錨碇段變形，並假設座入全轉成自由段回縮；實測保留力仍是必要的獨立證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Acceptance retains seating and retained-force records; the anchor designer approves compensation and reverification rather than pursuing a higher peak alone. The elastic expression excludes friction and bond deformation and assumes all seating shortens the free segment; measured retained force remains necessary independent evidence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：座入未計入會使保留力不足，後續牆體位移才重新動員地錨，失去預力限制變形的效果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted seating loss leaves insufficient retained force, requiring later wall movement to remobilize the anchor and reducing its deformation-control benefit. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Measure relative tendon-end and bearing-plate movement across lock-off, compare with load cells or approved lift-off testing, and separate temperature changes. Acceptance retains seating and retained-force records; the anchor designer approves compensation and reverification rather than pursuing a higher peak alone.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 驗收需保留座入與保留力紀錄；地錨設計者核定補償及再驗證條件，現場不得只追求較高峰值。線彈性式未含摩擦與錨碇段變形，並假設座入全轉成自由段回縮；實測保留力仍是必要的獨立證據。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance retains seating and retained-force records; the anchor designer approves compensation and reverification rather than pursuing a higher peak alone. The elastic expression excludes friction and bond deformation and assumes all seating shortens the free segment; measured retained force remains necessary independent evidence.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨頭座入損失的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head-seating loss mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
固定荷重時出現的位移全部都是鋼腱彈性伸長。
量測鎖定前後腱端與承壓板的相對位移，對照載重計或核定提離試驗，排除溫度變化。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
All movement under constant load is elastic tendon extension.
Measure relative tendon-end and bearing-plate movement across lock-off, compare with load cells or approved lift-off testing, and separate temperature changes.
quiz.explanation: 量測鎖定前後腱端與承壓板的相對位移，對照載重計或核定提離試驗，排除溫度變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure relative tendon-end and bearing-plate movement across lock-off, compare with load cells or approved lift-off testing, and separate temperature changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 錨頭座入損失的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head-seating loss mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨頭座入損失」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Head-seating loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 座入未計入會使保留力不足，後續牆體位移才重新動員地錨，失去預力限制變形的效果。線彈性式未含摩擦與錨碇段變形，並假設座入全轉成自由段回縮；實測保留力仍是必要的獨立證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted seating loss leaves insufficient retained force, requiring later wall movement to remobilize the anchor and reducing its deformation-control benefit. The elastic expression excludes friction and bond deformation and assumes all seating shortens the free segment; measured retained force remains necessary independent evidence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：線彈性式未含摩擦與錨碇段變形，並假設座入全轉成自由段回縮；實測保留力仍是必要的獨立證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The elastic expression excludes friction and bond deformation and assumes all seating shortens the free segment; measured retained force remains necessary independent evidence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「座入量很小，所以不可能顯著影響短自由段地錨。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small seating movement cannot significantly affect a short-free-length anchor." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 座入未計入會使保留力不足，後續牆體位移才重新動員地錨，失去預力限制變形的效果。線彈性式未含摩擦與錨碇段變形，並假設座入全轉成自由段回縮；實測保留力仍是必要的獨立證據。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted seating loss leaves insufficient retained force, requiring later wall movement to remobilize the anchor and reducing its deformation-control benefit. The elastic expression excludes friction and bond deformation and assumes all seating shortens the free segment; measured retained force remains necessary independent evidence.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錨頭座入損失的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Head-seating loss mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 座入未計入會使保留力不足，後續牆體位移才重新動員地錨，失去預力限制變形的效果。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
文件完整率達到百分之九十六就等於全部地錨合格。
optionsEn: Omitted seating loss leaves insufficient retained force, requiring later wall movement to remobilize the anchor and reducing its deformation-control benefit.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Ninety-six-percent documentation coverage means every anchor is acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 座入未計入會使保留力不足，後續牆體位移才重新動員地錨，失去預力限制變形的效果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted seating loss leaves insufficient retained force, requiring later wall movement to remobilize the anchor and reducing its deformation-control benefit. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 試驗文件覆蓋的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Test-evidence coverage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「試驗文件覆蓋」如何影響地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Test-evidence coverage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地錨的隱蔽性使施工與試驗文件成為長期可追溯性的核心，缺少一支資料不能由其他地錨平均合格來補足。資料完整率有助找出待處理清單，卻不代表品質合格率；荷重程序、校正、時間及地層證據都須逐支核對。比率只描述資料覆蓋，不衡量試驗結果或構造安全；缺少資料的地錨須保留未判定狀態，不可自動補成通過。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「試驗文件覆蓋」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Because anchors are concealed, construction and test records are central to traceability. Missing evidence for one anchor cannot be replaced by average compliance elsewhere. Completeness ratios identify unresolved items but are not quality-pass rates; loading procedure, calibration, timing and geological evidence must be checked anchor by anchor. The ratio describes evidence coverage, not test outcome or structural safety; anchors with missing evidence remain unresolved rather than being automatically marked as passing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Test-evidence coverage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設應有50支地錨完整紀錄、已確認48支，文件覆蓋率48/50=96%，仍有2支未解決。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: If complete records are required for fifty anchors and forty-eight are confirmed, coverage is 48/50=96%, leaving two unresolved.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「文件完整率達到百分之九十六就等於全部地錨合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ninety-six-percent documentation coverage means every anchor is acceptable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「試驗文件覆蓋」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Test-evidence coverage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試驗文件覆蓋的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 地錨的隱蔽性使施工與試驗文件成為長期可追溯性的核心，缺少一支資料不能由其他地錨平均合格來補足。資料完整率有助找出待處理清單，卻不代表品質合格率；荷重程序、校正、時間及地層證據都須逐支核對。
knowledge.textEn: Because anchors are concealed, construction and test records are central to traceability. Missing evidence for one anchor cannot be replaced by average compliance elsewhere.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：文件完整率達到百分之九十六就等於全部地錨合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Ninety-six-percent documentation coverage means every anchor is acceptable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試驗文件覆蓋的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Test-evidence coverage mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 文件完整率達到百分之九十六就等於全部地錨合格。
地錨的隱蔽性使施工與試驗文件成為長期可追溯性的核心，缺少一支資料不能由其他地錨平均合格來補足。
地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。
optionsEn: Ninety-six-percent documentation coverage means every anchor is acceptable.
Because anchors are concealed, construction and test records are central to traceability.
Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct.
quiz.explanation: 地錨的隱蔽性使施工與試驗文件成為長期可追溯性的核心，缺少一支資料不能由其他地錨平均合格來補足。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Because anchors are concealed, construction and test records are central to traceability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試驗文件覆蓋的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Test-evidence coverage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試驗文件覆蓋」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Test-evidence coverage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設應有50支地錨完整紀錄、已確認48支，文件覆蓋率48/50=96%，仍有2支未解決。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: If complete records are required for fifty anchors and forty-eight are confirmed, coverage is 48/50=96%, leaving two unresolved. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每支地錨編碼連結鑽孔、注漿、材料與試驗資料，抽核原始曲線及簽認，保留缺件清單。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link each anchor identifier to drilling, grout, material and test evidence, audit original curves and signatures, and retain an explicit missing-record list.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設應有50支地錨完整紀錄、已確認48支，文件覆蓋率48/50=96%，仍有2支未解決。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: If complete records are required for fifty anchors and forty-eight are confirmed, coverage is 48/50=96%, leaving two unresolved. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試驗文件覆蓋的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Test-evidence coverage mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 試驗位移計只會讀到鋼腱本身的彈性伸長。
所有地錨張力都可以直接當成水平擋土支撐力。
原創教學假設：假設應有50支地錨完整紀錄、已確認48支，文件覆蓋率48/50=96%，仍有2支未解決。
optionsEn: The test displacement gauge reads only elastic tendon extension.
All anchor tension can be counted directly as horizontal retaining resistance.
Original teaching assumptions: If complete records are required for fifty anchors and forty-eight are confirmed, coverage is 48/50=96%, leaving two unresolved.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設應有50支地錨完整紀錄、已確認48支，文件覆蓋率48/50=96%，仍有2支未解決。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 試驗文件覆蓋的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Test-evidence coverage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試驗文件覆蓋」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Test-evidence coverage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每支地錨編碼連結鑽孔、注漿、材料與試驗資料，抽核原始曲線及簽認，保留缺件清單。未解決地錨須逐支指定責任及補證方式；地工設計者與業主確認處置後，才可完成正式移交。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link each anchor identifier to drilling, grout, material and test evidence, audit original curves and signatures, and retain an explicit missing-record list. Assign responsibility and a resolution method to every unresolved anchor; formal handover follows joint confirmation by the geotechnical designer and owner. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：未解決地錨須逐支指定責任及補證方式；地工設計者與業主確認處置後，才可完成正式移交。比率只描述資料覆蓋，不衡量試驗結果或構造安全；缺少資料的地錨須保留未判定狀態，不可自動補成通過。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assign responsibility and a resolution method to every unresolved anchor; formal handover follows joint confirmation by the geotechnical designer and owner. The ratio describes evidence coverage, not test outcome or structural safety; anchors with missing evidence remain unresolved rather than being automatically marked as passing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只報高完整率可能掩蓋關鍵位置缺乏證據，日後維修時無法判斷原有荷載與防蝕系統。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reporting only a high completeness rate can conceal missing evidence at critical locations, preventing later interpretation of original loading and corrosion protection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The ratio describes evidence coverage, not test outcome or structural safety; anchors with missing evidence remain unresolved rather than being automatically marked as passing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「文件完整率達到百分之九十六就等於全部地錨合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ninety-six-percent documentation coverage means every anchor is acceptable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只報高完整率可能掩蓋關鍵位置缺乏證據，日後維修時無法判斷原有荷載與防蝕系統。比率只描述資料覆蓋，不衡量試驗結果或構造安全；缺少資料的地錨須保留未判定狀態，不可自動補成通過。
knowledge.textEn: Reporting only a high completeness rate can conceal missing evidence at critical locations, preventing later interpretation of original loading and corrosion protection. The ratio describes evidence coverage, not test outcome or structural safety; anchors with missing evidence remain unresolved rather than being automatically marked as passing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試驗文件覆蓋的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Test-evidence coverage mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只報高完整率可能掩蓋關鍵位置缺乏證據，日後維修時無法判斷原有荷載與防蝕系統。
地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Reporting only a high completeness rate can conceal missing evidence at critical locations, preventing later interpretation of original loading and corrosion protection.
Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct.
quiz.explanation: 只報高完整率可能掩蓋關鍵位置缺乏證據，日後維修時無法判斷原有荷載與防蝕系統。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reporting only a high completeness rate can conceal missing evidence at critical locations, preventing later interpretation of original loading and corrosion protection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 微型樁托底補強
summary: 微型樁托底的關鍵不只是把樁打到深處，而是建立既有柱、承台、連接件與地層之間可驗證的新力流。本課逐步檢查鋼材與黏結承載、預載移交、樁群剛度、無側限段挫屈與低淨高接頭，最後用長期沉陷判讀新舊基礎是否確實共同工作。
summaryEn: Micropile underpinning requires a verified new load path from existing columns through caps and connectors into ground. The course examines steel and bond resistance, preloaded transfer, group stiffness, buckling in unsupported zones and low-headroom joints, then interprets long-term settlement to establish interaction between old and new foundations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：現有柱力800 kN、增建250 kN、設備150 kN，在本例同時使用情境下合計1200 kN。若只增加現有柱力10%至880 kN，其他兩項維持不變，合計變成1280 kN，總需求增加80 kN或6.67%，而不是10%。還須按上部結構規範建立荷載組合，並確定新舊基礎如何分力。此加總不代表每根新樁平均分擔，也不證明承台連接或荷載移交完成；應以樁力、承台位移及現況調查共同驗證。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: an existing column carries 800 kN, an extension adds 250 kN and equipment adds 150 kN, giving 1200 kN in this simultaneous-use scenario. Increase only the existing-column component by 10% to 880 kN while holding the others fixed: total demand becomes 1280 kN, up 80 kN or 6.67%, not 10%. Appropriate structural load combinations and new-old foundation sharing remain necessary. This sum implies neither equal sharing by new piles nor completed cap connection and load transfer. Verify those using pile forces, cap movement and existing-condition investigation.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證」與「鋼材軸應力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification" and "Steel axial stress mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「既有荷載清冊」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Existing-load inventory” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 托底設計須先辨識目前柱力與未來增載，不能把原設計圖的基礎反力直接當成現況。使用變更、加建及設備集中載重會改變分配，施工期間的臨時支承也需單獨列出，才能決定新樁要接管多少力與何時接管。直接相加只描述本例同時服務荷載，沒有套用設計分項係數；不同作用組合及既有基礎可分擔比例需另行建立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「既有荷載清冊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Underpinning starts with current column forces and future additions rather than assuming original foundation reactions still apply. Changes of use, extensions and concentrated equipment alter load distribution, and temporary support requires a separate case. These distinctions determine how much load new piles must take and when transfer occurs. Direct addition describes simultaneous service loads in this example only; design factors, combinations and the share retained by existing foundations require separate definition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Existing-load inventory” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設現有柱力800 kN、增建250 kN、設備150 kN，服務荷載合計P=800+250+150=1200 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For existing column force 800 kN, extension 250 kN and equipment 150 kN, combined service load P=1200 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "New-pile capacity above the original column force makes current use irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「既有荷載清冊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Existing-load inventory”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 托底設計須先辨識目前柱力與未來增載，不能把原設計圖的基礎反力直接當成現況。使用變更、加建及設備集中載重會改變分配，施工期間的臨時支承也需單獨列出，才能決定新樁要接管多少力與何時接管。
knowledge.textEn: Underpinning starts with current column forces and future additions rather than assuming original foundation reactions still apply. Changes of use, extensions and concentrated equipment alter load distribution, and temporary support requires a separate case.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: New-pile capacity above the original column force makes current use irrelevant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。
托底設計須先辨識目前柱力與未來增載，不能把原設計圖的基礎反力直接當成現況。
微型樁平均鋼應力不高，就不用檢查接頭與局部挫屈。
optionsEn: New-pile capacity above the original column force makes current use irrelevant.
Underpinning starts with current column forces and future additions rather than assuming original foundation reactions still apply.
Low mean steel stress removes the need for connection and local-buckling checks.
quiz.explanation: 托底設計須先辨識目前柱力與未來增載，不能把原設計圖的基礎反力直接當成現況。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Underpinning starts with current column forces and future additions rather than assuming original foundation reactions still apply. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「既有荷載清冊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Existing-load inventory” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設現有柱力800 kN、增建250 kN、設備150 kN，服務荷載合計P=800+250+150=1200 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For existing column force 800 kN, extension 250 kN and equipment 150 kN, combined service load P=1200 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對現況尺寸、使用荷載及裂縫沉陷紀錄，將不同時期荷載分列，與上部結構模型交叉核查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check existing dimensions, imposed loads and cracking-settlement records, separating load stages and cross-checking them against the superstructure model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設現有柱力800 kN、增建250 kN、設備150 kN，服務荷載合計P=800+250+150=1200 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For existing column force 800 kN, extension 250 kN and equipment 150 kN, combined service load P=1200 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 微型樁試驗合格就代表與舊基礎的連接也合格。
同一承台下所有微型樁一定平均分擔柱力。
原創教學假設：假設現有柱力800 kN、增建250 kN、設備150 kN，服務荷載合計P=800+250+150=1200 kN。
optionsEn: A successful micropile load test proves the old-foundation connection is adequate.
Every micropile under one cap necessarily shares column load equally.
Original teaching assumptions: For existing column force 800 kN, extension 250 kN and equipment 150 kN, combined service load P=1200 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設現有柱力800 kN、增建250 kN、設備150 kN，服務荷載合計P=800+250+150=1200 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For existing column force 800 kN, extension 250 kN and equipment 150 kN, combined service load P=1200 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「既有荷載清冊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Existing-load inventory” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對現況尺寸、使用荷載及裂縫沉陷紀錄，將不同時期荷載分列，與上部結構模型交叉核查。荷載清冊應由上部結構與基礎設計者共同簽認；施工階段和最終使用階段不可混用未標示的力值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check existing dimensions, imposed loads and cracking-settlement records, separating load stages and cross-checking them against the superstructure model. Superstructure and foundation designers jointly sign the load inventory; construction and final-use forces must not be mixed without explicit stage labels. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：荷載清冊應由上部結構與基礎設計者共同簽認；施工階段和最終使用階段不可混用未標示的力值。直接相加只描述本例同時服務荷載，沒有套用設計分項係數；不同作用組合及既有基礎可分擔比例需另行建立。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Superstructure and foundation designers jointly sign the load inventory; construction and final-use forces must not be mixed without explicit stage labels. Direct addition describes simultaneous service loads in this example only; design factors, combinations and the share retained by existing foundations require separate definition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏列新增設備或移除原支承，會使微型樁承擔超出假設的荷載，造成移交後持續沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted equipment loads or removed original support can impose more load than assumed, causing continued settlement after transfer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對現況尺寸、使用荷載及裂縫沉陷紀錄，將不同時期荷載分列，與上部結構模型交叉核查。荷載清冊應由上部結構與基礎設計者共同簽認；施工階段和最終使用階段不可混用未標示的力值。
knowledge.textEn: Check existing dimensions, imposed loads and cracking-settlement records, separating load stages and cross-checking them against the superstructure model. Superstructure and foundation designers jointly sign the load inventory; construction and final-use forces must not be mixed without explicit stage labels.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 荷載清冊應由上部結構與基礎設計者共同簽認；施工階段和最終使用階段不可混用未標示的力值。直接相加只描述本例同時服務荷載，沒有套用設計分項係數；不同作用組合及既有基礎可分擔比例需另行建立。
knowledge.textEn: Superstructure and foundation designers jointly sign the load inventory; construction and final-use forces must not be mixed without explicit stage labels. Direct addition describes simultaneous service loads in this example only; design factors, combinations and the share retained by existing foundations require separate definition.

quiz.question: 要驗證「既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification"?
options: 核對現況尺寸、使用荷載及裂縫沉陷紀錄，將不同時期荷載分列，與上部結構模型交叉核查。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
柱力是向下的，就不可能讓任何托底樁受到拉力。
optionsEn: Check existing dimensions, imposed loads and cracking-settlement records, separating load stages and cross-checking them against the superstructure model.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A downward column load can never put an underpinning pile in tension.
quiz.explanation: 核對現況尺寸、使用荷載及裂縫沉陷紀錄，將不同時期荷載分列，與上部結構模型交叉核查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check existing dimensions, imposed loads and cracking-settlement records, separating load stages and cross-checking them against the superstructure model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 既有荷載清冊的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Existing-load inventory mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「既有荷載清冊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Existing-load inventory” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏列新增設備或移除原支承，會使微型樁承擔超出假設的荷載，造成移交後持續沉陷。直接相加只描述本例同時服務荷載，沒有套用設計分項係數；不同作用組合及既有基礎可分擔比例需另行建立。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 鋼材軸應力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel axial stress mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼材軸應力」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel axial stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 微型樁的鋼套管或鋼筋與水泥漿共同傳遞軸力，鋼材分擔比例取決於剛度及接頭連續性。先把全部力分配給鋼材可作特定保守假設，但不代表漿體永遠不參與；腐蝕餘量、套管接頭與局部挫屈也不能靠平均應力取代。這是指定分力下的平均應力，不是微型樁整體承載力；鋼材、漿體、連接及地層黏結需依相容荷載路徑分別檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼材軸應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel casing or bars share axial force with grout according to stiffness and continuity. Assigning all force to steel may be a specified conservative assumption, but does not imply grout never participates. Corrosion allowance, casing joints and local buckling also require checks beyond an average axial stress. This is mean stress under an assigned force, not total micropile capacity; steel, grout, connections and ground bond require separate checks on a compatible load path. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Steel axial stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設鋼材獨自承受P=600 kN、有效鋼面積As=0.004 m²，σs=P/As=150 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: If steel alone carries P=600 kN over effective area As=0.004 m², σs=P/As=150 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「微型樁平均鋼應力不高，就不用檢查接頭與局部挫屈。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low mean steel stress removes the need for connection and local-buckling checks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼材軸應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 鋼材軸應力的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel axial stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設鋼材獨自承受P=600 kN、有效鋼面積As=0.004 m²，σs=P/As=150 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: If steel alone carries P=600 kN over effective area As=0.004 m², σs=P/As=150 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對鋼材證書、實際壁厚與接頭型式，將載重試驗應變比較鋼漿共同作用假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify steel certificates, actual thickness and connection type, comparing load-test strains with the assumed steel-grout composite action.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼材軸應力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel axial stress mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
注漿量很多就必然得到較大且完整的黏結直徑。
把名目壁厚當有效面積可能忽略腐蝕或螺紋減弱，接頭也可能先於完整鋼管失效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
High grout volume necessarily creates a larger continuous bond diameter.
Using nominal thickness can ignore corrosion or thread reductions, and connections may fail before an intact casing section.
quiz.explanation: 把名目壁厚當有效面積可能忽略腐蝕或螺紋減弱，接頭也可能先於完整鋼管失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using nominal thickness can ignore corrosion or thread reductions, and connections may fail before an intact casing section. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地層黏結承載的機理與驗證」與「承台連接的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ground-bond resistance mechanism and verification" and "Cap connection mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地層黏結承載的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ground-bond resistance mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地層黏結承載」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ground-bond resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 樁端進入良好地層後，軸力沿漿土界面的剪力逐步傳出，荷載傳遞不一定均勻。注漿方式與地層條件影響有效直徑及黏結能力，不能把灌入量直接換成可靠樁徑；承載驗證需要代表性試驗及鑽孔紀錄共同支持。本式假設均勻平均剪力且有效直徑可信，未含群體作用與長期效應；試驗允收還需同時檢查位移和潛變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地層黏結承載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Axial force transfers progressively through grout-ground shear in the competent stratum and is not necessarily uniform along the bond. Grouting and ground conditions affect effective diameter and bond resistance, but injected volume does not directly establish a reliable diameter. Representative testing and bore records jointly support resistance assessment. The expression assumes uniform mean shear and credible diameter, excluding group and long-term effects; test acceptance must also address displacement and creep. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ground-bond resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設D=0.2 m、黏結長L=8 m、平均可用剪應力τ=150 kPa，R=πDLτ=754 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For D=0.2 m, bond length L=8 m and assumed usable mean shear τ=150 kPa, R=πDLτ=754 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注漿量很多就必然得到較大且完整的黏結直徑。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High grout volume necessarily creates a larger continuous bond diameter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地層黏結承載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ground-bond resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地層黏結承載的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 樁端進入良好地層後，軸力沿漿土界面的剪力逐步傳出，荷載傳遞不一定均勻。注漿方式與地層條件影響有效直徑及黏結能力，不能把灌入量直接換成可靠樁徑；承載驗證需要代表性試驗及鑽孔紀錄共同支持。
knowledge.textEn: Axial force transfers progressively through grout-ground shear in the competent stratum and is not necessarily uniform along the bond. Grouting and ground conditions affect effective diameter and bond resistance, but injected volume does not directly establish a reliable diameter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注漿量很多就必然得到較大且完整的黏結直徑。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High grout volume necessarily creates a larger continuous bond diameter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地層黏結承載的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ground-bond resistance mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 樁端進入良好地層後，軸力沿漿土界面的剪力逐步傳出，荷載傳遞不一定均勻。
注漿量很多就必然得到較大且完整的黏結直徑。
微型樁試驗合格就代表與舊基礎的連接也合格。
optionsEn: Axial force transfers progressively through grout-ground shear in the competent stratum and is not necessarily uniform along the bond.
High grout volume necessarily creates a larger continuous bond diameter.
A successful micropile load test proves the old-foundation connection is adequate.
quiz.explanation: 樁端進入良好地層後，軸力沿漿土界面的剪力逐步傳出，荷載傳遞不一定均勻。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Axial force transfers progressively through grout-ground shear in the competent stratum and is not necessarily uniform along the bond. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地層黏結承載的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ground-bond resistance mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地層黏結承載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ground-bond resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設D=0.2 m、黏結長L=8 m、平均可用剪應力τ=150 kPa，R=πDLτ=754 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For D=0.2 m, bond length L=8 m and assumed usable mean shear τ=150 kPa, R=πDLτ=754 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將鑽孔地層、注漿回流及試驗曲線按樁號連結，檢查錨固層是否連續並比較不同樁的移動趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link bore geology, grout returns and load-test curves by pile identifier, checking continuity of the bond stratum and comparing movement trends between piles.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設D=0.2 m、黏結長L=8 m、平均可用剪應力τ=150 kPa，R=πDLτ=754 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For D=0.2 m, bond length L=8 m and assumed usable mean shear τ=150 kPa, R=πDLτ=754 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地層黏結承載的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ground-bond resistance mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 同一承台下所有微型樁一定平均分擔柱力。
原創教學假設：假設D=0.2 m、黏結長L=8 m、平均可用剪應力τ=150 kPa，R=πDLτ=754 kN。
柱力是向下的，就不可能讓任何托底樁受到拉力。
optionsEn: Every micropile under one cap necessarily shares column load equally.
Original teaching assumptions: For D=0.2 m, bond length L=8 m and assumed usable mean shear τ=150 kPa, R=πDLτ=754 kN.
A downward column load can never put an underpinning pile in tension.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設D=0.2 m、黏結長L=8 m、平均可用剪應力τ=150 kPa，R=πDLτ=754 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For D=0.2 m, bond length L=8 m and assumed usable mean shear τ=150 kPa, R=πDLτ=754 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地層黏結承載的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ground-bond resistance mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地層黏結承載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ground-bond resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將鑽孔地層、注漿回流及試驗曲線按樁號連結，檢查錨固層是否連續並比較不同樁的移動趨勢。黏結參數及驗證樁位置需由地工設計者核准；任何異常回流或地層變更都要保留追查紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link bore geology, grout returns and load-test curves by pile identifier, checking continuity of the bond stratum and comparing movement trends between piles. The geotechnical designer approves bond parameters and verification-pile locations; abnormal returns or changed strata retain traceable investigation records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：黏結參數及驗證樁位置需由地工設計者核准；任何異常回流或地層變更都要保留追查紀錄。本式假設均勻平均剪力且有效直徑可信，未含群體作用與長期效應；試驗允收還需同時檢查位移和潛變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The geotechnical designer approves bond parameters and verification-pile locations; abnormal returns or changed strata retain traceable investigation records. The expression assumes uniform mean shear and credible diameter, excluding group and long-term effects; test acceptance must also address displacement and creep.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：黏結段跨入軟弱夾層或漿體不連續會使力集中，可能出現漸進滑移而非鋼材先降伏。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Weak interbeds or discontinuous grout concentrate transfer and can produce progressive slip before steel yielding. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將鑽孔地層、注漿回流及試驗曲線按樁號連結，檢查錨固層是否連續並比較不同樁的移動趨勢。黏結參數及驗證樁位置需由地工設計者核准；任何異常回流或地層變更都要保留追查紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Link bore geology, grout returns and load-test curves by pile identifier, checking continuity of the bond stratum and comparing movement trends between piles. The geotechnical designer approves bond parameters and verification-pile locations; abnormal returns or changed strata retain traceable investigation records.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 黏結參數及驗證樁位置需由地工設計者核准；任何異常回流或地層變更都要保留追查紀錄。本式假設均勻平均剪力且有效直徑可信，未含群體作用與長期效應；試驗允收還需同時檢查位移和潛變。
knowledge.textEn: The geotechnical designer approves bond parameters and verification-pile locations; abnormal returns or changed strata retain traceable investigation records. The expression assumes uniform mean shear and credible diameter, excluding group and long-term effects; test acceptance must also address displacement and creep.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地層黏結承載的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ground-bond resistance mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
載重試驗通過後，既有建物不需要再做沉陷監測。
將鑽孔地層、注漿回流及試驗曲線按樁號連結，檢查錨固層是否連續並比較不同樁的移動趨勢。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Passing a load test removes the need for further building-settlement monitoring.
Link bore geology, grout returns and load-test curves by pile identifier, checking continuity of the bond stratum and comparing movement trends between piles.
quiz.explanation: 將鑽孔地層、注漿回流及試驗曲線按樁號連結，檢查錨固層是否連續並比較不同樁的移動趨勢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Link bore geology, grout returns and load-test curves by pile identifier, checking continuity of the bond stratum and comparing movement trends between piles. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地層黏結承載的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ground-bond resistance mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地層黏結承載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ground-bond resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 黏結段跨入軟弱夾層或漿體不連續會使力集中，可能出現漸進滑移而非鋼材先降伏。本式假設均勻平均剪力且有效直徑可信，未含群體作用與長期效應；試驗允收還需同時檢查位移和潛變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Weak interbeds or discontinuous grout concentrate transfer and can produce progressive slip before steel yielding. The expression assumes uniform mean shear and credible diameter, excluding group and long-term effects; test acceptance must also address displacement and creep. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本式假設均勻平均剪力且有效直徑可信，未含群體作用與長期效應；試驗允收還需同時檢查位移和潛變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The expression assumes uniform mean shear and credible diameter, excluding group and long-term effects; test acceptance must also address displacement and creep.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注漿量很多就必然得到較大且完整的黏結直徑。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High grout volume necessarily creates a larger continuous bond diameter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 黏結段跨入軟弱夾層或漿體不連續會使力集中，可能出現漸進滑移而非鋼材先降伏。本式假設均勻平均剪力且有效直徑可信，未含群體作用與長期效應；試驗允收還需同時檢查位移和潛變。
knowledge.textEn: Weak interbeds or discontinuous grout concentrate transfer and can produce progressive slip before steel yielding. The expression assumes uniform mean shear and credible diameter, excluding group and long-term effects; test acceptance must also address displacement and creep.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地層黏結承載的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ground-bond resistance mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 黏結段跨入軟弱夾層或漿體不連續會使力集中，可能出現漸進滑移而非鋼材先降伏。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
微型樁試驗合格就代表與舊基礎的連接也合格。
optionsEn: Weak interbeds or discontinuous grout concentrate transfer and can produce progressive slip before steel yielding.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A successful micropile load test proves the old-foundation connection is adequate.
quiz.explanation: 黏結段跨入軟弱夾層或漿體不連續會使力集中，可能出現漸進滑移而非鋼材先降伏。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Weak interbeds or discontinuous grout concentrate transfer and can produce progressive slip before steel yielding. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 承台連接的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cap connection mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「承台連接」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cap connection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新微型樁必須透過承台、剪力環或其他核定連接把力接入舊基礎，單樁有容量不等於既有柱力已找到新路徑。舊混凝土品質、邊距及鋼筋位置會控制局部承壓與劈裂，施工擾動也可能削弱原有基礎的剩餘能力。平均承壓不包含局部劈裂、沖切及錨定需求，舊材料強度亦可能不均；完整節點驗算不能由此單式取代。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「承台連接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: New micropiles need a cap, shear rings or another approved connector to receive load from the old foundation. Pile capacity alone does not establish a new path for column force. Existing concrete quality, edge distance and reinforcement govern local bearing and splitting, while construction disturbance may reduce residual foundation capacity. Mean bearing excludes splitting, punching and anchorage, and existing strength may vary; this single equation cannot replace complete node analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cap connection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設連接傳力P=400 kN、有效承壓面A=0.08 m²，p=P/A=5 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For transferred connection force P=400 kN and effective bearing area A=0.08 m², p=P/A=5 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「微型樁試驗合格就代表與舊基礎的連接也合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A successful micropile load test proves the old-foundation connection is adequate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「承台連接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cap connection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 承台連接的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 新微型樁必須透過承台、剪力環或其他核定連接把力接入舊基礎，單樁有容量不等於既有柱力已找到新路徑。舊混凝土品質、邊距及鋼筋位置會控制局部承壓與劈裂，施工擾動也可能削弱原有基礎的剩餘能力。
knowledge.textEn: New micropiles need a cap, shear rings or another approved connector to receive load from the old foundation. Pile capacity alone does not establish a new path for column force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：微型樁試驗合格就代表與舊基礎的連接也合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A successful micropile load test proves the old-foundation connection is adequate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「承台連接的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cap connection mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 微型樁試驗合格就代表與舊基礎的連接也合格。
新微型樁必須透過承台、剪力環或其他核定連接把力接入舊基礎，單樁有容量不等於既有柱力已找到新路徑。
新樁完工後會立刻自然承擔所有設計荷載比例。
optionsEn: A successful micropile load test proves the old-foundation connection is adequate.
New micropiles need a cap, shear rings or another approved connector to receive load from the old foundation.
Completed new piles immediately carry every intended design load share naturally.
quiz.explanation: 新微型樁必須透過承台、剪力環或其他核定連接把力接入舊基礎，單樁有容量不等於既有柱力已找到新路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: New micropiles need a cap, shear rings or another approved connector to receive load from the old foundation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 承台連接的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cap connection mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「承台連接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cap connection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設連接傳力P=400 kN、有效承壓面A=0.08 m²，p=P/A=5 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For transferred connection force P=400 kN and effective bearing area A=0.08 m², p=P/A=5 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以探測及局部取樣確認舊基礎，核對連接面與鋼筋淨距，將實際傳力方向放入節點模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Investigate the existing foundation with scanning and justified sampling, verify connection faces and reinforcement clearance, and model the actual force direction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設連接傳力P=400 kN、有效承壓面A=0.08 m²，p=P/A=5 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For transferred connection force P=400 kN and effective bearing area A=0.08 m², p=P/A=5 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「承台連接的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cap connection mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 微型樁埋在地下，所以任何位置都不需要挫屈檢查。
接頭越多只會影響速度，不會影響樁的受力品質。
原創教學假設：假設連接傳力P=400 kN、有效承壓面A=0.08 m²，p=P/A=5 MPa。
optionsEn: A buried micropile never requires buckling checks anywhere along its length.
More splices affect speed only and never structural quality.
Original teaching assumptions: For transferred connection force P=400 kN and effective bearing area A=0.08 m², p=P/A=5 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設連接傳力P=400 kN、有效承壓面A=0.08 m²，p=P/A=5 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For transferred connection force P=400 kN and effective bearing area A=0.08 m², p=P/A=5 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 承台連接的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cap connection mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「承台連接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cap connection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以探測及局部取樣確認舊基礎，核對連接面與鋼筋淨距，將實際傳力方向放入節點模型。連接細部應在現況調查後核定；舊構件切削與新增孔洞由既有結構設計者確認剩餘力流再施工。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Investigate the existing foundation with scanning and justified sampling, verify connection faces and reinforcement clearance, and model the actual force direction. Finalize connections after existing-condition investigation; the existing-structure designer confirms remaining load paths before cutting or drilling new openings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：連接細部應在現況調查後核定；舊構件切削與新增孔洞由既有結構設計者確認剩餘力流再施工。平均承壓不包含局部劈裂、沖切及錨定需求，舊材料強度亦可能不均；完整節點驗算不能由此單式取代。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Finalize connections after existing-condition investigation; the existing-structure designer confirms remaining load paths before cutting or drilling new openings. Mean bearing excludes splitting, punching and anchorage, and existing strength may vary; this single equation cannot replace complete node analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：舊混凝土劈裂或接面滑移會使新樁未能接管，即使單樁載重試驗合格，柱仍持續下沉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Splitting of old concrete or interface slip can prevent takeover despite a successful pile load test, leaving the column settling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以探測及局部取樣確認舊基礎，核對連接面與鋼筋淨距，將實際傳力方向放入節點模型。連接細部應在現況調查後核定；舊構件切削與新增孔洞由既有結構設計者確認剩餘力流再施工。
knowledge.textEn: Investigate the existing foundation with scanning and justified sampling, verify connection faces and reinforcement clearance, and model the actual force direction. Finalize connections after existing-condition investigation; the existing-structure designer confirms remaining load paths before cutting or drilling new openings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 連接細部應在現況調查後核定；舊構件切削與新增孔洞由既有結構設計者確認剩餘力流再施工。平均承壓不包含局部劈裂、沖切及錨定需求，舊材料強度亦可能不均；完整節點驗算不能由此單式取代。
knowledge.textEn: Finalize connections after existing-condition investigation; the existing-structure designer confirms remaining load paths before cutting or drilling new openings. Mean bearing excludes splitting, punching and anchorage, and existing strength may vary; this single equation cannot replace complete node analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「承台連接的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cap connection mechanism and verification"?
options: 以探測及局部取樣確認舊基礎，核對連接面與鋼筋淨距，將實際傳力方向放入節點模型。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。
optionsEn: Investigate the existing foundation with scanning and justified sampling, verify connection faces and reinforcement clearance, and model the actual force direction.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
New-pile capacity above the original column force makes current use irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 以探測及局部取樣確認舊基礎，核對連接面與鋼筋淨距，將實際傳力方向放入節點模型。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Investigate the existing foundation with scanning and justified sampling, verify connection faces and reinforcement clearance, and model the actual force direction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 承台連接的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cap connection mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「承台連接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cap connection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 舊混凝土劈裂或接面滑移會使新樁未能接管，即使單樁載重試驗合格，柱仍持續下沉。平均承壓不包含局部劈裂、沖切及錨定需求，舊材料強度亦可能不均；完整節點驗算不能由此單式取代。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Splitting of old concrete or interface slip can prevent takeover despite a successful pile load test, leaving the column settling. Mean bearing excludes splitting, punching and anchorage, and existing strength may vary; this single equation cannot replace complete node analysis. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均承壓不包含局部劈裂、沖切及錨定需求，舊材料強度亦可能不均；完整節點驗算不能由此單式取代。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean bearing excludes splitting, punching and anchorage, and existing strength may vary; this single equation cannot replace complete node analysis.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「微型樁試驗合格就代表與舊基礎的連接也合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A successful micropile load test proves the old-foundation connection is adequate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 舊混凝土劈裂或接面滑移會使新樁未能接管，即使單樁載重試驗合格，柱仍持續下沉。平均承壓不包含局部劈裂、沖切及錨定需求，舊材料強度亦可能不均；完整節點驗算不能由此單式取代。
knowledge.textEn: Splitting of old concrete or interface slip can prevent takeover despite a successful pile load test, leaving the column settling. Mean bearing excludes splitting, punching and anchorage, and existing strength may vary; this single equation cannot replace complete node analysis.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「承台連接的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cap connection mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
舊混凝土劈裂或接面滑移會使新樁未能接管，即使單樁載重試驗合格，柱仍持續下沉。
新樁完工後會立刻自然承擔所有設計荷載比例。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Splitting of old concrete or interface slip can prevent takeover despite a successful pile load test, leaving the column settling.
Completed new piles immediately carry every intended design load share naturally.
quiz.explanation: 舊混凝土劈裂或接面滑移會使新樁未能接管，即使單樁載重試驗合格，柱仍持續下沉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Splitting of old concrete or interface slip can prevent takeover despite a successful pile load test, leaving the column settling. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預載荷載移交的機理與驗證」與「新舊樁群分力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Preloaded transfer mechanism and verification" and "Pile-group load sharing mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預載荷載移交的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Preloaded transfer mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預載荷載移交」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Preloaded transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新樁若沒有預先接觸或預載，往往要等舊基礎再沉陷才逐步動員，不能假設施工完成即分擔設計荷載。預載的目的在控制接管路徑及位移，但過大推力也可能抬升上部結構；須同時監測力與柱、承台的相對移動。剛度位移式假設接觸已建立且線性，未含原始間隙與舊基礎塑性；本例不提供現場頂升程序或施力目標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預載荷載移交」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Without established contact or preload, a new pile may need further old-foundation settlement before it mobilizes. Completion alone does not mean it carries the intended share. Preload controls transfer and movement, but excessive force can lift the structure, requiring simultaneous force and relative column-cap displacement monitoring. The stiffness relation assumes established linear contact and excludes initial gaps and old-foundation plasticity; it does not prescribe jacking procedures or field force targets. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Preloaded transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設需移交ΔP=300 kN、等效剛度k=100 kN/mm，彈性位移δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For transfer increment ΔP=300 kN and equivalent stiffness k=100 kN/mm, elastic movement δ=ΔP/k=3 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「新樁完工後會立刻自然承擔所有設計荷載比例。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Completed new piles immediately carry every intended design load share naturally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預載荷載移交」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Preloaded transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預載荷載移交的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 新樁若沒有預先接觸或預載，往往要等舊基礎再沉陷才逐步動員，不能假設施工完成即分擔設計荷載。預載的目的在控制接管路徑及位移，但過大推力也可能抬升上部結構；須同時監測力與柱、承台的相對移動。
knowledge.textEn: Without established contact or preload, a new pile may need further old-foundation settlement before it mobilizes. Completion alone does not mean it carries the intended share.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Completed new piles immediately carry every intended design load share naturally. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預載荷載移交的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Preloaded transfer mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 新樁完工後會立刻自然承擔所有設計荷載比例。
同一承台下所有微型樁一定平均分擔柱力。
新樁若沒有預先接觸或預載，往往要等舊基礎再沉陷才逐步動員，不能假設施工完成即分擔設計荷載。
optionsEn: Completed new piles immediately carry every intended design load share naturally.
Every micropile under one cap necessarily shares column load equally.
Without established contact or preload, a new pile may need further old-foundation settlement before it mobilizes.
