quiz.explanationEn: Without established contact or preload, a new pile may need further old-foundation settlement before it mobilizes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預載荷載移交的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Preloaded transfer mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預載荷載移交」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Preloaded transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設需移交ΔP=300 kN、等效剛度k=100 kN/mm，彈性位移δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For transfer increment ΔP=300 kN and equivalent stiffness k=100 kN/mm, elastic movement δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對新樁力、舊基礎沉陷與連接間隙，確認接管過程沒有造成局部抬升或未知支承卸載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare new-pile force, old-foundation settlement and connection gaps to confirm that transfer causes neither local uplift nor unintended unloading elsewhere.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 預載荷載移交的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Preloaded transfer mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預載荷載移交」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Preloaded transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對新樁力、舊基礎沉陷與連接間隙，確認接管過程沒有造成局部抬升或未知支承卸載。荷載移交須設結構及地工共同停留點；核定力位移範圍後，才可解除原有臨時支承。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare new-pile force, old-foundation settlement and connection gaps to confirm that transfer causes neither local uplift nor unintended unloading elsewhere. Load transfer requires a joint structural-geotechnical hold point; original temporary support is released only after approved force-displacement conditions are demonstrated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：荷載移交須設結構及地工共同停留點；核定力位移範圍後，才可解除原有臨時支承。剛度位移式假設接觸已建立且線性，未含原始間隙與舊基礎塑性；本例不提供現場頂升程序或施力目標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Load transfer requires a joint structural-geotechnical hold point; original temporary support is released only after approved force-displacement conditions are demonstrated. The stiffness relation assumes established linear contact and excludes initial gaps and old-foundation plasticity; it does not prescribe jacking procedures or field force targets.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看施加荷重而不看位移，可能在接管前先抬升樓板，損傷既有脆性接縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Monitoring applied force without movement can lift slabs before intended transfer and damage existing brittle joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 預載荷載移交的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Preloaded transfer mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預載荷載移交」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Preloaded transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看施加荷重而不看位移，可能在接管前先抬升樓板，損傷既有脆性接縫。剛度位移式假設接觸已建立且線性，未含原始間隙與舊基礎塑性；本例不提供現場頂升程序或施力目標。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Monitoring applied force without movement can lift slabs before intended transfer and damage existing brittle joints. The stiffness relation assumes established linear contact and excludes initial gaps and old-foundation plasticity; it does not prescribe jacking procedures or field force targets. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：剛度位移式假設接觸已建立且線性，未含原始間隙與舊基礎塑性；本例不提供現場頂升程序或施力目標。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「新樁完工後會立刻自然承擔所有設計荷載比例。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Completed new piles immediately carry every intended design load share naturally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看施加荷重而不看位移，可能在接管前先抬升樓板，損傷既有脆性接縫。剛度位移式假設接觸已建立且線性，未含原始間隙與舊基礎塑性；本例不提供現場頂升程序或施力目標。

quiz.question: 在「預載荷載移交的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Every micropile under one cap necessarily shares column load equally.
Monitoring applied force without movement can lift slabs before intended transfer and damage existing brittle joints.
quiz.explanation: 只看施加荷重而不看位移，可能在接管前先抬升樓板，損傷既有脆性接縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Monitoring applied force without movement can lift slabs before intended transfer and damage existing brittle joints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 新舊樁群分力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「新舊樁群分力」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pile-group load sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 共用承台下不同樁的剛度與初始接觸決定荷載分配，並非單純按樁數平均。新樁與舊基礎可能有不同沉陷歷史與端承條件；等位移模型有助說明剛度比例，但需要承台近似剛性且沒有額外轉動才成立。並聯彈簧模型未含土體群效與非線性，單組剛度應對應相同荷載區間；舊樁歷史力不能直接重新平均。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「新舊樁群分力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Relative stiffness and initial contact govern load sharing beneath a common cap rather than pile count alone. New piles and old foundations have different settlement histories and toe conditions. An equal-displacement model illustrates stiffness sharing only when the cap is sufficiently rigid and additional rotation is absent. Parallel springs exclude group-soil interaction and nonlinearity; stiffnesses must correspond to the same load range, and historical force in old piles cannot simply be redistributed by averaging. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pile-group load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設兩組剛度k₁=200、k₂=100 MN/m，共承P=1200 kN且等位移，P₁=Pk₁/(k₁+k₂)=800 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For groups k₁=200 and k₂=100 MN/m sharing P=1200 kN at equal displacement, P₁=Pk₁/(k₁+k₂)=800 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一承台下所有微型樁一定平均分擔柱力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every micropile under one cap necessarily shares column load equally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「新舊樁群分力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.observation: 如何核對：量測承台轉角與代表樁軸力，核對是否等位移，將不同樁的載重試驗剛度用於比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure cap rotation and representative pile forces to test equal displacement, using individual load-test stiffnesses for comparison.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設兩組剛度k₁=200、k₂=100 MN/m，共承P=1200 kN且等位移，P₁=Pk₁/(k₁+k₂)=800 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For groups k₁=200 and k₂=100 MN/m sharing P=1200 kN at equal displacement, P₁=Pk₁/(k₁+k₂)=800 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「新舊樁群分力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pile-group load sharing mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 接頭越多只會影響速度，不會影響樁的受力品質。

新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。
optionsEn: More splices affect speed only and never structural quality.
Original teaching assumptions: For groups k₁=200 and k₂=100 MN/m sharing P=1200 kN at equal displacement, P₁=Pk₁/(k₁+k₂)=800 kN.

steps.title: 新舊樁群分力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pile-group load sharing mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「新舊樁群分力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pile-group load sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測承台轉角與代表樁軸力，核對是否等位移，將不同樁的載重試驗剛度用於比較。分力模型應納入承台轉動與初始荷載；基礎設計者用試驗及監測修正後，再核定最終移交狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure cap rotation and representative pile forces to test equal displacement, using individual load-test stiffnesses for comparison. Include cap rotation and initial loading in sharing models; the foundation designer updates them with tests and monitoring before approving final transfer. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分力模型應納入承台轉動與初始荷載；基礎設計者用試驗及監測修正後，再核定最終移交狀態。並聯彈簧模型未含土體群效與非線性，單組剛度應對應相同荷載區間；舊樁歷史力不能直接重新平均。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Include cap rotation and initial loading in sharing models; the foundation designer updates them with tests and monitoring before approving final transfer. Parallel springs exclude group-soil interaction and nonlinearity; stiffnesses must correspond to the same load range, and historical force in old piles cannot simply be redistributed by averaging.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把剛度不同的樁平均分力，可能讓較硬新樁提前超載，較軟支承卻尚未有效參與。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equal-force allocation between unequal stiffnesses can overload the stiff new group before softer supports contribute effectively. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「新舊樁群分力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
注漿量很多就必然得到較大且完整的黏結直徑。

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
High grout volume necessarily creates a larger continuous bond diameter.
Measure cap rotation and representative pile forces to test equal displacement, using individual load-test stiffnesses for comparison.
quiz.explanation: 量測承台轉角與代表樁軸力，核對是否等位移，將不同樁的載重試驗剛度用於比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure cap rotation and representative pile forces to test equal displacement, using individual load-test stiffnesses for comparison. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 新舊樁群分力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pile-group load sharing mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「新舊樁群分力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pile-group load sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把剛度不同的樁平均分力，可能讓較硬新樁提前超載，較軟支承卻尚未有效參與。並聯彈簧模型未含土體群效與非線性，單組剛度應對應相同荷載區間；舊樁歷史力不能直接重新平均。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equal-force allocation between unequal stiffnesses can overload the stiff new group before softer supports contribute effectively. Parallel springs exclude group-soil interaction and nonlinearity; stiffnesses must correspond to the same load range, and historical force in old piles cannot simply be redistributed by averaging. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：並聯彈簧模型未含土體群效與非線性，單組剛度應對應相同荷載區間；舊樁歷史力不能直接重新平均。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Parallel springs exclude group-soil interaction and nonlinearity; stiffnesses must correspond to the same load range, and historical force in old piles cannot simply be redistributed by averaging.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一承台下所有微型樁一定平均分擔柱力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every micropile under one cap necessarily shares column load equally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把剛度不同的樁平均分力，可能讓較硬新樁提前超載，較軟支承卻尚未有效參與。並聯彈簧模型未含土體群效與非線性，單組剛度應對應相同荷載區間；舊樁歷史力不能直接重新平均。
knowledge.textEn: Equal-force allocation between unequal stiffnesses can overload the stiff new group before softer supports contribute effectively. Parallel springs exclude group-soil interaction and nonlinearity; stiffnesses must correspond to the same load range, and historical force in old piles cannot simply be redistributed by averaging.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「新舊樁群分力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pile-group load sharing mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把剛度不同的樁平均分力，可能讓較硬新樁提前超載，較軟支承卻尚未有效參與。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
微型樁埋在地下，所以任何位置都不需要挫屈檢查。
optionsEn: Equal-force allocation between unequal stiffnesses can overload the stiff new group before softer supports contribute effectively.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A buried micropile never requires buckling checks anywhere along its length.
quiz.explanation: 把剛度不同的樁平均分力，可能讓較硬新樁提前超載，較軟支承卻尚未有效參與。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal-force allocation between unequal stiffnesses can overload the stiff new group before softer supports contribute effectively. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證」與「偏心樁群反力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Unsupported-length buckling mechanism and verification" and "Eccentric group reactions mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unsupported-length buckling mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「無側限段挫屈」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unsupported-length buckling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 微型樁通常受到周圍地層側向約束，但穿越空洞、極軟層或施工開挖區時可能形成無側限長度。鋼套管的挫屈能力便成為重要限制，不能因樁很深就假設全長都有連續支承；接頭偏心與腐蝕也會放大不利影響。歐拉荷重是理想彈性上限，不是允許工作荷載；實際承載需考慮初彎、接頭、塑性與有效端部拘束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無側限段挫屈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground normally restrains micropiles laterally, but voids, very soft layers or excavation can create unsupported lengths. Casing buckling then becomes critical; depth does not guarantee continuous support. Joint eccentricity and corrosion amplify the vulnerability and require checking the actual restrained length rather than assuming full confinement. Euler load is an ideal elastic limit, not working-load permission; actual resistance includes bow, joints, plasticity and effective end restraint. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unsupported-length buckling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：理想鉸接段L=4 m、E=200 GPa、I=1×10⁻⁵ m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=1.23 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For an ideal pinned unsupported segment L=4 m, E=200 GPa and I=1×10⁻⁵ m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=1.23 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「微型樁埋在地下，所以任何位置都不需要挫屈檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A buried micropile never requires buckling checks anywhere along its length." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「無側限段挫屈」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unsupported-length buckling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 微型樁通常受到周圍地層側向約束，但穿越空洞、極軟層或施工開挖區時可能形成無側限長度。鋼套管的挫屈能力便成為重要限制，不能因樁很深就假設全長都有連續支承；接頭偏心與腐蝕也會放大不利影響。
knowledge.textEn: Ground normally restrains micropiles laterally, but voids, very soft layers or excavation can create unsupported lengths. Casing buckling then becomes critical; depth does not guarantee continuous support.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：微型樁埋在地下，所以任何位置都不需要挫屈檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A buried micropile never requires buckling checks anywhere along its length. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Unsupported-length buckling mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 微型樁埋在地下，所以任何位置都不需要挫屈檢查。
微型樁通常受到周圍地層側向約束，但穿越空洞、極軟層或施工開挖區時可能形成無側限長度。

optionsEn: A buried micropile never requires buckling checks anywhere along its length.
Ground normally restrains micropiles laterally, but voids, very soft layers or excavation can create unsupported lengths.
A downward column load can never put an underpinning pile in tension.
quiz.explanation: 微型樁通常受到周圍地層側向約束，但穿越空洞、極軟層或施工開挖區時可能形成無側限長度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

quiz.question: 依「無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unsupported-length buckling mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「無側限段挫屈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unsupported-length buckling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依鑽孔與開挖紀錄界定無側限區，核對套管接頭位置與直線度，檢查橫向地層彈簧可信度。無側限區與套管需求應明列於施工圖；地層流失或新增開挖發現後，設計者須重新核對穩定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define unsupported zones from drilling and excavation records, check casing-joint locations and straightness, and assess credibility of lateral ground springs. Show unsupported zones and casing requirements on drawings; the designer reassesses stability when ground loss or additional excavation occurs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：無側限區與套管需求應明列於施工圖；地層流失或新增開挖發現後，設計者須重新核對穩定。歐拉荷重是理想彈性上限，不是允許工作荷載；實際承載需考慮初彎、接頭、塑性與有效端部拘束。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Show unsupported zones and casing requirements on drawings; the designer reassesses stability when ground loss or additional excavation occurs. Euler load is an ideal elastic limit, not working-load permission; actual resistance includes bow, joints, plasticity and effective end restraint.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：隱藏空洞使有效長度增加，可能在軸應力仍低時發生挫屈，造成托底支承突然失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A hidden void increases effective length and may trigger buckling at low axial stress, abruptly compromising underpinning support. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Unsupported-length buckling mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「無側限段挫屈」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unsupported-length buckling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 隱藏空洞使有效長度增加，可能在軸應力仍低時發生挫屈，造成托底支承突然失效。歐拉荷重是理想彈性上限，不是允許工作荷載；實際承載需考慮初彎、接頭、塑性與有效端部拘束。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A hidden void increases effective length and may trigger buckling at low axial stress, abruptly compromising underpinning support. Euler load is an ideal elastic limit, not working-load permission; actual resistance includes bow, joints, plasticity and effective end restraint. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：歐拉荷重是理想彈性上限，不是允許工作荷載；實際承載需考慮初彎、接頭、塑性與有效端部拘束。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Euler load is an ideal elastic limit, not working-load permission; actual resistance includes bow, joints, plasticity and effective end restraint.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「微型樁埋在地下，所以任何位置都不需要挫屈檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A buried micropile never requires buckling checks anywhere along its length." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 隱藏空洞使有效長度增加，可能在軸應力仍低時發生挫屈，造成托底支承突然失效。歐拉荷重是理想彈性上限，不是允許工作荷載；實際承載需考慮初彎、接頭、塑性與有效端部拘束。
knowledge.textEn: A hidden void increases effective length and may trigger buckling at low axial stress, abruptly compromising underpinning support. Euler load is an ideal elastic limit, not working-load permission; actual resistance includes bow, joints, plasticity and effective end restraint.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Unsupported-length buckling mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
隱藏空洞使有效長度增加，可能在軸應力仍低時發生挫屈，造成托底支承突然失效。
柱力是向下的，就不可能讓任何托底樁受到拉力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A hidden void increases effective length and may trigger buckling at low axial stress, abruptly compromising underpinning support.
A downward column load can never put an underpinning pile in tension.
quiz.explanation: 隱藏空洞使有效長度增加，可能在軸應力仍低時發生挫屈，造成托底支承突然失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A hidden void increases effective length and may trigger buckling at low axial stress, abruptly compromising underpinning support. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 偏心樁群反力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Eccentric group reactions mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「偏心樁群反力」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentric group reactions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 柱中心與新樁群中心不一致時，除了總軸力還會產生力矩，承台需透過不同樁反力或拉壓偶抵抗。若只把總力平均分到樁上，邊樁需求會被低估；既有基礎是否仍接觸也會改變可用的反力分布。力偶式只給兩反力線的增量，不是每樁總力；須加上平均軸力並檢查承台剛度及拉力傳遞是否成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「偏心樁群反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An offset between column and new pile-group centres creates moment in addition to total axial load. The cap resists it through unequal reactions or a tension-compression couple. Averaging total force underestimates edge-pile demand, while continued contact with the original foundation changes the available reaction distribution. The couple equation gives the increment on two reaction lines, not total force per pile; add mean axial load and verify cap stiffness and tensile transfer. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric group reactions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設需抵抗力矩M=300 kN·m、兩反力線距s=2 m，力偶增量ΔP=M/s=150 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For moment M=300 kN·m and reaction-line spacing s=2 m, couple-force increment ΔP=M/s=150 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「柱力是向下的，就不可能讓任何托底樁受到拉力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A downward column load can never put an underpinning pile in tension." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「偏心樁群反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Eccentric group reactions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 偏心樁群反力的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Eccentric group reactions mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 柱中心與新樁群中心不一致時，除了總軸力還會產生力矩，承台需透過不同樁反力或拉壓偶抵抗。若只把總力平均分到樁上，邊樁需求會被低估；既有基礎是否仍接觸也會改變可用的反力分布。
knowledge.textEn: An offset between column and new pile-group centres creates moment in addition to total axial load. The cap resists it through unequal reactions or a tension-compression couple.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：柱力是向下的，就不可能讓任何托底樁受到拉力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A downward column load can never put an underpinning pile in tension. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「偏心樁群反力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Eccentric group reactions mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 柱力是向下的，就不可能讓任何托底樁受到拉力。
接頭越多只會影響速度，不會影響樁的受力品質。
柱中心與新樁群中心不一致時，除了總軸力還會產生力矩，承台需透過不同樁反力或拉壓偶抵抗。
optionsEn: A downward column load can never put an underpinning pile in tension.
More splices affect speed only and never structural quality.
An offset between column and new pile-group centres creates moment in addition to total axial load.
quiz.explanation: 柱中心與新樁群中心不一致時，除了總軸力還會產生力矩，承台需透過不同樁反力或拉壓偶抵抗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An offset between column and new pile-group centres creates moment in addition to total axial load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 偏心樁群反力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Eccentric group reactions mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏心樁群反力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eccentric group reactions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設需抵抗力矩M=300 kN·m、兩反力線距s=2 m，力偶增量ΔP=M/s=150 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For moment M=300 kN·m and reaction-line spacing s=2 m, couple-force increment ΔP=M/s=150 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對柱樁中心與實際樁位，量測承台轉角及邊樁力，將接觸或離縫狀態納入模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check actual column and pile centres, measure cap rotation and edge forces, and include contact or separation in the model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設需抵抗力矩M=300 kN·m、兩反力線距s=2 m，力偶增量ΔP=M/s=150 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For moment M=300 kN·m and reaction-line spacing s=2 m, couple-force increment ΔP=M/s=150 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「偏心樁群反力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Eccentric group reactions mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設需抵抗力矩M=300 kN·m、兩反力線距s=2 m，力偶增量ΔP=M/s=150 kN。
新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。
注漿量很多就必然得到較大且完整的黏結直徑。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For moment M=300 kN·m and reaction-line spacing s=2 m, couple-force increment ΔP=M/s=150 kN.

High grout volume necessarily creates a larger continuous bond diameter.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設需抵抗力矩M=300 kN·m、兩反力線距s=2 m，力偶增量ΔP=M/s=150 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For moment M=300 kN·m and reaction-line spacing s=2 m, couple-force increment ΔP=M/s=150 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eccentric group reactions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對柱樁中心與實際樁位，量測承台轉角及邊樁力，將接觸或離縫狀態納入模型。群樁設計應列垂直力及雙向彎矩組合；樁位超差須由基礎設計者核准重新分力後才驗收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check actual column and pile centres, measure cap rotation and edge forces, and include contact or separation in the model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.instruction: 邊樁可能受拉而原設計只查受壓，接頭與舊承台因此可能先裂開，形成非預期荷載重分配。力偶式只給兩反力線的增量，不是每樁總力；須加上平均軸力並檢查承台剛度及拉力傳遞是否成立。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An edge pile may enter tension although only compression was checked, cracking connections or the old cap and redistributing load unexpectedly. The couple equation gives the increment on two reaction lines, not total force per pile; add mean axial load and verify cap stiffness and tensile transfer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A downward column load can never put an underpinning pile in tension." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「低淨高接頭的機理與驗證」與「移交後沉陷的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification" and "Post-transfer settlement mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 低淨高接頭的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「低淨高接頭」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low-headroom splices” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受限空間的微型樁需以短節鋼材連接，接頭數增加就增加製造、安裝與檢查界面。每個接頭必須傳遞設計軸力及可能的彎曲，螺紋有效截面與套管同軸度也影響承載；施工方便不能取代接合性能證明。節數計算假設有效長度已扣除接合損失，並非加工切割清單；實際端部、接頭搭接與設備淨高需另外協調。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「低淨高接頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Restricted headroom requires short steel sections, increasing fabrication, installation and inspection interfaces. Every splice must transfer design axial force and possible bending, while thread-root area and casing alignment affect resistance. Ease of installation cannot substitute for evidence that the connection performs under the required force combinations. The section count assumes effective lengths already exclude connection loss and is not a fabrication cut list; ends, overlap and equipment headroom require separate coordination. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Low-headroom splices” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設總長L=18 m、每節有效長l=1.5 m，需n=ceil(L/l)=12節，通常有11個節間接頭。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For total length L=18 m and effective section length l=1.5 m, n=ceil(L/l)=12 sections, normally with eleven inter-section joints.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接頭越多只會影響速度，不會影響樁的受力品質。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More splices affect speed only and never structural quality." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「低淨高接頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Low-headroom splices”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 低淨高接頭的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 受限空間的微型樁需以短節鋼材連接，接頭數增加就增加製造、安裝與檢查界面。每個接頭必須傳遞設計軸力及可能的彎曲，螺紋有效截面與套管同軸度也影響承載；施工方便不能取代接合性能證明。
knowledge.textEn: Restricted headroom requires short steel sections, increasing fabrication, installation and inspection interfaces. Every splice must transfer design axial force and possible bending, while thread-root area and casing alignment affect resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接頭越多只會影響速度，不會影響樁的受力品質。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More splices affect speed only and never structural quality. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「低淨高接頭的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 受限空間的微型樁需以短節鋼材連接，接頭數增加就增加製造、安裝與檢查界面。
接頭越多只會影響速度，不會影響樁的受力品質。
載重試驗通過後，既有建物不需要再做沉陷監測。
optionsEn: Restricted headroom requires short steel sections, increasing fabrication, installation and inspection interfaces.
More splices affect speed only and never structural quality.
Passing a load test removes the need for further building-settlement monitoring.

steps.title: 低淨高接頭的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低淨高接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Low-headroom splices” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設總長L=18 m、每節有效長l=1.5 m，需n=ceil(L/l)=12節，通常有11個節間接頭。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For total length L=18 m and effective section length l=1.5 m, n=ceil(L/l)=12 sections, normally with eleven inter-section joints. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對每節長度、接頭序號與安裝證據，對照實際接頭深度及高彎曲或腐蝕區，查漏裝與錯件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify section lengths, splice identifiers and installation evidence against actual depths and high-bending or corrosion zones, checking missing or mismatched parts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設總長L=18 m、每節有效長l=1.5 m，需n=ceil(L/l)=12節，通常有11個節間接頭。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total length L=18 m and effective section length l=1.5 m, n=ceil(L/l)=12 sections, normally with eleven inter-section joints. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「低淨高接頭的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 微型樁平均鋼應力不高，就不用檢查接頭與局部挫屈。
原創教學假設：假設總長L=18 m、每節有效長l=1.5 m，需n=ceil(L/l)=12節，通常有11個節間接頭。

steps.title: 低淨高接頭的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「低淨高接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Low-headroom splices” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對每節長度、接頭序號與安裝證據，對照實際接頭深度及高彎曲或腐蝕區，查漏裝與錯件。接頭型式、檢驗方法及追溯編碼須由結構設計者核准；未完成接合檢查的鋼節不得以後續注漿取代驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify section lengths, splice identifiers and installation evidence against actual depths and high-bending or corrosion zones, checking missing or mismatched parts. The structural designer approves splice type, inspection and traceability; later grouting cannot replace verification of an unaccepted steel connection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接頭型式、檢驗方法及追溯編碼須由結構設計者核准；未完成接合檢查的鋼節不得以後續注漿取代驗證。節數計算假設有效長度已扣除接合損失，並非加工切割清單；實際端部、接頭搭接與設備淨高需另外協調。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural designer approves splice type, inspection and traceability; later grouting cannot replace verification of an unaccepted steel connection. The section count assumes effective lengths already exclude connection loss and is not a fabrication cut list; ends, overlap and equipment headroom require separate coordination.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭未完全接合或軸線偏移會降低有效容量，深埋後難以直接檢查，可能成為長期薄弱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Incomplete engagement or misalignment reduces effective resistance and can become a long-term weak point that is difficult to inspect after burial. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Verify section lengths, splice identifiers and installation evidence against actual depths and high-bending or corrosion zones, checking missing or mismatched parts. The structural designer approves splice type, inspection and traceability; later grouting cannot replace verification of an unaccepted steel connection.

knowledge.text: 接頭型式、檢驗方法及追溯編碼須由結構設計者核准；未完成接合檢查的鋼節不得以後續注漿取代驗證。節數計算假設有效長度已扣除接合損失，並非加工切割清單；實際端部、接頭搭接與設備淨高需另外協調。

quiz.question: 要驗證「低淨高接頭的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
同一承台下所有微型樁一定平均分擔柱力。
核對每節長度、接頭序號與安裝證據，對照實際接頭深度及高彎曲或腐蝕區，查漏裝與錯件。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Every micropile under one cap necessarily shares column load equally.
Verify section lengths, splice identifiers and installation evidence against actual depths and high-bending or corrosion zones, checking missing or mismatched parts.
quiz.explanation: 核對每節長度、接頭序號與安裝證據，對照實際接頭深度及高彎曲或腐蝕區，查漏裝與錯件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify section lengths, splice identifiers and installation evidence against actual depths and high-bending or corrosion zones, checking missing or mismatched parts. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 低淨高接頭的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低淨高接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Low-headroom splices” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接頭未完全接合或軸線偏移會降低有效容量，深埋後難以直接檢查，可能成為長期薄弱點。節數計算假設有效長度已扣除接合損失，並非加工切割清單；實際端部、接頭搭接與設備淨高需另外協調。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Incomplete engagement or misalignment reduces effective resistance and can become a long-term weak point that is difficult to inspect after burial. The section count assumes effective lengths already exclude connection loss and is not a fabrication cut list; ends, overlap and equipment headroom require separate coordination. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：節數計算假設有效長度已扣除接合損失，並非加工切割清單；實際端部、接頭搭接與設備淨高需另外協調。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The section count assumes effective lengths already exclude connection loss and is not a fabrication cut list; ends, overlap and equipment headroom require separate coordination.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接頭越多只會影響速度，不會影響樁的受力品質。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More splices affect speed only and never structural quality." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接頭未完全接合或軸線偏移會降低有效容量，深埋後難以直接檢查，可能成為長期薄弱點。節數計算假設有效長度已扣除接合損失，並非加工切割清單；實際端部、接頭搭接與設備淨高需另外協調。
knowledge.textEn: Incomplete engagement or misalignment reduces effective resistance and can become a long-term weak point that is difficult to inspect after burial. The section count assumes effective lengths already exclude connection loss and is not a fabrication cut list; ends, overlap and equipment headroom require separate coordination.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「低淨高接頭的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 接頭未完全接合或軸線偏移會降低有效容量，深埋後難以直接檢查，可能成為長期薄弱點。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
載重試驗通過後，既有建物不需要再做沉陷監測。
optionsEn: Incomplete engagement or misalignment reduces effective resistance and can become a long-term weak point that is difficult to inspect after burial.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Passing a load test removes the need for further building-settlement monitoring.
quiz.explanation: 接頭未完全接合或軸線偏移會降低有效容量，深埋後難以直接檢查，可能成為長期薄弱點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Incomplete engagement or misalignment reduces effective resistance and can become a long-term weak point that is difficult to inspect after burial. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 移交後沉陷的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-transfer settlement mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「移交後沉陷」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-transfer settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 托底後的沉陷可能來自新樁動員、舊土層壓密或連接變形，不應只以短期試驗合格結束觀察。長期趨勢需與荷載使用、地下水及季節變化一起判讀，固定基準與測點位置則是區分真變形與量測漂移的前提。平均速率可能掩蓋階段性加速，且本數值不是通用合格值；應以資產容許差異變形及量測解析度制定判據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「移交後沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Post-underpinning settlement may reflect new-pile mobilization, consolidation of old soils or connection movement, so short-term test acceptance should not end observation. Long-term trends require load-use, groundwater and seasonal context, with stable references and fixed measurement locations to distinguish actual deformation from instrumental drift. The mean rate can conceal episodic acceleration and is not a universal acceptance value; criteria depend on tolerable differential movement and measurement resolution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Post-transfer settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設沉陷由3 mm增至4 mm、間隔6 month，平均速率v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For settlement increasing from 3 mm to 4 mm over six months, mean rate v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「載重試驗通過後，既有建物不需要再做沉陷監測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing a load test removes the need for further building-settlement monitoring." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「移交後沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Post-transfer settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 移交後沉陷的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 托底後的沉陷可能來自新樁動員、舊土層壓密或連接變形，不應只以短期試驗合格結束觀察。長期趨勢需與荷載使用、地下水及季節變化一起判讀，固定基準與測點位置則是區分真變形與量測漂移的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Post-underpinning settlement may reflect new-pile mobilization, consolidation of old soils or connection movement, so short-term test acceptance should not end observation. Long-term trends require load-use, groundwater and seasonal context, with stable references and fixed measurement locations to distinguish actual deformation from instrumental drift.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：載重試驗通過後，既有建物不需要再做沉陷監測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing a load test removes the need for further building-settlement monitoring. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「移交後沉陷的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-transfer settlement mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 載重試驗通過後，既有建物不需要再做沉陷監測。
托底後的沉陷可能來自新樁動員、舊土層壓密或連接變形，不應只以短期試驗合格結束觀察。
新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。
optionsEn: Passing a load test removes the need for further building-settlement monitoring.
Post-underpinning settlement may reflect new-pile mobilization, consolidation of old soils or connection movement, so short-term test acceptance should not end observation.
New-pile capacity above the original column force makes current use irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 托底後的沉陷可能來自新樁動員、舊土層壓密或連接變形，不應只以短期試驗合格結束觀察。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Post-underpinning settlement may reflect new-pile mobilization, consolidation of old soils or connection movement, so short-term test acceptance should not end observation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 移交後沉陷的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-transfer settlement mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「移交後沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-transfer settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設沉陷由3 mm增至4 mm、間隔6 month，平均速率v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For settlement increasing from 3 mm to 4 mm over six months, mean rate v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將柱、承台及相鄰未托底基礎同步水準測量，對照使用荷載及水位，檢查差異而非只看單點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Level columns, caps and adjacent untreated foundations together, comparing loads and groundwater and examining differences rather than one isolated point.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設沉陷由3 mm增至4 mm、間隔6 month，平均速率v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For settlement increasing from 3 mm to 4 mm over six months, mean rate v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「移交後沉陷的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-transfer settlement mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 注漿量很多就必然得到較大且完整的黏結直徑。
新樁完工後會立刻自然承擔所有設計荷載比例。
原創教學假設：假設沉陷由3 mm增至4 mm、間隔6 month，平均速率v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month。
optionsEn: High grout volume necessarily creates a larger continuous bond diameter.
Completed new piles immediately carry every intended design load share naturally.
Original teaching assumptions: For settlement increasing from 3 mm to 4 mm over six months, mean rate v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設沉陷由3 mm增至4 mm、間隔6 month，平均速率v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For settlement increasing from 3 mm to 4 mm over six months, mean rate v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 移交後沉陷的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-transfer settlement mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「移交後沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-transfer settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將柱、承台及相鄰未托底基礎同步水準測量，對照使用荷載及水位，檢查差異而非只看單點。交接列出監測期限、終止條件及使用變更通報；異常速率由地工與既有結構設計者共同判讀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Level columns, caps and adjacent untreated foundations together, comparing loads and groundwater and examining differences rather than one isolated point. Handover defines monitoring duration, closure criteria and change-of-use reporting; geotechnical and existing-structure designers jointly interpret abnormal movement rates. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接列出監測期限、終止條件及使用變更通報；異常速率由地工與既有結構設計者共同判讀。平均速率可能掩蓋階段性加速，且本數值不是通用合格值；應以資產容許差異變形及量測解析度制定判據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover defines monitoring duration, closure criteria and change-of-use reporting; geotechnical and existing-structure designers jointly interpret abnormal movement rates. The mean rate can conceal episodic acceleration and is not a universal acceptance value; criteria depend on tolerable differential movement and measurement resolution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：停止追蹤可能漏掉連接逐步滑移，直到門窗卡住或新裂縫出現才發現托底尚未穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stopping observations can miss progressive connection slip until doors bind or new cracks reveal that underpinning performance has not stabilized. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Handover defines monitoring duration, closure criteria and change-of-use reporting; geotechnical and existing-structure designers jointly interpret abnormal movement rates.
