steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「載重試驗通過後，既有建物不需要再做沉陷監測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing a load test removes the need for further building-settlement monitoring." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 停止追蹤可能漏掉連接逐步滑移，直到門窗卡住或新裂縫出現才發現托底尚未穩定。平均速率可能掩蓋階段性加速，且本數值不是通用合格值；應以資產容許差異變形及量測解析度制定判據。
knowledge.textEn: Stopping observations can miss progressive connection slip until doors bind or new cracks reveal that underpinning performance has not stabilized. The mean rate can conceal episodic acceleration and is not a universal acceptance value; criteria depend on tolerable differential movement and measurement resolution.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「移交後沉陷的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-transfer settlement mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
停止追蹤可能漏掉連接逐步滑移，直到門窗卡住或新裂縫出現才發現托底尚未穩定。
新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Stopping observations can miss progressive connection slip until doors bind or new cracks reveal that underpinning performance has not stabilized.
New-pile capacity above the original column force makes current use irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 停止追蹤可能漏掉連接逐步滑移，直到門窗卡住或新裂縫出現才發現托底尚未穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Stopping observations can miss progressive connection slip until doors bind or new cracks reveal that underpinning performance has not stabilized. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 噴射灌漿地盤改良
summary: 噴射灌漿以高能流體侵蝕並混合原土，形成幾何與材料性質受地層控制的改良體。本課區分止水與承載需求，從滲流、咬合、材料留存及返漿量平衡出發，逐步檢查強度發展、複合地盤分力、鑽孔偏斜和統計變異，最後以水力試驗驗證整體功能。
summaryEn: Jet grouting erodes and mixes soil to form treated bodies whose geometry and properties depend on ground conditions. The course separates cutoff and bearing functions, linking seepage, overlap, binder retention and return balance to strength, composite-ground sharing, bore deviation and variability, then verifies overall performance hydraulically.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設均質改良體滲透係數k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、水力坡降i=2，流量Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。只把k增加10%至1.1×10⁻⁸ m/s，其他量不變，Q=2.2×10⁻⁶ m³/s，也增加10%。此線性敏感度只對固定幾何與達西流成立；若有貫通缺口，總流量可能由另一機制控制。驗證時要記錄上下游水頭、面積與有效流路，並結合取芯及全深幾何，不能用低流量或高強度單獨宣稱整體止水合格。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume homogeneous permeability k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and hydraulic gradient i=2. Darcy discharge is Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. Increase only k by 10% to 1.1×10⁻⁸ m/s while holding other inputs fixed: Q becomes 2.2×10⁻⁶ m³/s, also up 10%. This linear sensitivity requires fixed geometry and Darcy flow; a connected defect may instead control total discharge through another mechanism. Verification records upstream and downstream heads, area and effective paths, combining cores and full-depth geometry rather than inferring system sealing from low flow or high strength alone. The designer must verify that the test boundaries represent the intended permanent hydraulic condition.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」與「柱體交疊的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification" and "Column overlap mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「改良體滲流」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Treated-ground seepage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。均質達西模型可估平均流量，但施工接面、未改良夾層或縮頸會提供短路徑，平均滲透係數低並不能保證整個帷幕水密；驗收須同時涵蓋材料與幾何。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「改良體滲流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength. A homogeneous Darcy model estimates mean flow, but interfaces, untreated seams and necking create bypasses. Low average permeability therefore does not prove a sealed curtain; acceptance must address both material properties and geometry. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Treated-ground seepage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「改良體滲流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Treated-ground seepage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。均質達西模型可估平均流量，但施工接面、未改良夾層或縮頸會提供短路徑，平均滲透係數低並不能保證整個帷幕水密；驗收須同時涵蓋材料與幾何。
knowledge.textEn: For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength. A homogeneous Darcy model estimates mean flow, but interfaces, untreated seams and necking create bypasses.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。
改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。
每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。
optionsEn: High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance.
For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength.
Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone.
quiz.explanation: 改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「改良體滲流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Treated-ground seepage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。
後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。
原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。
optionsEn: A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent.
A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally.
Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「改良體滲流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Treated-ground seepage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths. Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths. Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.

quiz.question: 要驗證「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification"?
options: 對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
地面樁位符合容差，就無需再查深部軸線。
optionsEn: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Compliant surface position removes the need to check the deep column axis.
quiz.explanation: 對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「改良體滲流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Treated-ground seepage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。
每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff.
Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone.
quiz.explanation: 高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Column overlap mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「柱體交疊」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Column overlap” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 噴射柱的直徑隨土種、設備反應與施工條件改變，設計中心距必須給直徑變異留出餘裕。相鄰柱在某個深度相交，不代表全深都連續；黏土團塊、礫石或夾層可能讓截面不圓，應以試驗柱與全深證據建立保守幾何。等直徑咬合式只描述理想平行圓柱，真實不規則截面需用最小有效尺寸；重疊也不自動證明接面黏結。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「柱體交疊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jet-column diameter changes with soil, equipment response and execution conditions, so spacing must accommodate variability. Intersection at one depth does not establish full-depth continuity. Clay lumps, gravel and layering can create noncircular sections, requiring trial columns and full-depth evidence to define conservative geometry. Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Column overlap” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「柱體交疊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Column overlap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 噴射柱的直徑隨土種、設備反應與施工條件改變，設計中心距必須給直徑變異留出餘裕。相鄰柱在某個深度相交，不代表全深都連續；黏土團塊、礫石或夾層可能讓截面不圓，應以試驗柱與全深證據建立保守幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Jet-column diameter changes with soil, equipment response and execution conditions, so spacing must accommodate variability. Intersection at one depth does not establish full-depth continuity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「柱體交疊的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Column overlap mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。
注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。
噴射柱的直徑隨土種、設備反應與施工條件改變，設計中心距必須給直徑變異留出餘裕。
optionsEn: Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone.
All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column.
Jet-column diameter changes with soil, equipment response and execution conditions, so spacing must accommodate variability.
quiz.explanation: 噴射柱的直徑隨土種、設備反應與施工條件改變，設計中心距必須給直徑變異留出餘裕。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Jet-column diameter changes with soil, equipment response and execution conditions, so spacing must accommodate variability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Column overlap mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柱體交疊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Column overlap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以試驗柱揭露或核定探測取得分層直徑，結合孔斜重建最小交疊，不只查柱頂。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain layered diameters from exposed trial columns or approved investigation, combining them with bore deviation to reconstruct minimum overlap beyond the column head.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「柱體交疊的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Column overlap mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。
返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。
改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m.
Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better.
Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Column overlap mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「柱體交疊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Column overlap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以試驗柱揭露或核定探測取得分層直徑，結合孔斜重建最小交疊，不只查柱頂。柱距及補柱決策須依最不利地層試驗；地工設計者核定幾何不確定度與驗證位置後才施工。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain layered diameters from exposed trial columns or approved investigation, combining them with bore deviation to reconstruct minimum overlap beyond the column head. Spacing and supplementary columns follow trials in adverse strata; the geotechnical designer approves geometric uncertainty and verification locations before execution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：柱距及補柱決策須依最不利地層試驗；地工設計者核定幾何不確定度與驗證位置後才施工。等直徑咬合式只描述理想平行圓柱，真實不規則截面需用最小有效尺寸；重疊也不自動證明接面黏結。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Spacing and supplementary columns follow trials in adverse strata; the geotechnical designer approves geometric uncertainty and verification locations before execution. Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部縮頸可能留下貫通水路，即使柱頂直徑達標也無法彌補深部未交疊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local necking can leave a connected water path that adequate head diameter cannot compensate for. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Local necking can leave a connected water path that adequate head diameter cannot compensate for.
quiz.explanation: 局部縮頸可能留下貫通水路，即使柱頂直徑達標也無法彌補深部未交疊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local necking can leave a connected water path that adequate head diameter cannot compensate for. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「膠結材料留存的機理與驗證」與「直徑面積效應的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Binder retention mechanism and verification" and "Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 膠結材料留存的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Binder retention mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「膠結材料留存」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Binder retention” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 注入膠結材料有一部分隨返漿排出，另一部分留在地盤中參與固化，所以投入量不能直接當改良體配比。原土含水及返漿固體濃度會影響質量平衡，若只量體積而不量密度與成分，便無法合理判定實際留存量。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「膠結材料留存」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Some injected binder leaves with returns while the remainder participates in ground solidification, so input quantity is not the treated-body mix ratio. Soil water and return solids affect the mass balance. Volume alone, without density and composition, cannot reliably establish how much binder remains in the ground. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Binder retention” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設注入乾膠結材Min=1000 kg、返漿帶出同材Mout=250 kg，留存Mret=Min−Mout=750 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For injected dry binder Min=1000 kg and the same binder recovered in returns Mout=250 kg, retained Mret=750 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「膠結材料留存」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Binder retention”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 膠結材料留存的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 注入膠結材料有一部分隨返漿排出，另一部分留在地盤中參與固化，所以投入量不能直接當改良體配比。原土含水及返漿固體濃度會影響質量平衡，若只量體積而不量密度與成分，便無法合理判定實際留存量。
knowledge.textEn: Some injected binder leaves with returns while the remainder participates in ground solidification, so input quantity is not the treated-body mix ratio. Soil water and return solids affect the mass balance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「膠結材料留存的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Binder retention mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 注入膠結材料有一部分隨返漿排出，另一部分留在地盤中參與固化，所以投入量不能直接當改良體配比。
注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。
直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。
optionsEn: Some injected binder leaves with returns while the remainder participates in ground solidification, so input quantity is not the treated-body mix ratio.
All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column.
A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent.
quiz.explanation: 注入膠結材料有一部分隨返漿排出，另一部分留在地盤中參與固化，所以投入量不能直接當改良體配比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Some injected binder leaves with returns while the remainder participates in ground solidification, so input quantity is not the treated-body mix ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 膠結材料留存的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Binder retention mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膠結材料留存」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Binder retention” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設注入乾膠結材Min=1000 kg、返漿帶出同材Mout=250 kg，留存Mret=Min−Mout=750 kg。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For injected dry binder Min=1000 kg and the same binder recovered in returns Mout=250 kg, retained Mret=750 kg. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量注入與返漿體積、密度及代表性固體成分，明確區分原土固體與膠結材。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure input and return volumes, densities and representative solids together, explicitly distinguishing native-soil solids from binder.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設注入乾膠結材Min=1000 kg、返漿帶出同材Mout=250 kg，留存Mret=Min−Mout=750 kg。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For injected dry binder Min=1000 kg and the same binder recovered in returns Mout=250 kg, retained Mret=750 kg. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「膠結材料留存的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Binder retention mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。
原創教學假設：假設注入乾膠結材Min=1000 kg、返漿帶出同材Mout=250 kg，留存Mret=Min−Mout=750 kg。
地面樁位符合容差，就無需再查深部軸線。
optionsEn: A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally.
Original teaching assumptions: For injected dry binder Min=1000 kg and the same binder recovered in returns Mout=250 kg, retained Mret=750 kg.
Compliant surface position removes the need to check the deep column axis.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設注入乾膠結材Min=1000 kg、返漿帶出同材Mout=250 kg，留存Mret=Min−Mout=750 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For injected dry binder Min=1000 kg and the same binder recovered in returns Mout=250 kg, retained Mret=750 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 膠結材料留存的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Binder retention mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「膠結材料留存」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Binder retention” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量注入與返漿體積、密度及代表性固體成分，明確區分原土固體與膠結材。質量表需註明取樣方法與成分不確定度；材料負責人及地工設計者共同解釋異常留存率後才調整方案。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure input and return volumes, densities and representative solids together, explicitly distinguishing native-soil solids from binder. The balance identifies sampling and composition uncertainty; materials and geotechnical leads interpret anomalous retention together before modifying the scheme. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：質量表需註明取樣方法與成分不確定度；材料負責人及地工設計者共同解釋異常留存率後才調整方案。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The balance identifies sampling and composition uncertainty; materials and geotechnical leads interpret anomalous retention together before modifying the scheme. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將返漿全部固體當水泥或忽略返出損失，會錯估留存配比，造成強度預測與實測不符。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all return solids as cement or ignoring binder loss misstates retained mix and causes strength predictions to diverge from tests. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量注入與返漿體積、密度及代表性固體成分，明確區分原土固體與膠結材。質量表需註明取樣方法與成分不確定度；材料負責人及地工設計者共同解釋異常留存率後才調整方案。
knowledge.textEn: Measure input and return volumes, densities and representative solids together, explicitly distinguishing native-soil solids from binder. The balance identifies sampling and composition uncertainty; materials and geotechnical leads interpret anomalous retention together before modifying the scheme.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 質量表需註明取樣方法與成分不確定度；材料負責人及地工設計者共同解釋異常留存率後才調整方案。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。
knowledge.textEn: The balance identifies sampling and composition uncertainty; materials and geotechnical leads interpret anomalous retention together before modifying the scheme. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「膠結材料留存的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Binder retention mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
流量除以滲透係數與面積，得到的單位就是公尺。
同步量注入與返漿體積、密度及代表性固體成分，明確區分原土固體與膠結材。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Flow divided by permeability and area has units of metres.
Measure input and return volumes, densities and representative solids together, explicitly distinguishing native-soil solids from binder.
quiz.explanation: 同步量注入與返漿體積、密度及代表性固體成分，明確區分原土固體與膠結材。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure input and return volumes, densities and representative solids together, explicitly distinguishing native-soil solids from binder. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 膠結材料留存的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Binder retention mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「膠結材料留存」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Binder retention” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將返漿全部固體當水泥或忽略返出損失，會錯估留存配比，造成強度預測與實測不符。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating all return solids as cement or ignoring binder loss misstates retained mix and causes strength predictions to diverge from tests. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將返漿全部固體當水泥或忽略返出損失，會錯估留存配比，造成強度預測與實測不符。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。
knowledge.textEn: Treating all return solids as cement or ignoring binder loss misstates retained mix and causes strength predictions to diverge from tests. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「膠結材料留存的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Binder retention mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 將返漿全部固體當水泥或忽略返出損失，會錯估留存配比，造成強度預測與實測不符。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。
optionsEn: Treating all return solids as cement or ignoring binder loss misstates retained mix and causes strength predictions to diverge from tests.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent.
quiz.explanation: 將返漿全部固體當水泥或忽略返出損失，會錯估留存配比，造成強度預測與實測不符。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating all return solids as cement or ignoring binder loss misstates retained mix and causes strength predictions to diverge from tests. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 直徑面積效應的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「直徑面積效應」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diameter-area effect” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良柱直徑影響承載面積與交疊，但增大幾何尺寸不一定同比增加均勻強度區。噴射侵蝕受地層可侵蝕性控制，粗粒或高塑性夾層可讓外形及品質不同；方案比較應把幾何面積、材料性能與有效受力區分開列示。面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「直徑面積效應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Column diameter affects bearing area and overlap, but larger geometry does not necessarily enlarge the uniformly strong zone proportionally. Erodibility controls jet response, and coarse or highly plastic layers change shape and quality. Compare geometric area, material performance and effective loaded area separately in option studies. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diameter-area effect” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設圓截面直徑由D₁=1.0 m增至D₂=1.4 m，面積比A₂/A₁=(D₂/D₁)²=1.96。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For circular diameters D₁=1.0 m and D₂=1.4 m, area ratio A₂/A₁=(D₂/D₁)²=1.96.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「直徑面積效應」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diameter-area effect”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 直徑面積效應的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 改良柱直徑影響承載面積與交疊，但增大幾何尺寸不一定同比增加均勻強度區。噴射侵蝕受地層可侵蝕性控制，粗粒或高塑性夾層可讓外形及品質不同；方案比較應把幾何面積、材料性能與有效受力區分開列示。
knowledge.textEn: Column diameter affects bearing area and overlap, but larger geometry does not necessarily enlarge the uniformly strong zone proportionally. Erodibility controls jet response, and coarse or highly plastic layers change shape and quality.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「直徑面積效應的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。
改良柱直徑影響承載面積與交疊，但增大幾何尺寸不一定同比增加均勻強度區。
返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。
optionsEn: A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent.
Column diameter affects bearing area and overlap, but larger geometry does not necessarily enlarge the uniformly strong zone proportionally.
Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better.
quiz.explanation: 改良柱直徑影響承載面積與交疊，但增大幾何尺寸不一定同比增加均勻強度區。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Column diameter affects bearing area and overlap, but larger geometry does not necessarily enlarge the uniformly strong zone proportionally. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 直徑面積效應的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「直徑面積效應」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diameter-area effect” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設圓截面直徑由D₁=1.0 m增至D₂=1.4 m，面積比A₂/A₁=(D₂/D₁)²=1.96。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For circular diameters D₁=1.0 m and D₂=1.4 m, area ratio A₂/A₁=(D₂/D₁)²=1.96. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分層試驗柱尺寸與取芯均勻度比較不同方案，檢查增加面積是否位於實際受力或止水區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare layered trial-column dimensions and core uniformity, checking whether additional area lies within the actual bearing or cutoff zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

Meeting mean strength makes the lower tail and sampling positions irrelevant.

steps.title: 直徑面積效應的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「直徑面積效應」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diameter-area effect” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分層試驗柱尺寸與取芯均勻度比較不同方案，檢查增加面積是否位於實際受力或止水區。設計圖須區分名目直徑與有效改良直徑；地工設計者依試驗結果核定用於承載的範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare layered trial-column dimensions and core uniformity, checking whether additional area lies within the actual bearing or cutoff zone. Distinguish nominal and effective treated diameters on drawings; the geotechnical designer approves the area credited for resistance from trial evidence. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計圖須區分名目直徑與有效改良直徑；地工設計者依試驗結果核定用於承載的範圍。面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Distinguish nominal and effective treated diameters on drawings; the geotechnical designer approves the area credited for resistance from trial evidence. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用理想直徑放大容量可能忽略邊緣低強度區，造成受力集中與不均勻壓縮。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Scaling resistance by ideal diameter can overlook weak margins, concentrating load and producing differential compression. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Distinguish nominal and effective treated diameters on drawings; the geotechnical designer approves the area credited for resistance from trial evidence.

knowledge.textEn: Distinguish nominal and effective treated diameters on drawings; the geotechnical designer approves the area credited for resistance from trial evidence. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「直徑面積效應的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification"?
options: 以分層試驗柱尺寸與取芯均勻度比較不同方案，檢查增加面積是否位於實際受力或止水區。

噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare layered trial-column dimensions and core uniformity, checking whether additional area lies within the actual bearing or cutoff zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 直徑面積效應的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「直徑面積效應」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diameter-area effect” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用理想直徑放大容量可能忽略邊緣低強度區，造成受力集中與不均勻壓縮。面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Scaling resistance by ideal diameter can overlook weak margins, concentrating load and producing differential compression. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用理想直徑放大容量可能忽略邊緣低強度區，造成受力集中與不均勻壓縮。面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Scaling resistance by ideal diameter can overlook weak margins, concentrating load and producing differential compression. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「直徑面積效應的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用理想直徑放大容量可能忽略邊緣低強度區，造成受力集中與不均勻壓縮。
返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Scaling resistance by ideal diameter can overlook weak margins, concentrating load and producing differential compression.
Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better.
quiz.explanation: 用理想直徑放大容量可能忽略邊緣低強度區，造成受力集中與不均勻壓縮。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scaling resistance by ideal diameter can overlook weak margins, concentrating load and producing differential compression. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「返漿體積平衡的機理與驗證」與「強度齡期發展的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Return-volume balance mechanism and verification" and "Strength development mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 返漿體積平衡的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Return-volume balance mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「返漿體積平衡」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Return-volume balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 返漿提供注入流體及被侵蝕土粒離開地盤的路徑，返漿不足可能是滯留、堵塞或側向漏失，不能直接解釋為改良效率提高。體積差需連同密度、地表隆起及孔隙水壓判讀，才能分辨材料留存與不希望的地層位移。體積差不是純土體壓縮量，也不是乾膠結材質量；含水、氣泡、原土排出及量測延遲都可能影響此平衡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「返漿體積平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Returns provide an exit for injected fluid and eroded soil. Reduced returns may indicate retention, blockage or lateral loss rather than improved treatment efficiency. Interpret volume differences with density, surface heave and pore pressure to distinguish useful material retention from undesirable displacement of the surrounding ground. Volume difference is neither pure soil compression nor dry binder mass; water, air, removed native soil and measurement delay all affect the balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Return-volume balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設注入Vin=4 m³、量得返出Vout=3.2 m³，未平衡體積ΔV=0.8 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For input Vin=4 m³ and measured returns Vout=3.2 m³, unbalanced volume ΔV=0.8 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「返漿體積平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Return-volume balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 返漿體積平衡的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 返漿提供注入流體及被侵蝕土粒離開地盤的路徑，返漿不足可能是滯留、堵塞或側向漏失，不能直接解釋為改良效率提高。體積差需連同密度、地表隆起及孔隙水壓判讀，才能分辨材料留存與不希望的地層位移。
knowledge.textEn: Returns provide an exit for injected fluid and eroded soil. Reduced returns may indicate retention, blockage or lateral loss rather than improved treatment efficiency.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「返漿體積平衡的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Return-volume balance mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。
後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。
返漿提供注入流體及被侵蝕土粒離開地盤的路徑，返漿不足可能是滯留、堵塞或側向漏失，不能直接解釋為改良效率提高。
optionsEn: Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better.
A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally.
Returns provide an exit for injected fluid and eroded soil.

quiz.explanationEn: Returns provide an exit for injected fluid and eroded soil. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 返漿體積平衡的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Return-volume balance mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「返漿體積平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Return-volume balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設注入Vin=4 m³、量得返出Vout=3.2 m³，未平衡體積ΔV=0.8 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For input Vin=4 m³ and measured returns Vout=3.2 m³, unbalanced volume ΔV=0.8 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄返漿量、孔壓與地表位移，追查取樣及儲槽延遲，避免把暫時管內容積當地下留存。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize returns, pore pressure and surface movement, checking sampling and tank delays so that temporary pipe storage is not counted as subsurface retention.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 返漿體積平衡的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「返漿體積平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instructionEn: Synchronize returns, pore pressure and surface movement, checking sampling and tank delays so that temporary pipe storage is not counted as subsurface retention. Provide a joint hold point for abnormal returns and heave; geotechnical and construction leads determine material destination before approving further work. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：返漿異常與隆起應有共同停留點；地工及施工負責人查明去向後，才核定後續施工條件。體積差不是純土體壓縮量，也不是乾膠結材質量；含水、氣泡、原土排出及量測延遲都可能影響此平衡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Provide a joint hold point for abnormal returns and heave; geotechnical and construction leads determine material destination before approving further work. Volume difference is neither pure soil compression nor dry binder mass; water, air, removed native soil and measurement delay all affect the balance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：返漿通道阻塞可使地層隆起或漿液沿弱面外逸，鄰近管線可能在柱體強度形成前就受損。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Blocked returns can heave ground or force grout along weak planes, damaging nearby utilities before column strength develops. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。

steps.title: 返漿體積平衡的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Return-volume balance mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「返漿體積平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Return-volume balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 返漿通道阻塞可使地層隆起或漿液沿弱面外逸，鄰近管線可能在柱體強度形成前就受損。體積差不是純土體壓縮量，也不是乾膠結材質量；含水、氣泡、原土排出及量測延遲都可能影響此平衡。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked returns can heave ground or force grout along weak planes, damaging nearby utilities before column strength develops. Volume difference is neither pure soil compression nor dry binder mass; water, air, removed native soil and measurement delay all affect the balance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：體積差不是純土體壓縮量，也不是乾膠結材質量；含水、氣泡、原土排出及量測延遲都可能影響此平衡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Volume difference is neither pure soil compression nor dry binder mass; water, air, removed native soil and measurement delay all affect the balance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 返漿通道阻塞可使地層隆起或漿液沿弱面外逸，鄰近管線可能在柱體強度形成前就受損。體積差不是純土體壓縮量，也不是乾膠結材質量；含水、氣泡、原土排出及量測延遲都可能影響此平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Blocked returns can heave ground or force grout along weak planes, damaging nearby utilities before column strength develops. Volume difference is neither pure soil compression nor dry binder mass; water, air, removed native soil and measurement delay all affect the balance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「返漿體積平衡的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Return-volume balance mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。
返漿通道阻塞可使地層隆起或漿液沿弱面外逸，鄰近管線可能在柱體強度形成前就受損。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally.
Blocked returns can heave ground or force grout along weak planes, damaging nearby utilities before column strength develops.
quiz.explanation: 返漿通道阻塞可使地層隆起或漿液沿弱面外逸，鄰近管線可能在柱體強度形成前就受損。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Blocked returns can heave ground or force grout along weak planes, damaging nearby utilities before column strength develops. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 強度齡期發展的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Strength development mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「強度齡期發展」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strength development” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水泥土強度隨齡期及養護條件增加，但土體有機物、含水量與混合均勻度可能限制反應。早期強度與後期強度比例可比較材料發展，卻不能把單一比值套到所有土層；現場芯樣的擾動與尺寸也需和室內試體區分。強度比不是長期耐久或水密證明，且必須使用可比較的試體與試驗方法；不同養護條件不得直接合併。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「強度齡期發展」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Soil-cement strength develops with age and curing, but organic content, water and mixing uniformity can limit reactions. An early-to-late strength ratio compares development but is not universal across strata. Disturbance and dimensions of field cores must also be distinguished from laboratory specimens when interpreting the apparent gain. The ratio proves neither durability nor sealing and requires comparable specimens and methods; incompatible curing conditions must not be pooled directly. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Strength development” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設同類試體早期qu₁=1.2 MPa、後期qu₂=2.4 MPa，強度比qu₂/qu₁=2.0。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For comparable specimens with early qu₁=1.2 MPa and later qu₂=2.4 MPa, strength ratio qu₂/qu₁=2.0.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「強度齡期發展」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Strength development”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Soil-cement strength develops with age and curing, but organic content, water and mixing uniformity can limit reactions. An early-to-late strength ratio compares development but is not universal across strata.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「強度齡期發展的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strength development mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 水泥土強度隨齡期及養護條件增加，但土體有機物、含水量與混合均勻度可能限制反應。
後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。
改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。
optionsEn: Soil-cement strength develops with age and curing, but organic content, water and mixing uniformity can limit reactions.
A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally.
Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column.

steps.title: 強度齡期發展的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strength development mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「強度齡期發展」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strength development” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依地層與齡期分組試驗，保留養護溫度、尺寸與破壞型態，檢查現場取芯是否代表弱區。試驗計畫應預先處理取芯失敗與異常低值；材料及地工設計者共同判讀，不能任意刪除不利資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Group tests by stratum and age, retaining curing temperature, specimen dimensions and failure mode, and check whether field cores represent weak zones. The testing plan defines treatment of core loss and low results in advance; materials and geotechnical designers interpret them without arbitrary removal of adverse data. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

The ratio proves neither durability nor sealing and requires comparable specimens and methods; incompatible curing conditions must not be pooled directly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只挑完整芯樣會高估強度，未成芯區若被排除，最薄弱的改良體可能完全沒有進入統計。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Selecting only intact cores inflates strength; excluding uncoreable intervals can remove the weakest treated ground from the statistics entirely. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 強度齡期發展的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strength development mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「強度齡期發展」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strength development” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只挑完整芯樣會高估強度，未成芯區若被排除，最薄弱的改良體可能完全沒有進入統計。強度比不是長期耐久或水密證明，且必須使用可比較的試體與試驗方法；不同養護條件不得直接合併。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Selecting only intact cores inflates strength; excluding uncoreable intervals can remove the weakest treated ground from the statistics entirely. The ratio proves neither durability nor sealing and requires comparable specimens and methods; incompatible curing conditions must not be pooled directly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：強度比不是長期耐久或水密證明，且必須使用可比較的試體與試驗方法；不同養護條件不得直接合併。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

The ratio proves neither durability nor sealing and requires comparable specimens and methods; incompatible curing conditions must not be pooled directly.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「強度齡期發展的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strength development mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「複合地盤分力的機理與驗證」與「鑽孔偏斜的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Composite-ground sharing mechanism and verification" and "Bore deviation mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 複合地盤分力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite-ground sharing mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「複合地盤分力」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Composite-ground sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良柱與周圍原土共同承受上部荷載，剛度較高的柱往往承擔較高應力。等應變模型可推導柱土應力比，但需有足夠剛性上部荷載分配層；柔性載重、局部沉陷與柱端條件會使真實分力偏離簡化模型。式中n是相應應變下的剛度比，不是抗壓強度比；柱體承載、原土剪力與整體沉陷仍須分別檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「複合地盤分力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treated columns and native soil share load, with stiffer columns generally carrying greater stress. Equal-strain analysis derives a column-soil stress ratio but requires sufficiently rigid load distribution. Flexible loading, local settlement and toe conditions can produce sharing that differs substantially from the simplified relation. Here n is a stiffness ratio at corresponding strain, not a strength ratio; column resistance, native-soil shear and overall settlement still require separate checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Composite-ground sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設平均q=100 kPa、面積比a=0.3、柱土剛度比n=5且等應變，σc=q/[a+(1−a)/n]=227 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For mean q=100 kPa, area ratio a=0.3 and stiffness ratio n=5 under equal strain, σc=q/[a+(1−a)/n]=227 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「複合地盤分力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Composite-ground sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 複合地盤分力的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 改良柱與周圍原土共同承受上部荷載，剛度較高的柱往往承擔較高應力。等應變模型可推導柱土應力比，但需有足夠剛性上部荷載分配層；柔性載重、局部沉陷與柱端條件會使真實分力偏離簡化模型。
knowledge.textEn: Treated columns and native soil share load, with stiffer columns generally carrying greater stress. Equal-strain analysis derives a column-soil stress ratio but requires sufficiently rigid load distribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「複合地盤分力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Composite-ground sharing mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。
改良柱與周圍原土共同承受上部荷載，剛度較高的柱往往承擔較高應力。
地面樁位符合容差，就無需再查深部軸線。
optionsEn: Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column.
Treated columns and native soil share load, with stiffer columns generally carrying greater stress.
Compliant surface position removes the need to check the deep column axis.
quiz.explanation: 改良柱與周圍原土共同承受上部荷載，剛度較高的柱往往承擔較高應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
