steps.title: 複合地盤分力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Composite-ground sharing mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「複合地盤分力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Composite-ground sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設平均q=100 kPa、面積比a=0.3、柱土剛度比n=5且等應變，σc=q/[a+(1−a)/n]=227 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For mean q=100 kPa, area ratio a=0.3 and stiffness ratio n=5 under equal strain, σc=q/[a+(1−a)/n]=227 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測柱頂及土間壓力與沉陷，核對荷載分配層剛度，使用相同荷載範圍的柱土模數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure column-head and intervening-soil pressures with settlement, check load-transfer-layer stiffness, and use moduli from matching load ranges.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 量測柱頂及土間壓力與沉陷，核對荷載分配層剛度，使用相同荷載範圍的柱土模數。設計者應明確標示等應變假設與負載轉移層；試驗不支持此假設時，需改用符合實際邊界的互制分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure column-head and intervening-soil pressures with settlement, check load-transfer-layer stiffness, and use moduli from matching load ranges. The designer states equal-strain and load-transfer-layer assumptions; if measurements do not support them, use an interaction model consistent with actual boundaries. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計者應明確標示等應變假設與負載轉移層；試驗不支持此假設時，需改用符合實際邊界的互制分析。式中n是相應應變下的剛度比，不是抗壓強度比；柱體承載、原土剪力與整體沉陷仍須分別檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The designer states equal-strain and load-transfer-layer assumptions; if measurements do not support them, use an interaction model consistent with actual boundaries. Here n is a stiffness ratio at corresponding strain, not a strength ratio; column resistance, native-soil shear and overall settlement still require separate checks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只把平均載重當柱應力會低估柱體需求，局部破壞後荷載又轉到鄰柱並擴大差異沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using average load as column stress understates demand; local column failure transfers force to neighbours and enlarges differential settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 鑽孔偏斜的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bore deviation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鑽孔偏斜」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bore deviation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 噴射柱的軸線取決於鑽孔軌跡，深部小偏斜會減少相鄰柱交疊或接近地下資產。名目柱徑不能自動吸收所有偏差，尤其在需閉合止水的底部或轉角；幾何驗證應採實際軌跡而不是只有地面放樣位置。固定偏斜式是線性估算，真實曲線軌跡要逐段積分；偏移方向與相鄰柱相關性比單一絕對值更重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鑽孔偏斜」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bore trajectory defines the column axis, and small deep deviations can reduce overlap or approach buried assets. Nominal diameter cannot absorb every error, especially near cutoff toes and corners. Geometric verification must therefore use actual trajectories rather than ground-level setting-out positions alone. The constant-inclination formula is linear; curved trajectories require integration, and deviation direction and correlation between adjacent columns matter more than one absolute value. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bore deviation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設深度H=20 m、恆定偏斜比i=0.01，底部偏移δ=Hi=0.20 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For depth H=20 m and constant inclination ratio i=0.01, toe offset δ=Hi=0.20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地面樁位符合容差，就無需再查深部軸線。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compliant surface position removes the need to check the deep column axis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鑽孔偏斜」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bore deviation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 高風險界面需設孔斜查核停留點；地工設計者與資產管理者共同確認所需幾何餘量。固定偏斜式是線性估算，真實曲線軌跡要逐段積分；偏移方向與相鄰柱相關性比單一絕對值更重要。
knowledge.textEn: High-risk interfaces require a bore-deviation hold point; the geotechnical designer and asset owner jointly confirm the required geometric reserve. The constant-inclination formula is linear; curved trajectories require integration, and deviation direction and correlation between adjacent columns matter more than one absolute value.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鑽孔偏斜的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bore deviation mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
使用核定孔斜方法記錄全深軌跡，將其與管線調查及相鄰柱最小直徑重疊分析。
返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Record full-depth trajectory with an approved deviation method and combine it with utility investigation and minimum adjacent-column diameter.
Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better.
quiz.explanation: 使用核定孔斜方法記錄全深軌跡，將其與管線調查及相鄰柱最小直徑重疊分析。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record full-depth trajectory with an approved deviation method and combine it with utility investigation and minimum adjacent-column diameter. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鑽孔偏斜的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bore deviation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鑽孔偏斜」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bore deviation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 柱軸朝外偏移會留下改良缺口，朝資產偏移則可能改變周邊土體與既有結構接觸。固定偏斜式是線性估算，真實曲線軌跡要逐段積分；偏移方向與相鄰柱相關性比單一絕對值更重要。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Outward deviation leaves treatment gaps, while deviation toward an asset can alter surrounding ground and its contact with the existing structure. The constant-inclination formula is linear; curved trajectories require integration, and deviation direction and correlation between adjacent columns matter more than one absolute value. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：固定偏斜式是線性估算，真實曲線軌跡要逐段積分；偏移方向與相鄰柱相關性比單一絕對值更重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The constant-inclination formula is linear; curved trajectories require integration, and deviation direction and correlation between adjacent columns matter more than one absolute value.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地面樁位符合容差，就無需再查深部軸線。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Compliant surface position removes the need to check the deep column axis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 柱軸朝外偏移會留下改良缺口，朝資產偏移則可能改變周邊土體與既有結構接觸。固定偏斜式是線性估算，真實曲線軌跡要逐段積分；偏移方向與相鄰柱相關性比單一絕對值更重要。
knowledge.textEn: Outward deviation leaves treatment gaps, while deviation toward an asset can alter surrounding ground and its contact with the existing structure. The constant-inclination formula is linear; curved trajectories require integration, and deviation direction and correlation between adjacent columns matter more than one absolute value.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鑽孔偏斜的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bore deviation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均強度達標就不必理會分布尾端與取樣位置。
柱軸朝外偏移會留下改良缺口，朝資產偏移則可能改變周邊土體與既有結構接觸。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Meeting mean strength makes the lower tail and sampling positions irrelevant.
Outward deviation leaves treatment gaps, while deviation toward an asset can alter surrounding ground and its contact with the existing structure.
quiz.explanation: 柱軸朝外偏移會留下改良缺口，朝資產偏移則可能改變周邊土體與既有結構接觸。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Outward deviation leaves treatment gaps, while deviation toward an asset can alter surrounding ground and its contact with the existing structure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「強度變異係數的機理與驗證」與「水力坡降反算的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strength variability mechanism and verification" and "Back-calculated gradient mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 強度變異係數的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Strength variability mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「強度變異係數」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strength variability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水泥土品質具有空間變異，平均值相同的兩個改良區可能有很不同的低強度尾端。變異係數把標準差相對平均值表達，適合初步比較均勻度，但不能指出缺陷在哪裡；取樣位置及未成芯區會強烈影響統計代表性。變異係數是描述統計，沒有通用合格上限；分層材料或混合族群應分組，不能假設所有試體屬同一常態分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「強度變異係數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Soil-cement quality varies spatially, so areas with the same mean can have different weak tails. Coefficient of variation expresses standard deviation relative to mean and helps compare uniformity, but does not locate defects. Sampling positions and uncoreable intervals strongly affect whether the statistics represent the treated ground. CV is descriptive, without a universal pass threshold; layered or mixed populations require grouping rather than assuming all specimens follow one normal distribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Strength variability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設強度平均μ=2.0 MPa、標準差s=0.6 MPa，CV=s/μ=0.30。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For strength mean μ=2.0 MPa and standard deviation s=0.6 MPa, CV=s/μ=0.30.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均強度達標就不必理會分布尾端與取樣位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Meeting mean strength makes the lower tail and sampling positions irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「強度變異係數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Strength variability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 強度變異係數的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 水泥土品質具有空間變異，平均值相同的兩個改良區可能有很不同的低強度尾端。變異係數把標準差相對平均值表達，適合初步比較均勻度，但不能指出缺陷在哪裡；取樣位置及未成芯區會強烈影響統計代表性。
knowledge.textEn: Soil-cement quality varies spatially, so areas with the same mean can have different weak tails. Coefficient of variation expresses standard deviation relative to mean and helps compare uniformity, but does not locate defects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均強度達標就不必理會分布尾端與取樣位置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Meeting mean strength makes the lower tail and sampling positions irrelevant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「強度變異係數的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strength variability mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 水泥土品質具有空間變異，平均值相同的兩個改良區可能有很不同的低強度尾端。
平均強度達標就不必理會分布尾端與取樣位置。
流量除以滲透係數與面積，得到的單位就是公尺。
optionsEn: Soil-cement quality varies spatially, so areas with the same mean can have different weak tails.
Meeting mean strength makes the lower tail and sampling positions irrelevant.
Flow divided by permeability and area has units of metres.
quiz.explanation: 水泥土品質具有空間變異，平均值相同的兩個改良區可能有很不同的低強度尾端。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Soil-cement quality varies spatially, so areas with the same mean can have different weak tails. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 強度變異係數的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strength variability mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「強度變異係數」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strength variability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設強度平均μ=2.0 MPa、標準差s=0.6 MPa，CV=s/μ=0.30。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For strength mean μ=2.0 MPa and standard deviation s=0.6 MPa, CV=s/μ=0.30. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依柱號、深度與地層繪製強度分布，同時列樣本數及取芯失敗，不只提供一個平均值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map strength by column, depth and stratum, reporting sample count and core loss together rather than only a mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設強度平均μ=2.0 MPa、標準差s=0.6 MPa，CV=s/μ=0.30。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For strength mean μ=2.0 MPa and standard deviation s=0.6 MPa, CV=s/μ=0.30. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「強度變異係數的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strength variability mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。
原創教學假設：假設強度平均μ=2.0 MPa、標準差s=0.6 MPa，CV=s/μ=0.30。
直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。
optionsEn: Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone.
Original teaching assumptions: For strength mean μ=2.0 MPa and standard deviation s=0.6 MPa, CV=s/μ=0.30.
A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設強度平均μ=2.0 MPa、標準差s=0.6 MPa，CV=s/μ=0.30。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For strength mean μ=2.0 MPa and standard deviation s=0.6 MPa, CV=s/μ=0.30. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 強度變異係數的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strength variability mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「強度變異係數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strength variability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依柱號、深度與地層繪製強度分布，同時列樣本數及取芯失敗，不只提供一個平均值。統計判據與弱區補證方法應在取樣前核定；地工設計者依空間模式決定補強，不能只改報表平均值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map strength by column, depth and stratum, reporting sample count and core loss together rather than only a mean. Approve statistical criteria and weak-zone verification before sampling; the geotechnical designer selects remedies from spatial patterns rather than adjusting reported averages. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：統計判據與弱區補證方法應在取樣前核定；地工設計者依空間模式決定補強，不能只改報表平均值。變異係數是描述統計，沒有通用合格上限；分層材料或混合族群應分組，不能假設所有試體屬同一常態分布。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Approve statistical criteria and weak-zone verification before sampling; the geotechnical designer selects remedies from spatial patterns rather than adjusting reported averages. CV is descriptive, without a universal pass threshold; layered or mixed populations require grouping rather than assuming all specimens follow one normal distribution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：少量高值可能把平均拉高，掩蓋連續低強度帶；刪除取芯失敗會讓變異看似過小。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A few high values can raise the mean and hide a continuous weak band; excluding core loss makes variability appear artificially small. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 完工水力試驗需把流量與水頭及幾何一起解讀，否則低出水可能只因施加水頭小。若已知代表性滲透係數及面積，可由達西式反算坡降，但這是無因次量，不是水頭差；要得到水頭差仍需有效流路長度。反算若同時未知k、面積與流長便不唯一，不能用單一流量解出所有參數；局部缺口需另外檢測定位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水力坡降反算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Inversion is nonunique when permeability, area and path length are all unknown; one flow cannot determine them all, and local defects require separate location methods. optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Mislabeling gradient as head omits path length and distorts cutoff demand; test-boundary leakage can also be mistaken for treated-ground permeability.
High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance.
quiz.explanation: 將坡降誤寫成水頭差會漏掉流路長度，錯估止水需求；試驗邊界漏水也可能被誤判為改良體滲透。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mislabeling gradient as head omits path length and distorts cutoff demand; test-boundary leakage can also be mistaken for treated-ground permeability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 深層攪拌樁地盤改良
summary: 深層攪拌以機械拌合將膠結材料送入原土，效果由土樣反應性、材料量與攪拌分布共同決定。本課不把轉速或水泥用量當品質保證，而是連結含水比、柱體幾何、重疊、剛度及脆性，配合取樣統計和地盤變形建立材料到整體性能的驗證。
summaryEn: Deep mixing mechanically combines binder with native soil, with results governed by reactivity, dosage and mixing distribution. The course treats neither rotation rate nor cement quantity as a quality guarantee, linking water content, geometry, overlap, stiffness and brittleness to sampling statistics and ground movement from material to system performance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：原土水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=60%。若水量增加10%至66 kg而乾土不變，含水比變成66%，增加六個百分點，也就是相對增加10%。此結果不是飽和度，也不能直接推論固化後強度減少多少。配比還需計入新增漿液水、乾膠結材及土體反應性，並以相同養護及試驗方法比較。工程師應把含水比變化帶回材料試驗矩陣，避免用固定水泥量掩蓋不同土層的差異。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: native soil contains Mw=60 kg of water and Ms=100 kg of dry soil, giving w=Mw/Ms=60%. Increasing water mass by 10% to 66 kg while dry mass remains fixed raises water content to 66%, six percentage points or a 10% relative increase. This is not saturation and does not directly predict the resulting strength reduction. Mixture assessment also includes added slurry water, dry binder and soil reactivity under comparable curing and testing. Feed the changed water content into the laboratory matrix rather than assuming a fixed cement dosage neutralizes differences between strata.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「原土含水比的機理與驗證」與「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification" and "Binder dosage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「原土含水比」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Native-soil water content” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。不同土層即使加入相同膠結材量，也可能有不同水膠比及反應性；有機物、鹽分與黏土礦物更會改變強度發展，不能只按深度統一配比。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「原土含水比」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass. Equal binder dosage in different layers can produce different water-binder ratios and reactivity. Organics, salinity and clay minerals further alter strength development, so depth alone cannot justify one universal mixture. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Native-soil water content” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「原土含水比」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Native-soil water content”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。不同土層即使加入相同膠結材量，也可能有不同水膠比及反應性；有機物、鹽分與黏土礦物更會改變強度發展，不能只按深度統一配比。
knowledge.textEn: Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass. Equal binder dosage in different layers can produce different water-binder ratios and reactivity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「原土含水比的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。
原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。
每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。
optionsEn: Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass.
Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass.
Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength.
quiz.explanation: 原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「原土含水比」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Native-soil water content” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「原土含水比的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 工具名目直徑就是每個深度都已證明的成品直徑。
面積加權模數越大就表示所有失效模式都更安全。
原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。
optionsEn: Nominal tool diameter proves the finished diameter at every depth.
A larger area-weighted modulus improves safety for every failure mode.
Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「原土含水比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Native-soil water content” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information. Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field.

knowledge.textEn: Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.

quiz.question: 要驗證「原土含水比的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification"?
options: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
將不同地層全部平均，可以更準確代表最弱位置。
optionsEn: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Averaging all strata gives a more accurate description of the weakest location.
quiz.explanation: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「原土含水比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Native-soil water content” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。
knowledge.textEn: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「原土含水比的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。
每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity.
Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength.
quiz.explanation: 誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Binder dosage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「膠結材用量」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Binder dosage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 膠結材通常以每立方公尺原土的乾質量表示，但必須明確說明體積基準與材料留存。投入量只能描述供料，成品強度還受混合均勻、反應時間及土種影響；流量計與密度計誤差可能沿整根柱累積而不易被外觀發現。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「膠結材用量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Binder dosage commonly uses dry mass per cubic metre of native ground, requiring an explicit volume basis and retention assumption. Input describes supply, while strength also depends on uniformity, reaction time and soil type. Flow and density errors can accumulate along a column without producing visible surface evidence. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Binder dosage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「膠結材用量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Binder dosage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 膠結材通常以每立方公尺原土的乾質量表示，但必須明確說明體積基準與材料留存。投入量只能描述供料，成品強度還受混合均勻、反應時間及土種影響；流量計與密度計誤差可能沿整根柱累積而不易被外觀發現。
knowledge.textEn: Binder dosage commonly uses dry mass per cubic metre of native ground, requiring an explicit volume basis and retention assumption. Input describes supply, while strength also depends on uniformity, reaction time and soil type.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Binder dosage mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。
每米攪拌轉數越高，就一定有同比例的強度增加。
膠結材通常以每立方公尺原土的乾質量表示，但必須明確說明體積基準與材料留存。
optionsEn: Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength.
More rotations per metre necessarily increase strength proportionally.
Binder dosage commonly uses dry mass per cubic metre of native ground, requiring an explicit volume basis and retention assumption.
quiz.explanation: 膠結材通常以每立方公尺原土的乾質量表示，但必須明確說明體積基準與材料留存。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Binder dosage commonly uses dry mass per cubic metre of native ground, requiring an explicit volume basis and retention assumption. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Binder dosage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膠結材用量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Binder dosage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：校正供料質量、漿液密度及流量，按深度計算乾膠結材量，核對儲槽與現場紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate feed mass, slurry density and flow, calculate dry dosage by depth, and reconcile tank and field records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Binder dosage mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。
相鄰柱有幾何交疊，就必定像單一整體一樣工作。
固化土峰值強度達標就不必記錄峰後行為。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg.
Geometrically overlapping columns necessarily act as one monolithic body.
Compliant stabilized-soil peak strength makes post-peak behaviour irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Binder dosage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「膠結材用量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Binder dosage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 校正供料質量、漿液密度及流量，按深度計算乾膠結材量，核對儲槽與現場紀錄。每柱供料紀錄應與試體及地層編碼連結；材料負責人查明量平衡偏差後，由設計者確認是否需補證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate feed mass, slurry density and flow, calculate dry dosage by depth, and reconcile tank and field records. Link each column supply log to samples and strata; after the materials lead investigates imbalance, the designer determines supplementary evidence requirements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每柱供料紀錄應與試體及地層編碼連結；材料負責人查明量平衡偏差後，由設計者確認是否需補證。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Link each column supply log to samples and strata; after the materials lead investigates imbalance, the designer determines supplementary evidence requirements. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：流量計失準或密度變化可使名目用量合格而實際不足，形成局部弱層及承載不連續。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Flow-meter drift or density changes can give compliant nominal dosage but inadequate actual binder, producing weak layers and interrupted resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 校正供料質量、漿液密度及流量，按深度計算乾膠結材量，核對儲槽與現場紀錄。每柱供料紀錄應與試體及地層編碼連結；材料負責人查明量平衡偏差後，由設計者確認是否需補證。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate feed mass, slurry density and flow, calculate dry dosage by depth, and reconcile tank and field records. Link each column supply log to samples and strata; after the materials lead investigates imbalance, the designer determines supplementary evidence requirements.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每柱供料紀錄應與試體及地層編碼連結；材料負責人查明量平衡偏差後，由設計者確認是否需補證。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。
knowledge.textEn: Link each column supply log to samples and strata; after the materials lead investigates imbalance, the designer determines supplementary evidence requirements. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils.

quiz.question: 要驗證「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Binder dosage mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
校正供料質量、漿液密度及流量，按深度計算乾膠結材量，核對儲槽與現場紀錄。
漿液沒有返出就表示全部留在正確位置且沒有副作用。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Calibrate feed mass, slurry density and flow, calculate dry dosage by depth, and reconcile tank and field records.
No slurry return means all material remains correctly placed without adverse effects.
quiz.explanation: 校正供料質量、漿液密度及流量，按深度計算乾膠結材量，核對儲槽與現場紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate feed mass, slurry density and flow, calculate dry dosage by depth, and reconcile tank and field records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Binder dosage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「膠結材用量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Binder dosage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 流量計失準或密度變化可使名目用量合格而實際不足，形成局部弱層及承載不連續。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Flow-meter drift or density changes can give compliant nominal dosage but inadequate actual binder, producing weak layers and interrupted resistance. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Flow-meter drift or density changes can give compliant nominal dosage but inadequate actual binder, producing weak layers and interrupted resistance. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Binder dosage mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
每米攪拌轉數越高，就一定有同比例的強度增加。
流量計失準或密度變化可使名目用量合格而實際不足，形成局部弱層及承載不連續。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
More rotations per metre necessarily increase strength proportionally.
Flow-meter drift or density changes can give compliant nominal dosage but inadequate actual binder, producing weak layers and interrupted resistance.
quiz.explanation: 流量計失準或密度變化可使名目用量合格而實際不足，形成局部弱層及承載不連續。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Flow-meter drift or density changes can give compliant nominal dosage but inadequate actual binder, producing weak layers and interrupted resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「每米攪拌轉數的機理與驗證」與「柱體積與連續性的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rotations per metre mechanism and verification" and "Column volume and continuity mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 每米攪拌轉數的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rotations per metre mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「每米攪拌轉數」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotations per metre” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 攪拌葉片在某深度作用的程度與轉速、升降速度及重複行程有關，每米轉數可比較機械暴露量。相同轉數不代表相同能量，扭矩、葉片形狀及土體阻力會改變混合效果；材料供應時序也必須與葉片通過時間同步。每米轉數是運動學指標而非能量或品質標準，不能取代扭矩與取樣；此假設數字也不是現場設備設定建議。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「每米攪拌轉數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing exposure depends on rotation, vertical speed and repeated passes, and rotations per metre provide one process comparison. Equal counts do not imply equal energy because torque, blade geometry and soil resistance differ. Binder-delivery timing must also correspond to the interval when the blades pass through each layer. quiz.explanationEn: Nominal diameter and length estimate treated volume, but blade wear, soil clods and feed interruption can reduce effective section. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 柱體積與連續性的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Column volume and continuity mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柱體積與連續性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設圓柱D=0.8 m、L=15 m，V=πD²L/4=7.54 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For a circular column D=0.8 m and L=15 m, V=πD²L/4=7.54 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify tool dimensions and wear logs, combining cores, exposure or approved continuity investigations to locate depth-specific anomalies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 柱體積與連續性的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

Equipment-size changes update design geometry and testing; the geotechnical designer approves continued use of the original spacing. steps.instructionEn: Unrecorded tool wear creates smaller columns and inadequate overlap or area ratio even when total injected quantity appears normal. Cylinder volume assumes uniform section and reliable length, excluding overlap deductions and ground expansion; total volume is not automatically effective treated volume. steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「柱體積與連續性的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

工具磨耗未記錄會使柱體較小，柱群咬合與面積比不足，而總注入量仍可能看似正常。

Geometrically overlapping columns necessarily act as one monolithic body.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「攪拌柱重疊的機理與驗證」與「等效地盤模數的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 攪拌柱重疊的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mixing-column overlap” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重疊柱列可形成剪力或止水屏障，但新舊柱交界的混合與齡期會影響接面。幾何上交疊不等於材料完全重新拌合，偏斜與工具避讓還可能減少深部交集；施工順序應與固化時間及連續性驗證共同設計。線性咬合只描述等徑平行柱，未含偏斜及材料齡期差；設計需對接面失效模式保留獨立證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「攪拌柱重疊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Overlapping rows form shear or hydraulic barriers, but mixing and age at column interfaces govern continuity. Geometric intersection does not prove complete remixing, and deviation or tool interference can reduce deep overlap. Sequence therefore needs coordination with curing time and interface verification rather than geometry alone. Linear overlap describes equal parallel columns only, omitting deviation and age differences; interface failure mechanisms require independent supporting evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mixing-column overlap” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設有效D=0.8 m、中心距s=0.6 m，名目交疊o=D−s=0.20 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For effective D=0.8 m and spacing s=0.6 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相鄰柱有幾何交疊，就必定像單一整體一樣工作。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Geometrically overlapping columns necessarily act as one monolithic body." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「攪拌柱重疊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mixing-column overlap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 攪拌柱重疊的機理與驗證

knowledge.textEn: Overlapping rows form shear or hydraulic barriers, but mixing and age at column interfaces govern continuity. Geometric intersection does not prove complete remixing, and deviation or tool interference can reduce deep overlap.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相鄰柱有幾何交疊，就必定像單一整體一樣工作。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Geometrically overlapping columns necessarily act as one monolithic body. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

Overlapping rows form shear or hydraulic barriers, but mixing and age at column interfaces govern continuity.
quiz.explanation: 重疊柱列可形成剪力或止水屏障，但新舊柱交界的混合與齡期會影響接面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 攪拌柱重疊的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mixing-column overlap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將柱位、孔斜與施工時間疊合，優先於交界取樣，確認接面強度及水力連續性。接面試驗位置和施工順序須納入驗收文件；地工設計者對深部最小交集作獨立審查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay column position, inclination and execution time, prioritizing interface samples to verify mechanical and hydraulic continuity. Include interface-test locations and sequence in acceptance records; the geotechnical designer independently reviews the minimum effective deep intersection and its uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Include interface-test locations and sequence in acceptance records; the geotechnical designer independently reviews the minimum effective deep intersection and its uncertainty. Linear overlap describes equal parallel columns only, omitting deviation and age differences; interface failure mechanisms require independent supporting evidence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：交界形成未混合薄帶時，單柱芯樣可全部合格，屏障仍沿接面滑移或漏水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An unmixed interface seam can permit sliding or leakage even when all individual-column cores pass. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mixing-column overlap” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 交界形成未混合薄帶時，單柱芯樣可全部合格，屏障仍沿接面滑移或漏水。線性咬合只描述等徑平行柱，未含偏斜及材料齡期差；設計需對接面失效模式保留獨立證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An unmixed interface seam can permit sliding or leakage even when all individual-column cores pass. Linear overlap describes equal parallel columns only, omitting deviation and age differences; interface failure mechanisms require independent supporting evidence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相鄰柱有幾何交疊，就必定像單一整體一樣工作。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Geometrically overlapping columns necessarily act as one monolithic body." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「攪拌柱重疊的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A larger area-weighted modulus improves safety for every failure mode.
An unmixed interface seam can permit sliding or leakage even when all individual-column cores pass.

quiz.explanationEn: An unmixed interface seam can permit sliding or leakage even when all individual-column cores pass. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 等效地盤模數的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equivalent ground modulus mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「等效地盤模數」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equivalent ground modulus” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良柱與原土在剛性載重層下可能近似等應變，等效模數因此可用面積加權估計。此模型反映剛度而非強度，且原土排水條件及柱體開裂會改變模數；柔性路堤或端部沉陷不相容時不能直接套用。加權模數假設平行受力與共同應變，不適用串聯軟弱層；柱體抗剪、整體穩定與負載轉移層仍需分別檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「等效地盤模數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Under a rigid load-distribution layer, columns and soil may approximately share strain, allowing an area-weighted equivalent modulus. The model concerns stiffness rather than strength, and drainage and column cracking change the moduli. It cannot be transferred directly to flexible embankments or incompatible toe settlement. The weighted modulus assumes parallel loading and common strain, not weak layers in series; column shear, overall stability and load-transfer layers require separate checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equivalent ground modulus” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設面積比a=0.25、柱模數Ec=100 MPa、原土Es=10 MPa，Eeq=aEc+(1−a)Es=32.5 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For area ratio a=0.25, Ec=100 MPa and Es=10 MPa, Eeq=aEc+(1−a)Es=32.5 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「面積加權模數越大就表示所有失效模式都更安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A larger area-weighted modulus improves safety for every failure mode." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「等效地盤模數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equivalent ground modulus”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

The weighted modulus assumes parallel loading and common strain, not weak layers in series; column shear, overall stability and load-transfer layers require separate checks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接用室內小應變模數預測大荷載沉陷，可能高估剛度，讓實際沉陷及分力超出預期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using laboratory small-strain moduli for large-load settlement can overstate stiffness and mispredict movement and force sharing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測柱頂與柱間沉陷和壓力，檢查等應變假設，再以相應應力範圍的材料試驗比較。設計書須標明模數應變範圍與排水狀態；試驗不支持等應變時，由設計者改採互制模型。
knowledge.textEn: Measure column-head and intervening-soil settlement and pressure, testing equal strain before comparison with material tests at matching stress levels. State modulus strain range and drainage condition; where tests do not support equal strain, the designer adopts an interaction model.
