knowledge.text: 設計書須標明模數應變範圍與排水狀態；試驗不支持等應變時，由設計者改採互制模型。加權模數假設平行受力與共同應變，不適用串聯軟弱層；柱體抗剪、整體穩定與負載轉移層仍需分別檢查。
knowledge.textEn: State modulus strain range and drainage condition; where tests do not support equal strain, the designer adopts an interaction model. The weighted modulus assumes parallel loading and common strain, not weak layers in series; column shear, overall stability and load-transfer layers require separate checks.

quiz.question: 要驗證「等效地盤模數的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Equivalent ground modulus mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
每米攪拌轉數越高，就一定有同比例的強度增加。
量測柱頂與柱間沉陷和壓力，檢查等應變假設，再以相應應力範圍的材料試驗比較。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
More rotations per metre necessarily increase strength proportionally.
Measure column-head and intervening-soil settlement and pressure, testing equal strain before comparison with material tests at matching stress levels.
quiz.explanation: 量測柱頂與柱間沉陷和壓力，檢查等應變假設，再以相應應力範圍的材料試驗比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure column-head and intervening-soil settlement and pressure, testing equal strain before comparison with material tests at matching stress levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 等效地盤模數的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equivalent ground modulus mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「等效地盤模數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Equivalent ground modulus” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接用室內小應變模數預測大荷載沉陷，可能高估剛度，讓實際沉陷及分力超出預期。加權模數假設平行受力與共同應變，不適用串聯軟弱層；柱體抗剪、整體穩定與負載轉移層仍需分別檢查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using laboratory small-strain moduli for large-load settlement can overstate stiffness and mispredict movement and force sharing. The weighted modulus assumes parallel loading and common strain, not weak layers in series; column shear, overall stability and load-transfer layers require separate checks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：加權模數假設平行受力與共同應變，不適用串聯軟弱層；柱體抗剪、整體穩定與負載轉移層仍需分別檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The weighted modulus assumes parallel loading and common strain, not weak layers in series; column shear, overall stability and load-transfer layers require separate checks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「面積加權模數越大就表示所有失效模式都更安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A larger area-weighted modulus improves safety for every failure mode." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 直接用室內小應變模數預測大荷載沉陷，可能高估剛度，讓實際沉陷及分力超出預期。加權模數假設平行受力與共同應變，不適用串聯軟弱層；柱體抗剪、整體穩定與負載轉移層仍需分別檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Using laboratory small-strain moduli for large-load settlement can overstate stiffness and mispredict movement and force sharing. The weighted modulus assumes parallel loading and common strain, not weak layers in series; column shear, overall stability and load-transfer layers require separate checks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「等效地盤模數的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Equivalent ground modulus mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 直接用室內小應變模數預測大荷載沉陷，可能高估剛度，讓實際沉陷及分力超出預期。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
固化土峰值強度達標就不必記錄峰後行為。
optionsEn: Using laboratory small-strain moduli for large-load settlement can overstate stiffness and mispredict movement and force sharing.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Compliant stabilized-soil peak strength makes post-peak behaviour irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 直接用室內小應變模數預測大荷載沉陷，可能高估剛度，讓實際沉陷及分力超出預期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using laboratory small-strain moduli for large-load settlement can overstate stiffness and mispredict movement and force sharing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「殘餘強度的機理與驗證」與「強度離散的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Residual strength mechanism and verification" and "Strength scatter mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 殘餘強度的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Residual strength mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「殘餘強度」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual strength” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 固化土可能具有較高峰值強度但峰後脆性明顯，局部裂開後的殘餘能力影響荷載是否能安全轉移。只比較峰值會忽略施工擾動、地震或差異沉陷後的反應，試驗因此需要足夠變形範圍及完整應力應變曲線。殘餘比依試驗型式及應變定義改變，不是通用韌性等級；單軸結果也不能直接代表圍壓下的剪切殘餘強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「殘餘強度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stabilized soil may have high peak strength yet brittle post-peak behaviour, with residual resistance governing redistribution after cracking. Peak-only comparisons miss responses to disturbance, earthquakes or differential settlement. Testing therefore needs sufficient deformation range and complete stress-strain curves rather than terminating at the first peak. The residual ratio depends on test type and defined strain and is not a universal toughness class; unconfined results do not directly represent confined shear residual strength. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Residual strength” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設峰值qu=2 MPa、相應大應變殘餘qr=0.8 MPa，比值qr/qu=0.40。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For peak qu=2 MPa and residual qr=0.8 MPa at a defined large strain, qr/qu=0.40.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「固化土峰值強度達標就不必記錄峰後行為。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compliant stabilized-soil peak strength makes post-peak behaviour irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「殘餘強度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Residual strength”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 殘餘強度的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 固化土可能具有較高峰值強度但峰後脆性明顯，局部裂開後的殘餘能力影響荷載是否能安全轉移。只比較峰值會忽略施工擾動、地震或差異沉陷後的反應，試驗因此需要足夠變形範圍及完整應力應變曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Stabilized soil may have high peak strength yet brittle post-peak behaviour, with residual resistance governing redistribution after cracking. Peak-only comparisons miss responses to disturbance, earthquakes or differential settlement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：固化土峰值強度達標就不必記錄峰後行為。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Compliant stabilized-soil peak strength makes post-peak behaviour irrelevant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「殘餘強度的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Residual strength mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 固化土峰值強度達標就不必記錄峰後行為。
固化土可能具有較高峰值強度但峰後脆性明顯，局部裂開後的殘餘能力影響荷載是否能安全轉移。
將不同地層全部平均，可以更準確代表最弱位置。
optionsEn: Compliant stabilized-soil peak strength makes post-peak behaviour irrelevant.
Stabilized soil may have high peak strength yet brittle post-peak behaviour, with residual resistance governing redistribution after cracking.
Averaging all strata gives a more accurate description of the weakest location.
quiz.explanation: 固化土可能具有較高峰值強度但峰後脆性明顯，局部裂開後的殘餘能力影響荷載是否能安全轉移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stabilized soil may have high peak strength yet brittle post-peak behaviour, with residual resistance governing redistribution after cracking. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 殘餘強度的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Residual strength mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「殘餘強度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Residual strength” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設峰值qu=2 MPa、相應大應變殘餘qr=0.8 MPa，比值qr/qu=0.40。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For peak qu=2 MPa and residual qr=0.8 MPa at a defined large strain, qr/qu=0.40. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保存峰前峰後曲線、破壞面與試體含水，核對各試驗是否在相同應變及排水條件比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain pre- and post-peak curves, failure planes and specimen water content, comparing tests at consistent strain and drainage conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設峰值qu=2 MPa、相應大應變殘餘qr=0.8 MPa，比值qr/qu=0.40。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For peak qu=2 MPa and residual qr=0.8 MPa at a defined large strain, qr/qu=0.40. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「殘餘強度的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Residual strength mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 改良柱很硬就代表整個地盤的長期沉陷可以忽略。
每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。
原創教學假設：假設峰值qu=2 MPa、相應大應變殘餘qr=0.8 MPa，比值qr/qu=0.40。
optionsEn: Stiff treated columns make long-term settlement of the entire ground negligible.
Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength.
Original teaching assumptions: For peak qu=2 MPa and residual qr=0.8 MPa at a defined large strain, qr/qu=0.40.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設峰值qu=2 MPa、相應大應變殘餘qr=0.8 MPa，比值qr/qu=0.40。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For peak qu=2 MPa and residual qr=0.8 MPa at a defined large strain, qr/qu=0.40. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 殘餘強度的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Residual strength mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「殘餘強度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Residual strength” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保存峰前峰後曲線、破壞面與試體含水，核對各試驗是否在相同應變及排水條件比較。對需承受大變形的改良體，材料與地工設計者應共同指定殘餘性能試驗及分析假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain pre- and post-peak curves, failure planes and specimen water content, comparing tests at consistent strain and drainage conditions. For treatment expected to undergo large deformation, materials and geotechnical designers jointly specify residual-performance testing and analysis assumptions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對需承受大變形的改良體，材料與地工設計者應共同指定殘餘性能試驗及分析假設。殘餘比依試驗型式及應變定義改變，不是通用韌性等級；單軸結果也不能直接代表圍壓下的剪切殘餘強度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For treatment expected to undergo large deformation, materials and geotechnical designers jointly specify residual-performance testing and analysis assumptions. The residual ratio depends on test type and defined strain and is not a universal toughness class; unconfined results do not directly represent confined shear residual strength.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：脆性柱體局部破壞後無法承接預期重分配，鄰柱可能連鎖超載，整體平均強度仍無法描述此問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A brittle column may not sustain assumed redistribution after local failure, causing neighbour overload that mean strength does not describe. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Retain pre- and post-peak curves, failure planes and specimen water content, comparing tests at consistent strain and drainage conditions. For treatment expected to undergo large deformation, materials and geotechnical designers jointly specify residual-performance testing and analysis assumptions.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設同一族群μ=1.6 MPa、標準差s=0.4 MPa，CV=s/μ=0.25。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For one population with μ=1.6 MPa and standard deviation s=0.4 MPa, CV=s/μ=0.25. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 弱層資料被其他高值稀釋，可能讓平均合格卻仍存在連續低強度面，影響整體穩定。變異係數不直接提供特徵強度，仍需樣本數、分布及信賴程度；本值僅是合成資料的描述統計。
knowledge.textEn: Strong results can dilute a weak layer statistically, leaving a continuous low-strength plane despite an acceptable overall mean. CV does not directly provide characteristic strength; sample count, distribution and confidence are still needed, and this value only describes synthetic data.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「強度離散的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strength scatter mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
漿液沒有返出就表示全部留在正確位置且沒有副作用。
弱層資料被其他高值稀釋，可能讓平均合格卻仍存在連續低強度面，影響整體穩定。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
No slurry return means all material remains correctly placed without adverse effects.
Strong results can dilute a weak layer statistically, leaving a continuous low-strength plane despite an acceptable overall mean.
quiz.explanation: 弱層資料被其他高值稀釋，可能讓平均合格卻仍存在連續低強度面，影響整體穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Strong results can dilute a weak layer statistically, leaving a continuous low-strength plane despite an acceptable overall mean. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漿量與地表隆起的機理與驗證」與「複合層沉陷的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Slurry balance and heave mechanism and verification" and "Composite-layer settlement mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漿量與地表隆起的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Slurry balance and heave mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漿量與地表隆起」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slurry balance and heave” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 注入漿液增加地層內物質，若排出路徑受限，可能造成隆起或孔壓增加。投入與回收體積差不能全當成有益改良量，還需區分原土體積變化及混合膨脹；鄰近管線對短時位移的容忍度可能比成品強度更早控制施工。體積差不等於地表隆起體積，還受地下水排出及土體重排影響；需用獨立測量證據確認變形機制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漿量與地表隆起」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Injected slurry adds material to the ground and may cause heave or pore-pressure rise if escape paths are restricted. Input-return imbalance is not entirely beneficial treatment; separate native-soil volume change and mixing expansion. Nearby utilities may be governed by short-term movement before cured strength becomes relevant. Volume imbalance is not surface-heave volume because groundwater expulsion and soil rearrangement also contribute; independent measurements must establish the deformation mechanism. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Slurry balance and heave” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設注入Vin=5 m³、回收Vout=4.2 m³，體積差ΔV=0.8 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For injected Vin=5 m³ and recovered Vout=4.2 m³, volume imbalance ΔV=0.8 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漿液沒有返出就表示全部留在正確位置且沒有副作用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No slurry return means all material remains correctly placed without adverse effects." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漿量與地表隆起」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Slurry balance and heave”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漿量與地表隆起的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Slurry balance and heave mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 注入漿液增加地層內物質，若排出路徑受限，可能造成隆起或孔壓增加。投入與回收體積差不能全當成有益改良量，還需區分原土體積變化及混合膨脹；鄰近管線對短時位移的容忍度可能比成品強度更早控制施工。
knowledge.textEn: Injected slurry adds material to the ground and may cause heave or pore-pressure rise if escape paths are restricted. Input-return imbalance is not entirely beneficial treatment; separate native-soil volume change and mixing expansion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：漿液沒有返出就表示全部留在正確位置且沒有副作用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No slurry return means all material remains correctly placed without adverse effects. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漿量與地表隆起的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Slurry balance and heave mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 注入漿液增加地層內物質，若排出路徑受限，可能造成隆起或孔壓增加。
漿液沒有返出就表示全部留在正確位置且沒有副作用。
改良柱很硬就代表整個地盤的長期沉陷可以忽略。
optionsEn: Injected slurry adds material to the ground and may cause heave or pore-pressure rise if escape paths are restricted.
No slurry return means all material remains correctly placed without adverse effects.
Stiff treated columns make long-term settlement of the entire ground negligible.
quiz.explanation: 注入漿液增加地層內物質，若排出路徑受限，可能造成隆起或孔壓增加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Injected slurry adds material to the ground and may cause heave or pore-pressure rise if escape paths are restricted. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漿量與地表隆起的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Slurry balance and heave mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漿量與地表隆起」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slurry balance and heave” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設注入Vin=5 m³、回收Vout=4.2 m³，體積差ΔV=0.8 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For injected Vin=5 m³ and recovered Vout=4.2 m³, volume imbalance ΔV=0.8 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄供回漿、地表水準及孔壓，核對儲槽延遲和材料密度，追查變形與量差是否同時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize feed and returns with surface levels and pore pressure, checking tank delays and density and whether movement coincides with imbalance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設注入Vin=5 m³、回收Vout=4.2 m³，體積差ΔV=0.8 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For injected Vin=5 m³ and recovered Vout=4.2 m³, volume imbalance ΔV=0.8 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「漿量與地表隆起的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Slurry balance and heave mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。
原創教學假設：假設注入Vin=5 m³、回收Vout=4.2 m³，體積差ΔV=0.8 m³。
工具名目直徑就是每個深度都已證明的成品直徑。
optionsEn: Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength.
Original teaching assumptions: For injected Vin=5 m³ and recovered Vout=4.2 m³, volume imbalance ΔV=0.8 m³.
Nominal tool diameter proves the finished diameter at every depth.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設注入Vin=5 m³、回收Vout=4.2 m³，體積差ΔV=0.8 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For injected Vin=5 m³ and recovered Vout=4.2 m³, volume imbalance ΔV=0.8 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漿量與地表隆起的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Slurry balance and heave mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漿量與地表隆起」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slurry balance and heave” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄供回漿、地表水準及孔壓，核對儲槽延遲和材料密度，追查變形與量差是否同時。資產變形與量平衡需共用警戒機制；施工及地工負責人確認材料去向後才核准繼續。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize feed and returns with surface levels and pore pressure, checking tank delays and density and whether movement coincides with imbalance. Use a shared response mechanism for asset movement and volume balance; construction and geotechnical leads confirm material destination before approving continuation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：資產變形與量平衡需共用警戒機制；施工及地工負責人確認材料去向後才核准繼續。體積差不等於地表隆起體積，還受地下水排出及土體重排影響；需用獨立測量證據確認變形機制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use a shared response mechanism for asset movement and volume balance; construction and geotechnical leads confirm material destination before approving continuation. Volume imbalance is not surface-heave volume because groundwater expulsion and soil rearrangement also contribute; independent measurements must establish the deformation mechanism.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把異常少返漿當成高效率，可能錯過堵塞引起的抬升，先損傷周邊資產再發現品質問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Interpreting unusually low returns as efficiency can miss blockage-induced heave, damaging neighbouring assets before quality problems are recognized. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Volume imbalance is not surface-heave volume because groundwater expulsion and soil rearrangement also contribute; independent measurements must establish the deformation mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「漿量與地表隆起的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 複合層沉陷的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite-layer settlement mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「複合層沉陷」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Composite-layer settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良地盤的沉陷來自改良層壓縮及其下未處理土層，剛度提高不代表總沉陷必然很小。一維等效模數可初估指定層的壓縮量，但忽略側向變形與時間效應；移交時應確認實測沉陷發生在哪些深度，而非只比較地表總值。此處M明定為相應一維模數，不能無條件以楊氏模數代入；若沿深度應力或剛度變化，應分層積分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「複合層沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Settlement includes compression of the treated layer and untreated ground below, so higher stiffness does not guarantee small total movement. A one-dimensional equivalent modulus estimates compression of a specified layer but excludes lateral deformation and time effects. Handover should identify settlement by depth rather than compare surface totals alone. Here M is the corresponding constrained modulus and cannot automatically be replaced by Young's modulus; variable stress or stiffness requires layered integration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Composite-layer settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設均勻附加q=100 kPa、層厚H=10 m、相應一維模數M=32500 kPa，s=qH/M=0.0308 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For uniform increment q=100 kPa, thickness H=10 m and corresponding constrained modulus M=32500 kPa, s=qH/M=0.0308 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「改良柱很硬就代表整個地盤的長期沉陷可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stiff treated columns make long-term settlement of the entire ground negligible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「複合層沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Composite-layer settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 複合層沉陷的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 改良地盤的沉陷來自改良層壓縮及其下未處理土層，剛度提高不代表總沉陷必然很小。一維等效模數可初估指定層的壓縮量，但忽略側向變形與時間效應；移交時應確認實測沉陷發生在哪些深度，而非只比較地表總值。
knowledge.textEn: Settlement includes compression of the treated layer and untreated ground below, so higher stiffness does not guarantee small total movement. A one-dimensional equivalent modulus estimates compression of a specified layer but excludes lateral deformation and time effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：改良柱很硬就代表整個地盤的長期沉陷可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stiff treated columns make long-term settlement of the entire ground negligible. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「複合層沉陷的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Composite-layer settlement mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 改良柱很硬就代表整個地盤的長期沉陷可以忽略。
改良地盤的沉陷來自改良層壓縮及其下未處理土層，剛度提高不代表總沉陷必然很小。
含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。
optionsEn: Stiff treated columns make long-term settlement of the entire ground negligible.
Settlement includes compression of the treated layer and untreated ground below, so higher stiffness does not guarantee small total movement.
Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass.
quiz.explanation: 改良地盤的沉陷來自改良層壓縮及其下未處理土層，剛度提高不代表總沉陷必然很小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Settlement includes compression of the treated layer and untreated ground below, so higher stiffness does not guarantee small total movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 複合層沉陷的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Composite-layer settlement mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「複合層沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Composite-layer settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設均勻附加q=100 kPa、層厚H=10 m、相應一維模數M=32500 kPa，s=qH/M=0.0308 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For uniform increment q=100 kPa, thickness H=10 m and corresponding constrained modulus M=32500 kPa, s=qH/M=0.0308 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用分層沉陷計與孔壓資料，將改良層和下伏層分開比較，確認模數與應力區間一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use layered settlement and pore-pressure instruments to separate treated and underlying layers, checking that modulus and stress range are consistent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 複合層沉陷的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Composite-layer settlement mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「複合層沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Composite-layer settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用分層沉陷計與孔壓資料，將改良層和下伏層分開比較，確認模數與應力區間一致。交接須列未處理層及殘餘沉陷假設；地工設計者確認觀測趨勢與後續荷載計畫後才結案。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use layered settlement and pore-pressure instruments to separate treated and underlying layers, checking that modulus and stress range are consistent. Handover identifies untreated layers and residual-settlement assumptions; the geotechnical designer confirms observed trends and future loading before closeout. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接須列未處理層及殘餘沉陷假設；地工設計者確認觀測趨勢與後續荷載計畫後才結案。此處M明定為相應一維模數，不能無條件以楊氏模數代入；若沿深度應力或剛度變化，應分層積分。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover identifies untreated layers and residual-settlement assumptions; the geotechnical designer confirms observed trends and future loading before closeout. Here M is the corresponding constrained modulus and cannot automatically be replaced by Young's modulus; variable stress or stiffness requires layered integration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只檢查改良柱壓縮可能漏掉下伏軟層，完成後仍持續沉陷並損傷剛性結構或管線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking column compression alone misses soft ground below, allowing continued settlement that damages rigid structures or utilities. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

title: 補償灌漿沉陷控制
summary: 補償灌漿透過受控的地層變形降低隧道施工對資產的沉陷影響，其目標是控制差異變形而非追求最大抬升。本課把沉陷槽、注入效率、孔位誤差、有效應力及回饋延遲連成模型，再檢查結構角變形、曲率與停止注入後的殘餘反應。
summaryEn: Compensation grouting controls ground deformation to reduce settlement effects from tunnelling, targeting differential movement rather than maximum heave. The course connects settlement troughs, injection efficiency, bore position, effective stress and feedback delay, then evaluates structural distortion, curvature and residual movement after injection stops.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設高斯沉陷槽smax=20 mm、寬度參數i=10 m，在x=10 m位置，s=20 exp(−10²/(2×10²))=12.13 mm。若只增加峰值10%至22 mm，槽寬不變，同位置沉陷為13.34 mm，也增加10%。這個結果描述固定形狀的沉陷場，不是所需灌漿量；實際建物剛度、注入效率、孔位與反應延遲會影響補償。工程師應檢查全資產角變形與曲率，並以獨立測點驗證槽形，不能只把單點抬回原位當成完成。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume a Gaussian trough with smax=20 mm and width parameter i=10 m. At x=10 m, s=20 exp(−10²/(2×10²))=12.13 mm. Increase only the peak by 10% to 22 mm while keeping width fixed: movement at the same position becomes 13.34 mm, also up 10%. This describes a fixed-shape settlement field, not required grout quantity. Building stiffness, injection efficiency, port position and response delay affect actual compensation. Check distortion and curvature across the whole asset and validate trough shape at independent points rather than defining completion by restoring one point alone.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證」與「注入抬升效率的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification" and "Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉陷槽形狀」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Settlement-trough shape” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 隧道引起的地表沉陷可用高斯形狀作第一近似，最大沉陷與槽寬共同決定影響範圍。補償灌漿的監測應涵蓋整個敏感資產而非只追最大值，因為槽邊坡度與曲率可能更影響建物；分層地盤或多隧道會偏離單一對稱槽。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉陷槽形狀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A Gaussian shape approximates tunnel-induced surface settlement, with peak and width jointly defining the influence zone. Compensation monitoring should cover the sensitive asset rather than chase the peak alone because edge slope and curvature may govern building response. Layering and multiple tunnels can depart from one symmetric trough. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Settlement-trough shape” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設smax=20 mm、槽寬參數i=10 m、位置x=10 m，s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For smax=20 mm, trough parameter i=10 m and x=10 m, s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉陷槽形狀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Settlement-trough shape”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 隧道引起的地表沉陷可用高斯形狀作第一近似，最大沉陷與槽寬共同決定影響範圍。補償灌漿的監測應涵蓋整個敏感資產而非只追最大值，因為槽邊坡度與曲率可能更影響建物；分層地盤或多隧道會偏離單一對稱槽。
knowledge.textEn: A Gaussian shape approximates tunnel-induced surface settlement, with peak and width jointly defining the influence zone. Compensation monitoring should cover the sensitive asset rather than chase the peak alone because edge slope and curvature may govern building response.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。
隧道引起的地表沉陷可用高斯形狀作第一近似，最大沉陷與槽寬共同決定影響範圍。
注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。
optionsEn: Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location.
A Gaussian shape approximates tunnel-induced surface settlement, with peak and width jointly defining the influence zone.
One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave.
quiz.explanation: 隧道引起的地表沉陷可用高斯形狀作第一近似，最大沉陷與槽寬共同決定影響範圍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A Gaussian shape approximates tunnel-induced surface settlement, with peak and width jointly defining the influence zone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉陷槽形狀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Settlement-trough shape” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設smax=20 mm、槽寬參數i=10 m、位置x=10 m，s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For smax=20 mm, trough parameter i=10 m and x=10 m, s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用跨越資產的測線擬合峰值與槽寬，保留未參與配適測點驗證，檢查不對稱及局部突變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit peak and width from survey lines spanning the asset, retaining unused points for validation and checking asymmetry and local discontinuities.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設smax=20 mm、槽寬參數i=10 m、位置x=10 m，s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For smax=20 mm, trough parameter i=10 m and x=10 m, s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。
只要把每個地表點抬回原高程，建物內力就會減少。
原創教學假設：假設smax=20 mm、槽寬參數i=10 m、位置x=10 m，s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm。
optionsEn: Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth.
Returning every surface point to its original elevation necessarily reduces building forces.
Original teaching assumptions: For smax=20 mm, trough parameter i=10 m and x=10 m, s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設smax=20 mm、槽寬參數i=10 m、位置x=10 m，s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For smax=20 mm, trough parameter i=10 m and x=10 m, s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉陷槽形狀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Settlement-trough shape” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用跨越資產的測線擬合峰值與槽寬，保留未參與配適測點驗證，檢查不對稱及局部突變。變形目標應由資產結構評估制定；監測及灌漿設計者共同確認控制區與獨立驗證點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit peak and width from survey lines spanning the asset, retaining unused points for validation and checking asymmetry and local discontinuities. The asset assessment defines movement targets; monitoring and grouting designers jointly establish control areas and independent validation points. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：變形目標應由資產結構評估制定；監測及灌漿設計者共同確認控制區與獨立驗證點。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The asset assessment defines movement targets; monitoring and grouting designers jointly establish control areas and independent validation points. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只控制中央沉陷可能讓槽邊差異變形增大，建物出現裂縫時總沉陷仍可能不大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Controlling central settlement alone can increase edge distortion, allowing building cracking while total settlement remains modest. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用跨越資產的測線擬合峰值與槽寬，保留未參與配適測點驗證，檢查不對稱及局部突變。變形目標應由資產結構評估制定；監測及灌漿設計者共同確認控制區與獨立驗證點。
knowledge.textEn: Fit peak and width from survey lines spanning the asset, retaining unused points for validation and checking asymmetry and local discontinuities. The asset assessment defines movement targets; monitoring and grouting designers jointly establish control areas and independent validation points.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 變形目標應由資產結構評估制定；監測及灌漿設計者共同確認控制區與獨立驗證點。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。
knowledge.textEn: The asset assessment defines movement targets; monitoring and grouting designers jointly establish control areas and independent validation points. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification"?
options: 用跨越資產的測線擬合峰值與槽寬，保留未參與配適測點驗證，檢查不對稱及局部突變。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩點傾斜角很小，就能保證中間沒有局部高曲率。
optionsEn: Fit peak and width from survey lines spanning the asset, retaining unused points for validation and checking asymmetry and local discontinuities.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A small two-point tilt guarantees no high curvature between them.
quiz.explanation: 用跨越資產的測線擬合峰值與槽寬，保留未參與配適測點驗證，檢查不對稱及局部突變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit peak and width from survey lines spanning the asset, retaining unused points for validation and checking asymmetry and local discontinuities. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沉陷槽形狀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Settlement-trough shape” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只控制中央沉陷可能讓槽邊差異變形增大，建物出現裂縫時總沉陷仍可能不大。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Controlling central settlement alone can increase edge distortion, allowing building cracking while total settlement remains modest. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只控制中央沉陷可能讓槽邊差異變形增大，建物出現裂縫時總沉陷仍可能不大。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。
knowledge.textEn: Controlling central settlement alone can increase edge distortion, allowing building cracking while total settlement remains modest. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只控制中央沉陷可能讓槽邊差異變形增大，建物出現裂縫時總沉陷仍可能不大。
注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Controlling central settlement alone can increase edge distortion, allowing building cracking while total settlement remains modest.
One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave.
quiz.explanation: 只控制中央沉陷可能讓槽邊差異變形增大，建物出現裂縫時總沉陷仍可能不大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Controlling central settlement alone can increase edge distortion, allowing building cracking while total settlement remains modest. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 注入抬升效率的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「注入抬升效率」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Injection-heave efficiency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 注入漿液一部分填充孔隙或裂縫，另一部分造成土體位移，故注入體積不等於資產抬升體積。效率會隨既有灌漿、應力及排水改變，必須由已觀測反應校正；把所有留存量視為有效補償，可能導致過量注入與隆起。表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「注入抬升效率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Some grout fills voids or fractures while another part displaces soil, so injected volume does not equal asset-heave volume. Efficiency changes with prior treatment, stress and drainage and must be updated from observations. Treating all retained grout as useful compensation can cause excessive injection and unintended uplift. Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Injection-heave efficiency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設估算抬升體積Vh=0.6 m³、注入Vg=2 m³，表觀效率η=Vh/Vg=0.30。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For inferred heave volume Vh=0.6 m³ and injection Vg=2 m³, apparent efficiency η=Vh/Vg=0.30.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「注入抬升效率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Injection-heave efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 注入抬升效率的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 注入漿液一部分填充孔隙或裂縫，另一部分造成土體位移，故注入體積不等於資產抬升體積。效率會隨既有灌漿、應力及排水改變，必須由已觀測反應校正；把所有留存量視為有效補償，可能導致過量注入與隆起。
knowledge.textEn: Some grout fills voids or fractures while another part displaces soil, so injected volume does not equal asset-heave volume. Efficiency changes with prior treatment, stress and drainage and must be updated from observations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「注入抬升效率的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。
孔口放樣正確就表示所有袖閥都在設計位置。
注入漿液一部分填充孔隙或裂縫，另一部分造成土體位移，故注入體積不等於資產抬升體積。
optionsEn: One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave.
Correct collar setting-out proves every sleeve port is correctly positioned.
Some grout fills voids or fractures while another part displaces soil, so injected volume does not equal asset-heave volume.
quiz.explanation: 注入漿液一部分填充孔隙或裂縫，另一部分造成土體位移，故注入體積不等於資產抬升體積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Some grout fills voids or fractures while another part displaces soil, so injected volume does not equal asset-heave volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 注入抬升效率的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「注入抬升效率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Injection-heave efficiency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設估算抬升體積Vh=0.6 m³、注入Vg=2 m³，表觀效率η=Vh/Vg=0.30。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For inferred heave volume Vh=0.6 m³ and injection Vg=2 m³, apparent efficiency η=Vh/Vg=0.30. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將地表位移積分範圍、注入量與時間對齊，檢查資產外的變形是否被漏算，保留孔壓資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align the surface-integration area, injection volume and time, checking omitted movement outside the asset and retaining pore-pressure observations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設估算抬升體積Vh=0.6 m³、注入Vg=2 m³，表觀效率η=Vh/Vg=0.30。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For inferred heave volume Vh=0.6 m³ and injection Vg=2 m³, apparent efficiency η=Vh/Vg=0.30. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「注入抬升效率的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設估算抬升體積Vh=0.6 m³、注入Vg=2 m³，表觀效率η=Vh/Vg=0.30。
監測畫面仍有數字，就表示資料一定即時有效。
一次試驗得到的補償效率可以固定用到工程結束。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For inferred heave volume Vh=0.6 m³ and injection Vg=2 m³, apparent efficiency η=Vh/Vg=0.30.
Numbers remaining on a monitoring display mean the data are current and valid.
One trial compensation efficiency remains valid until project completion.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設估算抬升體積Vh=0.6 m³、注入Vg=2 m³，表觀效率η=Vh/Vg=0.30。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For inferred heave volume Vh=0.6 m³ and injection Vg=2 m³, apparent efficiency η=Vh/Vg=0.30. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 注入抬升效率的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「注入抬升效率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Injection-heave efficiency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將地表位移積分範圍、注入量與時間對齊，檢查資產外的變形是否被漏算，保留孔壓資料。效率估算應保留空間及時間範圍；地工設計者確認反應改變原因後，才調整補償方案。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align the surface-integration area, injection volume and time, checking omitted movement outside the asset and retaining pore-pressure observations. Document the spatial and temporal bounds of efficiency estimates; the geotechnical designer confirms why response changed before revising compensation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：效率估算應保留空間及時間範圍；地工設計者確認反應改變原因後，才調整補償方案。表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Document the spatial and temporal bounds of efficiency estimates; the geotechnical designer confirms why response changed before revising compensation. Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用固定效率追求補償可能在地盤變硬後造成過度隆起，或在漏失時持續注入而未達目標。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using fixed efficiency can cause excessive heave after ground stiffens or continued injection without compensation when losses occur. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Align the surface-integration area, injection volume and time, checking omitted movement outside the asset and retaining pore-pressure observations. Document the spatial and temporal bounds of efficiency estimates; the geotechnical designer confirms why response changed before revising compensation.

knowledge.text: 效率估算應保留空間及時間範圍；地工設計者確認反應改變原因後，才調整補償方案。表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。
knowledge.textEn: Document the spatial and temporal bounds of efficiency estimates; the geotechnical designer confirms why response changed before revising compensation. Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「注入抬升效率的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將地表位移積分範圍、注入量與時間對齊，檢查資產外的變形是否被漏算，保留孔壓資料。
一次注入得到的線性增益可精確預測任何後續用量。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Align the surface-integration area, injection volume and time, checking omitted movement outside the asset and retaining pore-pressure observations.
A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly.
quiz.explanation: 將地表位移積分範圍、注入量與時間對齊，檢查資產外的變形是否被漏算，保留孔壓資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align the surface-integration area, injection volume and time, checking omitted movement outside the asset and retaining pore-pressure observations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 注入抬升效率的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「注入抬升效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Injection-heave efficiency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用固定效率追求補償可能在地盤變硬後造成過度隆起，或在漏失時持續注入而未達目標。表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using fixed efficiency can cause excessive heave after ground stiffens or continued injection without compensation when losses occur. Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用固定效率追求補償可能在地盤變硬後造成過度隆起，或在漏失時持續注入而未達目標。表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。
knowledge.textEn: Using fixed efficiency can cause excessive heave after ground stiffens or continued injection without compensation when losses occur. Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「注入抬升效率的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
孔口放樣正確就表示所有袖閥都在設計位置。
用固定效率追求補償可能在地盤變硬後造成過度隆起，或在漏失時持續注入而未達目標。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Correct collar setting-out proves every sleeve port is correctly positioned.
Using fixed efficiency can cause excessive heave after ground stiffens or continued injection without compensation when losses occur.
quiz.explanation: 用固定效率追求補償可能在地盤變硬後造成過度隆起，或在漏失時持續注入而未達目標。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using fixed efficiency can cause excessive heave after ground stiffens or continued injection without compensation when losses occur. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「袖閥管定位的機理與驗證」與「注入與有效應力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sleeve-pipe location mechanism and verification" and "Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 袖閥管定位的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sleeve-pipe location mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「袖閥管定位」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sleeve-pipe location” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 灌漿管位置控制注入與資產間的幾何關係，長孔小角度偏差可把有效區移到不同地層或接近既有設施。只知道孔口位置不足以定位各袖閥，必須建立全長軌跡，並與地下資產資料的不確定範圍一起比較。固定角誤差式不是全孔軌跡模型，實際曲線與孔口誤差會疊加；不可把名目深度當唯一空間座標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「袖閥管定位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pipe location defines the geometry between injection and assets. Small angular errors over long bores can shift the effective zone into different strata or toward existing infrastructure. Collar position alone does not locate each sleeve port; full trajectories must be compared with the uncertainty envelope of buried assets. The fixed-angle expression is not a full trajectory model; curvature and collar errors accumulate, and nominal depth is not a unique spatial coordinate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sleeve-pipe location” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設管長L=20 m、方向誤差θ=1°，側向偏移δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For pipe length L=20 m and angular error θ=1°, lateral offset δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔口放樣正確就表示所有袖閥都在設計位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct collar setting-out proves every sleeve port is correctly positioned." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「袖閥管定位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sleeve-pipe location”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 袖閥管定位的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 灌漿管位置控制注入與資產間的幾何關係，長孔小角度偏差可把有效區移到不同地層或接近既有設施。只知道孔口位置不足以定位各袖閥，必須建立全長軌跡，並與地下資產資料的不確定範圍一起比較。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct collar setting-out proves every sleeve port is correctly positioned. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「袖閥管定位的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sleeve-pipe location mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 灌漿管位置控制注入與資產間的幾何關係，長孔小角度偏差可把有效區移到不同地層或接近既有設施。
孔口放樣正確就表示所有袖閥都在設計位置。
泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。
optionsEn: Pipe location defines the geometry between injection and assets.
Correct collar setting-out proves every sleeve port is correctly positioned.
Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth.

steps.instructionEn: Build three-dimensional port positions from approved deviation surveys and depth logs, checking utility-survey accuracy and whether response matches the intended stratum. steps.instructionEn: Rising local fluid pressure can reduce skeleton effective stress and initiate fracture opening or movement. Effective stress does not directly give fracture pressure, which also depends on minimum principal stress, tension and interfaces; these pressures are not field injection settings. steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

quiz.question: 依「注入與有效應力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly.

steps.title: 注入與有效應力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「注入與有效應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Injection and effective stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照泵端及注入點壓力與鄰近孔壓計，量測管路損失，將資產位移及時間延遲一併記錄。壓力量測位置與損失修正須列於方案；地工及設備負責人共同確認資料意義後才調整控制邊界。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pump and port pressures with nearby piezometers, assess line losses, and record asset movement and response delay together. State pressure locations and loss corrections in the plan; geotechnical and equipment leads confirm interpretation before control boundaries are changed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：壓力量測位置與損失修正須列於方案；地工及設備負責人共同確認資料意義後才調整控制邊界。此有效應力式不直接給劈裂壓力，還需最小主應力、抗拉及界面條件；教學壓力不是現場注入設定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State pressure locations and loss corrections in the plan; geotechnical and equipment leads confirm interpretation before control boundaries are changed. Effective stress does not directly give fracture pressure, which also depends on minimum principal stress, tension and interfaces; these pressures are not field injection settings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把泵壓當土壓會錯估劈裂條件，可能持續提高注入而在遠端弱面形成非預期變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating pump pressure as soil pressure misstates fracture conditions and can encourage continued injection that moves an unintended distant weak plane. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「注入與有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 把泵壓當土壓會錯估劈裂條件，可能持續提高注入而在遠端弱面形成非預期變形。此有效應力式不直接給劈裂壓力，還需最小主應力、抗拉及界面條件；教學壓力不是現場注入設定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「注入與有效應力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把泵壓當土壓會錯估劈裂條件，可能持續提高注入而在遠端弱面形成非預期變形。
監測畫面仍有數字，就表示資料一定即時有效。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating pump pressure as soil pressure misstates fracture conditions and can encourage continued injection that moves an unintended distant weak plane.
Numbers remaining on a monitoring display mean the data are current and valid.
quiz.explanation: 把泵壓當土壓會錯估劈裂條件，可能持續提高注入而在遠端弱面形成非預期變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating pump pressure as soil pressure misstates fracture conditions and can encourage continued injection that moves an unintended distant weak plane. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「回饋延遲的機理與驗證」與「建物角變形的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Feedback delay mechanism and verification" and "Building angular distortion mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 回饋延遲的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Feedback delay mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「回饋延遲」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Feedback delay” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 補償灌漿的控制迴路包含感測、傳輸、判讀與設備反應，每個環節的延遲會使已發生的位移晚到控制者眼前。若持續注入速度快於可觀察反應，容易超越目標；延遲應與地層本身的反應時間分開辨識。延遲相加假設環節串聯，並行處理需另建時間模型；二十秒不是允許延遲標準，也不取代資產反應分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回饋延遲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The control loop includes sensing, transmission, interpretation and equipment response, each delaying the movement information reaching the controller. If injection continues faster than observable response, compensation may overshoot. System delay must be distinguished from the physical response time of the ground rather than combining them into one unexplained lag. Adding delays assumes serial stages; parallel processing needs a different timing model, and twenty seconds is neither an allowable delay nor a substitute for asset-response analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Feedback delay” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設感測5 s、傳輸3 s、判讀與反應12 s，總延遲τ=5+3+12=20 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For sensing 5 s, transmission 3 s and interpretation-response 12 s, total delay τ=20 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「監測畫面仍有數字，就表示資料一定即時有效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Numbers remaining on a monitoring display mean the data are current and valid." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「回饋延遲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Feedback delay”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 回饋延遲的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 補償灌漿的控制迴路包含感測、傳輸、判讀與設備反應，每個環節的延遲會使已發生的位移晚到控制者眼前。若持續注入速度快於可觀察反應，容易超越目標；延遲應與地層本身的反應時間分開辨識。
knowledge.textEn: The control loop includes sensing, transmission, interpretation and equipment response, each delaying the movement information reaching the controller. If injection continues faster than observable response, compensation may overshoot.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：監測畫面仍有數字，就表示資料一定即時有效。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Numbers remaining on a monitoring display mean the data are current and valid. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「回饋延遲的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Feedback delay mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 監測畫面仍有數字，就表示資料一定即時有效。
只要把每個地表點抬回原高程，建物內力就會減少。
補償灌漿的控制迴路包含感測、傳輸、判讀與設備反應，每個環節的延遲會使已發生的位移晚到控制者眼前。
optionsEn: Numbers remaining on a monitoring display mean the data are current and valid.
Returning every surface point to its original elevation necessarily reduces building forces.
The control loop includes sensing, transmission, interpretation and equipment response, each delaying the movement information reaching the controller.
quiz.explanation: 補償灌漿的控制迴路包含感測、傳輸、判讀與設備反應，每個環節的延遲會使已發生的位移晚到控制者眼前。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
