steps.title: 回饋延遲的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Feedback delay mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「回饋延遲」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Feedback delay” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設感測5 s、傳輸3 s、判讀與反應12 s，總延遲τ=5+3+12=20 s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For sensing 5 s, transmission 3 s and interpretation-response 12 s, total delay τ=20 s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用共同時鐘追蹤注入事件與感測到達時間，模擬訊號中斷，確認遺失資料不會被當成零位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a common clock to trace injection events and data arrival, testing signal loss so missing data are not interpreted as zero movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Building angular distortion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 補償的目標通常是限制資產差異變位，單純追求回復地表標高可能反而造成局部反曲。兩點沉陷差可估平均角變形，但建物剛度及基礎連續性會改變力流；原有裂縫與脆性接頭需有個別的變形評估。平均角變形不是通用損傷指標，需依跨距、剛度與既有狀態解釋；剛體傾斜應與構件彎曲分離。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「建物角變形」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compensation generally targets differential asset movement, and restoring surface elevation alone can produce adverse local reverse curvature. Two-point settlement difference estimates mean angular distortion, but building stiffness and foundation continuity change force paths. Existing cracks and brittle connections require their own movement assessment rather than a generic surface target. Mean angular distortion is not a universal damage indicator; interpret it with span, stiffness and existing condition, separating rigid tilt from member bending. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Building angular distortion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設差異位移Δs=3 mm、測點距L=6 m=6000 mm，β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For differential movement Δs=3 mm over L=6 m=6000 mm, β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把每個地表點抬回原高程，建物內力就會減少。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Returning every surface point to its original elevation necessarily reduces building forces." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「建物角變形」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 資產變形控制區需由結構評估者核定；補償決策應同時檢查相鄰測點，不能只追單點目標。平均角變形不是通用損傷指標，需依跨距、剛度與既有狀態解釋；剛體傾斜應與構件彎曲分離。
knowledge.textEn: The structural assessor approves asset-control zones; compensation decisions check neighbouring points rather than pursuing one isolated target. Mean angular distortion is not a universal damage indicator; interpret it with span, stiffness and existing condition, separating rigid tilt from member bending.

quiz.question: 要驗證「建物角變形的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Building angular distortion mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
孔口放樣正確就表示所有袖閥都在設計位置。
量測資產本體而非只量附近地表，結合傾度與裂縫計分辨剛體轉動及真實畸變。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Correct collar setting-out proves every sleeve port is correctly positioned.
Measure the asset itself rather than nearby ground alone, combining tilt and crack gauges to distinguish rigid-body rotation from actual distortion.
quiz.explanation: 量測資產本體而非只量附近地表，結合傾度與裂縫計分辨剛體轉動及真實畸變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the asset itself rather than nearby ground alone, combining tilt and crack gauges to distinguish rigid-body rotation from actual distortion. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 建物角變形的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Building angular distortion mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「建物角變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Building angular distortion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過度補償一個測點可能讓鄰跨產生更大差異變位，總沉陷變小卻造成新的裂縫。平均角變形不是通用損傷指標，需依跨距、剛度與既有狀態解釋；剛體傾斜應與構件彎曲分離。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overcompensating one point can increase differential movement in the next span, reducing total settlement while causing new cracks. Mean angular distortion is not a universal damage indicator; interpret it with span, stiffness and existing condition, separating rigid tilt from member bending. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均角變形不是通用損傷指標，需依跨距、剛度與既有狀態解釋；剛體傾斜應與構件彎曲分離。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean angular distortion is not a universal damage indicator; interpret it with span, stiffness and existing condition, separating rigid tilt from member bending.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把每個地表點抬回原高程，建物內力就會減少。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Returning every surface point to its original elevation necessarily reduces building forces." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 過度補償一個測點可能讓鄰跨產生更大差異變位，總沉陷變小卻造成新的裂縫。平均角變形不是通用損傷指標，需依跨距、剛度與既有狀態解釋；剛體傾斜應與構件彎曲分離。
knowledge.textEn: Overcompensating one point can increase differential movement in the next span, reducing total settlement while causing new cracks. Mean angular distortion is not a universal damage indicator; interpret it with span, stiffness and existing condition, separating rigid tilt from member bending.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「建物角變形的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Building angular distortion mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 過度補償一個測點可能讓鄰跨產生更大差異變位，總沉陷變小卻造成新的裂縫。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
一次試驗得到的補償效率可以固定用到工程結束。
optionsEn: Overcompensating one point can increase differential movement in the next span, reducing total settlement while causing new cracks.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
One trial compensation efficiency remains valid until project completion.
quiz.explanation: 過度補償一個測點可能讓鄰跨產生更大差異變位，總沉陷變小卻造成新的裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Overcompensating one point can increase differential movement in the next span, reducing total settlement while causing new cracks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「效率隨歷程變化的機理與驗證」與「結構曲率的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "History-dependent efficiency mechanism and verification" and "Structural curvature mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 效率隨歷程變化的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: History-dependent efficiency mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「效率隨歷程變化」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “History-dependent efficiency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 前次灌漿可能填滿可進入空隙或改變地層應力，使後續相同注入量產生不同位移。效率變化是地盤狀態更新的訊號，不能直接把較高效率當進度優勢；反應突然增強可能意味抬升更局部或注入路徑轉移。兩個效率必須採相同量測定義才可相除，否則倍率可能只是觀測範圍改變；它不直接給出下一輪施工參數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「效率隨歷程變化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Previous grouting may fill accessible voids or alter stress, changing movement from the same later injection volume. Efficiency change signals evolving ground state rather than an automatic productivity benefit. A stronger response can mean more localized heave or a shifted injection path, requiring renewed spatial interpretation. Efficiencies require identical measurement definitions before comparison; otherwise the ratio may reflect a changed observation area and does not prescribe the next operational settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “History-dependent efficiency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設初期效率η₁=0.30、後期η₂=0.45，倍率η₂/η₁=1.5。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For initial efficiency η₁=0.30 and later η₂=0.45, response-efficiency ratio η₂/η₁=1.5.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次試驗得到的補償效率可以固定用到工程結束。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One trial compensation efficiency remains valid until project completion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「效率隨歷程變化」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “History-dependent efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 效率隨歷程變化的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 前次灌漿可能填滿可進入空隙或改變地層應力，使後續相同注入量產生不同位移。效率變化是地盤狀態更新的訊號，不能直接把較高效率當進度優勢；反應突然增強可能意味抬升更局部或注入路徑轉移。
knowledge.textEn: Previous grouting may fill accessible voids or alter stress, changing movement from the same later injection volume. Efficiency change signals evolving ground state rather than an automatic productivity benefit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次試驗得到的補償效率可以固定用到工程結束。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One trial compensation efficiency remains valid until project completion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「效率隨歷程變化的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "History-dependent efficiency mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 一次試驗得到的補償效率可以固定用到工程結束。
前次灌漿可能填滿可進入空隙或改變地層應力，使後續相同注入量產生不同位移。
兩點傾斜角很小，就能保證中間沒有局部高曲率。
optionsEn: One trial compensation efficiency remains valid until project completion.
Previous grouting may fill accessible voids or alter stress, changing movement from the same later injection volume.
A small two-point tilt guarantees no high curvature between them.
quiz.explanation: 前次灌漿可能填滿可進入空隙或改變地層應力，使後續相同注入量產生不同位移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Previous grouting may fill accessible voids or alter stress, changing movement from the same later injection volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 效率隨歷程變化的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: History-dependent efficiency mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「效率隨歷程變化」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “History-dependent efficiency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設初期效率η₁=0.30、後期η₂=0.45，倍率η₂/η₁=1.5。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For initial efficiency η₁=0.30 and later η₂=0.45, response-efficiency ratio η₂/η₁=1.5. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以相同觀測範圍和時間窗比較各輪注入，檢查位移形狀是否改變，而非只計體積比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare rounds over the same observation area and time window, examining movement shape as well as the volume ratio.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設初期效率η₁=0.30、後期η₂=0.45，倍率η₂/η₁=1.5。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For initial efficiency η₁=0.30 and later η₂=0.45, response-efficiency ratio η₂/η₁=1.5. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「效率隨歷程變化的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "History-dependent efficiency mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 停止灌漿後，地盤位移也會立即完全停止。
注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。
原創教學假設：假設初期效率η₁=0.30、後期η₂=0.45，倍率η₂/η₁=1.5。
optionsEn: Ground movement stops completely as soon as grouting stops.
One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave.
Original teaching assumptions: For initial efficiency η₁=0.30 and later η₂=0.45, response-efficiency ratio η₂/η₁=1.5.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設初期效率η₁=0.30、後期η₂=0.45，倍率η₂/η₁=1.5。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For initial efficiency η₁=0.30 and later η₂=0.45, response-efficiency ratio η₂/η₁=1.5. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 效率隨歷程變化的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: History-dependent efficiency mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「效率隨歷程變化」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “History-dependent efficiency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以相同觀測範圍和時間窗比較各輪注入，檢查位移形狀是否改變，而非只計體積比。每輪回饋需保留歷史狀態與反應差異；設計者審查效率變化後更新模型，且保留舊版本供追溯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare rounds over the same observation area and time window, examining movement shape as well as the volume ratio. Retain state history and response differences for each round; the designer updates the model after reviewing efficiency change and preserves earlier versions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每輪回饋需保留歷史狀態與反應差異；設計者審查效率變化後更新模型，且保留舊版本供追溯。兩個效率必須採相同量測定義才可相除，否則倍率可能只是觀測範圍改變；它不直接給出下一輪施工參數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain state history and response differences for each round; the designer updates the model after reviewing efficiency change and preserves earlier versions. Efficiencies require identical measurement definitions before comparison; otherwise the ratio may reflect a changed observation area and does not prescribe the next operational settings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沿用早期效率可能讓後續補償過量，資產局部隆起或接縫反向開合而未被平均值識別。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Retaining early efficiency can overcompensate later rounds, creating local uplift or reversed joint movement hidden by averages. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以相同觀測範圍和時間窗比較各輪注入，檢查位移形狀是否改變，而非只計體積比。每輪回饋需保留歷史狀態與反應差異；設計者審查效率變化後更新模型，且保留舊版本供追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Compare rounds over the same observation area and time window, examining movement shape as well as the volume ratio. Retain state history and response differences for each round; the designer updates the model after reviewing efficiency change and preserves earlier versions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每輪回饋需保留歷史狀態與反應差異；設計者審查效率變化後更新模型，且保留舊版本供追溯。兩個效率必須採相同量測定義才可相除，否則倍率可能只是觀測範圍改變；它不直接給出下一輪施工參數。
knowledge.textEn: Retain state history and response differences for each round; the designer updates the model after reviewing efficiency change and preserves earlier versions. Efficiencies require identical measurement definitions before comparison; otherwise the ratio may reflect a changed observation area and does not prescribe the next operational settings.

quiz.question: 要驗證「效率隨歷程變化的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "History-dependent efficiency mechanism and verification"?
options: 以相同觀測範圍和時間窗比較各輪注入，檢查位移形狀是否改變，而非只計體積比。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth.
quiz.explanation: 以相同觀測範圍和時間窗比較各輪注入，檢查位移形狀是否改變，而非只計體積比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare rounds over the same observation area and time window, examining movement shape as well as the volume ratio. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.instruction: 連續建物或管線受到地盤變形時，曲率比單一斜率更直接反映彎曲需求。兩段轉角差除以距離可估局部曲率，資料解析度及測點間距卻會影響結果；把粗間距測點插值成平滑曲線，可能漏掉剛度突變處的集中彎曲。有限差分曲率是假設變形平滑的近似，接縫可集中轉動時不應當連續梁；材料應變還須乘中性軸距離。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「結構曲率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For continuous buildings or pipes, curvature reflects bending demand more directly than one slope. Rotation difference over distance estimates local curvature, but resolution and spacing influence the result. stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證」與「停注後反應的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Small-signal response model mechanism and verification" and "Post-injection response mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Small-signal response model mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「小訊號反應模型」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Small-signal response model” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以既有小幅注入與量測可建立局部線性增益，供比較控制敏感度，但地盤劈裂與接觸開閉使系統本質非線性。模型只能在相近狀態及小增量內使用，不能從一次反應直接推算大體積注入，更不能把理論控制值當作現場施作指令。算例數字完全合成，只用來說明增益與輸入單位，不是推薦注入量；一旦狀態改變，需重新辨識或改採非線性模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「小訊號反應模型」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small observed injections can establish a local linear gain for comparing control sensitivity, but fracture growth and opening or closing contact make the ground nonlinear. The model applies only near the calibrated state and for small increments. One response cannot justify large-volume extrapolation or turn a theoretical control quantity into field instructions. The numbers are wholly synthetic and illustrate gain and input units rather than recommended injection quantity; changed state requires re-identification or a nonlinear model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Small-signal response model” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：純合成控制示例假設局部增益g=2 mm/L、微小輸入ΔV=0.5 L，預測Δs=gΔV=1 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: In a purely synthetic control example, local gain g=2 mm/L and small input ΔV=0.5 L give Δs=gΔV=1 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次注入得到的線性增益可精確預測任何後續用量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「小訊號反應模型」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Small-signal response model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Small-signal response model mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 以既有小幅注入與量測可建立局部線性增益，供比較控制敏感度，但地盤劈裂與接觸開閉使系統本質非線性。模型只能在相近狀態及小增量內使用，不能從一次反應直接推算大體積注入，更不能把理論控制值當作現場施作指令。
knowledge.textEn: Small observed injections can establish a local linear gain for comparing control sensitivity, but fracture growth and opening or closing contact make the ground nonlinear. The model applies only near the calibrated state and for small increments.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次注入得到的線性增益可精確預測任何後續用量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Small-signal response model mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 以既有小幅注入與量測可建立局部線性增益，供比較控制敏感度，但地盤劈裂與接觸開閉使系統本質非線性。
一次注入得到的線性增益可精確預測任何後續用量。
停止灌漿後，地盤位移也會立即完全停止。
optionsEn: Small observed injections can establish a local linear gain for comparing control sensitivity, but fracture growth and opening or closing contact make the ground nonlinear.
A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly.
Ground movement stops completely as soon as grouting stops.
quiz.explanation: 以既有小幅注入與量測可建立局部線性增益，供比較控制敏感度，但地盤劈裂與接觸開閉使系統本質非線性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small observed injections can establish a local linear gain for comparing control sensitivity, but fracture growth and opening or closing contact make the ground nonlinear. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Small-signal response model mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「小訊號反應模型」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Small-signal response model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：純合成控制示例假設局部增益g=2 mm/L、微小輸入ΔV=0.5 L，預測Δs=gΔV=1 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: In a purely synthetic control example, local gain g=2 mm/L and small input ΔV=0.5 L give Δs=gΔV=1 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用未參與辨識的小幅資料檢查增益，對比位置、時間及孔壓，確認反應沒有改變機制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the gain against small observations excluded from identification, comparing location, timing and pore pressure to confirm the mechanism remains unchanged.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：純合成控制示例假設局部增益g=2 mm/L、微小輸入ΔV=0.5 L，預測Δs=gΔV=1 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: In a purely synthetic control example, local gain g=2 mm/L and small input ΔV=0.5 L give Δs=gΔV=1 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Small-signal response model mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。
原創教學假設：純合成控制示例假設局部增益g=2 mm/L、微小輸入ΔV=0.5 L，預測Δs=gΔV=1 mm。
泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。
optionsEn: One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave.
Original teaching assumptions: In a purely synthetic control example, local gain g=2 mm/L and small input ΔV=0.5 L give Δs=gΔV=1 mm.
Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：純合成控制示例假設局部增益g=2 mm/L、微小輸入ΔV=0.5 L，預測Δs=gΔV=1 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: In a purely synthetic control example, local gain g=2 mm/L and small input ΔV=0.5 L give Δs=gΔV=1 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Small-signal response model mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「小訊號反應模型」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Small-signal response model” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用未參與辨識的小幅資料檢查增益，對比位置、時間及孔壓，確認反應沒有改變機制。現場參數需由核定試驗與資產限制決定；控制模型由地工設計者確認適用區間及失效停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the gain against small observations excluded from identification, comparing location, timing and pore pressure to confirm the mechanism remains unchanged. Field parameters follow approved trials and asset constraints; the geotechnical designer confirms the control model range and failure hold points. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：現場參數需由核定試驗與資產限制決定；控制模型由地工設計者確認適用區間及失效停留點。算例數字完全合成，只用來說明增益與輸入單位，不是推薦注入量；一旦狀態改變，需重新辨識或改採非線性模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Field parameters follow approved trials and asset constraints; the geotechnical designer confirms the control model range and failure hold points. The numbers are wholly synthetic and illustrate gain and input units rather than recommended injection quantity; changed state requires re-identification or a nonlinear model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把線性增益外推至大注入量，可能因新裂縫或局部抬升而產生遠超預期的變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extrapolating linear gain to large injection can activate new fractures or localized heave and produce movements far beyond prediction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用未參與辨識的小幅資料檢查增益，對比位置、時間及孔壓，確認反應沒有改變機制。現場參數需由核定試驗與資產限制決定；控制模型由地工設計者確認適用區間及失效停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check the gain against small observations excluded from identification, comparing location, timing and pore pressure to confirm the mechanism remains unchanged. Field parameters follow approved trials and asset constraints; the geotechnical designer confirms the control model range and failure hold points.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 現場參數需由核定試驗與資產限制決定；控制模型由地工設計者確認適用區間及失效停留點。算例數字完全合成，只用來說明增益與輸入單位，不是推薦注入量；一旦狀態改變，需重新辨識或改採非線性模型。
knowledge.textEn: Field parameters follow approved trials and asset constraints; the geotechnical designer confirms the control model range and failure hold points. The numbers are wholly synthetic and illustrate gain and input units rather than recommended injection quantity; changed state requires re-identification or a nonlinear model.

quiz.question: 要驗證「小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Small-signal response model mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要把每個地表點抬回原高程，建物內力就會減少。
用未參與辨識的小幅資料檢查增益，對比位置、時間及孔壓，確認反應沒有改變機制。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Returning every surface point to its original elevation necessarily reduces building forces.
Check the gain against small observations excluded from identification, comparing location, timing and pore pressure to confirm the mechanism remains unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 用未參與辨識的小幅資料檢查增益，對比位置、時間及孔壓，確認反應沒有改變機制。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the gain against small observations excluded from identification, comparing location, timing and pore pressure to confirm the mechanism remains unchanged. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Small-signal response model mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「小訊號反應模型」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Small-signal response model” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把線性增益外推至大注入量，可能因新裂縫或局部抬升而產生遠超預期的變形。算例數字完全合成，只用來說明增益與輸入單位，不是推薦注入量；一旦狀態改變，需重新辨識或改採非線性模型。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extrapolating linear gain to large injection can activate new fractures or localized heave and produce movements far beyond prediction. The numbers are wholly synthetic and illustrate gain and input units rather than recommended injection quantity; changed state requires re-identification or a nonlinear model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：算例數字完全合成，只用來說明增益與輸入單位，不是推薦注入量；一旦狀態改變，需重新辨識或改採非線性模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The numbers are wholly synthetic and illustrate gain and input units rather than recommended injection quantity; changed state requires re-identification or a nonlinear model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一次注入得到的線性增益可精確預測任何後續用量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把線性增益外推至大注入量，可能因新裂縫或局部抬升而產生遠超預期的變形。算例數字完全合成，只用來說明增益與輸入單位，不是推薦注入量；一旦狀態改變，需重新辨識或改採非線性模型。
knowledge.textEn: Extrapolating linear gain to large injection can activate new fractures or localized heave and produce movements far beyond prediction. The numbers are wholly synthetic and illustrate gain and input units rather than recommended injection quantity; changed state requires re-identification or a nonlinear model.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Small-signal response model mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把線性增益外推至大注入量，可能因新裂縫或局部抬升而產生遠超預期的變形。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
停止灌漿後，地盤位移也會立即完全停止。
optionsEn: Extrapolating linear gain to large injection can activate new fractures or localized heave and produce movements far beyond prediction.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Ground movement stops completely as soon as grouting stops.
quiz.explanation: 把線性增益外推至大注入量，可能因新裂縫或局部抬升而產生遠超預期的變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Extrapolating linear gain to large injection can activate new fractures or localized heave and produce movements far beyond prediction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 停注後反應的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-injection response mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停注後反應」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-injection response” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停止注入後，地盤仍可能因孔壓消散、漿材固化及隧道持續開挖而移動，因此控制不應在閥門關閉時結束。殘餘位移與時間的關係有助分辨短時回彈及長期沉陷，但需扣除其他施工事件並保持監測基準不變。四天平均率不代表最終沉陷或峰值速率，且需要固定位置與方向；本例不能取代專案監測終止判據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停注後反應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Movement can continue after injection through pore-pressure dissipation, curing and ongoing tunnelling, so control should not end when a valve closes. Residual movement over time helps distinguish rebound from longer-term settlement, but other construction events must be separated and the monitoring datum kept consistent. A four-day mean does not establish final settlement or peak rate and requires fixed location and direction; it cannot replace project monitoring closure criteria. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Post-injection response” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設停注後位移由1.0 mm至1.4 mm、間隔4 day，平均變化率v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For post-injection movement from 1.0 mm to 1.4 mm over four days, mean rate v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「停止灌漿後，地盤位移也會立即完全停止。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ground movement stops completely as soon as grouting stops." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停注後反應」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Post-injection response”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停注後反應的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 停止注入後，地盤仍可能因孔壓消散、漿材固化及隧道持續開挖而移動，因此控制不應在閥門關閉時結束。殘餘位移與時間的關係有助分辨短時回彈及長期沉陷，但需扣除其他施工事件並保持監測基準不變。
knowledge.textEn: Movement can continue after injection through pore-pressure dissipation, curing and ongoing tunnelling, so control should not end when a valve closes. Residual movement over time helps distinguish rebound from longer-term settlement, but other construction events must be separated and the monitoring datum kept consistent.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：停止灌漿後，地盤位移也會立即完全停止。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Ground movement stops completely as soon as grouting stops. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停注後反應的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-injection response mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 停止灌漿後，地盤位移也會立即完全停止。
停止注入後，地盤仍可能因孔壓消散、漿材固化及隧道持續開挖而移動，因此控制不應在閥門關閉時結束。
最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。
optionsEn: Ground movement stops completely as soon as grouting stops.
Movement can continue after injection through pore-pressure dissipation, curing and ongoing tunnelling, so control should not end when a valve closes.
Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location.
quiz.explanation: 停止注入後，地盤仍可能因孔壓消散、漿材固化及隧道持續開挖而移動，因此控制不應在閥門關閉時結束。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Movement can continue after injection through pore-pressure dissipation, curing and ongoing tunnelling, so control should not end when a valve closes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停注後反應的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-injection response mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停注後反應」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-injection response” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設停注後位移由1.0 mm至1.4 mm、間隔4 day，平均變化率v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For post-injection movement from 1.0 mm to 1.4 mm over four days, mean rate v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：持續記錄位移、孔壓及隧道進度，檢查停止注入後的相位及反向移動，保留資料到核定穩定條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Continue movement, pore-pressure and tunnel-progress records, checking phase and reversal after injection until approved stabilization conditions are demonstrated.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設停注後位移由1.0 mm至1.4 mm、間隔4 day，平均變化率v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For post-injection movement from 1.0 mm to 1.4 mm over four days, mean rate v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「停注後反應的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-injection response mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 孔口放樣正確就表示所有袖閥都在設計位置。
監測畫面仍有數字，就表示資料一定即時有效。
原創教學假設：假設停注後位移由1.0 mm至1.4 mm、間隔4 day，平均變化率v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day。
optionsEn: Correct collar setting-out proves every sleeve port is correctly positioned.
Numbers remaining on a monitoring display mean the data are current and valid.
Original teaching assumptions: For post-injection movement from 1.0 mm to 1.4 mm over four days, mean rate v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設停注後位移由1.0 mm至1.4 mm、間隔4 day，平均變化率v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For post-injection movement from 1.0 mm to 1.4 mm over four days, mean rate v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 停注後反應的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-injection response mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停注後反應」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-injection response” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 持續記錄位移、孔壓及隧道進度，檢查停止注入後的相位及反向移動，保留資料到核定穩定條件。交接需明定停止注入後的監測責任與結案條件；資產及地工負責人共同確認殘餘反應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Continue movement, pore-pressure and tunnel-progress records, checking phase and reversal after injection until approved stabilization conditions are demonstrated. Handover defines post-injection monitoring responsibility and closure conditions; asset and geotechnical leads jointly confirm residual response. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接需明定停止注入後的監測責任與結案條件；資產及地工負責人共同確認殘餘反應。四天平均率不代表最終沉陷或峰值速率，且需要固定位置與方向；本例不能取代專案監測終止判據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover defines post-injection monitoring responsibility and closure conditions; asset and geotechnical leads jointly confirm residual response. A four-day mean does not establish final settlement or peak rate and requires fixed location and direction; it cannot replace project monitoring closure criteria.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：太早結束監測會漏掉延遲抬升或回沉，資產可能在施工團隊撤離後才出現接縫問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ending monitoring early misses delayed uplift or renewed settlement, leaving asset joints to develop problems after the construction team leaves. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 持續記錄位移、孔壓及隧道進度，檢查停止注入後的相位及反向移動，保留資料到核定穩定條件。交接需明定停止注入後的監測責任與結案條件；資產及地工負責人共同確認殘餘反應。
knowledge.textEn: Continue movement, pore-pressure and tunnel-progress records, checking phase and reversal after injection until approved stabilization conditions are demonstrated. Handover defines post-injection monitoring responsibility and closure conditions; asset and geotechnical leads jointly confirm residual response.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接需明定停止注入後的監測責任與結案條件；資產及地工負責人共同確認殘餘反應。四天平均率不代表最終沉陷或峰值速率，且需要固定位置與方向；本例不能取代專案監測終止判據。
knowledge.textEn: Handover defines post-injection monitoring responsibility and closure conditions; asset and geotechnical leads jointly confirm residual response. A four-day mean does not establish final settlement or peak rate and requires fixed location and direction; it cannot replace project monitoring closure criteria.

quiz.question: 要驗證「停注後反應的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-injection response mechanism and verification"?
options: 持續記錄位移、孔壓及隧道進度，檢查停止注入後的相位及反向移動，保留資料到核定穩定條件。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
一次試驗得到的補償效率可以固定用到工程結束。
optionsEn: Continue movement, pore-pressure and tunnel-progress records, checking phase and reversal after injection until approved stabilization conditions are demonstrated.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
One trial compensation efficiency remains valid until project completion.
quiz.explanation: 持續記錄位移、孔壓及隧道進度，檢查停止注入後的相位及反向移動，保留資料到核定穩定條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Continue movement, pore-pressure and tunnel-progress records, checking phase and reversal after injection until approved stabilization conditions are demonstrated. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停注後反應的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-injection response mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停注後反應」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-injection response” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 太早結束監測會漏掉延遲抬升或回沉，資產可能在施工團隊撤離後才出現接縫問題。四天平均率不代表最終沉陷或峰值速率，且需要固定位置與方向；本例不能取代專案監測終止判據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ending monitoring early misses delayed uplift or renewed settlement, leaving asset joints to develop problems after the construction team leaves. A four-day mean does not establish final settlement or peak rate and requires fixed location and direction; it cannot replace project monitoring closure criteria. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：四天平均率不代表最終沉陷或峰值速率，且需要固定位置與方向；本例不能取代專案監測終止判據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A four-day mean does not establish final settlement or peak rate and requires fixed location and direction; it cannot replace project monitoring closure criteria.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「停止灌漿後，地盤位移也會立即完全停止。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ground movement stops completely as soon as grouting stops." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 太早結束監測會漏掉延遲抬升或回沉，資產可能在施工團隊撤離後才出現接縫問題。四天平均率不代表最終沉陷或峰值速率，且需要固定位置與方向；本例不能取代專案監測終止判據。
knowledge.textEn: Ending monitoring early misses delayed uplift or renewed settlement, leaving asset joints to develop problems after the construction team leaves. A four-day mean does not establish final settlement or peak rate and requires fixed location and direction; it cannot replace project monitoring closure criteria.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停注後反應的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-injection response mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
太早結束監測會漏掉延遲抬升或回沉，資產可能在施工團隊撤離後才出現接縫問題。
最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Ending monitoring early misses delayed uplift or renewed settlement, leaving asset joints to develop problems after the construction team leaves.
Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location.
quiz.explanation: 太早結束監測會漏掉延遲抬升或回沉，資產可能在施工團隊撤離後才出現接縫問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ending monitoring early misses delayed uplift or renewed settlement, leaving asset joints to develop problems after the construction team leaves. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 地盤壓密灌漿
summary: 壓密灌漿主要藉低流動性漿團擠移周圍土體，適用性與排水、密實狀態及可容許位移密切相關。本課區分擠密、填空與劈裂，從孔壓、孔隙比、漿泡幾何及處理覆蓋出發，連結等待時間、地表隆起、資產推力與改善後的剩餘沉陷。
summaryEn: Compaction grouting displaces surrounding soil with low-mobility grout masses, with suitability governed by drainage, density and tolerable movement. The course distinguishes densification, void filling and fracture, connecting pore pressure, void ratio, bulb geometry and coverage to waiting time, heave, asset force and residual settlement.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設飽和土受等向不排水總應力增量Δσ=100 kPa，Skempton係數B=0.9，超額孔壓Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa。只把總應力增量提高10%至110 kPa，B維持不變，Δu=99 kPa。這表示短時間內增加的荷載大部分由水壓反應承擔，不代表土骨架已永久增強。真實壓密灌漿並非等向試驗，還含剪應力、排水與漿泡形狀；應以孔壓消散及處理前後原位阻力共同確認改善，而非把高注入壓力當成密實度證據。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume saturated soil receives an isotropic undrained total-stress increment Δσ=100 kPa with Skempton coefficient B=0.9. Excess pressure is Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa. Increase only the stress increment by 10% to 110 kPa with B fixed and Δu becomes 99 kPa. Most of the short-term increment is therefore expressed in water pressure rather than demonstrated permanent skeleton strengthening. Actual compaction grouting is not an isotropic test and also involves shear, drainage and bulb geometry. Verify improvement using pressure dissipation and paired in-situ resistance tests rather than interpreting high injection pressure as density evidence.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「不排水孔壓的機理與驗證」與「孔隙比減少的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification" and "Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 不排水孔壓的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「不排水孔壓」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Undrained pore pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 低流動性漿團擠壓飽和土時，短時間內若水無法排出，部分總應力增量會轉成超額孔壓而非立即增加土骨架強度。反應取決於飽和度及應力路徑，不能因為注入壓力高就斷言地盤已變密；持續孔壓還可能暫時降低鄰近穩定。B係數式限於指定等向不排水路徑，真實漿團擴張具有剪應力變化；非等向情境需更完整的孔壓反應模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「不排水孔壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Displacing saturated soil with low-mobility grout can convert much of a rapid total-stress increment into excess pore pressure rather than immediate skeleton strengthening. Response depends on saturation and stress path, so high injection pressure does not prove densification. Persistent pore pressure may temporarily reduce stability nearby. The B relation applies to the stated isotropic undrained path; actual bulb expansion changes shear stress and needs a fuller pore-pressure model for nonisotropic loading. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Undrained pore pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設等向不排水增量Δσ=100 kPa、Skempton係數B=0.9，Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For an isotropic undrained increment Δσ=100 kPa and Skempton coefficient B=0.9, Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入壓力越高就表示土骨架已承受更多有效壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher injection pressure always means greater effective stress in the soil skeleton." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「不排水孔壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 不排水孔壓的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 低流動性漿團擠壓飽和土時，短時間內若水無法排出，部分總應力增量會轉成超額孔壓而非立即增加土骨架強度。反應取決於飽和度及應力路徑，不能因為注入壓力高就斷言地盤已變密；持續孔壓還可能暫時降低鄰近穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Displacing saturated soil with low-mobility grout can convert much of a rapid total-stress increment into excess pore pressure rather than immediate skeleton strengthening. Response depends on saturation and stress path, so high injection pressure does not prove densification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入壓力越高就表示土骨架已承受更多有效壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher injection pressure always means greater effective stress in the soil skeleton. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「不排水孔壓的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 注入壓力越高就表示土骨架已承受更多有效壓力。
低流動性漿團擠壓飽和土時，短時間內若水無法排出，部分總應力增量會轉成超額孔壓而非立即增加土骨架強度。
漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。
optionsEn: Higher injection pressure always means greater effective stress in the soil skeleton.
Displacing saturated soil with low-mobility grout can convert much of a rapid total-stress increment into excess pore pressure rather than immediate skeleton strengthening.
Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms.
quiz.explanation: 低流動性漿團擠壓飽和土時，短時間內若水無法排出，部分總應力增量會轉成超額孔壓而非立即增加土骨架強度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Displacing saturated soil with low-mobility grout can convert much of a rapid total-stress increment into excess pore pressure rather than immediate skeleton strengthening. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 不排水孔壓的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「不排水孔壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Undrained pore pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設等向不排水增量Δσ=100 kPa、Skempton係數B=0.9，Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For an isotropic undrained increment Δσ=100 kPa and Skempton coefficient B=0.9, Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以孔壓計與地表位移對照注入事件，檢查消散時間，並分辨管內壓力與土中孔壓。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare piezometers and surface movement with injection events, assess dissipation time, and distinguish pipe pressure from soil pore pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 不排水孔壓的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「不排水孔壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Undrained pore pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以孔壓計與地表位移對照注入事件，檢查消散時間，並分辨管內壓力與土中孔壓。注入與等待的判據應由孔壓及位移共同支持；地工設計者核定停留點，不以泵壓單獨判定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare piezometers and surface movement with injection events, assess dissipation time, and distinguish pipe pressure from soil pore pressure. Use pore pressure and displacement together for injection and waiting criteria; the geotechnical designer approves hold points rather than relying on pump pressure alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：注入與等待的判據應由孔壓及位移共同支持；地工設計者核定停留點，不以泵壓單獨判定。B係數式限於指定等向不排水路徑，真實漿團擴張具有剪應力變化；非等向情境需更完整的孔壓反應模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use pore pressure and displacement together for injection and waiting criteria; the geotechnical designer approves hold points rather than relying on pump pressure alone. The B relation applies to the stated isotropic undrained path; actual bulb expansion changes shear stress and needs a fuller pore-pressure model for nonisotropic loading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：孔壓累積而未消散可能降低有效應力，使周邊地盤暫時軟化，補強過程反而造成位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accumulated pore pressure reduces effective stress and can temporarily soften surrounding ground, causing movement during the improvement itself. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「不排水孔壓的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification"?

steps.title: 孔隙比減少的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔隙比減少」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Void-ratio reduction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 真正擠密需要土粒重新排列並減少土體孔隙，不能把漿液占據空洞直接當成原土密度提高。體積應變可由孔隙比變化估算，但前提是土粒體積不變且觀察的是同一土體；飽和細粒土還需要水能排出才能形成永久壓縮。孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔隙比減少」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Densification requires grain rearrangement and reduced void space; grout occupying an empty cavity is not automatically denser native soil. Void-ratio change estimates volumetric strain if solid volume is fixed and the same soil mass is followed. Saturated fine soil also needs drainage for permanent compression to develop. The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Void-ratio reduction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設e₀=0.8、e₁=0.7且固體體積不變，壓縮應變εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For e₀=0.8 and e₁=0.7 at constant solid volume, compressive strain εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔隙比減少」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Void-ratio reduction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔隙比減少的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 真正擠密需要土粒重新排列並減少土體孔隙，不能把漿液占據空洞直接當成原土密度提高。體積應變可由孔隙比變化估算，但前提是土粒體積不變且觀察的是同一土體；飽和細粒土還需要水能排出才能形成永久壓縮。
knowledge.textEn: Densification requires grain rearrangement and reduced void space; grout occupying an empty cavity is not automatically denser native soil. Void-ratio change estimates volumetric strain if solid volume is fixed and the same soil mass is followed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔隙比減少的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。
注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。
真正擠密需要土粒重新排列並減少土體孔隙，不能把漿液占據空洞直接當成原土密度提高。
optionsEn: Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms.
Equal injected volume always creates a spherical bulb of the same radius.
Densification requires grain rearrangement and reduced void space; grout occupying an empty cavity is not automatically denser native soil.
quiz.explanation: 真正擠密需要土粒重新排列並減少土體孔隙，不能把漿液占據空洞直接當成原土密度提高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Densification requires grain rearrangement and reduced void space; grout occupying an empty cavity is not automatically denser native soil. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔隙比減少的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔隙比減少」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Void-ratio reduction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設e₀=0.8、e₁=0.7且固體體積不變，壓縮應變εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For e₀=0.8 and e₁=0.7 at constant solid volume, compressive strain εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以處理前後密度與原位試驗比較，分層確認同一土體代表性，檢查材料移出或填入是否影響質量基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pre- and post-treatment density and in-situ tests by layer, checking representativeness and whether added or removed material changed the mass basis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設e₀=0.8、e₁=0.7且固體體積不變，壓縮應變εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For e₀=0.8 and e₁=0.7 at constant solid volume, compressive strain εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔隙比減少的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設e₀=0.8、e₁=0.7且固體體積不變，壓縮應變εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%。
前一孔灌漿結束就代表附近土體已完成壓密。
灌入量越大就能直接證明目標土體越密實。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For e₀=0.8 and e₁=0.7 at constant solid volume, compressive strain εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%.
Completion of one injection means surrounding soil has fully consolidated.
Greater injected volume directly proves denser target soil.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設e₀=0.8、e₁=0.7且固體體積不變，壓縮應變εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For e₀=0.8 and e₁=0.7 at constant solid volume, compressive strain εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔隙比減少的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔隙比減少」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Void-ratio reduction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以處理前後密度與原位試驗比較，分層確認同一土體代表性，檢查材料移出或填入是否影響質量基準。成效報告應分開填空、擠密與地層位移證據；地工設計者確認機制後才接受改善指標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pre- and post-treatment density and in-situ tests by layer, checking representativeness and whether added or removed material changed the mass basis. Separate cavity-filling, densification and ground-displacement evidence in reports; the geotechnical designer confirms the mechanism before accepting improvement indicators. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成效報告應分開填空、擠密與地層位移證據；地工設計者確認機制後才接受改善指標。孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate cavity-filling, densification and ground-displacement evidence in reports; the geotechnical designer confirms the mechanism before accepting improvement indicators. The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把空洞填充量當成土體壓縮量，會高估密實改善，處理後仍可能有鬆散土及差異沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting cavity fill as soil compression overstates densification and can leave loose ground and differential settlement after treatment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以處理前後密度與原位試驗比較，分層確認同一土體代表性，檢查材料移出或填入是否影響質量基準。成效報告應分開填空、擠密與地層位移證據；地工設計者確認機制後才接受改善指標。
knowledge.textEn: Compare pre- and post-treatment density and in-situ tests by layer, checking representativeness and whether added or removed material changed the mass basis. Separate cavity-filling, densification and ground-displacement evidence in reports; the geotechnical designer confirms the mechanism before accepting improvement indicators.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 成效報告應分開填空、擠密與地層位移證據；地工設計者確認機制後才接受改善指標。孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。
knowledge.textEn: Separate cavity-filling, densification and ground-displacement evidence in reports; the geotechnical designer confirms the mechanism before accepting improvement indicators. The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔隙比減少的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以處理前後密度與原位試驗比較，分層確認同一土體代表性，檢查材料移出或填入是否影響質量基準。
錐尖阻力增加六成，就代表所有承載與耐震能力增加六成。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare pre- and post-treatment density and in-situ tests by layer, checking representativeness and whether added or removed material changed the mass basis.
A sixty-percent cone-resistance gain increases every bearing and seismic capacity by sixty percent.
quiz.explanation: 以處理前後密度與原位試驗比較，分層確認同一土體代表性，檢查材料移出或填入是否影響質量基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pre- and post-treatment density and in-situ tests by layer, checking representativeness and whether added or removed material changed the mass basis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔隙比減少的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔隙比減少」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Void-ratio reduction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把空洞填充量當成土體壓縮量，會高估密實改善，處理後仍可能有鬆散土及差異沉陷。孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting cavity fill as soil compression overstates densification and can leave loose ground and differential settlement after treatment. The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把空洞填充量當成土體壓縮量，會高估密實改善，處理後仍可能有鬆散土及差異沉陷。孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。
knowledge.textEn: Counting cavity fill as soil compression overstates densification and can leave loose ground and differential settlement after treatment. The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔隙比減少的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。
把空洞填充量當成土體壓縮量，會高估密實改善，處理後仍可能有鬆散土及差異沉陷。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal injected volume always creates a spherical bulb of the same radius.
Counting cavity fill as soil compression overstates densification and can leave loose ground and differential settlement after treatment.
quiz.explanation: 把空洞填充量當成土體壓縮量，會高估密實改善，處理後仍可能有鬆散土及差異沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting cavity fill as soil compression overstates densification and can leave loose ground and differential settlement after treatment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漿泡等效半徑的機理與驗證」與「處理覆蓋比例的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equivalent grout-bulb radius mechanism and verification" and "Treatment coverage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漿泡等效半徑的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equivalent grout-bulb radius mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漿泡等效半徑」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equivalent grout-bulb radius” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 低流動性漿材可形成團塊並向周圍擠壓，但實際形狀受土層、裂隙及應力控制，未必是球體。等效球半徑可把體積轉成直觀尺寸，僅供比較材料量與可能影響範圍；不能據此直接確定處理交疊或資產安全距離。等效半徑是體積換算，不是可測得的施工直徑或擠密半徑；流失、壓縮與裂隙注入都會改變實際幾何。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漿泡等效半徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Low-mobility grout can form a mass that displaces its surroundings, but strata, fractures and stress control a shape that need not be spherical. Equivalent sphere radius converts volume into an intuitive size for comparison only; it cannot directly establish treatment overlap or safe separation from assets. Equivalent radius is a volume conversion, not a demonstrated installation or densification radius; loss, compression and fracture entry change actual geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equivalent grout-bulb radius” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設漿體積V=0.5 m³且理想球形，r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For grout volume V=0.5 m³ in an ideal sphere, r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal injected volume always creates a spherical bulb of the same radius." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漿泡等效半徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equivalent grout-bulb radius”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Low-mobility grout can form a mass that displaces its surroundings, but strata, fractures and stress control a shape that need not be spherical. Equivalent sphere radius converts volume into an intuitive size for comparison only; it cannot directly establish treatment overlap or safe separation from assets.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
