quiz.question: 關於「漿泡等效半徑的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equivalent grout-bulb radius mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 低流動性漿材可形成團塊並向周圍擠壓，但實際形狀受土層、裂隙及應力控制，未必是球體。
注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。
面積比超過一半就表示整個場址都改善了一半。
optionsEn: Low-mobility grout can form a mass that displaces its surroundings, but strata, fractures and stress control a shape that need not be spherical.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設漿體積V=0.5 m³且理想球形，r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設影響半徑r=0.5 m、正方形網格s=1.2 m，面積比a=πr²/s²=0.545。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For influence radius r=0.5 m and square spacing s=1.2 m, area ratio a=πr²/s²=0.545. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「處理覆蓋比例的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

A sixty-percent cone-resistance gain increases every bearing and seismic capacity by sixty percent.

steps.title: 處理覆蓋比例的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Treatment coverage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「處理覆蓋比例」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Treatment coverage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在孔間及處理邊界配置原位試驗，將改善指標畫成平面及深度圖，檢查最低值連通性。驗收點應包含最不利孔間位置；地工設計者按功能需求核定覆蓋與補孔，不僅追求總孔數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test between holes and at treatment edges, mapping improvement in plan and depth and checking connectivity of the lowest-value zones. Acceptance includes adverse inter-hole locations; the geotechnical designer approves coverage and additional holes from performance needs rather than total count alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：驗收點應包含最不利孔間位置；地工設計者按功能需求核定覆蓋與補孔，不僅追求總孔數。這是幾何圓面積比，不是密實度、體積替代率或安全係數；影響半徑本身須由試驗建立且未必均勻。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Acceptance includes adverse inter-hole locations; the geotechnical designer approves coverage and additional holes from performance needs rather than total count alone. This is a geometric circular-area ratio, not density, replacement ratio or safety factor; the influence radius requires testing and may be nonuniform.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只在注入孔附近測試會高估覆蓋，孔間弱帶可能在後續載重或地震中仍產生集中變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only near injection holes overstates coverage, leaving inter-hole weak corridors that deform under later loads or shaking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

注入壓力越高就表示土骨架已承受更多有效壓力。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

steps.title: 處理覆蓋比例的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Treatment coverage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「處理覆蓋比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Treatment coverage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只在注入孔附近測試會高估覆蓋，孔間弱帶可能在後續載重或地震中仍產生集中變形。這是幾何圓面積比，不是密實度、體積替代率或安全係數；影響半徑本身須由試驗建立且未必均勻。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only near injection holes overstates coverage, leaving inter-hole weak corridors that deform under later loads or shaking. This is a geometric circular-area ratio, not density, replacement ratio or safety factor; the influence radius requires testing and may be nonuniform. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是幾何圓面積比，不是密實度、體積替代率或安全係數；影響半徑本身須由試驗建立且未必均勻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is a geometric circular-area ratio, not density, replacement ratio or safety factor; the influence radius requires testing and may be nonuniform.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「面積比超過一半就表示整個場址都改善了一半。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An area ratio above one half proves the entire site is half improved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 只在注入孔附近測試會高估覆蓋，孔間弱帶可能在後續載重或地震中仍產生集中變形。這是幾何圓面積比，不是密實度、體積替代率或安全係數；影響半徑本身須由試驗建立且未必均勻。

This is a geometric circular-area ratio, not density, replacement ratio or safety factor; the influence radius requires testing and may be nonuniform.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「處理覆蓋比例的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Treatment coverage mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只在注入孔附近測試會高估覆蓋，孔間弱帶可能在後續載重或地震中仍產生集中變形。
前一孔灌漿結束就代表附近土體已完成壓密。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Testing only near injection holes overstates coverage, leaving inter-hole weak corridors that deform under later loads or shaking.
Completion of one injection means surrounding soil has fully consolidated.
quiz.explanation: 只在注入孔附近測試會高估覆蓋，孔間弱帶可能在後續載重或地震中仍產生集中變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only near injection holes overstates coverage, leaving inter-hole weak corridors that deform under later loads or shaking. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證」與「地表隆起體積的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification" and "Surface-heave volume mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔壓消散時間」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pore-pressure dissipation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分階段壓密灌漿需辨別材料反應與土體排水的時間，未消散孔壓會改變下一階段有效應力。壓密理論的時間因子可估指定排水長度的尺度，但真實三維排水及土層各向異性可能主導；排程不能只由設備可用時間決定。此一維式只是指定時間因子的尺度，Tv並非任意等同某百分比；需用相應理論關係解讀壓密度且不可直接當施工工期。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壓消散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Staged grouting must distinguish material response from drainage time because remaining pore pressure changes the next stage's effective stress. Consolidation time factors estimate a scale for a specified drainage path, but three-dimensional drainage and anisotropy may govern. Equipment availability alone therefore cannot set the waiting interval. The one-dimensional expression gives a scale at a specified time factor; Tv is not itself a consolidation percentage and requires the matching theoretical relation rather than direct schedule use. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pore-pressure dissipation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設Tv=0.2、有效排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For Tv=0.2, effective drainage path Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s, t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「前一孔灌漿結束就代表附近土體已完成壓密。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Completion of one injection means surrounding soil has fully consolidated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔壓消散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pore-pressure dissipation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 分階段壓密灌漿需辨別材料反應與土體排水的時間，未消散孔壓會改變下一階段有效應力。壓密理論的時間因子可估指定排水長度的尺度，但真實三維排水及土層各向異性可能主導；排程不能只由設備可用時間決定。
knowledge.textEn: Staged grouting must distinguish material response from drainage time because remaining pore pressure changes the next stage's effective stress. Consolidation time factors estimate a scale for a specified drainage path, but three-dimensional drainage and anisotropy may govern.

knowledge.text: 誤解：前一孔灌漿結束就代表附近土體已完成壓密。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Completion of one injection means surrounding soil has fully consolidated. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 前一孔灌漿結束就代表附近土體已完成壓密。
地表平均只抬升幾毫米，就不可能有局部資產損害。
分階段壓密灌漿需辨別材料反應與土體排水的時間，未消散孔壓會改變下一階段有效應力。
optionsEn: Completion of one injection means surrounding soil has fully consolidated.
A few millimetres of mean surface heave cannot damage local assets.
Staged grouting must distinguish material response from drainage time because remaining pore pressure changes the next stage's effective stress.
quiz.explanation: 分階段壓密灌漿需辨別材料反應與土體排水的時間，未消散孔壓會改變下一階段有效應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Staged grouting must distinguish material response from drainage time because remaining pore pressure changes the next stage's effective stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔壓消散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pore-pressure dissipation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設Tv=0.2、有效排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For Tv=0.2, effective drainage path Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s, t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以孔壓計量測消散曲線，核對排水邊界及cv試驗應力範圍，檢查是否有未觀測的低滲透夾層。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure dissipation with piezometers, verify drainage boundaries and the stress range of tested cv, and investigate unobserved low-permeability seams.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 用足夠密度的水準網積分位移，延伸到處理區外，並檢查是否有局部隆起被平均抹平。資產附近需依結構敏感度加密測點；地工與資產負責人共同核定隆起及差異變位停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate movement from a sufficiently dense levelling grid extending outside treatment, checking whether local heave is hidden by the mean. Increase measurement density near sensitive assets; geotechnical and asset leads jointly set hold points for heave and differential movement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 資產附近需依結構敏感度加密測點；地工與資產負責人共同核定隆起及差異變位停留點。面積乘平均高程只描述測區表面變化，不等於全部漿液留存；應交代積分範圍、基準與測點密度。
knowledge.textEn: Increase measurement density near sensitive assets; geotechnical and asset leads jointly set hold points for heave and differential movement. Area times mean elevation describes the surveyed surface only, not total retained grout; report integration extent, datum and sampling density.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地表隆起體積的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surface-heave volume mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。
用足夠密度的水準網積分位移，延伸到處理區外，並檢查是否有局部隆起被平均抹平。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Equal injected volume always creates a spherical bulb of the same radius.
Integrate movement from a sufficiently dense levelling grid extending outside treatment, checking whether local heave is hidden by the mean.
quiz.explanation: 用足夠密度的水準網積分位移，延伸到處理區外，並檢查是否有局部隆起被平均抹平。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate movement from a sufficiently dense levelling grid extending outside treatment, checking whether local heave is hidden by the mean. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地表隆起體積的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surface-heave volume mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地表隆起體積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Surface-heave volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均隆起低仍可能有局部尖峰，造成脆性管線或既有基礎接縫損傷，不能只看總體積。面積乘平均高程只描述測區表面變化，不等於全部漿液留存；應交代積分範圍、基準與測點密度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low mean heave can hide a local peak that damages brittle utilities or foundation joints; total volume alone is insufficient. Area times mean elevation describes the surveyed surface only, not total retained grout; report integration extent, datum and sampling density. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：面積乘平均高程只描述測區表面變化，不等於全部漿液留存；應交代積分範圍、基準與測點密度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Area times mean elevation describes the surveyed surface only, not total retained grout; report integration extent, datum and sampling density.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地表平均只抬升幾毫米，就不可能有局部資產損害。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A few millimetres of mean surface heave cannot damage local assets." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均隆起低仍可能有局部尖峰，造成脆性管線或既有基礎接縫損傷，不能只看總體積。面積乘平均高程只描述測區表面變化，不等於全部漿液留存；應交代積分範圍、基準與測點密度。
knowledge.textEn: Low mean heave can hide a local peak that damages brittle utilities or foundation joints; total volume alone is insufficient. Area times mean elevation describes the surveyed surface only, not total retained grout; report integration extent, datum and sampling density.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地表隆起體積的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surface-heave volume mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 平均隆起低仍可能有局部尖峰，造成脆性管線或既有基礎接縫損傷，不能只看總體積。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
灌入量越大就能直接證明目標土體越密實。
optionsEn: Low mean heave can hide a local peak that damages brittle utilities or foundation joints; total volume alone is insufficient.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Greater injected volume directly proves denser target soil.
quiz.explanation: 平均隆起低仍可能有局部尖峰，造成脆性管線或既有基礎接縫損傷，不能只看總體積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low mean heave can hide a local peak that damages brittle utilities or foundation joints; total volume alone is insufficient. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證」與「資產推力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification" and "Asset reaction force mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「填空與擠密分辨」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Void filling versus densification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓密灌漿遇到舊坑洞或鬆散填土時，漿液可能先填空，對周圍密度改善有限。材料平衡需區分已知空洞填充及真正擠移土體的部分，否則高注入量會被誤當高成效；不明耗量也是需要調查的地質訊號。比例只在空洞量可獨立證明時成立，剩餘三分之一也不能全部當作壓密；可能還有裂隙流失或地表隆起。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「填空與擠密分辨」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In old cavities or loose fill, grout may first fill empty space with little surrounding densification. Material balance should separate identified cavity fill from actual soil displacement, otherwise high consumption can be mistaken for high effectiveness. Unexplained consumption is also geological evidence requiring investigation. The fraction requires independently verified cavity volume; the remaining third is not necessarily all densification because fracture loss and surface heave may also occur. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Void filling versus densification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設總注入V=3 m³，其中可證明填空Vvoid=2 m³，填空比例Vvoid/V=66.7%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For total injection V=3 m³ with verified cavity filling Vvoid=2 m³, the filling fraction is 66.7%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「灌入量越大就能直接證明目標土體越密實。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Greater injected volume directly proves denser target soil." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「填空與擠密分辨」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Void filling versus densification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 壓密灌漿遇到舊坑洞或鬆散填土時，漿液可能先填空，對周圍密度改善有限。材料平衡需區分已知空洞填充及真正擠移土體的部分，否則高注入量會被誤當高成效；不明耗量也是需要調查的地質訊號。
knowledge.textEn: In old cavities or loose fill, grout may first fill empty space with little surrounding densification. Material balance should separate identified cavity fill from actual soil displacement, otherwise high consumption can be mistaken for high effectiveness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：灌入量越大就能直接證明目標土體越密實。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater injected volume directly proves denser target soil. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 灌入量越大就能直接證明目標土體越密實。
壓密灌漿遇到舊坑洞或鬆散填土時，漿液可能先填空，對周圍密度改善有限。
資產很硬不容易移動，所以附近灌漿不會影響它。
optionsEn: Greater injected volume directly proves denser target soil.
In old cavities or loose fill, grout may first fill empty space with little surrounding densification.
A stiff asset barely moves, so nearby grouting cannot affect it.
quiz.explanation: 壓密灌漿遇到舊坑洞或鬆散填土時，漿液可能先填空，對周圍密度改善有限。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In old cavities or loose fill, grout may first fill empty space with little surrounding densification. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「填空與擠密分辨」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Void filling versus densification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設總注入V=3 m³，其中可證明填空Vvoid=2 m³，填空比例Vvoid/V=66.7%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For total injection V=3 m³ with verified cavity filling Vvoid=2 m³, the filling fraction is 66.7%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以既有空洞調查、注入反應及後測密度交叉核對，追查高耗量卻低位移的區域。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check cavity investigation, injection response and post-treatment density, investigating high-consumption zones with little measured movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設總注入V=3 m³，其中可證明填空Vvoid=2 m³，填空比例Vvoid/V=66.7%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total injection V=3 m³ with verified cavity filling Vvoid=2 m³, the filling fraction is 66.7%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 表層原位試驗改善就代表所有深度的沉陷都已消除。
漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。
原創教學假設：假設總注入V=3 m³，其中可證明填空Vvoid=2 m³，填空比例Vvoid/V=66.7%。
optionsEn: Improved near-surface tests prove settlement has been eliminated at all depths.
Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms.
Original teaching assumptions: For total injection V=3 m³ with verified cavity filling Vvoid=2 m³, the filling fraction is 66.7%.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設總注入V=3 m³，其中可證明填空Vvoid=2 m³，填空比例Vvoid/V=66.7%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total injection V=3 m³ with verified cavity filling Vvoid=2 m³, the filling fraction is 66.7%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「填空與擠密分辨」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Void filling versus densification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以既有空洞調查、注入反應及後測密度交叉核對，追查高耗量卻低位移的區域。設計者應核定不明耗量調查及停留點；填空成果和擠密成果在驗收中分開證明。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check cavity investigation, injection response and post-treatment density, investigating high-consumption zones with little measured movement. The designer approves investigation and hold points for unexplained consumption; cavity-filling and densification outcomes are demonstrated separately at acceptance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計者應核定不明耗量調查及停留點；填空成果和擠密成果在驗收中分開證明。比例只在空洞量可獨立證明時成立，剩餘三分之一也不能全部當作壓密；可能還有裂隙流失或地表隆起。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The designer approves investigation and hold points for unexplained consumption; cavity-filling and densification outcomes are demonstrated separately at acceptance. The fraction requires independently verified cavity volume; the remaining third is not necessarily all densification because fracture loss and surface heave may also occur.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高耗量若流入未調查空洞，可能無法改善目標土層，甚至轉移到鄰近設施造成堵塞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High consumption into an uninvestigated cavity may leave the target stratum unimproved and migrate into neighbouring infrastructure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以既有空洞調查、注入反應及後測密度交叉核對，追查高耗量卻低位移的區域。設計者應核定不明耗量調查及停留點；填空成果和擠密成果在驗收中分開證明。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check cavity investigation, injection response and post-treatment density, investigating high-consumption zones with little measured movement. The designer approves investigation and hold points for unexplained consumption; cavity-filling and densification outcomes are demonstrated separately at acceptance.

knowledge.text: 設計者應核定不明耗量調查及停留點；填空成果和擠密成果在驗收中分開證明。比例只在空洞量可獨立證明時成立，剩餘三分之一也不能全部當作壓密；可能還有裂隙流失或地表隆起。
knowledge.textEn: The designer approves investigation and hold points for unexplained consumption; cavity-filling and densification outcomes are demonstrated separately at acceptance. The fraction requires independently verified cavity volume; the remaining third is not necessarily all densification because fracture loss and surface heave may also occur.

quiz.question: 要驗證「填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification"?
options: 以既有空洞調查、注入反應及後測密度交叉核對，追查高耗量卻低位移的區域。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Cross-check cavity investigation, injection response and post-treatment density, investigating high-consumption zones with little measured movement.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An area ratio above one half proves the entire site is half improved.
quiz.explanation: 以既有空洞調查、注入反應及後測密度交叉核對，追查高耗量卻低位移的區域。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check cavity investigation, injection response and post-treatment density, investigating high-consumption zones with little measured movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「填空與擠密分辨」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Void filling versus densification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高耗量若流入未調查空洞，可能無法改善目標土層，甚至轉移到鄰近設施造成堵塞。比例只在空洞量可獨立證明時成立，剩餘三分之一也不能全部當作壓密；可能還有裂隙流失或地表隆起。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High consumption into an uninvestigated cavity may leave the target stratum unimproved and migrate into neighbouring infrastructure. The fraction requires independently verified cavity volume; the remaining third is not necessarily all densification because fracture loss and surface heave may also occur. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater injected volume directly proves denser target soil." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。

steps.title: 資產推力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset reaction force mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產推力」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset reaction force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 既有管線或基礎若限制地盤擠移，位移會轉成額外作用力，剛度越高不代表受影響越小。簡化彈簧模型能說明小位移對剛性資產的力需求，但接觸開閉、土體塑性與結構接頭會造成非線性，須以實際界面分析。彈簧常數屬特定方向與邊界，不是材料模數；兩毫米也不是通用允許變位，應與資產能力及不確定度比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產推力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When an existing utility or foundation restrains displacement, movement becomes additional force; high stiffness does not mean low impact. A spring model illustrates force demand from small movement of a stiff asset, while opening contact, soil plasticity and joints introduce nonlinearity requiring actual interface analysis. The spring constant belongs to a direction and boundary condition rather than being a material modulus; two millimetres is not a universal permitted movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset reaction force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設資產等效剛度k=200 MN/m、強迫位移δ=0.002 m，F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For asset stiffness k=200 MN/m and imposed movement δ=0.002 m, F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「資產很硬不容易移動，所以附近灌漿不會影響它。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A stiff asset barely moves, so nearby grouting cannot affect it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產推力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset reaction force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

A spring model illustrates force demand from small movement of a stiff asset, while opening contact, soil plasticity and joints introduce nonlinearity requiring actual interface analysis.

knowledge.text: 誤解：資產很硬不容易移動，所以附近灌漿不會影響它。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A stiff asset barely moves, so nearby grouting cannot affect it. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產推力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset reaction force mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 資產很硬不容易移動，所以附近灌漿不會影響它。
錐尖阻力增加六成，就代表所有承載與耐震能力增加六成。
既有管線或基礎若限制地盤擠移，位移會轉成額外作用力，剛度越高不代表受影響越小。
optionsEn: A stiff asset barely moves, so nearby grouting cannot affect it.
A sixty-percent cone-resistance gain increases every bearing and seismic capacity by sixty percent.
When an existing utility or foundation restrains displacement, movement becomes additional force; high stiffness does not mean low impact.
quiz.explanation: 既有管線或基礎若限制地盤擠移，位移會轉成額外作用力，剛度越高不代表受影響越小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When an existing utility or foundation restrains displacement, movement becomes additional force; high stiffness does not mean low impact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產推力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset reaction force mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產推力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset reaction force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設資產等效剛度k=200 MN/m、強迫位移δ=0.002 m，F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For asset stiffness k=200 MN/m and imposed movement δ=0.002 m, F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測資產位移與應變，核對支承邊界及接縫自由度，將地盤抬升轉換成相應結構需求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure asset movement and strain, verify support boundaries and joint freedoms, and translate ground heave into corresponding structural demand.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設資產等效剛度k=200 MN/m、強迫位移δ=0.002 m，F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For asset stiffness k=200 MN/m and imposed movement δ=0.002 m, F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產推力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset reaction force mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設資產等效剛度k=200 MN/m、強迫位移δ=0.002 m，F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN。
注入壓力越高就表示土骨架已承受更多有效壓力。
注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For asset stiffness k=200 MN/m and imposed movement δ=0.002 m, F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN.
Higher injection pressure always means greater effective stress in the soil skeleton.
Equal injected volume always creates a spherical bulb of the same radius.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設資產等效剛度k=200 MN/m、強迫位移δ=0.002 m，F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For asset stiffness k=200 MN/m and imposed movement δ=0.002 m, F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產推力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset reaction force mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產推力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset reaction force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測資產位移與應變，核對支承邊界及接縫自由度，將地盤抬升轉換成相應結構需求。資產剛度與允許變形需由其結構負責人確認；灌漿設計者應依共同核定的界面模型訂控制目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure asset movement and strain, verify support boundaries and joint freedoms, and translate ground heave into corresponding structural demand. The asset structural lead confirms stiffness and permissible movement; the grouting designer uses the jointly approved interface model for control objectives. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：資產剛度與允許變形需由其結構負責人確認；灌漿設計者應依共同核定的界面模型訂控制目標。彈簧常數屬特定方向與邊界，不是材料模數；兩毫米也不是通用允許變位，應與資產能力及不確定度比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The asset structural lead confirms stiffness and permissible movement; the grouting designer uses the jointly approved interface model for control objectives. The spring constant belongs to a direction and boundary condition rather than being a material modulus; two millimetres is not a universal permitted movement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略剛性資產約束可能低估內力，外觀位移很小仍可能有大反力或接頭損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring stiff asset restraint understates forces; small visible movement can coexist with large reactions or connection damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
