quiz.questionEn: When "Asset reaction force mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
錐尖阻力增加六成，就代表所有承載與耐震能力增加六成。
忽略剛性資產約束可能低估內力，外觀位移很小仍可能有大反力或接頭損傷。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A sixty-percent cone-resistance gain increases every bearing and seismic capacity by sixty percent.
Ignoring stiff asset restraint understates forces; small visible movement can coexist with large reactions or connection damage.
quiz.explanation: 忽略剛性資產約束可能低估內力，外觀位移很小仍可能有大反力或接頭損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring stiff asset restraint understates forces; small visible movement can coexist with large reactions or connection damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「原位阻力增益的機理與驗證」與「剩餘沉陷的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "In-situ resistance gain mechanism and verification" and "Residual settlement mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 原位阻力增益的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: In-situ resistance gain mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「原位阻力增益」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “In-situ resistance gain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 處理前後錐尖阻力可比較地盤反應，但數值也受應力狀態、排水及測試位置影響。靠近硬漿團的高值不一定代表孔間原土同樣改善，應以統一程序和空間佈點評估；改善比更不能直接當抗液化安全係數。百分比只比較兩個相應測值，未含統計分散與修正關係；要推估容量或液化阻抗，需另用經驗或力學模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「原位阻力增益」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pre- and post-treatment cone resistance helps compare ground response but also depends on stress, drainage and test position. High resistance near hard grout does not prove equal improvement in native soil between bulbs. Use consistent procedures and spatial coverage, and do not interpret the gain ratio directly as liquefaction safety. The percentage compares two corresponding readings only, excluding scatter and correction relations; resistance or liquefaction assessment requires separate empirical or mechanical models. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “In-situ resistance gain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設相應地層qc由5 MPa增至8 MPa，相對增加(8−5)/5=60%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For comparable cone resistance increasing from qc=5 MPa to 8 MPa, relative gain (8−5)/5=60%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錐尖阻力增加六成，就代表所有承載與耐震能力增加六成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sixty-percent cone-resistance gain increases every bearing and seismic capacity by sixty percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「原位阻力增益」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “In-situ resistance gain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 原位阻力增益的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: In-situ resistance gain mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 處理前後錐尖阻力可比較地盤反應，但數值也受應力狀態、排水及測試位置影響。靠近硬漿團的高值不一定代表孔間原土同樣改善，應以統一程序和空間佈點評估；改善比更不能直接當抗液化安全係數。
knowledge.textEn: Pre- and post-treatment cone resistance helps compare ground response but also depends on stress, drainage and test position. High resistance near hard grout does not prove equal improvement in native soil between bulbs.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：錐尖阻力增加六成，就代表所有承載與耐震能力增加六成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sixty-percent cone-resistance gain increases every bearing and seismic capacity by sixty percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「原位阻力增益的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "In-situ resistance gain mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 處理前後錐尖阻力可比較地盤反應，但數值也受應力狀態、排水及測試位置影響。
錐尖阻力增加六成，就代表所有承載與耐震能力增加六成。
表層原位試驗改善就代表所有深度的沉陷都已消除。
optionsEn: Pre- and post-treatment cone resistance helps compare ground response but also depends on stress, drainage and test position.
A sixty-percent cone-resistance gain increases every bearing and seismic capacity by sixty percent.
Improved near-surface tests prove settlement has been eliminated at all depths.
quiz.explanation: 處理前後錐尖阻力可比較地盤反應，但數值也受應力狀態、排水及測試位置影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pre- and post-treatment cone resistance helps compare ground response but also depends on stress, drainage and test position. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 原位阻力增益的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: In-situ resistance gain mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「原位阻力增益」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “In-situ resistance gain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設相應地層qc由5 MPa增至8 MPa，相對增加(8−5)/5=60%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For comparable cone resistance increasing from qc=5 MPa to 8 MPa, relative gain (8−5)/5=60%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對相同深度與地層作前後配對，記錄錐孔距灌漿孔位置，檢查孔壓及應力修正是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair pre- and post-tests by depth and stratum, record distance from grout holes, and check consistent pore-pressure and stress corrections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設相應地層qc由5 MPa增至8 MPa，相對增加(8−5)/5=60%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For comparable cone resistance increasing from qc=5 MPa to 8 MPa, relative gain (8−5)/5=60%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「原位阻力增益的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "In-situ resistance gain mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。
原創教學假設：假設相應地層qc由5 MPa增至8 MPa，相對增加(8−5)/5=60%。
面積比超過一半就表示整個場址都改善了一半。
optionsEn: Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms.
Original teaching assumptions: For comparable cone resistance increasing from qc=5 MPa to 8 MPa, relative gain (8−5)/5=60%.
An area ratio above one half proves the entire site is half improved.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設相應地層qc由5 MPa增至8 MPa，相對增加(8−5)/5=60%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For comparable cone resistance increasing from qc=5 MPa to 8 MPa, relative gain (8−5)/5=60%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 原位阻力增益的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: In-situ resistance gain mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「原位阻力增益」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “In-situ resistance gain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對相同深度與地層作前後配對，記錄錐孔距灌漿孔位置，檢查孔壓及應力修正是否一致。驗收指標需對應設計功能與測試位置；地工設計者核定低值區處置，不以全場平均增益替代。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair pre- and post-tests by depth and stratum, record distance from grout holes, and check consistent pore-pressure and stress corrections. Acceptance indicators match design function and test locations; the geotechnical designer determines low-zone treatment rather than substituting mean site-wide gain. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：驗收指標需對應設計功能與測試位置；地工設計者核定低值區處置，不以全場平均增益替代。百分比只比較兩個相應測值，未含統計分散與修正關係；要推估容量或液化阻抗，需另用經驗或力學模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Acceptance indicators match design function and test locations; the geotechnical designer determines low-zone treatment rather than substituting mean site-wide gain. The percentage compares two corresponding readings only, excluding scatter and correction relations; resistance or liquefaction assessment requires separate empirical or mechanical models.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只選高阻力區會高估整體改善，未處理夾層仍可能控制沉陷或地震液化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Selecting high-resistance areas overstates system improvement while untreated seams may still govern settlement or liquefaction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對相同深度與地層作前後配對，記錄錐孔距灌漿孔位置，檢查孔壓及應力修正是否一致。驗收指標需對應設計功能與測試位置；地工設計者核定低值區處置，不以全場平均增益替代。
knowledge.textEn: Pair pre- and post-tests by depth and stratum, record distance from grout holes, and check consistent pore-pressure and stress corrections. Acceptance indicators match design function and test locations; the geotechnical designer determines low-zone treatment rather than substituting mean site-wide gain.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 驗收指標需對應設計功能與測試位置；地工設計者核定低值區處置，不以全場平均增益替代。百分比只比較兩個相應測值，未含統計分散與修正關係；要推估容量或液化阻抗，需另用經驗或力學模型。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance indicators match design function and test locations; the geotechnical designer determines low-zone treatment rather than substituting mean site-wide gain. The percentage compares two corresponding readings only, excluding scatter and correction relations; resistance or liquefaction assessment requires separate empirical or mechanical models.

quiz.question: 要驗證「原位阻力增益的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "In-situ resistance gain mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
地表平均只抬升幾毫米，就不可能有局部資產損害。
對相同深度與地層作前後配對，記錄錐孔距灌漿孔位置，檢查孔壓及應力修正是否一致。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A few millimetres of mean surface heave cannot damage local assets.
Pair pre- and post-tests by depth and stratum, record distance from grout holes, and check consistent pore-pressure and stress corrections.
quiz.explanation: 對相同深度與地層作前後配對，記錄錐孔距灌漿孔位置，檢查孔壓及應力修正是否一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair pre- and post-tests by depth and stratum, record distance from grout holes, and check consistent pore-pressure and stress corrections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 原位阻力增益的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: In-situ resistance gain mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「原位阻力增益」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “In-situ resistance gain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只選高阻力區會高估整體改善，未處理夾層仍可能控制沉陷或地震液化。百分比只比較兩個相應測值，未含統計分散與修正關係；要推估容量或液化阻抗，需另用經驗或力學模型。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Selecting high-resistance areas overstates system improvement while untreated seams may still govern settlement or liquefaction. The percentage compares two corresponding readings only, excluding scatter and correction relations; resistance or liquefaction assessment requires separate empirical or mechanical models. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：百分比只比較兩個相應測值，未含統計分散與修正關係；要推估容量或液化阻抗，需另用經驗或力學模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The percentage compares two corresponding readings only, excluding scatter and correction relations; resistance or liquefaction assessment requires separate empirical or mechanical models.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錐尖阻力增加六成，就代表所有承載與耐震能力增加六成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sixty-percent cone-resistance gain increases every bearing and seismic capacity by sixty percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只選高阻力區會高估整體改善，未處理夾層仍可能控制沉陷或地震液化。百分比只比較兩個相應測值，未含統計分散與修正關係；要推估容量或液化阻抗，需另用經驗或力學模型。
knowledge.textEn: Selecting high-resistance areas overstates system improvement while untreated seams may still govern settlement or liquefaction. The percentage compares two corresponding readings only, excluding scatter and correction relations; resistance or liquefaction assessment requires separate empirical or mechanical models.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「原位阻力增益的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "In-situ resistance gain mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只選高阻力區會高估整體改善，未處理夾層仍可能控制沉陷或地震液化。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
表層原位試驗改善就代表所有深度的沉陷都已消除。
optionsEn: Selecting high-resistance areas overstates system improvement while untreated seams may still govern settlement or liquefaction.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Improved near-surface tests prove settlement has been eliminated at all depths.
quiz.explanation: 只選高阻力區會高估整體改善，未處理夾層仍可能控制沉陷或地震液化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Selecting high-resistance areas overstates system improvement while untreated seams may still govern settlement or liquefaction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 剩餘沉陷的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Residual settlement mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剩餘沉陷」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良完成後仍可能有未處理土層或低改善區，總沉陷需把各層剩餘壓縮加總。分層應變可提供清楚的量級，但時間效應與荷載擴散會改變分布；移交不能只附灌漿量，還要保存後測與尚未消散孔壓的證據。分層加總假設各層應變可代表其厚度，未含三維側移與結構互制；四十毫米是算例結果，不是允許沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剩餘沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Untreated layers or poorly improved zones can remain after completion, so total settlement includes residual compression of each layer. Layered strains give a transparent scale, but time effects and stress spread alter the distribution. Handover therefore needs post-tests and remaining pore-pressure evidence rather than injected volume alone. Layer summation assumes representative strain through each thickness and excludes three-dimensional lateral movement and structural interaction; forty millimetres is a result, not an allowable settlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Residual settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設兩層H₁=5 m、ε₁=0.002；H₂=3 m、ε₂=0.01，s=ε₁H₁+ε₂H₂=0.04 m=40 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For layers H₁=5 m, ε₁=0.002 and H₂=3 m, ε₂=0.01, s=ε₁H₁+ε₂H₂=0.04 m=40 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「表層原位試驗改善就代表所有深度的沉陷都已消除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Improved near-surface tests prove settlement has been eliminated at all depths." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剩餘沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Residual settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剩餘沉陷的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 改良完成後仍可能有未處理土層或低改善區，總沉陷需把各層剩餘壓縮加總。分層應變可提供清楚的量級，但時間效應與荷載擴散會改變分布；移交不能只附灌漿量，還要保存後測與尚未消散孔壓的證據。
knowledge.textEn: Untreated layers or poorly improved zones can remain after completion, so total settlement includes residual compression of each layer. Layered strains give a transparent scale, but time effects and stress spread alter the distribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：表層原位試驗改善就代表所有深度的沉陷都已消除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Improved near-surface tests prove settlement has been eliminated at all depths. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剩餘沉陷的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Residual settlement mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 表層原位試驗改善就代表所有深度的沉陷都已消除。
改良完成後仍可能有未處理土層或低改善區，總沉陷需把各層剩餘壓縮加總。
注入壓力越高就表示土骨架已承受更多有效壓力。
optionsEn: Improved near-surface tests prove settlement has been eliminated at all depths.
Untreated layers or poorly improved zones can remain after completion, so total settlement includes residual compression of each layer.
Higher injection pressure always means greater effective stress in the soil skeleton.
quiz.explanation: 改良完成後仍可能有未處理土層或低改善區，總沉陷需把各層剩餘壓縮加總。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Untreated layers or poorly improved zones can remain after completion, so total settlement includes residual compression of each layer. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剩餘沉陷的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Residual settlement mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剩餘沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Residual settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設兩層H₁=5 m、ε₁=0.002；H₂=3 m、ε₂=0.01，s=ε₁H₁+ε₂H₂=0.04 m=40 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For layers H₁=5 m, ε₁=0.002 and H₂=3 m, ε₂=0.01, s=ε₁H₁+ε₂H₂=0.04 m=40 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用分層沉陷及後測資料確認剩餘壓縮來源，對照未來荷載計畫，檢查地表變形是否符合各層加總。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use layered settlement and post-treatment data to identify residual compression, compare future loading, and check surface movement against the layer sum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設兩層H₁=5 m、ε₁=0.002；H₂=3 m、ε₂=0.01，s=ε₁H₁+ε₂H₂=0.04 m=40 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For layers H₁=5 m, ε₁=0.002 and H₂=3 m, ε₂=0.01, s=ε₁H₁+ε₂H₂=0.04 m=40 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「剩餘沉陷的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Residual settlement mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。
前一孔灌漿結束就代表附近土體已完成壓密。
原創教學假設：假設兩層H₁=5 m、ε₁=0.002；H₂=3 m、ε₂=0.01，s=ε₁H₁+ε₂H₂=0.04 m=40 mm。
optionsEn: Equal injected volume always creates a spherical bulb of the same radius.
Completion of one injection means surrounding soil has fully consolidated.
Original teaching assumptions: For layers H₁=5 m, ε₁=0.002 and H₂=3 m, ε₂=0.01, s=ε₁H₁+ε₂H₂=0.04 m=40 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設兩層H₁=5 m、ε₁=0.002；H₂=3 m、ε₂=0.01，s=ε₁H₁+ε₂H₂=0.04 m=40 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For layers H₁=5 m, ε₁=0.002 and H₂=3 m, ε₂=0.01, s=ε₁H₁+ε₂H₂=0.04 m=40 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 剩餘沉陷的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Residual settlement mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剩餘沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Residual settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用分層沉陷及後測資料確認剩餘壓縮來源，對照未來荷載計畫，檢查地表變形是否符合各層加總。交接須列未處理層、剩餘沉陷及監測責任；地工設計者依資產需求確認驗收與長期追蹤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use layered settlement and post-treatment data to identify residual compression, compare future loading, and check surface movement against the layer sum. Handover states untreated layers, residual settlement and monitoring responsibility; the geotechnical designer confirms acceptance and follow-up against asset requirements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接須列未處理層、剩餘沉陷及監測責任；地工設計者依資產需求確認驗收與長期追蹤。分層加總假設各層應變可代表其厚度，未含三維側移與結構互制；四十毫米是算例結果，不是允許沉陷。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover states untreated layers, residual settlement and monitoring responsibility; the geotechnical designer confirms acceptance and follow-up against asset requirements. Layer summation assumes representative strain through each thickness and excludes three-dimensional lateral movement and structural interaction; forty millimetres is a result, not an allowable settlement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略未改良深層會讓完工表現短暫良好，後續荷載下仍出現持續沉陷及差異變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring deeper untreated ground can produce short-term apparent success followed by continued and differential settlement under later loads. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用分層沉陷及後測資料確認剩餘壓縮來源，對照未來荷載計畫，檢查地表變形是否符合各層加總。交接須列未處理層、剩餘沉陷及監測責任；地工設計者依資產需求確認驗收與長期追蹤。
knowledge.textEn: Use layered settlement and post-treatment data to identify residual compression, compare future loading, and check surface movement against the layer sum. Handover states untreated layers, residual settlement and monitoring responsibility; the geotechnical designer confirms acceptance and follow-up against asset requirements.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接須列未處理層、剩餘沉陷及監測責任；地工設計者依資產需求確認驗收與長期追蹤。分層加總假設各層應變可代表其厚度，未含三維側移與結構互制；四十毫米是算例結果，不是允許沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Handover states untreated layers, residual settlement and monitoring responsibility; the geotechnical designer confirms acceptance and follow-up against asset requirements. Layer summation assumes representative strain through each thickness and excludes three-dimensional lateral movement and structural interaction; forty millimetres is a result, not an allowable settlement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「剩餘沉陷的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Residual settlement mechanism and verification"?
options: 用分層沉陷及後測資料確認剩餘壓縮來源，對照未來荷載計畫，檢查地表變形是否符合各層加總。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
灌入量越大就能直接證明目標土體越密實。
optionsEn: Use layered settlement and post-treatment data to identify residual compression, compare future loading, and check surface movement against the layer sum.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Greater injected volume directly proves denser target soil.
quiz.explanation: 用分層沉陷及後測資料確認剩餘壓縮來源，對照未來荷載計畫，檢查地表變形是否符合各層加總。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use layered settlement and post-treatment data to identify residual compression, compare future loading, and check surface movement against the layer sum. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 剩餘沉陷的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Residual settlement mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剩餘沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Residual settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略未改良深層會讓完工表現短暫良好，後續荷載下仍出現持續沉陷及差異變形。分層加總假設各層應變可代表其厚度，未含三維側移與結構互制；四十毫米是算例結果，不是允許沉陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring deeper untreated ground can produce short-term apparent success followed by continued and differential settlement under later loads. Layer summation assumes representative strain through each thickness and excludes three-dimensional lateral movement and structural interaction; forty millimetres is a result, not an allowable settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分層加總假設各層應變可代表其厚度，未含三維側移與結構互制；四十毫米是算例結果，不是允許沉陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Layer summation assumes representative strain through each thickness and excludes three-dimensional lateral movement and structural interaction; forty millimetres is a result, not an allowable settlement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「表層原位試驗改善就代表所有深度的沉陷都已消除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Improved near-surface tests prove settlement has been eliminated at all depths." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略未改良深層會讓完工表現短暫良好，後續荷載下仍出現持續沉陷及差異變形。分層加總假設各層應變可代表其厚度，未含三維側移與結構互制；四十毫米是算例結果，不是允許沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring deeper untreated ground can produce short-term apparent success followed by continued and differential settlement under later loads. Layer summation assumes representative strain through each thickness and excludes three-dimensional lateral movement and structural interaction; forty millimetres is a result, not an allowable settlement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剩餘沉陷的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Residual settlement mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
忽略未改良深層會讓完工表現短暫良好，後續荷載下仍出現持續沉陷及差異變形。
注入壓力越高就表示土骨架已承受更多有效壓力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Ignoring deeper untreated ground can produce short-term apparent success followed by continued and differential settlement under later loads.
Higher injection pressure always means greater effective stress in the soil skeleton.
quiz.explanation: 忽略未改良深層會讓完工表現短暫良好，後續荷載下仍出現持續沉陷及差異變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring deeper untreated ground can produce short-term apparent success followed by continued and differential settlement under later loads. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 砂井與垂直排水板
titleEn: Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains
summary: 砂井與預製排水板縮短軟土排水路徑，使超額孔壓較快消散，但不會直接消除土的可壓縮性。本課以網格幾何、等效直徑、水平壓密時間與安裝塗抹為主線，連結井阻、載重、沉陷及排水老化，建立以孔壓與變形共同判斷的卸載交接條件。
summaryEn: Sand drains and prefabricated drains shorten drainage paths and accelerate excess-pressure dissipation without eliminating compressibility. The course connects grid geometry, equivalent diameter, radial time and installation smear to well resistance, loading, settlement and drain deterioration, establishing unloading and handover criteria from both pressure and movement.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：僅作固定無因次幾何與材料參數的擴散尺度比較，長路徑Llong=5 m、短路徑Lshort=1 m，時間比tshort/tlong=(1/5)²=0.0400。若短路徑增加10%至1.1 m，時間比變為(1.1/5)²=0.0484，比原比值增加21%。這不是排水板網格改變後的實際工期比例，因為井徑比、塗抹範圍及井阻可能同步改變。工程設計仍須用完整徑向壓密關係並配合孔壓、沉陷與排水能力觀測，確認各層剩餘壓密而非直接套用平方比。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: compare diffusion scales only while holding dimensionless geometry and material parameters fixed. With Llong=5 m and Lshort=1 m, tshort/tlong=(1/5)²=0.0400. Increasing the short length by 10% to 1.1 m changes the ratio to (1.1/5)²=0.0484, a 21% increase in that ratio. This is not the actual schedule ratio after changing a drain grid, because drain-size ratio, smear extent and well resistance may change simultaneously. Engineering design still requires the complete radial-consolidation relationship and observations of pore pressure, settlement and discharge capacity to establish residual consolidation in each layer.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水距離尺度的機理與驗證」與「三角網格影響徑的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drainage-length scale mechanism and verification" and "Triangular-grid influence diameter mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水距離尺度的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drainage-length scale mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水距離尺度」如何影響砂井與垂直排水板的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drainage-length scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水路徑縮短會加快壓力擴散，理想擴散時間隨特徵長度平方變化，這是垂直排水構想的基礎。實際排水板網格同時改變影響半徑、井徑比與塗抹比例，不能只用長度平方比直接預測現場工期；土層排水方向也需要辨識。本比值特別保持無因次參數不變，並非排水板間距改變後的工期比；實際n、塗抹與井阻會一同變動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水距離尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter drainage paths accelerate pressure diffusion, whose ideal characteristic time varies with squared length. This motivates vertical drains, but actual spacing changes influence radius, drain-size ratio and smear proportion together. A length-squared ratio alone therefore cannot predict field schedule, and relevant drainage directions must also be identified. This ratio explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed and is not the schedule ratio after changing drain spacing; actual size ratio, smear and well resistance change together. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drainage-length scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：僅在相同無因次幾何與材料參數的擴散尺度比較，L₁=5 m、L₂=1 m，t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Only for diffusion scaling with identical dimensionless geometry and material parameters, L₁=5 m and L₂=1 m give t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水距離減成五分之一，現場工期一定固定變成百分之四。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing drainage length to one fifth always makes the field duration exactly four percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水距離尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drainage-length scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水距離尺度的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 排水路徑縮短會加快壓力擴散，理想擴散時間隨特徵長度平方變化，這是垂直排水構想的基礎。實際排水板網格同時改變影響半徑、井徑比與塗抹比例，不能只用長度平方比直接預測現場工期；土層排水方向也需要辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Shorter drainage paths accelerate pressure diffusion, whose ideal characteristic time varies with squared length. This motivates vertical drains, but actual spacing changes influence radius, drain-size ratio and smear proportion together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水距離減成五分之一，現場工期一定固定變成百分之四。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reducing drainage length to one fifth always makes the field duration exactly four percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水距離尺度的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drainage-length scale mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 排水距離減成五分之一，現場工期一定固定變成百分之四。
排水路徑縮短會加快壓力擴散，理想擴散時間隨特徵長度平方變化，這是垂直排水構想的基礎。
三角與方形網格可以無條件用相同的等效直徑係數。
optionsEn: Reducing drainage length to one fifth always makes the field duration exactly four percent.
Shorter drainage paths accelerate pressure diffusion, whose ideal characteristic time varies with squared length.
Triangular and square grids can always use the same influence-diameter coefficient.
quiz.explanation: 排水路徑縮短會加快壓力擴散，理想擴散時間隨特徵長度平方變化，這是垂直排水構想的基礎。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shorter drainage paths accelerate pressure diffusion, whose ideal characteristic time varies with squared length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水距離尺度的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drainage-length scale mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水距離尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drainage-length scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：僅在相同無因次幾何與材料參數的擴散尺度比較，L₁=5 m、L₂=1 m，t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Only for diffusion scaling with identical dimensionless geometry and material parameters, L₁=5 m and L₂=1 m give t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以壓密試驗與分層孔壓建立排水方向，對照試驗區時間曲線，檢查塗抹與井阻是否主導。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use consolidation tests and multilevel pore pressure to define drainage direction, comparing trial-area time histories and checking whether smear or well resistance dominates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：僅在相同無因次幾何與材料參數的擴散尺度比較，L₁=5 m、L₂=1 m，t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Only for diffusion scaling with identical dimensionless geometry and material parameters, L₁=5 m and L₂=1 m give t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「排水距離尺度的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drainage-length scale mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 徑向時間因子等於零點六三就代表完成百分之六十三。
水進入排水板後就沒有任何沿程水頭損失。
原創教學假設：僅在相同無因次幾何與材料參數的擴散尺度比較，L₁=5 m、L₂=1 m，t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04。
optionsEn: A radial time factor of 0.63 means sixty-three-percent consolidation.
Water experiences no head loss after entering a vertical drain.
Original teaching assumptions: Only for diffusion scaling with identical dimensionless geometry and material parameters, L₁=5 m and L₂=1 m give t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：僅在相同無因次幾何與材料參數的擴散尺度比較，L₁=5 m、L₂=1 m，t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Only for diffusion scaling with identical dimensionless geometry and material parameters, L₁=5 m and L₂=1 m give t₂/t₁=(L₂/L₁)²=0.04. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 排水距離尺度的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drainage-length scale mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水距離尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drainage-length scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以壓密試驗與分層孔壓建立排水方向，對照試驗區時間曲線，檢查塗抹與井阻是否主導。設計者應分開記錄尺度示意與實際徑向壓密模型；卸載須依觀測而非單一平方比例放行。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use consolidation tests and multilevel pore pressure to define drainage direction, comparing trial-area time histories and checking whether smear or well resistance dominates. The designer separates scaling illustration from actual radial-consolidation modelling; unloading follows observations rather than one squared ratio. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計者應分開記錄尺度示意與實際徑向壓密模型；卸載須依觀測而非單一平方比例放行。本比值特別保持無因次參數不變，並非排水板間距改變後的工期比；實際n、塗抹與井阻會一同變動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The designer separates scaling illustration from actual radial-consolidation modelling; unloading follows observations rather than one squared ratio. This ratio explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed and is not the schedule ratio after changing drain spacing; actual size ratio, smear and well resistance change together.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把理想百分之四時間當實際排程，會提前卸除預壓，留下未消散孔壓與後續沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using the ideal four-percent time as a schedule can release surcharge early, leaving excess pressure and later settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以壓密試驗與分層孔壓建立排水方向，對照試驗區時間曲線，檢查塗抹與井阻是否主導。設計者應分開記錄尺度示意與實際徑向壓密模型；卸載須依觀測而非單一平方比例放行。
knowledge.textEn: Use consolidation tests and multilevel pore pressure to define drainage direction, comparing trial-area time histories and checking whether smear or well resistance dominates. The designer separates scaling illustration from actual radial-consolidation modelling; unloading follows observations rather than one squared ratio.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計者應分開記錄尺度示意與實際徑向壓密模型；卸載須依觀測而非單一平方比例放行。本比值特別保持無因次參數不變，並非排水板間距改變後的工期比；實際n、塗抹與井阻會一同變動。
knowledge.textEn: The designer separates scaling illustration from actual radial-consolidation modelling; unloading follows observations rather than one squared ratio. This ratio explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed and is not the schedule ratio after changing drain spacing; actual size ratio, smear and well resistance change together.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排水距離尺度的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drainage-length scale mechanism and verification"?
options: 以壓密試驗與分層孔壓建立排水方向，對照試驗區時間曲線，檢查塗抹與井阻是否主導。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
裝設排水板會把軟土的最終壓縮沉陷直接消除。
optionsEn: Use consolidation tests and multilevel pore pressure to define drainage direction, comparing trial-area time histories and checking whether smear or well resistance dominates.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Installing vertical drains directly eliminates ultimate compressive settlement of soft soil.
quiz.explanation: 以壓密試驗與分層孔壓建立排水方向，對照試驗區時間曲線，檢查塗抹與井阻是否主導。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use consolidation tests and multilevel pore pressure to define drainage direction, comparing trial-area time histories and checking whether smear or well resistance dominates. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 排水距離尺度的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drainage-length scale mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排水距離尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drainage-length scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把理想百分之四時間當實際排程，會提前卸除預壓，留下未消散孔壓與後續沉陷。本比值特別保持無因次參數不變，並非排水板間距改變後的工期比；實際n、塗抹與井阻會一同變動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using the ideal four-percent time as a schedule can release surcharge early, leaving excess pressure and later settlement. This ratio explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed and is not the schedule ratio after changing drain spacing; actual size ratio, smear and well resistance change together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本比值特別保持無因次參數不變，並非排水板間距改變後的工期比；實際n、塗抹與井阻會一同變動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This ratio explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed and is not the schedule ratio after changing drain spacing; actual size ratio, smear and well resistance change together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水距離減成五分之一，現場工期一定固定變成百分之四。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing drainage length to one fifth always makes the field duration exactly four percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把理想百分之四時間當實際排程，會提前卸除預壓，留下未消散孔壓與後續沉陷。本比值特別保持無因次參數不變，並非排水板間距改變後的工期比；實際n、塗抹與井阻會一同變動。
knowledge.textEn: Using the ideal four-percent time as a schedule can release surcharge early, leaving excess pressure and later settlement. This ratio explicitly holds dimensionless parameters fixed and is not the schedule ratio after changing drain spacing; actual size ratio, smear and well resistance change together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「排水距離尺度的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drainage-length scale mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把理想百分之四時間當實際排程，會提前卸除預壓，留下未消散孔壓與後續沉陷。
三角與方形網格可以無條件用相同的等效直徑係數。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using the ideal four-percent time as a schedule can release surcharge early, leaving excess pressure and later settlement.
Triangular and square grids can always use the same influence-diameter coefficient.
quiz.explanation: 把理想百分之四時間當實際排程，會提前卸除預壓，留下未消散孔壓與後續沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the ideal four-percent time as a schedule can release surcharge early, leaving excess pressure and later settlement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 三角網格影響徑的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Triangular-grid influence diameter mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「三角網格影響徑」如何影響砂井與垂直排水板的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Triangular-grid influence diameter” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水板網格把土體分成單井影響單元，等效圓面積用於徑向壓密分析。三角形與方形排列有不同的面積換算，施工偏位及漏插又會形成較大未排水區；名目間距需要與實際安裝位置一起驗證。係數一點零五是等面積近似，不描述邊界單元或排水不均；異常網格應以實際幾何重新建立模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「三角網格影響徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A drain grid divides soil into influence cells, represented by equivalent circular area in radial analysis. Triangular and square layouts use different area conversions, while misplaced or omitted drains create larger undrained zones. Nominal spacing therefore requires verification against actual installation positions rather than reliance on the layout drawing alone. The coefficient is an equal-area approximation, not a model of boundary cells or uneven drainage; irregular grids require revised geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Triangular-grid influence diameter” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：三角形網格假設間距s=1.2 m，等效影響直徑de≈1.05s=1.26 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For a triangular grid with spacing s=1.2 m, equivalent influence diameter de≈1.05s=1.26 m.

knowledge.text: 排水板網格把土體分成單井影響單元，等效圓面積用於徑向壓密分析。三角形與方形排列有不同的面積換算，施工偏位及漏插又會形成較大未排水區；名目間距需要與實際安裝位置一起驗證。

As-built grids retain actual positions and incomplete depths; the geotechnical designer approves additional drains and monitoring representativeness before acceptance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equivalent band-drain diameter” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水板是帶狀而非圓管，徑向土體分析常以等效圓直徑表示其周長效果。寬度與厚度之外，濾布透水性、芯材通道及受壓後變形都影響排水，幾何等效不等於水力容量等效，也不能直接套用砂井直徑。等周長式屬模型近似，不是流道內徑；受壓排水能力及土體濾層相容性需要獨立的水力試驗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「帶狀排水板等效徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Band drains are not circular pipes, so radial soil analysis commonly uses an equivalent diameter related to perimeter. Width and thickness do not capture filter permeability, core channels or compression. Geometric equivalence therefore is not hydraulic-capacity equivalence and cannot be substituted directly for a sand-drain diameter. The perimeter relation is a modelling approximation, not internal channel diameter; confined discharge and soil-filter compatibility need separate hydraulic tests. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equivalent band-drain diameter” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For width b=0.10 m and thickness t=0.004 m, perimeter-equivalent dw=2(b+t)/π=0.0662 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「等效直徑相同的排水板就一定有相同通水能力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 帶狀排水板等效徑的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equivalent band-drain diameter mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「帶狀排水板等效徑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Equivalent band-drain diameter” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設帶寬b=0.10 m、厚t=0.004 m，等周長等效dw=2(b+t)/π=0.0662 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For width b=0.10 m and thickness t=0.004 m, perimeter-equivalent dw=2(b+t)/π=0.0662 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對產品尺寸與受圍壓排水試驗，檢查彎折後通道及濾布狀態，分列等效直徑與通水量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify product dimensions and confined-flow tests, inspect channels and filter after bending, and report equivalent diameter separately from discharge capacity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「帶狀排水板等效徑的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equivalent band-drain diameter mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 水進入排水板後就沒有任何沿程水頭損失。
原創教學假設：假設帶寬b=0.10 m、厚t=0.004 m，等周長等效dw=2(b+t)/π=0.0662 m。
裝設排水板會把軟土的最終壓縮沉陷直接消除。
optionsEn: Water experiences no head loss after entering a vertical drain.
Original teaching assumptions: For width b=0.10 m and thickness t=0.004 m, perimeter-equivalent dw=2(b+t)/π=0.0662 m.
Installing vertical drains directly eliminates ultimate compressive settlement of soft soil.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設帶寬b=0.10 m、厚t=0.004 m，等周長等效dw=2(b+t)/π=0.0662 m。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 帶狀排水板等效徑的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equivalent band-drain diameter mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「帶狀排水板等效徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Equivalent band-drain diameter” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對產品尺寸與受圍壓排水試驗，檢查彎折後通道及濾布狀態，分列等效直徑與通水量。材料驗收應核對受壓、彎折及濾布試驗條件；設計者確認與實際土壓及沉陷相符後才採用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify product dimensions and confined-flow tests, inspect channels and filter after bending, and report equivalent diameter separately from discharge capacity. Acceptance checks confinement, bending and filter test conditions; the designer confirms their relevance to actual earth pressure and settlement before use. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：材料驗收應核對受壓、彎折及濾布試驗條件；設計者確認與實際土壓及沉陷相符後才採用。等周長式屬模型近似，不是流道內徑；受壓排水能力及土體濾層相容性需要獨立的水力試驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Acceptance checks confinement, bending and filter test conditions; the designer confirms their relevance to actual earth pressure and settlement before use. The perimeter relation is a modelling approximation, not internal channel diameter; confined discharge and soil-filter compatibility need separate hydraulic tests.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只按等效直徑選材可能忽略芯材壓潰或濾布堵塞，實際井阻遠大於設計假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Selecting by equivalent diameter alone can miss crushed cores or clogged filters, producing much greater well resistance than assumed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「帶狀排水板等效徑的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Equivalent band-drain diameter mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
地表沉陷看似停止就表示所有深度的孔壓都消散。

Apparently stopped surface settlement proves pore pressure has dissipated at every depth.
Verify product dimensions and confined-flow tests, inspect channels and filter after bending, and report equivalent diameter separately from discharge capacity.

steps.title: 帶狀排水板等效徑的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equivalent band-drain diameter mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「帶狀排水板等效徑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Equivalent band-drain diameter” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只按等效直徑選材可能忽略芯材壓潰或濾布堵塞，實際井阻遠大於設計假設。等周長式屬模型近似，不是流道內徑；受壓排水能力及土體濾層相容性需要獨立的水力試驗。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Selecting by equivalent diameter alone can miss crushed cores or clogged filters, producing much greater well resistance than assumed. The perimeter relation is a modelling approximation, not internal channel diameter; confined discharge and soil-filter compatibility need separate hydraulic tests. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：等周長式屬模型近似，不是流道內徑；受壓排水能力及土體濾層相容性需要獨立的水力試驗。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The perimeter relation is a modelling approximation, not internal channel diameter; confined discharge and soil-filter compatibility need separate hydraulic tests.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「等效直徑相同的排水板就一定有相同通水能力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drains with the same equivalent diameter have identical discharge capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只按等效直徑選材可能忽略芯材壓潰或濾布堵塞，實際井阻遠大於設計假設。等周長式屬模型近似，不是流道內徑；受壓排水能力及土體濾層相容性需要獨立的水力試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Selecting by equivalent diameter alone can miss crushed cores or clogged filters, producing much greater well resistance than assumed. The perimeter relation is a modelling approximation, not internal channel diameter; confined discharge and soil-filter compatibility need separate hydraulic tests.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「帶狀排水板等效徑的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Equivalent band-drain diameter mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只按等效直徑選材可能忽略芯材壓潰或濾布堵塞，實際井阻遠大於設計假設。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
徑向時間因子等於零點六三就代表完成百分之六十三。
optionsEn: Selecting by equivalent diameter alone can miss crushed cores or clogged filters, producing much greater well resistance than assumed.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A radial time factor of 0.63 means sixty-three-percent consolidation.
quiz.explanation: 只按等效直徑選材可能忽略芯材壓潰或濾布堵塞，實際井阻遠大於設計假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Selecting by equivalent diameter alone can miss crushed cores or clogged filters, producing much greater well resistance than assumed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 徑向時間因子的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Radial time factor mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「徑向時間因子」如何影響砂井與垂直排水板的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Radial time factor” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 徑向壓密的時間因子把水平壓密係數、時間及單井影響尺寸結合，便於比較不同觀測時段。它本身不是壓密完成度，還需井徑比、塗抹與井阻的函數；水平係數也不能無條件用垂直壓密試驗值替代。本算例明確使用平方公尺每一天，時間亦以天計；要從Tr求壓密度，還必須指定所採理論及全部無因次參數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「徑向時間因子」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The radial time factor combines horizontal consolidation coefficient, time and cell size to compare observation periods. It is not itself degree of consolidation, which also depends on drain-size ratio, smear and well resistance. Horizontal coefficients cannot automatically be replaced by vertical-test values without justification of anisotropy. This example explicitly uses square metres per day and time in days; converting Tr to consolidation degree still requires the selected theory and all dimensionless parameters. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Radial time factor” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設ch=0.01 m²/day、t=100 day、de=1.26 m，Tr=ch t/de²=0.630，無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For ch=0.01 m²/day, t=100 day and de=1.26 m, Tr=ch t/de²=0.630, dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「徑向時間因子等於零點六三就代表完成百分之六十三。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A radial time factor of 0.63 means sixty-three-percent consolidation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「徑向時間因子」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Radial time factor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：徑向時間因子等於零點六三就代表完成百分之六十三。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A radial time factor of 0.63 means sixty-three-percent consolidation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「徑向時間因子的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Radial time factor mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 徑向時間因子等於零點六三就代表完成百分之六十三。
徑向壓密的時間因子把水平壓密係數、時間及單井影響尺寸結合，便於比較不同觀測時段。
插設擾動只影響施工方便，對長期排水速度沒有影響。
optionsEn: A radial time factor of 0.63 means sixty-three-percent consolidation.
The radial time factor combines horizontal consolidation coefficient, time and cell size to compare observation periods.
Installation disturbance affects convenience but not long-term drainage rate.
quiz.explanation: 徑向壓密的時間因子把水平壓密係數、時間及單井影響尺寸結合，便於比較不同觀測時段。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「塗抹區滲透性的機理與驗證」與「排水井阻的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Smear-zone permeability mechanism and verification" and "Well resistance mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 塗抹區滲透性的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Smear-zone permeability mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「塗抹區滲透性」如何影響砂井與垂直排水板的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Smear-zone permeability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 插設套管擾動排水板周圍土體，可能重塑黏土並形成低水平滲透性的塗抹區。排水路徑雖變短，水仍需穿越這個局部阻力；因此增加排水板數量不一定按理想比例加速壓密，工具尺寸與土體敏感性需共同考慮。滲透比不足以完整描述塗抹效應，還需要塗抹區尺寸與原土各向異性；不能把本比值當普遍材料常數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「塗抹區滲透性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Installation mandrels disturb surrounding soil, potentially remoulding clay into a zone of lower horizontal permeability. Although the drainage path shortens, water must still cross this local resistance. More drains therefore need not accelerate consolidation by the ideal proportion, and tool size and soil sensitivity must be considered together. Permeability ratio alone does not define smear; its extent and native-soil anisotropy are also needed, and this ratio is not universal. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Smear-zone permeability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設塗抹區ks=1×10⁻⁹ m/s、未擾動kh=5×10⁻⁹ m/s，比值ks/kh=0.20。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For smear permeability ks=1×10⁻⁹ m/s and undisturbed kh=5×10⁻⁹ m/s, ks/kh=0.20.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「插設擾動只影響施工方便，對長期排水速度沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installation disturbance affects convenience but not long-term drainage rate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「塗抹區滲透性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Smear-zone permeability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Installation mandrels disturb surrounding soil, potentially remoulding clay into a zone of lower horizontal permeability. Although the drainage path shortens, water must still cross this local resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：插設擾動只影響施工方便，對長期排水速度沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

Water experiences no head loss after entering a vertical drain.

steps.title: 塗抹區滲透性的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設塗抹區ks=1×10⁻⁹ m/s、未擾動kh=5×10⁻⁹ m/s，比值ks/kh=0.20。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For smear permeability ks=1×10⁻⁹ m/s and undisturbed kh=5×10⁻⁹ m/s, ks/kh=0.20. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare dissipation near and away from drains, verify mandrel dimensions and remoulding tests, and assess uncertainty in smear radius and permeability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 比較靠近及遠離排水板的孔壓消散，核對套管尺寸與土體重塑試驗，辨識塗抹半徑和滲透性的不確定度。安裝設備與套管尺寸變更需重審塗抹假設；地工設計者以試驗區反應核定實際設計參數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare dissipation near and away from drains, verify mandrel dimensions and remoulding tests, and assess uncertainty in smear radius and permeability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略塗抹會高估排水速率，試驗區尚未達預期便需重新解釋模型，而非只增加預壓荷重。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.instruction: 忽略塗抹會高估排水速率，試驗區尚未達預期便需重新解釋模型，而非只增加預壓荷重。滲透比不足以完整描述塗抹效應，還需要塗抹區尺寸與原土各向異性；不能把本比值當普遍材料常數。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 排水井阻的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Well resistance mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水井阻」如何影響砂井與垂直排水板的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Well resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水進入排水板後還必須沿芯材向排水層流動，長排水板、圍壓及彎折可能造成顯著井阻。把排水板當成零水頭損失邊界會高估深部排水，砂墊層及出口不暢也可能限制整個系統，需分辨土內阻力與排水通道阻力。這是指定工況的等效阻力而非材料常數，與長度、圍壓及流量條件有關；井阻模型需保留實際排水方向。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水井阻」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After entering the drain, water travels along the core to an outlet. Long drains, confinement and bending can create significant well resistance. Assuming zero drain head loss overestimates deep drainage, while a restricted blanket or outlet can govern the whole system. Distinguish soil resistance from resistance inside the drainage path. This is equivalent resistance for one condition, not a material constant; length, confinement and flow matter, and the well-resistance model must retain the actual drainage direction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Well resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設水頭損失Δh=2 m、流量Q=0.0001 m³/s，等效水力阻力R=Δh/Q=20000 s/m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For head loss Δh=2 m and discharge Q=0.0001 m³/s, hydraulic resistance R=Δh/Q=20000 s/m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水進入排水板後就沒有任何沿程水頭損失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Water experiences no head loss after entering a vertical drain." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水井阻」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Well resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水井阻的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 水進入排水板後還必須沿芯材向排水層流動，長排水板、圍壓及彎折可能造成顯著井阻。把排水板當成零水頭損失邊界會高估深部排水，砂墊層及出口不暢也可能限制整個系統，需分辨土內阻力與排水通道阻力。
knowledge.textEn: After entering the drain, water travels along the core to an outlet. Long drains, confinement and bending can create significant well resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水進入排水板後就沒有任何沿程水頭損失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Water experiences no head loss after entering a vertical drain. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水井阻的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Well resistance mechanism and verification" is correct?

水進入排水板後就沒有任何沿程水頭損失。
加上八十千帕預壓，就立刻增加八十千帕有效應力。
optionsEn: After entering the drain, water travels along the core to an outlet.
Water experiences no head loss after entering a vertical drain.

steps.title: 排水井阻的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Well resistance mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水井阻」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Well resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設水頭損失Δh=2 m、流量Q=0.0001 m³/s，等效水力阻力R=Δh/Q=20000 s/m²。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For head loss Δh=2 m and discharge Q=0.0001 m³/s, hydraulic resistance R=Δh/Q=20000 s/m². This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測排水通道上不同高程水頭並核對出水量，將受壓通水試驗與現場彎折及沉陷條件比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure heads at different elevations along the drainage path and outlet flow, comparing confined discharge tests with field bending and settlement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設水頭損失Δh=2 m、流量Q=0.0001 m³/s，等效水力阻力R=Δh/Q=20000 s/m²。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For head loss Δh=2 m and discharge Q=0.0001 m³/s, hydraulic resistance R=Δh/Q=20000 s/m². This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「排水井阻的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Well resistance mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 現場出水量減少就一定表示排水板已經堵塞。

排水距離減成五分之一，現場工期一定固定變成百分之四。

Original teaching assumptions: For head loss Δh=2 m and discharge Q=0.0001 m³/s, hydraulic resistance R=Δh/Q=20000 s/m².

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For head loss Δh=2 m and discharge Q=0.0001 m³/s, hydraulic resistance R=Δh/Q=20000 s/m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instructionEn: Measure heads at different elevations along the drainage path and outlet flow, comparing confined discharge tests with field bending and settlement. steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.titleEn: Well resistance mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排水井阻」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 出口堵塞或芯材壓縮會讓深部孔壓消散落後，表層沉陷較快也不能證明全深有效排水。這是指定工況的等效阻力而非材料常數，與長度、圍壓及流量條件有關；井阻模型需保留實際排水方向。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A blocked outlet or compressed core delays deep pressure dissipation, and rapid shallow settlement does not prove effective full-depth drainage. This is equivalent resistance for one condition, not a material constant; length, confinement and flow matter, and the well-resistance model must retain the actual drainage direction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Water experiences no head loss after entering a vertical drain." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「排水井阻的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Well resistance mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

optionsEn: A blocked outlet or compressed core delays deep pressure dissipation, and rapid shallow settlement does not prove effective full-depth drainage.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Applying eighty kilopascals of surcharge immediately adds the same effective stress.
