quiz.explanationEn: A blocked outlet or compressed core delays deep pressure dissipation, and rapid shallow settlement does not prove effective full-depth drainage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「有效應力成長的機理與驗證」與「對數壓縮沉陷的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective-stress gain mechanism and verification" and "Logarithmic compression settlement mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 有效應力成長的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective-stress gain mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效應力成長」如何影響砂井與垂直排水板的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective-stress gain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預壓荷載初期可主要轉成超額孔壓，隨排水消散，更多荷載才移交給土骨架並引起壓密。若只量測地表荷重而沒有孔壓，就不能判定有效應力增加多少；水位變化與不同土層的初始壓力也需用同一基準處理。增量式需同一位置與時刻且正負號一致，不能把絕對孔壓混入超額孔壓；總應力分布還受荷載擴散影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效應力成長」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Surcharge may initially appear mainly as excess pore pressure; drainage progressively transfers more load to the skeleton and causes consolidation. Applied surface load alone cannot establish effective-stress gain without pressure observations. Groundwater changes and layer-specific initial pressures also require one consistent reference. The increment relation requires the same location, time and sign convention; absolute and excess pressures are not interchangeable, and total stress also reflects load spread. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective-stress gain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設總應力增量Δσ=80 kPa、殘餘超額孔壓Δu=30 kPa，Δσ′=Δσ−Δu=50 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For total-stress increment Δσ=80 kPa and remaining excess pressure Δu=30 kPa, effective increment Δσ′=Δσ−Δu=50 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加上八十千帕預壓，就立刻增加八十千帕有效應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Applying eighty kilopascals of surcharge immediately adds the same effective stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效應力成長」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective-stress gain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效應力成長的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 預壓荷載初期可主要轉成超額孔壓，隨排水消散，更多荷載才移交給土骨架並引起壓密。若只量測地表荷重而沒有孔壓，就不能判定有效應力增加多少；水位變化與不同土層的初始壓力也需用同一基準處理。
knowledge.textEn: Surcharge may initially appear mainly as excess pore pressure; drainage progressively transfers more load to the skeleton and causes consolidation. Applied surface load alone cannot establish effective-stress gain without pressure observations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：加上八十千帕預壓，就立刻增加八十千帕有效應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Applying eighty kilopascals of surcharge immediately adds the same effective stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有效應力成長的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective-stress gain mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 加上八十千帕預壓，就立刻增加八十千帕有效應力。
預壓荷載初期可主要轉成超額孔壓，隨排水消散，更多荷載才移交給土骨架並引起壓密。
裝設排水板會把軟土的最終壓縮沉陷直接消除。
optionsEn: Applying eighty kilopascals of surcharge immediately adds the same effective stress.
Surcharge may initially appear mainly as excess pore pressure; drainage progressively transfers more load to the skeleton and causes consolidation.
Installing vertical drains directly eliminates ultimate compressive settlement of soft soil.
quiz.explanation: 預壓荷載初期可主要轉成超額孔壓，隨排水消散，更多荷載才移交給土骨架並引起壓密。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Surcharge may initially appear mainly as excess pore pressure; drainage progressively transfers more load to the skeleton and causes consolidation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效應力成長的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective-stress gain mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效應力成長」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective-stress gain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設總應力增量Δσ=80 kPa、殘餘超額孔壓Δu=30 kPa，Δσ′=Δσ−Δu=50 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For total-stress increment Δσ=80 kPa and remaining excess pressure Δu=30 kPa, effective increment Δσ′=Δσ−Δu=50 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多深度孔壓與預壓高程核對荷載歷程，確認儀器基準水壓及地下水位變化，分層求有效增量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use multilevel pore pressure and surcharge elevation to reconstruct load history, checking baseline pressure and groundwater changes before calculating layer-wise effective increments.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設總應力增量Δσ=80 kPa、殘餘超額孔壓Δu=30 kPa，Δσ′=Δσ−Δu=50 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total-stress increment Δσ=80 kPa and remaining excess pressure Δu=30 kPa, effective increment Δσ′=Δσ−Δu=50 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效應力成長的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective-stress gain mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 地表沉陷看似停止就表示所有深度的孔壓都消散。
三角與方形網格可以無條件用相同的等效直徑係數。

optionsEn: Apparently stopped surface settlement proves pore pressure has dissipated at every depth.
Triangular and square grids can always use the same influence-diameter coefficient.
Original teaching assumptions: For total-stress increment Δσ=80 kPa and remaining excess pressure Δu=30 kPa, effective increment Δσ′=Δσ−Δu=50 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設總應力增量Δσ=80 kPa、殘餘超額孔壓Δu=30 kPa，Δσ′=Δσ−Δu=50 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total-stress increment Δσ=80 kPa and remaining excess pressure Δu=30 kPa, effective increment Δσ′=Δσ−Δu=50 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 有效應力成長的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective-stress gain mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效應力成長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective-stress gain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多深度孔壓與預壓高程核對荷載歷程，確認儀器基準水壓及地下水位變化，分層求有效增量。每階段荷載與孔壓應同步歸檔；地工設計者確認有效應力及穩定需求後才核准加載或卸載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use multilevel pore pressure and surcharge elevation to reconstruct load history, checking baseline pressure and groundwater changes before calculating layer-wise effective increments. Archive each loading stage with synchronized pore pressures; the geotechnical designer confirms effective stress and stability requirements before loading or unloading. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每階段荷載與孔壓應同步歸檔；地工設計者確認有效應力及穩定需求後才核准加載或卸載。增量式需同一位置與時刻且正負號一致，不能把絕對孔壓混入超額孔壓；總應力分布還受荷載擴散影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Archive each loading stage with synchronized pore pressures; the geotechnical designer confirms effective stress and stability requirements before loading or unloading. The increment relation requires the same location, time and sign convention; absolute and excess pressures are not interchangeable, and total stress also reflects load spread.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把預壓全重當成已完成有效應力，會高估土體強度及壓密度，卸載後留下可觀後續沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all surcharge as mobilized effective stress overstates strength and consolidation and can leave substantial later settlement after unloading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Use multilevel pore pressure and surcharge elevation to reconstruct load history, checking baseline pressure and groundwater changes before calculating layer-wise effective increments. Archive each loading stage with synchronized pore pressures; the geotechnical designer confirms effective stress and stability requirements before loading or unloading.

knowledge.text: 每階段荷載與孔壓應同步歸檔；地工設計者確認有效應力及穩定需求後才核准加載或卸載。增量式需同一位置與時刻且正負號一致，不能把絕對孔壓混入超額孔壓；總應力分布還受荷載擴散影響。

The increment relation requires the same location, time and sign convention; absolute and excess pressures are not interchangeable, and total stress also reflects load spread.

quiz.question: 要驗證「有效應力成長的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective-stress gain mechanism and verification"?
options: 以多深度孔壓與預壓高程核對荷載歷程，確認儀器基準水壓及地下水位變化，分層求有效增量。

A radial time factor of 0.63 means sixty-three-percent consolidation.
quiz.explanation: 以多深度孔壓與預壓高程核對荷載歷程，確認儀器基準水壓及地下水位變化，分層求有效增量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use multilevel pore pressure and surcharge elevation to reconstruct load history, checking baseline pressure and groundwater changes before calculating layer-wise effective increments. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 有效應力成長的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective-stress gain mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效應力成長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective-stress gain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把預壓全重當成已完成有效應力，會高估土體強度及壓密度，卸載後留下可觀後續沉陷。增量式需同一位置與時刻且正負號一致，不能把絕對孔壓混入超額孔壓；總應力分布還受荷載擴散影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating all surcharge as mobilized effective stress overstates strength and consolidation and can leave substantial later settlement after unloading. The increment relation requires the same location, time and sign convention; absolute and excess pressures are not interchangeable, and total stress also reflects load spread. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：增量式需同一位置與時刻且正負號一致，不能把絕對孔壓混入超額孔壓；總應力分布還受荷載擴散影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The increment relation requires the same location, time and sign convention; absolute and excess pressures are not interchangeable, and total stress also reflects load spread.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加上八十千帕預壓，就立刻增加八十千帕有效應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Applying eighty kilopascals of surcharge immediately adds the same effective stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把預壓全重當成已完成有效應力，會高估土體強度及壓密度，卸載後留下可觀後續沉陷。增量式需同一位置與時刻且正負號一致，不能把絕對孔壓混入超額孔壓；總應力分布還受荷載擴散影響。
knowledge.textEn: Treating all surcharge as mobilized effective stress overstates strength and consolidation and can leave substantial later settlement after unloading. The increment relation requires the same location, time and sign convention; absolute and excess pressures are not interchangeable, and total stress also reflects load spread.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「有效應力成長的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective-stress gain mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把預壓全重當成已完成有效應力，會高估土體強度及壓密度，卸載後留下可觀後續沉陷。
裝設排水板會把軟土的最終壓縮沉陷直接消除。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating all surcharge as mobilized effective stress overstates strength and consolidation and can leave substantial later settlement after unloading.
Installing vertical drains directly eliminates ultimate compressive settlement of soft soil.
quiz.explanation: 把預壓全重當成已完成有效應力，會高估土體強度及壓密度，卸載後留下可觀後續沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating all surcharge as mobilized effective stress overstates strength and consolidation and can leave substantial later settlement after unloading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 對數壓縮沉陷的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Logarithmic compression settlement mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「對數壓縮沉陷」如何影響砂井與垂直排水板的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Logarithmic compression settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 正常壓密黏土在一維條件下可用壓縮指數與有效應力對數關係估算沉陷，排水板主要改變到達此沉陷的速度而非終值。若存在先期壓密、不同應力路徑或次壓密，需分段採用相應參數，不能把一條正常壓密線套用所有土層。此式明定正常壓密、一維及以十為底對數，未含側移；Cc為無因次斜率，不能與以自然對數定義的參數混用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「對數壓縮沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For normally consolidated clay in one-dimensional conditions, compression index and logarithmic effective stress estimate settlement. Drains mainly change how quickly settlement occurs rather than its ultimate value. Preconsolidation, different stress paths and secondary compression require appropriate segments and parameters instead of one virgin-compression line for every layer. The formula specifies normally consolidated one-dimensional behaviour and base-ten logarithms, excluding lateral movement; dimensionless Cc cannot be mixed with a natural-log parameter. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Logarithmic compression settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設Cc=0.3、H=10 m、e₀=1.0、σ′₀=100 kPa、σ′f=150 kPa，s=CcH/(1+e₀) log₁₀(σ′f/σ′₀)=0.264 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For Cc=0.3, H=10 m, e₀=1.0, σ′₀=100 kPa and σ′f=150 kPa, s=CcH/(1+e₀) log₁₀(σ′f/σ′₀)=0.264 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裝設排水板會把軟土的最終壓縮沉陷直接消除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing vertical drains directly eliminates ultimate compressive settlement of soft soil." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「對數壓縮沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Logarithmic compression settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 對數壓縮沉陷的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Logarithmic compression settlement mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 正常壓密黏土在一維條件下可用壓縮指數與有效應力對數關係估算沉陷，排水板主要改變到達此沉陷的速度而非終值。若存在先期壓密、不同應力路徑或次壓密，需分段採用相應參數，不能把一條正常壓密線套用所有土層。
knowledge.textEn: For normally consolidated clay in one-dimensional conditions, compression index and logarithmic effective stress estimate settlement. Drains mainly change how quickly settlement occurs rather than its ultimate value.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：裝設排水板會把軟土的最終壓縮沉陷直接消除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Installing vertical drains directly eliminates ultimate compressive settlement of soft soil. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「對數壓縮沉陷的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Logarithmic compression settlement mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 裝設排水板會把軟土的最終壓縮沉陷直接消除。
現場出水量減少就一定表示排水板已經堵塞。
正常壓密黏土在一維條件下可用壓縮指數與有效應力對數關係估算沉陷，排水板主要改變到達此沉陷的速度而非終值。
optionsEn: Installing vertical drains directly eliminates ultimate compressive settlement of soft soil.
Reduced field discharge necessarily means the drain has clogged.
For normally consolidated clay in one-dimensional conditions, compression index and logarithmic effective stress estimate settlement.
quiz.explanation: 正常壓密黏土在一維條件下可用壓縮指數與有效應力對數關係估算沉陷，排水板主要改變到達此沉陷的速度而非終值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For normally consolidated clay in one-dimensional conditions, compression index and logarithmic effective stress estimate settlement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 對數壓縮沉陷的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Logarithmic compression settlement mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「對數壓縮沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Logarithmic compression settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設Cc=0.3、H=10 m、e₀=1.0、σ′₀=100 kPa、σ′f=150 kPa，s=CcH/(1+e₀) log₁₀(σ′f/σ′₀)=0.264 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For Cc=0.3, H=10 m, e₀=1.0, σ′₀=100 kPa and σ′f=150 kPa, s=CcH/(1+e₀) log₁₀(σ′f/σ′₀)=0.264 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以壓密試驗核對先期壓密壓力與指數，使用分層沉陷計比較，確認應力增量及厚度代表性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check preconsolidation pressure and indices from consolidation tests, compare layered settlement, and verify representative stress increments and thicknesses.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設Cc=0.3、H=10 m、e₀=1.0、σ′₀=100 kPa、σ′f=150 kPa，s=CcH/(1+e₀) log₁₀(σ′f/σ′₀)=0.264 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For Cc=0.3, H=10 m, e₀=1.0, σ′₀=100 kPa and σ′f=150 kPa, s=CcH/(1+e₀) log₁₀(σ′f/σ′₀)=0.264 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「對數壓縮沉陷的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Logarithmic compression settlement mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設Cc=0.3、H=10 m、e₀=1.0、σ′₀=100 kPa、σ′f=150 kPa，s=CcH/(1+e₀) log₁₀(σ′f/σ′₀)=0.264 m。
排水距離減成五分之一，現場工期一定固定變成百分之四。
等效直徑相同的排水板就一定有相同通水能力。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For Cc=0.3, H=10 m, e₀=1.0, σ′₀=100 kPa and σ′f=150 kPa, s=CcH/(1+e₀) log₁₀(σ′f/σ′₀)=0.264 m.
Reducing drainage length to one fifth always makes the field duration exactly four percent.
Drains with the same equivalent diameter have identical discharge capacity.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設Cc=0.3、H=10 m、e₀=1.0、σ′₀=100 kPa、σ′f=150 kPa，s=CcH/(1+e₀) log₁₀(σ′f/σ′₀)=0.264 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For Cc=0.3, H=10 m, e₀=1.0, σ′₀=100 kPa and σ′f=150 kPa, s=CcH/(1+e₀) log₁₀(σ′f/σ′₀)=0.264 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 對數壓縮沉陷的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Logarithmic compression settlement mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「對數壓縮沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Logarithmic compression settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以壓密試驗核對先期壓密壓力與指數，使用分層沉陷計比較，確認應力增量及厚度代表性。設計與交接應分開主要壓密及長期次壓密預測；地工設計者確認參數適用應力範圍後再解讀監測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check preconsolidation pressure and indices from consolidation tests, compare layered settlement, and verify representative stress increments and thicknesses. Separate primary and secondary settlement in design and handover; the geotechnical designer confirms parameter stress ranges before interpreting monitoring. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計與交接應分開主要壓密及長期次壓密預測；地工設計者確認參數適用應力範圍後再解讀監測。此式明定正常壓密、一維及以十為底對數，未含側移；Cc為無因次斜率，不能與以自然對數定義的參數混用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate primary and secondary settlement in design and handover; the geotechnical designer confirms parameter stress ranges before interpreting monitoring. The formula specifies normally consolidated one-dimensional behaviour and base-ten logarithms, excluding lateral movement; dimensionless Cc cannot be mixed with a natural-log parameter.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：誤把超壓密土全程用正常壓密指數，可能高估或錯估沉陷；忽略次壓密則會漏掉長期變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying virgin compression throughout an overconsolidated path mispredicts settlement, while neglecting secondary compression misses long-term movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以壓密試驗核對先期壓密壓力與指數，使用分層沉陷計比較，確認應力增量及厚度代表性。設計與交接應分開主要壓密及長期次壓密預測；地工設計者確認參數適用應力範圍後再解讀監測。
knowledge.textEn: Check preconsolidation pressure and indices from consolidation tests, compare layered settlement, and verify representative stress increments and thicknesses. Separate primary and secondary settlement in design and handover; the geotechnical designer confirms parameter stress ranges before interpreting monitoring.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計與交接應分開主要壓密及長期次壓密預測；地工設計者確認參數適用應力範圍後再解讀監測。此式明定正常壓密、一維及以十為底對數，未含側移；Cc為無因次斜率，不能與以自然對數定義的參數混用。
knowledge.textEn: Separate primary and secondary settlement in design and handover; the geotechnical designer confirms parameter stress ranges before interpreting monitoring. The formula specifies normally consolidated one-dimensional behaviour and base-ten logarithms, excluding lateral movement; dimensionless Cc cannot be mixed with a natural-log parameter.

quiz.question: 要驗證「對數壓縮沉陷的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Logarithmic compression settlement mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以壓密試驗核對先期壓密壓力與指數，使用分層沉陷計比較，確認應力增量及厚度代表性。
插設擾動只影響施工方便，對長期排水速度沒有影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Check preconsolidation pressure and indices from consolidation tests, compare layered settlement, and verify representative stress increments and thicknesses.
Installation disturbance affects convenience but not long-term drainage rate.
quiz.explanation: 以壓密試驗核對先期壓密壓力與指數，使用分層沉陷計比較，確認應力增量及厚度代表性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check preconsolidation pressure and indices from consolidation tests, compare layered settlement, and verify representative stress increments and thicknesses. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 對數壓縮沉陷的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Logarithmic compression settlement mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「對數壓縮沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Logarithmic compression settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 誤把超壓密土全程用正常壓密指數，可能高估或錯估沉陷；忽略次壓密則會漏掉長期變形。此式明定正常壓密、一維及以十為底對數，未含側移；Cc為無因次斜率，不能與以自然對數定義的參數混用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying virgin compression throughout an overconsolidated path mispredicts settlement, while neglecting secondary compression misses long-term movement. The formula specifies normally consolidated one-dimensional behaviour and base-ten logarithms, excluding lateral movement; dimensionless Cc cannot be mixed with a natural-log parameter. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The formula specifies normally consolidated one-dimensional behaviour and base-ten logarithms, excluding lateral movement; dimensionless Cc cannot be mixed with a natural-log parameter.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裝設排水板會把軟土的最終壓縮沉陷直接消除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing vertical drains directly eliminates ultimate compressive settlement of soft soil." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水能力衰減的機理與驗證」與「壓密度與卸載的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Discharge-capacity deterioration mechanism and verification" and "Consolidation and unloading mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水能力衰減的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Discharge-capacity deterioration mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水能力衰減」如何影響砂井與垂直排水板的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Discharge-capacity deterioration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水板隨土體沉陷彎折、圍壓增加或濾布堵塞，通水能力可能下降，因此出廠直條試驗不足以代表全工期。衰減比例應在相同水力坡降與圍壓下比較，才能辨別材料性能改變；現場出水下降也可能單純因超額孔壓已減少。百分比只對相同試驗邊界成立，不能把不同水頭下的流量直接比較；通水衰減也不等於壓密速度同比下降。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水能力衰減」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drain bending during settlement, rising confinement and filter clogging can reduce discharge, so a straight factory test does not represent the whole project. Compare deterioration at consistent gradient and confinement to identify material change. Falling field discharge may instead reflect reduced excess pressure and must not automatically be called clogging. The percentage requires identical test boundaries; flow at different heads is not directly comparable, and capacity loss does not imply proportional slowing of consolidation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Discharge-capacity deterioration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：在相同試驗條件下，通水量Q₀=100 L/h降至Q₁=70 L/h，衰減(Q₀−Q₁)/Q₀=30%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Under identical test conditions, discharge falls from Q₀=100 L/h to Q₁=70 L/h, giving deterioration of 30%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「現場出水量減少就一定表示排水板已經堵塞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced field discharge necessarily means the drain has clogged." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水能力衰減」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Discharge-capacity deterioration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水能力衰減的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 排水板隨土體沉陷彎折、圍壓增加或濾布堵塞，通水能力可能下降，因此出廠直條試驗不足以代表全工期。衰減比例應在相同水力坡降與圍壓下比較，才能辨別材料性能改變；現場出水下降也可能單純因超額孔壓已減少。
knowledge.textEn: Drain bending during settlement, rising confinement and filter clogging can reduce discharge, so a straight factory test does not represent the whole project. Compare deterioration at consistent gradient and confinement to identify material change.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：現場出水量減少就一定表示排水板已經堵塞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced field discharge necessarily means the drain has clogged. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水能力衰減的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Discharge-capacity deterioration mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 排水板隨土體沉陷彎折、圍壓增加或濾布堵塞，通水能力可能下降，因此出廠直條試驗不足以代表全工期。
現場出水量減少就一定表示排水板已經堵塞。
地表沉陷看似停止就表示所有深度的孔壓都消散。
optionsEn: Drain bending during settlement, rising confinement and filter clogging can reduce discharge, so a straight factory test does not represent the whole project.
Reduced field discharge necessarily means the drain has clogged.
Apparently stopped surface settlement proves pore pressure has dissipated at every depth.
quiz.explanation: 排水板隨土體沉陷彎折、圍壓增加或濾布堵塞，通水能力可能下降，因此出廠直條試驗不足以代表全工期。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drain bending during settlement, rising confinement and filter clogging can reduce discharge, so a straight factory test does not represent the whole project. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水能力衰減的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Discharge-capacity deterioration mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水能力衰減」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Discharge-capacity deterioration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：在相同試驗條件下，通水量Q₀=100 L/h降至Q₁=70 L/h，衰減(Q₀−Q₁)/Q₀=30%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Under identical test conditions, discharge falls from Q₀=100 L/h to Q₁=70 L/h, giving deterioration of 30%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以受壓彎折試驗比較前後通水量，現場則同步看孔壓與排水量，區分能力下降及驅動水頭減少。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare confined bent-drain discharge before and after conditioning; in the field assess pressure and flow together to distinguish capacity loss from reduced driving head.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：在相同試驗條件下，通水量Q₀=100 L/h降至Q₁=70 L/h，衰減(Q₀−Q₁)/Q₀=30%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水能力衰減」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Discharge-capacity deterioration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以受壓彎折試驗比較前後通水量，現場則同步看孔壓與排水量，區分能力下降及驅動水頭減少。材料試驗需涵蓋預期圍壓與變形；地工設計者核定能力折減，營運端保留出口維護與監測責任。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare confined bent-drain discharge before and after conditioning; in the field assess pressure and flow together to distinguish capacity loss from reduced driving head. Material tests cover anticipated confinement and deformation; the geotechnical designer approves capacity reduction while operators retain outlet-maintenance and monitoring responsibility. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.text: 忽略彎折與堵塞會讓深部排水變慢，若只按初始材料性能安排卸載，就可能留下殘餘孔壓。百分比只對相同試驗邊界成立，不能把不同水頭下的流量直接比較；通水衰減也不等於壓密速度同比下降。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring bending and clogging slows deep drainage; unloading based only on initial material performance can leave residual pressure. The percentage requires identical test boundaries; flow at different heads is not directly comparable, and capacity loss does not imply proportional slowing of consolidation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「排水能力衰減的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Discharge-capacity deterioration mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 忽略彎折與堵塞會讓深部排水變慢，若只按初始材料性能安排卸載，就可能留下殘餘孔壓。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
地表沉陷看似停止就表示所有深度的孔壓都消散。
optionsEn: Ignoring bending and clogging slows deep drainage; unloading based only on initial material performance can leave residual pressure.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Apparently stopped surface settlement proves pore pressure has dissipated at every depth.
quiz.explanation: 忽略彎折與堵塞會讓深部排水變慢，若只按初始材料性能安排卸載，就可能留下殘餘孔壓。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring bending and clogging slows deep drainage; unloading based only on initial material performance can leave residual pressure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓密度與卸載的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Consolidation and unloading mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓密度與卸載」如何影響砂井與垂直排水板的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Consolidation and unloading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 由實測沉陷除以估計最終主要壓密沉陷，可得到沉陷定義的平均壓密度，但分母本身有模型不確定度。地表沉陷可能混入側移或次壓密，孔壓定義的完成度也未必一致；卸載必須用多種證據確認剩餘變形符合資產需求。此壓密度以可靠的主要壓密終值為前提，不是通用卸載門檻；若終值重估，比例及殘餘沉陷都必須一起更新。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓密度與卸載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measured settlement divided by estimated ultimate primary settlement gives a settlement-based average consolidation degree, but its denominator is uncertain. Surface settlement may include lateral movement or secondary compression, and a pressure-based degree need not match exactly. Unloading therefore requires multiple evidence streams that confirm tolerable residual movement. This degree assumes a reliable ultimate primary settlement and is not a universal unloading threshold; revised ultimate estimates require updating both the ratio and residual settlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Consolidation and unloading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設已發生主要壓密沉陷s=240 mm、估計終值s∞=300 mm，Us=s/s∞=0.80=80%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For measured primary settlement s=240 mm and estimated ultimate s∞=300 mm, Us=s/s∞=0.80=80%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地表沉陷看似停止就表示所有深度的孔壓都消散。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Apparently stopped surface settlement proves pore pressure has dissipated at every depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓密度與卸載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Consolidation and unloading”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓密度與卸載的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Consolidation and unloading mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 由實測沉陷除以估計最終主要壓密沉陷，可得到沉陷定義的平均壓密度，但分母本身有模型不確定度。地表沉陷可能混入側移或次壓密，孔壓定義的完成度也未必一致；卸載必須用多種證據確認剩餘變形符合資產需求。
knowledge.textEn: Measured settlement divided by estimated ultimate primary settlement gives a settlement-based average consolidation degree, but its denominator is uncertain. Surface settlement may include lateral movement or secondary compression, and a pressure-based degree need not match exactly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地表沉陷看似停止就表示所有深度的孔壓都消散。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Apparently stopped surface settlement proves pore pressure has dissipated at every depth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓密度與卸載的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Consolidation and unloading mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 地表沉陷看似停止就表示所有深度的孔壓都消散。
由實測沉陷除以估計最終主要壓密沉陷，可得到沉陷定義的平均壓密度，但分母本身有模型不確定度。
排水距離減成五分之一，現場工期一定固定變成百分之四。
optionsEn: Apparently stopped surface settlement proves pore pressure has dissipated at every depth.
Measured settlement divided by estimated ultimate primary settlement gives a settlement-based average consolidation degree, but its denominator is uncertain.
Reducing drainage length to one fifth always makes the field duration exactly four percent.
quiz.explanation: 由實測沉陷除以估計最終主要壓密沉陷，可得到沉陷定義的平均壓密度，但分母本身有模型不確定度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Measured settlement divided by estimated ultimate primary settlement gives a settlement-based average consolidation degree, but its denominator is uncertain. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓密度與卸載的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Consolidation and unloading mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓密度與卸載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Consolidation and unloading” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設已發生主要壓密沉陷s=240 mm、估計終值s∞=300 mm，Us=s/s∞=0.80=80%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For measured primary settlement s=240 mm and estimated ultimate s∞=300 mm, Us=s/s∞=0.80=80%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較沉陷外推與多深度孔壓消散，檢查最終沉陷估算對資料時窗的敏感度，保留未達標層位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare settlement extrapolation with multilevel pressure dissipation, test sensitivity of ultimate-settlement estimates to the data window, and retain unresolved layers explicitly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設已發生主要壓密沉陷s=240 mm、估計終值s∞=300 mm，Us=s/s∞=0.80=80%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For measured primary settlement s=240 mm and estimated ultimate s∞=300 mm, Us=s/s∞=0.80=80%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓密度與卸載的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Consolidation and unloading mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 等效直徑相同的排水板就一定有相同通水能力。
插設擾動只影響施工方便，對長期排水速度沒有影響。
原創教學假設：假設已發生主要壓密沉陷s=240 mm、估計終值s∞=300 mm，Us=s/s∞=0.80=80%。
optionsEn: Drains with the same equivalent diameter have identical discharge capacity.
Installation disturbance affects convenience but not long-term drainage rate.
Original teaching assumptions: For measured primary settlement s=240 mm and estimated ultimate s∞=300 mm, Us=s/s∞=0.80=80%.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設已發生主要壓密沉陷s=240 mm、估計終值s∞=300 mm，Us=s/s∞=0.80=80%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For measured primary settlement s=240 mm and estimated ultimate s∞=300 mm, Us=s/s∞=0.80=80%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓密度與卸載的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Consolidation and unloading mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓密度與卸載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Consolidation and unloading” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較沉陷外推與多深度孔壓消散，檢查最終沉陷估算對資料時窗的敏感度，保留未達標層位。卸載移交應由地工設計者及資產管理者共同核准，列明剩餘沉陷、回彈及長期監測條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare settlement extrapolation with multilevel pressure dissipation, test sensitivity of ultimate-settlement estimates to the data window, and retain unresolved layers explicitly. The geotechnical designer and asset owner jointly approve unloading and handover, documenting residual settlement, rebound and long-term monitoring conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：卸載移交應由地工設計者及資產管理者共同核准，列明剩餘沉陷、回彈及長期監測條件。此壓密度以可靠的主要壓密終值為前提，不是通用卸載門檻；若終值重估，比例及殘餘沉陷都必須一起更新。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The geotechnical designer and asset owner jointly approve unloading and handover, documenting residual settlement, rebound and long-term monitoring conditions. This degree assumes a reliable ultimate primary settlement and is not a universal unloading threshold; revised ultimate estimates require updating both the ratio and residual settlement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高估已完成比例會提前移除預壓，營運載重後再產生沉陷；只用地表平均可能漏掉深部未壓密層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overstating completion releases surcharge early and permits later settlement; surface averages can miss deep unconsolidated layers. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較沉陷外推與多深度孔壓消散，檢查最終沉陷估算對資料時窗的敏感度，保留未達標層位。卸載移交應由地工設計者及資產管理者共同核准，列明剩餘沉陷、回彈及長期監測條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare settlement extrapolation with multilevel pressure dissipation, test sensitivity of ultimate-settlement estimates to the data window, and retain unresolved layers explicitly. The geotechnical designer and asset owner jointly approve unloading and handover, documenting residual settlement, rebound and long-term monitoring conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 卸載移交應由地工設計者及資產管理者共同核准，列明剩餘沉陷、回彈及長期監測條件。此壓密度以可靠的主要壓密終值為前提，不是通用卸載門檻；若終值重估，比例及殘餘沉陷都必須一起更新。
knowledge.textEn: The geotechnical designer and asset owner jointly approve unloading and handover, documenting residual settlement, rebound and long-term monitoring conditions. This degree assumes a reliable ultimate primary settlement and is not a universal unloading threshold; revised ultimate estimates require updating both the ratio and residual settlement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓密度與卸載的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Consolidation and unloading mechanism and verification"?
options: 比較沉陷外推與多深度孔壓消散，檢查最終沉陷估算對資料時窗的敏感度，保留未達標層位。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
加上八十千帕預壓，就立刻增加八十千帕有效應力。
optionsEn: Compare settlement extrapolation with multilevel pressure dissipation, test sensitivity of ultimate-settlement estimates to the data window, and retain unresolved layers explicitly.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Applying eighty kilopascals of surcharge immediately adds the same effective stress.
quiz.explanation: 比較沉陷外推與多深度孔壓消散，檢查最終沉陷估算對資料時窗的敏感度，保留未達標層位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare settlement extrapolation with multilevel pressure dissipation, test sensitivity of ultimate-settlement estimates to the data window, and retain unresolved layers explicitly. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓密度與卸載的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Consolidation and unloading mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓密度與卸載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Consolidation and unloading” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高估已完成比例會提前移除預壓，營運載重後再產生沉陷；只用地表平均可能漏掉深部未壓密層。此壓密度以可靠的主要壓密終值為前提，不是通用卸載門檻；若終值重估，比例及殘餘沉陷都必須一起更新。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overstating completion releases surcharge early and permits later settlement; surface averages can miss deep unconsolidated layers. This degree assumes a reliable ultimate primary settlement and is not a universal unloading threshold; revised ultimate estimates require updating both the ratio and residual settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此壓密度以可靠的主要壓密終值為前提，不是通用卸載門檻；若終值重估，比例及殘餘沉陷都必須一起更新。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This degree assumes a reliable ultimate primary settlement and is not a universal unloading threshold; revised ultimate estimates require updating both the ratio and residual settlement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地表沉陷看似停止就表示所有深度的孔壓都消散。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Apparently stopped surface settlement proves pore pressure has dissipated at every depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「壓密度與卸載的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Consolidation and unloading mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
高估已完成比例會提前移除預壓，營運載重後再產生沉陷；只用地表平均可能漏掉深部未壓密層。
排水距離減成五分之一，現場工期一定固定變成百分之四。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Overstating completion releases surcharge early and permits later settlement; surface averages can miss deep unconsolidated layers.
Reducing drainage length to one fifth always makes the field duration exactly four percent.
quiz.explanation: 高估已完成比例會提前移除預壓，營運載重後再產生沉陷；只用地表平均可能漏掉深部未壓密層。 需以量測區分可能原因。

title: 真空預壓軟土改良
summary: 本課聚焦連結負孔壓傳遞、排水能力與卸載回彈判斷真空壓密。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on relate suction transfer, drainage capacity and unloading rebound to vacuum consolidation. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。假設總應力固定，孔壓降幅由60增為66kPa，增加10%，有效應力增量也由60增為66kPa；這不能推論沉陷或強度同增10%，因壓縮性及應力路徑可能非線性。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa. The relation does not imply equal suction at every depth. At fixed total stress, increasing assumed pore-pressure reduction from60 to66kPa by10% raises effective-stress gain from60 to66kPa. Settlement or strength does not necessarily rise10%, because compressibility and stress paths may be nonlinear. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「有效應力增量」與「深度負壓傳遞」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective stress increment" and "Suction transfer with depth": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 有效應力增量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective stress increment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效應力增量」如何影響真空預壓軟土改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective stress increment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vacuum consolidation of soft soil”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 真空預壓透過降低孔隙水壓增加有效應力，不需要把相同荷載全由堆載重量提供。必須先說清楚所選土點的總應力是否保持不變，並區分抽氣系統壓力與土中孔壓。教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效應力增量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vacuum preloading increases effective stress by reducing pore pressure rather than supplying all loading through fill weight. Specify whether total stress stays fixed at the selected soil point and distinguish pump pressure from soil pore pressure. At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa. The relation does not imply equal suction at every depth. Substituting pump suction for deep pore pressure overstates treatment at depth. Surface settlement may occur mainly in upper layers while untreated deeper soil continues settling under the completed structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective stress increment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有效應力增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for effective stress increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效應力增量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective stress increment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效應力增量
knowledge.text: 真空預壓透過降低孔隙水壓增加有效應力，不需要把相同荷載全由堆載重量提供。必須先說清楚所選土點的總應力是否保持不變，並區分抽氣系統壓力與土中孔壓。
knowledge.textEn: Vacuum preloading increases effective stress by reducing pore pressure rather than supplying all loading through fill weight. Specify whether total stress stays fixed at the selected soil point and distinguish pump pressure from soil pore pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要有效應力增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for effective stress increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有效應力增量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective stress increment" is correct?
options: 只要有效應力增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
真空預壓透過降低孔隙水壓增加有效應力，不需要把相同荷載全由堆載重量提供。
只要深度負壓傳遞符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for effective stress increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Vacuum preloading increases effective stress by reducing pore pressure rather than supplying all loading through fill weight.
A nominal result for suction transfer with depth removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 真空預壓透過降低孔隙水壓增加有效應力，不需要把相同荷載全由堆載重量提供。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Vacuum preloading increases effective stress by reducing pore pressure rather than supplying all loading through fill weight. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效應力增量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective stress increment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效應力增量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective stress increment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa. The relation does not imply equal suction at every depth. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa. The relation does not imply equal suction at every depth.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效應力增量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective stress increment", which statement holds?
options: 只要透水夾層補注符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要堆載真空疊加符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。
optionsEn: A nominal result for recharge through permeable lenses removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for surcharge and vacuum combination removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 有效應力增量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective stress increment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效應力增量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective stress increment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。確認負孔壓感測能力與飽和狀態，讓有效應力推論有可追溯的原始資料。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum. Check sensor saturation and negative-pressure capability so the effective-stress inference rests on traceable observations. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Substituting pump suction for deep pore pressure overstates treatment at depth. Surface settlement may occur mainly in upper layers while untreated deeper soil continues settling under the completed structure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接有效應力增量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。確認負孔壓感測能力與飽和狀態，讓有效應力推論有可追溯的原始資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over effective stress increment, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum. Check sensor saturation and negative-pressure capability so the effective-stress inference rests on traceable observations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting pump suction for deep pore pressure overstates treatment at depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。確認負孔壓感測能力與飽和狀態，讓有效應力推論有可追溯的原始資料。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum. Check sensor saturation and negative-pressure capability so the effective-stress inference rests on traceable observations. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Substituting pump suction for deep pore pressure overstates treatment at depth. Surface settlement may occur mainly in upper layers while untreated deeper soil continues settling under the completed structure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接有效應力增量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。確認負孔壓感測能力與飽和狀態，讓有效應力推論有可追溯的原始資料。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over effective stress increment, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum. Check sensor saturation and negative-pressure capability so the effective-stress inference rests on traceable observations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「有效應力增量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective stress increment"?
options: 同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要真空中斷恢復符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for pressure recovery after interruption removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測土中孔壓、地表荷載及沉陷，將每個測點換到相同高程基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize soil pressure, surface loading and settlement on a common elevation datum. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 有效應力增量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective stress increment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效應力增量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective stress increment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting pump suction for deep pore pressure overstates treatment at depth. Surface settlement may occur mainly in upper layers while untreated deeper soil continues settling under the completed structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surface settlement may occur mainly in upper layers while untreated deeper soil continues settling under the completed structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要有效應力增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for effective stress increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把泵浦端負壓直接當深層孔壓，會高估深層改良；表面沉陷可能來自上層，尚未壓密的深層土在完工載重後仍會持續沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting pump suction for deep pore pressure overstates treatment at depth. Surface settlement may occur mainly in upper layers while untreated deeper soil continues settling under the completed structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
