optionsEn: A nominal result for air leakage balance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for drain head loss removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For unloading magnitude Δσ′=30kPa, layer H=8m and reloading modulus M=12000kPa, rebound S=Δσ′H/M=0.020m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設卸載幅值Δσ′=30kPa、層厚H=8m、重壓模數M=12000kPa，回彈S=Δσ′H/M=0.020m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For unloading magnitude Δσ′=30kPa, layer H=8m and reloading modulus M=12000kPa, rebound S=Δσ′H/M=0.020m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 卸載回彈預估：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unloading rebound estimate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「卸載回彈預估」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unloading rebound estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以卸載回載試驗選定相應模數，對照分層回彈與孔壓恢復。交接文件列出永久載重、剩餘沉陷及監測延續期間，卸載時點由設計者而非單次表面讀值決定。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把初次壓縮模數拿來估回彈，結果可能偏差很大；過早結束監測又會漏掉回彈後再壓縮，使完工高程與長期服務性判定失去依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Select modulus from relevant unload-reload tests and compare layer rebound with pressure recovery. Handover states permanent loading, residual settlement and continued monitoring; the designer determines unloading, not one surface reading. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using virgin compression stiffness for rebound can give substantial error. Ending monitoring early misses subsequent recompression and undermines the basis for finished elevation and long-term serviceability decisions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接卸載回彈預估時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以卸載回載試驗選定相應模數，對照分層回彈與孔壓恢復。交接文件列出永久載重、剩餘沉陷及監測延續期間，卸載時點由設計者而非單次表面讀值決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over unloading rebound estimate, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Select modulus from relevant unload-reload tests and compare layer rebound with pressure recovery. Handover states permanent loading, residual settlement and continued monitoring; the designer determines unloading, not one surface reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把初次壓縮模數拿來估回彈，結果可能偏差很大；過早結束監測又會漏掉回彈後再壓縮，使完工高程與長期服務性判定失去依據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using virgin compression stiffness for rebound can give substantial error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以卸載回載試驗選定相應模數，對照分層回彈與孔壓恢復。交接文件列出永久載重、剩餘沉陷及監測延續期間，卸載時點由設計者而非單次表面讀值決定。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把初次壓縮模數拿來估回彈，結果可能偏差很大；過早結束監測又會漏掉回彈後再壓縮，使完工高程與長期服務性判定失去依據。
knowledge.textEn: Select modulus from relevant unload-reload tests and compare layer rebound with pressure recovery. Handover states permanent loading, residual settlement and continued monitoring; the designer determines unloading, not one surface reading. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using virgin compression stiffness for rebound can give substantial error. Ending monitoring early misses subsequent recompression and undermines the basis for finished elevation and long-term serviceability decisions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接卸載回彈預估時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以卸載回載試驗選定相應模數，對照分層回彈與孔壓恢復。交接文件列出永久載重、剩餘沉陷及監測延續期間，卸載時點由設計者而非單次表面讀值決定。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over unloading rebound estimate, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Select modulus from relevant unload-reload tests and compare layer rebound with pressure recovery. Handover states permanent loading, residual settlement and continued monitoring; the designer determines unloading, not one surface reading.

quiz.question: 要驗證「卸載回彈預估」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Unloading rebound estimate"?
options: 以卸載回載試驗選定相應模數，對照分層回彈與孔壓恢復。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要沉陷壓密比例符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Select modulus from relevant unload-reload tests and compare layer rebound with pressure recovery.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A nominal result for settlement based consolidation ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 以卸載回載試驗選定相應模數，對照分層回彈與孔壓恢復。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Select modulus from relevant unload-reload tests and compare layer rebound with pressure recovery. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 卸載回彈預估：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Unloading rebound estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「卸載回彈預估」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unloading rebound estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把初次壓縮模數拿來估回彈，結果可能偏差很大；過早結束監測又會漏掉回彈後再壓縮，使完工高程與長期服務性判定失去依據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using virgin compression stiffness for rebound can give substantial error. Ending monitoring early misses subsequent recompression and undermines the basis for finished elevation and long-term serviceability decisions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把初次壓縮模數拿來估回彈，結果可能偏差很大；過早結束監測又會漏掉回彈後再壓縮，使完工高程與長期服務性判定失去依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ending monitoring early misses subsequent recompression and undermines the basis for finished elevation and long-term serviceability decisions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要卸載回彈預估符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for unloading rebound estimate removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把初次壓縮模數拿來估回彈，結果可能偏差很大；過早結束監測又會漏掉回彈後再壓縮，使完工高程與長期服務性判定失去依據。
knowledge.textEn: Using virgin compression stiffness for rebound can give substantial error. Ending monitoring early misses subsequent recompression and undermines the basis for finished elevation and long-term serviceability decisions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「卸載回彈預估」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Unloading rebound estimate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若把初次壓縮模數拿來估回彈，結果可能偏差很大；過早結束監測又會漏掉回彈後再壓縮，使完工高程與長期服務性判定失去依據。
只要有效應力增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using virgin compression stiffness for rebound can give substantial error.
A nominal result for effective stress increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若把初次壓縮模數拿來估回彈，結果可能偏差很大；過早結束監測又會漏掉回彈後再壓縮，使完工高程與長期服務性判定失去依據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using virgin compression stiffness for rebound can give substantial error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 動力夯實地盤改良
summary: 本課聚焦以能量、孔壓與鄰近振動證據評估動力夯實成效。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on evaluate dynamic compaction through energy, pore pressure and neighbouring vibration evidence. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設質量m=15000kg、落高h=15m，在理想條件下E=mgh=15000×9.81×15=2207250J=2.20725MJ，約2.21MJ。假設落高15m固定，質量由15000增加10%至16500kg，位能由2.20725增為2.427975MJ，約2.428MJ；能量增加10%不等於改善深度增加10%，也不授權改變現場吊重。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=15000kg and height h=15m, E=mgh=2207250J=2.20725MJ, approximately2.21MJ, before impact losses. At fixed15m height, raising assumed mass from15000 to16500kg by10% changes potential energy from2.20725 to2.427975MJ, about2.428MJ. Ten percent more energy is not ten percent more treatment depth and does not authorize changing field lifting loads. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「落錘位能尺度」與「單位面積能量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drop weight energy scale" and "Energy per treatment area": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 落錘位能尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drop weight energy scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「落錘位能尺度」如何影響動力夯實地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drop weight energy scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic compaction of ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 動力夯實把落錘位能傳入地盤，但能量分配包含波傳、塑性變形及設備損失。位能不是衝擊峰值力，也不是直接的改善深度；施工參數必須由場址試夯建立。假設質量m=15000kg、落高h=15m，在理想條件下E=mgh=15000×9.81×15=2207250J=2.20725MJ，約2.21MJ。同樣位能在不同土層不會產生相同改善，若用能量達標取代孔壓與密實度驗證，軟弱夾層仍可能存在並在正式載重後造成差異沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「落錘位能尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dynamic compaction transfers drop-weight energy into ground deformation, waves and losses. Potential energy is neither peak impact force nor improvement depth; field parameters require a site-specific trial. For mass m=15000kg and height h=15m, E=mgh=2207250J=2.20725MJ, approximately2.21MJ, before impact losses. Equal energy does not produce equal improvement in different soils. Energy compliance without pressure and density verification can leave weak layers that later cause differential settlement under permanent loading. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drop weight energy scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設質量m=15000kg、落高h=15m，在理想條件下E=mgh=15000×9.81×15=2207250J=2.20725MJ，約2.21MJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=15000kg and height h=15m, E=mgh=2207250J=2.20725MJ, approximately2.21MJ, before impact losses.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要落錘位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for drop weight energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「落錘位能尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drop weight energy scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 落錘位能尺度
knowledge.text: 動力夯實把落錘位能傳入地盤，但能量分配包含波傳、塑性變形及設備損失。位能不是衝擊峰值力，也不是直接的改善深度；施工參數必須由場址試夯建立。
knowledge.textEn: Dynamic compaction transfers drop-weight energy into ground deformation, waves and losses. Potential energy is neither peak impact force nor improvement depth; field parameters require a site-specific trial.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要落錘位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for drop weight energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「落錘位能尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drop weight energy scale" is correct?
options: 只要落錘位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
動力夯實把落錘位能傳入地盤，但能量分配包含波傳、塑性變形及設備損失。
只要單位面積能量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for drop weight energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Dynamic compaction transfers drop-weight energy into ground deformation, waves and losses.
A nominal result for energy per treatment area removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 動力夯實把落錘位能傳入地盤，但能量分配包含波傳、塑性變形及設備損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dynamic compaction transfers drop-weight energy into ground deformation, waves and losses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 落錘位能尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drop weight energy scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「落錘位能尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drop weight energy scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設質量m=15000kg、落高h=15m，在理想條件下E=mgh=15000×9.81×15=2207250J=2.20725MJ，約2.21MJ。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=15000kg and height h=15m, E=mgh=2207250J=2.20725MJ, approximately2.21MJ, before impact losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對設備質量與核准作業紀錄中的落高，將能量和試夯後測試結果配對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile mass and recorded approved drop height, pairing energy with post-trial tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設質量m=15000kg、落高h=15m，在理想條件下E=mgh=15000×9.81×15=2207250J=2.20725MJ，約2.21MJ。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=15000kg and height h=15m, E=mgh=2207250J=2.20725MJ, approximately2.21MJ, before impact losses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「落錘位能尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drop weight energy scale", which statement holds?
options: 只要超額孔壓比例符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要夯坑幾何估量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設質量m=15000kg、落高h=15m，在理想條件下E=mgh=15000×9.81×15=2207250J=2.20725MJ，約2.21MJ。
optionsEn: A nominal result for excess pressure ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for crater geometry estimate removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=15000kg and height h=15m, E=mgh=2207250J=2.20725MJ, approximately2.21MJ, before impact losses.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設質量m=15000kg、落高h=15m，在理想條件下E=mgh=15000×9.81×15=2207250J=2.20725MJ，約2.21MJ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=15000kg and height h=15m, E=mgh=2207250J=2.20725MJ, approximately2.21MJ, before impact losses. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 落錘位能尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drop weight energy scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「落錘位能尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drop weight energy scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對設備質量與核准作業紀錄中的落高，將能量和試夯後測試結果配對。質量、吊具與安全作業由合格施工團隊管理，本算例僅供桌面能量分析。同時排除以下干擾原因：同樣位能在不同土層不會產生相同改善，若用能量達標取代孔壓與密實度驗證，軟弱夾層仍可能存在並在正式載重後造成差異沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile mass and recorded approved drop height, pairing energy with post-trial tests. Qualified construction personnel control equipment and lifting; the example supports desktop energy analysis only. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Equal energy does not produce equal improvement in different soils. Energy compliance without pressure and density verification can leave weak layers that later cause differential settlement under permanent loading. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接落錘位能尺度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對設備質量與核准作業紀錄中的落高，將能量和試夯後測試結果配對。質量、吊具與安全作業由合格施工團隊管理，本算例僅供桌面能量分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over drop weight energy scale, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile mass and recorded approved drop height, pairing energy with post-trial tests. Qualified construction personnel control equipment and lifting; the example supports desktop energy analysis only.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同樣位能在不同土層不會產生相同改善，若用能量達標取代孔壓與密實度驗證，軟弱夾層仍可能存在並在正式載重後造成差異沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equal energy does not produce equal improvement in different soils. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「落錘位能尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drop weight energy scale"?
options: 核對設備質量與核准作業紀錄中的落高，將能量和試夯後測試結果配對。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要平板反力剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reconcile mass and recorded approved drop height, pairing energy with post-trial tests.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for plate response stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 核對設備質量與核准作業紀錄中的落高，將能量和試夯後測試結果配對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile mass and recorded approved drop height, pairing energy with post-trial tests. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 落錘位能尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drop weight energy scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「落錘位能尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drop weight energy scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同樣位能在不同土層不會產生相同改善，若用能量達標取代孔壓與密實度驗證，軟弱夾層仍可能存在並在正式載重後造成差異沉陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equal energy does not produce equal improvement in different soils. Energy compliance without pressure and density verification can leave weak layers that later cause differential settlement under permanent loading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：同樣位能在不同土層不會產生相同改善，若用能量達標取代孔壓與密實度驗證，軟弱夾層仍可能存在並在正式載重後造成差異沉陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Energy compliance without pressure and density verification can leave weak layers that later cause differential settlement under permanent loading.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要落錘位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for drop weight energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同樣位能在不同土層不會產生相同改善，若用能量達標取代孔壓與密實度驗證，軟弱夾層仍可能存在並在正式載重後造成差異沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Equal energy does not produce equal improvement in different soils. Energy compliance without pressure and density verification can leave weak layers that later cause differential settlement under permanent loading.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「落錘位能尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drop weight energy scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
同樣位能在不同土層不會產生相同改善，若用能量達標取代孔壓與密實度驗證，軟弱夾層仍可能存在並在正式載重後造成差異沉陷。
只要單位面積能量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Equal energy does not produce equal improvement in different soils.
A nominal result for energy per treatment area removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 同樣位能在不同土層不會產生相同改善，若用能量達標取代孔壓與密實度驗證，軟弱夾層仍可能存在並在正式載重後造成差異沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal energy does not produce equal improvement in different soils. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 單位面積能量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy per treatment area: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「單位面積能量」如何影響動力夯實地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy per treatment area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic compaction of ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 能量應按夯點網格與遍數分配，不能只累計全場總量。平均面積能量有助比較試區，卻可能掩蓋網格間及場界的未處理區，需保留空間分布。假設每擊取四捨五入E=2.21MJ、同一25m²單元共10擊，EA=10×2.21/25=0.884MJ/m²；非均勻能量場的保證。若重複記錄同一夯點或以全場平均補償漏點，總能量看似足夠卻可能留下連續弱帶；載重跨越弱帶時，差異沉陷會比平均沉陷更嚴重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「單位面積能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distribute energy by grid and pass rather than only total site energy. Average areal energy compares trials but may conceal gaps between points or at boundaries, requiring spatial records. Using rounded E=2.21MJ per impact, ten impacts over a25m² cell give EA=0.884MJ/m², without guaranteeing uniform spatial delivery. Duplicate records or site averages compensating for omitted points can conceal continuous weak bands. Loads crossing those bands may develop differential movement more consequential than the site's average settlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Energy per treatment area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設每擊取四捨五入E=2.21MJ、同一25m²單元共10擊，EA=10×2.21/25=0.884MJ/m²；非均勻能量場的保證。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using rounded E=2.21MJ per impact, ten impacts over a25m² cell give EA=0.884MJ/m², without guaranteeing uniform spatial delivery.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要單位面積能量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for energy per treatment area removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「單位面積能量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Energy per treatment area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 單位面積能量
knowledge.text: 能量應按夯點網格與遍數分配，不能只累計全場總量。平均面積能量有助比較試區，卻可能掩蓋網格間及場界的未處理區，需保留空間分布。
knowledge.textEn: Distribute energy by grid and pass rather than only total site energy. Average areal energy compares trials but may conceal gaps between points or at boundaries, requiring spatial records.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要單位面積能量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for energy per treatment area removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單位面積能量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Energy per treatment area" is correct?
options: 只要單位面積能量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要經驗改善深度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
能量應按夯點網格與遍數分配，不能只累計全場總量。
optionsEn: A nominal result for energy per treatment area removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for empirical treatment depth removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Distribute energy by grid and pass rather than only total site energy.
quiz.explanation: 能量應按夯點網格與遍數分配，不能只累計全場總量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Distribute energy by grid and pass rather than only total site energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單位面積能量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy per treatment area: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單位面積能量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Energy per treatment area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設每擊取四捨五入E=2.21MJ、同一25m²單元共10擊，EA=10×2.21/25=0.884MJ/m²；非均勻能量場的保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using rounded E=2.21MJ per impact, ten impacts over a25m² cell give EA=0.884MJ/m², without guaranteeing uniform spatial delivery. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用坐標與時間記錄每次能量事件，和設計網格及遍數核對，再將測試點覆蓋到網格中間及邊緣。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map each event by coordinates and time against the planned grid and passes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設每擊取四捨五入E=2.21MJ、同一25m²單元共10擊，EA=10×2.21/25=0.884MJ/m²；非均勻能量場的保證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using rounded E=2.21MJ per impact, ten impacts over a25m² cell give EA=0.884MJ/m², without guaranteeing uniform spatial delivery.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「單位面積能量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Energy per treatment area", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設每擊取四捨五入E=2.21MJ、同一25m²單元共10擊，EA=10×2.21/25=0.884MJ/m²；非均勻能量場的保證。
只要鄰近振動衰減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要乾密度與含水符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using rounded E=2.21MJ per impact, ten impacts over a25m² cell give EA=0.884MJ/m², without guaranteeing uniform spatial delivery.
A nominal result for neighbouring vibration attenuation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for dry density and moisture removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設每擊取四捨五入E=2.21MJ、同一25m²單元共10擊，EA=10×2.21/25=0.884MJ/m²；非均勻能量場的保證。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using rounded E=2.21MJ per impact, ten impacts over a25m² cell give EA=0.884MJ/m², without guaranteeing uniform spatial delivery. Keep units when recalculating.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用坐標與時間記錄每次能量事件，和設計網格及遍數核對，再將測試點覆蓋到網格中間及邊緣。漏點須由試驗結果及設計責任人決定補充方案。同時排除以下干擾原因：若重複記錄同一夯點或以全場平均補償漏點，總能量看似足夠卻可能留下連續弱帶；載重跨越弱帶時，差異沉陷會比平均沉陷更嚴重。
knowledge.textEn: Map each event by coordinates and time against the planned grid and passes. Place verification between points and at edges; the designer uses test results to resolve missed treatment areas. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Duplicate records or site averages compensating for omitted points can conceal continuous weak bands. Loads crossing those bands may develop differential movement more consequential than the site's average settlement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接單位面積能量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用坐標與時間記錄每次能量事件，和設計網格及遍數核對，再將測試點覆蓋到網格中間及邊緣。漏點須由試驗結果及設計責任人決定補充方案。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over energy per treatment area, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map each event by coordinates and time against the planned grid and passes. Place verification between points and at edges; the designer uses test results to resolve missed treatment areas.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單位面積能量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy per treatment area"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用坐標與時間記錄每次能量事件，和設計網格及遍數核對，再將測試點覆蓋到網格中間及邊緣。
只要設備接地壓力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Map each event by coordinates and time against the planned grid and passes.
A nominal result for equipment ground contact pressure removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 用坐標與時間記錄每次能量事件，和設計網格及遍數核對，再將測試點覆蓋到網格中間及邊緣。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map each event by coordinates and time against the planned grid and passes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 單位面積能量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy per treatment area: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「單位面積能量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Energy per treatment area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若重複記錄同一夯點或以全場平均補償漏點，總能量看似足夠卻可能留下連續弱帶；載重跨越弱帶時，差異沉陷會比平均沉陷更嚴重。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Duplicate records or site averages compensating for omitted points can conceal continuous weak bands. Loads crossing those bands may develop differential movement more consequential than the site's average settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若重複記錄同一夯點或以全場平均補償漏點，總能量看似足夠卻可能留下連續弱帶；載重跨越弱帶時，差異沉陷會比平均沉陷更嚴重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Loads crossing those bands may develop differential movement more consequential than the site's average settlement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要單位面積能量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for energy per treatment area removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若重複記錄同一夯點或以全場平均補償漏點，總能量看似足夠卻可能留下連續弱帶；載重跨越弱帶時，差異沉陷會比平均沉陷更嚴重。
knowledge.textEn: Duplicate records or site averages compensating for omitted points can conceal continuous weak bands. Loads crossing those bands may develop differential movement more consequential than the site's average settlement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「單位面積能量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Energy per treatment area" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要經驗改善深度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
若重複記錄同一夯點或以全場平均補償漏點，總能量看似足夠卻可能留下連續弱帶；載重跨越弱帶時，差異沉陷會比平均沉陷更嚴重。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for empirical treatment depth removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Duplicate records or site averages compensating for omitted points can conceal continuous weak bands.
quiz.explanation: 若重複記錄同一夯點或以全場平均補償漏點，總能量看似足夠卻可能留下連續弱帶；載重跨越弱帶時，差異沉陷會比平均沉陷更嚴重。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Duplicate records or site averages compensating for omitted points can conceal continuous weak bands. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「經驗改善深度」與「超額孔壓比例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Empirical treatment depth" and "Excess pressure ratio": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 經驗改善深度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Empirical treatment depth: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「經驗改善深度」如何影響動力夯實地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Empirical treatment depth” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic compaction of ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改善深度的平方根經驗式依土類、能量效率及指定單位校準，係數不是通用無因次常數。它只能安排調查與試區尺度，不能取代深度分層的成效驗證。約定D以m、W以t、H以m，D=n√(WH)；選定經驗n=0.5、W=15t、H=15m得D=7.5m，不是保證改善深度。把噸改成公斤卻不轉換係數會大幅誇大深度；即使單位正確，硬殼或軟黏土夾層也可能阻隔能量，使經驗估算無法代表真正改善底界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「經驗改善深度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A square-root depth correlation depends on soil, efficiency and specified units. Its coefficient is not universally dimensionless; use it to plan investigations and trials rather than replace depth-specific verification. With D in metres, W in tonnes and H in metres, D=n√(WH). A calibrated-unit coefficient n=0.5, W=15t and H=15m give7.5m, not a guaranteed treatment depth. Changing tonnes to kilograms without changing the coefficient grossly inflates depth. Even consistent units cannot account automatically for a hard crust or soft clay lens that disrupts energy transfer. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Empirical treatment depth” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：約定D以m、W以t、H以m，D=n√(WH)；選定經驗n=0.5、W=15t、H=15m得D=7.5m，不是保證改善深度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With D in metres, W in tonnes and H in metres, D=n√(WH).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要經驗改善深度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for empirical treatment depth removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「經驗改善深度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Empirical treatment depth”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 經驗改善深度
knowledge.text: 改善深度的平方根經驗式依土類、能量效率及指定單位校準，係數不是通用無因次常數。它只能安排調查與試區尺度，不能取代深度分層的成效驗證。
knowledge.textEn: A square-root depth correlation depends on soil, efficiency and specified units. Its coefficient is not universally dimensionless; use it to plan investigations and trials rather than replace depth-specific verification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要經驗改善深度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for empirical treatment depth removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「經驗改善深度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Empirical treatment depth" is correct?
options: 改善深度的平方根經驗式依土類、能量效率及指定單位校準，係數不是通用無因次常數。
只要經驗改善深度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要超額孔壓比例符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A square-root depth correlation depends on soil, efficiency and specified units.
A nominal result for empirical treatment depth removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for excess pressure ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 改善深度的平方根經驗式依土類、能量效率及指定單位校準，係數不是通用無因次常數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A square-root depth correlation depends on soil, efficiency and specified units. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 經驗改善深度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Empirical treatment depth: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「經驗改善深度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Empirical treatment depth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：約定D以m、W以t、H以m，D=n√(WH)；選定經驗n=0.5、W=15t、H=15m得D=7.5m，不是保證改善深度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With D in metres, W in tonnes and H in metres, D=n√(WH). A calibrated-unit coefficient n=0.5, W=15t and H=15m give7.5m, not a guaranteed treatment depth. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查明係數的試驗來源及單位慣例，於試區各深度比較施工前後貫入或其他核准測試。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify the coefficient's evidence and unit convention, comparing approved pre- and post-treatment tests at depth.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：約定D以m、W以t、H以m，D=n√(WH)；選定經驗n=0.5、W=15t、H=15m得D=7.5m，不是保證改善深度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With D in metres, W in tonnes and H in metres, D=n√(WH). A calibrated-unit coefficient n=0.5, W=15t and H=15m give7.5m, not a guaranteed treatment depth.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「經驗改善深度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Empirical treatment depth", which statement holds?
options: 只要夯坑幾何估量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：約定D以m、W以t、H以m，D=n√(WH)；選定經驗n=0.5、W=15t、H=15m得D=7.5m，不是保證改善深度。
只要平板反力剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for crater geometry estimate removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With D in metres, W in tonnes and H in metres, D=n√(WH).
A nominal result for plate response stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With D in metres, W in tonnes and H in metres, D=n√(WH). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 經驗改善深度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Empirical treatment depth: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「經驗改善深度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Empirical treatment depth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查明係數的試驗來源及單位慣例，於試區各深度比較施工前後貫入或其他核准測試。若深部未改變，須重查地層及排水條件，不只調整係數配合預期。同時排除以下干擾原因：把噸改成公斤卻不轉換係數會大幅誇大深度；即使單位正確，硬殼或軟黏土夾層也可能阻隔能量，使經驗估算無法代表真正改善底界。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Even consistent units cannot account automatically for a hard crust or soft clay lens that disrupts energy transfer. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over empirical treatment depth, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Verify the coefficient's evidence and unit convention, comparing approved pre- and post-treatment tests at depth. Unchanged deep material requires reviewing stratigraphy and drainage instead of fitting the coefficient to the desired answer.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Changing tonnes to kilograms without changing the coefficient grossly inflates depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 查明係數的試驗來源及單位慣例，於試區各深度比較施工前後貫入或其他核准測試。若深部未改變，須重查地層及排水條件，不只調整係數配合預期。同時排除以下干擾原因：把噸改成公斤卻不轉換係數會大幅誇大深度；即使單位正確，硬殼或軟黏土夾層也可能阻隔能量，使經驗估算無法代表真正改善底界。

Unchanged deep material requires reviewing stratigraphy and drainage instead of fitting the coefficient to the desired answer. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Changing tonnes to kilograms without changing the coefficient grossly inflates depth. steps.instruction: 飽和地盤受快速衝擊時可產生超額孔壓，使有效應力暫時降低。每一遍之間的排水恢復會影響後續效果，因此須將孔壓時間反應與能量紀錄一起分析。假設超額孔壓Δu=60kPa、初始有效垂直應力σ′v0=80kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.75；分母為初始有效應力而非總應力。若儀器取樣太慢，峰值可能被平均掉而誤判地盤已恢復；持續施加能量於高孔壓土層，可能增加側向移動而不是獲得預期密實效果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「超額孔壓比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid impacts in saturated ground generate excess pressure and temporarily reduce effective stress. The denominator is initial effective stress, not total stress. Slow sampling can average away peaks and suggest premature recovery. steps.instruction: 若儀器取樣太慢，峰值可能被平均掉而誤判地盤已恢復；持續施加能量於高孔壓土層，可能增加側向移動而不是獲得預期密實效果。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slow sampling can average away peaks and suggest premature recovery. Continued impacts in highly pressurized soil may increase lateral movement rather than deliver the intended densification. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若儀器取樣太慢，峰值可能被平均掉而誤判地盤已恢復；持續施加能量於高孔壓土層，可能增加側向移動而不是獲得預期密實效果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Continued impacts in highly pressurized soil may increase lateral movement rather than deliver the intended densification.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要超額孔壓比例符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for excess pressure ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若儀器取樣太慢，峰值可能被平均掉而誤判地盤已恢復；持續施加能量於高孔壓土層，可能增加側向移動而不是獲得預期密實效果。
knowledge.textEn: Slow sampling can average away peaks and suggest premature recovery. Continued impacts in highly pressurized soil may increase lateral movement rather than deliver the intended densification.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超額孔壓比例」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Excess pressure ratio" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若儀器取樣太慢，峰值可能被平均掉而誤判地盤已恢復；持續施加能量於高孔壓土層，可能增加側向移動而不是獲得預期密實效果。
只要鄰近振動衰減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Slow sampling can average away peaks and suggest premature recovery.
A nominal result for neighbouring vibration attenuation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若儀器取樣太慢，峰值可能被平均掉而誤判地盤已恢復；持續施加能量於高孔壓土層，可能增加側向移動而不是獲得預期密實效果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Slow sampling can average away peaks and suggest premature recovery. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鄰近振動衰減」與「夯坑幾何估量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Neighbouring vibration attenuation" and "Crater geometry estimate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鄰近振動衰減：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Neighbouring vibration attenuation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鄰近振動衰減」如何影響動力夯實地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Neighbouring vibration attenuation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic compaction of ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 振動傳播受土層、頻率與建物條件影響，經驗距離式只能在校準範圍內比較。峰值粒子速度與加速度不同，單一數字也不能取代對脆弱設施的評估。假設已校準PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5，r=40m時PPV=2.83mm/s；指數1.5為選定擬合值，非普遍規律。單向感測器或未牢固耦合會低估真實峰值；若地層導波造成局部放大，單靠距離倍增即假設安全會漏掉遠處敏感設施的較大反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鄰近振動衰減」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground layers, frequency and structures affect vibration. A distance correlation is valid only within its calibration range; peak particle velocity differs from acceleration and cannot alone establish acceptability for sensitive assets. For calibrated PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5, r=40m gives2.83mm/s. The exponent1.5 is a selected fit, not a universal law. A poorly coupled or single-axis sensor can underread the peak. Guided waves may amplify remote response, making an assumed safety benefit from distance alone unreliable for sensitive facilities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Neighbouring vibration attenuation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已校準PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5，r=40m時PPV=2.83mm/s；指數1.5為選定擬合值，非普遍規律。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For calibrated PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5, r=40m gives2.83mm/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要鄰近振動衰減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for neighbouring vibration attenuation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鄰近振動衰減」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Neighbouring vibration attenuation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鄰近振動衰減
knowledge.text: 振動傳播受土層、頻率與建物條件影響，經驗距離式只能在校準範圍內比較。峰值粒子速度與加速度不同，單一數字也不能取代對脆弱設施的評估。
knowledge.textEn: Ground layers, frequency and structures affect vibration. A distance correlation is valid only within its calibration range; peak particle velocity differs from acceleration and cannot alone establish acceptability for sensitive assets.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要鄰近振動衰減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for neighbouring vibration attenuation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鄰近振動衰減」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Neighbouring vibration attenuation" is correct?
options: 只要鄰近振動衰減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要夯坑幾何估量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
振動傳播受土層、頻率與建物條件影響，經驗距離式只能在校準範圍內比較。
optionsEn: A nominal result for neighbouring vibration attenuation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for crater geometry estimate removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Ground layers, frequency and structures affect vibration.
quiz.explanation: 振動傳播受土層、頻率與建物條件影響，經驗距離式只能在校準範圍內比較。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ground layers, frequency and structures affect vibration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鄰近振動衰減：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Neighbouring vibration attenuation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鄰近振動衰減」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Neighbouring vibration attenuation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已校準PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5，r=40m時PPV=2.83mm/s；指數1.5為選定擬合值，非普遍規律。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For calibrated PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5, r=40m gives2.83mm/s. The exponent1.5 is a selected fit, not a universal law. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用三向地震檢波器記錄波形、頻率與距離，在代表性方位建立現地關係。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record three-axis waveforms, frequencies and distances to establish site relations in representative directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已校準PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5，r=40m時PPV=2.83mm/s；指數1.5為選定擬合值，非普遍規律。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For calibrated PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5, r=40m gives2.83mm/s. The exponent1.5 is a selected fit, not a universal law.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鄰近振動衰減」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Neighbouring vibration attenuation", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已校準PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5，r=40m時PPV=2.83mm/s；指數1.5為選定擬合值，非普遍規律。
只要平板反力剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要貫入阻力改善比符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For calibrated PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5, r=40m gives2.83mm/s.
A nominal result for plate response stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for penetration resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已校準PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5，r=40m時PPV=2.83mm/s；指數1.5為選定擬合值，非普遍規律。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For calibrated PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5, r=40m gives2.83mm/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鄰近振動衰減：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Neighbouring vibration attenuation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鄰近振動衰減」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Neighbouring vibration attenuation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用三向地震檢波器記錄波形、頻率與距離，在代表性方位建立現地關係。鄰近管線及歷史建物的允許條件由權責工程師依狀態和規範決定。同時排除以下干擾原因：單向感測器或未牢固耦合會低估真實峰值；若地層導波造成局部放大，單靠距離倍增即假設安全會漏掉遠處敏感設施的較大反應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record three-axis waveforms, frequencies and distances to establish site relations in representative directions. Responsible engineers set limits for nearby utilities and heritage structures using their condition and applicable guidance. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A poorly coupled or single-axis sensor can underread the peak. Guided waves may amplify remote response, making an assumed safety benefit from distance alone unreliable for sensitive facilities. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接鄰近振動衰減時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用三向地震檢波器記錄波形、頻率與距離，在代表性方位建立現地關係。鄰近管線及歷史建物的允許條件由權責工程師依狀態和規範決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over neighbouring vibration attenuation, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Record three-axis waveforms, frequencies and distances to establish site relations in representative directions. Responsible engineers set limits for nearby utilities and heritage structures using their condition and applicable guidance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單向感測器或未牢固耦合會低估真實峰值；若地層導波造成局部放大，單靠距離倍增即假設安全會漏掉遠處敏感設施的較大反應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A poorly coupled or single-axis sensor can underread the peak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.explanation: 深坑也可能來自側向擠土或表層破壞，而不表示深部改善；只追求坑深會忽略鄰近隆起、地下管線變形及不均勻回填形成的次生沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A deep crater may reflect lateral extrusion or surface failure rather than deep improvement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「乾密度與含水」與「平板反力剛度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dry density and moisture" and "Plate response stiffness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 乾密度與含水：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dry density and moisture: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「乾密度與含水」如何影響動力夯實地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dry density and moisture” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic compaction of ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密實度評估須分清乾土質量與含水質量，試樣體積與代表性同樣重要。單一點位乾密度不能代表整個深度或面積，應配合分層測試與含水狀態判讀。假設乾土質量Md=1800kg、體積V=1m³，ρd=Md/V=1800kg/m³；若量得濕質量，必須先按含水率換算。若把濕質量直接計為乾密度，含水較高區會顯得更密實；這種假改善可能掩蓋孔壓未消散與土骨架鬆散，導致錯誤驗收地盤承載狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「乾密度與含水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish dry mass from wet mass when evaluating density, with reliable volume and representative sampling. One result does not characterize the full area or depth and needs layered tests and moisture context. For dry mass Md=1800kg and volume V=1m³, ρd=1800kg/m³. A measured wet mass must first be corrected using water content. Using wet mass as dry mass makes wetter soil appear denser. That false improvement can conceal remaining pore pressure and loose fabric, leading to incorrect acceptance of foundation conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dry density and moisture” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設乾土質量Md=1800kg、體積V=1m³，ρd=Md/V=1800kg/m³；若量得濕質量，必須先按含水率換算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For dry mass Md=1800kg and volume V=1m³, ρd=1800kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要乾密度與含水符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for dry density and moisture removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「乾密度與含水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dry density and moisture”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 乾密度與含水
knowledge.text: 密實度評估須分清乾土質量與含水質量，試樣體積與代表性同樣重要。單一點位乾密度不能代表整個深度或面積，應配合分層測試與含水狀態判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Distinguish dry mass from wet mass when evaluating density, with reliable volume and representative sampling. One result does not characterize the full area or depth and needs layered tests and moisture context.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要乾密度與含水符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for dry density and moisture removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「乾密度與含水」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dry density and moisture" is correct?
options: 只要乾密度與含水符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
密實度評估須分清乾土質量與含水質量，試樣體積與代表性同樣重要。
只要平板反力剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for dry density and moisture removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Distinguish dry mass from wet mass when evaluating density, with reliable volume and representative sampling.
A nominal result for plate response stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 密實度評估須分清乾土質量與含水質量，試樣體積與代表性同樣重要。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Distinguish dry mass from wet mass when evaluating density, with reliable volume and representative sampling. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 乾密度與含水：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dry density and moisture: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「乾密度與含水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dry density and moisture” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設乾土質量Md=1800kg、體積V=1m³，ρd=Md/V=1800kg/m³；若量得濕質量，必須先按含水率換算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For dry mass Md=1800kg and volume V=1m³, ρd=1800kg/m³. A measured wet mass must first be corrected using water content. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依核准方法取得代表試樣與含水率，保存取樣深度及體積校正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain representative samples and moisture by approved methods, retaining depth and volume calibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設乾土質量Md=1800kg、體積V=1m³，ρd=Md/V=1800kg/m³；若量得濕質量，必須先按含水率換算。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For dry mass Md=1800kg and volume V=1m³, ρd=1800kg/m³. A measured wet mass must first be corrected using water content.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「乾密度與含水」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dry density and moisture", which statement holds?
options: 只要貫入阻力改善比符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要單位面積能量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設乾土質量Md=1800kg、體積V=1m³，ρd=Md/V=1800kg/m³；若量得濕質量，必須先按含水率換算。
optionsEn: A nominal result for penetration resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for energy per treatment area removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For dry mass Md=1800kg and volume V=1m³, ρd=1800kg/m³.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設乾土質量Md=1800kg、體積V=1m³，ρd=Md/V=1800kg/m³；若量得濕質量，必須先按含水率換算。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For dry mass Md=1800kg and volume V=1m³, ρd=1800kg/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 乾密度與含水：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dry density and moisture: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「乾密度與含水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dry density and moisture” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依核准方法取得代表試樣與含水率，保存取樣深度及體積校正。對照相關規格及試驗不確定性，將不易取樣區明列而非用附近單點值填補。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把濕質量直接計為乾密度，含水較高區會顯得更密實；這種假改善可能掩蓋孔壓未消散與土骨架鬆散，導致錯誤驗收地盤承載狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain representative samples and moisture by approved methods, retaining depth and volume calibration. Compare with relevant specifications and uncertainty, explicitly marking difficult-to-sample areas instead of substituting one nearby result. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using wet mass as dry mass makes wetter soil appear denser. That false improvement can conceal remaining pore pressure and loose fabric, leading to incorrect acceptance of foundation conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接乾密度與含水時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。依核准方法取得代表試樣與含水率，保存取樣深度及體積校正。對照相關規格及試驗不確定性，將不易取樣區明列而非用附近單點值填補。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over dry density and moisture, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Obtain representative samples and moisture by approved methods, retaining depth and volume calibration. Compare with relevant specifications and uncertainty, explicitly marking difficult-to-sample areas instead of substituting one nearby result.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把濕質量直接計為乾密度，含水較高區會顯得更密實；這種假改善可能掩蓋孔壓未消散與土骨架鬆散，導致錯誤驗收地盤承載狀態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using wet mass as dry mass makes wetter soil appear denser. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依核准方法取得代表試樣與含水率，保存取樣深度及體積校正。對照相關規格及試驗不確定性，將不易取樣區明列而非用附近單點值填補。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把濕質量直接計為乾密度，含水較高區會顯得更密實；這種假改善可能掩蓋孔壓未消散與土骨架鬆散，導致錯誤驗收地盤承載狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain representative samples and moisture by approved methods, retaining depth and volume calibration. Compare with relevant specifications and uncertainty, explicitly marking difficult-to-sample areas instead of substituting one nearby result. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using wet mass as dry mass makes wetter soil appear denser. That false improvement can conceal remaining pore pressure and loose fabric, leading to incorrect acceptance of foundation conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接乾密度與含水時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。依核准方法取得代表試樣與含水率，保存取樣深度及體積校正。對照相關規格及試驗不確定性，將不易取樣區明列而非用附近單點值填補。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over dry density and moisture, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Obtain representative samples and moisture by approved methods, retaining depth and volume calibration. Compare with relevant specifications and uncertainty, explicitly marking difficult-to-sample areas instead of substituting one nearby result.

quiz.question: 要驗證「乾密度與含水」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dry density and moisture"?
options: 依核准方法取得代表試樣與含水率，保存取樣深度及體積校正。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要超額孔壓比例符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Obtain representative samples and moisture by approved methods, retaining depth and volume calibration.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for excess pressure ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 依核准方法取得代表試樣與含水率，保存取樣深度及體積校正。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain representative samples and moisture by approved methods, retaining depth and volume calibration. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 乾密度與含水：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dry density and moisture: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「乾密度與含水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dry density and moisture” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把濕質量直接計為乾密度，含水較高區會顯得更密實；這種假改善可能掩蓋孔壓未消散與土骨架鬆散，導致錯誤驗收地盤承載狀態。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using wet mass as dry mass makes wetter soil appear denser. That false improvement can conceal remaining pore pressure and loose fabric, leading to incorrect acceptance of foundation conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把濕質量直接計為乾密度，含水較高區會顯得更密實；這種假改善可能掩蓋孔壓未消散與土骨架鬆散，導致錯誤驗收地盤承載狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That false improvement can conceal remaining pore pressure and loose fabric, leading to incorrect acceptance of foundation conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要乾密度與含水符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for dry density and moisture removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把濕質量直接計為乾密度，含水較高區會顯得更密實；這種假改善可能掩蓋孔壓未消散與土骨架鬆散，導致錯誤驗收地盤承載狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Using wet mass as dry mass makes wetter soil appear denser. That false improvement can conceal remaining pore pressure and loose fabric, leading to incorrect acceptance of foundation conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「乾密度與含水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dry density and moisture" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把濕質量直接計為乾密度，含水較高區會顯得更密實；這種假改善可能掩蓋孔壓未消散與土骨架鬆散，導致錯誤驗收地盤承載狀態。
只要平板反力剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using wet mass as dry mass makes wetter soil appear denser.
A nominal result for plate response stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若把濕質量直接計為乾密度，含水較高區會顯得更密實；這種假改善可能掩蓋孔壓未消散與土骨架鬆散，導致錯誤驗收地盤承載狀態。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using wet mass as dry mass makes wetter soil appear denser. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 平板反力剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Plate response stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「平板反力剛度」如何影響動力夯實地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plate response stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic compaction of ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平板載重的壓力沉陷比是試驗尺度下的反力指標，受板尺寸與受力深度影響。它不是土壤楊氏模數，也不應直接外推到大型基礎的深層沉陷。假設壓力q=200kPa、沉陷s=0.010m，k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m；單位為壓力除長度，非MPa。表面硬殼可讓小平板呈現高剛度，下面軟層卻未改善；將此反力係數當材料常數會低估大面積載重沉陷，造成對施工成果過度樂觀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「平板反力剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A plate's pressure-settlement ratio is a test-scale response influenced by plate size and stressed depth. It is not soil Young's modulus and cannot directly predict deeper settlement under a large foundation. For q=200kPa and s=0.010m, k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m. Its unit is pressure per length, not MPa. A surface crust can stiffen a small plate while soft material remains below. Treating its response coefficient as a material constant understates settlement under larger loads and overstates treatment success. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Plate response stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 平板反力剛度

steps.title: 平板反力剛度：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設壓力q=200kPa、沉陷s=0.010m，k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m；單位為壓力除長度，非MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For q=200kPa and s=0.010m, k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m. Its unit is pressure per length, not MPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 平板反力剛度：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「平板反力剛度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Plate response stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保存完整載重卸載曲線與持荷時間，核對板尺寸、基底整平及位移基準。以相同試驗條件比較前後改善，深層承載及沉陷另由地層模型檢核。同時排除以下干擾原因：表面硬殼可讓小平板呈現高剛度，下面軟層卻未改善；將此反力係數當材料常數會低估大面積載重沉陷，造成對施工成果過度樂觀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain complete load-unload curves, hold times, plate dimensions and displacement references. Treating its response coefficient as a material constant understates settlement under larger loads and overstates treatment success. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
