steps.title: 設備接地壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equipment ground contact pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「設備接地壓力」如何影響動力夯實地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equipment ground contact pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic compaction of ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 施工設備作用地盤的接觸壓力影響作業平台穩定，和改善後永久地盤能力是不同問題。平均壓力不含履帶端部集中、動態反力或偏心，平台需獨立設計。假設設備垂直荷載P=1000kN、總有效接觸A=2m²，q=P/A=500kPa；此為靜態平均值，不是平台許可壓力。接觸面積若因不平整或坑邊只剩一部分，實際壓力可遠高於平均值；即使場地已改良，局部平台破壞仍可能造成設備傾斜與連鎖風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「設備接地壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Equipment contact pressure governs working-platform stability, separately from improved permanent-ground capacity. Average pressure excludes track-edge concentration, dynamic reactions and eccentricity, requiring a dedicated platform design. For vertical equipment load P=1000kN over effective A=2m², q=500kPa. This is static average pressure, not allowable platform bearing pressure. Uneven ground or a crater edge can reduce contact area and raise actual pressure well above average. Local platform failure can tilt equipment even on generally improved ground, creating wider hazards. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equipment ground contact pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 施工前後貫入阻力比可顯示改變，但受有效應力、孔壓、測試位置及土層分類影響。成效判讀應檢查完整深度剖面，不能只報全場最大的改善倍率。假設同層可比較錐阻力qc由6MPa增至12MPa，比值12/6=2；兩倍錐阻力不是兩倍承載力或所有土層合格。前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「貫入阻力改善比」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 貫入阻力改善比：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同層可比較錐阻力qc由6MPa增至12MPa，比值12/6=2；兩倍錐阻力不是兩倍承載力或所有土層合格。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For comparable same-layer cone resistance rising from6MPa to12MPa, the ratio is2. Doubled cone resistance is not doubled bearing capacity or acceptance of all strata. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 貫入阻力改善比：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 配對前後測線與高程，檢查等待孔壓消散時間、探頭校正及土層變化。對低增幅區保留原始剖面與原因分析，依工程目標逐區簽認而非平均通過。同時排除以下干擾原因：前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

title: 振動碎石樁施工
summary: 本課聚焦連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。方格間距固定2m，假設直徑由0.8增加10%至0.88m，置換率由0.1257增為0.1521，比例增加21%而非10%；實際直徑與深度連續性仍需證據，不能只用供料量保證。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell. At fixed2m square spacing, increasing assumed diameter from0.8 to0.88m by10% raises replacement from0.1257 to0.1521, a21% rather than10% increase. Actual diameter and continuity still require evidence rather than a delivered-material guarantee. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「方格置換面積」與「粒料側向拘束」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Square grid replacement area" and "Aggregate lateral confinement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 方格置換面積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Square grid replacement area: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方格置換面積」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Square grid replacement area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 碎石樁和原土共同承擔荷載，樁面積占單元面積的比例是配置起點。平均直徑不一定代表每一深度的有效斷面，網格邊界與漏樁也會改變實際置換。假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。若將三角網格與方格公式混用，置換率會被誤算；實際縮頸或場界缺柱也可使名義比例失去代表性，集中載重下會增加差異沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方格置換面積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stone columns and native soil share load, making area replacement a starting descriptor. Mean diameter does not establish effective section at every depth, while boundaries and missing columns alter actual replacement. For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell. Confusing triangular and square grids miscalculates replacement. Necking or missing boundary columns can also invalidate nominal coverage and increase differential settlement beneath localized concentrated loads. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Square grid replacement area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 用竣工坐標與材料記錄核對每個單元，檢查不同深度的可能縮頸。圖面列出場界、障礙及漏樁位置，不能以全場平均替代關鍵基礎下的局部配置。同時排除以下干擾原因：若將三角網格與方格公式混用，置換率會被誤算；實際縮頸或場界缺柱也可使名義比例失去代表性，集中載重下會增加差異沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile as-built coordinates and material records by cell, checking possible necking with depth. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Confusing triangular and square grids miscalculates replacement. Necking or missing boundary columns can also invalidate nominal coverage and increase differential settlement beneath localized concentrated loads. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.objective: 說明「粒料側向拘束」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aggregate lateral confinement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 碎石柱不是可獨立受壓的鋼筋混凝土樁，粒料抗剪需要周圍土體提供拘束。理想摩擦材料的主應力比顯示拘束重要性，但不能直接當整根柱的承載公式。假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「粒料側向拘束」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A stone column is not an independently supported reinforced-concrete pile. Aggregate shear resistance needs surrounding confinement; an ideal frictional stress ratio illustrates that dependence rather than providing a whole-column capacity formula. For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses. Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aggregate lateral confinement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses.

A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanation: 碎石柱不是可獨立受壓的鋼筋混凝土樁，粒料抗剪需要周圍土體提供拘束。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A stone column is not an independently supported reinforced-concrete pile. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 粒料側向拘束：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aggregate lateral confinement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「粒料側向拘束」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aggregate lateral confinement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「粒料側向拘束」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Aggregate lateral confinement", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。
只要成柱材料體積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要排水時間尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses.
A nominal result for column material volume removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for drainage time scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 粒料側向拘束：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aggregate lateral confinement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「粒料側向拘束」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aggregate lateral confinement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。載重試驗須追蹤沉陷和側向變形，由設計工程師確認是否需要包覆或其他拘束措施。同時排除以下干擾原因：上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones. Monitor settlement and lateral deformation in load tests so the designer can assess additional confinement or encasement. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接粒料側向拘束時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。載重試驗須追蹤沉陷和側向變形，由設計工程師確認是否需要包覆或其他拘束措施。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over aggregate lateral confinement, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones. Monitor settlement and lateral deformation in load tests so the designer can assess additional confinement or encasement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。載重試驗須追蹤沉陷和側向變形，由設計工程師確認是否需要包覆或其他拘束措施。同時排除以下干擾原因：上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。
knowledge.textEn: Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones. Monitor settlement and lateral deformation in load tests so the designer can assess additional confinement or encasement. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated.

knowledge.text: 交接粒料側向拘束時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。載重試驗須追蹤沉陷和側向變形，由設計工程師確認是否需要包覆或其他拘束措施。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over aggregate lateral confinement, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones. quiz.question: 要驗證「粒料側向拘束」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Aggregate lateral confinement"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。
只要邊緣柱與內柱符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones.
A nominal result for edge and interior columns removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 粒料側向拘束：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aggregate lateral confinement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「粒料側向拘束」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aggregate lateral confinement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要粒料側向拘束符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for aggregate lateral confinement removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。
knowledge.textEn: Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「粒料側向拘束」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Aggregate lateral confinement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要等應變荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging.
quiz.explanation: 上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「等應變荷載分配」與「柱體排水通量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equal strain load sharing" and "Column drainage flow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 等應變荷載分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equal strain load sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「等應變荷載分配」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equal strain load sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 複合地盤中較硬柱體常吸引較多應力，但分配受剛度、變形相容及載重面積影響。等應變單元可說明平衡，應力集中比必須有分析或試驗依據。假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「等應變荷載分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stiffer columns often attract more stress, with sharing governed by stiffness, compatibility and loaded area. An equal-strain cell illustrates equilibrium, but its concentration ratio requires analytical or experimental support. For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa. Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equal strain load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要等應變荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「等應變荷載分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equal strain load sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 等應變荷載分配
knowledge.text: 複合地盤中較硬柱體常吸引較多應力，但分配受剛度、變形相容及載重面積影響。等應變單元可說明平衡，應力集中比必須有分析或試驗依據。
knowledge.textEn: Stiffer columns often attract more stress, with sharing governed by stiffness, compatibility and loaded area. An equal-strain cell illustrates equilibrium, but its concentration ratio requires analytical or experimental support.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要等應變荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「等應變荷載分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equal strain load sharing" is correct?
options: 複合地盤中較硬柱體常吸引較多應力，但分配受剛度、變形相容及載重面積影響。
只要等應變荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要柱體排水通量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Stiffer columns often attract more stress, with sharing governed by stiffness, compatibility and loaded area.
A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for column drainage flow removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 複合地盤中較硬柱體常吸引較多應力，但分配受剛度、變形相容及載重面積影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stiffer columns often attract more stress, with sharing governed by stiffness, compatibility and loaded area. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.titleEn: Equal strain load sharing: quantitative estimate

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Equal strain load sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以柱頂及土面荷重資料核對單元力平衡，觀察沉陷是否足以支持等應變假設。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 等應變荷載分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equal strain load sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「等應變荷載分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Equal strain load sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以柱頂及土面荷重資料核對單元力平衡，觀察沉陷是否足以支持等應變假設。若柱土分離、局部荷重或墊層拱效應明顯，應重建分配模型。同時排除以下干擾原因：把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check cell equilibrium using column and soil loading evidence and assess whether measured movement supports equal strain. Separation, localized loading or significant mat arching requires a revised sharing model. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接等應變荷載分配時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以柱頂及土面荷重資料核對單元力平衡，觀察沉陷是否足以支持等應變假設。若柱土分離、局部荷重或墊層拱效應明顯，應重建分配模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over equal strain load sharing, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check cell equilibrium using column and soil loading evidence and assess whether measured movement supports equal strain. Separation, localized loading or significant mat arching requires a revised sharing model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「等應變荷載分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.instruction: 把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要等應變荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

quiz.question: 在「等應變荷載分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A nominal result for column drainage flow removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.title: 柱體排水通量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Column drainage flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「柱體排水通量」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Column drainage flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高透水柱體可提供排水路徑，但是否有效取決於連通、濾層及周圍土進水能力。達西通量只描述選定柱段，不能以柱材高透水性證明全地盤迅速消散孔壓。假設柱材k=0.01m/s、有效A=0.5m²、梯度i=0.2，Q=kiA=0.001m³/s；假設此流速下可採達西關係。細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「柱體排水通量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A permeable column provides drainage only with connectivity, filtering and inflow from the surrounding soil. Darcy flow describes a selected segment; high aggregate permeability alone does not prove rapid pressure dissipation throughout the ground. For k=0.01m/s, effective A=0.5m² and i=0.2, Q=0.001m³/s, assuming Darcy behaviour at the relevant velocity. Fine migration can clog the perimeter while the core remains permeable, limiting inflow. With a closed outlet, the column may merely redistribute pressure rather than discharge water from the ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Column drainage flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設柱材k=0.01m/s、有效A=0.5m²、梯度i=0.2，Q=kiA=0.001m³/s；假設此流速下可採達西關係。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For k=0.01m/s, effective A=0.5m² and i=0.2, Q=0.001m³/s, assuming Darcy behaviour at the relevant velocity.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要柱體排水通量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for column drainage flow removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「柱體排水通量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 成柱材料體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Column material volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「成柱材料體積」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Column material volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想圓柱體積有助核對材料帳，但實際投入量含鬆散堆積、地盤擴張及施工損失。材料超量或不足均需解釋，不能直接把卡車運送體積當竣工直徑證明。假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。單靠總用量可漏掉上部過度擴張而下部縮頸的柱體；整根帳面體積吻合時，深部薄弱斷面仍可能控制鼓脹或沉陷，無法由平均量排除。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「成柱材料體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal cylindrical volume helps reconcile material, but delivered quantities include loose packing, ground expansion and losses. Both excess and shortage need explanation; truck volume alone does not demonstrate as-built diameter. For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery. Total quantity can hide an oversized upper segment and a necked lower one. Even a matching volume balance cannot exclude a weak deep section controlling bulging or settlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Column material volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要成柱材料體積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 單靠總用量可漏掉上部過度擴張而下部縮頸的柱體；整根帳面體積吻合時，深部薄弱斷面仍可能控制鼓脹或沉陷，無法由平均量排除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 複合地盤壓縮：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite ground compression: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「複合地盤壓縮」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Composite ground compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良後沉陷取決於有效複合模數與未改善下層，簡化一維估算只適用指定應力範圍。柱土分配模型和模數選定需相容，不能把石料模數直接當整片地盤模數。假設平均新增q=100kPa、改良層H=6m、有效拘束模數M=15000kPa，s=qH/M=0.040m；未含下層與次壓密。若主要軟層延伸到柱底以下，表層改善仍不能消除整體沉陷；將柱材高模數套用全深度，會使估算過小並誤判鄰接構造的差異位移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「複合地盤壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Settlement depends on composite stiffness and untreated deeper layers. A one-dimensional estimate applies within a specified stress range; load sharing and modulus must agree, rather than substituting aggregate modulus for the entire ground. For mean added q=100kPa, H=6m and effective constrained modulus M=15000kPa, s=qH/M=0.040m, excluding deeper layers and secondary compression. Soft soil below column toes can continue dominating settlement despite surface improvement. Extending aggregate stiffness through the full profile produces an unrealistically small estimate and misjudges differential movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Composite ground compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均新增q=100kPa、改良層H=6m、有效拘束模數M=15000kPa，s=qH/M=0.040m；未含下層與次壓密。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean added q=100kPa, H=6m and effective constrained modulus M=15000kPa, s=qH/M=0.040m, excluding deeper layers and secondary compression.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要複合地盤壓縮符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「複合地盤壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 若主要軟層延伸到柱底以下，表層改善仍不能消除整體沉陷；將柱材高模數套用全深度，會使估算過小並誤判鄰接構造的差異位移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水時間尺度」與「柱端壓力尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drainage time scale" and "Column toe pressure scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水時間尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drainage time scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水時間尺度」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drainage time scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水能否跟上載重歷程需要比較時間尺度，不只比較滲透係數大小。擴散估算用於提出問題，實際徑向幾何、塗抹區及非線性都可能改變消散時間。假設特徵路徑L=1m、擴散係數c=0.05m²/s，t≈L²/c=20s；只是量級，不證明地震期間已充分排水。若把慢速試驗的排水改善直接套到短暫地震，孔壓可能來不及消散；高透水材料存在不代表土中水能及時進入柱體，排水效益會被高估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水時間尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Whether drainage keeps pace with loading requires comparing timescales, not permeability alone. A diffusion estimate frames the question; radial geometry, smear and nonlinearity can substantially change dissipation. For characteristic L=1m and diffusion coefficient c=0.05m²/s, t≈L²/c=20s. This scale does not establish adequate drainage during an earthquake. Transferring drainage benefits from a slow test to a brief earthquake can overstate dissipation. Permeable aggregate does not ensure pore water can enter the column quickly enough during shaking. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drainage time scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設特徵路徑L=1m、擴散係數c=0.05m²/s，t≈L²/c=20s；只是量級，不證明地震期間已充分排水。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For characteristic L=1m and diffusion coefficient c=0.05m²/s, t≈L²/c=20s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要排水時間尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for drainage time scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水時間尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drainage time scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水時間尺度
knowledge.text: 排水能否跟上載重歷程需要比較時間尺度，不只比較滲透係數大小。擴散估算用於提出問題，實際徑向幾何、塗抹區及非線性都可能改變消散時間。
knowledge.textEn: Whether drainage keeps pace with loading requires comparing timescales, not permeability alone. A diffusion estimate frames the question; radial geometry, smear and nonlinearity can substantially change dissipation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要排水時間尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for drainage time scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水時間尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drainage time scale" is correct?
options: 只要排水時間尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
排水能否跟上載重歷程需要比較時間尺度，不只比較滲透係數大小。
只要柱端壓力尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for drainage time scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Whether drainage keeps pace with loading requires comparing timescales, not permeability alone.
A nominal result for column toe pressure scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 排水能否跟上載重歷程需要比較時間尺度，不只比較滲透係數大小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Whether drainage keeps pace with loading requires comparing timescales, not permeability alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水時間尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drainage time scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水時間尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drainage time scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設特徵路徑L=1m、擴散係數c=0.05m²/s，t≈L²/c=20s；只是量級，不證明地震期間已充分排水。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For characteristic L=1m and diffusion coefficient c=0.05m²/s, t≈L²/c=20s. This scale does not establish adequate drainage during an earthquake. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實測孔壓消散曲線校準係數及邊界，再和設計載重持續時間比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate coefficients and boundaries with observed dissipation, then compare with design loading duration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設特徵路徑L=1m、擴散係數c=0.05m²/s，t≈L²/c=20s；只是量級，不證明地震期間已充分排水。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For characteristic L=1m and diffusion coefficient c=0.05m²/s, t≈L²/c=20s. This scale does not establish adequate drainage during an earthquake.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「排水時間尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drainage time scale", which statement holds?
options: 只要排水堵塞後孔壓符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要粒料側向拘束符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設特徵路徑L=1m、擴散係數c=0.05m²/s，t≈L²/c=20s；只是量級，不證明地震期間已充分排水。
optionsEn: A nominal result for pressure after drain blockage removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for aggregate lateral confinement removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For characteristic L=1m and diffusion coefficient c=0.05m²/s, t≈L²/c=20s.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設特徵路徑L=1m、擴散係數c=0.05m²/s，t≈L²/c=20s；只是量級，不證明地震期間已充分排水。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For characteristic L=1m and diffusion coefficient c=0.05m²/s, t≈L²/c=20s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.titleEn: Drainage time scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水時間尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drainage time scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實測孔壓消散曲線校準係數及邊界，再和設計載重持續時間比較。對快速循環荷載保留瞬態分析，由岩土工程師確認排水效益是否可納入設計。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把慢速試驗的排水改善直接套到短暫地震，孔壓可能來不及消散；高透水材料存在不代表土中水能及時進入柱體，排水效益會被高估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate coefficients and boundaries with observed dissipation, then compare with design loading duration. Rapid cyclic loading needs transient assessment before a geotechnical engineer credits a drainage benefit. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Transferring drainage benefits from a slow test to a brief earthquake can overstate dissipation. Permeable aggregate does not ensure pore water can enter the column quickly enough during shaking. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over drainage time scale, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Calibrate coefficients and boundaries with observed dissipation, then compare with design loading duration. Rapid cyclic loading needs transient assessment before a geotechnical engineer credits a drainage benefit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把慢速試驗的排水改善直接套到短暫地震，孔壓可能來不及消散；高透水材料存在不代表土中水能及時進入柱體，排水效益會被高估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Transferring drainage benefits from a slow test to a brief earthquake can overstate dissipation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 柱端壓力尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Column toe pressure scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「柱端壓力尺度」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Column toe pressure scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 柱端荷載和側向傳遞共同決定底部應力，不能假設所有荷載都傳至硬層。端面平均壓力只是一個局部需求量，若柱端坐落軟土，需考慮刺入及下部壓縮。假設抵達柱端P=300kN、D=0.8m，qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa，約597kPa；P不是整根柱頂載重的必然值。薄硬層下仍有軟土時可發生穿刺與整體下沉，柱端壓力再低也不代表安全；錯把短暫施工阻力當成持力層，會使終孔深度缺乏根據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「柱端壓力尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Toe load and side transfer govern base stress; not all load automatically reaches a hard stratum. Mean toe pressure is a local demand, and a toe in soft soil requires checks for punching and underlying compression. For toe load P=300kN and D=0.8m, qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa, about597kPa. Toe load need not equal the column-head load. A thin hard lens over soft soil can punch through and settle as a system. Misreading temporary installation resistance as a bearing layer leaves the chosen termination depth unsupported. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Column toe pressure scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設抵達柱端P=300kN、D=0.8m，qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa，約597kPa；P不是整根柱頂載重的必然值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For toe load P=300kN and D=0.8m, qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa, about597kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要柱端壓力尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for column toe pressure scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「柱端壓力尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Column toe pressure scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 柱端壓力尺度

knowledge.textEn: Toe load and side transfer govern base stress; not all load automatically reaches a hard stratum. Mean toe pressure is a local demand, and a toe in soft soil requires checks for punching and underlying compression.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for column toe pressure scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「柱端壓力尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

柱端荷載和側向傳遞共同決定底部應力，不能假設所有荷載都傳至硬層。

A nominal result for edge and interior columns removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設抵達柱端P=300kN、D=0.8m，qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa，約597kPa；P不是整根柱頂載重的必然值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

以地層及施工深度確認柱端位置，將荷載傳遞分析和分層沉陷比較。
只要成柱材料體積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Confirm toe location from stratigraphy and installation depth, comparing transfer analysis with layer movement.
A nominal result for column material volume removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 以地層及施工深度確認柱端位置，將荷載傳遞分析和分層沉陷比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm toe location from stratigraphy and installation depth, comparing transfer analysis with layer movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 柱端壓力尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Column toe pressure scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「柱端壓力尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Column toe pressure scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 薄硬層下仍有軟土時可發生穿刺與整體下沉，柱端壓力再低也不代表安全；錯把短暫施工阻力當成持力層，會使終孔深度缺乏根據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A thin hard lens over soft soil can punch through and settle as a system. Misreading temporary installation resistance as a bearing layer leaves the chosen termination depth unsupported. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄硬層下仍有軟土時可發生穿刺與整體下沉，柱端壓力再低也不代表安全；錯把短暫施工阻力當成持力層，會使終孔深度缺乏根據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Misreading temporary installation resistance as a bearing layer leaves the chosen termination depth unsupported.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要柱端壓力尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for column toe pressure scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 薄硬層下仍有軟土時可發生穿刺與整體下沉，柱端壓力再低也不代表安全；錯把短暫施工阻力當成持力層，會使終孔深度缺乏根據。
knowledge.textEn: A thin hard lens over soft soil can punch through and settle as a system. Misreading temporary installation resistance as a bearing layer leaves the chosen termination depth unsupported.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「柱端壓力尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Column toe pressure scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要邊緣柱與內柱符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
薄硬層下仍有軟土時可發生穿刺與整體下沉，柱端壓力再低也不代表安全；錯把短暫施工阻力當成持力層，會使終孔深度缺乏根據。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for edge and interior columns removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A thin hard lens over soft soil can punch through and settle as a system.
quiz.explanation: 薄硬層下仍有軟土時可發生穿刺與整體下沉，柱端壓力再低也不代表安全；錯把短暫施工阻力當成持力層，會使終孔深度缺乏根據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A thin hard lens over soft soil can punch through and settle as a system. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「邊緣柱與內柱」與「排水堵塞後孔壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Edge and interior columns" and "Pressure after drain blockage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 邊緣柱與內柱：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Edge and interior columns: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「邊緣柱與內柱」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Edge and interior columns” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 邊緣柱的拘束、荷載分配及排水邊界和內柱不同，不應一律用單元對稱模型。試驗結果比較要說明位置及載重範圍，避免把邊界效應誤認為施工品質差。假設可比較沉陷下邊柱載重Pedge=240kN、內柱Pinner=300kN，比值=0.80；這是試驗比較，不是通用邊柱折減係數。邊柱外側缺乏拘束可能先鼓脹，若只驗中央柱便會漏掉控制位置；外圍施工障礙又可降低置換率，兩種效應疊加會增加基礎角落沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「邊緣柱與內柱」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Edge columns differ in confinement, load sharing and drainage from interior columns, limiting symmetric-cell assumptions. Comparisons need position and loading extent so boundary effects are not automatically labelled poor workmanship. At comparable settlement, hypothetical edge load240kN and interior load300kN give a ratio0.80. This is a test comparison, not a universal edge reduction factor. An edge column can bulge first where restraint is missing. Testing only the centre misses that condition, while perimeter obstructions reduce replacement and compound settlement near foundation corners. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Edge and interior columns” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較沉陷下邊柱載重Pedge=240kN、內柱Pinner=300kN，比值=0.80；這是試驗比較，不是通用邊柱折減係數。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At comparable settlement, hypothetical edge load240kN and interior load300kN give a ratio0.80.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要邊緣柱與內柱符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for edge and interior columns removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「邊緣柱與內柱」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Edge and interior columns”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 邊緣柱與內柱
knowledge.text: 邊緣柱的拘束、荷載分配及排水邊界和內柱不同，不應一律用單元對稱模型。試驗結果比較要說明位置及載重範圍，避免把邊界效應誤認為施工品質差。
knowledge.textEn: Edge columns differ in confinement, load sharing and drainage from interior columns, limiting symmetric-cell assumptions. Comparisons need position and loading extent so boundary effects are not automatically labelled poor workmanship.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要邊緣柱與內柱符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for edge and interior columns removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「邊緣柱與內柱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Edge and interior columns" is correct?
options: 邊緣柱的拘束、荷載分配及排水邊界和內柱不同，不應一律用單元對稱模型。
只要邊緣柱與內柱符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要排水堵塞後孔壓符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Edge columns differ in confinement, load sharing and drainage from interior columns, limiting symmetric-cell assumptions.
A nominal result for edge and interior columns removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for pressure after drain blockage removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 邊緣柱的拘束、荷載分配及排水邊界和內柱不同，不應一律用單元對稱模型。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Edge columns differ in confinement, load sharing and drainage from interior columns, limiting symmetric-cell assumptions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 邊緣柱與內柱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Edge and interior columns: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊緣柱與內柱」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Edge and interior columns” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較沉陷下邊柱載重Pedge=240kN、內柱Pinner=300kN，比值=0.80；這是試驗比較，不是通用邊柱折減係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At comparable settlement, hypothetical edge load240kN and interior load300kN give a ratio0.80. This is a test comparison, not a universal edge reduction factor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在試區保留邊緣與內部位置的載重及位移資料，核對周圍土與墊層連續性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain edge and interior load-movement records, checking surrounding soil and mat continuity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較沉陷下邊柱載重Pedge=240kN、內柱Pinner=300kN，比值=0.80；這是試驗比較，不是通用邊柱折減係數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At comparable settlement, hypothetical edge load240kN and interior load300kN give a ratio0.80. This is a test comparison, not a universal edge reduction factor.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「邊緣柱與內柱」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Edge and interior columns", which statement holds?
options: 只要粒料側向拘束符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較沉陷下邊柱載重Pedge=240kN、內柱Pinner=300kN，比值=0.80；這是試驗比較，不是通用邊柱折減係數。
只要柱體排水通量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for aggregate lateral confinement removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At comparable settlement, hypothetical edge load240kN and interior load300kN give a ratio0.80.
A nominal result for column drainage flow removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較沉陷下邊柱載重Pedge=240kN、內柱Pinner=300kN，比值=0.80；這是試驗比較，不是通用邊柱折減係數。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At comparable settlement, hypothetical edge load240kN and interior load300kN give a ratio0.80. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 邊緣柱與內柱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Edge and interior columns: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「邊緣柱與內柱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Edge and interior columns” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在試區保留邊緣與內部位置的載重及位移資料，核對周圍土與墊層連續性。由設計者評估實際基礎邊界，不把單一位置試驗代表全場每一根柱。同時排除以下干擾原因：邊柱外側缺乏拘束可能先鼓脹，若只驗中央柱便會漏掉控制位置；外圍施工障礙又可降低置換率，兩種效應疊加會增加基礎角落沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain edge and interior load-movement records, checking surrounding soil and mat continuity. The designer evaluates real foundation boundaries rather than using one tested location to represent all columns. Also rule out the following competing explanation: An edge column can bulge first where restraint is missing. Testing only the centre misses that condition, while perimeter obstructions reduce replacement and compound settlement near foundation corners. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接邊緣柱與內柱時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。在試區保留邊緣與內部位置的載重及位移資料，核對周圍土與墊層連續性。由設計者評估實際基礎邊界，不把單一位置試驗代表全場每一根柱。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over edge and interior columns, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Retain edge and interior load-movement records, checking surrounding soil and mat continuity. The designer evaluates real foundation boundaries rather than using one tested location to represent all columns.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：邊柱外側缺乏拘束可能先鼓脹，若只驗中央柱便會漏掉控制位置；外圍施工障礙又可降低置換率，兩種效應疊加會增加基礎角落沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An edge column can bulge first where restraint is missing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在試區保留邊緣與內部位置的載重及位移資料，核對周圍土與墊層連續性。由設計者評估實際基礎邊界，不把單一位置試驗代表全場每一根柱。同時排除以下干擾原因：邊柱外側缺乏拘束可能先鼓脹，若只驗中央柱便會漏掉控制位置；外圍施工障礙又可降低置換率，兩種效應疊加會增加基礎角落沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Retain edge and interior load-movement records, checking surrounding soil and mat continuity. The designer evaluates real foundation boundaries rather than using one tested location to represent all columns. Also rule out the following competing explanation: An edge column can bulge first where restraint is missing. Testing only the centre misses that condition, while perimeter obstructions reduce replacement and compound settlement near foundation corners.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接邊緣柱與內柱時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。在試區保留邊緣與內部位置的載重及位移資料，核對周圍土與墊層連續性。由設計者評估實際基礎邊界，不把單一位置試驗代表全場每一根柱。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over edge and interior columns, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Retain edge and interior load-movement records, checking surrounding soil and mat continuity. The designer evaluates real foundation boundaries rather than using one tested location to represent all columns.

quiz.question: 要驗證「邊緣柱與內柱」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Edge and interior columns"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要複合地盤壓縮符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
在試區保留邊緣與內部位置的載重及位移資料，核對周圍土與墊層連續性。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A nominal result for composite ground compression removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Retain edge and interior load-movement records, checking surrounding soil and mat continuity.
quiz.explanation: 在試區保留邊緣與內部位置的載重及位移資料，核對周圍土與墊層連續性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain edge and interior load-movement records, checking surrounding soil and mat continuity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 邊緣柱與內柱：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Edge and interior columns: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「邊緣柱與內柱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Edge and interior columns” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.instruction: 長期排水維護決定柱體作為水力通路是否仍有效，出口淤塞可使水頭回升。孔壓增量應和荷載及有效應力一起評估，不能把碎石存在視為永遠暢通。假設局部排水水頭增加Δh=2m，Δu=γwΔh=9.81×2=19.62kPa，約19.6kPa；未改變總應力時有效應力同量下降。若排水失效後仍沿用施工期的有效應力與模數，可能高估服務能力；長期水位回升與附加載重一起出現時，沉陷或局部鼓脹會加速發展。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水堵塞後孔壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long-term outlet maintenance determines whether columns remain effective hydraulic paths. Blockage can raise head, and the resulting pressure change must be assessed with loading and effective stress rather than assuming permanent drainage. For a local head increase Δh=2m, Δu=9.81×2=19.62kPa, about19.6kPa. Effective stress falls by the same amount if total stress is unchanged. Retaining construction-stage effective stress and stiffness after drainage loss overestimates service performance. Water-level recovery combined with added load can accelerate settlement or local column bulging. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure after drain blockage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a local head increase Δh=2m, Δu=9.81×2=19.62kPa, about19.6kPa.
