steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若排水失效後仍沿用施工期的有效應力與模數，可能高估服務能力；長期水位回升與附加載重一起出現時，沉陷或局部鼓脹會加速發展。
knowledge.textEn: Retaining construction-stage effective stress and stiffness after drainage loss overestimates service performance. Water-level recovery combined with added load can accelerate settlement or local column bulging.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「排水堵塞後孔壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure after drain blockage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若排水失效後仍沿用施工期的有效應力與模數，可能高估服務能力；長期水位回升與附加載重一起出現時，沉陷或局部鼓脹會加速發展。
只要方格置換面積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Retaining construction-stage effective stress and stiffness after drainage loss overestimates service performance.
A nominal result for square grid replacement area removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若排水失效後仍沿用施工期的有效應力與模數，可能高估服務能力；長期水位回升與附加載重一起出現時，沉陷或局部鼓脹會加速發展。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Retaining construction-stage effective stress and stiffness after drainage loss overestimates service performance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 液化地盤評估與改善
summary: 本課聚焦區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。假設總應力150kPa固定，孔壓由100增加10%至110kPa，有效應力由50降至40kPa，降低20%；這展示差值的敏感度，不表示液化機率增加20%，亦未單獨完成抗力與需求評估。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination. At fixed total stress150kPa, increasing assumed pore pressure from100 to110kPa by10% reduces effective stress from50 to40kPa, or20%. This illustrates difference sensitivity, not a20% rise in liquefaction probability or a complete demand-resistance evaluation. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「飽和土有效應力」與「循環應力需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective stress in saturated soil" and "Cyclic stress demand": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 飽和土有效應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective stress in saturated soil: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「飽和土有效應力」如何影響液化地盤評估與改善的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective stress in saturated soil” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Liquefaction assessment and mitigation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土骨架承擔的有效應力等於總應力扣除孔壓，地震快速循環可改變孔壓而不立即改變上覆重量。初始狀態必須由地層、地下水與應力歷史共同建立。假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「飽和土有效應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Soil-skeleton effective stress is total stress minus pressure. Rapid earthquake cycling can change pressure without immediately changing overburden weight, so initial conditions require stratigraphy, groundwater and stress history. At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination. Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective stress in saturated soil” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要飽和土有效應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for effective stress in saturated soil removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「飽和土有效應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective stress in saturated soil”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 飽和土有效應力
knowledge.text: 土骨架承擔的有效應力等於總應力扣除孔壓，地震快速循環可改變孔壓而不立即改變上覆重量。初始狀態必須由地層、地下水與應力歷史共同建立。
knowledge.textEn: Soil-skeleton effective stress is total stress minus pressure. Rapid earthquake cycling can change pressure without immediately changing overburden weight, so initial conditions require stratigraphy, groundwater and stress history.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要飽和土有效應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for effective stress in saturated soil removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「飽和土有效應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective stress in saturated soil" is correct?
options: 只要飽和土有效應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
土骨架承擔的有效應力等於總應力扣除孔壓，地震快速循環可改變孔壓而不立即改變上覆重量。
只要循環應力需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for effective stress in saturated soil removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Soil-skeleton effective stress is total stress minus pressure.
A nominal result for cyclic stress demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 土骨架承擔的有效應力等於總應力扣除孔壓，地震快速循環可改變孔壓而不立即改變上覆重量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Soil-skeleton effective stress is total stress minus pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 飽和土有效應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective stress in saturated soil: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「飽和土有效應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective stress in saturated soil” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「飽和土有效應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective stress in saturated soil", which statement holds?
options: 只要超額孔壓接近極限符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要側向擴展應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。
optionsEn: A nominal result for high excess pressure ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for lateral spreading strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 飽和土有效應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective stress in saturated soil: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「飽和土有效應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective stress in saturated soil” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。季節或承壓含水層差異須列成情境，不能用單次乾季讀值代表地震設計水位。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Seasonal and confined-aquifer differences need scenarios rather than one dry-season reading representing design groundwater. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接飽和土有效應力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。季節或承壓含水層差異須列成情境，不能用單次乾季讀值代表地震設計水位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over effective stress in saturated soil, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Seasonal and confined-aquifer differences need scenarios rather than one dry-season reading representing design groundwater.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。季節或承壓含水層差異須列成情境，不能用單次乾季讀值代表地震設計水位。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Seasonal and confined-aquifer differences need scenarios rather than one dry-season reading representing design groundwater. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接飽和土有效應力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。季節或承壓含水層差異須列成情境，不能用單次乾季讀值代表地震設計水位。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over effective stress in saturated soil, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Seasonal and confined-aquifer differences need scenarios rather than one dry-season reading representing design groundwater.

quiz.question: 要驗證「飽和土有效應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective stress in saturated soil"?
options: 以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要樁身震後負摩阻符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for post event pile downdrag removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 飽和土有效應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective stress in saturated soil: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「飽和土有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective stress in saturated soil” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要飽和土有效應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for effective stress in saturated soil removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「飽和土有效應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要循環應力需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections.
A nominal result for cyclic stress demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 循環應力需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cyclic stress demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「循環應力需求」如何影響液化地盤評估與改善的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cyclic stress demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Liquefaction assessment and mitigation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 簡化循環應力比把地表加速度、應力比與深度折減整合，用於相容方法內的觸發分析。它不是完整時域土體反應，複雜場址與重要構造可能需要更深入分析。假設amax/g=0.30、σv/σ′v=2、rd=0.90，CSR=0.65(amax/g)(σv/σ′v)rd=0.351；各因子都採用無因次比值。將基岩加速度直接當地表值或把峰值加速度單位錯用為g，會系統性改變需求；忽略場址放大時，錯誤不會因資料表計算精確而消失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環應力需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A simplified cyclic stress ratio combines acceleration, stress ratio and depth reduction within a compatible triggering method. It is not a full time-history soil response, and complex sites or important assets may need more detailed analysis. For amax/g=0.30, σv/σ′v=2 and rd=0.90, CSR=0.65×0.30×2×0.90=0.351; all factors are dimensionless. Substituting bedrock motion for surface motion or confusing acceleration units with g changes demand systematically. Spreadsheet precision cannot correct omitted site amplification or an inconsistent input definition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cyclic stress demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For amax/g=0.30, σv/σ′v=2 and rd=0.90, CSR=0.65×0.30×2×0.90=0.351; all factors are dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要循環應力需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「循環應力需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cyclic stress demand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 循環應力需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cyclic stress demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「循環應力需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設amax/g=0.30、σv/σ′v=2、rd=0.90，CSR=0.65(amax/g)(σv/σ′v)rd=0.351；各因子都採用無因次比值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For amax/g=0.30, σv/σ′v=2 and rd=0.90, CSR=0.65×0.30×2×0.90=0.351; all factors are dimensionless. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對地震輸入的基準位置、加速度定義及折減係數來源，將採用的震級與持續時間處理方式寫清楚。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check motion reference location, acceleration definition and reduction-factor source, documenting magnitude and duration treatment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設amax/g=0.30、σv/σ′v=2、rd=0.90，CSR=0.65(amax/g)(σv/σ′v)rd=0.351；各因子都採用無因次比值。

steps.title: 循環應力需求：試驗與驗證

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Spreadsheet precision cannot correct omitted site amplification or an inconsistent input definition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要循環應力需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將基岩加速度直接當地表值或把峰值加速度單位錯用為g，會系統性改變需求；忽略場址放大時，錯誤不會因資料表計算精確而消失。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting bedrock motion for surface motion or confusing acceleration units with g changes demand systematically. Spreadsheet precision cannot correct omitted site amplification or an inconsistent input definition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「循環應力需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要觸發抗力比值符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
將基岩加速度直接當地表值或把峰值加速度單位錯用為g，會系統性改變需求；忽略場址放大時，錯誤不會因資料表計算精確而消失。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for triggering resistance ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Substituting bedrock motion for surface motion or confusing acceleration units with g changes demand systematically.
quiz.explanation: 將基岩加速度直接當地表值或把峰值加速度單位錯用為g，會系統性改變需求；忽略場址放大時，錯誤不會因資料表計算精確而消失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting bedrock motion for surface motion or confusing acceleration units with g changes demand systematically. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「觸發抗力比值」與「超額孔壓接近極限」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Triggering resistance ratio" and "High excess pressure ratio": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 觸發抗力比值：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Triggering resistance ratio: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「觸發抗力比值」如何影響液化地盤評估與改善的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Triggering resistance ratio” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Liquefaction assessment and mitigation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 循環抗力與需求必須處於同一震級、應力及修正基準，才可相除成觸發指標。比值超過一仍不直接證明永久位移、局部薄層及整體系統皆可接受。假設已相容修正CRR=0.40、CSR=0.351，FS=CRR/CSR=1.14；數值是教學比值，不作現地驗收門檻。把不同文獻的修正係數任意混用，可能在無察覺下高估抗力；平均比值大於一也可能掩蓋連續薄弱層，造成側移或地盤支承能力突變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「觸發抗力比值」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cyclic resistance and demand must share magnitude, stress and correction references before division. A ratio above unity does not itself establish acceptable permanent deformation, thin-layer response or system performance. With compatibly corrected CRR=0.40 and CSR=0.351, FS=1.14. This teaching ratio is not a field acceptance threshold. Mixing corrections from incompatible methods can silently overstate resistance. An average ratio above unity may conceal a continuous weak layer responsible for lateral movement or a sharp loss of support. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Triggering resistance ratio” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已相容修正CRR=0.40、CSR=0.351，FS=CRR/CSR=1.14；數值是教學比值，不作現地驗收門檻。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With compatibly corrected CRR=0.40 and CSR=0.351, FS=1.14.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要觸發抗力比值符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for triggering resistance ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「觸發抗力比值」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Triggering resistance ratio”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 觸發抗力比值
knowledge.text: 循環抗力與需求必須處於同一震級、應力及修正基準，才可相除成觸發指標。比值超過一仍不直接證明永久位移、局部薄層及整體系統皆可接受。
knowledge.textEn: Cyclic resistance and demand must share magnitude, stress and correction references before division. A ratio above unity does not itself establish acceptable permanent deformation, thin-layer response or system performance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要觸發抗力比值符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for triggering resistance ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「觸發抗力比值」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Triggering resistance ratio" is correct?
options: 循環抗力與需求必須處於同一震級、應力及修正基準，才可相除成觸發指標。
只要觸發抗力比值符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要超額孔壓接近極限符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Cyclic resistance and demand must share magnitude, stress and correction references before division.
A nominal result for triggering resistance ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for high excess pressure ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 循環抗力與需求必須處於同一震級、應力及修正基準，才可相除成觸發指標。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cyclic resistance and demand must share magnitude, stress and correction references before division. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 觸發抗力比值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Triggering resistance ratio: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「觸發抗力比值」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Triggering resistance ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已相容修正CRR=0.40、CSR=0.351，FS=CRR/CSR=1.14；數值是教學比值，不作現地驗收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With compatibly corrected CRR=0.40 and CSR=0.351, FS=1.14. This teaching ratio is not a field acceptance threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保存貫入試驗原始資料與每項修正，逐層檢查細料、應力及震級基準是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain penetration data and every correction, checking fines, stress and magnitude conventions by layer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已相容修正CRR=0.40、CSR=0.351，FS=CRR/CSR=1.14；數值是教學比值，不作現地驗收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With compatibly corrected CRR=0.40 and CSR=0.351, FS=1.14. This teaching ratio is not a field acceptance threshold.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「觸發抗力比值」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Triggering resistance ratio", which statement holds?
options: 只要側向擴展應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已相容修正CRR=0.40、CSR=0.351，FS=CRR/CSR=1.14；數值是教學比值，不作現地驗收門檻。
只要樁身震後負摩阻符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for lateral spreading strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With compatibly corrected CRR=0.40 and CSR=0.351, FS=1.14.
A nominal result for post event pile downdrag removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With compatibly corrected CRR=0.40 and CSR=0.351, FS=1.14. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 觸發抗力比值：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Triggering resistance ratio: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「觸發抗力比值」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Triggering resistance ratio” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保存貫入試驗原始資料與每項修正，逐層檢查細料、應力及震級基準是否一致。將抗力與需求的不確定性一併審查，由岩土工程師訂定所需可靠度。同時排除以下干擾原因：把不同文獻的修正係數任意混用，可能在無察覺下高估抗力；平均比值大於一也可能掩蓋連續薄弱層，造成側移或地盤支承能力突變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain penetration data and every correction, checking fines, stress and magnitude conventions by layer. Review demand and resistance uncertainty together, with the geotechnical engineer defining the required reliability. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Mixing corrections from incompatible methods can silently overstate resistance. An average ratio above unity may conceal a continuous weak layer responsible for lateral movement or a sharp loss of support. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接觸發抗力比值時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。保存貫入試驗原始資料與每項修正，逐層檢查細料、應力及震級基準是否一致。將抗力與需求的不確定性一併審查，由岩土工程師訂定所需可靠度。

Retain penetration data and every correction, checking fines, stress and magnitude conventions by layer. Review demand and resistance uncertainty together, with the geotechnical engineer defining the required reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把不同文獻的修正係數任意混用，可能在無察覺下高估抗力；平均比值大於一也可能掩蓋連續薄弱層，造成側移或地盤支承能力突變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing corrections from incompatible methods can silently overstate resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 超額孔壓接近極限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: High excess pressure ratio: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「超額孔壓接近極限」如何影響液化地盤評估與改善的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High excess pressure ratio” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Liquefaction assessment and mitigation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高超額孔壓比代表初始有效應力大幅耗減，但實際土體應力路徑及循環剪應變仍重要。不能把一個感測點的比值當整場地同時完全液化的證據。假設初始σ′v0=100kPa、循環增加Δu=95kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.95；若總應力近似固定，殘餘有效應力約5kPa。感測器量程不足可把更大的反應截成固定值，或漏氣使峰值偏低；只看單點最大比值而不查波形，會錯判液化範圍與後續變形需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「超額孔壓接近極限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A high excess-pressure ratio indicates substantial loss of initial effective stress, while stress path and cyclic strain remain important. One sensor cannot establish simultaneous full liquefaction across a site. For initial σ′v0=100kPa and cyclic Δu=95kPa, ru=0.95. Approximately fixed total stress leaves about5kPa effective stress. Insufficient range can clip the response while air leakage can suppress peaks. A single maximum without waveform review can misrepresent the extent of liquefaction and subsequent deformation demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “High excess pressure ratio” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始σ′v0=100kPa、循環增加Δu=95kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.95；若總應力近似固定，殘餘有效應力約5kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial σ′v0=100kPa and cyclic Δu=95kPa, ru=0.95.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要超額孔壓接近極限符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「超額孔壓接近極限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 超額孔壓接近極限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High excess pressure ratio: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超額孔壓接近極限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High excess pressure ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始σ′v0=100kPa、循環增加Δu=95kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.95；若總應力近似固定，殘餘有效應力約5kPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial σ′v0=100kPa and cyclic Δu=95kPa, ru=0.95. Approximately fixed total stress leaves about5kPa effective stress. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測孔壓須同步加速度與變形，檢查飽和、零點、動態範圍及位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize pressure with acceleration and movement, checking saturation, zero, range and location.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 超額孔壓接近極限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: High excess pressure ratio: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「超額孔壓接近極限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High excess pressure ratio” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測孔壓須同步加速度與變形，檢查飽和、零點、動態範圍及位置。比較多深度反應，區別儀器截頂、局部噴砂通道與可代表土層的行為。同時排除以下干擾原因：感測器量程不足可把更大的反應截成固定值，或漏氣使峰值偏低；只看單點最大比值而不查波形，會錯判液化範圍與後續變形需求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize pressure with acceleration and movement, checking saturation, zero, range and location. Compare depths to distinguish clipping, local vent paths and representative layer response. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Insufficient range can clip the response while air leakage can suppress peaks. A single maximum without waveform review can misrepresent the extent of liquefaction and subsequent deformation demand. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接超額孔壓接近極限時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。量測孔壓須同步加速度與變形，檢查飽和、零點、動態範圍及位置。比較多深度反應，區別儀器截頂、局部噴砂通道與可代表土層的行為。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over high excess pressure ratio, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Synchronize pressure with acceleration and movement, checking saturation, zero, range and location. Compare depths to distinguish clipping, local vent paths and representative layer response.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測器量程不足可把更大的反應截成固定值，或漏氣使峰值偏低；只看單點最大比值而不查波形，會錯判液化範圍與後續變形需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient range can clip the response while air leakage can suppress peaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 震後排水與再密實造成體積變形，沉陷需按層厚與體積應變積分。估計應變應來自合適方法，不能用觸發安全比值直接線性換算地表下沉。假設兩層厚H1=3m、H2=4m，震後體積應變εv1=0.02、εv2=0.01，S=Σ εviHi=0.02×3+0.01×4=0.10m。遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層震後沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drainage and reconsolidation after shaking cause volumetric change, requiring integration over layer thickness. Suitable methods establish strains; a triggering factor cannot simply be converted linearly into surface settlement. For H1=3m, H2=4m, εv1=0.02 and εv2=0.01, S=Σ εviHi=0.10m, assuming predominantly vertical, one-dimensional reconsolidation of both layers. Omitting a thin high-strain lens understates settlement. Spatial variation can exceed joint movement limits even with a moderate site average, so average subsidence alone cannot establish serviceability. knowledge.title: 分層震後沉陷
knowledge.text: 震後排水與再密實造成體積變形，沉陷需按層厚與體積應變積分。估計應變應來自合適方法，不能用觸發安全比值直接線性換算地表下沉。
knowledge.textEn: Drainage and reconsolidation after shaking cause volumetric change, requiring integration over layer thickness. Suitable methods establish strains; a triggering factor cannot simply be converted linearly into surface settlement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for layered post shaking settlement removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分層震後沉陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Layered post shaking settlement" is correct?
options: 只要分層震後沉陷符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要側向擴展應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
震後排水與再密實造成體積變形，沉陷需按層厚與體積應變積分。
optionsEn: A nominal result for layered post shaking settlement removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for lateral spreading strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Drainage and reconsolidation after shaking cause volumetric change, requiring integration over layer thickness.
quiz.explanation: 震後排水與再密實造成體積變形，沉陷需按層厚與體積應變積分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drainage and reconsolidation after shaking cause volumetric change, requiring integration over layer thickness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分層震後沉陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Layered post shaking settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分層震後沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Layered post shaking settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩層厚H1=3m、H2=4m，震後體積應變εv1=0.02、εv2=0.01，S=Σ εviHi=0.02×3+0.01×4=0.10m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For H1=3m, H2=4m, εv1=0.02 and εv2=0.01, S=Σ εviHi=0.10m, assuming predominantly vertical, one-dimensional reconsolidation of both layers. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較震前後水準測量、地下沉陷及地層分布，辨別側移或基礎轉動造成的表觀沉陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pre- and post-event levels, subsurface settlement and stratigraphy, distinguishing lateral movement or foundation rotation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For H1=3m, H2=4m, εv1=0.02 and εv2=0.01, S=Σ εviHi=0.10m, assuming predominantly vertical, one-dimensional reconsolidation of both layers.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 分層震後沉陷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Layered post shaking settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層震後沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Layered post shaking settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較震前後水準測量、地下沉陷及地層分布，辨別側移或基礎轉動造成的表觀沉陷。將每層應變來源與適用範圍列入計算書，保留不確定區間。同時排除以下干擾原因：遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pre- and post-event levels, subsurface settlement and stratigraphy, distinguishing lateral movement or foundation rotation. Document each layer's strain source, applicable range and uncertainty. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Omitting a thin high-strain lens understates settlement. Spatial variation can exceed joint movement limits even with a moderate site average, so average subsidence alone cannot establish serviceability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接分層震後沉陷時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比較震前後水準測量、地下沉陷及地層分布，辨別側移或基礎轉動造成的表觀沉陷。將每層應變來源與適用範圍列入計算書，保留不確定區間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over layered post shaking settlement, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare pre- and post-event levels, subsurface settlement and stratigraphy, distinguishing lateral movement or foundation rotation. Document each layer's strain source, applicable range and uncertainty.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting a thin high-strain lens understates settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較震前後水準測量、地下沉陷及地層分布，辨別側移或基礎轉動造成的表觀沉陷。將每層應變來源與適用範圍列入計算書，保留不確定區間。同時排除以下干擾原因：遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。
knowledge.textEn: Compare pre- and post-event levels, subsurface settlement and stratigraphy, distinguishing lateral movement or foundation rotation. Document each layer's strain source, applicable range and uncertainty. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Omitting a thin high-strain lens understates settlement. Spatial variation can exceed joint movement limits even with a moderate site average, so average subsidence alone cannot establish serviceability.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接分層震後沉陷時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比較震前後水準測量、地下沉陷及地層分布，辨別側移或基礎轉動造成的表觀沉陷。將每層應變來源與適用範圍列入計算書，保留不確定區間。

Compare pre- and post-event levels, subsurface settlement and stratigraphy, distinguishing lateral movement or foundation rotation. quiz.question: 要驗證「分層震後沉陷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Layered post shaking settlement"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
比較震前後水準測量、地下沉陷及地層分布，辨別側移或基礎轉動造成的表觀沉陷。

steps.title: 分層震後沉陷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Layered post shaking settlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分層震後沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Layered post shaking settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting a thin high-strain lens understates settlement. Spatial variation can exceed joint movement limits even with a moderate site average, so average subsidence alone cannot establish serviceability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Spatial variation can exceed joint movement limits even with a moderate site average, so average subsidence alone cannot establish serviceability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要分層震後沉陷符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for layered post shaking settlement removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting a thin high-strain lens understates settlement. Spatial variation can exceed joint movement limits even with a moderate site average, so average subsidence alone cannot establish serviceability.

quiz.question: 在「分層震後沉陷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要側向擴展應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。

A nominal result for lateral spreading strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.title: 側向擴展應變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral spreading strain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「側向擴展應變」如何影響液化地盤評估與改善的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral spreading strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Liquefaction assessment and mitigation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 液化區鄰近自由面或斜坡可能產生永久側向位移，對埋管及隧道接頭的需求和垂直沉陷不同。平均剪應變只能描述選定帶寬，局部剪切集中還需細化。假設兩側相對永久位移Δ=0.30m、變形帶寬L=5m，γ≈Δ/L=0.06即6%；這不是由震級直接推算的位移。將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側向擴展應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Liquefied ground near a free face or slope can move laterally, imposing demands unlike vertical settlement. Mean shear strain describes a selected band width but does not resolve localized shear concentration. For relative permanent movement Δ=0.30m across L=5m, γ≈0.06, or6%. This assumed movement is not derived directly from earthquake magnitude. Spreading displacement across too long a distance understates local strain and can miss rupture at a narrow band. Absence of obvious sand boils does not exclude damaging deep lateral movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lateral spreading strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩側相對永久位移Δ=0.30m、變形帶寬L=5m，γ≈Δ/L=0.06即6%；這不是由震級直接推算的位移。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For relative permanent movement Δ=0.30m across L=5m, γ≈0.06, or6%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要側向擴展應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for lateral spreading strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「側向擴展應變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lateral spreading strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 側向擴展應變
knowledge.text: 液化區鄰近自由面或斜坡可能產生永久側向位移，對埋管及隧道接頭的需求和垂直沉陷不同。平均剪應變只能描述選定帶寬，局部剪切集中還需細化。
knowledge.textEn: Liquefied ground near a free face or slope can move laterally, imposing demands unlike vertical settlement. Mean shear strain describes a selected band width but does not resolve localized shear concentration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要側向擴展應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for lateral spreading strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「側向擴展應變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lateral spreading strain" is correct?
options: 液化區鄰近自由面或斜坡可能產生永久側向位移，對埋管及隧道接頭的需求和垂直沉陷不同。
只要側向擴展應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要改善抗力增幅符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Liquefied ground near a free face or slope can move laterally, imposing demands unlike vertical settlement.
A nominal result for lateral spreading strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for treatment resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 液化區鄰近自由面或斜坡可能產生永久側向位移，對埋管及隧道接頭的需求和垂直沉陷不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Liquefied ground near a free face or slope can move laterally, imposing demands unlike vertical settlement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 側向擴展應變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral spreading strain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「側向擴展應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral spreading strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩側相對永久位移Δ=0.30m、變形帶寬L=5m，γ≈Δ/L=0.06即6%；這不是由震級直接推算的位移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For relative permanent movement Δ=0.30m across L=5m, γ≈0.06, or6%. This assumed movement is not derived directly from earthquake magnitude. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用地表裂縫、測量與地層調查辨識變形帶，沿管線方向分解相對位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map deformation bands using cracks, surveys and stratigraphy, resolving relative motion along utilities.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩側相對永久位移Δ=0.30m、變形帶寬L=5m，γ≈Δ/L=0.06即6%；這不是由震級直接推算的位移。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For relative permanent movement Δ=0.30m across L=5m, γ≈0.06, or6%. This assumed movement is not derived directly from earthquake magnitude.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「側向擴展應變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lateral spreading strain", which statement holds?
options: 只要改善範圍證據符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩側相對永久位移Δ=0.30m、變形帶寬L=5m，γ≈Δ/L=0.06即6%；這不是由震級直接推算的位移。
只要飽和土有效應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for verified improvement coverage removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For relative permanent movement Δ=0.30m across L=5m, γ≈0.06, or6%.
A nominal result for effective stress in saturated soil removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩側相對永久位移Δ=0.30m、變形帶寬L=5m，γ≈Δ/L=0.06即6%；這不是由震級直接推算的位移。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For relative permanent movement Δ=0.30m across L=5m, γ≈0.06, or6%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 側向擴展應變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral spreading strain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「側向擴展應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lateral spreading strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用地表裂縫、測量與地層調查辨識變形帶，沿管線方向分解相對位移。把接頭、支承及穿越位置納入協調，由地工和結構工程師共同判定需求。同時排除以下干擾原因：將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map deformation bands using cracks, surveys and stratigraphy, resolving relative motion along utilities. Coordinate joints, supports and crossings so geotechnical and structural engineers jointly establish demand. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Spreading displacement across too long a distance understates local strain and can miss rupture at a narrow band. Absence of obvious sand boils does not exclude damaging deep lateral movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接側向擴展應變時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用地表裂縫、測量與地層調查辨識變形帶，沿管線方向分解相對位移。把接頭、支承及穿越位置納入協調，由地工和結構工程師共同判定需求。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over lateral spreading strain, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map deformation bands using cracks, surveys and stratigraphy, resolving relative motion along utilities. Coordinate joints, supports and crossings so geotechnical and structural engineers jointly establish demand.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Spreading displacement across too long a distance understates local strain and can miss rupture at a narrow band. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用地表裂縫、測量與地層調查辨識變形帶，沿管線方向分解相對位移。把接頭、支承及穿越位置納入協調，由地工和結構工程師共同判定需求。同時排除以下干擾原因：將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。
knowledge.textEn: Map deformation bands using cracks, surveys and stratigraphy, resolving relative motion along utilities. Coordinate joints, supports and crossings so geotechnical and structural engineers jointly establish demand. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Spreading displacement across too long a distance understates local strain and can miss rupture at a narrow band. Absence of obvious sand boils does not exclude damaging deep lateral movement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接側向擴展應變時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用地表裂縫、測量與地層調查辨識變形帶，沿管線方向分解相對位移。把接頭、支承及穿越位置納入協調，由地工和結構工程師共同判定需求。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over lateral spreading strain, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map deformation bands using cracks, surveys and stratigraphy, resolving relative motion along utilities. Coordinate joints, supports and crossings so geotechnical and structural engineers jointly establish demand.

quiz.question: 要驗證「側向擴展應變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lateral spreading strain"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要觸發抗力比值符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
用地表裂縫、測量與地層調查辨識變形帶，沿管線方向分解相對位移。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A nominal result for triggering resistance ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Map deformation bands using cracks, surveys and stratigraphy, resolving relative motion along utilities.
quiz.explanation: 用地表裂縫、測量與地層調查辨識變形帶，沿管線方向分解相對位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map deformation bands using cracks, surveys and stratigraphy, resolving relative motion along utilities. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 側向擴展應變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lateral spreading strain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「側向擴展應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lateral spreading strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Spreading displacement across too long a distance understates local strain and can miss rupture at a narrow band. Absence of obvious sand boils does not exclude damaging deep lateral movement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Absence of obvious sand boils does not exclude damaging deep lateral movement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要側向擴展應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for lateral spreading strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。
knowledge.textEn: Spreading displacement across too long a distance understates local strain and can miss rupture at a narrow band. Absence of obvious sand boils does not exclude damaging deep lateral movement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「側向擴展應變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lateral spreading strain" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要改善抗力增幅符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Spreading displacement across too long a distance understates local strain and can miss rupture at a narrow band.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A nominal result for treatment resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Spreading displacement across too long a distance understates local strain and can miss rupture at a narrow band. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「改善抗力增幅」與「樁身震後負摩阻」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Treatment resistance gain" and "Post event pile downdrag": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 改善抗力增幅：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Treatment resistance gain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「改善抗力增幅」如何影響液化地盤評估與改善的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Treatment resistance gain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Liquefaction assessment and mitigation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良前後循環抗力比較應保持相同應力及震級基準，且考慮土層代表性。抗力增幅不是安全係數增幅，除非同時證明需求、修正及載重狀態均相同。假設相容CRRold=0.30、CRRnew=0.45，抗力比0.45/0.30=1.50；只有CSR相同時觸發比值才同比增加。地盤加載可能同時改變有效應力與需求，若只看抗力增加就宣稱風險下降，會漏掉新增結構荷載及水位改變造成的不利效果與空間差異。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「改善抗力增幅」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare cyclic resistance before and after treatment on common stress and magnitude references. Resistance gain is not necessarily a safety-factor gain unless demand, corrections and loading also remain unchanged. For compatible CRRold=0.30 and CRRnew=0.45, resistance gain is1.50. The triggering ratio increases proportionally only if CSR stays unchanged. New loading can change both effective stress and demand. Claiming lower risk from resistance alone overlooks adverse effects of added structure load, changed groundwater and spatial variation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Treatment resistance gain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相容CRRold=0.30、CRRnew=0.45，抗力比0.45/0.30=1.50；只有CSR相同時觸發比值才同比增加。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For compatible CRRold=0.30 and CRRnew=0.45, resistance gain is1.50.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要改善抗力增幅符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for treatment resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「改善抗力增幅」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Treatment resistance gain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 改善抗力增幅
knowledge.text: 改良前後循環抗力比較應保持相同應力及震級基準，且考慮土層代表性。抗力增幅不是安全係數增幅，除非同時證明需求、修正及載重狀態均相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare cyclic resistance before and after treatment on common stress and magnitude references. Resistance gain is not necessarily a safety-factor gain unless demand, corrections and loading also remain unchanged.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要改善抗力增幅符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for treatment resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「改善抗力增幅」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Treatment resistance gain" is correct?
options: 只要改善抗力增幅符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
改良前後循環抗力比較應保持相同應力及震級基準，且考慮土層代表性。
只要樁身震後負摩阻符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for treatment resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Compare cyclic resistance before and after treatment on common stress and magnitude references.
A nominal result for post event pile downdrag removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 改良前後循環抗力比較應保持相同應力及震級基準，且考慮土層代表性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare cyclic resistance before and after treatment on common stress and magnitude references. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 改善抗力增幅：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Treatment resistance gain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「改善抗力增幅」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Treatment resistance gain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相容CRRold=0.30、CRRnew=0.45，抗力比0.45/0.30=1.50；只有CSR相同時觸發比值才同比增加。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For compatible CRRold=0.30 and CRRnew=0.45, resistance gain is1.50. The triggering ratio increases proportionally only if CSR stays unchanged. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：配對施工前後地層與試驗位置，保存修正後抗力剖面和新增載重情境。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Match layers and tests before and after work, retaining corrected profiles and new loading scenarios.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相容CRRold=0.30、CRRnew=0.45，抗力比0.45/0.30=1.50；只有CSR相同時觸發比值才同比增加。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For compatible CRRold=0.30 and CRRnew=0.45, resistance gain is1.50. The triggering ratio increases proportionally only if CSR stays unchanged.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「改善抗力增幅」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Treatment resistance gain", which statement holds?
options: 只要需求敏感度與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要循環應力需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相容CRRold=0.30、CRRnew=0.45，抗力比0.45/0.30=1.50；只有CSR相同時觸發比值才同比增加。
optionsEn: A nominal result for demand sensitivity and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for cyclic stress demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For compatible CRRold=0.30 and CRRnew=0.45, resistance gain is1.50.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相容CRRold=0.30、CRRnew=0.45，抗力比0.45/0.30=1.50；只有CSR相同時觸發比值才同比增加。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For compatible CRRold=0.30 and CRRnew=0.45, resistance gain is1.50. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 改善抗力增幅：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Treatment resistance gain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「改善抗力增幅」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Treatment resistance gain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 配對施工前後地層與試驗位置，保存修正後抗力剖面和新增載重情境。用獨立測試或試區檢查低改良區，避免只選最佳位置代表全區成效。同時排除以下干擾原因：地盤加載可能同時改變有效應力與需求，若只看抗力增加就宣稱風險下降，會漏掉新增結構荷載及水位改變造成的不利效果與空間差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Match layers and tests before and after work, retaining corrected profiles and new loading scenarios. Independently examine low-gain zones rather than presenting the best location as representative of the whole treatment. Also rule out the following competing explanation: New loading can change both effective stress and demand. Claiming lower risk from resistance alone overlooks adverse effects of added structure load, changed groundwater and spatial variation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接改善抗力增幅時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。配對施工前後地層與試驗位置，保存修正後抗力剖面和新增載重情境。用獨立測試或試區檢查低改良區，避免只選最佳位置代表全區成效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over treatment resistance gain, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Match layers and tests before and after work, retaining corrected profiles and new loading scenarios. Independently examine low-gain zones rather than presenting the best location as representative of the whole treatment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：地盤加載可能同時改變有效應力與需求，若只看抗力增加就宣稱風險下降，會漏掉新增結構荷載及水位改變造成的不利效果與空間差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: New loading can change both effective stress and demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Treatment resistance gain"?

量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要超額孔壓接近極限符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for high excess pressure ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Match layers and tests before and after work, retaining corrected profiles and new loading scenarios. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 改善抗力增幅：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Treatment resistance gain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「改善抗力增幅」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Treatment resistance gain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 地盤加載可能同時改變有效應力與需求，若只看抗力增加就宣稱風險下降，會漏掉新增結構荷載及水位改變造成的不利效果與空間差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: New loading can change both effective stress and demand. Claiming lower risk from resistance alone overlooks adverse effects of added structure load, changed groundwater and spatial variation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地盤加載可能同時改變有效應力與需求，若只看抗力增加就宣稱風險下降，會漏掉新增結構荷載及水位改變造成的不利效果與空間差異。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Claiming lower risk from resistance alone overlooks adverse effects of added structure load, changed groundwater and spatial variation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要改善抗力增幅符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for treatment resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 地盤加載可能同時改變有效應力與需求，若只看抗力增加就宣稱風險下降，會漏掉新增結構荷載及水位改變造成的不利效果與空間差異。

quiz.question: 在「改善抗力增幅」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

地盤加載可能同時改變有效應力與需求，若只看抗力增加就宣稱風險下降，會漏掉新增結構荷載及水位改變造成的不利效果與空間差異。
只要樁身震後負摩阻符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
New loading can change both effective stress and demand.
A nominal result for post event pile downdrag removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
