quiz.explanationEn: New loading can change both effective stress and demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 樁身震後負摩阻：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Post event pile downdrag: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「樁身震後負摩阻」如何影響液化地盤評估與改善的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post event pile downdrag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Liquefaction assessment and mitigation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 周圍土震後下沉相對於樁身會形成負摩阻，增加樁的軸力需求。簡化沿程均勻剪應力只提供量級，實際中性點、樁土相對位移及荷載轉移需共同分析。假設樁徑D=1m、受負摩阻長L=8m、平均τ=20kPa，Qdrag=πDLτ=502.7kN，約503kN；不得與同段正摩阻重複計入。同一樁段一面計負摩阻需求一面又計滿額正摩阻抗力會重複使用界面能力；震後樁身軸力可能因此被低估，接頭與樁端更容易過載。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樁身震後負摩阻」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reconsolidating soil moving down relative to a pile adds downdrag. Uniform interface shear provides a scale estimate, while the neutral plane, relative movement and load transfer require integrated analysis. For D=1m, downdrag length L=8m and mean τ=20kPa, Qdrag=πDLτ=502.7kN, about503kN. Do not also credit positive friction over that segment. Crediting full positive resistance while assigning downdrag on the same segment double counts interface capacity. This can understate post-event axial force and expose connections or toes to overload. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Post event pile downdrag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設樁徑D=1m、受負摩阻長L=8m、平均τ=20kPa，Qdrag=πDLτ=502.7kN，約503kN；不得與同段正摩阻重複計入。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For D=1m, downdrag length L=8m and mean τ=20kPa, Qdrag=πDLτ=502.7kN, about503kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要樁身震後負摩阻符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for post event pile downdrag removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「樁身震後負摩阻」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 樁身震後負摩阻：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 以土層沉陷預估與樁身應變或荷載資料建立相對位移模型，檢查中性點及樁端反應。將震後狀態作獨立荷載組合，由基礎工程師確認容量及服務性。同時排除以下干擾原因：同一樁段一面計負摩阻需求一面又計滿額正摩阻抗力會重複使用界面能力；震後樁身軸力可能因此被低估，接頭與樁端更容易過載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Combine soil-settlement estimates with pile strain or force evidence to model relative movement, neutral plane and toe response. The foundation engineer checks capacity and serviceability for a distinct post-event load case. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Crediting full positive resistance while assigning downdrag on the same segment double counts interface capacity. This can understate post-event axial force and expose connections or toes to overload. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「改善範圍證據」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Verified improvement coverage", which statement holds?
options: 只要循環應力需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設目標面積1000m²、符合既定證據要求900m²，覆蓋率=900/1000=90%；剩餘100m²不因平均比例高而自動合格。
只要超額孔壓接近極限符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for cyclic stress demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a1000m² target and900m² meeting predefined evidence requirements, coverage is90%.
A nominal result for high excess pressure ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設目標面積1000m²、符合既定證據要求900m²，覆蓋率=900/1000=90%；剩餘100m²不因平均比例高而自動合格。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a1000m² target and900m² meeting predefined evidence requirements, coverage is90%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 改善範圍證據：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Verified improvement coverage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「改善範圍證據」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Verified improvement coverage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每個測試、施工柱位與深度範圍放入同一地圖，標記未覆蓋的帶狀或角落區。依控制破壞機制決定補查位置，主管工程師逐區確認證據充分性。同時排除以下干擾原因：未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map tests, treatment locations and depth ranges together, marking unverified strips and corners. Choose supplementary checks by controlling failure mechanism and have the engineer confirm evidence zone by zone. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A small unverified strip crossing the foundation can control lateral deformation. Report length or total test count is not spatial coverage and can create a false impression of system reliability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接改善範圍證據時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將每個測試、施工柱位與深度範圍放入同一地圖，標記未覆蓋的帶狀或角落區。依控制破壞機制決定補查位置，主管工程師逐區確認證據充分性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over verified improvement coverage, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map tests, treatment locations and depth ranges together, marking unverified strips and corners. Choose supplementary checks by controlling failure mechanism and have the engineer confirm evidence zone by zone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small unverified strip crossing the foundation can control lateral deformation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將每個測試、施工柱位與深度範圍放入同一地圖，標記未覆蓋的帶狀或角落區。依控制破壞機制決定補查位置，主管工程師逐區確認證據充分性。同時排除以下干擾原因：未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。
knowledge.textEn: Map tests, treatment locations and depth ranges together, marking unverified strips and corners. Choose supplementary checks by controlling failure mechanism and have the engineer confirm evidence zone by zone. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A small unverified strip crossing the foundation can control lateral deformation. Report length or total test count is not spatial coverage and can create a false impression of system reliability.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接改善範圍證據時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將每個測試、施工柱位與深度範圍放入同一地圖，標記未覆蓋的帶狀或角落區。依控制破壞機制決定補查位置，主管工程師逐區確認證據充分性。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over verified improvement coverage, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map tests, treatment locations and depth ranges together, marking unverified strips and corners. Choose supplementary checks by controlling failure mechanism and have the engineer confirm evidence zone by zone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「改善範圍證據」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Verified improvement coverage"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要側向擴展應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
將每個測試、施工柱位與深度範圍放入同一地圖，標記未覆蓋的帶狀或角落區。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A nominal result for lateral spreading strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Map tests, treatment locations and depth ranges together, marking unverified strips and corners.
quiz.explanation: 將每個測試、施工柱位與深度範圍放入同一地圖，標記未覆蓋的帶狀或角落區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map tests, treatment locations and depth ranges together, marking unverified strips and corners. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 改善範圍證據：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Verified improvement coverage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「改善範圍證據」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Verified improvement coverage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A small unverified strip crossing the foundation can control lateral deformation. Report length or total test count is not spatial coverage and can create a false impression of system reliability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Report length or total test count is not spatial coverage and can create a false impression of system reliability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要改善範圍證據符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for verified improvement coverage removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。
knowledge.textEn: A small unverified strip crossing the foundation can control lateral deformation. Report length or total test count is not spatial coverage and can create a false impression of system reliability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「改善範圍證據」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Verified improvement coverage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要需求敏感度與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A small unverified strip crossing the foundation can control lateral deformation.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A nominal result for demand sensitivity and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A small unverified strip crossing the foundation can control lateral deformation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 需求敏感度與交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Demand sensitivity and handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「需求敏感度與交接」如何影響液化地盤評估與改善的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Demand sensitivity and handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Liquefaction assessment and mitigation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 觸發判定對需求及抗力都有不確定性，交接應保留情境範圍和最不利位置。兩個需求值的比較只顯示模型敏感度，不代表地震發生機率或永久變形大小。固定教學CRR=0.40時，CSR=0.30得FS=1.33，CSR=0.40得FS=1.00；需求提高會降低同基準抗力比。若新增開挖或地下水改變後仍沿用原比值，風險資料會失去時效；只保存合格結論而未保存假設，接手工程師無法辨識哪些條件已經改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「需求敏感度與交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Both demand and resistance are uncertain, so handover preserves scenario ranges and controlling locations. Comparing two demand values illustrates model sensitivity, not earthquake probability or permanent deformation magnitude. At fixed teaching CRR=0.40, CSR=0.30 gives FS=1.33, while CSR=0.40 gives FS=1.00. Higher demand lowers the consistently referenced ratio. Later excavation or groundwater changes can invalidate the original ratio. Retaining only a passing conclusion without assumptions prevents the next engineer from identifying which boundary conditions have changed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Demand sensitivity and handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：固定教學CRR=0.40時，CSR=0.30得FS=1.33，CSR=0.40得FS=1.00；需求提高會降低同基準抗力比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed teaching CRR=0.40, CSR=0.30 gives FS=1.33, while CSR=0.40 gives FS=1.00.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要需求敏感度與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for demand sensitivity and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「需求敏感度與交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Demand sensitivity and handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 需求敏感度與交接
knowledge.text: 觸發判定對需求及抗力都有不確定性，交接應保留情境範圍和最不利位置。兩個需求值的比較只顯示模型敏感度，不代表地震發生機率或永久變形大小。
knowledge.textEn: Both demand and resistance are uncertain, so handover preserves scenario ranges and controlling locations. Comparing two demand values illustrates model sensitivity, not earthquake probability or permanent deformation magnitude.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要需求敏感度與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for demand sensitivity and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「需求敏感度與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Demand sensitivity and handover" is correct?
options: 只要需求敏感度與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
觸發判定對需求及抗力都有不確定性，交接應保留情境範圍和最不利位置。
只要飽和土有效應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for demand sensitivity and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Both demand and resistance are uncertain, so handover preserves scenario ranges and controlling locations.
A nominal result for effective stress in saturated soil removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 觸發判定對需求及抗力都有不確定性，交接應保留情境範圍和最不利位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Both demand and resistance are uncertain, so handover preserves scenario ranges and controlling locations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 需求敏感度與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Demand sensitivity and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「需求敏感度與交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Demand sensitivity and handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：固定教學CRR=0.40時，CSR=0.30得FS=1.33，CSR=0.40得FS=1.00；需求提高會降低同基準抗力比。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed teaching CRR=0.40, CSR=0.30 gives FS=1.33, while CSR=0.40 gives FS=1.00. Higher demand lowers the consistently referenced ratio. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接輸入地震、水位、試驗修正及改善覆蓋地圖，列明哪些變更需要重新評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Handover motion, groundwater, corrections and coverage maps, identifying changes requiring reassessment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：固定教學CRR=0.40時，CSR=0.30得FS=1.33，CSR=0.40得FS=1.00；需求提高會降低同基準抗力比。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed teaching CRR=0.40, CSR=0.30 gives FS=1.33, while CSR=0.40 gives FS=1.00. Higher demand lowers the consistently referenced ratio.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「需求敏感度與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Demand sensitivity and handover", which statement holds?
options: 只要觸發抗力比值符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要分層震後沉陷符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：固定教學CRR=0.40時，CSR=0.30得FS=1.33，CSR=0.40得FS=1.00；需求提高會降低同基準抗力比。
optionsEn: A nominal result for triggering resistance ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for layered post shaking settlement removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed teaching CRR=0.40, CSR=0.30 gives FS=1.33, while CSR=0.40 gives FS=1.00.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：固定教學CRR=0.40時，CSR=0.30得FS=1.33，CSR=0.40得FS=1.00；需求提高會降低同基準抗力比。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed teaching CRR=0.40, CSR=0.30 gives FS=1.33, while CSR=0.40 gives FS=1.00. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 需求敏感度與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Demand sensitivity and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「需求敏感度與交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Demand sensitivity and handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接輸入地震、水位、試驗修正及改善覆蓋地圖，列明哪些變更需要重新評估。業主與工程師共同指定監測、震後檢查及重啟條件，避免單一比值取代程序。同時排除以下干擾原因：若新增開挖或地下水改變後仍沿用原比值，風險資料會失去時效；只保存合格結論而未保存假設，接手工程師無法辨識哪些條件已經改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Handover motion, groundwater, corrections and coverage maps, identifying changes requiring reassessment. Owner and engineers define monitoring, post-event inspection and reopening conditions rather than replacing procedures with one ratio. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Later excavation or groundwater changes can invalidate the original ratio. Retaining only a passing conclusion without assumptions prevents the next engineer from identifying which boundary conditions have changed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接需求敏感度與交接時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。交接輸入地震、水位、試驗修正及改善覆蓋地圖，列明哪些變更需要重新評估。業主與工程師共同指定監測、震後檢查及重啟條件，避免單一比值取代程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over demand sensitivity and handover, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Handover motion, groundwater, corrections and coverage maps, identifying changes requiring reassessment. Owner and engineers define monitoring, post-event inspection and reopening conditions rather than replacing procedures with one ratio.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若新增開挖或地下水改變後仍沿用原比值，風險資料會失去時效；只保存合格結論而未保存假設，接手工程師無法辨識哪些條件已經改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Later excavation or groundwater changes can invalidate the original ratio. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「需求敏感度與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Demand sensitivity and handover"?
options: 交接輸入地震、水位、試驗修正及改善覆蓋地圖，列明哪些變更需要重新評估。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要改善抗力增幅符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Handover motion, groundwater, corrections and coverage maps, identifying changes requiring reassessment.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A nominal result for treatment resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 交接輸入地震、水位、試驗修正及改善覆蓋地圖，列明哪些變更需要重新評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Handover motion, groundwater, corrections and coverage maps, identifying changes requiring reassessment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 需求敏感度與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Demand sensitivity and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「需求敏感度與交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Demand sensitivity and handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若新增開挖或地下水改變後仍沿用原比值，風險資料會失去時效；只保存合格結論而未保存假設，接手工程師無法辨識哪些條件已經改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Later excavation or groundwater changes can invalidate the original ratio. Retaining only a passing conclusion without assumptions prevents the next engineer from identifying which boundary conditions have changed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若新增開挖或地下水改變後仍沿用原比值，風險資料會失去時效；只保存合格結論而未保存假設，接手工程師無法辨識哪些條件已經改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Retaining only a passing conclusion without assumptions prevents the next engineer from identifying which boundary conditions have changed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要需求敏感度與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for demand sensitivity and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若新增開挖或地下水改變後仍沿用原比值，風險資料會失去時效；只保存合格結論而未保存假設，接手工程師無法辨識哪些條件已經改變。
knowledge.textEn: Later excavation or groundwater changes can invalidate the original ratio. Retaining only a passing conclusion without assumptions prevents the next engineer from identifying which boundary conditions have changed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「需求敏感度與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Demand sensitivity and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若新增開挖或地下水改變後仍沿用原比值，風險資料會失去時效；只保存合格結論而未保存假設，接手工程師無法辨識哪些條件已經改變。
只要飽和土有效應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Later excavation or groundwater changes can invalidate the original ratio.
A nominal result for effective stress in saturated soil removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若新增開挖或地下水改變後仍沿用原比值，風險資料會失去時效；只保存合格結論而未保存假設，接手工程師無法辨識哪些條件已經改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Later excavation or groundwater changes can invalidate the original ratio. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 隧道耐震接頭設計
summary: 本課聚焦以相對位移、接頭剛度與止水餘量理解隧道耐震接頭。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on understand seismic tunnel joints through relative movement, joint stiffness and sealing reserve. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。假設指定方向粒子速度由0.50增加10%至0.55m/s，對應波速固定500m/s，應變由0.001增為0.0011；同一20m分配長度的位移由20增至22mm。此結果須維持波型、方向與分配邊界相同。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001. An arbitrary total peak is unsuitable. Increasing assumed directional particle velocity from0.50 to0.55m/s by10% at corresponding speed500m/s changes strain from0.001 to0.0011. Over the same20m allocation length, movement rises from20 to22mm. Wave type, direction and allocation boundaries must remain unchanged. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波傳軸向應變」與「接頭相對伸長」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wave induced axial strain" and "Joint relative extension": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波傳軸向應變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wave induced axial strain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「波傳軸向應變」如何影響隧道耐震接頭設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wave induced axial strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic tunnel-joint design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下結構受地震波強迫變形，和地面建物單看慣性力的模型不同。沿隧道方向的簡化平面波可用粒子速度與對應波速估應變，但必須指定方向及波型。假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波傳軸向應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seismic waves impose ground deformation on tunnels, unlike a model considering only building inertia. A simplified wave along the tunnel relates particle velocity to the corresponding wave speed, requiring an explicit direction and wave type. For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001. An arbitrary total peak is unsuitable. Combining shear-wave speed with unrelated particle motion misestimates strain. Stiff-soft transitions can also concentrate displacement, so a mean wave model may miss the joint controlling actual performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wave induced axial strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要波傳軸向應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for wave induced axial strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「波傳軸向應變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wave induced axial strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波傳軸向應變
knowledge.text: 地下結構受地震波強迫變形，和地面建物單看慣性力的模型不同。沿隧道方向的簡化平面波可用粒子速度與對應波速估應變，但必須指定方向及波型。
knowledge.textEn: Seismic waves impose ground deformation on tunnels, unlike a model considering only building inertia. A simplified wave along the tunnel relates particle velocity to the corresponding wave speed, requiring an explicit direction and wave type.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要波傳軸向應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for wave induced axial strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波傳軸向應變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wave induced axial strain" is correct?
options: 只要波傳軸向應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
地下結構受地震波強迫變形，和地面建物單看慣性力的模型不同。
只要接頭相對伸長符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for wave induced axial strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Seismic waves impose ground deformation on tunnels, unlike a model considering only building inertia.
A nominal result for joint relative extension removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 地下結構受地震波強迫變形，和地面建物單看慣性力的模型不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Seismic waves impose ground deformation on tunnels, unlike a model considering only building inertia. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波傳軸向應變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wave induced axial strain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波傳軸向應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wave induced axial strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001. An arbitrary total peak is unsuitable. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對地震輸入的方向、波型與波速剖面，將自由場應變和土結互制分析比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check input direction, wave type and velocity profile, comparing free-field strain with interaction analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001. An arbitrary total peak is unsuitable.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

steps.title: 波傳軸向應變：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 核對地震輸入的方向、波型與波速剖面，將自由場應變和土結互制分析比較。對斜交波及地層變化保留專門分析，不把此式當所有地震情境的包絡值。同時排除以下干擾原因：若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check input direction, wave type and velocity profile, comparing free-field strain with interaction analysis. Oblique waves and stratigraphic transitions require specific treatment; the relation is not a universal seismic envelope. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Combining shear-wave speed with unrelated particle motion misestimates strain. Stiff-soft transitions can also concentrate displacement, so a mean wave model may miss the joint controlling actual performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 接頭相對伸長：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint relative extension: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接頭相對伸長」如何影響隧道耐震接頭設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint relative extension” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic tunnel-joint design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軸向地盤應變在一段長度上累積成位移，但並非全部都集中在單一接頭。襯砌軸向剛度、地盤摩擦及接頭分布共同決定分配，簡式只是指定分攤情境。假設ε=0.001均勻作用於L=20m且這段變形分配給所查接頭，Δ=εL=0.020m即20mm；實際分配另算。若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭相對伸長」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Axial ground strain accumulates over length but does not necessarily concentrate at one joint. Lining stiffness, ground friction and joint distribution govern sharing; the simple relation represents a specified allocation scenario. If ε=0.001 acts uniformly over L=20m and that segment's deformation is allocated to the checked joint, Δ=0.020m, or20mm; real sharing needs analysis. Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand. Uniform sharing can instead understate opening at an unusually flexible joint and miss loss of water sealing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint relative extension” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「接頭相對伸長」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint relative extension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將環縫與縱向接頭位置畫成變形相容圖，檢查位移和襯砌伸長的總和。比較接頭量測及模型結果，對端部、剛度變化與特殊構造另設控制點。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map circumferential and longitudinal joints in a compatibility diagram, checking the sum of joint movement and lining extension. Compare measured and modelled response at ends, stiffness changes and special structures. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand. Uniform sharing can instead understate opening at an unusually flexible joint and miss loss of water sealing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接接頭相對伸長時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將環縫與縱向接頭位置畫成變形相容圖，檢查位移和襯砌伸長的總和。比較接頭量測及模型結果，對端部、剛度變化與特殊構造另設控制點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over joint relative extension, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map circumferential and longitudinal joints in a compatibility diagram, checking the sum of joint movement and lining extension. Compare measured and modelled response at ends, stiffness changes and special structures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Uniform sharing can instead understate opening at an unusually flexible joint and miss loss of water sealing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接頭相對伸長」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint relative extension"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將環縫與縱向接頭位置畫成變形相容圖，檢查位移和襯砌伸長的總和。
只要震後外水壓變化符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Map circumferential and longitudinal joints in a compatibility diagram, checking the sum of joint movement and lining extension.
A nominal result for post event water pressure change removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.title: 接頭相對伸長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint relative extension: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接頭相對伸長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint relative extension” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand. Uniform sharing can instead understate opening at an unusually flexible joint and miss loss of water sealing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Uniform sharing can instead understate opening at an unusually flexible joint and miss loss of water sealing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要接頭相對伸長符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for joint relative extension removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand. Uniform sharing can instead understate opening at an unusually flexible joint and miss loss of water sealing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接頭相對伸長」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint relative extension" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要接頭剪切剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for joint shear stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand.
quiz.explanation: 若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接頭剪切剛度」與「轉角邊緣張開」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint shear stiffness" and "Rotation induced edge opening": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接頭剪切剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint shear stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接頭剪切剛度」如何影響隧道耐震接頭設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint shear stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic tunnel-joint design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接頭剪切剛度決定位移引起的力，柔性接頭能減少某些力卻可能增加位移與密封需求。線性彈簧只代表特定範圍，間隙、摩擦滑移及損傷會改變關係。假設剪切剛度k=50MN/m、相對位移Δ=0.010m，V=kΔ=0.50MN；此為線性範圍的力，不是接頭剪力容量。若模型忽略接觸閉合後剛度突然升高，峰值力可能被低估；相反，滑移後殘餘變形也可能超出止水能力，即使計算內力看似下降。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭剪切剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint shear stiffness converts movement to force. Flexibility may reduce force while increasing displacement and sealing demand; a linear spring applies only within a range, before gaps, frictional slip or damage change behaviour. For shear stiffness k=50MN/m and Δ=0.010m, V=kΔ=0.50MN. This is linear-range demand, not joint shear capacity. Ignoring sudden stiffness increase after contact can understate peak force. Conversely, residual slip may exceed sealing capacity even when the calculated force falls, so one favourable response measure is insufficient. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint shear stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設剪切剛度k=50MN/m、相對位移Δ=0.010m，V=kΔ=0.50MN；此為線性範圍的力，不是接頭剪力容量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For shear stiffness k=50MN/m and Δ=0.010m, V=kΔ=0.50MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要接頭剪切剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for joint shear stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接頭剪切剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint shear stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接頭剪切剛度
knowledge.text: 接頭剪切剛度決定位移引起的力，柔性接頭能減少某些力卻可能增加位移與密封需求。線性彈簧只代表特定範圍，間隙、摩擦滑移及損傷會改變關係。
knowledge.textEn: Joint shear stiffness converts movement to force. Flexibility may reduce force while increasing displacement and sealing demand; a linear spring applies only within a range, before gaps, frictional slip or damage change behaviour.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要接頭剪切剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for joint shear stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接頭剪切剛度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint shear stiffness" is correct?
options: 接頭剪切剛度決定位移引起的力，柔性接頭能減少某些力卻可能增加位移與密封需求。
只要接頭剪切剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要轉角邊緣張開符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Joint shear stiffness converts movement to force.
A nominal result for joint shear stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for rotation induced edge opening removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 接頭剪切剛度決定位移引起的力，柔性接頭能減少某些力卻可能增加位移與密封需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint shear stiffness converts movement to force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接頭剪切剛度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint shear stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接頭剪切剛度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint shear stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設剪切剛度k=50MN/m、相對位移Δ=0.010m，V=kΔ=0.50MN；此為線性範圍的力，不是接頭剪力容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For shear stiffness k=50MN/m and Δ=0.010m, V=kΔ=0.50MN. This is linear-range demand, not joint shear capacity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用代表性接頭試驗確認力位移曲線、循環退化與溫度條件，將軸向壓力也列入比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test representative force-displacement response, cyclic degradation and temperature, including axial loading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設剪切剛度k=50MN/m、相對位移Δ=0.010m，V=kΔ=0.50MN；此為線性範圍的力，不是接頭剪力容量。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For shear stiffness k=50MN/m and Δ=0.010m, V=kΔ=0.50MN. This is linear-range demand, not joint shear capacity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接頭剪切剛度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint shear stiffness", which statement holds?
options: 只要連接件局部應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設剪切剛度k=50MN/m、相對位移Δ=0.010m，V=kΔ=0.50MN；此為線性範圍的力，不是接頭剪力容量。
只要串聯柔度分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for local connector strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For shear stiffness k=50MN/m and Δ=0.010m, V=kΔ=0.50MN.
A nominal result for series compliance sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設剪切剛度k=50MN/m、相對位移Δ=0.010m，V=kΔ=0.50MN；此為線性範圍的力，不是接頭剪力容量。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For shear stiffness k=50MN/m and Δ=0.010m, V=kΔ=0.50MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接頭剪切剛度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint shear stiffness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接頭剪切剛度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint shear stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用代表性接頭試驗確認力位移曲線、循環退化與溫度條件，將軸向壓力也列入比較。設計須同時檢查力、位移及密封，不能只降低剛度求較小內力。同時排除以下干擾原因：若模型忽略接觸閉合後剛度突然升高，峰值力可能被低估；相反，滑移後殘餘變形也可能超出止水能力，即使計算內力看似下降。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test representative force-displacement response, cyclic degradation and temperature, including axial loading. Check force, movement and sealing together rather than selecting low stiffness solely to reduce calculated force. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Ignoring sudden stiffness increase after contact can understate peak force. Conversely, residual slip may exceed sealing capacity even when the calculated force falls, so one favourable response measure is insufficient. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接接頭剪切剛度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用代表性接頭試驗確認力位移曲線、循環退化與溫度條件，將軸向壓力也列入比較。設計須同時檢查力、位移及密封，不能只降低剛度求較小內力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over joint shear stiffness, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Test representative force-displacement response, cyclic degradation and temperature, including axial loading. options: 使用至少可辨識轉動的多點位移配置，將剛體平移與旋轉分開擬合。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要波傳軸向應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Use multiple displacement points to distinguish rigid translation and rotation.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A nominal result for wave induced axial strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 使用至少可辨識轉動的多點位移配置，將剛體平移與旋轉分開擬合。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use multiple displacement points to distinguish rigid translation and rotation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉角邊緣張開：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rotation induced edge opening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉角邊緣張開」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rotation induced edge opening” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單點量測若靠近旋轉中心，會低估邊緣開口；假設整條止水帶承受相同壓縮會漏掉一側失去接觸、另一側過度壓縮的同時發生。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A sensor near the rotation centre can miss edge opening. Uniform seal compression assumptions conceal simultaneous contact loss on one side and excessive compression on the other. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單點量測若靠近旋轉中心，會低估邊緣開口；假設整條止水帶承受相同壓縮會漏掉一側失去接觸、另一側過度壓縮的同時發生。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Uniform seal compression assumptions conceal simultaneous contact loss on one side and excessive compression on the other.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要轉角邊緣張開符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for rotation induced edge opening removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單點量測若靠近旋轉中心，會低估邊緣開口；假設整條止水帶承受相同壓縮會漏掉一側失去接觸、另一側過度壓縮的同時發生。
knowledge.textEn: A sensor near the rotation centre can miss edge opening. Uniform seal compression assumptions conceal simultaneous contact loss on one side and excessive compression on the other.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉角邊緣張開」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rotation induced edge opening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
單點量測若靠近旋轉中心，會低估邊緣開口；假設整條止水帶承受相同壓縮會漏掉一側失去接觸、另一側過度壓縮的同時發生。
只要止水壓縮幾何餘量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A sensor near the rotation centre can miss edge opening.
A nominal result for seal compression geometry reserve removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 單點量測若靠近旋轉中心，會低估邊緣開口；假設整條止水帶承受相同壓縮會漏掉一側失去接觸、另一側過度壓縮的同時發生。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A sensor near the rotation centre can miss edge opening. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「止水壓縮幾何餘量」與「連接件局部應變」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seal compression geometry reserve" and "Local connector strain": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 止水壓縮幾何餘量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seal compression geometry reserve: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「止水壓縮幾何餘量」如何影響隧道耐震接頭設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seal compression geometry reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic tunnel-joint design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 止水剩餘壓縮量是幾何量，水密性還取決於材料曲線、老化、表面及水壓。幾何仍有接觸不等於接觸壓力足夠，必須用試驗建立容許的運動範圍。假設初始壓縮c0=30mm、接頭張開Δ=12mm，cres=c0−Δ=18mm；沒有材料曲線不能算接觸壓或保證不漏水。止水老化硬化或局部折皺會讓相同壓縮量產生不同接觸狀態；只保留名義幾何餘量可能忽略細小通道，在持續外水壓下逐步發展滲漏。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「止水壓縮幾何餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Remaining seal compression is geometric. Watertightness also depends on material response, ageing, contact surfaces and water pressure. Continued geometric contact does not establish enough contact pressure; testing defines the admissible motion range. For initial compression c0=30mm and opening Δ=12mm, cres=18mm. Without a material curve this cannot determine contact pressure or guarantee watertightness. Ageing or wrinkles can change contact at the same nominal compression. A geometric reserve alone misses small flow paths that can develop into leakage under sustained external pressure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seal compression geometry reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始壓縮c0=30mm、接頭張開Δ=12mm，cres=c0−Δ=18mm；沒有材料曲線不能算接觸壓或保證不漏水。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial compression c0=30mm and opening Δ=12mm, cres=18mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要止水壓縮幾何餘量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for seal compression geometry reserve removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「止水壓縮幾何餘量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Seal compression geometry reserve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 止水壓縮幾何餘量
knowledge.text: 止水剩餘壓縮量是幾何量，水密性還取決於材料曲線、老化、表面及水壓。幾何仍有接觸不等於接觸壓力足夠，必須用試驗建立容許的運動範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Remaining seal compression is geometric. Watertightness also depends on material response, ageing, contact surfaces and water pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要止水壓縮幾何餘量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for seal compression geometry reserve removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「止水壓縮幾何餘量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seal compression geometry reserve" is correct?
options: 只要止水壓縮幾何餘量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要連接件局部應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
止水剩餘壓縮量是幾何量，水密性還取決於材料曲線、老化、表面及水壓。
optionsEn: A nominal result for seal compression geometry reserve removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for local connector strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Remaining seal compression is geometric.
quiz.explanation: 止水剩餘壓縮量是幾何量，水密性還取決於材料曲線、老化、表面及水壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Remaining seal compression is geometric. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 止水壓縮幾何餘量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seal compression geometry reserve: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「止水壓縮幾何餘量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seal compression geometry reserve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始壓縮c0=30mm、接頭張開Δ=12mm，cres=c0−Δ=18mm；沒有材料曲線不能算接觸壓或保證不漏水。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial compression c0=30mm and opening Δ=12mm, cres=18mm. Without a material curve this cannot determine contact pressure or guarantee watertightness. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對密封材料批次、初始壓縮與接觸面公差，採具代表水壓和多軸位移的試驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify seal batch, initial compression and contact tolerances using representative pressure and multiaxis tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始壓縮c0=30mm、接頭張開Δ=12mm，cres=c0−Δ=18mm；沒有材料曲線不能算接觸壓或保證不漏水。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial compression c0=30mm and opening Δ=12mm, cres=18mm. Without a material curve this cannot determine contact pressure or guarantee watertightness.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「止水壓縮幾何餘量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Seal compression geometry reserve", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始壓縮c0=30mm、接頭張開Δ=12mm，cres=c0−Δ=18mm；沒有材料曲線不能算接觸壓或保證不漏水。
只要串聯柔度分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要位移容量與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial compression c0=30mm and opening Δ=12mm, cres=18mm.
A nominal result for series compliance sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for movement capacity and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始壓縮c0=30mm、接頭張開Δ=12mm，cres=c0−Δ=18mm；沒有材料曲線不能算接觸壓或保證不漏水。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial compression c0=30mm and opening Δ=12mm, cres=18mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 止水壓縮幾何餘量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seal compression geometry reserve: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「止水壓縮幾何餘量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seal compression geometry reserve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對密封材料批次、初始壓縮與接觸面公差，採具代表水壓和多軸位移的試驗。把老化後性能與施工偏差納入包絡，驗收由設計與品質責任人共同簽認。同時排除以下干擾原因：止水老化硬化或局部折皺會讓相同壓縮量產生不同接觸狀態；只保留名義幾何餘量可能忽略細小通道，在持續外水壓下逐步發展滲漏。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify seal batch, initial compression and contact tolerances using representative pressure and multiaxis tests. Include aged performance and installation deviation in the envelope, with design and quality leads jointly accepting evidence. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Ageing or wrinkles can change contact at the same nominal compression. A geometric reserve alone misses small flow paths that can develop into leakage under sustained external pressure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接止水壓縮幾何餘量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對密封材料批次、初始壓縮與接觸面公差，採具代表水壓和多軸位移的試驗。把老化後性能與施工偏差納入包絡，驗收由設計與品質責任人共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over seal compression geometry reserve, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Verify seal batch, initial compression and contact tolerances using representative pressure and multiaxis tests. Include aged performance and installation deviation in the envelope, with design and quality leads jointly accepting evidence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：止水老化硬化或局部折皺會讓相同壓縮量產生不同接觸狀態；只保留名義幾何餘量可能忽略細小通道，在持續外水壓下逐步發展滲漏。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ageing or wrinkles can change contact at the same nominal compression. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對密封材料批次、初始壓縮與接觸面公差，採具代表水壓和多軸位移的試驗。把老化後性能與施工偏差納入包絡，驗收由設計與品質責任人共同簽認。同時排除以下干擾原因：止水老化硬化或局部折皺會讓相同壓縮量產生不同接觸狀態；只保留名義幾何餘量可能忽略細小通道，在持續外水壓下逐步發展滲漏。
knowledge.textEn: Verify seal batch, initial compression and contact tolerances using representative pressure and multiaxis tests. Include aged performance and installation deviation in the envelope, with design and quality leads jointly accepting evidence. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Ageing or wrinkles can change contact at the same nominal compression. A geometric reserve alone misses small flow paths that can develop into leakage under sustained external pressure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接止水壓縮幾何餘量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對密封材料批次、初始壓縮與接觸面公差，採具代表水壓和多軸位移的試驗。把老化後性能與施工偏差納入包絡，驗收由設計與品質責任人共同簽認。

Verify seal batch, initial compression and contact tolerances using representative pressure and multiaxis tests. Include aged performance and installation deviation in the envelope, with design and quality leads jointly accepting evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Verify seal batch, initial compression and contact tolerances using representative pressure and multiaxis tests. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.titleEn: Seal compression geometry reserve: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「止水壓縮幾何餘量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seal compression geometry reserve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 止水老化硬化或局部折皺會讓相同壓縮量產生不同接觸狀態；只保留名義幾何餘量可能忽略細小通道，在持續外水壓下逐步發展滲漏。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ageing or wrinkles can change contact at the same nominal compression. A geometric reserve alone misses small flow paths that can develop into leakage under sustained external pressure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：止水老化硬化或局部折皺會讓相同壓縮量產生不同接觸狀態；只保留名義幾何餘量可能忽略細小通道，在持續外水壓下逐步發展滲漏。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A geometric reserve alone misses small flow paths that can develop into leakage under sustained external pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要止水壓縮幾何餘量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for seal compression geometry reserve removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 止水老化硬化或局部折皺會讓相同壓縮量產生不同接觸狀態；只保留名義幾何餘量可能忽略細小通道，在持續外水壓下逐步發展滲漏。
knowledge.textEn: Ageing or wrinkles can change contact at the same nominal compression. A geometric reserve alone misses small flow paths that can develop into leakage under sustained external pressure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「止水壓縮幾何餘量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seal compression geometry reserve" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要連接件局部應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
止水老化硬化或局部折皺會讓相同壓縮量產生不同接觸狀態；只保留名義幾何餘量可能忽略細小通道，在持續外水壓下逐步發展滲漏。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A nominal result for local connector strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Ageing or wrinkles can change contact at the same nominal compression.
quiz.explanation: 止水老化硬化或局部折皺會讓相同壓縮量產生不同接觸狀態；只保留名義幾何餘量可能忽略細小通道，在持續外水壓下逐步發展滲漏。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ageing or wrinkles can change contact at the same nominal compression. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 連接件局部應變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local connector strain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「連接件局部應變」如何影響隧道耐震接頭設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local connector strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic tunnel-joint design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接頭連接件的變形集中於有效自由長度，不能把位移除以整支外觀長度稀釋應變。局部塑性、螺紋及錨定區可能先控制，線性應變估算不能直接當疲勞壽命。假設連接件有效長L=200mm、伸長Δ=2mm，ε=Δ/L=0.010即1%；是否彈性須另看材料與接頭構造。把錨固在混凝土中的長度也當可均勻伸長，會低估局部應變；反覆運動可在螺紋根部或接合處累積損傷，即使整體位移仍在名義行程內。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「連接件局部應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Connector extension concentrates over the effective free length, not necessarily its full visible length. Plasticity, threads and anchorage may govern; a simple strain estimate is not a fatigue-life calculation. For effective length L=200mm and extension Δ=2mm, ε=0.010, or1%. Elasticity depends separately on material and connection details. Counting embedded length as uniformly extensible understates local strain. Repeated movement can damage thread roots or connections while overall displacement remains within the nominal stroke. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local connector strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設連接件有效長L=200mm、伸長Δ=2mm，ε=Δ/L=0.010即1%；是否彈性須另看材料與接頭構造。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective length L=200mm and extension Δ=2mm, ε=0.010, or1%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要連接件局部應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for local connector strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「連接件局部應變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local connector strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for local connector strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「連接件局部應變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Local connector strain" is correct?
options: 接頭連接件的變形集中於有效自由長度，不能把位移除以整支外觀長度稀釋應變。
只要連接件局部應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

optionsEn: Connector extension concentrates over the effective free length, not necessarily its full visible length.
A nominal result for local connector strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for fault deformation band demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.title: 連接件局部應變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Local connector strain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「連接件局部應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local connector strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設連接件有效長L=200mm、伸長Δ=2mm，ε=Δ/L=0.010即1%；是否彈性須另看材料與接頭構造。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective length L=200mm and extension Δ=2mm, ε=0.010, or1%. Elasticity depends separately on material and connection details. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對自由長度、螺紋及錨定段，將應變量測位置與有限元素或接頭試驗比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review free length, threads and anchorage, comparing strain locations with analysis or joint testing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設連接件有效長L=200mm、伸長Δ=2mm，ε=Δ/L=0.010即1%；是否彈性須另看材料與接頭構造。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective length L=200mm and extension Δ=2mm, ε=0.010, or1%. Elasticity depends separately on material and connection details.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「連接件局部應變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Local connector strain", which statement holds?
options: 只要震後外水壓變化符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設連接件有效長L=200mm、伸長Δ=2mm，ε=Δ/L=0.010即1%；是否彈性須另看材料與接頭構造。
只要波傳軸向應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for post event water pressure change removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective length L=200mm and extension Δ=2mm, ε=0.010, or1%.
A nominal result for wave induced axial strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設連接件有效長L=200mm、伸長Δ=2mm，ε=Δ/L=0.010即1%；是否彈性須另看材料與接頭構造。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective length L=200mm and extension Δ=2mm, ε=0.010, or1%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 連接件局部應變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Local connector strain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「連接件局部應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local connector strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對自由長度、螺紋及錨定段，將應變量測位置與有限元素或接頭試驗比較。對循環載重記錄殘餘變形與裂縫，不能只看最後一圈的最大力。同時排除以下干擾原因：把錨固在混凝土中的長度也當可均勻伸長，會低估局部應變；反覆運動可在螺紋根部或接合處累積損傷，即使整體位移仍在名義行程內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review free length, threads and anchorage, comparing strain locations with analysis or joint testing. Under cycling, record residual extension and cracking rather than only the maximum force in the final cycle. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Counting embedded length as uniformly extensible understates local strain. Repeated movement can damage thread roots or connections while overall displacement remains within the nominal stroke. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接連接件局部應變時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對自由長度、螺紋及錨定段，將應變量測位置與有限元素或接頭試驗比較。對循環載重記錄殘餘變形與裂縫，不能只看最後一圈的最大力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over local connector strain, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Review free length, threads and anchorage, comparing strain locations with analysis or joint testing. Under cycling, record residual extension and cracking rather than only the maximum force in the final cycle.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把錨固在混凝土中的長度也當可均勻伸長，會低估局部應變；反覆運動可在螺紋根部或接合處累積損傷，即使整體位移仍在名義行程內。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting embedded length as uniformly extensible understates local strain. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
