knowledge.textEn: Counting embedded length as uniformly extensible understates local strain. Repeated movement can damage thread roots or connections while overall displacement remains within the nominal stroke.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「連接件局部應變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Local connector strain" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把錨固在混凝土中的長度也當可均勻伸長，會低估局部應變；反覆運動可在螺紋根部或接合處累積損傷，即使整體位移仍在名義行程內。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要斷層變形帶需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Counting embedded length as uniformly extensible understates local strain.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A nominal result for fault deformation band demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 把錨固在混凝土中的長度也當可均勻伸長，會低估局部應變；反覆運動可在螺紋根部或接合處累積損傷，即使整體位移仍在名義行程內。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting embedded length as uniformly extensible understates local strain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斷層變形帶需求」與「串聯柔度分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fault deformation band demand" and "Series compliance sharing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斷層變形帶需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault deformation band demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「斷層變形帶需求」如何影響隧道耐震接頭設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault deformation band demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic tunnel-joint design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 永久斷層錯動和振動造成的往復變形不是同一荷載情境，需分別評估。將錯距分攤到變形帶只能提供平均幾何需求，實際局部剪切可能更集中。假設相對錯距Δ=0.50m、分布寬L=20m，平均γ=Δ/L=0.025即2.5%；並非斷層位移的預測公式。若實際錯動集中於狹窄面，原本分散到長距離的柔性安排可能無效；單一接頭的容量再大也未必容納複合剪切與旋轉，鄰近襯砌可能先受損。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「斷層變形帶需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Permanent fault offset differs from oscillatory shaking and requires a separate scenario. Spreading offset over a deformation band provides only average geometric demand; localized shear may be more concentrated. For assumed offset Δ=0.50m distributed across L=20m, mean γ=0.025, or2.5%. This is not a formula predicting fault displacement. Concentrated offset can defeat flexibility distributed over a long distance. Even a large single-joint capacity may not accommodate combined shear and rotation before adjacent lining is damaged. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault deformation band demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相對錯距Δ=0.50m、分布寬L=20m，平均γ=Δ/L=0.025即2.5%；並非斷層位移的預測公式。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For assumed offset Δ=0.50m distributed across L=20m, mean γ=0.025, or2.5%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要斷層變形帶需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for fault deformation band demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「斷層變形帶需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fault deformation band demand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 斷層變形帶需求
knowledge.text: 永久斷層錯動和振動造成的往復變形不是同一荷載情境，需分別評估。將錯距分攤到變形帶只能提供平均幾何需求，實際局部剪切可能更集中。
knowledge.textEn: Permanent fault offset differs from oscillatory shaking and requires a separate scenario. Spreading offset over a deformation band provides only average geometric demand; localized shear may be more concentrated.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要斷層變形帶需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for fault deformation band demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斷層變形帶需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fault deformation band demand" is correct?
options: 只要斷層變形帶需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
永久斷層錯動和振動造成的往復變形不是同一荷載情境，需分別評估。
只要串聯柔度分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for fault deformation band demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Permanent fault offset differs from oscillatory shaking and requires a separate scenario.
A nominal result for series compliance sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 永久斷層錯動和振動造成的往復變形不是同一荷載情境，需分別評估。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Permanent fault offset differs from oscillatory shaking and requires a separate scenario. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斷層變形帶需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fault deformation band demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斷層變形帶需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault deformation band demand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相對錯距Δ=0.50m、分布寬L=20m，平均γ=Δ/L=0.025即2.5%；並非斷層位移的預測公式。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For assumed offset Δ=0.50m distributed across L=20m, mean γ=0.025, or2.5%. This is not a formula predicting fault displacement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以地質證據建立可能位置及帶寬情境，將永久位移與動態需求交由結構模型分別處理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define fault location and width scenarios from geological evidence, analysing permanent and dynamic demands separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相對錯距Δ=0.50m、分布寬L=20m，平均γ=Δ/L=0.025即2.5%；並非斷層位移的預測公式。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For assumed offset Δ=0.50m distributed across L=20m, mean γ=0.025, or2.5%. This is not a formula predicting fault displacement.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斷層變形帶需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fault deformation band demand", which statement holds?
options: 只要位移容量與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要接頭相對伸長符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相對錯距Δ=0.50m、分布寬L=20m，平均γ=Δ/L=0.025即2.5%；並非斷層位移的預測公式。
optionsEn: A nominal result for movement capacity and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for joint relative extension removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For assumed offset Δ=0.50m distributed across L=20m, mean γ=0.025, or2.5%.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相對錯距Δ=0.50m、分布寬L=20m，平均γ=Δ/L=0.025即2.5%；並非斷層位移的預測公式。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For assumed offset Δ=0.50m distributed across L=20m, mean γ=0.025, or2.5%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斷層變形帶需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fault deformation band demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷層變形帶需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault deformation band demand” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以地質證據建立可能位置及帶寬情境，將永久位移與動態需求交由結構模型分別處理。特殊接頭或擴挖方案須有專案審查，不能用平均應變替代斷層評估。同時排除以下干擾原因：若實際錯動集中於狹窄面，原本分散到長距離的柔性安排可能無效；單一接頭的容量再大也未必容納複合剪切與旋轉，鄰近襯砌可能先受損。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define fault location and width scenarios from geological evidence, analysing permanent and dynamic demands separately. Special joints or enlarged sections need project review rather than an average-strain substitute for fault assessment. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Concentrated offset can defeat flexibility distributed over a long distance. Even a large single-joint capacity may not accommodate combined shear and rotation before adjacent lining is damaged. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接斷層變形帶需求時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以地質證據建立可能位置及帶寬情境，將永久位移與動態需求交由結構模型分別處理。特殊接頭或擴挖方案須有專案審查，不能用平均應變替代斷層評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over fault deformation band demand, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Define fault location and width scenarios from geological evidence, analysing permanent and dynamic demands separately. Special joints or enlarged sections need project review rather than an average-strain substitute for fault assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若實際錯動集中於狹窄面，原本分散到長距離的柔性安排可能無效；單一接頭的容量再大也未必容納複合剪切與旋轉，鄰近襯砌可能先受損。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Concentrated offset can defeat flexibility distributed over a long distance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以地質證據建立可能位置及帶寬情境，將永久位移與動態需求交由結構模型分別處理。特殊接頭或擴挖方案須有專案審查，不能用平均應變替代斷層評估。同時排除以下干擾原因：若實際錯動集中於狹窄面，原本分散到長距離的柔性安排可能無效；單一接頭的容量再大也未必容納複合剪切與旋轉，鄰近襯砌可能先受損。
knowledge.textEn: Define fault location and width scenarios from geological evidence, analysing permanent and dynamic demands separately. Special joints or enlarged sections need project review rather than an average-strain substitute for fault assessment. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Concentrated offset can defeat flexibility distributed over a long distance. Even a large single-joint capacity may not accommodate combined shear and rotation before adjacent lining is damaged.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接斷層變形帶需求時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以地質證據建立可能位置及帶寬情境，將永久位移與動態需求交由結構模型分別處理。特殊接頭或擴挖方案須有專案審查，不能用平均應變替代斷層評估。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over fault deformation band demand, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Define fault location and width scenarios from geological evidence, analysing permanent and dynamic demands separately. Special joints or enlarged sections need project review rather than an average-strain substitute for fault assessment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斷層變形帶需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fault deformation band demand"?
options: 以地質證據建立可能位置及帶寬情境，將永久位移與動態需求交由結構模型分別處理。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要轉角邊緣張開符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Define fault location and width scenarios from geological evidence, analysing permanent and dynamic demands separately.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for rotation induced edge opening removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 以地質證據建立可能位置及帶寬情境，將永久位移與動態需求交由結構模型分別處理。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Define fault location and width scenarios from geological evidence, analysing permanent and dynamic demands separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斷層變形帶需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fault deformation band demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斷層變形帶需求」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fault deformation band demand” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若實際錯動集中於狹窄面，原本分散到長距離的柔性安排可能無效；單一接頭的容量再大也未必容納複合剪切與旋轉，鄰近襯砌可能先受損。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrated offset can defeat flexibility distributed over a long distance. Even a large single-joint capacity may not accommodate combined shear and rotation before adjacent lining is damaged. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若實際錯動集中於狹窄面，原本分散到長距離的柔性安排可能無效；單一接頭的容量再大也未必容納複合剪切與旋轉，鄰近襯砌可能先受損。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Even a large single-joint capacity may not accommodate combined shear and rotation before adjacent lining is damaged.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要斷層變形帶需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for fault deformation band demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若實際錯動集中於狹窄面，原本分散到長距離的柔性安排可能無效；單一接頭的容量再大也未必容納複合剪切與旋轉，鄰近襯砌可能先受損。
knowledge.textEn: Concentrated offset can defeat flexibility distributed over a long distance. Even a large single-joint capacity may not accommodate combined shear and rotation before adjacent lining is damaged.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斷層變形帶需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fault deformation band demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若實際錯動集中於狹窄面，原本分散到長距離的柔性安排可能無效；單一接頭的容量再大也未必容納複合剪切與旋轉，鄰近襯砌可能先受損。
只要串聯柔度分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Concentrated offset can defeat flexibility distributed over a long distance.
A nominal result for series compliance sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若實際錯動集中於狹窄面，原本分散到長距離的柔性安排可能無效；單一接頭的容量再大也未必容納複合剪切與旋轉，鄰近襯砌可能先受損。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Concentrated offset can defeat flexibility distributed over a long distance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 串聯柔度分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Series compliance sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「串聯柔度分配」如何影響隧道耐震接頭設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Series compliance sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic tunnel-joint design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩個接頭串聯承受相同力而分攤位移，柔度相加不是剛度直接相加。此模型需要相同作用方向且無旁路，土體及其他連接若提供平行路徑必須另建網路。假設k1=100MN/m、k2=50MN/m串聯，keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m；不適用直接並聯相加。串並聯判錯會大幅改變需求分配；較軟接頭可能吃掉大部分位移而先超限，若只用平均剛度，會掩蓋局部止水與連接件的控制情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「串聯柔度分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two series joints carry the same force and share displacement; add compliance rather than stiffness. The model assumes one direction without bypasses, while ground or other parallel connections require a different network. For series k1=100MN/m and k2=50MN/m, keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m, unlike a parallel stiffness sum. Confusing series and parallel paths changes demand allocation substantially. The softer joint can take most displacement and fail first while an average stiffness hides controlling seal and connector conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Series compliance sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設k1=100MN/m、k2=50MN/m串聯，keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m；不適用直接並聯相加。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For series k1=100MN/m and k2=50MN/m, keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m, unlike a parallel stiffness sum.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要串聯柔度分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for series compliance sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「串聯柔度分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Series compliance sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 串聯柔度分配
knowledge.text: 兩個接頭串聯承受相同力而分攤位移，柔度相加不是剛度直接相加。此模型需要相同作用方向且無旁路，土體及其他連接若提供平行路徑必須另建網路。
knowledge.textEn: Two series joints carry the same force and share displacement; add compliance rather than stiffness. The model assumes one direction without bypasses, while ground or other parallel connections require a different network.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要串聯柔度分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for series compliance sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「串聯柔度分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Series compliance sharing" is correct?
options: 只要串聯柔度分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要震後外水壓變化符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
兩個接頭串聯承受相同力而分攤位移，柔度相加不是剛度直接相加。
optionsEn: A nominal result for series compliance sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for post event water pressure change removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Two series joints carry the same force and share displacement; add compliance rather than stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 兩個接頭串聯承受相同力而分攤位移，柔度相加不是剛度直接相加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Two series joints carry the same force and share displacement; add compliance rather than stiffness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 串聯柔度分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Series compliance sharing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「串聯柔度分配」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Series compliance sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設k1=100MN/m、k2=50MN/m串聯，keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m；不適用直接並聯相加。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For series k1=100MN/m and k2=50MN/m, keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m, unlike a parallel stiffness sum. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出每個連接的受力路徑並檢查位移相容，用試驗或量測確認同力假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw load paths and displacement compatibility, checking the common-force assumption against tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設k1=100MN/m、k2=50MN/m串聯，keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m；不適用直接並聯相加。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For series k1=100MN/m and k2=50MN/m, keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m, unlike a parallel stiffness sum.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「串聯柔度分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Series compliance sharing", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設k1=100MN/m、k2=50MN/m串聯，keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m；不適用直接並聯相加。
只要波傳軸向應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要接頭剪切剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For series k1=100MN/m and k2=50MN/m, keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m, unlike a parallel stiffness sum.
A nominal result for wave induced axial strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for joint shear stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設k1=100MN/m、k2=50MN/m串聯，keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m；不適用直接並聯相加。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For series k1=100MN/m and k2=50MN/m, keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m, unlike a parallel stiffness sum. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 串聯柔度分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Series compliance sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「串聯柔度分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Series compliance sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出每個連接的受力路徑並檢查位移相容，用試驗或量測確認同力假設。若一處接頭閉合、摩擦鎖定或碰止擋，必須更新等效剛度與變形分配。同時排除以下干擾原因：串並聯判錯會大幅改變需求分配；較軟接頭可能吃掉大部分位移而先超限，若只用平均剛度，會掩蓋局部止水與連接件的控制情境。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw load paths and displacement compatibility, checking the common-force assumption against tests. Closure, friction locking or a stop at one joint requires updated stiffness and movement allocation. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Confusing series and parallel paths changes demand allocation substantially. The softer joint can take most displacement and fail first while an average stiffness hides controlling seal and connector conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接串聯柔度分配時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。畫出每個連接的受力路徑並檢查位移相容，用試驗或量測確認同力假設。若一處接頭閉合、摩擦鎖定或碰止擋，必須更新等效剛度與變形分配。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over series compliance sharing, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Draw load paths and displacement compatibility, checking the common-force assumption against tests. Closure, friction locking or a stop at one joint requires updated stiffness and movement allocation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：串並聯判錯會大幅改變需求分配；較軟接頭可能吃掉大部分位移而先超限，若只用平均剛度，會掩蓋局部止水與連接件的控制情境。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing series and parallel paths changes demand allocation substantially. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 畫出每個連接的受力路徑並檢查位移相容，用試驗或量測確認同力假設。若一處接頭閉合、摩擦鎖定或碰止擋，必須更新等效剛度與變形分配。同時排除以下干擾原因：串並聯判錯會大幅改變需求分配；較軟接頭可能吃掉大部分位移而先超限，若只用平均剛度，會掩蓋局部止水與連接件的控制情境。
knowledge.textEn: Draw load paths and displacement compatibility, checking the common-force assumption against tests. Closure, friction locking or a stop at one joint requires updated stiffness and movement allocation. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Confusing series and parallel paths changes demand allocation substantially. The softer joint can take most displacement and fail first while an average stiffness hides controlling seal and connector conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接串聯柔度分配時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。畫出每個連接的受力路徑並檢查位移相容，用試驗或量測確認同力假設。若一處接頭閉合、摩擦鎖定或碰止擋，必須更新等效剛度與變形分配。

Draw load paths and displacement compatibility, checking the common-force assumption against tests. quiz.question: 要驗證「串聯柔度分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Series compliance sharing"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
畫出每個連接的受力路徑並檢查位移相容，用試驗或量測確認同力假設。
只要止水壓縮幾何餘量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Draw load paths and displacement compatibility, checking the common-force assumption against tests.
A nominal result for seal compression geometry reserve removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 畫出每個連接的受力路徑並檢查位移相容，用試驗或量測確認同力假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw load paths and displacement compatibility, checking the common-force assumption against tests. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 串聯柔度分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Series compliance sharing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「串聯柔度分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Series compliance sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 串並聯判錯會大幅改變需求分配；較軟接頭可能吃掉大部分位移而先超限，若只用平均剛度，會掩蓋局部止水與連接件的控制情境。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing series and parallel paths changes demand allocation substantially. The softer joint can take most displacement and fail first while an average stiffness hides controlling seal and connector conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：串並聯判錯會大幅改變需求分配；較軟接頭可能吃掉大部分位移而先超限，若只用平均剛度，會掩蓋局部止水與連接件的控制情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The softer joint can take most displacement and fail first while an average stiffness hides controlling seal and connector conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要串聯柔度分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for series compliance sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 串並聯判錯會大幅改變需求分配；較軟接頭可能吃掉大部分位移而先超限，若只用平均剛度，會掩蓋局部止水與連接件的控制情境。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing series and parallel paths changes demand allocation substantially. The softer joint can take most displacement and fail first while an average stiffness hides controlling seal and connector conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「串聯柔度分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Series compliance sharing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要震後外水壓變化符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
串並聯判錯會大幅改變需求分配；較軟接頭可能吃掉大部分位移而先超限，若只用平均剛度，會掩蓋局部止水與連接件的控制情境。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for post event water pressure change removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Confusing series and parallel paths changes demand allocation substantially.
quiz.explanation: 串並聯判錯會大幅改變需求分配；較軟接頭可能吃掉大部分位移而先超限，若只用平均剛度，會掩蓋局部止水與連接件的控制情境。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing series and parallel paths changes demand allocation substantially. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「震後外水壓變化」與「位移容量與交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Post event water pressure change" and "Movement capacity and handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 震後外水壓變化：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Post event water pressure change: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「震後外水壓變化」如何影響隧道耐震接頭設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post event water pressure change” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic tunnel-joint design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地震後接頭需同時面對殘餘位移與可能改變的水壓，密封檢核不能只在無水狀態做。靜水壓增量簡單，但裂縫連通、排水損壞及水頭來源須由現場資料確認。假設外側水頭增加Δh=8m，Δu=γwΔh=9.81×8=78.48kPa，約78.5kPa；此為增加值而非總設計水壓。若只驗接頭沒有斷裂而忽略外水恢復，密封可能在稍後水頭升高才失效；排水系統同時受損時，漏水後果可能比單一構件損傷更嚴重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「震後外水壓變化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After shaking, joints face residual movement and potentially changed water pressure. Dry testing alone is insufficient; pressure increment is simple, but fracture connections, damaged drainage and head sources need field evidence. For an external head increase Δh=8m, Δu=78.48kPa, about78.5kPa. This is added pressure, not total design pressure. A joint may remain intact yet leak later as water head recovers. Concurrent drainage damage can make that leakage more consequential than the initial visible component damage suggests. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Post event water pressure change” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 震後外水壓變化
knowledge.text: 地震後接頭需同時面對殘餘位移與可能改變的水壓，密封檢核不能只在無水狀態做。靜水壓增量簡單，但裂縫連通、排水損壞及水頭來源須由現場資料確認。
knowledge.textEn: After shaking, joints face residual movement and potentially changed water pressure. Dry testing alone is insufficient; pressure increment is simple, but fracture connections, damaged drainage and head sources need field evidence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要震後外水壓變化符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for post event water pressure change removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「震後外水壓變化」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.instruction: 震後對照水位、滲漏與接頭位移，使用核准的壓力及變形組合評估剩餘功能。檢查排水與備援能力，重啟條件由業主和結構及水工責任人共同確認。同時排除以下干擾原因：若只驗接頭沒有斷裂而忽略外水恢復，密封可能在稍後水頭升高才失效；排水系統同時受損時，漏水後果可能比單一構件損傷更嚴重。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 位移容量與交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Movement capacity and handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「位移容量與交接」如何影響隧道耐震接頭設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Movement capacity and handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic tunnel-joint design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接頭容量須對應具體運動方向、水壓、老化及循環條件，不能把單軸試驗行程當所有組合的許可值。名義餘量幫助整理，最終仍要查多軸包絡與施工公差。假設同一方向相同試驗條件的容量40mm、需求25mm，餘量40−25=15mm；未包含旋轉、剪切及公差互制。若以最大試驗行程減平均需求，可能忽略最不利接頭與多軸組合；施工初始偏差已消耗部分容量時，表面正餘量不能證明震後仍可維持水密與通行。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「位移容量與交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint capacity belongs to a specified direction, pressure, ageing and cycling condition. A uniaxial stroke is not allowable for every combination; nominal reserve organizes evidence but needs multiaxis and tolerance checks. For capacity40mm and demand25mm in the same direction and test conditions, reserve is15mm, excluding rotation, shear and tolerance interaction. Subtracting mean demand from maximum test stroke misses critical joints and combined motion. Initial installation offsets may already consume capacity, so a positive nominal reserve cannot prove post-event sealing or access. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Movement capacity and handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For capacity40mm and demand25mm in the same direction and test conditions, reserve is15mm, excluding rotation, shear and tolerance interaction.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Movement capacity and handover" is correct?
options: 只要位移容量與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
接頭容量須對應具體運動方向、水壓、老化及循環條件，不能把單軸試驗行程當所有組合的許可值。
只要波傳軸向應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for movement capacity and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Joint capacity belongs to a specified direction, pressure, ageing and cycling condition.
A nominal result for wave induced axial strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 接頭容量須對應具體運動方向、水壓、老化及循環條件，不能把單軸試驗行程當所有組合的許可值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint capacity belongs to a specified direction, pressure, ageing and cycling condition. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 位移容量與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Movement capacity and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「位移容量與交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Movement capacity and handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同一方向相同試驗條件的容量40mm、需求25mm，餘量40−25=15mm；未包含旋轉、剪切及公差互制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For capacity40mm and demand25mm in the same direction and test conditions, reserve is15mm, excluding rotation, shear and tolerance interaction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接容量試驗、安裝偏差、監測零點及震後檢查流程，逐項核對設計包絡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Handover capacity tests, installation deviations, monitoring zeros and post-event procedures against the design envelope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同一方向相同試驗條件的容量40mm、需求25mm，餘量40−25=15mm；未包含旋轉、剪切及公差互制。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For capacity40mm and demand25mm in the same direction and test conditions, reserve is15mm, excluding rotation, shear and tolerance interaction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「位移容量與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Movement capacity and handover", which statement holds?
options: 只要接頭剪切剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要止水壓縮幾何餘量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同一方向相同試驗條件的容量40mm、需求25mm，餘量40−25=15mm；未包含旋轉、剪切及公差互制。
optionsEn: A nominal result for joint shear stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for seal compression geometry reserve removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For capacity40mm and demand25mm in the same direction and test conditions, reserve is15mm, excluding rotation, shear and tolerance interaction.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同一方向相同試驗條件的容量40mm、需求25mm，餘量40−25=15mm；未包含旋轉、剪切及公差互制。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For capacity40mm and demand25mm in the same direction and test conditions, reserve is15mm, excluding rotation, shear and tolerance interaction. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 位移容量與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Movement capacity and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「位移容量與交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Movement capacity and handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接容量試驗、安裝偏差、監測零點及震後檢查流程，逐項核對設計包絡。任何更換密封或連接件都需確認性能相容，責任工程師簽認後更新文件及警戒值。同時排除以下干擾原因：若以最大試驗行程減平均需求，可能忽略最不利接頭與多軸組合；施工初始偏差已消耗部分容量時，表面正餘量不能證明震後仍可維持水密與通行。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Handover capacity tests, installation deviations, monitoring zeros and post-event procedures against the design envelope. Replacement seals or connectors require compatibility review and engineering approval before documents and alarms are updated. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Subtracting mean demand from maximum test stroke misses critical joints and combined motion. Initial installation offsets may already consume capacity, so a positive nominal reserve cannot prove post-event sealing or access. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接位移容量與交接時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。交接容量試驗、安裝偏差、監測零點及震後檢查流程，逐項核對設計包絡。任何更換密封或連接件都需確認性能相容，責任工程師簽認後更新文件及警戒值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over movement capacity and handover, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Handover capacity tests, installation deviations, monitoring zeros and post-event procedures against the design envelope. Replacement seals or connectors require compatibility review and engineering approval before documents and alarms are updated.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以最大試驗行程減平均需求，可能忽略最不利接頭與多軸組合；施工初始偏差已消耗部分容量時，表面正餘量不能證明震後仍可維持水密與通行。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Subtracting mean demand from maximum test stroke misses critical joints and combined motion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接容量試驗、安裝偏差、監測零點及震後檢查流程，逐項核對設計包絡。任何更換密封或連接件都需確認性能相容，責任工程師簽認後更新文件及警戒值。同時排除以下干擾原因：若以最大試驗行程減平均需求，可能忽略最不利接頭與多軸組合；施工初始偏差已消耗部分容量時，表面正餘量不能證明震後仍可維持水密與通行。
knowledge.textEn: Handover capacity tests, installation deviations, monitoring zeros and post-event procedures against the design envelope. Replacement seals or connectors require compatibility review and engineering approval before documents and alarms are updated. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Subtracting mean demand from maximum test stroke misses critical joints and combined motion. Initial installation offsets may already consume capacity, so a positive nominal reserve cannot prove post-event sealing or access.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接位移容量與交接時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。交接容量試驗、安裝偏差、監測零點及震後檢查流程，逐項核對設計包絡。任何更換密封或連接件都需確認性能相容，責任工程師簽認後更新文件及警戒值。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over movement capacity and handover, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Handover capacity tests, installation deviations, monitoring zeros and post-event procedures against the design envelope. Replacement seals or connectors require compatibility review and engineering approval before documents and alarms are updated.

quiz.question: 要驗證「位移容量與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Movement capacity and handover"?
options: 交接容量試驗、安裝偏差、監測零點及震後檢查流程，逐項核對設計包絡。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要斷層變形帶需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Handover capacity tests, installation deviations, monitoring zeros and post-event procedures against the design envelope.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A nominal result for fault deformation band demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 交接容量試驗、安裝偏差、監測零點及震後檢查流程，逐項核對設計包絡。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Handover capacity tests, installation deviations, monitoring zeros and post-event procedures against the design envelope. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 位移容量與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Movement capacity and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「位移容量與交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Movement capacity and handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以最大試驗行程減平均需求，可能忽略最不利接頭與多軸組合；施工初始偏差已消耗部分容量時，表面正餘量不能證明震後仍可維持水密與通行。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Subtracting mean demand from maximum test stroke misses critical joints and combined motion. Initial installation offsets may already consume capacity, so a positive nominal reserve cannot prove post-event sealing or access. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若以最大試驗行程減平均需求，可能忽略最不利接頭與多軸組合；施工初始偏差已消耗部分容量時，表面正餘量不能證明震後仍可維持水密與通行。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Initial installation offsets may already consume capacity, so a positive nominal reserve cannot prove post-event sealing or access.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要位移容量與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for movement capacity and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以最大試驗行程減平均需求，可能忽略最不利接頭與多軸組合；施工初始偏差已消耗部分容量時，表面正餘量不能證明震後仍可維持水密與通行。
knowledge.textEn: Subtracting mean demand from maximum test stroke misses critical joints and combined motion. Initial installation offsets may already consume capacity, so a positive nominal reserve cannot prove post-event sealing or access.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「位移容量與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Movement capacity and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若以最大試驗行程減平均需求，可能忽略最不利接頭與多軸組合；施工初始偏差已消耗部分容量時，表面正餘量不能證明震後仍可維持水密與通行。
只要波傳軸向應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Subtracting mean demand from maximum test stroke misses critical joints and combined motion.
A nominal result for wave induced axial strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若以最大試驗行程減平均需求，可能忽略最不利接頭與多軸組合；施工初始偏差已消耗部分容量時，表面正餘量不能證明震後仍可維持水密與通行。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Subtracting mean demand from maximum test stroke misses critical joints and combined motion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 地下結構浮力穩定
summary: 本課聚焦以外水壓、有效重量與施工階段判讀地下結構抗浮。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on evaluate underground uplift through external water pressure, effective weight and construction stages. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：取水重度γw=9.81kN/m³及外包排水體積V=500m³，U=γwV=4905kN；此處假設箱體封閉且完全浸沒，並非混凝土重量。假設外包排水體積由500增為550m³而保持水重度9.81kN/m³，浮力由4905增為5395.5kN，增加490.5kN即10%；內部混凝土體積未參與這個體積替換。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With water unit weight γw=9.81kN/m³ and displaced envelope V=500m³, U=γwV=4905kN. The box is assumed sealed and fully submerged; this is not concrete weight. Increasing assumed displaced envelope volume from500 to550m³ at9.81kN/m³ changes uplift from4905 to5395.5kN, an increase of490.5kN or10%; internal concrete volume is not the displaced-volume input. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「外包排水體積」與「基底水壓分布」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Displaced envelope volume" and "Base water pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 外包排水體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Displaced envelope volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「外包排水體積」如何影響地下結構浮力穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Displaced envelope volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Uplift stability of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密閉地下箱體的總浮力來自周圍水壓在外表面的合力，不能只拿混凝土材料體積計算。模型先畫出水能到達的邊界，再辨別開口進水是否改變有效排水體積。取水重度γw=9.81kN/m³及外包排水體積V=500m³，U=γwV=4905kN；此處假設箱體封閉且完全浸沒，並非混凝土重量。若以混凝土量代替排水體積，空心箱體的上浮荷載會被低估；外水回升時可能先出現接縫張開、止水破壞，再發展成整體上浮。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「外包排水體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Net buoyancy on a sealed underground box is the resultant of water pressure on its external surfaces. Concrete material volume alone is not the displaced volume. First draw the boundary accessible to water, then determine whether flooding through an opening changes that displacement. With water unit weight γw=9.81kN/m³ and displaced envelope V=500m³, U=γwV=4905kN. The box is assumed sealed and fully submerged; this is not concrete weight. Substituting concrete volume for displaced volume underestimates uplift on a hollow box; rising external water can open joints and damage waterstops before global flotation progressively develops. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Displaced envelope volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Base water pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Uplift stability of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 基底水壓由壓力水頭控制，排水管有出水不代表整片底板都處於零水壓。分層滲透與局部堵塞可形成不均勻抬升，總合力及偏心需分別核算。水頭h=8m且靜水條件下，p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa，約78.5kPa；水頭須從底板外側所選測點起算。孔壓計濾頭若位在排水通道旁，讀值可偏低而掩蓋遠處高壓；平均水壓看似合理仍可能漏掉局部裂縫與板角翹起的控制區。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基底水壓分布」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Base pressure follows pressure head. Visible discharge from one drain does not prove zero pressure beneath the entire slab. Layered permeability and local blockage can produce uneven uplift, requiring separate checks of resultant force and eccentricity. For h=8m under hydrostatic conditions, p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa, about78.5kPa. Measure pressure head above the selected point on the external slab face. A sensor beside a drain can read low while remote pressure remains high; an apparently reasonable average can miss the locations controlling local cracking and corner uplift. quiz.question: 關於「基底水壓分布」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base water pressure" is correct?
options: 只要基底水壓分布符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要施工重量不足符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
基底水壓由壓力水頭控制，排水管有出水不代表整片底板都處於零水壓。
optionsEn: A nominal result for base water pressure removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for insufficient construction weight removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Base pressure follows pressure head.
quiz.explanation: 基底水壓由壓力水頭控制，排水管有出水不代表整片底板都處於零水壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Base pressure follows pressure head. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基底水壓分布：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base water pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基底水壓分布」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Base water pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：水頭h=8m且靜水條件下，p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa，約78.5kPa；水頭須從底板外側所選測點起算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For h=8m under hydrostatic conditions, p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa, about78.5kPa. Measure pressure head above the selected point on the external slab face. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在不同排水分區布置孔壓觀測，將每點高程轉為同一水頭再繪等壓圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe pore pressure across drainage zones and convert every elevation to a common head before mapping pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：水頭h=8m且靜水條件下，p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa，約78.5kPa；水頭須從底板外側所選測點起算。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For h=8m under hydrostatic conditions, p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa, about78.5kPa. Measure pressure head above the selected point on the external slab face.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基底水壓分布」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Base water pressure", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：水頭h=8m且靜水條件下，p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa，約78.5kPa；水頭須從底板外側所選測點起算。
只要側壁摩阻動員符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要底板局部彎曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For h=8m under hydrostatic conditions, p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa, about78.5kPa.
A nominal result for side friction mobilization removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for local slab bending removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For h=8m under hydrostatic conditions, p=γwh=9.81×8=78.48kPa, about78.5kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基底水壓分布：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base water pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基底水壓分布」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Base water pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在不同排水分區布置孔壓觀測，將每點高程轉為同一水頭再繪等壓圖。驗證孔壓計飽和、零點及量測時間，不能以單一集水井水位代替全底板壓力。同時排除以下干擾原因：孔壓計濾頭若位在排水通道旁，讀值可偏低而掩蓋遠處高壓；平均水壓看似合理仍可能漏掉局部裂縫與板角翹起的控制區。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe pore pressure across drainage zones and convert every elevation to a common head before mapping pressure. Check sensor saturation, zero and timing; one sump level cannot represent the full slab pressure field. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A sensor beside a drain can read low while remote pressure remains high; an apparently reasonable average can miss the locations controlling local cracking and corner uplift. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接基底水壓分布時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。在不同排水分區布置孔壓觀測，將每點高程轉為同一水頭再繪等壓圖。驗證孔壓計飽和、零點及量測時間，不能以單一集水井水位代替全底板壓力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over base water pressure, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Observe pore pressure across drainage zones and convert every elevation to a common head before mapping pressure. Check sensor saturation, zero and timing; one sump level cannot represent the full slab pressure field.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：孔壓計濾頭若位在排水通道旁，讀值可偏低而掩蓋遠處高壓；平均水壓看似合理仍可能漏掉局部裂縫與板角翹起的控制區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A sensor beside a drain can read low while remote pressure remains high; an apparently reasonable average can miss the locations controlling local cracking and corner uplift. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在不同排水分區布置孔壓觀測，將每點高程轉為同一水頭再繪等壓圖。驗證孔壓計飽和、零點及量測時間，不能以單一集水井水位代替全底板壓力。同時排除以下干擾原因：孔壓計濾頭若位在排水通道旁，讀值可偏低而掩蓋遠處高壓；平均水壓看似合理仍可能漏掉局部裂縫與板角翹起的控制區。
knowledge.textEn: Observe pore pressure across drainage zones and convert every elevation to a common head before mapping pressure. Check sensor saturation, zero and timing; one sump level cannot represent the full slab pressure field. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A sensor beside a drain can read low while remote pressure remains high; an apparently reasonable average can miss the locations controlling local cracking and corner uplift.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接基底水壓分布時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。在不同排水分區布置孔壓觀測，將每點高程轉為同一水頭再繪等壓圖。驗證孔壓計飽和、零點及量測時間，不能以單一集水井水位代替全底板壓力。

Observe pore pressure across drainage zones and convert every elevation to a common head before mapping pressure. Check sensor saturation, zero and timing; one sump level cannot represent the full slab pressure field.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基底水壓分布」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Base water pressure"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在不同排水分區布置孔壓觀測，將每點高程轉為同一水頭再繪等壓圖。
只要水位敏感度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Observe pore pressure across drainage zones and convert every elevation to a common head before mapping pressure.
A nominal result for water level sensitivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 在不同排水分區布置孔壓觀測，將每點高程轉為同一水頭再繪等壓圖。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Observe pore pressure across drainage zones and convert every elevation to a common head before mapping pressure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基底水壓分布：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base water pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基底水壓分布」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Base water pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 孔壓計濾頭若位在排水通道旁，讀值可偏低而掩蓋遠處高壓；平均水壓看似合理仍可能漏掉局部裂縫與板角翹起的控制區。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A sensor beside a drain can read low while remote pressure remains high; an apparently reasonable average can miss the locations controlling local cracking and corner uplift. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：孔壓計濾頭若位在排水通道旁，讀值可偏低而掩蓋遠處高壓；平均水壓看似合理仍可能漏掉局部裂縫與板角翹起的控制區。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A sensor beside a drain can read low while remote pressure remains high; an apparently reasonable average can miss the locations controlling local cracking and corner uplift.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要基底水壓分布符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for base water pressure removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 孔壓計濾頭若位在排水通道旁，讀值可偏低而掩蓋遠處高壓；平均水壓看似合理仍可能漏掉局部裂縫與板角翹起的控制區。
knowledge.textEn: A sensor beside a drain can read low while remote pressure remains high; an apparently reasonable average can miss the locations controlling local cracking and corner uplift.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基底水壓分布」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base water pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要施工重量不足符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
孔壓計濾頭若位在排水通道旁，讀值可偏低而掩蓋遠處高壓；平均水壓看似合理仍可能漏掉局部裂縫與板角翹起的控制區。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for insufficient construction weight removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A sensor beside a drain can read low while remote pressure remains high.
quiz.explanation: 孔壓計濾頭若位在排水通道旁，讀值可偏低而掩蓋遠處高壓；平均水壓看似合理仍可能漏掉局部裂縫與板角翹起的控制區。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A sensor beside a drain can read low while remote pressure remains high; an apparently reasonable average can miss the locations controlling local cracking and corner uplift. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工重量不足」與「抗拔樁荷載分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Insufficient construction weight" and "Tension pile distribution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工重量不足：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Insufficient construction weight: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工重量不足」如何影響地下結構浮力穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Insufficient construction weight” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Uplift stability of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抗浮不能只檢查完工樓板與覆土全部到位的狀態。開挖完成但上部結構尚輕時，外水恢復與停泵必須列為獨立施工階段，分清當時真正存在的永久重量。假設當期重量W=4000kN、浮力U=4905kN，未乘分項係數的比值W/U=0.815；小於1表示此理想平衡已不足，不能視為法規安全係數。將尚未施工的樓板重量提前計入，會在停電或提早停泵時失去抗浮儲備；即使最終設計足夠，施工期也可能發生不可逆接縫損傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工重量不足」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A final-state check with every floor and cover layer installed does not establish construction stability. After excavation but before the superstructure gains weight, water recovery and pump shutdown require separate staged checks using only loads actually present. Assume current weight W=4000kN and uplift U=4905kN. The unfactored ratio W/U=0.815 is below unity, indicating deficient ideal equilibrium; it is not a code safety factor. Crediting future floor weight removes the apparent uplift reserve during an outage or premature shutdown; an adequate final design can still suffer irreversible joint damage during construction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Insufficient construction weight” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設當期重量W=4000kN、浮力U=4905kN，未乘分項係數的比值W/U=0.815；小於1表示此理想平衡已不足，不能視為法規安全係數。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume current weight W=4000kN and uplift U=4905kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要施工重量不足符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for insufficient construction weight removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工重量不足」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Insufficient construction weight”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工重量不足
knowledge.text: 抗浮不能只檢查完工樓板與覆土全部到位的狀態。開挖完成但上部結構尚輕時，外水恢復與停泵必須列為獨立施工階段，分清當時真正存在的永久重量。
knowledge.textEn: A final-state check with every floor and cover layer installed does not establish construction stability. After excavation but before the superstructure gains weight, water recovery and pump shutdown require separate staged checks using only loads actually present.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要施工重量不足符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for insufficient construction weight removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工重量不足」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Insufficient construction weight" is correct?
options: 抗浮不能只檢查完工樓板與覆土全部到位的狀態。
只要施工重量不足符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要抗拔樁荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A final-state check with every floor and cover layer installed does not establish construction stability.
A nominal result for insufficient construction weight removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for tension pile distribution removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 抗浮不能只檢查完工樓板與覆土全部到位的狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A final-state check with every floor and cover layer installed does not establish construction stability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工重量不足：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Insufficient construction weight: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工重量不足」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Insufficient construction weight” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設當期重量W=4000kN、浮力U=4905kN，未乘分項係數的比值W/U=0.815；小於1表示此理想平衡已不足，不能視為法規安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume current weight W=4000kN and uplift U=4905kN. The unfactored ratio W/U=0.815 is below unity, indicating deficient ideal equilibrium; it is not a code safety factor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐層核對已澆置體積、實際材料重度及可依賴的荷載，將養護、回填與停泵時點排列成施工表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile placed volumes, material unit weights and dependable loads for every stage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 施工重量不足：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Insufficient construction weight: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工重量不足」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Insufficient construction weight” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐層核對已澆置體積、實際材料重度及可依賴的荷載，將養護、回填與停泵時點排列成施工表。責任工程師應依當期水位與分項設計重新核准轉換條件。同時排除以下干擾原因：將尚未施工的樓板重量提前計入，會在停電或提早停泵時失去抗浮儲備；即使最終設計足夠，施工期也可能發生不可逆接縫損傷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile placed volumes, material unit weights and dependable loads for every stage. Schedule curing, backfill and pump shutdown, and require the responsible engineer to approve each transition using current water levels and factored design checks. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Crediting future floor weight removes the apparent uplift reserve during an outage or premature shutdown; an adequate final design can still suffer irreversible joint damage during construction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over insufficient construction weight, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile placed volumes, material unit weights and dependable loads for every stage. Schedule curing, backfill and pump shutdown, and require the responsible engineer to approve each transition using current water levels and factored design checks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將尚未施工的樓板重量提前計入，會在停電或提早停泵時失去抗浮儲備；即使最終設計足夠，施工期也可能發生不可逆接縫損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Crediting future floor weight removes the apparent uplift reserve during an outage or premature shutdown; an adequate final design can still suffer irreversible joint damage during construction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 施工重量不足：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Insufficient construction weight: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工重量不足」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instructionEn: Crediting future floor weight removes the apparent uplift reserve during an outage or premature shutdown; an adequate final design can still suffer irreversible joint damage during construction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將尚未施工的樓板重量提前計入，會在停電或提早停泵時失去抗浮儲備；即使最終設計足夠，施工期也可能發生不可逆接縫損傷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Crediting future floor weight removes the apparent uplift reserve during an outage or premature shutdown; an adequate final design can still suffer irreversible joint damage during construction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要施工重量不足符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for insufficient construction weight removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將尚未施工的樓板重量提前計入，會在停電或提早停泵時失去抗浮儲備；即使最終設計足夠，施工期也可能發生不可逆接縫損傷。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工重量不足」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Insufficient construction weight" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 將尚未施工的樓板重量提前計入，會在停電或提早停泵時失去抗浮儲備；即使最終設計足夠，施工期也可能發生不可逆接縫損傷。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要抗拔樁荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Crediting future floor weight removes the apparent uplift reserve during an outage or premature shutdown.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A nominal result for tension pile distribution removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Crediting future floor weight removes the apparent uplift reserve during an outage or premature shutdown; an adequate final design can still suffer irreversible joint damage during construction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 抗拔樁荷載分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tension pile distribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「抗拔樁荷載分配」如何影響地下結構浮力穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tension pile distribution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Uplift stability of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抗拔樁把淨上浮力經底板接頭傳到樁身及周圍土層。平均分配只是剛度相近且幾何對稱時的第一輪估算，偏心、群樁互制及接頭延性不能由平均值證明。若U=6000kN、已存在重量W=4000kN且10支樁理想均分，T=(U−W)/10=200kN/樁；實際各樁須由相容變形與群樁分析確認。軟硬不均或樁頭鬆脫會讓鄰樁承受超過平均值的拉力；只看總樁數可能漏掉局部破壞，裂縫又會使防水失效並改變水壓條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「抗拔樁荷載分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tension piles transfer net uplift through slab connections into the pile shafts and surrounding ground. Equal sharing is only an initial estimate for comparable stiffness and symmetric geometry; it does not establish eccentric response, group interaction or connection ductility. For U=6000kN, existing W=4000kN and ten ideally equal piles, T=(U−W)/10=200kN per pile. Actual forces require compatible deformations and group analysis. Unequal stiffness or a loose pile head can overload adjacent piles beyond the mean; total pile count conceals local failure, while cracking damages waterproofing and changes the pressure boundary. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tension pile distribution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：若U=6000kN、已存在重量W=4000kN且10支樁理想均分，T=(U−W)/10=200kN/樁；實際各樁須由相容變形與群樁分析確認。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For U=6000kN, existing W=4000kN and ten ideally equal piles, T=(U−W)/10=200kN per pile.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要抗拔樁荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for tension pile distribution removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「抗拔樁荷載分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tension pile distribution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for tension pile distribution removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.
