steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：若U=6000kN、已存在重量W=4000kN且10支樁理想均分，T=(U−W)/10=200kN/樁；實際各樁須由相容變形與群樁分析確認。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For U=6000kN, existing W=4000kN and ten ideally equal piles, T=(U−W)/10=200kN per pile. Actual forces require compatible deformations and group analysis.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「抗拔樁荷載分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tension pile distribution", which statement holds?

A nominal result for water level sensitivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.title: 抗拔樁荷載分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tension pile distribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「抗拔樁荷載分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tension pile distribution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對樁頭拉力傳遞細部與代表性抗拔試驗，將量測伸長及荷載分配和計算剛度比較。試驗方法、持荷與驗收門檻由設計及試驗工程師訂定，不以課程數值代替。同時排除以下干擾原因：軟硬不均或樁頭鬆脫會讓鄰樁承受超過平均值的拉力；只看總樁數可能漏掉局部破壞，裂縫又會使防水失效並改變水壓條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review pile-head tension details and representative uplift tests. Compare measured elongation and force sharing with calculated stiffness; the design and testing engineers set the procedure, hold periods and acceptance limits rather than adopting course numbers. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Unequal stiffness or a loose pile head can overload adjacent piles beyond the mean; total pile count conceals local failure, while cracking damages waterproofing and changes the pressure boundary. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over tension pile distribution, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Review pile-head tension details and representative uplift tests. Compare measured elongation and force sharing with calculated stiffness; the design and testing engineers set the procedure, hold periods and acceptance limits rather than adopting course numbers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：軟硬不均或樁頭鬆脫會讓鄰樁承受超過平均值的拉力；只看總樁數可能漏掉局部破壞，裂縫又會使防水失效並改變水壓條件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unequal stiffness or a loose pile head can overload adjacent piles beyond the mean; total pile count conceals local failure, while cracking damages waterproofing and changes the pressure boundary. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「抗拔樁荷載分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 抗拔樁荷載分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tension pile distribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「抗拔樁荷載分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tension pile distribution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 軟硬不均或樁頭鬆脫會讓鄰樁承受超過平均值的拉力；只看總樁數可能漏掉局部破壞，裂縫又會使防水失效並改變水壓條件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unequal stiffness or a loose pile head can overload adjacent piles beyond the mean; total pile count conceals local failure, while cracking damages waterproofing and changes the pressure boundary. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：軟硬不均或樁頭鬆脫會讓鄰樁承受超過平均值的拉力；只看總樁數可能漏掉局部破壞，裂縫又會使防水失效並改變水壓條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unequal stiffness or a loose pile head can overload adjacent piles beyond the mean; total pile count conceals local failure, while cracking damages waterproofing and changes the pressure boundary.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要抗拔樁荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for tension pile distribution removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 軟硬不均或樁頭鬆脫會讓鄰樁承受超過平均值的拉力；只看總樁數可能漏掉局部破壞，裂縫又會使防水失效並改變水壓條件。
knowledge.textEn: Unequal stiffness or a loose pile head can overload adjacent piles beyond the mean; total pile count conceals local failure, while cracking damages waterproofing and changes the pressure boundary.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「抗拔樁荷載分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tension pile distribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
軟硬不均或樁頭鬆脫會讓鄰樁承受超過平均值的拉力；只看總樁數可能漏掉局部破壞，裂縫又會使防水失效並改變水壓條件。
只要側壁摩阻動員符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unequal stiffness or a loose pile head can overload adjacent piles beyond the mean.
A nominal result for side friction mobilization removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 軟硬不均或樁頭鬆脫會讓鄰樁承受超過平均值的拉力；只看總樁數可能漏掉局部破壞，裂縫又會使防水失效並改變水壓條件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unequal stiffness or a loose pile head can overload adjacent piles beyond the mean; total pile count conceals local failure, while cracking damages waterproofing and changes the pressure boundary. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「側壁摩阻動員」與「排水失效增量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Side friction mobilization" and "Drainage failure increment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 側壁摩阻動員：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Side friction mobilization: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「側壁摩阻動員」如何影響地下結構浮力穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Side friction mobilization” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Uplift stability of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側壁土體能否提供向下阻力取決於相對位移、界面及有效應力，不是接觸就自動產生全額抗力。回填鬆動、滑動層或防水保護膜都可能降低可動員的摩阻。假設已證明可動員的平均剪應力τ=15kPa、接觸面積A=100m²，R=τA=1500kN；尚未驗證的接觸面不可直接套此抗力。把極限摩阻當作零位移即可使用的反力，會隱藏服務性失效；結構必須上浮後才得到阻力，屆時密封接縫可能已經拉開而不能恢復。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側壁摩阻動員」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Downward side resistance depends on relative movement, interface properties and effective stress, rather than contact alone. Loose backfill, slip layers or waterproofing protection sheets may reduce the resistance that can actually be mobilized. If mobilizable average shear stress τ=15kPa is demonstrated over A=100m², R=τA=1500kN. An unverified interface must not automatically receive this resistance. Treating ultimate friction as a zero-movement reaction hides serviceability failure; sufficient uplift may be needed to mobilize resistance only after sealing joints have opened irreversibly. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Side friction mobilization” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已證明可動員的平均剪應力τ=15kPa、接觸面積A=100m²，R=τA=1500kN；尚未驗證的接觸面不可直接套此抗力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If mobilizable average shear stress τ=15kPa is demonstrated over A=100m², R=τA=1500kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要側壁摩阻動員符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for side friction mobilization removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「側壁摩阻動員」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Side friction mobilization”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 側壁摩阻動員
knowledge.text: 側壁土體能否提供向下阻力取決於相對位移、界面及有效應力，不是接觸就自動產生全額抗力。回填鬆動、滑動層或防水保護膜都可能降低可動員的摩阻。
knowledge.textEn: Downward side resistance depends on relative movement, interface properties and effective stress, rather than contact alone. Loose backfill, slip layers or waterproofing protection sheets may reduce the resistance that can actually be mobilized.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要側壁摩阻動員符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for side friction mobilization removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「側壁摩阻動員」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Side friction mobilization" is correct?
options: 只要側壁摩阻動員符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要排水失效增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

A nominal result for drainage failure increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Downward side resistance depends on relative movement, interface properties and effective stress, rather than contact alone.

quiz.explanationEn: Downward side resistance depends on relative movement, interface properties and effective stress, rather than contact alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.titleEn: Side friction mobilization: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「側壁摩阻動員」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Side friction mobilization” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已證明可動員的平均剪應力τ=15kPa、接觸面積A=100m²，R=τA=1500kN；尚未驗證的接觸面不可直接套此抗力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect interface materials and backfill records, comparing shear-test conditions with field effective stress.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已證明可動員的平均剪應力τ=15kPa、接觸面積A=100m²，R=τA=1500kN；尚未驗證的接觸面不可直接套此抗力。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Side friction mobilization” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查驗界面材料與施工回填紀錄，將剪切試驗條件和現地有效應力比較。另列達到假設摩阻所需位移，檢查該位移是否已超過止水與鄰接管線容許變形。同時排除以下干擾原因：把極限摩阻當作零位移即可使用的反力，會隱藏服務性失效；結構必須上浮後才得到阻力，屆時密封接縫可能已經拉開而不能恢復。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 側壁摩阻動員：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Side friction mobilization: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「側壁摩阻動員」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Side friction mobilization” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把極限摩阻當作零位移即可使用的反力，會隱藏服務性失效；結構必須上浮後才得到阻力，屆時密封接縫可能已經拉開而不能恢復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating ultimate friction as a zero-movement reaction hides serviceability failure; sufficient uplift may be needed to mobilize resistance only after sealing joints have opened irreversibly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把極限摩阻當作零位移即可使用的反力，會隱藏服務性失效；結構必須上浮後才得到阻力，屆時密封接縫可能已經拉開而不能恢復。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating ultimate friction as a zero-movement reaction hides serviceability failure; sufficient uplift may be needed to mobilize resistance only after sealing joints have opened irreversibly.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要側壁摩阻動員符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for side friction mobilization removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A nominal result for drainage failure increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Treating ultimate friction as a zero-movement reaction hides serviceability failure.

steps.title: 排水失效增量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drainage failure increment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水失效增量」如何影響地下結構浮力穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drainage failure increment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Uplift stability of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抽排系統降低作用水頭，但電力、濾層與排放路徑是會退化的外部條件。抗浮評估應把排水正常與失效分列，並追蹤水位恢復速度，而非只記泵浦額定流量。此處研究底板下表面水壓，須假設上表面乾燥或壓力固定；完全浸沒封閉箱體還有頂面向下水壓，淨浮力不能只取底面增量。假設均勻增加水頭Δh=3m、底面A=200m²，ΔU=γwAΔh=9.81×200×3=5886kN；此為底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定時的上浮合力增量；不適用於外包體積固定且完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力，後者仍為γwV。流量下降可能表示水源減少，也可能是濾層堵塞；若誤判成環境變乾而取消備援，水壓可在無出水的情況下升高並危及整體穩定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水失效增量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pumping reduces head but depends on power, filters and discharge paths that can deteriorate. Evaluate normal drainage separately from failure, tracking water-level recovery rather than treating a pump nameplate flow as proof of uplift control. Here the lower slab-face pressure is studied with the upper face dry or held at fixed pressure; a fully submerged sealed box also gains downward roof pressure, so its net buoyancy cannot be obtained from the bottom increment alone. For uniform Δh=3m over A=200m², ΔU=γwAΔh=5886kN assumes the upper slab face remains dry or at fixed pressure. A sealed, fully submerged box of fixed volume retains net buoyancy γwV instead. Reduced flow can mean less recharge or a blocked filter. Mistaking blockage for drying can remove backup capacity while hidden pressure rises despite little discharge and threatens global stability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drainage failure increment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設均勻增加水頭Δh=3m、底面A=200m²，ΔU=γwAΔh=9.81×200×3=5886kN；此為底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定時的上浮合力增量；不適用於外包體積固定且完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力，後者仍為γwV。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform Δh=3m over A=200m², ΔU=γwAΔh=5886kN assumes the upper slab face remains dry or at fixed pressure.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要排水失效增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for drainage failure increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水失效增量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drainage failure increment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設均勻增加水頭Δh=3m、底面A=200m²，ΔU=γwAΔh=9.81×200×3=5886kN；此為底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定時的上浮合力增量；不適用於外包體積固定且完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力，後者仍為γwV。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

A sealed, fully submerged box of fixed volume retains net buoyancy γwV instead. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use controlled scenario analysis to compare backup-power failure, blockage and high external water.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

optionsEn: A nominal result for water level sensitivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform Δh=3m over A=200m², ΔU=γwAΔh=5886kN assumes the upper slab face remains dry or at fixed pressure.

steps.title: 排水失效增量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drainage failure increment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水失效增量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drainage failure increment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以受控情境分析比較備援供電、排水堵塞及高外水位的孔壓反應，檢查警報傳遞與值班回應時間。任何停泵試驗須經工程師批准並配有獨立監測與停止條件。同時排除以下干擾原因：流量下降可能表示水源減少，也可能是濾層堵塞；若誤判成環境變乾而取消備援，水壓可在無出水的情況下升高並危及整體穩定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use controlled scenario analysis to compare backup-power failure, blockage and high external water. Check alarm delivery and response times; any shutdown test needs engineering approval, independent monitoring and defined stop conditions. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Reduced flow can mean less recharge or a blocked filter. Mistaking blockage for drying can remove backup capacity while hidden pressure rises despite little discharge and threatens global stability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接排水失效增量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以受控情境分析比較備援供電、排水堵塞及高外水位的孔壓反應，檢查警報傳遞與值班回應時間。任何停泵試驗須經工程師批准並配有獨立監測與停止條件。

Use controlled scenario analysis to compare backup-power failure, blockage and high external water. Check alarm delivery and response times; any shutdown test needs engineering approval, independent monitoring and defined stop conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：流量下降可能表示水源減少，也可能是濾層堵塞；若誤判成環境變乾而取消備援，水壓可在無出水的情況下升高並危及整體穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reduced flow can mean less recharge or a blocked filter. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排水失效增量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drainage failure increment"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要施工重量不足符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
以受控情境分析比較備援供電、排水堵塞及高外水位的孔壓反應，檢查警報傳遞與值班回應時間。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A nominal result for insufficient construction weight removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Use controlled scenario analysis to compare backup-power failure, blockage and high external water.

steps.title: 排水失效增量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drainage failure increment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排水失效增量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drainage failure increment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 流量下降可能表示水源減少，也可能是濾層堵塞；若誤判成環境變乾而取消備援，水壓可在無出水的情況下升高並危及整體穩定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reduced flow can mean less recharge or a blocked filter. Mistaking blockage for drying can remove backup capacity while hidden pressure rises despite little discharge and threatens global stability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：流量下降可能表示水源減少，也可能是濾層堵塞；若誤判成環境變乾而取消備援，水壓可在無出水的情況下升高並危及整體穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mistaking blockage for drying can remove backup capacity while hidden pressure rises despite little discharge and threatens global stability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要排水失效增量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for drainage failure increment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 流量下降可能表示水源減少，也可能是濾層堵塞；若誤判成環境變乾而取消備援，水壓可在無出水的情況下升高並危及整體穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Reduced flow can mean less recharge or a blocked filter. Mistaking blockage for drying can remove backup capacity while hidden pressure rises despite little discharge and threatens global stability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「排水失效增量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drainage failure increment" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 流量下降可能表示水源減少，也可能是濾層堵塞；若誤判成環境變乾而取消備援，水壓可在無出水的情況下升高並危及整體穩定。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要底板局部彎曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reduced flow can mean less recharge or a blocked filter.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A nominal result for local slab bending removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 流量下降可能表示水源減少，也可能是濾層堵塞；若誤判成環境變乾而取消備援，水壓可在無出水的情況下升高並危及整體穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reduced flow can mean less recharge or a blocked filter. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「底板局部彎曲」與「偏心水壓力矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Local slab bending" and "Eccentric uplift moment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 底板局部彎曲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local slab bending: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「底板局部彎曲」如何影響地下結構浮力穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local slab bending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Uplift stability of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 整體重量足以抵抗浮力仍不代表底板每一跨可承受局部水壓。簡支單向帶模型用於辨識彎矩量級，實際雙向配筋、支承剛度及裂縫寬度需要另外設計。取淨上向壓力p=80kPa、跨L=4m與1m板帶，線荷載w=80kN/m，M=wL²/8=160kN·m每米板寬；簡支假設不含連續板負彎矩。若把上向水壓照抄成下向重力的配筋方向，受拉面可能缺筋；總抗浮比值仍正常時，跨中或支承裂縫已可形成滲流通道並降低耐久性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「底板局部彎曲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Global resistance to buoyancy does not prove that every slab span resists local pressure. A simply supported one-way strip estimates moment scale; actual two-way reinforcement, support stiffness and crack width require separate design. For net upward p=80kPa, span L=4m and a one-metre strip, w=80kN/m and M=wL²/8=160kN·m per metre width. Simple supports omit continuity moments. Copying reinforcement orientation from downward gravity loading can leave the uplift tension face deficient. Even with adequate global equilibrium, support or midspan cracks can admit water and reduce durability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local slab bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：取淨上向壓力p=80kPa、跨L=4m與1m板帶，線荷載w=80kN/m，M=wL²/8=160kN·m每米板寬；簡支假設不含連續板負彎矩。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For net upward p=80kPa, span L=4m and a one-metre strip, w=80kN/m and M=wL²/8=160kN·m per metre width.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要底板局部彎曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for local slab bending removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「底板局部彎曲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local slab bending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 底板局部彎曲
knowledge.text: 整體重量足以抵抗浮力仍不代表底板每一跨可承受局部水壓。簡支單向帶模型用於辨識彎矩量級，實際雙向配筋、支承剛度及裂縫寬度需要另外設計。
knowledge.textEn: Global resistance to buoyancy does not prove that every slab span resists local pressure. A simply supported one-way strip estimates moment scale; actual two-way reinforcement, support stiffness and crack width require separate design.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要底板局部彎曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for local slab bending removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「底板局部彎曲」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Local slab bending" is correct?
options: 只要底板局部彎曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
整體重量足以抵抗浮力仍不代表底板每一跨可承受局部水壓。
只要偏心水壓力矩符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for local slab bending removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Global resistance to buoyancy does not prove that every slab span resists local pressure.
A nominal result for eccentric uplift moment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 整體重量足以抵抗浮力仍不代表底板每一跨可承受局部水壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Global resistance to buoyancy does not prove that every slab span resists local pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 底板局部彎曲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Local slab bending: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「底板局部彎曲」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local slab bending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：取淨上向壓力p=80kPa、跨L=4m與1m板帶，線荷載w=80kN/m，M=wL²/8=160kN·m每米板寬；簡支假設不含連續板負彎矩。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For net upward p=80kPa, span L=4m and a one-metre strip, w=80kN/m and M=wL²/8=160kN·m per metre width. Simple supports omit continuity moments. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照底板跨距、樁柱位置與實際支承條件畫出彎矩圖，再核對上下層鋼筋與接頭錨定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw moments using actual spans, pile and column locations and support conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取淨上向壓力p=80kPa、跨L=4m與1m板帶，線荷載w=80kN/m，M=wL²/8=160kN·m每米板寬；簡支假設不含連續板負彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For net upward p=80kPa, span L=4m and a one-metre strip, w=80kN/m and M=wL²/8=160kN·m per metre width. Simple supports omit continuity moments.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「底板局部彎曲」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Local slab bending", which statement holds?

只要基底水壓分布符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

optionsEn: A nominal result for uplift evidence handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for base water pressure removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For net upward p=80kPa, span L=4m and a one-metre strip, w=80kN/m and M=wL²/8=160kN·m per metre width.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For net upward p=80kPa, span L=4m and a one-metre strip, w=80kN/m and M=wL²/8=160kN·m per metre width. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 底板局部彎曲：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Local slab bending: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「底板局部彎曲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local slab bending” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照底板跨距、樁柱位置與實際支承條件畫出彎矩圖，再核對上下層鋼筋與接頭錨定。裂縫量測須記錄水位，讓服務性驗證與荷載狀態相互對應。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把上向水壓照抄成下向重力的配筋方向，受拉面可能缺筋；總抗浮比值仍正常時，跨中或支承裂縫已可形成滲流通道並降低耐久性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw moments using actual spans, pile and column locations and support conditions. Check reinforcement on both faces and anchorage; record water level alongside crack measurements so serviceability observations correspond to the applied load. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Copying reinforcement orientation from downward gravity loading can leave the uplift tension face deficient. Even with adequate global equilibrium, support or midspan cracks can admit water and reduce durability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Check reinforcement on both faces and anchorage; record water level alongside crack measurements so serviceability observations correspond to the applied load.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把上向水壓照抄成下向重力的配筋方向，受拉面可能缺筋；總抗浮比值仍正常時，跨中或支承裂縫已可形成滲流通道並降低耐久性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 底板局部彎曲：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local slab bending: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「底板局部彎曲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local slab bending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把上向水壓照抄成下向重力的配筋方向，受拉面可能缺筋；總抗浮比值仍正常時，跨中或支承裂縫已可形成滲流通道並降低耐久性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Copying reinforcement orientation from downward gravity loading can leave the uplift tension face deficient. Even with adequate global equilibrium, support or midspan cracks can admit water and reduce durability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把上向水壓照抄成下向重力的配筋方向，受拉面可能缺筋；總抗浮比值仍正常時，跨中或支承裂縫已可形成滲流通道並降低耐久性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Even with adequate global equilibrium, support or midspan cracks can admit water and reduce durability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要底板局部彎曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for local slab bending removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把上向水壓照抄成下向重力的配筋方向，受拉面可能缺筋；總抗浮比值仍正常時，跨中或支承裂縫已可形成滲流通道並降低耐久性。
knowledge.textEn: Copying reinforcement orientation from downward gravity loading can leave the uplift tension face deficient. Even with adequate global equilibrium, support or midspan cracks can admit water and reduce durability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「底板局部彎曲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Local slab bending" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把上向水壓照抄成下向重力的配筋方向，受拉面可能缺筋；總抗浮比值仍正常時，跨中或支承裂縫已可形成滲流通道並降低耐久性。
只要偏心水壓力矩符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Copying reinforcement orientation from downward gravity loading can leave the uplift tension face deficient.
A nominal result for eccentric uplift moment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若把上向水壓照抄成下向重力的配筋方向，受拉面可能缺筋；總抗浮比值仍正常時，跨中或支承裂縫已可形成滲流通道並降低耐久性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Copying reinforcement orientation from downward gravity loading can leave the uplift tension face deficient. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 偏心水壓力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Eccentric uplift moment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「偏心水壓力矩」如何影響地下結構浮力穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentric uplift moment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Uplift stability of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不均勻水壓讓合力偏離重量中心，帶來轉動及樁頭拉力差。計算總浮力時必須保留作用位置，不能把分區孔壓平均後就丟掉偏心資訊。若浮力U=5000kN偏心e=0.5m，附加力矩M=Ue=2500kN·m；它必須與重量、支承反力在同一參考點取矩平衡。只將合力除以總面積會掩蓋一側先離地的情境；隨支承接觸消失，原本假設的反力分配失效，接縫張開與樁力集中會彼此加劇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「偏心水壓力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven pressure displaces the uplift resultant from the centre of gravity and creates rotation and unequal pile forces. Preserve load locations when summing uplift; averaging compartment pressures must not erase their eccentricity. If U=5000kN acts at eccentricity e=0.5m, M=Ue=2500kN·m. Balance it with weight and support reactions about the same reference point. Dividing total uplift by total area conceals early separation on one side; losing contact invalidates assumed reactions, allowing joint opening and concentrated pile tension to reinforce each other. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric uplift moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：若浮力U=5000kN偏心e=0.5m，附加力矩M=Ue=2500kN·m；它必須與重量、支承反力在同一參考點取矩平衡。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If U=5000kN acts at eccentricity e=0.5m, M=Ue=2500kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要偏心水壓力矩符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for eccentric uplift moment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「偏心水壓力矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Eccentric uplift moment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 偏心水壓力矩
knowledge.text: 不均勻水壓讓合力偏離重量中心，帶來轉動及樁頭拉力差。計算總浮力時必須保留作用位置，不能把分區孔壓平均後就丟掉偏心資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven pressure displaces the uplift resultant from the centre of gravity and creates rotation and unequal pile forces. Preserve load locations when summing uplift; averaging compartment pressures must not erase their eccentricity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要偏心水壓力矩符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for eccentric uplift moment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「偏心水壓力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Eccentric uplift moment" is correct?
options: 只要偏心水壓力矩符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要水位敏感度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
不均勻水壓讓合力偏離重量中心，帶來轉動及樁頭拉力差。
optionsEn: A nominal result for eccentric uplift moment removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for water level sensitivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Uneven pressure displaces the uplift resultant from the centre of gravity and creates rotation and unequal pile forces.
quiz.explanation: 不均勻水壓讓合力偏離重量中心，帶來轉動及樁頭拉力差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Uneven pressure displaces the uplift resultant from the centre of gravity and creates rotation and unequal pile forces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 偏心水壓力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Eccentric uplift moment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏心水壓力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eccentric uplift moment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：若浮力U=5000kN偏心e=0.5m，附加力矩M=Ue=2500kN·m；它必須與重量、支承反力在同一參考點取矩平衡。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If U=5000kN acts at eccentricity e=0.5m, M=Ue=2500kN·m. Balance it with weight and support reactions about the same reference point. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將孔壓分區合力與坐標同時輸入自由體圖，用測量儀與傾度計比較板面變形方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Enter pressure-zone forces and coordinates together in a free-body diagram.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：若浮力U=5000kN偏心e=0.5m，附加力矩M=Ue=2500kN·m；它必須與重量、支承反力在同一參考點取矩平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If U=5000kN acts at eccentricity e=0.5m, M=Ue=2500kN·m. Balance it with weight and support reactions about the same reference point.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「偏心水壓力矩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Eccentric uplift moment", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：若浮力U=5000kN偏心e=0.5m，附加力矩M=Ue=2500kN·m；它必須與重量、支承反力在同一參考點取矩平衡。
只要外包排水體積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要施工重量不足符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If U=5000kN acts at eccentricity e=0.5m, M=Ue=2500kN·m.
A nominal result for displaced envelope volume removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for insufficient construction weight removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：若浮力U=5000kN偏心e=0.5m，附加力矩M=Ue=2500kN·m；它必須與重量、支承反力在同一參考點取矩平衡。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If U=5000kN acts at eccentricity e=0.5m, M=Ue=2500kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instruction: 將孔壓分區合力與坐標同時輸入自由體圖，用測量儀與傾度計比較板面變形方向。若模型預測和轉動相反，先查感測器高程、分區連通及重量偏心。同時排除以下干擾原因：只將合力除以總面積會掩蓋一側先離地的情境；隨支承接觸消失，原本假設的反力分配失效，接縫張開與樁力集中會彼此加劇。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 偏心水壓力矩：失效診斷

steps.instructionEn: Dividing total uplift by total area conceals early separation on one side; losing contact invalidates assumed reactions, allowing joint opening and concentrated pile tension to reinforce each other. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水位敏感度」與「抗浮證據交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Water level sensitivity" and "Uplift evidence handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水位敏感度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water level sensitivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水位敏感度」如何影響地下結構浮力穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water level sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Uplift stability of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 維護期的抗浮警報應連結水位對荷載的敏感度，而不只使用固定高程。均勻底板面積提供簡單斜率，若淹水邊界或排水分區改變，須重新建立作用面積。此斜率是底板下表面水壓對固定上表面壓力的合力增量；完全浸沒封閉箱體的頂面水壓增量須另計。取A=300m²且作用面積固定，dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m；假設底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定，水位每增加1m，底板上浮合力增加2943kN；固定體積完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力γwV不隨此水位上升增加。若新增鄰近抽水或外部回填改變水流卻仍沿用舊斜率，警報可能無法代表現況；高解析度感測器也不能修正錯誤的有效面積與水力邊界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水位敏感度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Operational alarms should reflect the sensitivity of load to water level rather than relying only on a fixed elevation. A uniform footprint gives a simple slope; changing inundation or drainage boundaries requires an updated effective area. This slope describes the lower slab-face force relative to a fixed upper-face pressure; a fully submerged sealed box also requires the roof-pressure increment. With fixed A=300m², dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m. Assuming the upper slab face is dry or at fixed pressure, a one-metre rise adds2943kN to slab uplift. Net buoyancy γwV of a fully submerged sealed box of fixed volume does not increase with this water-level rise. Nearby pumping or backfill can alter flow while an old slope remains in use; even a high-resolution sensor cannot correct the wrong effective area or hydraulic boundary in an outdated alarm model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water level sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：取A=300m²且作用面積固定，dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m；假設底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定，水位每增加1m，底板上浮合力增加2943kN；固定體積完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力γwV不隨此水位上升增加。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With fixed A=300m², dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要水位敏感度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for water level sensitivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水位敏感度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water level sensitivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水位敏感度
knowledge.text: 維護期的抗浮警報應連結水位對荷載的敏感度，而不只使用固定高程。均勻底板面積提供簡單斜率，若淹水邊界或排水分區改變，須重新建立作用面積。
knowledge.textEn: Operational alarms should reflect the sensitivity of load to water level rather than relying only on a fixed elevation. A uniform footprint gives a simple slope; changing inundation or drainage boundaries requires an updated effective area.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要水位敏感度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for water level sensitivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水位敏感度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water level sensitivity" is correct?
options: 維護期的抗浮警報應連結水位對荷載的敏感度，而不只使用固定高程。
只要水位敏感度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要抗浮證據交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Operational alarms should reflect the sensitivity of load to water level rather than relying only on a fixed elevation.
A nominal result for water level sensitivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for uplift evidence handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 維護期的抗浮警報應連結水位對荷載的敏感度，而不只使用固定高程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Operational alarms should reflect the sensitivity of load to water level rather than relying only on a fixed elevation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水位敏感度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water level sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水位敏感度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water level sensitivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：取A=300m²且作用面積固定，dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m；假設底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定，水位每增加1m，底板上浮合力增加2943kN；固定體積完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力γwV不隨此水位上升增加。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With fixed A=300m², dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m. Assuming the upper slab face is dry or at fixed pressure, a one-metre rise adds2943kN to slab uplift. Net buoyancy γwV of a fully submerged sealed box of fixed volume does not increase with this water-level rise. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以季節水位紀錄估計合理變動範圍，將量測不確定性乘上敏感度得到荷載誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate credible variations from seasonal records and multiply level uncertainty by sensitivity to obtain force uncertainty.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取A=300m²且作用面積固定，dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m；假設底板上表面乾燥或壓力固定，水位每增加1m，底板上浮合力增加2943kN；固定體積完全浸沒封閉箱體的淨浮力γwV不隨此水位上升增加。

Assuming the upper slab face is dry or at fixed pressure, a one-metre rise adds2943kN to slab uplift. Net buoyancy γwV of a fully submerged sealed box of fixed volume does not increase with this water-level rise.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水位敏感度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Water level sensitivity", which statement holds?
options: 只要基底水壓分布符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：取A=300m²且作用面積固定，dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m。
只要抗拔樁荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With fixed A=300m², dU/dh=γwA=9.81×300=2943kN/m.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water level sensitivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以季節水位紀錄估計合理變動範圍，將量測不確定性乘上敏感度得到荷載誤差。由維護與設計負責人共同訂警戒層級及回應時限，保存每次修改理由。同時排除以下干擾原因：若新增鄰近抽水或外部回填改變水流卻仍沿用舊斜率，警報可能無法代表現況；高解析度感測器也不能修正錯誤的有效面積與水力邊界。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate credible variations from seasonal records and multiply level uncertainty by sensitivity to obtain force uncertainty. steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over water level sensitivity, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Estimate credible variations from seasonal records and multiply level uncertainty by sensitivity to obtain force uncertainty. Maintenance and design leads should jointly set alarm levels and response times, retaining the rationale for each change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若新增鄰近抽水或外部回填改變水流卻仍沿用舊斜率，警報可能無法代表現況；高解析度感測器也不能修正錯誤的有效面積與水力邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nearby pumping or backfill can alter flow while an old slope remains in use; even a high-resolution sensor cannot correct the wrong effective area or hydraulic boundary in an outdated alarm model. steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以季節水位紀錄估計合理變動範圍，將量測不確定性乘上敏感度得到荷載誤差。由維護與設計負責人共同訂警戒層級及回應時限，保存每次修改理由。同時排除以下干擾原因：若新增鄰近抽水或外部回填改變水流卻仍沿用舊斜率，警報可能無法代表現況；高解析度感測器也不能修正錯誤的有效面積與水力邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate credible variations from seasonal records and multiply level uncertainty by sensitivity to obtain force uncertainty. Maintenance and design leads should jointly set alarm levels and response times, retaining the rationale for each change. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Nearby pumping or backfill can alter flow while an old slope remains in use; even a high-resolution sensor cannot correct the wrong effective area or hydraulic boundary in an outdated alarm model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接水位敏感度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以季節水位紀錄估計合理變動範圍，將量測不確定性乘上敏感度得到荷載誤差。由維護與設計負責人共同訂警戒層級及回應時限，保存每次修改理由。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over water level sensitivity, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Estimate credible variations from seasonal records and multiply level uncertainty by sensitivity to obtain force uncertainty. Maintenance and design leads should jointly set alarm levels and response times, retaining the rationale for each change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水位敏感度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

以季節水位紀錄估計合理變動範圍，將量測不確定性乘上敏感度得到荷載誤差。

quiz.explanationEn: Estimate credible variations from seasonal records and multiply level uncertainty by sensitivity to obtain force uncertainty. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水位敏感度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water level sensitivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水位敏感度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 若新增鄰近抽水或外部回填改變水流卻仍沿用舊斜率，警報可能無法代表現況；高解析度感測器也不能修正錯誤的有效面積與水力邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Nearby pumping or backfill can alter flow while an old slope remains in use; even a high-resolution sensor cannot correct the wrong effective area or hydraulic boundary in an outdated alarm model.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若新增鄰近抽水或外部回填改變水流卻仍沿用舊斜率，警報可能無法代表現況；高解析度感測器也不能修正錯誤的有效面積與水力邊界。

quiz.question: 在「水位敏感度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 抗浮證據交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Uplift evidence handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「抗浮證據交接」如何影響地下結構浮力穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Uplift evidence handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Uplift stability of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 交接要同時保存永久重量、可動員抗力及高水位情境，讓維護者知道哪些能力依賴機械排水。抗力不得重複計入，例如同一土塊重量與同一滑面摩阻需核對相容機制。假設同一可相容工況W=7000kN、額外抗力R=1000kN、U=7500kN，未分項餘量W+R−U=500kN；正餘量本身不等於通過所有規範。把設計圖上的抗力視為永久不變會忽略腐蝕、蠕變及排水堵塞；若責任移交未包含高水位情境，維護者可能在不知情下改變穩定機制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「抗浮證據交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Handover must preserve dependable weight, mobilizable resistance and high-water scenarios so operators know which capacity relies on pumping. Avoid double counting, for example when the same soil mass and interface resistance participate in incompatible mechanisms. For one compatible scenario with W=7000kN, additional R=1000kN and U=7500kN, the unfactored margin W+R−U=500kN. A positive margin alone is not full code compliance. Treating drawing capacities as permanent ignores corrosion, creep and blocked drains; omitting high-water scenarios from handover lets operators unknowingly alter the mechanism that maintains stability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Uplift evidence handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同一可相容工況W=7000kN、額外抗力R=1000kN、U=7500kN，未分項餘量W+R−U=500kN；正餘量本身不等於通過所有規範。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For one compatible scenario with W=7000kN, additional R=1000kN and U=7500kN, the unfactored margin W+R−U=500kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要抗浮證據交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for uplift evidence handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「抗浮證據交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Uplift evidence handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 抗浮證據交接
knowledge.text: 交接要同時保存永久重量、可動員抗力及高水位情境，讓維護者知道哪些能力依賴機械排水。抗力不得重複計入，例如同一土塊重量與同一滑面摩阻需核對相容機制。
knowledge.textEn: Handover must preserve dependable weight, mobilizable resistance and high-water scenarios so operators know which capacity relies on pumping. Avoid double counting, for example when the same soil mass and interface resistance participate in incompatible mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要抗浮證據交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for uplift evidence handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「抗浮證據交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Uplift evidence handover" is correct?

optionsEn: A nominal result for uplift evidence handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Handover must preserve dependable weight, mobilizable resistance and high-water scenarios so operators know which capacity relies on pumping.
A nominal result for displaced envelope volume removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.title: 抗浮證據交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Uplift evidence handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「抗浮證據交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Uplift evidence handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同一可相容工況W=7000kN、額外抗力R=1000kN、U=7500kN，未分項餘量W+R−U=500kN；正餘量本身不等於通過所有規範。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.textEn: Reconcile calculation versions, pressure datums, uplift tests, drainage responsibilities and emergency contacts. If evidence for a controlling resistance is missing, the responsible engineer must redefine the acceptable operating scenarios before handover. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Treating drawing capacities as permanent ignores corrosion, creep and blocked drains; omitting high-water scenarios from handover lets operators unknowingly alter the mechanism that maintains stability.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接抗浮證據交接時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用交接清單逐項核對計算版本、孔壓基準、抗拔試驗、排水維護責任及緊急聯絡程序。缺少任一控制抗力的證據時，主管工程師應重新界定可接受的使用情境。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over uplift evidence handover, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile calculation versions, pressure datums, uplift tests, drainage responsibilities and emergency contacts. If evidence for a controlling resistance is missing, the responsible engineer must redefine the acceptable operating scenarios before handover.

quiz.question: 要驗證「抗浮證據交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Uplift evidence handover"?
options: 用交接清單逐項核對計算版本、孔壓基準、抗拔試驗、排水維護責任及緊急聯絡程序。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要底板局部彎曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reconcile calculation versions, pressure datums, uplift tests, drainage responsibilities and emergency contacts.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A nominal result for local slab bending removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 用交接清單逐項核對計算版本、孔壓基準、抗拔試驗、排水維護責任及緊急聯絡程序。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile calculation versions, pressure datums, uplift tests, drainage responsibilities and emergency contacts. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 抗浮證據交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Uplift evidence handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「抗浮證據交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Uplift evidence handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把設計圖上的抗力視為永久不變會忽略腐蝕、蠕變及排水堵塞；若責任移交未包含高水位情境，維護者可能在不知情下改變穩定機制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating drawing capacities as permanent ignores corrosion, creep and blocked drains; omitting high-water scenarios from handover lets operators unknowingly alter the mechanism that maintains stability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把設計圖上的抗力視為永久不變會忽略腐蝕、蠕變及排水堵塞；若責任移交未包含高水位情境，維護者可能在不知情下改變穩定機制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating drawing capacities as permanent ignores corrosion, creep and blocked drains; omitting high-water scenarios from handover lets operators unknowingly alter the mechanism that maintains stability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要抗浮證據交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for uplift evidence handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把設計圖上的抗力視為永久不變會忽略腐蝕、蠕變及排水堵塞；若責任移交未包含高水位情境，維護者可能在不知情下改變穩定機制。
knowledge.textEn: Treating drawing capacities as permanent ignores corrosion, creep and blocked drains; omitting high-water scenarios from handover lets operators unknowingly alter the mechanism that maintains stability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「抗浮證據交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Uplift evidence handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把設計圖上的抗力視為永久不變會忽略腐蝕、蠕變及排水堵塞；若責任移交未包含高水位情境，維護者可能在不知情下改變穩定機制。
只要外包排水體積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating drawing capacities as permanent ignores corrosion, creep and blocked drains.
A nominal result for displaced envelope volume removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 把設計圖上的抗力視為永久不變會忽略腐蝕、蠕變及排水堵塞；若責任移交未包含高水位情境，維護者可能在不知情下改變穩定機制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating drawing capacities as permanent ignores corrosion, creep and blocked drains; omitting high-water scenarios from handover lets operators unknowingly alter the mechanism that maintains stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 岩石邊坡錨固與監測
summary: 本課聚焦從節理幾何、錨固荷載與量測基準判讀岩坡穩定。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on interpret rock slope stability through discontinuity geometry, anchor loads and measurement datums. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。假設坡面65°固定，節理傾角由40°增加10%至44°，角差由25°降至21°，減少4°；這只是傾向一致時的幾何變化，不能稱安全係數降低16%。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling. Holding the face at65° while increasing assumed joint dip from40° to44° by10% reduces the angular difference from25° to21°, a4° change; with matching directions this is geometry, not a16% loss of safety factor. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「節理出露幾何」與「孔壓扣除法向力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Discontinuity daylighting geometry" and "Pore pressure and normal force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 節理出露幾何：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity daylighting geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「節理出露幾何」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。必須另外確認傾向相近、連續長度、側向釋放面與摩擦，不能把角度差當安全儲備。假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「節理出露幾何」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry. A joint flatter than the face meets only one geometric condition. Similar dip direction, persistence, lateral release surfaces and friction also matter; the angular difference is not a stability reserve. Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling. Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「節理出露幾何」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Discontinuity daylighting geometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節理出露幾何
knowledge.text: 平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。必須另外確認傾向相近、連續長度、側向釋放面與摩擦，不能把角度差當安全儲備。
knowledge.textEn: Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry. A joint flatter than the face meets only one geometric condition.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節理出露幾何」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Discontinuity daylighting geometry" is correct?
options: 只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。
只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry.
A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節理出露幾何：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity daylighting geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節理出露幾何」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節理出露幾何」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Discontinuity daylighting geometry", which statement holds?
options: 只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要落石位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。
optionsEn: A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for rockfall energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 節理出露幾何：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity daylighting geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節理出露幾何」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。將不可見延伸列成不確定區，由岩土工程師確認控制滑動模式。同時排除以下干擾原因：僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Mark hidden extensions as uncertain and have the geotechnical engineer identify controlling mechanisms. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity. 僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。

A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
