steps.title: 孔壓扣除法向力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and normal force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔壓扣除法向力」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pore pressure and normal force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩塊重量分解到滑面後，水壓合力會減少有效接觸力。此處假設單一平面及合力已知，張裂縫水推力與地震慣性需另加，不能混入同一孔壓數字。W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壓扣除法向力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Resolve block weight normal to the sliding plane before subtracting water thrust. The example assumes one plane and a known resultant; crack-water thrust and seismic inertia require separate terms rather than being hidden inside one pore-pressure value. For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. A positive result only indicates compressive contact in this model. Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pore pressure and normal force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔壓扣除法向力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pore pressure and normal force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 岩塊重量分解到滑面後，水壓合力會減少有效接觸力。此處假設單一平面及合力已知，張裂縫水推力與地震慣性需另加，不能混入同一孔壓數字。
knowledge.textEn: Resolve block weight normal to the sliding plane before subtracting water thrust. The example assumes one plane and a known resultant; crack-water thrust and seismic inertia require separate terms rather than being hidden inside one pore-pressure value.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔壓扣除法向力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Resolve block weight normal to the sliding plane before subtracting water thrust.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. A positive result only indicates compressive contact in this model. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.question: 依「孔壓扣除法向力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。

A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。若量測僅在單一裂隙，應保留其他裂隙水力連通的不確定性。同時排除以下干擾原因：把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。
knowledge.textEn: Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. A reading in one fracture leaves hydraulic connectivity to other fractures uncertain. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接孔壓扣除法向力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。若量測僅在單一裂隙，應保留其他裂隙水力連通的不確定性。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over pore pressure and normal force, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. A reading in one fracture leaves hydraulic connectivity to other fractures uncertain.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔壓扣除法向力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pore pressure and normal force"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。
只要位移速率與時窗符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram.
A nominal result for movement rate and time window removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔壓扣除法向力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and normal force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔壓扣除法向力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pore pressure and normal force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔壓扣除法向力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pore pressure and normal force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force.
quiz.explanation: 把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「節理摩擦抗力」與「錨索方向分量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Discontinuity friction resistance" and "Anchor force projection": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 節理摩擦抗力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity friction resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「節理摩擦抗力」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Discontinuity friction resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 清潔接觸、充填物與表面粗糙度決定節理的剪切行為，峰值強度不一定能在大位移後維持。模型先忽略黏聚及幾何咬合，以了解有效正向力對摩擦的作用。取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「節理摩擦抗力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Clean contact, infill and roughness govern discontinuity shear response, and peak strength may not persist after displacement. The model omits cohesion and interlocking to isolate how effective normal force contributes to friction. With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN. This is one plane's friction term, excluding anchors and other forces. Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Discontinuity friction resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「節理摩擦抗力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Discontinuity friction resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節理摩擦抗力
knowledge.text: 清潔接觸、充填物與表面粗糙度決定節理的剪切行為，峰值強度不一定能在大位移後維持。模型先忽略黏聚及幾何咬合，以了解有效正向力對摩擦的作用。
knowledge.textEn: Clean contact, infill and roughness govern discontinuity shear response, and peak strength may not persist after displacement. The model omits cohesion and interlocking to isolate how effective normal force contributes to friction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節理摩擦抗力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Discontinuity friction resistance" is correct?
options: 清潔接觸、充填物與表面粗糙度決定節理的剪切行為，峰值強度不一定能在大位移後維持。
只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Clean contact, infill and roughness govern discontinuity shear response, and peak strength may not persist after displacement.
A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 清潔接觸、充填物與表面粗糙度決定節理的剪切行為，峰值強度不一定能在大位移後維持。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Clean contact, infill and roughness govern discontinuity shear response, and peak strength may not persist after displacement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節理摩擦抗力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity friction resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節理摩擦抗力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Discontinuity friction resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN. This is one plane's friction term, excluding anchors and other forces. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN. This is one plane's friction term, excluding anchors and other forces.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節理摩擦抗力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Discontinuity friction resistance", which statement holds?
options: 只要落石位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。
只要位移量測投影符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for rockfall energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN.
A nominal result for displacement measurement projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 節理摩擦抗力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity friction resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節理摩擦抗力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Discontinuity friction resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。設計審查需明列採用峰值或殘餘值的理由，並和可能位移機制相容。同時排除以下干擾原因：試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions. The design review must explain the choice of peak or residual strength and demonstrate compatibility with the anticipated movement mechanism. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接節理摩擦抗力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。設計審查需明列採用峰值或殘餘值的理由，並和可能位移機制相容。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over discontinuity friction resistance, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions. The design review must explain the choice of peak or residual strength and demonstrate compatibility with the anticipated movement mechanism.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。設計審查需明列採用峰值或殘餘值的理由，並和可能位移機制相容。同時排除以下干擾原因：試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。
knowledge.textEn: Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions. The design review must explain the choice of peak or residual strength and demonstrate compatibility with the anticipated movement mechanism. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening.

steps.title: 節理摩擦抗力：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 錨索方向分量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「錨索方向分量」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anchor force projection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 錨索拉力必須相對於滑動方向分解，不能把整支拉力全部當直接抗滑。與滑面法向的分量可能改變摩擦，這項效應應獨立計算並避免和直接分量重複。T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錨索方向分量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Resolve anchor tension relative to the sliding direction instead of crediting the full force as direct resistance. Its normal component may alter friction, but that contribution must be calculated separately and not double counted with the direct component. For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN. This expression excludes any additional friction term. A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Anchor force projection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「錨索方向分量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Anchor force projection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anchor force projection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN. This expression excludes any additional friction term. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查驗鑽孔方位、錨頭偏角及滑面幾何，將竣工方向代入向量平衡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check drilling azimuth, head deviation and plane geometry, then insert as-built directions into vector equilibrium.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN. This expression excludes any additional friction term.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anchor force projection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查驗鑽孔方位、錨頭偏角及滑面幾何，將竣工方向代入向量平衡。用荷載量測比對實際張力，偏斜過大時由設計者重算錨頭彎曲與可用分量。同時排除以下干擾原因：鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check drilling azimuth, head deviation and plane geometry, then insert as-built directions into vector equilibrium. Compare measured tension and have the designer reassess head bending and usable components if alignment differs significantly. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Check drilling azimuth, head deviation and plane geometry, then insert as-built directions into vector equilibrium. Compare measured tension and have the designer reassess head bending and usable components if alignment differs significantly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.observation: 連結機制：鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。
knowledge.textEn: A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錨索方向分量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Anchor force projection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。
只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance.
A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「穩定區錨固長度」與「落石位能尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bond beyond the moving zone" and "Rockfall energy scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 穩定區錨固長度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bond beyond the moving zone: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「穩定區錨固長度」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bond beyond the moving zone” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 固定段必須進入可承受反力的岩體，穿過滑面只是第一個幾何條件。實際黏結長度仍受裂隙、灌漿品質與鄰近錨索互制限制，自由段不得誤算成有效固定段。假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。固定段若仍位於可移動岩塊中，錨索只是把不穩定塊體互相拉住；表面荷載試驗短期正常也不能證明深部滑面已有可靠反力來源。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「穩定區錨固長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bond zone must enter rock capable of providing reaction. Crossing the plane is only a geometric requirement; fractures, grout quality and anchor interaction limit usable bond length, and the free length is not an effective bond zone. If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m. This is available geometry, not demonstrated bond capacity. A bond zone inside the moving block merely connects unstable rock to itself. A short-term satisfactory load test does not demonstrate a dependable reaction beyond the deep failure surface. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bond beyond the moving zone” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「穩定區錨固長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bond beyond the moving zone”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 穩定區錨固長度
knowledge.text: 固定段必須進入可承受反力的岩體，穿過滑面只是第一個幾何條件。實際黏結長度仍受裂隙、灌漿品質與鄰近錨索互制限制，自由段不得誤算成有效固定段。
knowledge.textEn: The bond zone must enter rock capable of providing reaction. Crossing the plane is only a geometric requirement; fractures, grout quality and anchor interaction limit usable bond length, and the free length is not an effective bond zone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「穩定區錨固長度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bond beyond the moving zone" is correct?
options: 只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要落石位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
固定段必須進入可承受反力的岩體，穿過滑面只是第一個幾何條件。
optionsEn: A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for rockfall energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
The bond zone must enter rock capable of providing reaction.
quiz.explanation: 固定段必須進入可承受反力的岩體，穿過滑面只是第一個幾何條件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The bond zone must enter rock capable of providing reaction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 穩定區錨固長度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bond beyond the moving zone: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「穩定區錨固長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bond beyond the moving zone” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m. This is available geometry, not demonstrated bond capacity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照定向鑽探與灌漿紀錄檢查固定段所在岩層，並以代表性試驗核對荷載、位移及時間效應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile oriented bore logs and grouting records with the proposed bond stratum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m. This is available geometry, not demonstrated bond capacity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「穩定區錨固長度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bond beyond the moving zone", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。
只要位移量測投影符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要錨索長期損失符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m.
A nominal result for displacement measurement projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for long term anchor loss removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 穩定區錨固長度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bond beyond the moving zone: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「穩定區錨固長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bond beyond the moving zone” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照定向鑽探與灌漿紀錄檢查固定段所在岩層，並以代表性試驗核對荷載、位移及時間效應。發現新滑面時必須重新定位固定段，而非延用原圖。同時排除以下干擾原因：固定段若仍位於可移動岩塊中，錨索只是把不穩定塊體互相拉住；表面荷載試驗短期正常也不能證明深部滑面已有可靠反力來源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile oriented bore logs and grouting records with the proposed bond stratum. Representative tests must examine load, movement and time effects; a newly identified sliding plane requires relocating the bond zone rather than relying on old drawings. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A bond zone inside the moving block merely connects unstable rock to itself. A short-term satisfactory load test does not demonstrate a dependable reaction beyond the deep failure surface. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over bond beyond the moving zone, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile oriented bore logs and grouting records with the proposed bond stratum. Representative tests must examine load, movement and time effects; a newly identified sliding plane requires relocating the bond zone rather than relying on old drawings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：固定段若仍位於可移動岩塊中，錨索只是把不穩定塊體互相拉住；表面荷載試驗短期正常也不能證明深部滑面已有可靠反力來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A bond zone inside the moving block merely connects unstable rock to itself. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

quiz.question: 要驗證「穩定區錨固長度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bond beyond the moving zone"?

steps.title: 穩定區錨固長度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bond beyond the moving zone: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「穩定區錨固長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 邊坡錨固與落石防護處理不同機制，不能用整體抗滑通過取代局部塊石控制。位能估算只描述能量來源，碰撞角度、轉動、彈跳及攔截距離決定防護系統需求。岩塊質量m=1000kg、落差h=20m，Ep=mgh=1000×9.81×20=196200J=196.2kJ；未扣除沿途能量損失，也未算衝擊峰值力。把位能直接除以任意短距離作為合格衝擊力，會忽略系統變形與局部穿透；攔網即使標稱能量足夠，位置不對仍可能被彈跳越過。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「落石位能尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

For mass m=1000kg and drop h=20m, Ep=mgh=196200J=196.2kJ. The estimate omits energy loss along the path and does not give peak impact force. Dividing energy by an arbitrary short distance ignores deformation and local penetration. Even a nominally adequate barrier can be bypassed by a rebound if its location is unsuitable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rockfall energy scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.explanationEn: Dividing energy by an arbitrary short distance ignores deformation and local penetration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水恢復摩擦」與「位移量測投影」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drainage and friction recovery" and "Displacement measurement projection": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水恢復摩擦：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drainage and friction recovery: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水恢復摩擦」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drainage and friction recovery” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水主要藉降低裂隙水壓恢復有效正向力，不應以出水量直接換算支護容量。流量下降可能是水位降低，也可能是堵塞，須用孔壓及降雨紀錄辨別。假設水壓合力減少ΔU=100kN、φ=30°且其餘荷載不變，ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN；未計新增黏聚或錨索作用。排水口暢通但內段被細料阻塞時，表面仍可見少量流出；若缺乏深部孔壓監測，工程師可能錯估摩擦恢復而錯誤減少其他支護需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水恢復摩擦」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drainage restores effective normal force by reducing fracture-water pressure; discharge is not itself a support capacity. Falling flow can mean lower water levels or blockage, so pressure and rainfall records are needed to distinguish the causes. If water thrust falls by ΔU=100kN at φ=30° with other loads fixed, ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN. No added cohesion or anchor force is included. A clear outlet may still pass a little water while its inner section is clogged. Without deep pressure observations, friction recovery can be overstated and other support needs wrongly reduced. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drainage and friction recovery” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設水壓合力減少ΔU=100kN、φ=30°且其餘荷載不變，ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN；未計新增黏聚或錨索作用。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If water thrust falls by ΔU=100kN at φ=30° with other loads fixed, ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要排水恢復摩擦符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for drainage and friction recovery removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水恢復摩擦」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drainage and friction recovery”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水恢復摩擦
knowledge.text: 排水主要藉降低裂隙水壓恢復有效正向力，不應以出水量直接換算支護容量。流量下降可能是水位降低，也可能是堵塞，須用孔壓及降雨紀錄辨別。
knowledge.textEn: Drainage restores effective normal force by reducing fracture-water pressure; discharge is not itself a support capacity. Falling flow can mean lower water levels or blockage, so pressure and rainfall records are needed to distinguish the causes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要排水恢復摩擦符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for drainage and friction recovery removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水恢復摩擦」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drainage and friction recovery" is correct?
options: 只要排水恢復摩擦符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
排水主要藉降低裂隙水壓恢復有效正向力，不應以出水量直接換算支護容量。
只要位移量測投影符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for drainage and friction recovery removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Drainage restores effective normal force by reducing fracture-water pressure; discharge is not itself a support capacity.
A nominal result for displacement measurement projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 排水主要藉降低裂隙水壓恢復有效正向力，不應以出水量直接換算支護容量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drainage restores effective normal force by reducing fracture-water pressure; discharge is not itself a support capacity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水恢復摩擦：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drainage and friction recovery: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水恢復摩擦」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drainage and friction recovery” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設水壓合力減少ΔU=100kN、φ=30°且其餘荷載不變，ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN；未計新增黏聚或錨索作用。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If water thrust falls by ΔU=100kN at φ=30° with other loads fixed, ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN. No added cohesion or anchor force is included. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較同一場雨前後的降雨、孔壓與排水流量時間序列，檢查滯後及異常高水位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare rainfall, pressure and discharge time series around the same storm, noting lag and persistent high head.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設水壓合力減少ΔU=100kN、φ=30°且其餘荷載不變，ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN；未計新增黏聚或錨索作用。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If water thrust falls by ΔU=100kN at φ=30° with other loads fixed, ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN. No added cohesion or anchor force is included.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「排水恢復摩擦」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drainage and friction recovery", which statement holds?
options: 只要錨索長期損失符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設水壓合力減少ΔU=100kN、φ=30°且其餘荷載不變，ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN；未計新增黏聚或錨索作用。
optionsEn: A nominal result for long term anchor loss removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If water thrust falls by ΔU=100kN at φ=30° with other loads fixed, ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設水壓合力減少ΔU=100kN、φ=30°且其餘荷載不變，ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN；未計新增黏聚或錨索作用。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If water thrust falls by ΔU=100kN at φ=30° with other loads fixed, ΔR=ΔUtanφ=57.7kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 排水恢復摩擦：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drainage and friction recovery: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水恢復摩擦」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drainage and friction recovery” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較同一場雨前後的降雨、孔壓與排水流量時間序列，檢查滯後及異常高水位。維護驗收以水力反應和設計目標共同判斷，不以單次通水作唯一證據。同時排除以下干擾原因：排水口暢通但內段被細料阻塞時，表面仍可見少量流出；若缺乏深部孔壓監測，工程師可能錯估摩擦恢復而錯誤減少其他支護需求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare rainfall, pressure and discharge time series around the same storm, noting lag and persistent high head. Accept maintenance using hydraulic response and design objectives together rather than a single successful flushing observation. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A clear outlet may still pass a little water while its inner section is clogged. Without deep pressure observations, friction recovery can be overstated and other support needs wrongly reduced. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接排水恢復摩擦時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比較同一場雨前後的降雨、孔壓與排水流量時間序列，檢查滯後及異常高水位。維護驗收以水力反應和設計目標共同判斷，不以單次通水作唯一證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over drainage and friction recovery, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare rainfall, pressure and discharge time series around the same storm, noting lag and persistent high head. Accept maintenance using hydraulic response and design objectives together rather than a single successful flushing observation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水口暢通但內段被細料阻塞時，表面仍可見少量流出；若缺乏深部孔壓監測，工程師可能錯估摩擦恢復而錯誤減少其他支護需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A clear outlet may still pass a little water while its inner section is clogged. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較同一場雨前後的降雨、孔壓與排水流量時間序列，檢查滯後及異常高水位。維護驗收以水力反應和設計目標共同判斷，不以單次通水作唯一證據。同時排除以下干擾原因：排水口暢通但內段被細料阻塞時，表面仍可見少量流出；若缺乏深部孔壓監測，工程師可能錯估摩擦恢復而錯誤減少其他支護需求。
knowledge.textEn: Compare rainfall, pressure and discharge time series around the same storm, noting lag and persistent high head. Accept maintenance using hydraulic response and design objectives together rather than a single successful flushing observation. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A clear outlet may still pass a little water while its inner section is clogged. Without deep pressure observations, friction recovery can be overstated and other support needs wrongly reduced.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接排水恢復摩擦時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比較同一場雨前後的降雨、孔壓與排水流量時間序列，檢查滯後及異常高水位。維護驗收以水力反應和設計目標共同判斷，不以單次通水作唯一證據。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over drainage and friction recovery, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare rainfall, pressure and discharge time series around the same storm, noting lag and persistent high head. Accept maintenance using hydraulic response and design objectives together rather than a single successful flushing observation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排水恢復摩擦」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drainage and friction recovery"?
options: 比較同一場雨前後的降雨、孔壓與排水流量時間序列，檢查滯後及異常高水位。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Compare rainfall, pressure and discharge time series around the same storm, noting lag and persistent high head.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 比較同一場雨前後的降雨、孔壓與排水流量時間序列，檢查滯後及異常高水位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare rainfall, pressure and discharge time series around the same storm, noting lag and persistent high head. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 排水恢復摩擦：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drainage and friction recovery: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排水恢復摩擦」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drainage and friction recovery” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水口暢通但內段被細料阻塞時，表面仍可見少量流出；若缺乏深部孔壓監測，工程師可能錯估摩擦恢復而錯誤減少其他支護需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A clear outlet may still pass a little water while its inner section is clogged. Without deep pressure observations, friction recovery can be overstated and other support needs wrongly reduced. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水口暢通但內段被細料阻塞時，表面仍可見少量流出；若缺乏深部孔壓監測，工程師可能錯估摩擦恢復而錯誤減少其他支護需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without deep pressure observations, friction recovery can be overstated and other support needs wrongly reduced.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要排水恢復摩擦符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for drainage and friction recovery removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 排水口暢通但內段被細料阻塞時，表面仍可見少量流出；若缺乏深部孔壓監測，工程師可能錯估摩擦恢復而錯誤減少其他支護需求。
knowledge.textEn: A clear outlet may still pass a little water while its inner section is clogged. Without deep pressure observations, friction recovery can be overstated and other support needs wrongly reduced.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「排水恢復摩擦」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drainage and friction recovery" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
排水口暢通但內段被細料阻塞時，表面仍可見少量流出；若缺乏深部孔壓監測，工程師可能錯估摩擦恢復而錯誤減少其他支護需求。
只要位移量測投影符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A clear outlet may still pass a little water while its inner section is clogged.
A nominal result for displacement measurement projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 排水口暢通但內段被細料阻塞時，表面仍可見少量流出；若缺乏深部孔壓監測，工程師可能錯估摩擦恢復而錯誤減少其他支護需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A clear outlet may still pass a little water while its inner section is clogged. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 位移量測投影：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Displacement measurement projection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「位移量測投影」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Displacement measurement projection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 感測器測得的是特定方向的位移分量，並不自然等於沿滑面的總位移。解算必須知道移動方向與量測軸，若方向未知則多軸或獨立測量比單軸反推可靠。假設真位移方向與感測軸夾60°、量測投影5mm，d=5/cos60°=10mm；方向已知且剛體移動是此簡化的前提。感測器支座鬆動或滑動方向改變，會使投影關係失效；看似位移減少可能只是方向轉變，錯誤判讀會延誤對加速變形的處置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「位移量測投影」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A sensor records displacement along its own axis, not automatically the full movement along a plane. Recovery requires the movement direction and measurement axis; unknown directions call for multiple axes or independent surveys rather than one-axis inversion. With a known60° angle between movement and sensor axis and measured projection5mm, d=5/cos60°=10mm. The calculation assumes a known direction and rigid-block movement. A loose sensor support or changed movement direction invalidates projection. An apparent reduction can be a directional change and may delay the planned response to accelerating deformation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Displacement measurement projection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設真位移方向與感測軸夾60°、量測投影5mm，d=5/cos60°=10mm；方向已知且剛體移動是此簡化的前提。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With a known60° angle between movement and sensor axis and measured projection5mm, d=5/cos60°=10mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要位移量測投影符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Displacement measurement projection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for displacement measurement projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「位移量測投影」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

只要位移速率與時窗符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

optionsEn: A nominal result for displacement measurement projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for movement rate and time window removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A sensor records displacement along its own axis, not automatically the full movement along a plane.

quiz.explanationEn: A sensor records displacement along its own axis, not automatically the full movement along a plane. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 位移量測投影：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Displacement measurement projection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「位移量測投影」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Displacement measurement projection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設真位移方向與感測軸夾60°、量測投影5mm，d=5/cos60°=10mm；方向已知且剛體移動是此簡化的前提。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With a known60° angle between movement and sensor axis and measured projection5mm, d=5/cos60°=10mm. The calculation assumes a known direction and rigid-block movement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先記錄感測器安裝方位，再用全站儀或其他獨立量測比較位移向量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record sensor orientation and compare the displacement vector with an independent total-station survey.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設真位移方向與感測軸夾60°、量測投影5mm，d=5/cos60°=10mm；方向已知且剛體移動是此簡化的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With a known60° angle between movement and sensor axis and measured projection5mm, d=5/cos60°=10mm. The calculation assumes a known direction and rigid-block movement.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「位移量測投影」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Displacement measurement projection", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設真位移方向與感測軸夾60°、量測投影5mm，d=5/cos60°=10mm；方向已知且剛體移動是此簡化的前提。
只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With a known60° angle between movement and sensor axis and measured projection5mm, d=5/cos60°=10mm.
A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With a known60° angle between movement and sensor axis and measured projection5mm, d=5/cos60°=10mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 位移量測投影：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Displacement measurement projection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「位移量測投影」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Displacement measurement projection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先記錄感測器安裝方位，再用全站儀或其他獨立量測比較位移向量。若接近垂直投影造成放大，應報不確定性而非只增加小數位來營造精度。同時排除以下干擾原因：感測器支座鬆動或滑動方向改變，會使投影關係失效；看似位移減少可能只是方向轉變，錯誤判讀會延誤對加速變形的處置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record sensor orientation and compare the displacement vector with an independent total-station survey. Near-perpendicular projection amplifies uncertainty; report that uncertainty instead of adding decimal places that imply unsupported precision. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A loose sensor support or changed movement direction invalidates projection. An apparent reduction can be a directional change and may delay the planned response to accelerating deformation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接位移量測投影時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。先記錄感測器安裝方位，再用全站儀或其他獨立量測比較位移向量。若接近垂直投影造成放大，應報不確定性而非只增加小數位來營造精度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over displacement measurement projection, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Record sensor orientation and compare the displacement vector with an independent total-station survey. Near-perpendicular projection amplifies uncertainty; report that uncertainty instead of adding decimal places that imply unsupported precision.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測器支座鬆動或滑動方向改變，會使投影關係失效；看似位移減少可能只是方向轉變，錯誤判讀會延誤對加速變形的處置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A loose sensor support or changed movement direction invalidates projection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先記錄感測器安裝方位，再用全站儀或其他獨立量測比較位移向量。若接近垂直投影造成放大，應報不確定性而非只增加小數位來營造精度。同時排除以下干擾原因：感測器支座鬆動或滑動方向改變，會使投影關係失效；看似位移減少可能只是方向轉變，錯誤判讀會延誤對加速變形的處置。
knowledge.textEn: Record sensor orientation and compare the displacement vector with an independent total-station survey. Near-perpendicular projection amplifies uncertainty; report that uncertainty instead of adding decimal places that imply unsupported precision. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A loose sensor support or changed movement direction invalidates projection. An apparent reduction can be a directional change and may delay the planned response to accelerating deformation.

knowledge.text: 交接位移量測投影時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。先記錄感測器安裝方位，再用全站儀或其他獨立量測比較位移向量。若接近垂直投影造成放大，應報不確定性而非只增加小數位來營造精度。

quiz.question: 要驗證「位移量測投影」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Displacement measurement projection"?

先記錄感測器安裝方位，再用全站儀或其他獨立量測比較位移向量。
只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

Record sensor orientation and compare the displacement vector with an independent total-station survey.
A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Record sensor orientation and compare the displacement vector with an independent total-station survey. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 位移量測投影：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Displacement measurement projection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「位移量測投影」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Displacement measurement projection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 感測器支座鬆動或滑動方向改變，會使投影關係失效；看似位移減少可能只是方向轉變，錯誤判讀會延誤對加速變形的處置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A loose sensor support or changed movement direction invalidates projection. An apparent reduction can be a directional change and may delay the planned response to accelerating deformation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：感測器支座鬆動或滑動方向改變，會使投影關係失效；看似位移減少可能只是方向轉變，錯誤判讀會延誤對加速變形的處置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An apparent reduction can be a directional change and may delay the planned response to accelerating deformation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要位移量測投影符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for displacement measurement projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 感測器支座鬆動或滑動方向改變，會使投影關係失效；看似位移減少可能只是方向轉變，錯誤判讀會延誤對加速變形的處置。
knowledge.textEn: A loose sensor support or changed movement direction invalidates projection. An apparent reduction can be a directional change and may delay the planned response to accelerating deformation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「位移量測投影」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Displacement measurement projection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要位移速率與時窗符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
感測器支座鬆動或滑動方向改變，會使投影關係失效；看似位移減少可能只是方向轉變，錯誤判讀會延誤對加速變形的處置。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for movement rate and time window removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A loose sensor support or changed movement direction invalidates projection.
quiz.explanation: 感測器支座鬆動或滑動方向改變，會使投影關係失效；看似位移減少可能只是方向轉變，錯誤判讀會延誤對加速變形的處置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A loose sensor support or changed movement direction invalidates projection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「位移速率與時窗」與「錨索長期損失」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Movement rate and time window" and "Long term anchor loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 位移速率與時窗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Movement rate and time window: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「位移速率與時窗」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Movement rate and time window” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 速率必須和取樣時間窗一起報告，短暫噪聲不能直接當趨勢，長時間平均也可能掩蓋加速。監測觸發值須由場址機制、儀器解析度及回應時間共同制定。假設6h內真位移增加3mm，平均速率v=3/6=0.5mm/h；這不是瞬時速率，也不能直接預測剩餘失穩時間。缺測後把較長間隔誤當正常採樣週期會高估速率；相反，將快速位移攤平到整日可低估加速，兩者都會扭曲應變優先順序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「位移速率與時窗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Report velocity with its observation window. Brief noise is not a trend, while long averaging can hide acceleration. Site mechanisms, sensor resolution and response time must jointly determine monitoring triggers. If displacement increases3mm over6h, average velocity v=3/6=0.5mm/h. This is not instantaneous velocity and cannot directly predict time to failure. Treating a long data gap as a normal interval overstates velocity; averaging a rapid excursion over an entire day understates acceleration. Both distort response priorities and engineering escalation decisions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Movement rate and time window” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設6h內真位移增加3mm，平均速率v=3/6=0.5mm/h；這不是瞬時速率，也不能直接預測剩餘失穩時間。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If displacement increases3mm over6h, average velocity v=3/6=0.5mm/h.

knowledge.title: 位移速率與時窗
knowledge.text: 速率必須和取樣時間窗一起報告，短暫噪聲不能直接當趨勢，長時間平均也可能掩蓋加速。監測觸發值須由場址機制、儀器解析度及回應時間共同制定。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for movement rate and time window removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「位移速率與時窗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 位移速率與時窗：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「位移速率與時窗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Movement rate and time window” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設6h內真位移增加3mm，平均速率v=3/6=0.5mm/h；這不是瞬時速率，也不能直接預測剩餘失穩時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If displacement increases3mm over6h, average velocity v=3/6=0.5mm/h. This is not instantaneous velocity and cannot directly predict time to failure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 位移速率與時窗：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「位移速率與時窗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Movement rate and time window” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留原始時間戳、缺測與溫度資料，分別用短窗和長窗檢查趨勢。獨立複測確認異常後依已核准的分級應變表處理，避免臨場任意修改警戒門檻。同時排除以下干擾原因：缺測後把較長間隔誤當正常採樣週期會高估速率；相反，將快速位移攤平到整日可低估加速，兩者都會扭曲應變優先順序。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain original timestamps, gaps and temperature records, and compare short and long windows. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Treating a long data gap as a normal interval overstates velocity; averaging a rapid excursion over an entire day understates acceleration. Both distort response priorities and engineering escalation decisions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 錨索長期損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long term anchor loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「錨索長期損失」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long term anchor loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 錨索長期力可因岩土蠕變、鋼材鬆弛、錨頭就位及腐蝕改變，單次初張力不是永久能力。交接應保存基準荷載、量測方法及允許的變化範圍，並指定維護責任。假設可比較的錨索力由250kN降至220kN，損失率=(250−220)/250=12%；比例僅描述量測變化，不能單獨決定是否重新張拉。若腐蝕減少截面卻只補回名義張力，剩餘鋼材應力可能升高；將負荷損失當正常鬆弛會漏掉破損錨頭、失效固定段或深層位移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錨索長期損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long-term force changes through ground creep, steel relaxation, seating and corrosion; initial tension is not a permanent capacity. Preserve baseline load, measurement method and permitted variation at handover, with an explicit maintenance responsibility. Comparable force readings falling from250kN to220kN give loss=(250−220)/250=12%. This ratio describes change and does not alone authorize retensioning. Restoring nominal tension to a corroded section can raise stress in the remaining steel. Dismissing loss as normal relaxation can miss a damaged head, failed bond zone or deep movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long term anchor loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
