knowledge.text: 誤解：只要錨索長期損失符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for long term anchor loss removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錨索長期損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long term anchor loss" is correct?
options: 只要錨索長期損失符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
錨索長期力可因岩土蠕變、鋼材鬆弛、錨頭就位及腐蝕改變，單次初張力不是永久能力。
只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for long term anchor loss removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Long-term force changes through ground creep, steel relaxation, seating and corrosion; initial tension is not a permanent capacity.
A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 錨索長期力可因岩土蠕變、鋼材鬆弛、錨頭就位及腐蝕改變，單次初張力不是永久能力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term force changes through ground creep, steel relaxation, seating and corrosion; initial tension is not a permanent capacity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錨索長期損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long term anchor loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨索長期損失」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long term anchor loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較的錨索力由250kN降至220kN，損失率=(250−220)/250=12%；比例僅描述量測變化，不能單獨決定是否重新張拉。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Comparable force readings falling from250kN to220kN give loss=(250−220)/250=12%. This ratio describes change and does not alone authorize retensioning. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對量測設備校正及溫度補償，連同位移、滲水與防蝕檢查判讀荷載變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check calibration and temperature compensation, interpreting force alongside movement, seepage and corrosion observations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較的錨索力由250kN降至220kN，損失率=(250−220)/250=12%；比例僅描述量測變化，不能單獨決定是否重新張拉。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Comparable force readings falling from250kN to220kN give loss=(250−220)/250=12%. This ratio describes change and does not alone authorize retensioning.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錨索長期損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long term anchor loss", which statement holds?
options: 只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較的錨索力由250kN降至220kN，損失率=(250−220)/250=12%；比例僅描述量測變化，不能單獨決定是否重新張拉。
optionsEn: A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Comparable force readings falling from250kN to220kN give loss=(250−220)/250=12%.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較的錨索力由250kN降至220kN，損失率=(250−220)/250=12%；比例僅描述量測變化，不能單獨決定是否重新張拉。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Comparable force readings falling from250kN to220kN give loss=(250−220)/250=12%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錨索長期損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long term anchor loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨索長期損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long term anchor loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對量測設備校正及溫度補償，連同位移、滲水與防蝕檢查判讀荷載變化。任何調整荷載方案都由錨固設計與維護工程師確認，先辨別損失來源。同時排除以下干擾原因：若腐蝕減少截面卻只補回名義張力，剩餘鋼材應力可能升高；將負荷損失當正常鬆弛會漏掉破損錨頭、失效固定段或深層位移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check calibration and temperature compensation, interpreting force alongside movement, seepage and corrosion observations. Anchor design and maintenance engineers must identify the cause before approving any load-adjustment procedure. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Restoring nominal tension to a corroded section can raise stress in the remaining steel. Dismissing loss as normal relaxation can miss a damaged head, failed bond zone or deep movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接錨索長期損失時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對量測設備校正及溫度補償，連同位移、滲水與防蝕檢查判讀荷載變化。任何調整荷載方案都由錨固設計與維護工程師確認，先辨別損失來源。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over long term anchor loss, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check calibration and temperature compensation, interpreting force alongside movement, seepage and corrosion observations. Anchor design and maintenance engineers must identify the cause before approving any load-adjustment procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若腐蝕減少截面卻只補回名義張力，剩餘鋼材應力可能升高；將負荷損失當正常鬆弛會漏掉破損錨頭、失效固定段或深層位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Restoring nominal tension to a corroded section can raise stress in the remaining steel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對量測設備校正及溫度補償，連同位移、滲水與防蝕檢查判讀荷載變化。任何調整荷載方案都由錨固設計與維護工程師確認，先辨別損失來源。同時排除以下干擾原因：若腐蝕減少截面卻只補回名義張力，剩餘鋼材應力可能升高；將負荷損失當正常鬆弛會漏掉破損錨頭、失效固定段或深層位移。
knowledge.textEn: Check calibration and temperature compensation, interpreting force alongside movement, seepage and corrosion observations. Anchor design and maintenance engineers must identify the cause before approving any load-adjustment procedure. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Restoring nominal tension to a corroded section can raise stress in the remaining steel. Dismissing loss as normal relaxation can miss a damaged head, failed bond zone or deep movement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接錨索長期損失時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對量測設備校正及溫度補償，連同位移、滲水與防蝕檢查判讀荷載變化。任何調整荷載方案都由錨固設計與維護工程師確認，先辨別損失來源。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over long term anchor loss, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check calibration and temperature compensation, interpreting force alongside movement, seepage and corrosion observations. Anchor design and maintenance engineers must identify the cause before approving any load-adjustment procedure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨索長期損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long term anchor loss"?
options: 核對量測設備校正及溫度補償，連同位移、滲水與防蝕檢查判讀荷載變化。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要排水恢復摩擦符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Check calibration and temperature compensation, interpreting force alongside movement, seepage and corrosion observations.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A nominal result for drainage and friction recovery removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 核對量測設備校正及溫度補償，連同位移、滲水與防蝕檢查判讀荷載變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check calibration and temperature compensation, interpreting force alongside movement, seepage and corrosion observations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 錨索長期損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long term anchor loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨索長期損失」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long term anchor loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若腐蝕減少截面卻只補回名義張力，剩餘鋼材應力可能升高；將負荷損失當正常鬆弛會漏掉破損錨頭、失效固定段或深層位移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Restoring nominal tension to a corroded section can raise stress in the remaining steel. Dismissing loss as normal relaxation can miss a damaged head, failed bond zone or deep movement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若腐蝕減少截面卻只補回名義張力，剩餘鋼材應力可能升高；將負荷損失當正常鬆弛會漏掉破損錨頭、失效固定段或深層位移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dismissing loss as normal relaxation can miss a damaged head, failed bond zone or deep movement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要錨索長期損失符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for long term anchor loss removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若腐蝕減少截面卻只補回名義張力，剩餘鋼材應力可能升高；將負荷損失當正常鬆弛會漏掉破損錨頭、失效固定段或深層位移。
knowledge.textEn: Restoring nominal tension to a corroded section can raise stress in the remaining steel. Dismissing loss as normal relaxation can miss a damaged head, failed bond zone or deep movement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錨索長期損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long term anchor loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若腐蝕減少截面卻只補回名義張力，剩餘鋼材應力可能升高；將負荷損失當正常鬆弛會漏掉破損錨頭、失效固定段或深層位移。
只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Restoring nominal tension to a corroded section can raise stress in the remaining steel.
A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若腐蝕減少截面卻只補回名義張力，剩餘鋼材應力可能升高；將負荷損失當正常鬆弛會漏掉破損錨頭、失效固定段或深層位移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Restoring nominal tension to a corroded section can raise stress in the remaining steel. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 地下管線探地雷達探測
summary: 本課聚焦校準雷達波速與定位誤差並保留地下管線判讀的不確定性。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on calibrate radar velocity and location error while retaining buried utility interpretation uncertainty. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：取真空波速c=0.3m/ns、相對介電常數εr=9，v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns；這是均質低損耗假設，並非所有土層固定波速。假設介電常數由9增加10%至9.9，固定c=0.3m/ns，速度由0.100降為0.09535m/ns，約下降4.65%；若回波時間不變，換算深度也下降4.65%，不是下降10%。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With c=0.3m/ns and relative permittivity εr=9, v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns. This assumes homogeneous low-loss ground, not a universal soil velocity. Increasing assumed permittivity from9 to9.9 by10% at fixed c=0.3m/ns changes velocity from0.100 to0.09535m/ns, about4.65% lower. At fixed echo time, converted depth also falls4.65%, rather than10%. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「介電常數與波速」與「雙程時間換深度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Permittivity and wave speed" and "Two way time to depth": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 介電常數與波速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Permittivity and wave speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「介電常數與波速」如何影響地下管線探地雷達探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Permittivity and wave speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground-penetrating radar for buried utilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地中電磁波速度隨有效介電常數改變，含水率與填土差異因此影響深度換算。低損耗、非磁性近似讓公式容易理解，強導電土層則需考慮衰減與頻散而不能照套。取真空波速c=0.3m/ns、相對介電常數εr=9，v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns；這是均質低損耗假設，並非所有土層固定波速。若沿用乾燥地面的波速處理濕區，深度可能系統性偏大；圖面看似連續但誤差同向累積，後續開挖判斷會錯估管線上方的保護土層。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「介電常數與波速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Electromagnetic speed varies with effective permittivity, making moisture and fill variation important to depth conversion. A low-loss, nonmagnetic approximation simplifies the relation; conductive ground requires attention to attenuation and dispersion before applying it. With c=0.3m/ns and relative permittivity εr=9, v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns. This assumes homogeneous low-loss ground, not a universal soil velocity. knowledge.title: 介電常數與波速
knowledge.text: 地中電磁波速度隨有效介電常數改變，含水率與填土差異因此影響深度換算。低損耗、非磁性近似讓公式容易理解，強導電土層則需考慮衰減與頻散而不能照套。
knowledge.textEn: Electromagnetic speed varies with effective permittivity, making moisture and fill variation important to depth conversion. A low-loss, nonmagnetic approximation simplifies the relation; conductive ground requires attention to attenuation and dispersion before applying it.

只要雙程時間換深度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for permittivity and wave speed removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Electromagnetic speed varies with effective permittivity, making moisture and fill variation important to depth conversion.
A nominal result for two way time to depth removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 地中電磁波速度隨有效介電常數改變，含水率與填土差異因此影響深度換算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 介電常數與波速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Permittivity and wave speed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「介電常數與波速」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Permittivity and wave speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：取真空波速c=0.3m/ns、相對介電常數εr=9，v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns；這是均質低損耗假設，並非所有土層固定波速。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With c=0.3m/ns and relative permittivity εr=9, v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns. This assumes homogeneous low-loss ground, not a universal soil velocity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知深度目標或適用的多偏移距量測校準速度，在不同含水區分別記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate velocity using a known-depth target or suitable multiple-offset observations, recording wet and dry zones separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取真空波速c=0.3m/ns、相對介電常數εr=9，v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns；這是均質低損耗假設，並非所有土層固定波速。

steps.title: 介電常數與波速：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Permittivity and wave speed: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「介電常數與波速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Permittivity and wave speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以已知深度目標或適用的多偏移距量測校準速度，在不同含水區分別記錄。比較換算深度與獨立管線資料，未校準的區段須標明速度假設而非填入精確高程。同時排除以下干擾原因：若沿用乾燥地面的波速處理濕區，深度可能系統性偏大；圖面看似連續但誤差同向累積，後續開挖判斷會錯估管線上方的保護土層。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate velocity using a known-depth target or suitable multiple-offset observations, recording wet and dry zones separately. A visually continuous map may accumulate consistent error and misrepresent the cover protecting a utility during later excavation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over permittivity and wave speed, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Calibrate velocity using a known-depth target or suitable multiple-offset observations, recording wet and dry zones separately. Compare depths with independent utility evidence and label uncalibrated sections with their assumed velocity rather than a precise elevation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沿用乾燥地面的波速處理濕區，深度可能系統性偏大；圖面看似連續但誤差同向累積，後續開挖判斷會錯估管線上方的保護土層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 雙程時間換深度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Two way time to depth: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙程時間換深度」如何影響地下管線探地雷達探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 雷達回波經過下行及回程兩段路徑，時間零點與天線間距需先確認。垂直入射平層模型是初步解讀，傾斜界面、近場與目標尺寸會讓簡單除二失去精度。取v=0.1m/ns、校正後雙程t=30ns，z=vt/2=1.5m；t已扣除儀器與空氣路徑偏移，並假設垂直反射。忘記雙程除二會將深度加倍；若零點漂移卻只修速度，淺目標與深目標可能呈現不同相對誤差，單點校準也會造成錯誤的信心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙程時間換深度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 保留原始雷達剖面與時間零點校正紀錄，選取同一反射相位作比較。已知深度點應分布於不同材質區，讓檢核能辨別固定時間偏移與速度誤差兩種來源。同時排除以下干擾原因：忘記雙程除二會將深度加倍；若零點漂移卻只修速度，淺目標與深目標可能呈現不同相對誤差，單點校準也會造成錯誤的信心。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 雙曲線目標幾何：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hyperbolic target geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙曲線目標幾何」如何影響地下管線探地雷達探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hyperbolic target geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground-penetrating radar for buried utilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 點狀或細管目標在掃描剖面常形成雙曲線，但其寬度同時受深度、速度與掃描方向影響。用單一曲線推斷管徑與方位是非唯一問題，應保留可辨識參數的界限。均質地盤點散射模型t(x)=2√(z²+x²)/v；取z=1m、x=1m、v=0.1m/ns，t=28.28ns，約28.3ns。掃描線斜交管線時曲線變寬，若一律當成深度增加便會錯置管線；過度擬合雜訊還可能把相鄰兩根管線合併成不存在的大目標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙曲線目標幾何」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A point or thin pipe target often creates a hyperbola, whose width depends on depth, velocity and scan direction. Inferring diameter and orientation from one curve is nonunique, so state which parameters the observations actually constrain. For a homogeneous point-scatterer model t(x)=2√(z²+x²)/v, use z=1m, x=1m and v=0.1m/ns to obtain t=28.28ns, about28.3ns. An oblique crossing broadens the curve and can be misread as greater depth. Overfitting noise can also merge adjacent pipes into a nonexistent large buried target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hyperbolic target geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 雙曲線目標幾何
knowledge.text: 點狀或細管目標在掃描剖面常形成雙曲線，但其寬度同時受深度、速度與掃描方向影響。用單一曲線推斷管徑與方位是非唯一問題，應保留可辨識參數的界限。
knowledge.textEn: A point or thin pipe target often creates a hyperbola, whose width depends on depth, velocity and scan direction. Inferring diameter and orientation from one curve is nonunique, so state which parameters the observations actually constrain.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：均質地盤點散射模型t(x)=2√(z²+x²)/v；取z=1m、x=1m、v=0.1m/ns，t=28.28ns，約28.3ns。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.objective: 說明「頻率與波長尺度」如何影響地下管線探地雷達探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frequency and wavelength scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground-penetrating radar for buried utilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高頻通常提供較短波長，但較短波長不保證在所有地盤中達到更深穿透。辨識能力還依天線頻寬、脈衝、目標對比及噪聲，不能直接把波長當精確定位誤差。取速度v=1×10⁸m/s、頻率f=5×10⁸Hz即500MHz，λ=v/f=0.20m；實際解析度不是直接宣稱0.20m。使用高頻卻未檢查導電衰減可能只看到淺層，深部無回波不能證明沒有管線；影像看起來清晰也不代表深度轉換的速度已正確。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頻率與波長尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Higher frequency generally shortens wavelength but does not guarantee deeper penetration. Discrimination also depends on bandwidth, pulse shape, target contrast and noise; wavelength is not automatically a precise location-error bound. For v=1×10⁸m/s and f=5×10⁸Hz, or500MHz, λ=v/f=0.20m. This does not establish an actual resolution of0.20m. High frequency without an attenuation check may image only shallow layers. No deep echo does not prove no utility, and sharp images do not establish correct velocity for depth conversion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Frequency and wavelength scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For v=1×10⁸m/s and f=5×10⁸Hz, or500MHz, λ=v/f=0.20m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要頻率與波長尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要頻率與波長尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for frequency and wavelength scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頻率與波長尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Frequency and wavelength scale" is correct?
options: 只要頻率與波長尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
高頻通常提供較短波長，但較短波長不保證在所有地盤中達到更深穿透。
只要傳播衰減範圍符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for frequency and wavelength scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Higher frequency generally shortens wavelength but does not guarantee deeper penetration.
A nominal result for propagation attenuation range removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 高頻通常提供較短波長，但較短波長不保證在所有地盤中達到更深穿透。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Higher frequency generally shortens wavelength but does not guarantee deeper penetration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頻率與波長尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Frequency and wavelength scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頻率與波長尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Frequency and wavelength scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：取速度v=1×10⁸m/s、頻率f=5×10⁸Hz即500MHz，λ=v/f=0.20m；實際解析度不是直接宣稱0.20m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For v=1×10⁸m/s and f=5×10⁸Hz, or500MHz, λ=v/f=0.20m. This does not establish an actual resolution of0.20m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表性土區用已知目標比對不同頻段的可辨識程度，保留增益與濾波設定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare frequency bands on known targets in representative ground, retaining gain and filtering settings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取速度v=1×10⁸m/s、頻率f=5×10⁸Hz即500MHz，λ=v/f=0.20m；實際解析度不是直接宣稱0.20m。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For v=1×10⁸m/s and f=5×10⁸Hz, or500MHz, λ=v/f=0.20m. This does not establish an actual resolution of0.20m.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「頻率與波長尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Frequency and wavelength scale", which statement holds?
options: 只要里程輪定位誤差符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要深度合成不確定性符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：取速度v=1×10⁸m/s、頻率f=5×10⁸Hz即500MHz，λ=v/f=0.20m；實際解析度不是直接宣稱0.20m。
optionsEn: A nominal result for distance wheel location error removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for combined depth uncertainty removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For v=1×10⁸m/s and f=5×10⁸Hz, or500MHz, λ=v/f=0.20m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取速度v=1×10⁸m/s、頻率f=5×10⁸Hz即500MHz，λ=v/f=0.20m；實際解析度不是直接宣稱0.20m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For v=1×10⁸m/s and f=5×10⁸Hz, or500MHz, λ=v/f=0.20m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 頻率與波長尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Frequency and wavelength scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頻率與波長尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Frequency and wavelength scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表性土區用已知目標比對不同頻段的可辨識程度，保留增益與濾波設定。驗證目標分離是否重現於重複測線，避免把影像銳化造成的邊緣當真實尺寸。同時排除以下干擾原因：使用高頻卻未檢查導電衰減可能只看到淺層，深部無回波不能證明沒有管線；影像看起來清晰也不代表深度轉換的速度已正確。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare frequency bands on known targets in representative ground, retaining gain and filtering settings. Confirm target separation on repeated lines rather than treating sharpened image edges as actual dimensions. Also rule out the following competing explanation: High frequency without an attenuation check may image only shallow layers. No deep echo does not prove no utility, and sharp images do not establish correct velocity for depth conversion. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接頻率與波長尺度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。在代表性土區用已知目標比對不同頻段的可辨識程度，保留增益與濾波設定。驗證目標分離是否重現於重複測線，避免把影像銳化造成的邊緣當真實尺寸。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over frequency and wavelength scale, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare frequency bands on known targets in representative ground, retaining gain and filtering settings. Confirm target separation on repeated lines rather than treating sharpened image edges as actual dimensions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用高頻卻未檢查導電衰減可能只看到淺層，深部無回波不能證明沒有管線；影像看起來清晰也不代表深度轉換的速度已正確。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High frequency without an attenuation check may image only shallow layers. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頻率與波長尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Frequency and wavelength scale"?
options: 在代表性土區用已知目標比對不同頻段的可辨識程度，保留增益與濾波設定。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要介電常數與波速符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Compare frequency bands on known targets in representative ground, retaining gain and filtering settings.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A nominal result for permittivity and wave speed removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 在代表性土區用已知目標比對不同頻段的可辨識程度，保留增益與濾波設定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare frequency bands on known targets in representative ground, retaining gain and filtering settings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 頻率與波長尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Frequency and wavelength scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻率與波長尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Frequency and wavelength scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用高頻卻未檢查導電衰減可能只看到淺層，深部無回波不能證明沒有管線；影像看起來清晰也不代表深度轉換的速度已正確。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High frequency without an attenuation check may image only shallow layers. No deep echo does not prove no utility, and sharp images do not establish correct velocity for depth conversion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用高頻卻未檢查導電衰減可能只看到淺層，深部無回波不能證明沒有管線；影像看起來清晰也不代表深度轉換的速度已正確。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: No deep echo does not prove no utility, and sharp images do not establish correct velocity for depth conversion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要頻率與波長尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for frequency and wavelength scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 使用高頻卻未檢查導電衰減可能只看到淺層，深部無回波不能證明沒有管線；影像看起來清晰也不代表深度轉換的速度已正確。
knowledge.textEn: High frequency without an attenuation check may image only shallow layers. No deep echo does not prove no utility, and sharp images do not establish correct velocity for depth conversion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頻率與波長尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Frequency and wavelength scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
使用高頻卻未檢查導電衰減可能只看到淺層，深部無回波不能證明沒有管線；影像看起來清晰也不代表深度轉換的速度已正確。
只要傳播衰減範圍符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
High frequency without an attenuation check may image only shallow layers.
A nominal result for propagation attenuation range removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 使用高頻卻未檢查導電衰減可能只看到淺層，深部無回波不能證明沒有管線；影像看起來清晰也不代表深度轉換的速度已正確。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: High frequency without an attenuation check may image only shallow layers. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「傳播衰減範圍」與「介面反射對比」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Propagation attenuation range" and "Interface reflection contrast": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 傳播衰減範圍：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Propagation attenuation range: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「傳播衰減範圍」如何影響地下管線探地雷達探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Propagation attenuation range” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground-penetrating radar for buried utilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 導電與介電損耗會降低振幅，回波還有幾何擴散與反射損失。指數模型只隔離一個衰減機制，單程與雙程必須寫清楚，避免把影像增益誤當訊號真實恢復。假設振幅衰減係數α=2m⁻¹、單程z=1m，A/A0=e^(−αz)=e^(−2)=0.135；雙程同深度僅此項為e^(−4)=0.0183。自動增益同時放大雜訊，容易讓無訊號區出現似管線的條紋；反過來，過度濾波可抹去弱回波，使漏探被誤認為地層均勻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「傳播衰減範圍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Conductive and dielectric losses reduce amplitude, alongside geometric spreading and reflection losses. An exponential model isolates only one mechanism. State whether the path is one-way or round-trip so display gain is not mistaken for recovered physical signal. For amplitude attenuation coefficient α=2m⁻¹ and one-way z=1m, A/A0=e^(−αz)=0.135. The corresponding round-trip factor alone is e^(−4)=0.0183. Automatic gain amplifies noise as well as signal and may create pipe-like stripes. Aggressive filtering can erase weak echoes, turning missed detections into a false impression of uniform ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Propagation attenuation range” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設振幅衰減係數α=2m⁻¹、單程z=1m，A/A0=e^(−αz)=e^(−2)=0.135；雙程同深度僅此項為e^(−4)=0.0183。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For amplitude attenuation coefficient α=2m⁻¹ and one-way z=1m, A/A0=e^(−αz)=0.135.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要傳播衰減範圍符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for propagation attenuation range removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「傳播衰減範圍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Propagation attenuation range”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設振幅衰減係數α=2m⁻¹、單程z=1m，A/A0=e^(−αz)=e^(−2)=0.135；雙程同深度僅此項為e^(−4)=0.0183。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For amplitude attenuation coefficient α=2m⁻¹ and one-way z=1m, A/A0=e^(−αz)=0.135. steps.title: 介面反射對比：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「介面反射對比」如何影響地下管線探地雷達探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interface reflection contrast” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground-penetrating radar for buried utilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電磁阻抗差讓能量在介面反射，振幅與極性受材料、含水、導電性及幾何共同影響。簡式只適用法向入射的無損非磁性介質，不能用一個反射係數唯一識別材質。取兩側εr1=4、εr2=9，以對比指標C=(√εr2−√εr1)/(√εr2+√εr1)=(3−2)/(3+2)=0.20；符號須依電場定義校核。若把同樣振幅一律標成同材質，含水土界面可能被誤當塑膠管；只依顏色圖層決定施工方式，會把顯示比例造成的差異當物性差異。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「介面反射對比」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Impedance contrast causes reflection, with amplitude and polarity affected by material, moisture, conductivity and geometry. The simple relation assumes normal incidence in lossless nonmagnetic media and cannot uniquely identify material from one coefficient. For εr1=4 and εr2=9, contrast index C=(√εr2−√εr1)/(√εr2+√εr1)=(3−2)/(3+2)=0.20. Check sign against the chosen electric-field convention. Equal displayed amplitudes need not imply equal materials; a wet-soil boundary can resemble a plastic pipe. Choosing work methods from colours alone mistakes display scaling for physical properties. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Interface reflection contrast” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 里程輪定位誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Distance wheel location error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「里程輪定位誤差」如何影響地下管線探地雷達探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Distance wheel location error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground-penetrating radar for buried utilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 里程輪把掃描時間轉成平面距離，打滑及坡面路徑會造成比例誤差。雷達深度再準確，也不能補償錯誤的平面坐標，因此定位需要獨立控制點與閉合檢核。已知路段實長10.0m，里程輪顯示10.2m，相對誤差=(10.2−10.0)/10.0=2%；若條件不變，顯示距離需乘10/10.2校正。泥濘表面打滑會造成非固定比例的距離失真，單一校正係數不一定有效；若忽略局部失真，交叉測線可能錯誤配對到不同管線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「里程輪定位誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The distance wheel converts acquisition timing to horizontal position, with slip and sloping travel introducing scale error. Accurate radar depth cannot repair wrong map coordinates, making independent control points and closure checks necessary. For a true10.0m line measured as10.2m, relative error=(10.2−10.0)/10.0=2%. Under unchanged conditions, displayed distance requires a10/10.2 correction factor. Wheel slip on mud can create nonlinear distance distortion that one factor cannot correct. Ignoring local distortion can make crossing profiles falsely identify different utilities as the same line. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Distance wheel location error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 里程輪定位誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Distance wheel location error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「里程輪定位誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Distance wheel location error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在已知基線做往返測試，記錄地表材質、輪徑與接觸狀況。將控制點與雷達測線同步，閉合差超過計畫容許值時重查定位而非只平移成果圖。同時排除以下干擾原因：泥濘表面打滑會造成非固定比例的距離失真，單一校正係數不一定有效；若忽略局部失真，交叉測線可能錯誤配對到不同管線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run forward and reverse checks on a known baseline, noting surface, wheel diameter and contact. Synchronize control points with profiles; excessive closure error requires revisiting positioning rather than merely shifting the finished map. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Wheel slip on mud can create nonlinear distance distortion that one factor cannot correct. Ignoring local distortion can make crossing profiles falsely identify different utilities as the same line. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Synchronize control points with profiles; excessive closure error requires revisiting positioning rather than merely shifting the finished map.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：泥濘表面打滑會造成非固定比例的距離失真，單一校正係數不一定有效；若忽略局部失真，交叉測線可能錯誤配對到不同管線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.instruction: 泥濘表面打滑會造成非固定比例的距離失真，單一校正係數不一定有效；若忽略局部失真，交叉測線可能錯誤配對到不同管線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wheel slip on mud can create nonlinear distance distortion that one factor cannot correct. Ignoring local distortion can make crossing profiles falsely identify different utilities as the same line. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：泥濘表面打滑會造成非固定比例的距離失真，單一校正係數不一定有效；若忽略局部失真，交叉測線可能錯誤配對到不同管線。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要里程輪定位誤差符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for distance wheel location error removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

泥濘表面打滑會造成非固定比例的距離失真，單一校正係數不一定有效；若忽略局部失真，交叉測線可能錯誤配對到不同管線。

Wheel slip on mud can create nonlinear distance distortion that one factor cannot correct.
A nominal result for velocity error propagation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Wheel slip on mud can create nonlinear distance distortion that one factor cannot correct. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 速度誤差傳遞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Velocity error propagation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「速度誤差傳遞」如何影響地下管線探地雷達探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Velocity error propagation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground-penetrating radar for buried utilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 當回波時間固定時，換算深度和速度成正比，所以速度不確定性應隨深度一起交付。資料處理若只報厘米小數位而不報速度範圍，會誇大成果的可信度。在t固定且小變動近似下，Δz/z=Δv/v；取v=0.10m/ns、Δv=0.01m/ns，深度相對變動為10%。把每條測線獨立調速到符合舊圖，可能消除真正的空間差異；這種循環校準只證明符合先驗圖面，不能當作獨立管線位置驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度誤差傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With fixed echo time, converted depth is proportional to velocity, so velocity uncertainty belongs with the depth result. Reporting centimetre decimals without a velocity range exaggerates confidence in the interpretation. With fixed t and a small-change approximation, Δz/z=Δv/v. For v=0.10m/ns and Δv=0.01m/ns, the relative depth variation is10%. Adjusting each line's velocity to match old drawings can erase real spatial variation. Such circular calibration establishes agreement with prior assumptions rather than independently verifying a utility location. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Velocity error propagation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：在t固定且小變動近似下，Δz/z=Δv/v；取v=0.10m/ns、Δv=0.01m/ns，深度相對變動為10%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With fixed t and a small-change approximation, Δz/z=Δv/v.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要速度誤差傳遞符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for velocity error propagation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「速度誤差傳遞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Velocity error propagation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 速度誤差傳遞
knowledge.text: 當回波時間固定時，換算深度和速度成正比，所以速度不確定性應隨深度一起交付。資料處理若只報厘米小數位而不報速度範圍，會誇大成果的可信度。
knowledge.textEn: With fixed echo time, converted depth is proportional to velocity, so velocity uncertainty belongs with the depth result. Reporting centimetre decimals without a velocity range exaggerates confidence in the interpretation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要速度誤差傳遞符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「速度誤差傳遞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: A nominal result for velocity error propagation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for combined depth uncertainty removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
With fixed echo time, converted depth is proportional to velocity, so velocity uncertainty belongs with the depth result.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：在t固定且小變動近似下，Δz/z=Δv/v；取v=0.10m/ns、Δv=0.01m/ns，深度相對變動為10%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With fixed t and a small-change approximation, Δz/z=Δv/v. For v=0.10m/ns and Δv=0.01m/ns, the relative depth variation is10%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對速度建立有證據的上下界，將同一回波分別換算成深度範圍。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 對速度建立有證據的上下界，將同一回波分別換算成深度範圍。比較不同測線與實際揭露點，若偏差隨深度增加，優先檢查速度而非任意移動所有目標。同時排除以下干擾原因：把每條測線獨立調速到符合舊圖，可能消除真正的空間差異；這種循環校準只證明符合先驗圖面，不能當作獨立管線位置驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 把每條測線獨立調速到符合舊圖，可能消除真正的空間差異；這種循環校準只證明符合先驗圖面，不能當作獨立管線位置驗證。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for velocity error propagation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for combined depth uncertainty removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Adjusting each line's velocity to match old drawings can erase real spatial variation.

quiz.explanationEn: Adjusting each line's velocity to match old drawings can erase real spatial variation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「深度合成不確定性」與「管線證據分類」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Combined depth uncertainty" and "Utility evidence classification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 深度合成不確定性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Combined depth uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「深度合成不確定性」如何影響地下管線探地雷達探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Combined depth uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground-penetrating radar for buried utilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 時間拾取與速度都有誤差，兩者獨立時可用一階傳遞合成標準不確定性。若同一校準造成相關性則需加入共變異，所得區間也不等於保證不會誤挖的保護距離。採一階獨立誤差傳遞，z=vt/2，取t=30ns、v=0.10m/ns、σv=0.01m/ns、σt=1ns且獨立，σz=√[(tσv/2)²+(vσt/2)²]=0.158m。遺漏速度系統偏差會讓統計誤差條看似很窄，卻整體偏離真值；即使不確定性算式正確，錯誤的介質模型仍可主導實際定位偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「深度合成不確定性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Both timing picks and velocity carry uncertainty. Independent errors allow first-order combination, while shared calibration may require covariance. The resulting statistical interval is not a guaranteed clearance preventing a utility strike. Using first-order propagation for z=vt/2, t=30ns, v=0.10m/ns, σv=0.01m/ns and independent σt=1ns, σz=√[(tσv/2)²+(vσt/2)²]=0.158m. Omitted systematic velocity bias can produce narrow error bars centred on the wrong depth. Even correct uncertainty arithmetic cannot compensate for a wrong propagation-medium model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Combined depth uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：採一階獨立誤差傳遞，z=vt/2，取t=30ns、v=0.10m/ns、σv=0.01m/ns、σt=1ns且獨立，σz=√[(tσv/2)²+(vσt/2)²]=0.158m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using first-order propagation for z=vt/2, t=30ns, v=0.10m/ns, σv=0.01m/ns and independent σt=1ns, σz=√[(tσv/2)²+(vσt/2)²]=0.158m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要深度合成不確定性符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for combined depth uncertainty removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「深度合成不確定性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Combined depth uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 深度合成不確定性
knowledge.text: 時間拾取與速度都有誤差，兩者獨立時可用一階傳遞合成標準不確定性。若同一校準造成相關性則需加入共變異，所得區間也不等於保證不會誤挖的保護距離。
knowledge.textEn: Both timing picks and velocity carry uncertainty. Independent errors allow first-order combination, while shared calibration may require covariance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要深度合成不確定性符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for combined depth uncertainty removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「深度合成不確定性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Combined depth uncertainty" is correct?
options: 時間拾取與速度都有誤差，兩者獨立時可用一階傳遞合成標準不確定性。
只要深度合成不確定性符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要管線證據分類符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Both timing picks and velocity carry uncertainty.
A nominal result for combined depth uncertainty removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for utility evidence classification removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 時間拾取與速度都有誤差，兩者獨立時可用一階傳遞合成標準不確定性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Both timing picks and velocity carry uncertainty. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 深度合成不確定性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Combined depth uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「深度合成不確定性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Combined depth uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：採一階獨立誤差傳遞，z=vt/2，取t=30ns、v=0.10m/ns、σv=0.01m/ns、σt=1ns且獨立，σz=√[(tσv/2)²+(vσt/2)²]=0.158m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using first-order propagation for z=vt/2, t=30ns, v=0.10m/ns, σv=0.01m/ns and independent σt=1ns, σz=√[(tσv/2)²+(vσt/2)²]=0.158m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：重複拾取回波評估時間散布，另以獨立校準估計速度變異，明列是否相關。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use repeated picks to assess timing scatter and independent calibration for velocity variation, explicitly stating correlation assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：採一階獨立誤差傳遞，z=vt/2，取t=30ns、v=0.10m/ns、σv=0.01m/ns、σt=1ns且獨立，σz=√[(tσv/2)²+(vσt/2)²]=0.158m。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using first-order propagation for z=vt/2, t=30ns, v=0.10m/ns, σv=0.01m/ns and independent σt=1ns, σz=√[(tσv/2)²+(vσt/2)²]=0.158m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「深度合成不確定性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Combined depth uncertainty", which statement holds?
options: 只要雙程時間換深度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

只要頻率與波長尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for two way time to depth removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using first-order propagation for z=vt/2, t=30ns, v=0.10m/ns, σv=0.01m/ns and independent σt=1ns, σz=√[(tσv/2)²+(vσt/2)²]=0.158m.
A nominal result for frequency and wavelength scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.title: 深度合成不確定性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Combined depth uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「深度合成不確定性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Combined depth uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 重複拾取回波評估時間散布，另以獨立校準估計速度變異，明列是否相關。成果表同時列深度、標準不確定性與模型限制，由管線協調人員規劃下一階段確認。同時排除以下干擾原因：遺漏速度系統偏差會讓統計誤差條看似很窄，卻整體偏離真值；即使不確定性算式正確，錯誤的介質模型仍可主導實際定位偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use repeated picks to assess timing scatter and independent calibration for velocity variation, explicitly stating correlation assumptions. Deliver depth, standard uncertainty and model limitations together so utility coordinators can plan subsequent confirmation. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Omitted systematic velocity bias can produce narrow error bars centred on the wrong depth. Even correct uncertainty arithmetic cannot compensate for a wrong propagation-medium model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接深度合成不確定性時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。重複拾取回波評估時間散布，另以獨立校準估計速度變異，明列是否相關。成果表同時列深度、標準不確定性與模型限制，由管線協調人員規劃下一階段確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over combined depth uncertainty, retain original records, units and reference conditions. steps.instructionEn: Omitted systematic velocity bias can produce narrow error bars centred on the wrong depth. steps.title: 管線證據分類：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Utility evidence classification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「管線證據分類」如何影響地下管線探地雷達探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Utility evidence classification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground-penetrating radar for buried utilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管線成果需區分已獨立確認、推測及尚未釐清的目標，避免把完整彩色地圖誤當完整地下清單。雷達與既有紀錄不一致時，應保留衝突而不是以多數票決定真實位置。教學假設24個候選目標中18個得到獨立確認，確認比例18/24=75%；其餘6個仍未解，不能解讀成75%的整體探測率。若把未確認目標刪掉以提高成果整潔度，接手者會誤認該區已排除危險；候選目標的確認率也無法揭示完全沒有回波的漏探管線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「管線證據分類」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Utility deliverables must distinguish independently confirmed, inferred and unresolved targets. A complete-looking colour map is not a complete underground inventory. Conflicts between radar and existing records should remain visible rather than being resolved by a majority vote. If18 of24 candidate targets have independent confirmation, the confirmation fraction is75%. Six remain unresolved; this is not a75% detection rate for all utilities. Deleting unresolved targets to tidy the map implies a hazard-free area to the next user. Confirmation among candidates also says nothing about utilities that produced no detectable echo at all. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Utility evidence classification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設24個候選目標中18個得到獨立確認，確認比例18/24=75%；其餘6個仍未解，不能解讀成75%的整體探測率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If18 of24 candidate targets have independent confirmation, the confirmation fraction is75%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要管線證據分類符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for utility evidence classification removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「管線證據分類」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Utility evidence classification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 管線證據分類
knowledge.text: 管線成果需區分已獨立確認、推測及尚未釐清的目標，避免把完整彩色地圖誤當完整地下清單。雷達與既有紀錄不一致時，應保留衝突而不是以多數票決定真實位置。

quiz.question: 關於「管線證據分類」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接管線證據分類時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。逐目標保存測線、坐標、回波、速度假設與確認方法，並標示未調查區及無法探測深度。開挖前由權責管線單位與工程師審查衝突清單及必要的進一步確認。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over utility evidence classification, retain original records, units and reference conditions. For each target retain lines, coordinates, echoes, velocity assumptions and confirmation method. Mark uninvestigated areas and inaccessible depths; responsible utility owners and engineers review conflicts and further confirmation needs before excavation.

steps.title: 管線證據分類：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Utility evidence classification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「管線證據分類」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Utility evidence classification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把未確認目標刪掉以提高成果整潔度，接手者會誤認該區已排除危險；候選目標的確認率也無法揭示完全沒有回波的漏探管線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Deleting unresolved targets to tidy the map implies a hazard-free area to the next user. Confirmation among candidates also says nothing about utilities that produced no detectable echo at all. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把未確認目標刪掉以提高成果整潔度，接手者會誤認該區已排除危險；候選目標的確認率也無法揭示完全沒有回波的漏探管線。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Confirmation among candidates also says nothing about utilities that produced no detectable echo at all.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要管線證據分類符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for utility evidence classification removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
